However, extending these models to fine-grained dense prediction tasks, such as semantic segmentation and depth estimation, typically necessitates the incorporation of complex, task-specific decoders and other customizations. This architectural fragmentation increases model complexity and deviates from the generalist design of MLLMs, ultimately limiting their practicality. In this work, we challenge this paradigm by accommodating standard MLLMs to perform dense predictions without requiring additional task-specific decoders. The proposed model is called DenseMLLM, grounded in the standard architecture with a novel vision token supervision strategy for multiple labels and tasks. Despite its minimalist design, our model achieves highly competitive performance across a wide range of dense prediction and vision-language benchmarks, demonstrating that a standard, general-purpose MLLM can effectively support dense perception without architectural specialization. This project is available at github.com/Eli-YiLi/DenseMLLM.

</details>


### [390] [Visual Persuasion: What Influences Decisions of Vision-Language Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15278)
*Manuel Cherep,Pranav M R,Pattie Maes,Nikhil Singh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通过揭示偏好框架推断视觉语言模型（VLM）视觉偏好的方法，利用图像编辑工具对输入进行系统性扰动，并通过大规模实验证明优化后的编辑能显著改变模型的选择概率，同时开发了自动可解释性流程来识别驱动选择的视觉主题，为AI代理的视觉安全审计提供支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管视觉语言模型被广泛应用于图像理解和决策，但我们对其视觉偏好的结构知之甚少，缺乏系统性的方法来发现这些模型在视觉选择中的潜在脆弱性和安全问题。

Method: 将VLM的决策函数视为潜在视觉效用，通过揭示偏好方法从系统编辑的图像中推断；提出视觉提示优化方法，将文本优化方法适配到图像生成模型上，迭代地提出并应用视觉上合理的修改（如构图、光照、背景），评估哪些编辑能增加选择概率。

Result: 通过在前沿VLM上的大规模实验，证明优化后的编辑能显著改变模型在两两比较中的选择概率；开发的自动可解释性流程能识别出一致的视觉主题，这些主题驱动了模型的选择偏好。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种实用且高效的方式来发现视觉漏洞和安全问题，这些问题否则可能在真实场景中被隐含地发现，从而支持对基于图像的AI代理进行更主动的审计和治理。

Abstract: The web is littered with images, once created for human consumption and now increasingly interpreted by agents using vision-language models (VLMs). These agents make visual decisions at scale, deciding what to click, recommend, or buy. Yet, we know little about the structure of their visual preferences. We introduce a framework for studying this by placing VLMs in controlled image-based choice tasks and systematically perturbing their inputs. Our key idea is to treat the agent's decision function as a latent visual utility that can be inferred through revealed preference: choices between systematically edited images. Starting from common images, such as product photos, we propose methods for visual prompt optimization, adapting text optimization methods to iteratively propose and apply visually plausible modifications using an image generation model (such as in composition, lighting, or background). We then evaluate which edits increase selection probability. Through large-scale experiments on frontier VLMs, we demonstrate that optimized edits significantly shift choice probabilities in head-to-head comparisons. We develop an automatic interpretability pipeline to explain these preferences, identifying consistent visual themes that drive selection. We argue that this approach offers a practical and efficient way to surface visual vulnerabilities, safety concerns that might otherwise be discovered implicitly in the wild, supporting more proactive auditing and governance of image-based AI agents.

</details>


### [391] [DerMAE: Improving skin lesion classification through conditioned latent diffusion and MAE distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.19848)
*Francisco Filho,Kelvin Cunha,Fábio Papais,Emanoel dos Santos,Rodrigo Mota,Thales Bezerra,Erico Medeiros,Paulo Borba,Tsang Ing Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出使用类别条件扩散模型生成合成皮肤病变图像，结合MAE自监督预训练和大规模ViT，再通过知识蒸馏压缩为轻量模型，在解决类别不平衡问题的同时实现高效临床部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 皮肤病变分类数据集存在严重类别不平衡（恶性样本显著不足），导致深度学习训练产生偏斜的决策边界。

Method: (1) 使用类别条件扩散模型生成合成皮肤镜图像；(2) 在合成数据上进行MAE自监督预训练，使大型ViT学习鲁棒的领域相关特征；(3) 通过知识蒸馏将知识迁移至适合移动设备的小型ViT学生模型。

Result: MAE在合成数据上的预训练结合知识蒸馏，在提升分类性能的同时实现了高效的设备端推理。

Conclusion: 合成数据+自监督预训练+知识蒸馏的组合策略能够有效缓解类别不平衡问题，并支持轻量模型在临床环境中的实际部署。

Abstract: Skin lesion classification datasets often suffer from severe class imbalance, with malignant cases significantly underrepresented, leading to biased decision boundaries during deep learning training. We address this challenge using class-conditioned diffusion models to generate synthetic dermatological images, followed by self-supervised MAE pretraining to enable huge ViT models to learn robust, domain-relevant features. To support deployment in practical clinical settings, where lightweight models are required, we apply knowledge distillation to transfer these representations to a smaller ViT student suitable for mobile devices. Our results show that MAE pretraining on synthetic data, combined with distillation, improves classification performance while enabling efficient on-device inference for practical clinical use.

</details>


### [392] [Contrastive meta-domain adaptation for robust skin lesion classification across clinical and acquisition conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.19857)
*Rodrigo Mota,Kelvin Cunha,Emanoel dos Santos,Fábio Papais,Francisco Filho,Thales Bezerra,Erico Medeiros,Paulo Borba,Tsang Ing Ren*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对皮肤病变分类中的领域偏移问题，提出基于视觉元域的自适应策略，通过从大规模皮肤镜数据集迁移视觉表征到临床图像域，显著提升了分类性能并缩小了皮肤镜与临床图像间的性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型在皮肤科图像分析中对采集变异和领域特异性视觉特征敏感，部署到临床环境时性能下降严重，现有方法缺乏对领域偏移的有效鲁棒性。

Method: 提出基于视觉元域（visual meta-domains）的适应策略，将较大皮肤镜数据集的视觉表征迁移到临床图像领域。

Result: 在多个皮肤科数据集上，分类性能持续提升，皮肤镜与临床图像之间的性能差距显著缩小。

Conclusion: 领域感知训练对于构建可部署的皮肤病变分类系统至关重要，所提方法有效提升了模型的泛化鲁棒性。

Abstract: Deep learning models for dermatological image analysis remain sensitive to acquisition variability and domain-specific visual characteristics, leading to performance degradation when deployed in clinical settings. We investigate how visual artifacts and domain shifts affect deep learning-based skin lesion classification. We propose an adaptation strategy, grounded in the idea of visual meta-domains, that transfers visual representations from larger dermoscopic datasets into clinical image domains, thereby improving generalization robustness. Experiments across multiple dermatology datasets show consistent gains in classification performance and reduced gaps between dermoscopic and clinical images. These results emphasize the importance of domain-aware training for deployable systems.

</details>


### [393] [You Don't Need All That Attention: Surgical Memorization Mitigation in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00133)
*Kairan Zhao,Eleni Triantafillou,Peter Triantafillou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GUARD是一种针对文本到图像扩散模型的记忆缓解框架，通过吸引-排斥动力学调整去噪过程，引导生成远离原始训练图像但仍与提示对齐，并提出基于交叉注意力衰减的具体实现，在多个架构上实现了最先进的记忆缓解效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型会"记忆"训练数据，导致逐字或近似逐字地生成图像，引发隐私泄露或版权侵权问题。

Method: 提出GUARD框架，采用吸引-排斥动力学调整图像去噪过程；具体实现包括：(1) 新颖的统计机制自动识别需要衰减的交叉注意力位置；(2) 在每提示的特定位置衰减交叉注意力，将生成引导向与训练数据不同的方向。

Result: GUARD在两种架构上，针对逐字记忆和模板记忆，均一致地产生了最先进的记忆缓解效果，同时在图像质量方面有所提升或达到可比结果。

Conclusion: GUARD是一种手术式的、动态的、每提示的推理时方法，在记忆缓解方面具有最强的鲁棒性，且不影响图像生成质量。

Abstract: Generative models have been shown to "memorize" certain training data, leading to verbatim or near-verbatim generating images, which may cause privacy concerns or copyright infringement. We introduce Guidance Using Attractive-Repulsive Dynamics (GUARD), a novel framework for memorization mitigation in text-to-image diffusion models. GUARD adjusts the image denoising process to guide the generation away from an original training image and towards one that is distinct from training data while remaining aligned with the prompt, guarding against reproducing training data, without hurting image generation quality. We propose a concrete instantiation of this framework, where the positive target that we steer towards is given by a novel method for (cross) attention attenuation based on (i) a novel statistical mechanism that automatically identifies the prompt positions where cross attention must be attenuated and (ii) attenuating cross-attention in these per-prompt locations. The resulting GUARD offers a surgical, dynamic per-prompt inference-time approach that, we find, is by far the most robust method in terms of consistently producing state-of-the-art results for memorization mitigation across two architectures and for both verbatim and template memorization, while also improving upon or yielding comparable results in terms of image quality.

</details>


### [394] [LookWise: Knowing When and Where to Look for Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00171)
*Yuxiang Shen,Hailong Huang,Zhenkun Gao,Xueheng Li,Man Zhou,Chengjun Xie,Haoxuan Che,Xuanhua He,Jie Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LookWise是一个无需额外训练的自适应视觉推理框架，通过置信度模块和语义引导定位模块，解决现有训练无关方法中的感知冗余和语义-空间偏移问题，在细粒度视觉推理任务上提升准确率并实现约4倍推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLMs训练无关方法存在两个缺陷：一是无差别裁剪导致感知冗余，增加计算成本并引入噪声；二是语义意图与空间注意力之间存在漂移，无法准确定位用户关注的区域。

Method: 提出LookWise框架，采用两阶段流水线：1) 基于置信度的模块决定何时需要更仔细地观察；2) 语义引导的定位模块确定观察位置。无需额外训练即可使MLLMs自适应获取细粒度视觉证据。

Result: 在细粒度及高分辨率视觉推理基准上，LookWise持续优于强基线方法，相比搜索型方法ZoomEye实现约4倍推理加速，并展现出良好的跨模型泛化能力。

Conclusion: LookWise通过轻量级、训练无关的设计有效解决了现有方法的感知冗余和语义-空间漂移问题，在保证精度的同时大幅提升推理效率。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are shifting towards "Thinking with Images" by actively exploring image details. While effective, large-scale training is computationally expensive, which has spurred growing interest in lightweight, training-free solutions. However, existing training-free methods suffer from two flaws: perceptual redundancy from indiscriminate cropping, which increases computational cost and introduces noise; and a drift between semantic intent and spatial attention, which prevents accurate localization of user-focused regions. To address these challenges, we propose LookWise, a framework for adaptive visual reasoning. LookWise follows a two-stage pipeline: a confidence-based module decides when to look more carefully, and a semantic-guided localization module determines where to look. This design enables MLLMs to adaptively acquire fine-grained visual evidence without additional training. Experiments on fine-grained and high-resolution visual reasoning benchmarks show that LookWise consistently improves accuracy over strong baselines while achieving an approximately $4.0\times$ inference speedup over the search-based method ZoomEye, demonstrating robust cross-model generalization.

</details>


### [395] [AutoFFS: Adversarial Deformations for Facial Feminization Surgery Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02288)
*Paul Friedrich,Florentin Bieder,Florian M. Thieringer,Philippe C. Cattin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AutoFFS是一个数据驱动的框架，通过对抗性自由形变生成反事实头骨形态，为跨性别者的面部女性化手术提供定量化的术前规划依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前面部女性化手术的规划主要依赖主观临床评估，缺乏定量且可复现的解剖学指导。

Method: 采用基于形变的目标对抗攻击方法，攻击预训练的二元性别分类器集成模型，通过学习到的性别二态性将个体头骨形状向目标性别转换。

Result: 通过分类器评估、提出的Morphological Fréchet Distance和Morphological Kernel Distance以及人类感知研究，验证了生成形态确实具有目标性别特征。

Conclusion: AutoFFS为FFS手术规划提供了定量基础，推动了这一长期被忽视的患者群体的术前规划进展。

Abstract: Facial feminization surgery (FFS) is a key component of gender affirmation for transgender and gender diverse patients, aiming to reshape craniofacial structures toward a female morphology. Current surgical planning procedures largely rely on subjective clinical assessment, lacking quantitative and reproducible anatomical guidance. We therefore propose AutoFFS, a novel data-driven framework that generates counterfactual skull morphologies through adversarial free-form deformations. Our method performs a deformation-based targeted adversarial attack on an ensemble of pre-trained binary sex classifiers that learned sexual dimorphism, effectively transforming individual skull shapes toward the target sex. The generated counterfactual skull morphologies provide a quantitative foundation for preoperative planning in FFS, driving advances in this largely overlooked patient group. We validate our approach through classifier-based evaluation, propose Morphological Fréchet Distance (MFD) and Morphological Kernel Distance (MKD) to evaluate distributional alignment of generated and real populations, and perform a human perceptual study, confirming that the generated morphologies exhibit target sex characteristics.

</details>


### [396] [A Hypertoroidal Covering for Perfect Color Equivariance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.04256)
*Yulong Yang,Zhikun Xu,Yaojun Li,Christine Allen-Blanchette*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种真正的颜色等变神经网络架构，通过将区间值（饱和度、亮度）提升到圆上的双覆盖表示，解决了先前方法因近似处理而产生的伪影问题，在细粒度分类和医学影像等任务上表现更优，并可将该提升方法推广到尺度等几何变换。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有颜色等变架构将色相变化建模为2D旋转、饱和度和亮度变换建模为1D平移，但将区间值量（饱和度、亮度）近似为实数轴上的平移会引入明显伪影。

Method: 将饱和度、亮度等区间值提升到圆上的双覆盖表示，在此基础上构建真正的等变表示，而非用实数轴近似区间。

Result: 解决了先前方法的近似伪影问题，提高了可解释性和泛化能力，在细粒度分类和医学影像任务上优于传统和等变基线。

Conclusion: 所提出的提升方法不仅适用于颜色变换，还可推广到尺度等几何变换，具有更广泛的适用性。

Abstract: When the color distribution of input images changes at inference, the performance of conventional neural network architectures drops considerably. A few researchers have begun to incorporate prior knowledge of color geometry in neural network design. These color equivariant architectures have modeled hue variation with 2D rotations, and saturation and luminance transformations as 1D translations. While this approach improves neural network robustness to color variations in a number of contexts, we find that approximating saturation and luminance (interval valued quantities) as 1D translations introduces appreciable artifacts. In this paper, we introduce a color equivariant architecture that is truly equivariant. Instead of approximating the interval with the real line, we lift values on the interval to values on the circle (a double-cover) and build equivariant representations there. Our approach resolves the approximation artifacts of previous methods, improves interpretability and generalizability, and achieves better predictive performance than conventional and equivariant baselines on tasks such as fine-grained classification and medical imaging tasks. Going beyond the context of color, we show that our proposed lifting can also extend to geometric transformations such as scale.

</details>


### [397] [WorldCache: Accelerating World Models for Free via Heterogeneous Token Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06331)
*Weilun Feng,Guoxin Fan,Haotong Qin,Mingqiang Wu,Yuqi Li,Xiangqi Li,Zhulin An,Libo Huang,Dingrui Wang,Longlong Liao,Michele Magno,Yongjun Xu,Chuanguang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出WorldCache，一种专为扩散世界模型设计的缓存加速框架，通过曲率引导的异构令牌预测和混沌优先自适应跳过策略，在保持98% rollout质量的同时实现最高3.7倍端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散世界模型虽能统一世界模拟，但迭代去噪过程计算成本过高，难以支持交互式使用和长程推演。现有面向单模态扩散的策略因令牌异构性和非均匀时间动态两大障碍，无法直接迁移到世界模型。

Method: 提出两个核心组件：1) 曲率引导的异构令牌预测：利用基于物理的曲率分数估计令牌可预测性，对方向突变的混沌令牌采用Hermite引导的阻尼预测器；2) 混沌优先自适应跳过：累积曲率归一化的无量纲漂移信号，仅在瓶颈令牌开始漂移时重新计算。

Result: 在扩散世界模型上实现最高3.7倍端到端加速，同时保持98%的rollout质量。

Conclusion: WorldCache在资源受限场景下展示了扩散世界模型加速的巨大优势与实用性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Diffusion-based world models have shown strong potential for unified world simulation, but the iterative denoising remains too costly for interactive use and long-horizon rollouts. While feature caching can accelerate inference without training, we find that policies designed for single-modal diffusion transfer poorly to world models due to two world-model-specific obstacles: \emph{token heterogeneity} from multi-modal coupling and spatial variation, and \emph{non-uniform temporal dynamics} where a small set of hard tokens drives error growth, making uniform skipping either unstable or overly conservative. We propose \textbf{WorldCache}, a caching framework tailored to diffusion world models. We introduce \textit{Curvature-guided Heterogeneous Token Prediction}, which uses a physics-grounded curvature score to estimate token predictability and applies a Hermite-guided damped predictor for chaotic tokens with abrupt direction changes. We also design \textit{Chaotic-prioritized Adaptive Skipping}, which accumulates a curvature-normalized, dimensionless drift signal and recomputes only when bottleneck tokens begin to drift. Experiments on diffusion world models show that WorldCache delivers up to \textbf{3.7$\times$} end-to-end speedups while maintaining \textbf{98\%} rollout quality, demonstrating the vast advantages and practicality of WorldCache in resource-constrained scenarios. Our code is released in https://github.com/FofGofx/WorldCache.

</details>


### [398] [Pinterest Canvas: Large-Scale Image Generation at Pinterest](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06453)
*Yu Wang,Eric Tzeng,Raymond Shiau,Jie Yang,Dmitry Kislyuk,Charles Rosenberg*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍Pinterest Canvas，一个大规模图像生成系统，通过先训练基础扩散模型，再针对下游任务快速微调出专用模型的方式，在背景增强和宽高比外扩等任务上实现了18.0%和12.5%的用户参与度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图像生成模型灵活性虽强，但难以通过简单提示或推理适配来精确控制，无法满足严格的产品需求，因此需要一种既能保持广泛能力又能针对具体任务精确控制的图像生成系统。

Method: 首先在多样化的多模态数据集上训练一个具有广泛图像编辑能力的基础扩散模型，然后针对不同下游任务，在任务特定数据集上快速微调该基础模型的变体，产生专用模型。

Result: 在线A/B实验显示，增强图像分别获得了18.0%和12.5%的参与度提升；与人类评估者的比较进一步验证了模型在相关任务上优于第三方模型。

Conclusion: Canvas系统通过"基础模型+任务特定微调"的范式，能够有效支持多种下游任务（包括背景增强、宽高比外扩、多图像场景合成和图像到视频生成），并满足严格的产品需求。

Abstract: While recent image generation models demonstrate a remarkable ability to handle a wide variety of image generation tasks, this flexibility makes them hard to control via prompting or simple inference adaptation alone, rendering them unsuitable for use cases with strict product requirements. In this paper, we introduce Pinterest Canvas, our large-scale image generation system built to support image editing and enhancement use cases at Pinterest. Canvas is first trained on a diverse, multimodal dataset to produce a foundational diffusion model with broad image-editing capabilities. However, rather than relying on one generic model to handle every downstream task, we instead rapidly fine-tune variants of this base model on task-specific datasets, producing specialized models for individual use cases. We describe key components of Canvas and summarize our best practices for dataset curation, training, and inference. We also showcase task-specific variants through case studies on background enhancement and aspect-ratio outpainting, highlighting how we tackle their specific product requirements. Online A/B experiments demonstrate that our enhanced images receive a significant 18.0% and 12.5% engagement lift, respectively, and comparisons with human raters further validate that our models outperform third-party models on these tasks. Finally, we showcase other Canvas variants, including multi-image scene synthesis and image-to-video generation, demonstrating that our approach can generalize to a wide variety of potential downstream tasks.

</details>


### [399] [MipSLAM: Alias-Free Gaussian Splatting SLAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06989)
*Yingzhao Li,Yan Li,Shixiong Tian,Yanjie Liu,Lijun Zhao,Gim Hee Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MipSLAM是一种频率感知的3D高斯溅射SLAM框架，通过椭圆自适应抗锯齿算法和频谱感知位姿图优化，实现了高保真抗锯齿新视角合成和鲁棒位姿估计，在Replica和TUM数据集上达到SOTA效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于3DGS的SLAM系统因滤波不充分和纯空间优化，存在锯齿伪影和轨迹漂移问题，需要一种能处理多相机配置下抗锯齿渲染和鲁棒位姿估计的方法。

Method: 1) 椭圆自适应抗锯齿(EAA)算法：通过几何感知数值积分近似高斯贡献，避免昂贵的解析计算；2) 频谱感知位姿图优化(SA-PGO)模块：在频域中重新表述轨迹估计，通过图拉普拉斯分析有效抑制高频噪声和漂移。

Result: 在Replica和TUM数据集上的广泛评估表明，MipSLAM在多种分辨率下实现了最先进的渲染质量和定位精度。

Conclusion: 提出的频率感知框架有效解决了3DGS-SLAM中的锯齿伪影和轨迹漂移问题，兼顾了渲染质量与位姿估计精度。

Abstract: This paper introduces MipSLAM, a frequency-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) SLAM framework capable of high-fidelity anti-aliased novel view synthesis and robust pose estimation under varying camera configurations. Existing 3DGS-based SLAM systems often suffer from aliasing artifacts and trajectory drift due to inadequate filtering and purely spatial optimization. To overcome these limitations, we propose an Elliptical Adaptive Anti-aliasing (EAA) algorithm that approximates Gaussian contributions via geometry-aware numerical integration, avoiding costly analytic computation. Furthermore, we present a Spectral-Aware Pose Graph Optimization (SA-PGO) module that reformulates trajectory estimation in the frequency domain, effectively suppressing high-frequency noise and drift through graph Laplacian analysis. Extensive evaluations on Replica and TUM datasets demonstrate that MipSLAM achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality and localization accuracy across multiple resolutions. Code is available at https://github.com/yzli1998/MipSLAM.

</details>


### [400] [Training-Free Coverless Multi-Image Steganography with Access Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09390)
*Minyeol Bae,Si-Hyeon Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MIDAS是一种基于扩散模型的免训练无载体图像隐写框架，通过潜在级融合实现多图像隐藏和特定用户的访问控制，在隐写质量、多样性、鲁棒性和抗检测性方面均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无载体图像隐写方法缺乏鲁棒的访问控制机制，难以在多用户场景下向不同授权用户选择性揭示不同隐藏内容，无法满足可扩展和隐私敏感的信息隐藏需求。

Method: 提出MIDAS框架，包含随机基机制（Random Basis）抑制残差结构信息并附带信息泄漏理论分析，以及潜在向量融合模块（Latent Vector Fusion）重塑聚合潜在表示以更好地对齐扩散过程。

Result: 在访问控制功能、隐写图像质量和多样性、噪声鲁棒性以及抗隐写分析能力上，MIDAS持续优于现有的免训练无载体图像隐写基线方法。

Conclusion: MIDAS建立了一种实用且可扩展的访问控制型无载体隐写方法，为多用户隐私敏感场景下的信息隐藏提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Coverless Image Steganography (CIS) hides information without explicitly modifying a cover image, providing strong imperceptibility and inherent robustness to steganalysis. However, existing CIS methods largely lack robust access control, making it difficult to selectively reveal different hidden contents to different authorized users. Such access control is critical for scalable and privacy-sensitive information hiding in multi-user settings. We propose MIDAS (Multi-Image Diffusion-based Access-controlled Steganography), a training-free diffusion-based CIS framework that enables multi-image hiding with user-specific access control via latent-level fusion. MIDAS introduces a Random Basis mechanism to suppress residual structural information, together with a theoretical analysis of information leakage, and a Latent Vector Fusion module that reshapes aggregated latents to better align with the diffusion process. Experimental results demonstrate that MIDAS consistently outperforms existing training-free CIS baselines in access control functionality, stego image quality and diversity, robustness to noise, and resistance to steganalysis, establishing a practical and scalable approach to access-controlled coverless steganography.

</details>


### [401] [RESBev: Making BEV Perception More Robust](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09529)
*Lifeng Zhuo,Kefan Jin,Zhe Liu,Hesheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RESBev是一种即插即用的鲁棒BEV感知方法，通过构建潜在世界模型在语义特征层面预测清洁BEV特征以修复受损观测，在nuScenes数据集上通过少样本微调显著提升现有BEV感知模型对自然干扰和对抗攻击的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实部署中BEV感知面临传感器退化和对抗攻击导致的感知异常，严重威胁自动驾驶系统安全性，现有方法缺乏对多种干扰的通用鲁棒性增强方案。

Method: 将感知鲁棒性重新定义为潜在语义预测问题，构建潜在世界模型提取时序BEV观测的时空相关性，学习潜在BEV状态转移以预测清洁BEV特征并重建受损观测；该方法在Lift-Splat-Shoot管道的语义特征层面运行，无需修改骨干网络即可泛化至自然干扰和对抗攻击。

Result: 在nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，经过少样本微调后，RESBev显著提升了现有BEV感知模型在多种外部干扰和对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: RESBev作为一种即插即用框架，能够有效增强BEV感知系统对多样扰动的鲁棒性，为提升自动驾驶系统的安全性提供了一种通用且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception has emerged as a cornerstone of autonomous driving systems, providing a structured, ego-centric representation critical for downstream planning and control. However, real-world deployment faces challenges from sensor degradation and adversarial attacks, which can cause severe perceptual anomalies and ultimately compromise the safety of autonomous driving systems. To address this, we propose a resilient and plug-and-play BEV perception method, RESBev, which can be easily applied to existing BEV perception methods to enhance their robustness to diverse disturbances. Specifically, we reframe perception robustness as a latent semantic prediction problem. A latent world model is constructed to extract spatiotemporal correlations across sequential BEV observations, thereby learning the underlying BEV state transitions to predict clean BEV features for reconstructing corrupted observations. The proposed framework operates at the semantic feature level of the Lift-Splat-Shoot pipeline, enabling recovery that generalizes across both natural disturbances and adversarial attacks without modifying the underlying backbone. Extensive experiments on the nuScenes dataset demonstrate that, with few-shot fine-tuning, RESBev significantly improves the robustness of existing BEV perception models against various external disturbances and adversarial attacks.

</details>


### [402] [To See or To Please: Uncovering Visual Sycophancy and Split Beliefs in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18373)
*Rui Hong,Shuxue Quan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出三层诊断框架，通过潜在异常检测、视觉必要性评分和竞争评分三个指标，揭示VLM在72.9%的样本中表现出视觉迎合现象（Visual Sycophancy），即内部保留正确视觉证据却解码出幻觉答案，且零样本表现出稳健拒绝（Robust Refusal）。扩展Qwen-VL家族时，规模增大单调减少语言捷径但加剧视觉迎合，表明规模和新后训练无法解决接地问题。诊断分数可实现免训练的选择性预测策略，在50%覆盖率下准确率提升+9.5个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视觉语言模型（VLM）虽然能正确回答问题时，但不确定它们是否真正依赖视觉信息，还是仅凭语言先验或表面模式。现有方法缺乏细粒度诊断来区分感知、依赖和对齐三类失败。

Method: 提出三层诊断框架，包含三个每样本指标：1）潜在异常检测（Latent Anomaly Detection）——检测内部表示是否与视觉证据一致；2）视觉必要性评分（Visual Necessity Score）——衡量视觉信息对正确答案的必要性；3）竞争评分（Competition Score）——量化视觉与语言信息在解码阶段的竞争。在9个VLM和9000个模型-样本对上实施反事实盲、噪声和冲突干预。

Result: 72.9%的样本表现出视觉迎合（Visual Sycophancy）——内部证据完整但解码出幻觉答案；零样本表现出稳健拒绝（Robust Refusal）。Qwen-VL系列中规模增大单调减少语言捷径但增加视觉迎合。诊断分数引导的免训练选择性预测策略在50%覆盖率下提升+9.5个百分点的准确率。

Conclusion: 当前对齐训练消除了稳健拒绝作为解码结果，但无法解决接地问题；规模扩展和新后训练技术本身不足以让VLM真正依赖视觉信息；提出的诊断框架可有效检测和缓解视觉幻觉问题。

Abstract: When VLMs answer correctly, do they genuinely rely on visual information? We introduce a Tri-Layer Diagnostic Framework with three per-sample metrics: Latent Anomaly Detection, Visual Necessity Score, and Competition Score, which disentangle perception, dependency, and alignment failures. Across 9 VLMs and 9,000 model-sample pairs under counterfactual blind, noise, and conflict interventions, 72.9% of samples exhibit Visual Sycophancy, a Split Beliefs pattern in which internal evidence is preserved yet a hallucinated answer is decoded, while zero samples show Robust Refusal, indicating that current alignment training has eliminated refusal as a decoding outcome. Scaling within the Qwen-VL family, both within- and across-generation, monotonically reduces Language Shortcuts but amplifies Visual Sycophancy, showing that scale and newer post-training alone cannot resolve the grounding problem. Diagnostic scores further enable a training-free selective-prediction strategy yielding up to +9.5 percentage points accuracy at 50% coverage.

</details>


### [403] [Beyond String Matching: Semantic Evaluation of PDF Table Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.18652)
*Pius Horn,Janis Keuper*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出基于LLM-as-a-judge的表格语义评估框架，通过合成PDF基准测试发现LLM评估（r=0.93）显著优于传统TEDS（r=0.68）和GriTS（r=0.70），并评估了21种PDF解析器在451个表格上的性能差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PDF表格提取评估依赖基于规则的指标（如TEDS、GriTS），无法捕捉表格内容的语义等价性，亟需更符合人类判断的评估方法。

Method: 1）从arXiv获取表格构建合成PDF基准，确保真实复杂度；2）提出LLM-as-a-judge的语义评估方法，集成到匹配流水线中处理解析器输出不一致性；3）通过1500+人类判断验证LLM评估与人类判断的相关性。

Result: LLM评估与人类判断的Pearson相关系数r=0.93，远超TEDS（r=0.68）和GriTS（r=0.70）；21种PDF解析器在451个表格上表现出显著性能差异。

Conclusion: LLM-as-a-judge为PDF表格提取提供了可复现、可扩展的语义评估方法，并为实际场景中选择表格解析器提供了指导。

Abstract: Reliably extracting tables from PDFs is essential for large-scale scientific data mining and knowledge base construction, yet existing evaluation approaches rely on rule-based metrics that fail to capture semantic equivalence of table content. We present a benchmarking framework based on synthetically generated PDFs with precise LaTeX ground truth, using tables sourced from arXiv to ensure realistic complexity and diversity. As our central methodological contribution, we apply LLM-as-a-judge for semantic table evaluation, integrated into a matching pipeline that accommodates inconsistencies in parser outputs. Through a human validation study comprising over 1,500 quality judgments on extracted table pairs, we show that LLM-based evaluation achieves substantially higher correlation with human judgment (Pearson r=0.93) compared to currently used Tree Edit Distance-based Similarity (TEDS, r=0.68) and Grid Table Similarity (GriTS, r=0.70). Evaluating 21 contemporary PDF parsers across 100 synthetic documents containing 451 tables reveals significant performance disparities. Our results offer practical guidance for selecting parsers for tabular data extraction and establish a reproducible, scalable evaluation methodology for this critical task.
  Code and data: https://github.com/phorn1/pdf-parse-bench Metric study and human evaluation: https://github.com/phorn1/table-metric-study

</details>


### [404] [LagerNVS: Latent Geometry for Fully Neural Real-time Novel View Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.20176)
*Stanislaw Szymanowicz,Minghao Chen,Jianyuan Wang,Christian Rupprecht,Andrea Vedaldi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LagerNVS是一个编码器-解码器神经网络，通过从3D重建网络初始化的编码器提取"3D感知"潜在特征，在无需显式3D重建的情况下实现了最先进的新视角合成性能（Re10k上PSNR 31.4），支持实时渲染、泛化到野外数据，并可结合扩散解码器进行生成式外推。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 证明强3D归纳偏置在新视角合成网络设计中仍然有益，尽管已有工作表明神经网络可以在没有显式3D重建的情况下完成3D任务。

Method: 提出LagerNVS编码器-解码器架构：编码器从使用显式3D监督预训练的3D重建网络初始化，提取"3D感知"潜在特征；搭配轻量级解码器，通过光度损失进行端到端训练。

Result: 在Re10k上达到31.4 PSNR，实现最先进的确定性前馈新视角合成；支持已知和未知相机参数；实现实时渲染；可泛化到野外数据；可与扩散解码器结合用于生成式外推。

Conclusion: 强3D归纳偏置在新视角合成网络设计中仍然是有益的，通过将3D重建网络的先验知识引入编码器，可以显著提升NVS性能。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that neural networks can perform 3D tasks such as Novel View Synthesis (NVS) without explicit 3D reconstruction. Even so, we argue that strong 3D inductive biases are still helpful in the design of such networks. We show this point by introducing LagerNVS, an encoder-decoder neural network for NVS that builds on `3D-aware' latent features. The encoder is initialized from a 3D reconstruction network pre-trained using explicit 3D supervision. This is paired with a lightweight decoder, and trained end-to-end with photometric losses. LagerNVS achieves state-of-the-art deterministic feed-forward Novel View Synthesis (including 31.4 PSNR on Re10k), with and without known cameras, renders in real time, generalizes to in-the-wild data, and can be paired with a diffusion decoder for generative extrapolation.

</details>


### [405] [λSplit: Self-Supervised Content-Aware Spectral Unmixing for Fluorescence Microscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23647)
*Federico Carrara,Talley Lambert,Mehdi Seifi,Florian Jug*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: λSplit是一个物理信息引导的深度生成模型，利用分层变分自编码器学习浓度图的条件分布，通过可微分的频谱混合器确保与图像形成过程的一致性，在荧光显微镜频谱分离任务上达到新最优水平，尤其在高噪声、严重光谱重叠和低光谱维度条件下表现突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统荧光显微镜频谱分离方法基于逐像素最小二乘拟合，在发射光谱高度重叠和高噪声条件下性能严重下降；现有基于学习的方法要么未针对显微数据进行优化，要么仅适用于特定场景而无法泛化到荧光显微镜设置。因此需要一种能够学习并利用结构先验的数据驱动方法以提升频谱分离效果。

Method: 提出λSplit，一种物理信息引导的深度生成模型。核心架构为分层变分自编码器，学习浓度图的条件分布；其中可微分的Spectral Mixer模块强制执行与图像形成物理过程的一致性约束；模型通过学习到的结构先验实现频谱分离与隐式噪声去除。

Result: 在3个真实数据集上合成构建了66个挑战性频谱分离基准，与10种基线方法（包括经典方法和多种学习方法）对比。在低噪声条件下具有竞争力，在高噪声、光谱严重重叠及低光谱维度情况下展现出明显更好的鲁棒性，达到新的最优水平。

Conclusion: λSplit在荧光显微镜频谱分离任务上实现了新的最优性能，且兼容标准共聚焦显微镜产生的光谱数据，无需专用硬件改造即可直接采用。

Abstract: In fluorescence microscopy, spectral unmixing aims to recover individual fluorophore concentrations from spectral images that capture mixed fluorophore emissions. Since classical methods operate pixel-wise and rely on least-squares fitting, their performance degrades with increasingly overlapping emission spectra and higher levels of noise, suggesting that a data-driven approach that can learn and utilize a structural prior might lead to improved results. Learning-based approaches for spectral imaging do exist, but they are either not optimized for microscopy data or are developed for very specific cases that are not applicable to fluorescence microscopy settings. To address this, we propose λSplit, a physics-informed deep generative model that learns a conditional distribution over concentration maps using a hierarchical Variational Autoencoder. A fully differentiable Spectral Mixer enforces consistency with the image formation process, while the learned structural priors enable state-of-the-art unmixing and implicit noise removal. We demonstrate λSplit on 3 real-world datasets that we synthetically cast into a total of 66 challenging spectral unmixing benchmarks. We compare our results against a total of 10 baseline methods, including classical methods and a range of learning-based methods. Our results consistently show competitive performance and improved robustness in high noise regimes, when spectra overlap considerably, or when the spectral dimensionality is lowered, making λSplit a new state-of-the-art for spectral unmixing of fluorescent microscopy data. Importantly, λSplit is compatible with spectral data produced by standard confocal microscopes, enabling immediate adoption without specialized hardware modifications.

</details>


### [406] [Learning to Trim: End-to-End Causal Graph Pruning with Dynamic Anatomical Feature Banks for Medical VQA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.26028)
*Zibo Xu,Qiang Li,Weizhi Nie,Yuting Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可学习因果剪枝框架LCT，通过动态解剖特征库和可微分剪枝模块，在端到端优化中抑制虚假关联，提升MedVQA模型的泛化性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MedVQA模型因依赖数据集层面的虚假关联（如解剖模式、问题类型规律）而非真正诊断证据，导致泛化能力受限；现有因果方法多为静态调整或事后修正，缺乏端到端可学习的因果干预机制。

Method: 提出LCT框架：1) 动态解剖特征库(DAFB)通过动量机制更新，捕捉数据集级别全局原型；2) 可微分剪枝模块估计实例特征与全局原型的依赖度，高相关特征被软抑制，实例特有证据被增强，实现端到端因果剪枝。

Result: 在VQA-RAD、SLAKE、SLAKE-CP和PathVQA四个基准上，LCT一致优于现有去偏策略，显著提升了模型的鲁棒性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 可学习的因果剪枝框架能有效替代静态因果调整，通过软抑制数据集级虚假关联、突出实例级因果信号，为MedVQA提供更通用的去偏方案。

Abstract: Medical Visual Question Answering (MedVQA) models often exhibit limited generalization due to reliance on dataset-specific correlations, such as recurring anatomical patterns or question-type regularities, rather than genuine diagnostic evidence. Existing causal approaches are typically implemented as static adjustments or post-hoc corrections. To address this issue, we propose a Learnable Causal Trimming (LCT) framework that integrates causal pruning into end-to-end optimization. We introduce a Dynamic Anatomical Feature Bank (DAFB), updated via a momentum mechanism, to capture global prototypes of frequent anatomical and linguistic patterns, serving as an approximation of dataset-level regularities. We further design a differentiable trimming module that estimates the dependency between instance-level representations and the global feature bank. Features highly correlated with global prototypes are softly suppressed, while instance-specific evidence is emphasized. This learnable mechanism encourages the model to prioritize causal signals over spurious correlations adaptively. Experiments on VQA-RAD, SLAKE, SLAKE-CP and PathVQA demonstrate that LCT consistently improves robustness and generalization over existing debiasing strategies.

</details>


### [407] [Limits of Spatial Imagery Reasoning in Frontier LLM Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.26779)
*Sergio Y. Hayashi,Nina S. T. Hirata*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文探究了为LLM配备外部“意象模块”（能渲染和旋转3D模型的工具）是否能弥补其在心理旋转等空间任务上的不足。实验采用双模块架构（推理模块MLLM+意象模块）在3D模型旋转任务上测试，准确率最高仅62.5%。进一步分析表明，即使将3D状态的维护和操作外化，系统仍然失败，原因是当前前沿模型缺乏与意象模块交互所需的基础视觉空间原语，包括：(1) 提取深度、运动、短期动态预测等空间信号的低级敏感性；(2) 对图像进行沉思性推理、动态切换视觉焦点、平衡意象与符号/关联信息的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在需要心理模拟的空间任务（如心理旋转）上表现不佳。作者希望探究通过外部工具（意象模块）来弥补这一缺陷，验证“认知假体”思路是否可行。

Method: 构建双模块架构：推理模块（MLLM）与意象模块（能渲染和旋转3D模型的工具）交互，在3D模型旋转任务上进行实验，并进一步分析失败原因。

Result: 准确率最高仅62.5%，性能低于预期。即使将3D状态维护和操作外化，系统仍然失败。

Conclusion: 当前前沿模型缺乏与外部意象模块有效交互所需的基础视觉空间原语，具体包括低级的空间信号提取能力和高级的沉思性图像推理能力。仅靠外化空间操作不足以解决LLM在空间推理上的根本局限。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive reasoning capabilities, yet they struggle with spatial tasks that require mental simulation, such as mental rotation. This paper investigates whether equipping an LLM with an external ``Imagery Module'' -- a tool capable of rendering and rotating 3D models -- can bridge this gap, functioning as a ``cognitive prosthetic.'' We conducted experiments using a dual-module architecture in which a reasoning module (an MLLM) interacts with an imagery module on 3D model rotation tasks. Performance was lower than expected, with accuracy reaching at most 62.5%. Further investigation suggests that even when the burden of maintaining and manipulating a holistic 3D state is outsourced, the system still fails. This reveals that current frontier models lack the foundational visual-spatial primitives required to interface with imagery. Specifically, they lack: (1) the low-level sensitivity to extract spatial signals such as (a) depth, (b) motion, and (c) short-horizon dynamic prediction; and (2) the capacity to reason contemplatively over images, dynamically shifting visual focus and balancing imagery with symbolic and associative information.

</details>


### [408] [EuraGovExam: A Multilingual Multimodal Benchmark from Real-World Civil Service Exams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27223)
*Jaeseong Kim,Chaehwan Lim,Sang Hyun Gil,Suan Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EuraGovExam是一个从欧亚五个地区（韩国、日本、台湾、印度、欧盟）真实公务员考试中构建的多语言多模态基准，包含8000+高分辨率扫描多选题，要求视觉-语言模型直接从图像中进行布局感知的跨语言推理，最先进模型也仅达86%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准缺乏能反映真实公共部门考试复杂性的多语言、多模态数据集，特别是需要处理包含表格、多语排印和表单布局的真实扫描文档的场景。

Method: 从五个欧亚地区真实公务员考试文档中收集8000+扫描多选题，所有问题内容（题干、选项、视觉元素）嵌入单一图像中，仅提供标准化的答案格式指令，要求模型直接进行视觉驱动的布局感知推理。

Result: 最先进的视觉-语言模型在EuraGovExam上仅达到86%准确率，证明该基准具有挑战性且能有效诊断当前模型的能力局限。

Conclusion: EuraGovExam通过强调文化真实性、视觉复杂性和语言多样性，为评估高风险、多语言、图像驱动场景下的VLM建立了新标准，并支持电子政务、公共文档分析和公平考试准备等实际应用。

Abstract: We present EuraGovExam, a multilingual and multimodal benchmark sourced from real-world civil service examinations across five representative Eurasian regions: South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, India, and the European Union. Designed to reflect the authentic complexity of public-sector assessments, the dataset contains over 8,000 high-resolution scanned multiple-choice questions covering 17 diverse academic and administrative domains. Unlike existing benchmarks, EuraGovExam embeds all question content--including problem statements, answer choices, and visual elements--within a single image, providing only a minimal standardized instruction for answer formatting. This design demands that models perform layout-aware, cross-lingual reasoning directly from visual input. All items are drawn from real exam documents, preserving rich visual structures such as tables, multilingual typography, and form-like layouts. Evaluation results show that even state-of-the-art vision-language models (VLMs) achieve only 86% accuracy, underscoring the benchmark's difficulty and its power to diagnose the limitations of current models. By emphasizing cultural realism, visual complexity, and linguistic diversity, EuraGovExam establishes a new standard for evaluating VLMs in high-stakes, multilingual, image-grounded settings. It also supports practical applications in e-governance, public-sector document analysis, and equitable exam preparation.

</details>


### [409] [OpenDPR: Open-Vocabulary Change Detection via Vision-Centric Diffusion-Guided Prototype Retrieval for Remote Sensing Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27645)
*Qi Guo,Jue Wang,Yinhe Liu,Yanfei Zhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OpenDPR框架，通过扩散模型构建原型检索（解决类别识别瓶颈）和S2C弱监督变化检测模块（解决变化定位瓶颈），在开放词汇变化检测任务上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放词汇变化检测（OVCD）旨在识别任意变化类别，但现有方法存在两个瓶颈：1) 基于图像-文本匹配的VLM（如CLIP）难以表示细粒度土地覆盖类别，导致类别识别错误；2) VFM（如SAM、DINOv2）缺乏变化先验知识，导致变化定位不准确。

Method: 提出OpenDPR框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 训练无关的扩散引导原型检索（利用扩散模型离线构建目标类别多样化原型，推理时在视觉空间与变化提议进行相似性检索）；2) 空间到变化（S2C）弱监督变化检测模块（将VFM的强空间建模能力适配到变化定位任务）。将S2C集成到OpenDPR得到弱监督变体OpenDPR-W。

Result: 在四个基准数据集上，所提方法在两种监督模式下均达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: 通过揭示OVCD的两个主要瓶颈（类别识别和变化定位），并分别提出扩散模型原型检索和S2C模块，有效提升了开放词汇变化检测的性能。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary change detection (OVCD) seeks to recognize arbitrary changes of interest by enabling generalization beyond a fixed set of predefined classes. We reformulate OVCD as a two-stage pipeline: first generate class-agnostic change proposals using visual foundation models (VFMs) such as SAM and DINOv2, and then perform category identification with vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP. We reveal that category identification errors are the primary bottleneck of OVCD, mainly due to the limited ability of VLMs based on image-text matching to represent fine-grained land-cover categories. To address this, we propose OpenDPR, a training-free vision-centric diffusion-guided prototype retrieval framework. OpenDPR leverages diffusion models to construct diverse prototypes for target categories offline, and to perform similarity retrieval with change proposals in the visual space during inference. The secondary bottleneck lies in change localization, due to the inherent lack of change priors in VFMs. To bridge this gap, we design a spatial-to-change weakly supervised change detection module named S2C to adapt their strong spatial modeling capabilities for change localization. Integrating the pretrained S2C into OpenDPR leads to an optional weakly supervised variant named OpenDPR-W, which further improves OVCD with minimal supervision. Experimental results on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed methods achieve state-of-the-art performance under both supervision modes. Code is available at https://github.com/guoqi2002/OpenDPR.

</details>


### [410] [FlowIt: Global Matching via Hierarchical Transformers and Optimal Transport for Optical Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.28759)
*Sadra Safadoust,Fabio Tosi,Matteo Poggi,Fatma Güney*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlowIt是一种结合全局匹配与置信度/遮挡引导精化的光流估计新架构，通过层次化Transformer捕获长距离对应关系，将流初始化建模为最优传输问题以获取鲁棒的初始流场及显式的遮挡和置信度图，并在引导精化阶段从高置信区域向低置信区域传播可靠运动估计。在Sintel、Spring和LayeredFlow上实现了零样本泛化的新SOTA，在KITTI上也取得竞争性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有光流估计方法受限于局部匹配，难以有效建模长距离对应关系，且缺乏对遮挡和置信度的显式建模与利用，导致在歧义区域的估计不准确。

Method: 采用层次化Transformer架构捕获全局上下文；将流初始化建模为最优传输问题，获得鲁棒初始流场及显式的遮挡和置信度图；通过引导精化阶段，从高置信区域向低置信区域传播可靠运动信息。

Result: 在Sintel基准上达到SOTA；在Sintel、Spring、LayeredFlow上创下跨数据集零样本泛化的新SOTA；在KITTI基准和零样本泛化设置下取得竞争性表现。

Conclusion: FlowIt验证了全局匹配与置信度/遮挡引导精化相结合的有效性，为光流估计中的长距离对应和歧义区域处理提供了新的范式。

Abstract: We present FlowIt, a novel architecture for optical flow estimation that combines global matching with confidence and occlusion-guided refinement. At its core, FlowIt leverages a hierarchical transformer architecture that captures extensive global context, enabling the model to effectively model long-range correspondences. To overcome the limitations of localized matching, we formulate the flow initialization as an optimal transport problem. This formulation yields a highly robust initial flow field, alongside explicitly derived occlusion and confidence maps. These cues are then seamlessly integrated into a guided refinement stage, where the network actively propagates reliable motion estimates from high-confidence regions into ambiguous, low-confidence areas. Extensive experiments across the Sintel, KITTI, Spring, and LayeredFlow datasets validate the effectiveness of our approach. FlowIt achieves state-of-the-art results on the competitive Sintel benchmark and establishes new state-of-the-art cross-dataset zero-shot generalization performance on Sintel, Spring, and LayeredFlow, while also delivering competitive performance on both the KITTI benchmark and KITTI zero-shot generalization settings.

</details>


### [411] [MMTalker: Multiresolution 3D Talking Head Synthesis with Multimodal Feature Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02941)
*Bin Liu,Zhixiang Xiong,Zhifen He,Bo Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MMTalker，一种基于多分辨率表示和多模态特征融合的3D语音驱动面部动画合成方法。通过网格参数化和非均匀可微采样实现连续表示，利用残差图卷积网络和双交叉注意力机制提取多模态特征，最后用轻量级回归网络预测顶点位移。实验表明在唇部和眼部运动同步精度上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前语音驱动3D面部动画合成方法在唇形同步精度和面部表情真实性方面仍面临挑战，这主要源于跨模态映射的高度病态性。现有方法难以准确重建3D面部运动的丰富细节。

Method: 1) 通过网格参数化和非均匀可微采样实现3D面部的连续表示；2) 采用残差图卷积网络和双交叉注意力机制提取多模态判别性面部运动特征；3) 轻量级回归网络联合处理UV空间采样点和编码的面部运动特征，预测顶点几何位移。

Result: 实验证明该方法在唇部和眼部运动同步精度上显著优于现有方法。

Conclusion: MMTalker通过多分辨率表示和多模态特征融合有效解决了语音驱动3D面部动画中的同步精度和表情真实性问题。

Abstract: Speech-driven three-dimensional (3D) facial animation synthesis aims to build a mapping from one-dimensional (1D) speech signals to time-varying 3D facial motion signals. Current methods still face challenges in maintaining lip-sync accuracy and producing realistic facial expressions, primarily due to the highly ill-posed nature of this cross-modal mapping. In this paper, we introduce a novel 3D audio-driven facial animation synthesis method through multi-resolution representation and multi-modal feature fusion, called MMTalker which can accurately reconstruct the rich details of 3D facial motion.
  We first achieve the continuous representation of 3D face with details by mesh parameterization and non-uniform differentiable sampling. The mesh parameterization technique establishes the correspondence between UV plane and 3D facial mesh and is used to offer ground truth for the continuous learning. Differentiable non-uniform sampling enables precise facial detail acquisition by setting learnable sampling probability in each triangular face. Next, we employ residual graph convolutional network and dual cross-attention mechanism to extract discriminative facial motion feature from multiple input modalities. This proposed multimodal fusion strategy takes full use of the hierarchical features of speech and the explicit spatiotemporal geometric features of facial mesh. Finally, a lightweight regression network predicts the vertex-wise geometric displacements of the synthesized talking face by jointly processing the sampled points in the canonical UV space and the encoded facial motion features.
  Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that significant improvements are achieved over state-of-the-art methods, especially in the synchronization accuracy of lip and eye movements.

</details>


### [412] [Frequency-Enhanced Diffusion Models: Curriculum-Guided Semantic Alignment for Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09063)
*Yuxi Zhou,Zhengbo Zhang,Jingyu Pan,Zhiyu Lin,Zhigang Tu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出频域感知扩散模型FDSM用于零样本骨架动作识别，通过语义引导的频谱残差模块、时间步自适应频谱损失和课程式语义抽象，解决了扩散模型频谱偏差导致的高频动态过平滑问题，在多个数据集上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监督式骨架动作识别依赖大量标注，难以泛化到新动作；零样本骨架动作识别中，扩散模型的频谱偏差会过度平滑高频动态信息，导致细粒度运动细节丢失。

Method: 提出FDSM，包含三个核心组件：(1) 语义引导的频谱残差模块，用于恢复高频细节；(2) 时间步自适应频谱损失，动态平衡不同频率成分的学习；(3) 课程式语义抽象，逐步提升语义表征的抽象层次。

Result: 在NTU RGB+D、PKU-MMD和Kinetics-skeleton数据集上均达到当前最优性能。

Conclusion: FDSM有效恢复了细粒度运动细节，为扩散模型在零样本骨架动作识别中的频谱偏差问题提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Human action recognition is pivotal in computer vision, with applications ranging from surveillance to human-robot interaction. Despite the effectiveness of supervised skeleton-based methods, their reliance on exhaustive annotation limits generalization to novel actions. Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition (ZSAR) emerges as a promising paradigm, yet it faces challenges due to the spectral bias of diffusion models, which oversmooth high-frequency dynamics. Here, we propose Frequency-Aware Diffusion for Skeleton-Text Matching (FDSM), integrating a Semantic-Guided Spectral Residual Module, a Timestep-Adaptive Spectral Loss, and Curriculum-based Semantic Abstraction to address these challenges. Our approach effectively recovers fine-grained motion details, achieving state-of-the-art performance on NTU RGB+D, PKU-MMD, and Kinetics-skeleton datasets. Code has been made available at https://github.com/yuzhi535/FDSM. Project homepage: https://yuzhi535.github.io/FDSM.github.io/

</details>


### [413] [BareBones: Benchmarking Zero-Shot Geometric Comprehension in VLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10528)
*Aaditya Baranwal,Vishal Yadav,Abhishek Rajora*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BareBones是一个零样本基准测试，通过剔除RGB纹理、仅保留轮廓剪影来评估VLM对纯几何形状的理解能力。测试26个先进VLM后发现，在去除纹理后模型性能严重崩溃，揭示了普遍的“纹理偏差悬崖”现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM的零样本识别能力是否真正理解几何结构，还是仅利用RGB纹理和上下文先验作为统计捷径？已有评估方法无法隔离这一机制，混淆了语义推理与纹理映射，且标注不精确会泄露环境线索。

Method: 构建BareBones基准，使用像素级轮廓剪影（去除RGB纹理）测试纯几何形状理解。数据集包括5个现有分割数据集（ImageNet-S、DIS5K、ThinObject5K、PASCAL VOC、CUB-200）和自建的WTP-Bench旗舰集，后者是基于边界轮廓的细粒度视觉谜题。

Result: 在26个先进VLM（GPT-4.1、Gemini、Claude Sonnet 4.5、LLaVA等）上测试发现，去除RGB后模型性能一致且严重下降，即“纹理偏差悬崖”。

Conclusion: VLM存在普遍的结构性盲点，缺乏真正的几何空间理解；BareBones可作为评估几何推理能力的严格标尺。

Abstract: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate remarkable zero-shot recognition capabilities across a diverse spectrum of multimodal tasks, it yet remains an open question whether these architectures genuinely comprehend geometric structure or merely exploit RGB textures and contextual priors as statistical shortcuts. Existing evaluations fail to isolate this mechanism, conflating semantic reasoning with texture mapping and relying on imprecise annotations that inadvertently leak environmental cues. To address this gap, we introduce $\textbf{BareBones}$, a zero-shot benchmark designed to stress-test pure geometric shape comprehension. We curate pixel-level silhouettes of geometrically distinct classes across six datasets: five established segmentation sources (ImageNet-S, DIS5K, ThinObject5K, PASCAL VOC, CUB-200) and our novel flagship collection, WTP-Bench, establishing a noise-free geometric taxonomy. WTP-Bench is an extreme, fine-grained visual puzzle that forces models to identify inter-class geometric concepts from boundary contours alone. Our evaluation of 26 state-of-the-art proprietary and open-weight VLMs (eg. GPT-4.1, Gemini, Claude Sonnet 4.5, LLaVA) reveals a consistent, severe performance collapse under RGB deprivation, a phenomenon we term the $\textit{Texture Bias Cliff}$. By documenting universal structural blindspots, BareBones establishes a rigorous yardstick for genuine geometric grounding. Project Page: https://eternal-f1ame.github.io/WTP-Bench/

</details>


### [414] [Multimodal Large Language Model-Enabled Video Translation: A Role-Oriented Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11283)
*Bingzheng Qu,Kehai Chen,Xuefeng Bai,Min Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文综述了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在视频翻译中的应用，将传统的级联流水线（ASR、机器翻译、TTS、唇形同步）统一为多模态推理与生成问题，并按照语义推理器、表达性表演者、视觉合成器三种功能角色对现有研究进行分类，总结了数据集、基准、评估方法及未来挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频翻译传统上采用级联流水线方式，各模块独立运行，难以实现跨模态的语义保真、时间对齐、说话人一致性和情感表达。MLLM的出现使统一建模成为可能，但目前缺乏系统性的综述来梳理这一新兴方向的研究进展与挑战。

Method: 采用角色导向的分类法，将MLLM驱动的视频翻译研究划分为三个功能角色：Semantic Reasoner（基于视频理解、时间推理和多模态融合进行翻译）、Expressive Performer（支持可控且上下文感知的语音生成）、Visual Synthesizer（实现唇形同步和视觉一致的说话人渲染）。进一步总结了各角色的数据集、基准和评估指标，并分析了现有评估协议的不足。

Result: 建立了MLLM在视频翻译中三种功能角色的分类体系，识别出现有评估方法无法全面满足端到端视频翻译需求的问题，并指出了长视频理解、时间建模、多模态对齐、多语言鲁棒性和负责任部署等开放挑战。

Conclusion: MLLM为视频翻译从级联流水线向统一多模态框架演进提供了新范式，但在长视频建模、跨模态对齐、多语言泛化及可信部署方面仍存在显著挑战，未来需发展更全面的端到端评估体系。

Abstract: Recent progress in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is reshaping video translation from a cascaded pipeline of automatic speech recognition, machine translation, text-to-speech, and lip synchronization into a unified multimodal reasoning and generation problem. High-quality video translation requires not only semantic fidelity, but also temporal alignment, speaker consistency, and emotional expressiveness across visual, acoustic, and linguistic streams. This survey provides a focused review of MLLM-enabled video translation through a role-oriented taxonomy. We organize MLLM-enabled and MLLM-relevant studies into three functional roles: Semantic Reasoner, which grounds translation in video understanding, temporal reasoning, and multimodal fusion; Expressive Performer, which supports controllable and context-aware speech generation; and Visual Synthesizer, which enables lip synchronization and visually coherent speaker rendering. We further summarize representative datasets, benchmarks, and metrics for each role, and discuss how current evaluation protocols fall short of end-to-end video translation requirements. Finally, we identify open challenges in long-form video understanding, temporal modeling, multimodal alignment, multilingual robustness, and responsible deployment, outlining future directions for natural and trustworthy cross-lingual video communication.

</details>


### [415] [Dual-Anchoring: Addressing State Drift in Vision-Language Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17473)
*Kangyi Wu,Pengna Li,Kailin Lyu,Xi Lin,Lin Zhao,Qingrong He,Jinjun Wang,Jianyi Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出双锚定框架（Dual-Anchoring Framework）解决VLN中的状态漂移问题，通过指令进度锚定和记忆地标锚定两种机制，在仿真和真实环境中分别提升了15.2%的成功率和24.7%的长轨迹成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Video-LLM在长场景VLN中极易发生状态漂移（State Drift），表现为目标徘徊和无法执行关键指令。作者将其归因为两种认知缺陷：进度漂移（无法区分已完成和未完成的子目标）和记忆漂移（历史表征退化，丢失已访问地标信息）。

Method: 提出双锚定框架：（1）指令进度锚定——监督代理生成结构化文本标记，划分已完成与剩余子目标；（2）记忆地标锚定——利用地标中心世界模型，回溯预测SAM提取的物体中心嵌入，强制代理验证过去观察并保留区分性地标表征。同时构建了两个大规模数据集：360万样本的显式进度描述数据和93.7万的地标回溯验证数据。

Result: 在仿真和真实环境中均取得显著提升，成功率提升15.2%，长轨迹成功率提升24.7%。

Conclusion: 双锚定框架有效缓解了VLN中的状态漂移问题，尤其对长程导航任务效果突出。代码、数据生成流程和数据集将开源以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Vision-Language Navigation(VLN) requires an agent to navigate through 3D environments by following natural language instructions. While recent Video Large Language Models(Video-LLMs) have largely advanced VLN, they remain highly susceptible to State Drift in long scenarios. In these cases, the agent's internal state drifts away from the true task execution state, leading to aimless wandering and failure to execute essential maneuvers in the instruction. We attribute this failure to two distinct cognitive deficits: Progress Drift, where the agent fails to distinguish completed sub-goals from remaining ones, and Memory Drift, where the agent's history representations degrade, making it lose track of visited landmarks. In this paper, we propose a Dual-Anchoring Framework that explicitly anchors the instruction progress and history representations. First, to address progress drift, we introduce Instruction Progress Anchoring, which supervises the agent to generate structured text tokens that delineate completed versus remaining sub-goals. Second, to mitigate memory drift, we propose Memory Landmark Anchoring, which utilizes a Landmark-Centric World Model to retrospectively predict object-centric embeddings extracted by the Segment Anything Model, compelling the agent to explicitly verify past observations and preserve distinct representations of visited landmarks. Facilitating this framework, we curate two extensive datasets: 3.6 million samples with explicit progress descriptions, and 937k grounded landmark data for retrospective verification. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate the superiority of our method, achieving a 15.2% improvement in Success Rate and a remarkable 24.7% gain on long-horizon trajectories. To facilitate further research, we will release our code, data generation pipelines, and the collected datasets.

</details>


### [416] [FlowC2S: Flowing from Current to Succeeding Frames for Fast and Memory-Efficient Video Continuation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17625)
*Hovhannes Margaryan,Quentin Bammey,Christian Sandor*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FlowC2S方法，通过微调预训练文本到视频流模型，利用固有最优耦合和目标反转技术，实现快速、内存高效且质量优越的视频延续生成，仅需5次函数评估即可超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频延续生成方法通常将当前帧与噪声结合并逐步去噪，导致模型输入维度高、计算开销大、推理速度慢。本文旨在通过更直接的流式映射方式降低维度、加速推理并提升视觉保真度。

Method: 1) 微调预训练文本到视频流模型，学习当前与后续视频块之间的向量场；2) 提出固有最优耦合，使用时间相邻视频块作为训练中的最优耦合代理，产生更直的流；3) 引入目标反转，将目标块的潜在反转注入输入表示以增强对应关系和视觉保真度；4) 直接从当前帧流向后续帧，而非结合噪声，将模型输入维度减半。

Result: 在LTXV和Wan上微调后，FlowC2S在FID和FVD定量评估上超越SOTA，且仅需5次神经函数评估。

Conclusion: FlowC2S通过固有最优耦合和目标反转两种关键设计，实现了更直接、更低维度、更高效的视频延续生成，在极少的函数评估次数下达到最优性能，为视频生成领域提供了一种高效的新范式。

Abstract: This paper introduces a novel methodology for generating fast and memory-efficient video continuations. Our method, dubbed FlowC2S, fine-tunes a pre-trained text-to-video flow model to learn a vector field between the current and succeeding video chunks. Two design choices are key. First, we introduce inherent optimal couplings, utilizing temporally adjacent video chunks during training as a practical proxy for true optimal couplings, resulting in straighter flows. Second, we incorporate target inversion, injecting the inverted latent of the target chunk into the input representation to strengthen correspondences and improve visual fidelity. By flowing directly from current to succeeding frames, instead of the common combination of current frames with noise to generate a video continuation, we reduce the dimensionality of the model input by a factor of two. The proposed method, fine-tuned from LTXV and Wan, surpasses the state-of-the-art scores across quantitative evaluations with FID and FVD, with as few as five neural function evaluations.

</details>


### [417] [OmniHuman: A Large-scale Dataset and Benchmark for Human-Centric Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18326)
*Lei Zhu,Xing Cai,Yingjie Chen,Yiheng Li,Binxin Yang,Hao Liu,Jie Chen,Chen Li,Jing LYu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OmniHuman数据集和OHBench基准，解决了现有音频-视频联合生成模型在人脸中心视频中因数据集结构缺陷（场景多样性不足、交互建模稀疏、属性对齐不够）导致生成质量受限的问题，提供分层标注和自动化流程，并建立了与人类感知高度一致的三级评估体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频-视频联合生成模型在复杂真实物理场景中生成高保真人脸中心视频时表现不佳，根本原因在于现有数据集在三个维度存在结构性缺陷：全局场景与相机多样性有限、稀疏的交互建模（人际与人物交互）、个体属性对齐不足。

Method: 构建大规模多场景数据集OmniHuman，提供涵盖视频级场景、帧级交互、个体级属性的分层标注；开发全自动数据收集与多模态标注管线；建立三级评估体系OHBench，引入与人类感知高度一致的指标。

Result: OHBench能够对音频-视频合成进行全局场景、关系交互和个体属性三个层面的科学诊断，且其指标与人类感知高度一致，填补了现有基准的评估空白。

Conclusion: OmniHuman数据集和OHBench基准为精细化人脸建模和人脸中心音频-视频合成提供了更全面的数据支撑和评估标准，有望推动该领域在复杂真实场景下的生成质量提升。

Abstract: Recent advancements in audio-video joint generation models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in content creation. However, generating high-fidelity human-centric videos in complex, real-world physical scenes remains a significant challenge. We identify that the root cause lies in the structural deficiencies of existing datasets across three dimensions: limited global scene and camera diversity, sparse interaction modeling (both person-person and person-object), and insufficient individual attribute alignment. To bridge these gaps, we present OmniHuman, a large-scale, multi-scene dataset designed for fine-grained human modeling. OmniHuman provides a hierarchical annotation covering video-level scenes, frame-level interactions, and individual-level attributes. To facilitate this, we develop a fully automated pipeline for high-quality data collection and multi-modal annotation. Complementary to the dataset, we establish the OmniHuman Benchmark (OHBench), a three-level evaluation system that provides a scientific diagnosis for human-centric audio-video synthesis. Crucially, OHBench introduces metrics that are highly consistent with human perception, filling the gaps in existing benchmarks by providing a comprehensive diagnosis across global scenes, relational interactions, and individual attributes.

</details>


### [418] [Agentic AI for Remote Sensing: Technical Challenges and Research Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.24919)
*Muhammad Akhtar Munir,Muhammad Umer Sheikh,Akashah Shabbir,Muhammad Haris Khan,Fahad Khan,Xiao Xiang Zhu,Begüm Demir,Salman Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文论证了地球观测（EO）需要原生地理空间智能体，而非直接套用通用智能体AI，因为EO工作流涉及地理参考、多模态、时序结构数据，且操作会改变底层状态并导致错误级联传播，提出了以结构化地理空间状态、工具感知推理、验证器引导执行和有效性感知学习为核心的设计原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用智能体AI在处理EO工作流时会因地理空间一致性、时序有效性和物理有效性等约束而失效，这些挑战是结构性的而非偶然的，因此需要重新思考面向EO的原生智能体设计。

Method: 通过分析通用智能体系统的常见假设在EO工作流中的失效模式，剖析多步骤EO管线的错误传播特征，进而提出面向EO原生的智能体设计原则。

Result: 识别出EO工作流中因重投影、重采样、合成、聚合等操作导致的状态变换和约束变化，以及由此引发的错误无声传播问题；明确了通用智能体在EO场景下的关键失效模式。

Conclusion: 构建可靠的EO智能体必须围绕物理、地理空间和工作流约束来重新设计智能体架构，具体包括结构化地理空间状态、工具感知推理、验证器引导执行和有效性感知学习与评估四个核心原则。

Abstract: Earth Observation (EO) is moving beyond static prediction toward multi-step analytical workflows that require coordinated reasoning over data, tools, and geospatial state. While foundation models and vision-language models have advanced representation learning and language-grounded interaction in remote sensing, and agentic AI has shown strong potential for long-horizon reasoning and tool use, EO is not a straightforward extension of generic agentic AI. EO workflows operate on georeferenced, multi-modal, and temporally structured data, where operations such as reprojection, resampling, compositing, and aggregation transform the underlying state and can constrain later analysis. As a result, errors may propagate silently across steps, and correctness depends not only on internal coherence but also on geospatial consistency, temporally valid comparisons, and physical validity. This position paper argues that these challenges are structural rather than incidental. We examine the assumptions commonly made in generic agentic systems, analyze how they break in geospatial workflows, and characterize failure modes in multi-step EO pipelines. We then outline design principles for EO-native agents centered on structured geospatial state, tool-aware reasoning, verifier-guided execution, and validity-aware learning and evaluation. Building reliable geospatial agents, therefore, requires rethinking agent design around the physical, geospatial, and workflow constraints that govern EO analysis.

</details>


### [419] [MedSynapse-V: Bridging Visual Perception and Clinical Intuition via Latent Memory Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26283)
*Chunzheng Zhu,Jiaqi Zeng,Junyu Jiang,Jianxin Lin,Yijun Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MedSynapse框架，通过隐式诊断记忆演化机制模拟临床专家的经验调用，解决医学视觉语言模型因离散分词导致的认知偏差问题，在多个数据集上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学VLM因离散分词导致量化损失、长距离信息消散以及缺乏病例自适应专家经验，无法准确模拟临床医生在图像判读时即时调用的隐式诊断记忆。

Method: 提出三个核心模块：1) Meta Query for Prior Memorization：可学习探针从解剖先验编码器检索结构化先验生成压缩隐式记忆；2) Causal Counterfactual Refinement (CCR)：利用强化学习和反事实奖励量化每个记忆的因果贡献，剪枝冗余；3) Intrinsic Memory Transition (IMT)：特权-自主双分支范式通过全词汇散度对齐将教师分支诊断模式内化到学生分支。

Result: 在多个数据集上的综合实验表明，MedSynapse通过将外部经验转化为内生参数，在诊断准确率上显著超越现有最先进方法，特别是思维链范式。

Conclusion: 将隐式诊断记忆以参数内化的方式融入模型，是弥合医学VLM与临床专家认知差距的有效途径。

Abstract: High-precision medical diagnosis relies not only on static imaging features but also on the implicit diagnostic memory experts instantly invoke during image interpretation. We pinpoint a fundamental cognitive misalignment in medical VLMs caused by discrete tokenization, leading to quantization loss, long-range information dissipation, and missing case-adaptive expertise. To bridge this gap, we propose ours, a framework for latent diagnostic memory evolution that simulates the experiential invocation of clinicians by dynamically synthesizing implicit diagnostic memories within the model's hidden stream. Specifically, it begins with a Meta Query for Prior Memorization mechanism, where learnable probes retrieve structured priors from an anatomical prior encoder to generate condensed implicit memories. To ensure clinical fidelity, we introduce Causal Counterfactual Refinement (CCR), which leverages reinforcement learning and counterfactual rewards derived from region-level feature masking to quantify the causal contribution of each memory, thereby pruning redundancies and aligning latent representations with diagnostic logic. This evolutionary process culminates in Intrinsic Memory Transition (IMT), a privileged-autonomous dual-branch paradigm that internalizes teacher-branch diagnostic patterns into the student-branch via full-vocabulary divergence alignment. Comprehensive empirical evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate that ours, by transferring external expertise into endogenous parameters, significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, particularly chain-of-thought paradigms, in diagnostic accuracy. The code is available at https://github.com/zhcz328/MedSynapse-V.

</details>


### [420] [Action Motifs: Self-Supervised Hierarchical Representation of Human Body Movements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.28173)
*Genki Kinoshita,Shu Nakamura,Ryo Kawahara,Shohei Nobuhara,Yasutomo Kawanishi,Ko Nishino*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出A4Mer，一种自监督层次化Transformer，通过Action Atoms（原子关节运动）和Action Motifs（时间组合模式）学习人体运动的分层表示，并引入脚部摄像机多视角数据集AMD，在动作识别、预测和插值任务上取得显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人体行为建模需要利用人体运动的组合性（compositionality），但现有方法缺乏能够捕捉原子运动单元及其时序组合模式的层次化表示学习框架。

Method: 提出A4Mer（嵌套潜在Transformer），将3D姿态序列分割为可变长度片段并编码为Action Atoms潜在token；通过自监督掩码预测任务在底层和顶层潜在空间联合训练，使Action Motifs自然涌现；同时构建AMD数据集（多视角+脚部摄像机）以应对严重遮挡下的SMPL标注。

Result: 在动作识别、运动预测和运动插值任务上，A4Mer提取的Action Motifs显著优于基线方法，验证了层次化表示的有效性。

Conclusion: 层次化表示学习（Action Atoms→Action Motifs）是人体行为建模的有效范式，脚部摄像机方案为复杂遮挡场景下的数据采集提供了新思路。

Abstract: Effective human behavior modeling requires a representation of the human body movement that capitalizes on its compositionality. We propose a hierarchical representation consisting of Action Atoms that capture the atomic joint movements and Action Motifs that are formed by their temporal compositions and encode similar body movements found across different overall human actions. We derive A4Mer, a nested latent Transformer to learn this hierarchical representation from human pose data in a fully self-supervised manner. A4Mer splits a 3D pose sequence into variable-length segments and represents each segment as a single latent token (Action Atoms). Through bottom-up representation learning, temporal patterns composed of these Action Atoms, which capture meaningful temporal spans of reusable, semantic segments of body movements, naturally emerge (Action Motifs). A4Mer achieves this with a unified pretext task of masked token prediction in their respective latent spaces. We also introduce Action Motif Dataset (AMD), a large-scale dataset of multi-view human behavior videos with full SMPL annotations. We introduce a novel use of cameras by mounting them on the feet to achieve their frame-wise annotations despite frequent and heavy body occlusions. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of A4Mer for extracting meaningful Action Motifs, which significantly benefit human behavior modeling tasks including action recognition, motion prediction, and motion interpolation.

</details>


### [421] [Beyond Visual Fidelity: Benchmarking Super-Resolution Models for Large-Scale Remote Sensing Imagery via Downstream Task Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00310)
*Zhili Li,Kangyang Chai,Zhihao Wang,Xiaowei Jia,Yanhua Li,Gengchen Mai,Sergii Skakun,Dinesh Manocha,Yiqun Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoSR-Bench是一个集成下游任务的超分辨率基准数据集，包含约36,000个地点的多分辨率图像对，评估发现传统SR指标（PSNR/SSIM）与下游任务性能之间缺乏正相关，甚至存在负相关，揭示了将下游任务纳入SR模型评估的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有超分辨率研究使用PSNR、SSIM等保真度指标评估模型，但这些指标无法反映超分图像在下游任务（如土地覆盖分类、生物量估算、变化检测）中的实际效用，存在评估与真实应用之间的鸿沟。

Method: 构建了GeoSR-Bench基准数据集，包含约36,000个位置的空间共位、时间对齐、质量控制的图像对，分辨率从500m到0.6m；使用270种实验设置，涵盖2个跨平台SR任务、9种SR模型（GAN、Transformer、神经算子、扩散模型）、3个下游任务模型和5个下游任务，对SR模型进行感知质量和下游任务性能的综合基准测试。

Result: 传统SR指标的改进与下游任务性能提升之间往往不相关，甚至存在负相关，表明这些指标无法有效指导面向下游应用的任务模型选择。

Conclusion: 需要将下游任务整合到SR模型开发和评估中，现有保真度指标不足以反映超分图像的实际应用价值。

Abstract: Super-resolution (SR) techniques have made major advances in reconstructing high-resolution images from low-resolution inputs. The increased resolution provides visual enhancement and utility for monitoring tasks. In particular, SR has been increasingly developed for satellite-based Earth observation, with applications in urban planning, agriculture, ecology, and disaster response. However, existing SR studies and benchmarks typically use fidelity metrics such as PSNR or SSIM, whereas the true utility of super-resolved images lies in supporting downstream tasks such as land cover classification, biomass estimation, and change detection. To bridge this gap, we introduce GeoSR-Bench, a downstream task-integrated SR benchmark dataset to evaluate SR models beyond fidelity metrics. GeoSR-Bench comprises spatially co-located, temporally aligned, and quality-controlled image pairs from about 36,000 locations across diverse land covers, spanning resolutions from 500m to 0.6m. To the best of our knowledge, GeoSR-Bench is the first SR benchmark that directly connects improved image resolution from SR models with downstream Earth monitoring tasks, including land cover segmentation, infrastructure mapping, and biophysical variable estimation. Using GeoSR-Bench, we benchmark GAN, transformer, neural operator, and diffusion-based SR models on perceptual quality and downstream task performance. We conduct experiments with 270 settings, covering 2 cross-platform SR tasks, 9 SR models, 3 downstream task models, and 5 downstream tasks for each SR task. The results show that improvements in traditional SR metrics often do not correlate with gains in task performance, and the correlations can be negative, indicating that these metrics provide limited guidance for selecting superior models for downstream tasks. This reveals the need to integrate downstream tasks into SR model development and evaluation.

</details>


### [422] [GRPO-TTA: Test-Time Visual Tuning for Vision-Language Models via GRPO-Driven Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03403)
*Yujun Li,Hongyuan Zhang,Yuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GRPO-TTA方法，将GRPO策略引入视觉语言模型的测试时适应任务，通过构建输出组和设计特定奖励函数，在无需真实标签的情况下实现无监督适应，实验证明该方法在多种分布偏移场景下优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究GRPO策略是否能够有效促进视觉语言模型的测试时适应（TTA）能力，弥补现有TTA方法在无标签条件下优化效率不足的问题。

Method: 1) 将类别特定的提示预测重构为组级策略优化问题；2) 通过从CLIP相似度分布中采样top-K类别候选构建输出组，实现无真实标签的概率驱动优化；3) 设计对齐奖励和分散奖励两种测试时适应奖励函数，引导视觉编码器的高效微调。

Result: 在多种基准数据集上，GRPO-TTA一致优于现有测试时适应方法，尤其在自然分布偏移场景下性能提升更为显著。

Conclusion: GRPO策略可以有效应用于视觉语言模型的测试时适应，通过组级策略优化和定制化奖励函数设计，无需标签即可显著提升模型在分布偏移下的适应能力。

Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has recently shown strong performance in post-training large language models and vision-language models. It raises a question of whether the GRPO also significantly promotes the test-time adaptation (TTA) of vision language models. In this paper, we propose Group Relative Policy Optimization for Test-Time Adaptation (GRPO-TTA), which adapts GRPO to the TTA setting by reformulating class-specific prompt prediction as a group-wise policy optimization problem. Specifically, we construct output groups by sampling top-K class candidates from CLIP similarity distributions, enabling probability-driven optimization without access to ground-truth labels. Moreover, we design reward functions tailored to test-time adaptation, including alignment rewards and dispersion rewards, to guide effective visual encoder tuning. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that GRPO-TTA consistently outperforms existing test-time adaptation methods, with notably larger performance gains under natural distribution shifts.

</details>


### [423] [ScriptHOI: Learning Scripted State Transitions for Open-Vocabulary Human-Object Interaction Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05057)
*Minh Anh Nguyen,Quang Huy Tran,Bao Ngoc Le,SuiYang Guang,Tuan Kiet Pham,Linh Chi Vo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ScriptHOI提出了一种结构化框架，将交互短语分解为多个语义槽位（身体角色、接触、几何、功能、运动、物体状态），通过视觉状态分词器解析人-物对，利用槽位匹配估计脚本覆盖率和冲突，并结合区间部分标签学习和反事实对比损失，显著提升了开放词汇HOI检测中稀有和未见交互的识别能力，同时减少了功能冲突导致的误检。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM驱动的HOI检测器预测常被物体功能属性和短语级共现主导，未能验证手、工具、目标、接触模式和物体状态是否共同支持动作，导致模型仅凭刀和蛋糕存在就预测"切蛋糕"。

Method: 1) 将交互短语分解为身体角色、接触、几何、功能、运动、物体状态六个语义槽位；2) 视觉状态分词器将人-物对解析为对应状态token；3) 槽位匹配器估计脚本覆盖率和脚本冲突，校准HOI logits；4) 区间部分标签学习为未标注候选提供概率上下界约束；5) 反事实脚本对比损失通过交换脚本槽位抑制物体捷径。

Result: 在HICO-DET、V-COCO和开放词汇HOI分割上，ScriptHOI提升了稀有和未见交互的识别，同时显著减少了功能冲突导致的误检。

Conclusion: 将交互短语分解为结构化脚本槽位并验证各个视觉证据的综合一致性，能有效克服物体功能偏置，提升HOI检测的语义泛化能力和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary human-object interaction (HOI) detection requires recognizing interaction phrases that may not appear as annotated categories during training. Recent vision-language HOI detectors improve semantic transfer by matching human-object features with text embeddings, but their predictions are often dominated by object affordance and phrase-level co-occurrence. As a result, a model may predict \textit{cut cake} from the presence of a knife and a cake without verifying whether the hand, tool, target, contact pattern, and object state jointly support the action. We propose \textbf{ScriptHOI}, a structured framework that represents each interaction phrase as a soft scripted state transition. Rather than treating a phrase as a single class token, ScriptHOI decomposes it into body-role, contact, geometry, affordance, motion, and object-state slots. A visual state tokenizer parses each detected human-object pair into corresponding state tokens, and a slot-wise matcher estimates both script coverage and script conflict. These two quantities calibrate HOI logits, expose missing visual evidence, and provide training constraints for incomplete annotations. To avoid suppressing valid but unannotated interactions, we further introduce interval partial-label learning, which constrains unannotated candidates with script-derived lower and upper probability bounds instead of assigning closed-world negatives. A counterfactual script contrast loss swaps individual script slots to discourage object-only shortcuts. Experiments on HICO-DET, V-COCO, and open-vocabulary HOI splits show that ScriptHOI improves rare and unseen interaction recognition while substantially reducing affordance-conflict false positives.

</details>


### [424] [DVD: Discrete Voxel Diffusion for 3D Generation and Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07971)
*Zhengrui Xiang,Jiaqi Wu,Fupeng Sun,Heliang Zheng,Yingzhen Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出离散体素扩散（DVD）框架，用于稀疏体素的生成、评估和编辑，通过将体素占用率视为原生离散变量，避免了连续到离散的阈值化过程，并利用预测熵进行不确定性估计，同时提出轻量级微调策略实现单轮采样的体素修补与编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SLat（结构化潜在）3D生成管线依赖连续扩散模型，生成后需进行连续到离散的阈值化处理，导致信息损失且缺乏对离散体素原生支持。此外，现有方法在体素的不确定性估计、质量评估及局部编辑方面能力不足，亟需一个统一框架来同时解决生成、评估和编辑问题。

Method: 1) 将体素占用率建模为原生离散变量，构建离散扩散框架（DVD）；2) 利用预测熵作为鲁棒的不确定性度量，识别模糊体素区域和复杂样本；3) 提出基于块结构扰动模式的轻量级微调策略，在单轮采样内实现体素修补与编辑，仅需极少的辅助计算且无需额外模型评估。

Result: DVD在稀疏体素生成质量上优于现有方法；通过预测熵有效实现了数据过滤和质量评估；轻量级微调策略成功实现了高效的体素修补与编辑功能。

Conclusion: 离散扩散在稀疏体素作为第一阶段的先验模型中具有有效性，为3D生成管线提供了一种更简洁、可解释性更强的替代方案，同时拓展了不确定性引导的质量控制和零开销编辑能力。

Abstract: We introduce Discrete Voxel Diffusion (DVD), a discrete diffusion framework to generate, assess, and edit sparse voxels for SLat (Structured LATent) based 3D generative pipelines. Although discrete diffusion has not generally displaced continuous diffusion in image-like generation, we show that it can be an effective first-stage prior for sparse voxel scaffolds. By treating voxel occupancy as a native discrete variable, DVD avoids continuous-to-discrete thresholding and provides a simple framework for voxel generation, uncertainty estimation, and editing. Beyond quality gains, DVD provides more interpretable generation dynamics through explicit categorical modeling. Furthermore, we leverage the predictive entropy as a robust uncertainty metric to identify ambiguous voxel regions and complicated samples, facilitating tasks such as data filtering and quality assessment. Finally, we propose a lightweight fine-tuning strategy using block-structured perturbation patterns. This approach empowers the model to inpaint and edit voxels within a single sampling round, requiring negligible auxiliary computation and no additional model evaluations.

</details>


### [425] [Normalization Equivariance for Arbitrary Backbones, with Application to Image Denoising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08193)
*Youssef Saied,François Fleuret*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Wrapped Normalization Equivariance (WNE)，一种无需参数的外包装方法，通过对输入归一化、应用任意骨干网络、再反归一化输出，实现归一化等变性，在盲去噪任务中提升鲁棒性且无GPU开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有归一化等变性(NE)方法要求每个内部层都兼容NE操作，增加了运行时开销且排除了softmax注意力、LayerNorm等标准Transformer组件，因此需要一种更灵活高效的NE实现方式。

Method: 提出WNE：一个无参数的外包装器，将输入归一化后送入任意骨干网络（如CNN或Transformer），再对输出进行反归一化；理论上证明了任何NE函数都可以分解为此形式。

Result: 在盲去噪任务中，包装CNN和Transformer架构可在噪声水平失配下提升鲁棒性，且无额外GPU开销；而基于架构的NE基线方法速度慢达1.6倍。

Conclusion: WNE通过简洁的外包装方式精确参数化了整个NE函数类，避免了内部层约束，兼容标准Transformer组件，在保持零额外计算开销的同时提升了分布偏移鲁棒性。

Abstract: Normalization Equivariance (NE) is a structural prior that improves robustness to distribution shift in image-to-image tasks. A function $f$ is normalization equivariant iff $f(a y + b\mathbf{1}) = a f(y) + b\mathbf{1}$ for all $a>0$ and $b\in\mathbb{R}$. Existing NE methods constrain every internal layer to NE-compatible operations. These constraints add runtime cost and exclude standard transformer components such as softmax attention and LayerNorm. We introduce Wrapped Normalization Equivariance (WNE), a parameter-free wrapper that normalizes the input, applies any backbone, and denormalizes the output. We prove every NE function admits this factorization, so the wrapper exactly parameterizes the class of NE functions. On blind denoising, wrapping CNN and transformer architectures improves robustness under noise-level mismatch with no measurable GPU overhead, while architectural NE baselines are up to $1.6\times$ slower.

</details>


### [426] [PermuQuant: Lowering Per-Group Quantization Error by Reordering Channels for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09503)
*Yongsen Cheng,Kai Liu,Kaiwen Tao,Junxian Li,Zhixin Wang,Zhikai Chen,Renjing Pei,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PermuQuant，一种针对低比特扩散模型的后训练量化框架。该方法通过联合二阶矩准则对通道进行排序，将统计特征相似的通道分在同一组，从而减少分组量化中的量化误差。PermuQuant还采用基于校准数据的接受规则来选择性应用重排序，并将排序操作吸收到相邻模块或离线处理，避免运行时开销。在FLUX.1-dev等大规模扩散模型上，PermuQuant在W4A4 NVFP4量化下实现了最高1.7倍的单步加速和3.5倍的DiT内存缩减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练量化方法在极低比特设置下仍存在严重的质量退化问题。本文发现分组量化中通道排序是一个重要但被忽视的因素——当统计特征差异大的通道被分在同一组时，量化尺度会被异常值主导，导致较大的量化误差。

Method: 提出PermuQuant框架，包含三个核心步骤：(1) 基于联合二阶矩准则对通道进行排序，将具有相似激活和权重统计特征的通道分在同一组；(2) 采用基于校准数据的接受规则，仅在选定排列能降低校准数据上的量化误差时才应用重排序；(3) 将选定的排列吸收到相邻模块或离线应用于权重，避免显式的运行时排列操作。

Result: 在多个大规模扩散模型上的实验表明，PermuQuant一致地降低了量化误差，并优于现有PTQ基线。在FLUX.1-dev上使用RTX 5090，W4A4 NVFP4量化下实现了最高1.7倍的单步加速和3.5倍的DiT内存占用缩减。

Conclusion: 通过关注通道排序这一被忽视的因素，PermuQuant为低比特扩散模型的高效部署提供了简单有效的解决方案，在资源受限场景下具有实用价值。

Abstract: Large-scale visual generative models have achieved remarkable performance. However, their high computational and memory costs make deployment challenging in resource-constrained scenarios, such as interactive applications and personal single-GPU usage. Post-training quantization (PTQ) offers a practical solution by compressing pretrained models without expensive retraining. However, existing PTQ methods still suffer from severe quality degradation under extremely low-bit settings. In this paper, we identify channel ordering as an important but underexplored factor in per-group quantization. In this setting, each contiguous group shares one quantization scale. When channels with very different statistics are placed in the same group, the scale can be dominated by outliers and cause large quantization errors. Based on this observation, we propose PermuQuant, a simple and effective PTQ framework for low-bit diffusion models. PermuQuant sorts channels by a joint second-moment criterion before per-group quantization, placing channels with similar activation and weight statistics into the same group. It further uses a calibration-based acceptance rule to apply reordering only when the selected permutation reduces quantization error on calibration data. The selected permutations are absorbed into adjacent modules or applied to weights offline, avoiding explicit runtime permutation operations. Extensive experiments on multiple large diffusion models show that PermuQuant consistently reduces quantization error and outperforms existing PTQ baselines.
