On FLUX.1-dev with an RTX 5090, PermuQuant achieves up to a 1.7$\times$ single step speedup and reduces the DiT memory footprint by 3.5$\times$ under W4A4 NVFP4 quantization. Code will be available at https://github.com/yscheng04/PermuQuant.

</details>


### [427] [The Cartesian Shortcut: Re-evaluate Vision Reasoning in Polar Coordinate Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09883)
*Xia Hu,Zhenrui Yue,Brian Potetz,Howard Zhou,Leonidas Guibas,Chun-Ta Lu,Zhicheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 当前多模态大模型在视觉推理基准测试中的高分主要源于利用"笛卡尔捷径"——将正交网格布局离散化为文本坐标进行推理，而非真正的视觉理解。Polaris-Bench通过将53个视觉推理任务转换为极坐标空间，打破了这一先验，揭示了前沿模型性能从70-83%骤降至31-39%，表明模型缺乏拓扑不变的视觉推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示多模态大模型在视觉推理基准上的高分是否真正反映稳健的视觉理解能力，识别并消除模型利用正交网格布局进行文本推理的"笛卡尔捷径"。

Method: 提出Polaris-Bench，将53个视觉推理任务重新构建在极坐标空间中，同时保留一致的逻辑约束和任务语义，并配以对应的笛卡尔坐标版本作为参考，从根本上打破模型所依赖的正交先验。

Result: 14个最先进的多模态大模型在笛卡尔布局上达到70-83%的准确率，在极坐标等价任务上骤降至31-39%；即使在完全逻辑等价的情况下，退化仍然持续存在；笛卡尔布局上的推理增益在极坐标版本中严重削弱。

Conclusion: 当前多模态大模型缺乏拓扑不变的视觉推理能力，其视觉推理基准的高分掩盖了模型依赖文本推理捷径而非真正视觉理解的本质缺陷。

Abstract: As current Multimodal Large Language Models rapidly saturate canonical visual reasoning benchmarks, a key question emerges: do these strong scores genuinely reflect robust visual understanding? We identify a pervasive vulnerability, the Cartesian Shortcut: visual reasoning benchmarks prevalently build on orthogonal grid-based layouts that can be readily discretized into explicit textual coordinates. Models systematically exploit this property, heavily leveraging text-based deductive reasoning to assist visual problem-solving. To systematically dismantle this shortcut, we introduce Polaris-Bench, which re-formulates 53 visual reasoning tasks in Polar coordinate space with paired Cartesian counterparts as reference, while preserving consistent logical constraints and task semantics -- thus fundamentally breaking the orthogonal prior that models exploit. Comprehensive evaluation across $14$ state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that frontier models achieving $70$--$83\%$ on Cartesian layouts collapse to $31$--$39\%$ on Polar equivalents, with degradation persisting even under complete logical equivalence. Moreover, reasoning gains observed on Cartesian layouts are severely diminished on Polar equivalents. These findings expose a critical deficiency in current MLLMs: the lack of topology-invariant visual reasoning.

</details>


### [428] [Fast Image Super-Resolution via Consistency Rectified Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12377)
*Jiaqi Xu,Wenbo Li,Haoze Sun,Fan Li,Zhixin Wang,Long Peng,Jingjing Ren,Haoran Yang,Xiaowei Hu,Renjing Pei,Pheng-Ann Heng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlowSR提出了一种基于修正流的单步图像超分辨率方法，通过改进的一致性学习策略和快慢调度机制，在单步采样中实现了高质量的超分辨率重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在图像超分辨率中表现出色，但多步采样耗时长；现有少步或单步方法要么对噪声输入建模效率低，要么未能充分利用迭代生成先验，导致重建图像的保真度和质量受损。

Method: 1) 将SR问题重新表述为从低分辨率到高分辨率图像的修正流；2) 改进一致性蒸馏过程，引入HR正则化，使学习到的SR流既保持自一致性又精确收敛到真实HR目标；3) 提出快慢调度策略，相邻时间步分别从快速调度器（少步，提高效率）和慢速调度器（多步，捕捉细粒度纹理细节）中采样。

Result: 大量实验表明FlowSR在效率和图像质量方面均取得了优异的性能。

Conclusion: FlowSR通过修正流框架和创新的训练策略，有效解决了扩散模型在超分辨率任务中效率与质量之间的权衡问题，实现了单步高质量超分辨率。

Abstract: Diffusion models (DMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in real-world image super-resolution (SR), yet their reliance on time-consuming multi-step sampling largely hinders their practical applications. While recent efforts have introduced few- or single-step solutions, existing methods either inefficiently model the process from noisy input or fail to fully exploit iterative generative priors, compromising the fidelity and quality of the reconstructed images. To address this issue, we propose FlowSR, a novel approach that reformulates the SR problem as a rectified flow from low-resolution (LR) to high-resolution (HR) images. Our method leverages an improved consistency learning strategy to enable high-quality SR in a single step. Specifically, we refine the original consistency distillation process by incorporating HR regularization, ensuring that the learned SR flow not only enforces self-consistency but also converges precisely to the ground-truth HR target. Furthermore, we introduce a fast-slow scheduling strategy, where adjacent timesteps for consistency learning are sampled from two distinct schedulers: a fast scheduler with fewer timesteps to improve efficiency, and a slow scheduler with more timesteps to capture fine-grained texture details. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FlowSR achieves outstanding performance in both efficiency and image quality. Code: \href{https://github.com/jiaqixuac/FlowSR}{this https URL}.

</details>


### [429] [CLIP Tricks You: Training-free Token Pruning for Efficient Pixel Grounding in Large VIsion-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13178)
*Sangin Lee,Yukyung Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LiteLVLM是一种无需训练、基于文本引导的视觉令牌剪枝策略，通过反转CLIP视觉-文本相似度排序，有效保留指代区域令牌并恢复上下文令牌，在像素级定位任务中实现超过5%的性能提升，同时以22%加速和2.3倍内存缩减维持90%原始性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大视觉语言模型中视觉令牌占据大部分输入令牌导致计算开销巨大，现有剪枝方法在像素级定位任务上表现不佳，因为令牌重要性高度依赖于输入文本。

Method: 通过对CLIP的深入分析，发现指代区域内视觉令牌与文本表示的相似度较低；据此提出LiteLVLM，通过反转CLIP视觉-文本相似度排序来保留指代区域令牌，同时恢复上下文令牌以实现清晰的前景-背景分离。

Result: 在多种令牌预算下，LiteLVLM相比现有方法性能提升超过5%；无需任何训练或微调，实现22%速度提升和2.3倍内存缩减，同时保持90%原始性能。

Conclusion: LiteLVLM是一种高效的、无需训练的文本引导令牌剪枝策略，在像素级定位任务上显著优于现有方法，在效率与性能之间取得了良好平衡。

Abstract: In large vision-language models, visual tokens typically constitute the majority of input tokens, leading to substantial computational overhead. To address this, recent studies have explored pruning redundant or less informative visual tokens for image understanding tasks. However, these methods struggle with pixel grounding tasks, where token importance is highly contingent on the input text. Through an in-depth analysis of CLIP, we observe that visual tokens within referent regions often exhibit low similarity to their textual representation. Motivated by this insight, we introduce LiteLVLM, a training-free, text-guided token pruning strategy for efficient pixel grounding inference. By reversing the ranking of CLIP's visual-text similarity, LiteLVLM effectively retains visual tokens covering the referent regions, while recovering context tokens to enable clear foreground-background separation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiteLVLM significantly outperforms existing methods by over 5% across diverse token budgets. Without any training or fine-tuning, LiteLVLM maintains 90% of the original performance with a 22% speedup and a 2.3X memory reduction. Our code is available at https://github.com/sejong-rcv/LiteLVLM.

</details>


### [430] [Breaking Dual Bottlenecks: Evolving Unified Multimodal Models into Self-Adaptive Interleaved Visual Reasoners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.14709)
*Qingyang Liu,Bingjie Gao,Canmiao Fu,Zhipeng Huang,Chen Li,Feng Wang,Shuochen Chang,Shaobo Wang,Yali Wang,Keming Ye,Jiangtong Li,Li Niu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自适应切换生成策略的统一框架，通过分层数据流水线构建三种模式（直接生成、自我反思、多步规划），结合两阶段训练（SFT+RL）和奖励设计，有效弥合了多模态理解与生成之间的鸿沟，在X2I任务上取得了优于基线方法的生成保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有统一模型在多模态理解和生成之间存在"理解-生成鸿沟"——模型能捕捉用户意图但无法将其转化为精确的像素级操作，导致在anything-to-image任务中出现注意力纠缠和视觉细化两大瓶颈。

Method: 1) 构建分层数据流水线，包含三种自适应模式：直接生成（简单情况）、自我反思（质量细化）、多步规划（复杂场景分解）；2) 构建5万+高质量数据集；3) 两阶段训练策略：SFT + RL；4) 设计逐步推理奖励（确保逻辑一致性）和组内复杂度惩罚（防止冗余计算开销）。

Result: 在X2I任务上，该方法在简单到复杂指令下均优于现有基线，实现了更高的生成保真度。

Conclusion: 通过让统一模型根据指令复杂度和自身能力自主切换生成策略，有效解决了理解-生成鸿沟问题，提升了多模态生成质量。

Abstract: Recent unified models integrate multimodal understanding and generation within a single framework. However, an "understanding-generation gap" persists, where models can capture user intent but often fail to translate this semantic knowledge into precise pixel-level manipulation. This gap results in two bottlenecks in anything-to-image task (X2I): the attention entanglement bottleneck, where blind planning struggles with complex prompts, and the visual refinement bottleneck, where unstructured feedback fails to correct imperfections efficiently. In this paper, we propose a novel framework that empowers unified models to autonomously switch between generation strategies based on instruction complexity and model capability. To achieve this, we construct a hierarchical data pipeline that constructs execution paths across three adaptive modes: direct generation for simple cases, self-reflection for quality refinement, and multi-step planning for decomposing complex scenarios. Building on this pipeline, we contribute a high-quality dataset with over 50,000 samples and implement a two-stage training strategy comprising SFT and RL. Specifically, we design step-wise reasoning rewards to ensure logical consistency and intra-group complexity penalty to prevent redundant computational overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing baselines on X2I, achieving superior generation fidelity among simple-to-complex instructions. The code is released at https://github.com/WeChatCV/Interleaved_Visual_Reasoner.

</details>


### [431] [Causal Forcing++: Scalable Few-Step Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15141)
*Min Zhao,Hongzhou Zhu,Kaiwen Zheng,Zihan Zhou,Bokai Yan,Xinyuan Li,Xiao Yang,Chongxuan Li,Jun Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Causal Forcing++，一种通过因果一致性蒸馏（causal CD）实现帧级1-2步自回归视频生成的高效初始化方法，在帧级2步设置下超越SOTA的4步分块方法，同时降低50%首帧延迟和约4倍Stage 2训练成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AR扩散蒸馏方法在分块4步设置上表现良好，但存在响应粒度粗、采样延迟大的问题。更激进的帧级1-2步自回归场景中，现有初始化策略存在目标不对齐、无法支持少步生成或扩展成本过高的问题。

Method: 提出Causal Forcing++，核心是因果一致性蒸馏（causal CD）：学习与因果ODE蒸馏相同的AR条件流映射，但仅需相邻时间步之间的单个在线教师ODE步骤作为监督，无需预计算和存储完整PF-ODE轨迹，从而实现高效且易于优化的初始化。

Result: 在帧级2步设置下，VBench Total提升0.1，VBench Quality提升0.3，VisionReward提升0.335；首帧延迟降低50%，Stage 2训练成本降低约4倍。

Conclusion: Causal Forcing++实现了帧级少步自回归视频生成的高效初始化，并在多指标上超越SOTA，同时可扩展至动作条件世界模型生成。

Abstract: Real-time interactive video generation requires low-latency, streaming, and controllable rollout. Existing autoregressive (AR) diffusion distillation methods have achieved strong results in the chunk-wise 4-step regime by distilling bidirectional base models into few-step AR students, but they remain limited by coarse response granularity and non-negligible sampling latency. In this paper, we study a more aggressive setting: frame-wise autoregression with only 1--2 sampling steps. In this regime, we identify the initialization of a few-step AR student as the key bottleneck: existing strategies are either target-misaligned, incapable of few-step generation, or too costly to scale. We propose \textbf{Causal Forcing++}, a principled and scalable pipeline that uses \emph{causal consistency distillation} (causal CD) for few-step AR initialization. The core idea is that causal CD learns the same AR-conditional flow map as causal ODE distillation, but obtains supervision from a single online teacher ODE step between adjacent timesteps, avoiding the need to precompute and store full PF-ODE trajectories. This makes the initialization both more efficient and easier to optimize. The resulting pipeline, \ours, surpasses the SOTA 4-step chunk-wise Causal Forcing under the \textit{\textbf{frame-wise 2-step setting}} by 0.1 in VBench Total, 0.3 in VBench Quality, and 0.335 in VisionReward, while reducing first-frame latency by 50\% and Stage 2 training cost by $\sim$$4\times$. We further extend the pipeline to action-conditioned world model generation in the spirit of Genie3. Project Page: https://github.com/thu-ml/Causal-Forcing and https://github.com/shengshu-ai/minWM .

</details>


### [432] [Diffusion Models, Denoiser Architecture and Creativity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16415)
*Itamar Levine,Yair Weiss*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过理论和实验证明，扩散模型的创造力源于去噪器架构与目标分布之间的交互作用。不同的去噪器架构（线性、多项式、瓶颈、UNET变体）会导致不同的生成结果，只有当去噪器的归纳偏置与真实目标分布高度对齐时，模型才能成功生成逼真且非简单复制的样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解释扩散模型为何能生成高度逼真且不同于训练数据的新样本（即"创造力"），尽管理论上贝叶斯最优去噪器只会复制训练样本。

Method: 理论分析：针对线性、多项式、瓶颈三种去噪器架构，推导生成样本分布与目标分布及去噪器架构的函数关系。实证分析：对流行UNET去噪器架构进行微小改动，观察其对生成结果的影响。

Result: 扩散模型的创造力取决于去噪器架构的归纳偏置与目标分布的匹配程度；UNET架构的微小改动会导致截然不同的创造力表现，且常产生高度非真实的样本。

Conclusion: 扩散模型成功的关键在于去噪器架构的归纳偏置与真实目标分布之间的强对齐。

Abstract: The creativity of diffusion models refers to their ability to generate highly realistic images that are different from their training data. Creativity is somewhat surprising since it is known that if the denoiser used in the diffusion model is the Bayes optimal denoiser for a given training set, then the model will simply copy the training samples. In this paper we present empirical and theoretical results that suggest that creativity in diffusion models is due to an interaction between the denoiser architecture and the target distribution. Theoretically, we give explicit forms for the distribution of generated samples as a function of the target distribution and the denoiser architecture for three different denoiser architectures (linear, polynomial, bottleneck). Empirically, we show that small changes in the popular UNET denoiser architecture leads to very different forms of creativity, and these small changes often yield samples that are highly nonrealistic. Taken together, our results show that diffusion models will only be successful if the inductive bias of the denoiser architecture is in strong alignment with the true target distribution.

</details>


### [433] [TRACE: Evidence Grounding-Guided Multi-Video Event Understanding and Claim Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16740)
*Pengyu Yan,Akhil Gorugantu,Mahesh Bhosale,Abdul Wasi,Vishvesh Trivedi,David Doermann*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: TRACE是一个面向多视频事件理解的证据定位引导框架，采用"先定位后推理"策略，通过OCR和目标检测构建文本可搜索的时间线，由纯文本LLM进行查询感知的证据定位，再引导LVLM生成事实性更完整、归因更准确的内容。在MAGMaR 2026验证集上，宏平均MiRAGE F1从0.705提升至0.811，引用召回率从0.440提升至0.628，达到SOTA水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在跨多个长视频的事件理解中，上下文预算迅速耗尽，难以精确定位证据片段，经常遗漏广播图形、字幕、记分牌等密集信息线索，导致事实完整性和归因保真度不足。

Method: 提出TRACE框架，采用ground-before-reasoning策略：1) 利用OCR和目标检测为每个视频构建结构化的文本可搜索时间线；2) 使用纯文本LLM进行查询感知的证据定位，在视觉推理之前选择相关时刻；3) 将检索到的帧及其定位摘要用于引导LVLM进行声明生成和跨视频引用整合。

Result: 在MAGMaR 2026验证集上，宏平均MiRAGE F1从0.705提升至0.811，引用召回率从0.440提升至0.628；在WikiVideo数据集上也验证了有效性；在MAGMaR 2026官方排行榜上达到SOTA。

Conclusion: 结构化证据定位能显著提升多视频事件理解的事实完整性和归因保真度，先定位后推理的策略优于无引导的VLMs基线。

Abstract: Multi-video event understanding demands models that can locate and attribute query-relevant evidence scattered across long, heterogeneous video corpora. Existing large vision-language models (LVLMs) often underperform in this regime because they quickly exhaust their context budget and struggle to precisely localize evidentially important segments, frequently missing dense informational cues such as broadcast graphics, subtitles, and scoreboards. We introduce TRACE, an evidence grounding-guided framework that follows a ground-before-reasoning strategy for multi-video event reasoning. Our approach first builds a structured, text-searchable timeline for each video using OCR and object detection. A text-only LLM then conducts query-aware evidence localization, selecting relevant moments prior to any downstream visual reasoning. The retrieved frames and their grounding summaries are subsequently used to steer LVLM-based claim generation and cross-video citation consolidation. Experiments on MAGMaR 2026 and WikiVideo demonstrate that structured grounding markedly boosts factual completeness and attribution fidelity. On the MAGMaR validation split, TRACE raises macro-average MiRAGE F1 from 0.705 to 0.811 compared to an unguided Qwen3-VL-30B baseline, with especially strong improvements in citation recall from 0.440 to 0.628. The method also attains state-of-the-art results on the official MAGMaR 2026 leaderboard. Code is released at https://github.com/pengyu965/TRACE.

</details>


### [434] [An Efficient Streaming Video Understanding Framework with Agentic Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17921)
*Jinming Liu,Jianguo Huang,Zhaoyang Jia,Jiahao Li,Xiaoyi Zhang,Zongyu Guo,Bin Li,Wenjun Zeng,Yan Lu,Xin Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出R3-Streaming框架，将流式视频理解建模为级联控制问题，通过年龄感知遗忘策略进行内存压缩，并利用TB-GRPO目标函数进行计算路由，在显著降低视觉令牌使用量的同时达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式视频方法采用静态策略（固定内存压缩或单一模型），导致快速模型无法处理复杂查询，而重型模型违反实时约束且过度处理简单查询，亟需动态决策机制。

Method: 1) 级联控制流水线：依次执行内存压缩、响应就绪判断和计算路由；2) 年龄感知遗忘策略（Age-aware Forgetting）：基于帧时效性进行自适应压缩；3) TB-GRPO：目标平衡的强化学习目标，将复杂查询路由到强模型同时防止模式坍缩。

Result: OVO-Bench 57.92分，StreamingBench 76.36分，视觉令牌使用量减少95-96%。

Conclusion: 动态路由和年龄感知压缩可有效平衡流式视频理解中的延迟与性能，为实时多模态理解提供新范式。

Abstract: Streaming video requires handling dynamic information density under strict latency budgets. Yet, existing methods typically employ static strategies, such as fixed memory compression or reliance on a single model, forcing a trade-off: fast models fail on complex queries, while always-on heavy models violate real-time constraints and overcomplicate simple queries. Rather than fixing these decisions upfront, we propose R3-Streaming (Remember, Respond, Reason), which formulates streaming video understanding as a cascaded control problem: for each query, the system compresses memory, judges response readiness, and routes computation sequentially, so that each downstream decision builds on progressively refined information states. To optimize this pipeline, we introduce an age-aware forgetting policy for memory compression, as aggressively compressing historical frames can yield substantial performance gains. For compute routing, we propose TB-GRPO, a target-balanced reinforcement learning objective that routes hard queries to a stronger model while preventing mode collapse. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that R3-Streaming achieves state-of-the-art results among streaming MLLMs, reaching 57.92 on OVO-Bench and 76.36 on StreamingBench, while reducing visual token usage by 95 to 96 percent.

</details>


### [435] [MSAVBench: Towards Comprehensive and Reliable Evaluation of Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20183)
*Yujie Wei,Yujin Han,Zhekai Chen,Yongming Li,Kaixun Jiang,Zhihang Liu,Quanhao Li,Zhiwu Qing,Xiang Wang,Zhen Xing,Ruihang Chu,Lingyi Hong,Yefei He,Junjie Zhou,Junqiu Yu,Yang Shi,Difan Zou,Kai Zhu,Shiwei Zhang,Yingya Zhang,Yu Liu,Xihui Liu,Hongming Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MSAVBench是首个面向多镜头音视频生成（MSAV）的综合基准与自适应混合评估框架，涵盖视频、音频、镜头、参考四个维度，支持最多15个镜头，通过自适应自校正分割、实例级评分和工具化证据提取实现稳健评估，与人类判断的Spearman秩相关达91.5%，对19个模型的系统评估表明现有模型在导演级控制和细粒度音视频同步上仍有不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成正从单镜头合成向复杂多镜头音视频叙事演进，但现有基准在数据多样性上有限，评估流程僵化，无法系统可靠地评估现代MSAV模型，迫切需要更全面的基准和评估框架。

Method: 构建涵盖视频、音频、镜头、参考四个维度的MSAVBench基准，包含多样任务设置、最多15个镜头及非真实场景；提出自适应混合评估框架，含自适应自校正镜头分割机制、实例级主观评分规则和工具化证据提取方法。

Result: MSAVBench与人类判断的Spearman秩相关系数达91.5%；对19个闭源和开源模型的系统评估显示，现有模型在导演级控制和细粒度音视频同步上仍存在困难，模块化或智能体化生成流水线有望缩小开源与闭源模型差距。

Conclusion: MSAVBench作为首个全面的MSAV基准和自适应混合评估框架，有效填补了现有评估体系的空白，揭示了当前模型的不足，并为未来研究指明了方向。

Abstract: Video generation is rapidly evolving from single-shot synthesis to complex multi-shot audio-video (MSAV) narratives to meet real-world demands. However, evaluating such frontier models remains a fundamental challenge. Existing benchmarks are limited in scope and data diversity, and rely on rigid evaluation pipelines, preventing systematic and reliable assessment of modern MSAV models. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MSAVBench, the first comprehensive benchmark and adaptive hybrid evaluation framework for multi-shot audio-video generation. Our benchmark spans four key dimensions, video, audio, shot, and reference, covering diverse task settings, varying shot counts of up to 15, and challenging non-realistic scenarios. Our evaluation framework improves robustness through an adaptive self-correction mechanism for shot segmentation, instance-wise rubrics for subjective metrics, and tool-grounded evidence extraction for complex judgments. Furthermore, MSAVBench achieves high alignment with human judgments, reaching a Spearman rank correlation of 91.5%. Our systematic evaluation of 19 state-of-the-art closed- and open-source models shows that current systems still struggle with director-level control and fine-grained audio-visual synchronization, while modular or agentic generation pipelines offer a promising path toward narrowing the gap between open- and closed-source models. The benchmark data and evaluation code are publicly available at https://github.com/ali-vilab/MSAVBench.

</details>


### [436] [Can Vision Models Truly Forget? Mirage: Representation-Level Certification of Visual Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20282)
*Zhenyu Yu,Yangchen Zeng,Chunlei Meng,Guangzhen Yao,Shuigeng Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Mirage框架，通过四个表征级诊断方法评估纵向联邦学习中的机器遗忘，发现现有方法仅通过输出级指标认证遗忘存在严重缺陷：存在遗忘差距、无法同时满足三重目标、以及类别与样本级遗忘的不对称性，呼吁采用表征级评估标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有纵向联邦学习中的机器遗忘方法仅依赖输出级指标来认证遗忘效果，缺乏对模型内部表征的评估，可能导致对遗忘程度的误判。作者旨在揭示这一评估标准的不足，并提出更全面的表征级审计框架。

Method: 提出Mirage框架，包含四种互补的诊断方法：线性探针恢复（LPR）、中心核对齐（CKA）、特征可分离性评分和逐层恢复分析。在7个数据集和7种基线方法上进行实验，遵循近期VFL遗忘协议进行系统评估。

Result: 三个关键发现：①遗忘差距：通过输出级认证的方法在表征中仍保留显著类别结构，LPR超过重训练基线最多15.4点；②遗忘三难困境：现有方法无法同时实现高效用、输出级遗忘和表征级遗忘；③类别-样本不对称性：类别级遗忘残留强表征痕迹（LPR高达97%），而样本级遗忘与随机水平无异（LPR约50%）。

Conclusion: 现有VFL遗忘方法的输出级认证不可靠，需要引入表征级评估标准；同时揭示了遗忘任务中效用、输出级遗忘和表征级遗忘三者之间的根本性权衡。

Abstract: Machine unlearning in Vertical Federated Learning (VFL) has attracted growing interest, yet existing methods certify forgetting solely using output-level metrics. We challenge these claims by introducing Mirage, a representation-level auditing framework comprising four complementary diagnostics: Linear Probe Recovery (LPR), Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), Feature Separability Scoring, and Layer-Wise Recovery Analysis. Through experiments across seven datasets and seven baseline methods following recent VFL unlearning protocols, Mirage reveals three key findings: (i) Forgetting gap: methods that pass output-level certification still retain substantial class structure in their representations, with LPR exceeding the retrained baseline by up to 15.4 points; CKA shows these models remain structurally closer to the original than to the retrained reference, while separability scores indicate persistent geometric discrimination. (ii) Unlearning trilemma: no existing method simultaneously achieves high utility, output-level forgetting, and representation-level forgetting. (iii) Class-sample asymmetry: class-level forgetting leaves strong representational traces (LPR up to 97%), whereas sample-level forgetting is indistinguishable from chance (LPR approx. 50%); layer-wise analysis further shows residual class information persists across network depths. These findings call for representation-aware evaluation standards in federated unlearning research.

</details>


### [437] [Co-Fusion4D: Spatio-temporal Collaborative Fusion for Robust 3D Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20301)
*Wenxuan Li,Qin Zou,Shoubing Chen,Chi Chen,Yingyi Yang,Qingxiang Meng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Co-Fusion4D通过当前帧主导-历史帧互补的融合机制和双注意力融合模块，显式保持跨帧时空一致性，在nuScenes上达到74.9% mAP和75.6% NDS的SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BEV检测器中物体运动与自车运动导致跨帧时空不一致，具体表现为时序BEV特征错位和时空一致性退化。

Method: 1）采用当前帧主导-历史帧互补的融合策略，先进行时空滤波与对齐再选择性融合历史帧；2）设计双注意力融合(DAF)模块，同时利用帧内空间注意力和帧间时序注意力，自适应地对齐和融合多帧特征。

Result: 在nuScenes基准上达到74.9% mAP和75.6% NDS，无需测试时增强或外部数据，达到SOTA。

Conclusion: Co-Fusion4D通过显式保持时空一致性和抑制时序特征漂移，有效提升了BEV表示的时序稳定性和判别能力。

Abstract: In autonomous driving, 3D object detection is essential for accurate perception and reliable decision-making. However, object motion and ego-motion often induce cross-frame spatiotemporal inconsistencies in BEV-based detectors, leading to temporal BEV feature misalignment and degraded spatiotemporal consistency.
  To address these challenges, we propose Co-Fusion4D, a unified framework that explicitly preserves cross-frame spatiotemporal consistency and suppresses temporal feature drift. Co-Fusion4D adopts a current-frame-centric strategy, treating the current frame as the primary source of information while selectively incorporating historical frames after spatiotemporal filtering and alignment. This dominant-complementary mechanism effectively mitigates cumulative alignment errors, suppresses noisy feature propagation, and exploits reliable temporal cues for a more consistent BEV representation.
  In addition, Co-Fusion4D integrates a Dual Attention Fusion (DAF) module to further enhance spatiotemporal feature interaction. DAF jointly leverages intra-frame spatial attention and inter-frame temporal attention to adaptively align and fuse multi-frame features, emphasizing motion-consistent regions while suppressing spurious correlations. By departing from conventional uniform fusion paradigms, this design substantially improves the temporal stability and discriminative capability of BEV representations.
  Extensive experiments on the nuScenes benchmark demonstrate that Co-Fusion4D achieves state-of-the-art performance, with 74.9% mAP and 75.6% NDS, without relying on test-time augmentation or external data.

</details>


### [438] [RelWitness: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation with Visual-Geometric Relation Witnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20823)
*Minh Anh Nguyen,Quang Huy Tran,Bao Ngoc Le,Tuan Kiet Pham,Sui Yang Guang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出RelWitness框架，通过“关系见证者”（relation witness）概念，利用视觉-几何线索从未完全标注的RGB-D序列中生成开放词汇的3D场景图，解决关系标注不完整导致的监督不可靠问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放词汇3D场景图生成面临标注不可靠问题：数据集中关系标注具有选择性，大量有效的物体对关系未被标注，导致监督信号不完整。

Method: 提出关系见证者（relation witness）概念，即让关系在捕获场景中可被观测的具体视觉-几何线索；构建包含RGB视图、深度图、3D几何、角色敏感文本、物体先验空视图和多视角一致性的见证记录；通过视觉-几何见证验证器将未标注的关系候选分类为已验证的正例、可靠负例或不确定样本；采用见证引导的正-无标签（positive-unlabeled）学习目标从未完整标注中学习；引入见证一致解码和RGB-D缺失关系审计协议。

Result: 在3DSSG/3RScan和ScanNet开放词汇分割上的模拟实验显示：未见关系识别能力提升、见证精度提高、幻觉减少、冗余关系短语降低。结果均为规划值，需替换为实际测量值。

Conclusion: RelWitness通过关系见证者机制有效缓解了3D场景图生成中关系标注不完整的监督问题，为开放词汇关系识别提供了可行框架。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation seeks to describe object instances and their relations with flexible natural-language predicates. The central difficulty is not only vocabulary expansion, but supervision reliability: relation annotations in 3D scene graph datasets are selective, and many valid object-pair relations are unannotated. We propose RelWitness, a framework for open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation from posed RGB-D sequences under incomplete relation supervision. The key concept is a relation witness: a concrete visual-geometric cue that makes a relation observable in the captured scene. Support relations require contact and vertical ordering; containment requires enclosure; proximity requires metric closeness; orientation requires facing direction; and stable relations should persist across views where both objects are visible. RelWitness constructs relation witness records from RGB views, depth maps, reconstructed 3D geometry, role-sensitive text, object-prior null views, and multi-view consistency. A visual-geometric witness verifier assigns unannotated relation candidates to verified missing positives, reliable negatives, or uncertain unlabeled cases. A witness-guided positive-unlabeled objective then learns from incomplete annotations without turning every missing label into a negative. We further introduce witness-consistent decoding and an RGB-D missing-relation audit protocol. Simulated manuscript-planning experiments on 3DSSG/3RScan and ScanNet-derived open-vocabulary splits show the intended behavior: improved unseen-relation recognition, higher witness precision, lower hallucination, and reduced redundant relation phrases. All numerical results are planning values and must be replaced by reproduced measurements before submission

</details>


### [439] [AIGaitor: Privacy-preserving and cloud-free motion analysis for everyone, using edge computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21421)
*Lauhitya Reddy,Trisha M. Kesar,Hyeokhyen Kwon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AIGaitor是一个隐私保护、无需云端的运动分析系统，完全在消费级智能手机上运行无标记单目运动捕捉和下游深度学习分析，在iPhone 14上处理10秒4K 60fps视频仅需77秒，性能可与高端云服务器媲美，解决了临床应用的成本、复杂性和隐私问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床运动分析因成本、技术复杂性和隐私问题而受限；对74名康复临床医生的调查显示，92%愿意采用准确、低成本、易用的AI步态分析工具，而79.7%认为运营成本、68.9%认为培训不足、64.9%认为隐私问题是主要障碍。

Method: 在消费级智能手机上部署并优化单目运动捕捉管线，包括2D/3D姿态估计、姿态优化、基于骨架的深度学习分析和视觉语言模型；通过Time-Priority端到端管线在设备上处理视频；利用轻量级模型（如ViTPose-s）实现实时关键点提取和亚毫秒级步态分类。

Result: 在iPhone 14上处理10秒4K 60fps视频仅需77秒，与高端NVIDIA H200云服务器（含网络传输）相比，在移动平均上行链路下为94秒、发达地区Wi-Fi下为66秒，性能相当甚至更优。

Conclusion: AIGaitor是首个在端侧实现端到端单目运动捕捉和下游深度学习分析的系统，为临床提供了低成本、隐私保护且易于获取的运动分析方案。

Abstract: Motion capture is the gold standard for measuring human movement, but clinical use remains limited by cost, technical complexity, and privacy concerns. AIGaitor is a privacy-preserving, cloud-free motion analysis system that runs markerless monocular motion-capture pipelines and downstream deep-learning analysis entirely on a consumer smartphone using on-device neural accelerators. To motivate its design, we surveyed 74 rehabilitation clinicians: 92 percent said they would adopt an accurate, cost-effective, easy-to-use AI gait analysis tool, while 79.7 percent cited operating cost, 68.9 percent insufficient training, and 64.9 percent privacy concerns as leading barriers. We then optimized and benchmarked mobile iOS implementations of current monocular pipeline components, including 2D and 3D pose estimation, pose optimization, skeleton-based deep-learning analysis, and a vision-language model. A Time-Priority end-to-end on-device pipeline processes a 10 s 4K 60 fps video clip in 77 s on an iPhone 14, matching or beating the same pipeline on a high-end NVIDIA H200 cloud server when network transfer is included: 94 s at global mobile-average uplink and 66 s at developed-world Wi-Fi. Lightweight models such as ViTPose-s achieve real-time keypoint extraction, and skeleton-based action-recognition models provide sub-millisecond gait classification on the same clip. To our knowledge, AIGaitor is the first monocular system to demonstrate end-to-end on-device motion capture and downstream deep-learning analysis, supporting clinically applicable movement analysis that is low-cost, private, and accessible to smartphone users.

</details>


### [440] [Dual-Integrated Low-Latency Single-Lens Infrared Computational Imaging for Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21964)
*Xuquan Wang,Guishuo Yang,Dapeng Yan,Yujie Xing,Xuanyu Qian,Kai Zhang,Xiong Dun,Jiande Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PDI-Net提出一种结合物理先验的低延迟红外计算成像框架，通过在推理阶段跳过完整重建、利用半U-Net编码器与YOLO检测器共享特征，并引入基于场变点扩散函数的PALS-Bridge模块弥合重建特征与检测语义之间的差距，在M3FD基准上相比剪枝策略的Rec+Det方法减少84.06%推理时间并提升5.07% mAP@0.5:0.95。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算成像中重建与检测的级联或联合推理延迟高，而加速策略多聚焦于网络剪枝压缩，忽视了光学路径中的物理先验信息，导致精度与速度之间存在权衡。

Method: 提出PDI-Net：训练阶段使用监督U-Net；推理阶段采用半U-Net编码器直接与YOLO检测器共享特征，跳过完整图像重建；引入PALS-Bridge（物理感知大小桥接模块），利用场变点扩散函数先验自适应调制多尺度卷积分支；同时构建物理信息驱动的光学退化仿真流程用于训练和验证。

Result: 在单透镜红外相机上减重约50%；在M3FD低信噪比条件下，相比Rec+Det+剪枝策略，推理时间降低84.06%，mAP@0.5:0.95提升5.07%。

Conclusion: PDI-Net实现了紧凑、低延迟的计算红外成像，适用于资源受限平台上的实时目标检测任务。

Abstract: Computational imaging enables compact infrared systems, but deep-learning pipelines that combine image reconstruction and object detection often introduce substantial inference latency. Most existing acceleration strategies compress the reconstruction network while overlooking physical priors from the optical path, leaving a trade-off between accuracy and speed. We present Physics-aware Dual-Integrated Network (PDI-Net), a low-latency framework that integrates infrared reconstruction with object detection and further embeds optical priors into the learning process. PDI-Net uses a supervised U-Net during training, while a semi-U-Net encoder shares features directly with a YOLO-based detector during inference, avoiding full image reconstruction. To bridge the gap between fidelity-oriented reconstruction features and detection-oriented semantics, we introduce a physics-aware large-small bridge (PALS-Bridge), which uses field-dependent point spread function priors to adaptively modulate multiscale convolutional branches. A physics-informed optical degradation simulation pipeline is also developed for training and validation. The method is deployed on a single-lens infrared camera, reducing system weight by about 50% compared with traditional multi-lens designs. On the M3FD benchmark under low-SNR conditions, PDI-Net reduces inference time by 84.06% compared with the Rec+Det with pruning strategy while improving mAP@0.5:0.95 by 5.07%. These results demonstrate compact, low-latency computational infrared imaging for real-time object detection on resource-constrained platforms.

</details>


### [441] [From Abstraction to Instantiation: Learning Behavioral Representation for Vision-Language-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22671)
*Bing Hu,Zaijing Li,Rui Shao,Junda Chen,April Hua Liu,Wei-Shi Zheng,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BehaviorVLA通过因果Mamba架构的长程行为编码器和相位条件解码器，实现了跨分布偏移的鲁棒操作，在多项基准上达到SOTA，且仅需50%数据即可匹敌OpenVLA-OFT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型在分布偏移下性能下降，因为难以学习跨环境的通用行为表征；现有方法受限于短视时间碎片化和静态执行对齐，导致复杂场景中行为不一致。

Method: 提出BehaviorVLA框架，包含两个对称组件：(1) Visuomotor Behavior Encoder (VBE)：基于因果Mamba架构聚合长程轨迹信息为统一行为表征；(2) Phase-conditioned Behavior Decoder (PBD)：通过动态对齐任务级先验与实时执行进度，将行为表征解码为精确动作。

Result: RoboTwin 2.0上58%成功率，LIBERO上98%成功率，CALVIN上4.36 Avg.Len；在真实sim-to-real迁移中，仅用50%演示数据即达到OpenVLA-OFT性能。

Conclusion: BehaviorVLA通过时间一致性行为表征学习实现了鲁棒操作，兼具数据效率与泛化能力。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often suffer from performance degradation under distribution shifts, as they struggle to learn generalized behavior representations across varying environments. While existing approaches attempt to construct behavior representations through action-centric latent variables, they are often limited by short-horizon temporal fragmentation and static execution-alignment, leading to inconsistent behaviors in complex scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{BehaviorVLA}, a framework that facilitates robust manipulation through the learning of a temporally coherent behavioral representations. Our approach features two symmetric components: (1) the \textbf{Visuomotor Behavior Encoder (VBE)}, which utilizes a causal Mamba-based architecture to aggregate long-horizon trajectory information into a unified behavior representation; and (2) the \textbf{Phase-conditioned Behavior Decoder (PBD)}, which decodes this representation into precise actions by dynamically aligning task-level priors with real-time execution progress. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and CALVIN demonstrate state-of-the-art success rates of 58\%, 98\%, and 4.36 (Avg.Len), respectively. Notably, in real-world sim-to-real transfer, BehaviorVLA matches the performance of OpenVLA-OFT using only 50\% of the demonstration data, showcasing its superior data efficiency and generalization.

</details>


### [442] [Beyond Normal References: Discriminative Few-Shot Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23231)
*Huan Wang,Jun Shen,Jun Yan,Guansong Pang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: IDEAL是一个针对判别式少样本异常检测任务的框架，通过从有限的正异常样本中学习内在偏差模式，抑制正常变化干扰并提取可泛化的判别性偏差方向，在8个真实数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少样本异常检测方法仅依赖正常样本进行正常性匹配，忽略了异常参考样本中的判别线索；而直接同时拟合正常和异常样本会导致对已见异常的过拟合，无法泛化到未见异常。

Method: 提出IDEAL框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 正常变化擦除器，抑制导致噪声偏差的正常变化；2) 内在偏差编码器，将去噪后的偏差表征分解为最具有判别性的正交内在偏差向量。推理时通过计算投影到已学习内在偏差向量后的查询样本与正常样本之间的偏差进行评分。

Result: 在8个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，IDEAL能够有效泛化到未见异常，并持续优于现有最先进的少样本异常检测方法。

Conclusion: IDEAL通过显式学习可泛化的内在偏差模式，在同时利用正常和异常参考样本的情况下，避免了过拟合问题，实现了对已见和未见异常的有效检测。

Abstract: This paper considers a practical few-shot anomaly detection (FSAD) setting, termed discriminative FSAD, where a limited number of both normal and anomalous examples are available as references during inference. Existing FSAD methods rely on normal-only references through normality matching, ignoring the discriminative clues in anomalous references, while directly fitting both references can overfit to the seen anomalies. We introduce IDEAL, an intrinsic deviation learning framework that leverages both reference types to learn intrinsic deviation patterns characterizing generalizable abnormality as deviations from normality. IDEAL decomposes the learning process into two novel components: 1) a Normal Variation Eraser to suppress nuisance normal variations that may lead to noisy deviations from normality, thereby highlighting anomaly-relevant deviation representations; 2) an Intrinsic Deviation Encoder to decompose these denoised deviation representations into intrinsic deviation vectors capturing the most discriminative orthogonal deviation directions. At inference, IDEAL scores query-to-normal deviations preserved after projection onto the learned intrinsic deviation vectors, enabling generalization for both seen and unseen anomalies. Extensive experiments on eight real-world datasets show that IDEAL generalizes effectively to unseen anomalies and consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art FSAD methods. Code and data will be available at \href{https://github.com/mala-lab/IDEAL}{https://github.com/mala-lab/IDEAL}.

</details>


### [443] [B-GRTO: Bootstrapped Group Relative Tool Optimization for Referring Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23500)
*Mario Markov,Stefan Maria Ailuro,Mohammad Mahdi,Luc Van Gool,Danda Pani Paudel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出组相对工具优化（GRTO）框架，将强化学习与可微分工具目标统一优化，并引入Bootstrap预训练方法，在复杂指代分割任务中显著优于纯GRPO，达到甚至超越领域最优方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将大视觉语言模型与分割解码器配对，但强化学习用于提升推理能力时，可训练工具（如分割解码器）通常用可微分目标单独优化，缺乏将这类目标原则性整合到强化学习中的方法。

Method: 提出GRTO框架，复用GRPO的rollouts来优化辅助工具目标，使解码器梯度补充策略奖励；进一步提出B-GRTO预训练方法，低成本引导工具训练，加速收敛并提升性能。

Result: 在三个具有挑战性的指代分割设定中，B-GRTO相比纯GRPO有显著提升，匹配或超越领域特定最先进方法。

Conclusion: 将强化学习与可微分辅助目标统一优化，对推理密集型分割任务具有重要价值。

Abstract: Segmentation is a fundamental task in computer vision, underpinning pixel-level scene understanding and serving as a cornerstone for applications ranging from autonomous perception to medical image analysis. For complex referring segmentation, recent methods pair large vision-language models with segmentation decoders: the former analyzes the image and prompt, while the latter predicts the target mask. Although reinforcement learning improves reasoning-intensive vision-language systems, trainable tools such as segmentation decoders are typically optimized separately with differentiable objectives, and the principled integration of such objectives into reinforcement learning remains underexplored. Thus, we introduce group relative tool optimization (GRTO), a mathematically grounded framework for jointly optimizing a policy with differentiable tool use. GRTO reuses group relative policy optimization (GRPO) rollouts to optimize the auxiliary tool objective, letting decoder gradients complement policy rewards. Further, we derive Bootstrapped-GRTO (B-GRTO), a pre-training method that cheaply bootstraps the tool, leading to faster convergence and superior performance. Across three challenging referring segmentation settings, B-GRTO results in substantial improvements over plain GRPO, matching or surpassing domain-specific state-of-the-art methods. This demonstrates the value of unifying reinforcement learning with differentiable auxiliary objectives for reasoning-intensive segmentation.

</details>


### [444] [Task-Aligned Self-Supervised Learning for Medical Image Analysis: A Systematic Review and Practical Design Guidelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23995)
*Chathura Wimalasiri*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了2017-2025年间75项自监督学习在医学影像中的研究，将方法分为对比、非对比/预测、生成/重建和混合四类范式，发现没有普适最优策略，性能取决于预文本任务与成像模态及下游任务的匹配度，对比方法适合分类，生成方法适合分割，混合方法综合最优，并提出了实用设计指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学影像中标注数据稀缺是主要瓶颈，自监督学习虽有潜力但效果高度依赖预文本任务设计与临床目标的匹配，现有研究缺乏从任务导向出发的系统性综述。

Method: 遵循PRISMA指南，系统分析2017-2025年间75篇研究，将SSL方法划分为对比、非对比/预测、生成/重建和混合学习四类范式，并将各范式映射到最适合的下游任务目标上。

Result: 没有普适最优SSL策略；对比方法擅长分类但可能忽略细微病理模式；生成和空间预测方法更适合分割等密集预测任务；混合方法综合性能最均衡；模态特异性设计至关重要；SSL在低标注和小样本场景下效益最大。

Conclusion: 基于发现提炼出实用设计指南，并指出开放挑战包括病理感知预文本任务设计、高维数据的高效训练和标准化评估协议。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for addressing the annotation bottleneck in medical imaging by learning representations from unlabeled data. However, its effectiveness depends heavily on the design of the pretext task and its alignment with the downstream clinical-objectives. We present a systematic, task-oriented review of SSL in medical imaging, examining how different pretext-task formulations influence performance across classification, segmentation, detection, and other tasks. Following PRISMA guidelines, we analyze 75 studies published between 2017 and 2025 and organize them into four paradigms: contrastive, non-contrastive and predictive, generative and reconstruction-based, and hybrid learning. Rather than cataloguing methods by architecture, we map each paradigm to the downstream objectives it best supports. Our analysis shows there is no universally optimal SSL strategy; instead, performance is governed by the alignment between the pretext task, the imaging modality, and the target task. Contrastive methods learn global discriminative features and align well with classification, but may overlook subtle pathological patterns. Generative and spatial prediction-based approaches better preserve local anatomical structure, making them more suitable for segmentation and other dense prediction tasks, while hybrid methods offer the most balanced performance. We further show that modality-specific design is critical and that SSL provides its greatest benefit in low-label and few-shot regimes. Finally, we distill these findings into practical design guidelines and outline open challenges, including pathology-aware pretext task design, resource-efficient training for high-dimensional data, and standardized evaluation protocols. This work offers practical guidance for designing more effective and clinically relevant SSL frameworks in medical imaging.

</details>


### [445] [CRISP -- Clustering-Based Redundancy-Reduced Instance Sampling for Pathology Case Representation and Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24253)
*Zahra Rahimi Afzal,Wataru Uegami,Saghir Alfasly,Saba Yasir,Judy C. Boughey,Matthew P. Goetz,Krishna R. Kalari,H. R. Tizhoosh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了CRISP，一个无监督的两阶段框架，用于处理数字病理学中每个病例包含多个全切片图像（WSI）的情况。该框架先减少单个WSI内的冗余，再通过聚类采样选择紧凑且具代表性的病理块集合，构建病例级表征，用于患者检索。在梅奥诊所的乳腺癌数据集上，CRISP在病例检索任务中达到了或超越了当前依赖病理学家选择单张切片的金标准方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的数字病理分析方法大多依赖病理学家选择单张WSI，忽略了病例中其他切片可能包含的肿瘤异质性信息，缺乏一个能够自动整合多张WSI进行病例级分析的无监督框架。

Method: 提出CRISP两阶段框架：第一阶段在单个WSI内通过冗余减少采样剔除相似病理块；第二阶段应用基于聚类的采样，从所有WSI中选取紧凑且具代表性的病理块集合，构建病例级表征，直接用作检索索引。

Result: 在梅奥诊所两个乳腺癌数据集（诊断和治疗计划）上，CRISP在病例搜索和检索任务中一致地匹配或超越了当前结合模型和病理学家选择单张WSI的金标准方法。

Conclusion: CRISP通过自动化病例级处理并消除主观的WSI选择，能够挖掘当前被忽略的分布在多张WSI中的临床相关信息，为多WSI病例分析提供了一个有效的无监督解决方案。

Abstract: Digital pathology archives increasingly contain multiple whole-slide images (WSIs) per case, capturing spatially distinct tumour regions and reflecting intrinsic morphological heterogeneity. However, most existing approaches rely on a single pathologist-selected slide, thereby discarding potentially informative evidence distributed across the remaining WSIs. To date, no autonomous framework has been proposed for comprehensive multi-WSI case processing. Here, we present an unsupervised framework for case-level analysis that integrates information from all available slides within a case. Rather than relying on a single designated slide, the proposed approach constructs case-level representations by selectively distilling informative patches across WSIs. We introduce Clustering-Based Redundancy-Reduced Instance Sampling for Pathology (CRISP), a two-stage framework that first reduces redundancy within individual WSIs and subsequently applies clustering-based sampling to select a compact yet representative set of patches for the entire case. The resulting patch set captures case-level heterogeneity while avoiding exhaustive processing of gigapixel images, and directly serves as a retrieval index. Using two Mayo Clinic breast cancer datasets for diagnosis and treatment planning, we demonstrate that CRISP consistently matches or surpasses the current standard practice of combined model and pathologist slide selection for patient/case search and retrieval. By automating case-level processing and eliminating subjective WSI selection, CRISP potentially enables the exploitation of clinically relevant information distributed across multiple WSIs that is currently overlooked.

</details>


### [446] [TempRet: Temporal Enhancement and Two-Stage Reranking for CVPR 2026 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Multi-Instance Retrieval Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24470)
*Zixu Li,Yupeng Hu,Zhiwei Chen,Zhiheng Fu,Xiaowei Zhu,Weili Guan,Liqiang Nie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对自我中心视频检索中时间动态被忽略的问题，提出TempRet方法，在CLIP双编码器基础上引入时间Transformer和两阶段重排序流水线，利用软标签相关性矩阵训练，在EK-100 MIR基准上取得67.97%平均mAP和82.92%平均nDCG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频-文本检索方法继承图像-文本检索的逐帧处理假设，忽略了自我中心视频的时间动态特性；同时EPIC-KITCHENS-100 MIR挑战引入软标签相关性矩阵而非二值标签，要求模型能够解决跨模态的渐进语义对应问题。

Method: 基于CLIP双编码器主干，提出两个关键组件：(1) 时间Transformer——仅在视频侧运行，通过可学习位置编码和帧级CLIP特征上的多头自注意力建模帧间依赖；(2) 两阶段重排序流水线——先通过双编码器检索Top-K候选，再利用带图像-文本匹配头的交叉编码器优化分数。整个系统使用对称多相似性损失利用软标签相关性矩阵进行训练。

Result: 在EK-100 MIR基准上，方法达到67.97%平均mAP和82.92%平均nDCG。

Conclusion: 时间建模与跨模态精炼对自我中心视频检索有效，证明了CLIP双编码器+时间Transformer+两阶段重排序框架在处理软标签相关性矩阵场景下的优越性。

Abstract: Video-text retrieval has witnessed remarkable progress driven by large-scale vision-language pretraining, yet most existing approaches inherit an implicit assumption from image-text retrieval: that visual semantics can be captured frame-by-frame. This assumption overlooks the temporal dynamics of egocentric videos. The EPIC-KITCHENS-100 Multi-Instance Retrieval (MIR) challenge further raises the bar by providing soft-label relevance matrices rather than binary labels, demanding models that can resolve graded semantic correspondences across modalities. In this report, we present our solution, termed TempRet, to the CVPR 2026 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 MIR challenge. Our approach builds upon a CLIP-based dual-encoder backbone and introduces two key components to address the temporal and cross-modal challenges. First, a temporal transformer operates exclusively on the video side, modeling inter-frame dependencies through learnable positional encodings and multi-head self-attention over frame-level CLIP features. Second, a two-stage reranking pipeline first retrieves Top-K candidates via the dual-encoder, then refines their scores using a cross-encoder equipped with an Image-Text Matching (ITM) head. The entire system is trained with Symmetric Multi-Similarity Loss to exploit the soft-label relevance matrices provided by the challenge. Our method achieves 67.97% average mAP and 82.92% average nDCG on the EK-100 MIR benchmark, demonstrating the effectiveness of temporal modeling and cross-modal refinement for egocentric video retrieval.

</details>


### [447] [Resolving Ambiguity in Composed Image Retrieval via Calibrated Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24634)
*Amsisan Tran,Baogh Le,Tuan Kiet Pham,Sui Yang Guang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出现有组合图像检索（CIR）任务的核心缺陷——查询的模糊性导致假阴性问题，并提出将CIR重新定义为不确定性下的校准意图解析：通过共形预测层返回具有覆盖保证的候选集，以集合大小作为模糊性的度量，并在必要时通过信息增益策略提出最有效的澄清问题。文章引入AmbiCIR基准和用户模拟器，在多个基准上达到单轮SOTA性能，同时显著减少交互轮次，并首次报告了有效的覆盖率和校准结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CIR系统都假设一个查询对应单个目标，用Recall@K评估，但这忽视了查询天然具有的模糊性（如"让它更正式"并不指向特定图像，而是一个图像区域），导致严重的假阴性问题，且模型无法区分精确查询和模糊查询。

Method: 将CIR重新框架为"不确定性下的校准意图解析"：检索器外包裹共形预测层，生成具有统计覆盖保证的候选集，候选集大小作为模糊性的量化指标；当集合过大时，采用期望信息增益策略，从可解释的模糊性轴中选出最有用的澄清问题，从而收缩候选集。同时构建了AmbiCIR基准和经过人工验证的用户模拟器。

Result: 在开放域和时尚基准上，该方法在精确查询上达到单轮SOTA性能；在模糊查询场景下，以远少于朴素对话基线的交互轮次到达目标图像；首次为CIR任务报告了有效的覆盖率和校准结果。

Conclusion: 共形预测+主动澄清问询策略能够在不牺牲精确查询性能的前提下，有效处理CIR中的查询模糊性问题，提供统计保证的覆盖率和校准度量，为CIR任务提供了更合理的问题框架和评估范式。

Abstract: Composed image retrieval (CIR) searches a corpus with a reference image and a text describing how to modify it. Despite rapid progress from triplet-trained compositors to zero-shot and generative methods, essentially all systems share one assumption: that a query maps to a single target, scored by Recall@K against one annotation. We argue this is fundamentally at odds with the task. A query such as make it more formal does not name an image but a region of the corpus, and which member the user intends is genuinely underdetermined. This underspecification is the root of the well-known false-negative problem and leaves current models unable to tell a precise query from an ambiguous one. We reframe CIR as calibrated intent resolution under uncertainty: a retriever is wrapped in a conformal prediction layer that returns a candidate set with a coverage guarantee and whose size is a principled measure of ambiguity; when the set is large, an expected-information-gain policy asks the single most useful clarifying question, drawn from interpretable ambiguity axes, and the set contracts. We introduce AmbiCIR, a benchmark and human-validated user simulator that revive the dormant auxiliary and dialogue annotations of CIRR and extend the multiple-positive setting of CIRCO. Across open-domain and fashion benchmarks our method matches single-turn state of the art, confirming calibrated resolution is cost-free on precise queries, while reaching the intended target in a fraction of the interaction budget required by naive conversational baselines, and it is the first to report valid coverage and calibration for the task.

</details>


### [448] [X-Foresight: A Joint Vision-Action Causal Forecasting Network via Predictive World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24892)
*Baolu Li,Jingyu Qian,Rui Guo,Yilun Chen,Hanpeng Liu,Yuan Lin,Junhong Zhou,Ruixin Liu,Willow Yang,Yutong Zheng,Zhenli Zhang,Tenglong,Gu,Zhuangzhuang Ding,Pengkun Zheng,Yu Zhang,Xianming Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: X-Foresight是一个将预测性世界模型直接集成到VLA架构中的方法，通过长距离块级自回归策略（密集块内帧+稀疏块间过渡）、课程学习、时间重要性采样和扩散多视图渲染器，有效解决了视频预测中的低熵退化与长程因果建模困境，在规划性能和生成保真度上显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理世界知识主要存在于视频中，赋予VLA模型此类知识对安全、可泛化的规划至关重要。然而，朴素的下一个帧预测面临两个挑战：1) 视频令牌低熵且冗余，预测退化为琐碎外推；2) 世界建模存在时间困境：密集预测捕获瞬时动态但无法高效建模长程因果关系。

Method: 1) 长距离块级自回归策略：预测语义上相距较远的块（chunk）而非相邻帧，块内密集帧捕捉瞬时动态，块间稀疏过渡建模长程因果关系。2) 课程学习：逐步扩展预测视野并稳定长程训练。3) 时间重要性采样：根据自我运动和行为信号识别安全关键块，集中监督。4) 扩散式多视图渲染器：负责逼真合成，提升外观真实性。

Result: X-Foresight在规划性能上显著优于VLA基线，同时保持强大的生成保真度。

Conclusion: X-Foresight建立了一个以世界知识驱动的自主系统鲁棒范式，证明将预测性世界模型集成到VLA架构中能有效提升物理世界理解与规划能力。

Abstract: Physical world knowledge resides mainly in videos. Equipping Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with such knowledge is fundamental for safe and generalizable planning. Predictive world modeling enables VLA to internalize physical dynamics and long-term causality by predicting future video from past observations. However, naive next-frame prediction faces two challenges: 1) unlike semantically distinct text tokens, video tokens are low-entropy and redundant, causing prediction to degenerate into trivial extrapolation. 2) world modeling poses a temporal dilemma: dense prediction captures instantaneous dynamics, but cannot efficiently model long-horizon causality.
  To learn world knowledge effectively, we introduce X-Foresight, a predictive world model integrated directly into the VLA architecture to jointly learn world modeling and real-time action control. At its core lies a long-horizon chunk-wise auto-regressive strategy that addresses both challenges: by predicting semantically distant chunks rather than adjacent frames, it escapes trivial extrapolation, while preserving dense intra-chunk frames for instantaneous dynamics and sparse inter-chunk transitions for long-term causality. A curriculum learning schedule progressively extends prediction horizons and stabilizes long-horizon training. To capture long-term causality effectively, we present temporal importance sampling, which concentrates supervision on safety-critical chunks identified by ego-motion and behavioral signals. We further delegate photorealistic synthesis to a diffusion-based multi-view renderer, improving photorealistic appearance.
  Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that X-Foresight significantly outperforms VLA baselines in planning performance while maintaining strong generative fidelity, establishing a robust paradigm for world-knowledge-driven autonomous systems.

</details>


### [449] [SpikeReg: Energy-Efficient 3D Deformable Medical Image Registration with Spiking Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25144)
*Ali Mikaeili Barzili,Behzad Moshiri,Hamid Azadegan,Mohammad-Reza A. Dehaqani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Deformable medical image registration aligns anatomical structures across images but remains computationally dense at 3D resolution. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) offer sparse event-driven computation, yet have not been systematically studied for deformable medical image registration. We introduce SpikeReg, a spiking U-Net for 3D brain MRI registration. SpikeReg is initialized from an analog ANN registration teacher, converted by layer-wise weight transfer and activation-percentile threshold calibration, and fine-tuned with a surrogate-gradient objective combining local cross-correlation, diffusion regularization, and spike-rate sparsity. On the OASIS Learn2Reg validation split ($19$ image pairs), SpikeReg reaches Dice $0.7474 \pm 0.032$, with no significant paired Dice difference from the ANN teacher ($0.7480 \pm 0.037$, $p = 0.67$), at a $12.8\%$ mean spike rate and a $55.5\times$ projected arithmetic-energy reduction under an event-sparse SynOps/MAC proxy relative to the dense-ANN baseline. We additionally report two negative findings: displacement distillation from the ANN teacher hurts performance, and ANN teachers trained with a label-Dice loss fail to transfer through rate-code conversion. Together these results show that dense geometric prediction can be performed under sparse event-driven computation, opening a path toward neuromorphic medical image registration.

</details>


### [450] [Baton: Explicit Semantic Blueprints for Joint Video-Audio Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25195)
*Shuyuan Tu,Qi Tian,Zihan Yang,Yue Wu,Xintong Han,Weijie Kong,Jiangfeng Xiong,Jian-Wei Zhang,Zhao Zhong,Liefeng Bo,Zuxuan Wu,Yu-Gang Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Baton提出首个将显式语义规划引入联合视频-音频生成的框架，通过VA-Planner生成模态感知的规划令牌作为蓝图，并借助相对语义RoPE实现时空对齐，解决了开源扩散模型在音视频生成中语义粗糙、轨迹不协调的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有开源扩散模型依赖粗粒度文本嵌入引导音视频去噪，丢失了细粒度语义信息且缺乏共享的长程规划，导致音视频生成不稳定、不同步，尤其在复杂语义推理场景下表现不佳。

Method: 提出Baton框架：1) VA-Planner：使用具备双语义对齐塔的多模态语言模型，通过可学习查询交叉注意力于视频和音频特征，生成语义对齐的视频/音频规划令牌作为关键帧级蓝图；2) 将规划令牌通过交叉注意力层注入扩散主干，补充粗粒度文本嵌入；3) 提出相对语义RoPE，将规划令牌与潜在变量映射到共享时空坐标系，实现位置对应的语义注意力。

Result: 在基准测试上的定性和定量实验均证明了Baton的有效性。

Conclusion: 显式语义规划是提升联合音视频生成协调性与语义丰富度的有效途径，Baton通过蓝图式规划令牌和相对位置编码解决了跨模态对齐和去噪轨迹不协调的问题。

Abstract: Current open-source diffusion models struggle to generate stable and synchronized audio-visual content, particularly in scenarios demanding complex semantic reasoning. The root cause is that existing methods rely on coarse text embeddings from off-the-shelf encoders to guide audio-video denoising, which discards fine-grained semantics and, critically, lacks a shared long-horizon plan, leading to uncoordinated denoising trajectories and fragile cross-modal alignment. We propose Baton, the first framework that introduces explicit semantic planning into joint video-audio generation. Our key insight is that complementing coarse text guidance with semantically rich, modality-aware planned tokens, jointly reasoned and mutually aligned before denoising, can simultaneously restore fine-grained semantic detail and establish a shared blueprint that coordinates both audio and video denoising trajectories. Concretely, Baton first introduces the VA-Planner, a multimodal language model equipped with dual semantic alignment towers, where learnable queries cross-attend to both video and audio features to produce a pair of semantically aligned video and audio planned tokens as keyframe-level blueprints. These planned tokens are injected into the diffusion backbone via cross-attention layers, providing temporally grounded guidance complementary to coarse text embeddings. Since planned tokens do not share one-to-one spatial-temporal correspondence with diffusion latents, we further propose Relative Semantic RoPE, a relative positional encoding that maps planned tokens and latents into a shared spatial-temporal coordinate frame, enabling each latent to accurately attend to its positionally corresponding semantic cues. Experiments on benchmarks show the effectiveness of Baton both qualitatively and quantitatively.

</details>


### [451] [Channel-wise Vector Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26089)
*Wei Song,Tianhang Wang,Yitong Chen,Tong Zhang,Zuxuan Wu,Min Li,Jiaqi Wang,Kaicheng Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的图像分词范式——通道级向量量化（CVQ），将传统的 patch-wise 分词替换为 channel-wise 分词。基于 CVQ，作者引入了一种新的视觉自回归框架——通道级自回归（CAR），通过"下一通道预测"机制，按照通道顺序逐步生成图像，先从全局结构开始，再细化细节。实验表明 CVQ 实现了 100% 码本利用率，CAR 在文本到图像生成任务中取得了优异的 DPG 和 GenEval 分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的向量量化方法（VQ）将每个 patch 的特征向量离散化为一个 token，以空间网格方式表示图像。这种方式忽略了图像通道维度上蕴含的层次化视觉细节信息，且存在码本利用率低等问题。作者希望探索一种新的量化范式，能够更充分地利用通道维度的信息，同时模拟人类艺术家先勾勒整体结构再细化细节的创作过程。

Method: CVQ：将特征图的每个通道独立量化，每个通道对应一个离散 token，将图像表示为多个视觉细节层次而非空间 patch 网格。CAR：基于 CVQ 的视觉自回归模型，通过"下一通道预测"的方式，按照通道顺序逐步生成图像，先预测代表全局结构的通道 token，再逐步预测包含细粒度属性的通道 token。

Result: (1) CVQ 在无额外技巧的情况下实现了 16K+ 码本大小下的 100% 码本利用率，并且相比传统 VQ 大幅提升了重建质量；(2) CAR 在文本到图像生成任务上取得了 DPG 分数 86.7 和 GenEval 分数 0.79，展现出强大的有效性。

Conclusion: 通道级向量量化（CVQ）和通道级自回归（CAR）为图像表示和生成提供了一种全新的范式，相较于传统的 patch 级方法具有显著优势，为视觉自回归模型的发展提供了新方向。

Abstract: We present Channel-wise Vector Quantization (CVQ), a novel image tokenization paradigm that replaces patch-wise tokens with channel-wise tokens. Unlike conventional vector quantization, which assigns a discrete token to each patch feature vector, CVQ quantizes each channel of the feature map. This formulation represents an image as discrete levels of visual details, rather than as a grid of spatial patches. Based on CVQ, we introduce a new visual autoregressive framework with "next-channel prediction". Instead of rendering images patch by patch in raster order, our Channel-wise Autoregressive (CAR) model predicts image channels sequentially, producing progressively enriched visual details. Specifically, it first sketches global structure and then refines fine-grained attributes, akin to a human artist's workflow. Empirically, we show that: (1) CVQ achieves 100% codebook utilization with a 16K+ codebook size without any bells and whistles, and substantially improves reconstruction quality over conventional VQ; and (2) CAR attains a DPG score of 86.7 and a GenEval score of 0.79, demonstrating strong effectiveness for text-to-image generation.

</details>


### [452] [InstructSAM: Segment Any Instance with Any Instructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26102)
*Yuqian Yuan,Wentong Li,Zhaocheng Li,Yutong Lin,Juncheng Li,Siliang Tang,Jun Xiao,Yueting Zhuang,Wenqiao Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: InstructSAM 是一个统一框架，通过将可学习实例查询注入视觉语言模型并桥接SAM3，实现基于任意指令的多实例分割，仅用2B参数即在多个基准上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在处理复杂指令驱动的多实例分割时存在不足，要么依赖SAM3的agentic流水线效率低下，要么端到端方法缺乏灵活的指令理解能力。作者希望设计一个统一、高效的框架，使模型能够理解任意指令并进行多实例分割。

Method: 1) 将指令驱动实例分割建模为集合结构查询预测问题；2) 提出推理到实例查询接口，将可学习实例查询注入VLM，与指令和视觉信息上下文融合；3) 设计混合注意力机制促进查询、视觉令牌和指令令牌间交互；4) 将LLM条件化查询投影到SAM3检测器查询空间，单次前向实现多实例分割；5) 构建Inst2Seg大规模高质量指令实例分割数据集。

Result: 仅2B参数的InstructSAM在复杂指令驱动和短语级指代分割基准上均取得强结果，超越了先前端到端方法和SAM3的agentic流水线，实现了高效的单次多实例预测。

Conclusion: InstructSAM通过将指令理解与实例级集合预测能力结合，在不修改SAM3核心架构的前提下赋予其高层次指令理解、组合推理和多实例分割能力，为指令驱动分割提供了一种高效统一的解决方案。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce InstructSAM, a unified and streamlined framework designed for multi-instance segmentation under arbitrary instructions. We formulates instruction-driven instance segmentation as a set-structured query prediction problem and propose an explicit reasoning-to-instance query interface that elegantly bridges a vision-language model (VLM) and SAM3. Specifically, a bank of learnable instance queries is injected into the VLM and contextualized with instruction and visual information, enabling each query to serve as an instance-aware slot. A hybrid-attention mechanism further promotes interaction among these queries, visual tokens, and instruction tokens, improving instance enumeration and reducing duplicate predictions. The resulting LLM-conditioned queries are projected into SAM3's detector query space to drive accurate multi-instance segmentation in a single forward pass. This design equips SAM3 with high-level instruction understanding, compositional reasoning, and instance-level set prediction without modifying its core architecture. To support training and evaluation, we further construct Inst2Seg, a high-quality and large-scale instruction-based instance segmentation dataset and benchmark that couples free-form instructions with instance-level masks. Extensive experiments show that only 2B-scale InstructSAM achieves strong results across complex instruction-driven and phrase-level referring segmentation benchmarks, outperforming prior end-to-end methods and SAM3's agentic pipeline while enabling efficient single-pass multi-instance prediction.

</details>


### [453] [Evi-Steer: Learning to Steer Biomedical Vision-Language Models through Efficient and Generalizable Evidential Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26292)
*Taha Koleilat,Hassan Rivaz,Yiming Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Evi-Steer 是一个针对 BiomedCLIP 的不确定性感知参数高效微调框架，仅更新 0.11% 的参数，通过轻量级低维令牌更新和基于 Dempster-Shafer 理论的跨模态置信融合，在 15 个生物医学影像数据集上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言基础模型的参数高效微调方法在领域偏移或模糊图像-文本对齐下表现不佳且缺乏不确定性量化，这在临床低数据场景中尤为关键。

Method: 1) 在视觉和文本编码器中进行轻量级低维令牌更新；2) 通过认知不确定性估计更新门控残差，实现证据不足时的保守适应；3) 基于 Dempster-Shafer 理论的跨模态置信融合，以文本置信度调节视觉适应并抑制冲突更新。

Result: 在 15 个涵盖 8 个器官和 8 种成像模态的数据集上，Evi-Steer 在小样本学习和领域泛化设置下均持续优于最先进方法。

Conclusion: Evi-Steer 提供了在真实临床场景中部署视觉-语言模型的实用且鲁棒的途径。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient adaptation of vision-language foundation models is crucial for precise multimodal understanding of biomedical images, yet existing methods remain deterministic and often struggle under domain shift or ambiguous image-text alignment. This limitation is particularly critical in the clinic, where models should remain robust in low-data regimes and domain shifts. We present Evi-Steer, an evidential cross-modal low-dimensional steering framework for BiomedCLIP that enables uncertainty-aware parameter-efficient fine-tuning while updating only 0.11% of total model parameters. Our approach performs lightweight low-dimensional token updates in both vision and text encoders while simultaneously estimating epistemic uncertainty. These uncertainty estimates update gate residuals, allowing the model to adapt conservatively when evidence is weak. Furthermore, we introduce cross-modal confidence fusion based on Dempster-Shafer theory, enabling visual adaptation to be conditioned on textual confidence and suppressing conflicting or uncertain cross-modal updates. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation on 15 biomedical imaging datasets spanning 8 organs and 8 imaging modalities under few-shot learning and domain generalization settings. Evi-Steer consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods under few-shot learning and domain shift settings, demonstrating a practical and robust pathway for deploying vision-language models in real-world clinical settings. Code is available at https://github.com/HealthX-Lab/Evi-Steer.

</details>


### [454] [Generic Interpretation Approach for Transformer Models Incorporating Heterogenous Attention Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27458)
*Yongjin Cui,Xiaohui Fan,Huajun Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对Transformer模型中的异质注意力结构（如co-attention），提出了一种新的解释方法，并通过对代表性模型进行语义和逻辑层面的实验分析，揭示了其工作机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异质注意力结构是Transformer实现复杂功能和多模态信息融合的基础，但信息来自不同源带来了新的可解释性挑战，无论是学术研究还是政策要求都需要对这类模型进行解释。

Method: 将Transformer注意力结构分为同质与异质两类；针对异质注意力结构提出专门的解释方法；并构建实验分析范式，对代表性模型进行语义解释和逻辑解释。

Result: 基于所提方法和实验分析范式，成功对具有异质注意力结构的代表性Transformer模型进行了语义和逻辑层面的解释，揭示了其内部运行机制。

Conclusion: 异质注意力结构的可解释性研究对于Transformer模型的复杂功能理解和多模态信息融合具有重要意义，所提出的解释方法能够有效解析此类模型的工作机制。

Abstract: Transformer has significantly propelled the development of artificial intelligence, and certainly the development of agents as well. We categorize attention structures of Transformer into two types based on the source of the input information: homogenous and heterogenous attention structures. Heterogenous attention structures, with co-attention as a typical example, process information from different sources. Heterogenous attention structure is the foundation for Transformer models to achieve more complex functions and integrate more modal information. Whether for research purposes or policy requirements, the interpretation of Transformer models with heterogenous attention structures is an important task. The fusion of information from different sources brings new challenges. Our work mainly includes two parts: method and experimentation. In terms of method, we propose an interpretation method for Transformer models with heterogenous attention structures. In terms of experimentation, based on our experimental analysis paradigm, we interpret the operating mechanisms of representative models, conduct semantic interpretation and logical interpretation.

</details>


### [455] [ForestHG-Trace: Traceable Long-Horizon Ecological Reasoning over Large-Scale Forest Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27590)
*Zihang Cheng,Duanchu Wang,Cheng Li,Jing Huang,Huanzhao Fu,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ForestHG-Trace框架，利用生态超图表示和多步确定性工具链，实现可追踪的长时域森林生态推理问答，显著提升准确率和执行忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感QA在大型森林场景中需要进行多步过滤、数值聚合、邻域推理和可验证证据链，传统单步语义预测和场景图方法难以支持这种长时域生态推理。

Method: 1) 构建生态超图（ForestHG），将NEON森林场景表示为树实例、空间单元、语义组和邻域关系的高阶结构；2) LLM引导的智能体调用确定性工具（读取、过滤、扩展、聚合、比较、审计），生成可重放执行轨迹和紧凑证据记录；3) 构建ForestTraceQA基准。

Result: ForestHG-Trace在准确率和执行忠实度上显著优于单步基线和场景图智能体；执行深度是长时域生态QA的主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: 超图表示+LLM引导的确定性工具链能有效支持可追踪、可验证的复杂生态推理，执行深度问题是未来优化关键方向。

Abstract: Remote sensing question answering (RS-QA) often requires more than direct semantic prediction, especially in large-scale forest scenes where ecological analysis involves multi-step filtering, numerical aggregation, neighborhood reasoning, and verifiable evidence. We introduce ForestHG-Trace, a framework for traceable long-horizon ecological reasoning over forest environments. It represents multimodal NEON forest scenes as ecological hypergraphs, where tree instances, spatial units, semantic groups, and neighborhood relations support higher-order reasoning beyond pairwise scene graphs. An LLM-guided agent then invokes deterministic tools for reading, filtering, expansion, aggregation, comparison, and auditing, producing replayable execution traces and compact evidence records rather than only free-form answers. We further construct ForestTraceQA, an executable benchmark for evaluating ecological QA across diverse task types and reasoning depths. Experiments show that ForestHG-Trace substantially improves answer accuracy and execution faithfulness over single-step baselines and scene-graph agents, while highlighting execution depth as the main bottleneck for long-horizon ecological QA.

</details>


### [456] [ST-ColoNet: Spatio-Temporal Colon Segment Recognition via Hybrid Attention and Edge-Guided Feature Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28119)
*Crystal Cai,Ziyi Wang,Zhengjie Zhang,Jingsheng Gao,Dahong Qian,Suncheng Xiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对结肠镜视频中的结肠段识别任务，构建了标注数据集，并提出了ST-ColoNet两阶段深度学习框架，通过Colorlaus模块（度量学习优化边缘空间特征）和Full-Temp模块（三种自注意力模式组合近似全自注意力）利用时空信息，在准确率81.0%和F1分数70.7%上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结肠段识别方法仅使用单帧图像，未充分利用时序信息，且缺乏公开视频数据集，导致性能不佳。

Method: 提出ST-ColoNet两阶段框架：1) Colorlaus模块，利用度量学习优化基于边缘的空间特征提取；2) Full-Temp模块，结合三种自注意力模式近似全自注意力，优化长序列时序特征聚合。

Result: 准确率81.0%，F1分数70.7%，大幅超越现有SOTA方法。

Conclusion: 所提框架通过时空信息融合有效提升了结肠段识别性能，且发布的数据集可促进该领域研究。

Abstract: Colo-segment recognition in colonoscopy videos is a key requirement for many downstream tasks, but existing automatic recognition methods only use colonoscopy images without fully exploiting the use of temporal information, leading to poor performance. Additionally, relevant public video-based datasets are in scarcity. To tackle this problem, we curate and release a labeled dataset specifically for the task of colo-segment recognition. In addition, we propose a two-stage deep learning-based framework, Colo-Segment Recognition via SpatioTemporal Network (ST-ColoNet), for the task of colo-segment recognition from colonoscopy videos which includes the Colorlaus module that uses metric learning to optimize edge-mediated spatial feature extraction, as well as the Full-Temp module which combines three self-attention patterns to better approximate full self-attention on long colonoscopy sequences and optimize temporal feature aggregation. Through extensive ablation experiments, we show that our framework is capable of achieving state-of-the-art performance on the task of colo-segment recognition, achieving an accuracy of 81.0% and F1-score of 70.7%, which is a tremendous improvement over state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [457] [GAP3D: Generative Alignment of VLM Latents to Patch-Level Embeddings for 3D Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28995)
*Polytimi Anna Gkotsi,Andrii Zadaianchuk,Mohammad Mahdi Derakhshani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GAP3D提出了一种模块化扩散方法，将VLM生成的潜在特征直接对齐到预训练图像编码器的完整补丁级特征空间，使冻结的下游生成模型能利用VLM作为提示编码器，同时保持空间结构条件信号，应用于3D资产生成，无需大规模3D数据训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将VLM作为生成模型条件编码器时，要么依赖昂贵的端到端训练，要么将特征映射到压缩表示，从而丢失了3D资产生成等几何感知任务所需的密集空间结构信息。

Method: 提出GAP3D，一种模块化扩散方法。通过将VLM生成的潜在特征直接对齐到预训练图像编码器的完整补丁级特征空间，使得冻结的下游生成模型能够将VLM作为提示编码器使用，同时保持空间结构化的条件信号。训练主要在通用域图像-文本对上进行。

Result: 在3D资产生成任务上，无需大规模3D数据。展现出对多模态提示的零样本能力（尽管仅使用文本输入训练）。但当前在细粒度细节上存在局限，优先保证高层语义。

Conclusion: VLM与图像编码器特征空间之间的表征差距可以通过扩散对齐部分弥合，为通过生成对齐到密集嵌入空间实现基础模型的模块化集成迈出了第一步。

Abstract: Recent approaches integrating vision-language models (VLMs) as prompt encoders for generative model conditioning typically rely on expensive end-to-end training or map features to compressed representations, discarding the dense spatial structure required for geometry-aware tasks like 3D asset generation. To address this, we propose GAP3D, a modular, diffusion-based approach that aligns VLM-generated latents directly to the complete, patch-level feature space of a pre-trained image encoder, enabling a frozen downstream generative model to utilize a VLM as prompt encoder while maintaining a spatially structured conditioning signal. Evaluated on 3D asset generation, our method bypasses the need for large-scale 3D data by training mainly on general-domain image-text pairs. It also exhibits emergent zero-shot capabilities for multimodal prompts, despite being trained exclusively on text input. Finally, while currently prioritizing high-level semantics over fine-grained detail, GAP3D demonstrates that the representation gap between VLM and image-encoder feature spaces can be partially bridged through diffusion-based alignment, taking the first steps towards a modular integration of foundation models through generative alignment to dense embedding spaces.

</details>


### [458] [Deep Psychovisual Image Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29260)
*Wendi Ma,Aryaman Sharma,Wei Dai,Shekhar S. Chandra*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Deep Visual Coding，一种基于心理视觉模型的频域表示方法，通过复数图像表示和可学习的谱滤波器生成类似心理视觉的抽象特征，使深度学习模型更高效、更透明，并减少对深度的依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习视觉模型使用同质空间层堆叠提取特征，决策过程不透明；而心理视觉模型表明人类视觉通过中间抽象解耦低级特征提取与高级认知。作者希望将心理视觉编码引入深度学习，以提高模型的可解释性和效率。

Method: 受1990年代图像编码启发，提出Deep Visual Coding：在频域中学习数据驱动的谱滤波器，结合复数图像表示，将任务相关的语义结构编码到不同频带中，形成心理视觉风格的抽象特征。

Result: 心理视觉模型提取高度可解释的对象部件（对比CNN的模糊区域）；模型对深度依赖更小，复数表示和学习到的抽象可替代深度空间层的作用。

Conclusion: 心理视觉编码为构建更高效、更透明的视觉模型提供了有前景的路径。

Abstract: Psychovisual models suggest human vision decouples low-level feature extraction from higher cognition by first forming intermediate abstractions. In contrast, deep learning-based vision models routinely extract and aggregate features using homogeneous stacks of spatial layers, rendering their decision-making processes opaque. In this paper, we propose Deep Visual Coding, a learned frequency-domain representation inspired by 1990s image codes that quantised perceptually salient frequencies, which together with complex-valued image representations produces psychovisual-style abstractions. This approach enables the first psychovisual-based deep learning framework, utilizing data-driven spectral filters that learn to encode task-relevant semantic structures within distinct frequency sub-bands. Salience analyses reveal that our psychovisual models extract highly interpretable object parts compared to the amorphous regions produced by regular Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). Furthermore, we find that our models are less depth dependent than CNNs for model scaling, since our complex-valued representations and learned abstractions subsume the role of the deep spatial layers. Together, these findings demonstrate that psychovisual coding provides a promising path toward more efficient and transparent vision models.

</details>


### [459] [WorldMemArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agent Memory Through Action-World Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29341)
*Chengzhi Liu,Yuzhe Yang,Sophia Xiao Pu,Yepeng Liu,Lin Long,Yichen Guo,Nuo Chen,Zhaotian Weng,Elena Kochkina,Simerjot Kaur,Charese Smiley,Xiaomo Liu,James Zou,Sheng Liu,Yuheng Bu,Songyou Peng,Xin Eric Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出WorldMemArena基准，包含400个多会话多模态任务，系统评估智能体记忆在写入、维护、检索和使用四个阶段的性能，发现更好的记忆写入不保证更好性能、多模态记忆难以充分利用视觉证据、系统跨领域不稳定、自主记忆更灵活但成本高且可靠性不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准只能测量静态对话召回、将记忆压缩为单一任务准确率、将视觉观察简化为字幕，无法定位失败在记忆的哪个阶段（写入、维护、检索或使用）；同时缺乏原则性方法来比较手工设计的记忆管线与自主管理记忆的智能体框架。

Method: 将多模态智能体记忆形式化为动作-世界交互循环的四阶段生命周期（Action-World Interaction Loop），并实例化为WorldMemArena：包含400个多会话多模态任务，覆盖Lifelong Evolution（演化个人/任务状态）和Agentic Execution（来自真实观测、动作和反馈的记忆），标注了黄金记忆点、更新、干扰项和证据链，支持阶段级诊断。

Result: (1)更优的记忆写入和存储不保证更优性能；(2)多模态记忆仍难以充分利用视觉证据；(3)系统跨领域不稳定且在真实智能体轨迹上性能下降；(4)自主记忆（harness）更灵活但成本高且可靠性不足。

Conclusion: 需要对记忆各阶段进行细粒度诊断，多模态记忆的视觉证据利用仍有显著提升空间，自主记忆方案需在灵活性和可靠性之间取得平衡。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models are increasingly deployed as long-horizon agents, where memory must do more than recall: it must track an evolving world, revise what has gone stale, and surface the right evidence at decision time. Existing benchmarks measure recall over static dialogue, collapse memory into a single end-of-task accuracy, and reduce visual observations to captions, leaving us unable to localize failures to writing, maintenance, retrieval, or use. The rise of agent harnesses that author their own memory sharpens this gap, since we have no principled way to compare hand-designed pipelines with self-managing alternatives. To close these gaps, we formulate multimodal agent memory as an Action-World Interaction Loop with an observable four-stage lifecycle, and instantiate it in WorldMemArena: 400 multi-session multimodal tasks spanning Lifelong Evolution (evolving personal and task states) and Agentic Execution (memory from real observations, actions, and feedback), annotated with gold memory points, updates, distractors, and evidence chains for stage-level diagnosis. This enables the first head-to-head comparison of long-context, manually designed (RAG and external memory systems), and harness-based memory agents. Results show that: (1) better memory writing and storage do not guarantee better performance; (2) multimodal memory still struggles to fully use visual evidence; (3) systems are unstable across domains and degrade on realistic agentic trajectories; and (4) harness memory is more flexible but remains costly and less reliable.

</details>


### [460] [AnyMo: Scaling Any-Modality Conditional Motion Generation with Masked Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29488)
*Yiheng Li,Zhuo Li,Ruibing Hou,Yingjie Chen,Hong Chang,Hao Liu,Shiguang Shan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出大规模多模态对齐运动数据集OmniHuMo（5000+小时运动/320万序列）及统一框架AnyMo（残差FSQ运动分词器+可扩展掩码建模Transformer），实现任意模态组合下的高质量人体运动生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有条件运动生成方法受限于固定模态配置和任务特定架构，跨模态交互及多模态条件合成尚未充分探索，且缺乏大规模、高质量、多模态对齐的运动数据。

Method: 构建OmniHuMo大规模多模态对齐数据集；提出AnyMo框架：残差FSQ运动分词器将运动离散化为token，结合可扩展掩码建模Transformer，支持文本、语音、音乐、轨迹等任意模态组合的条件运动生成。

Result: AnyMo在多种模态组合下实现高保真运动合成，支持空间和风格属性的灵活控制。

Conclusion: 大规模多模态对齐数据可有效推动多模态条件运动生成，统一框架AnyMo展现出良好的泛化能力和可控性。

Abstract: Conditional human motion generation remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision and robotics. Despite significant progress, current methods are often constrained by fixed modality configurations and task-specific architectures, leaving cross-modal interactions and the scaling laws of multimodal-conditioned synthesis largely underexplored. A key bottleneck is the scarcity of large-scale modality-aligned motion data, limiting generalization across diverse control signals. In this work, we introduce OmniHuMo, a large-scale, high-quality dataset comprising over 5,000 hours of motion and 3.2 million sequences with precisely aligned multimodal annotations (e.g., text, speech, music, and trajectory). Leveraging OmniHuMo, we propose AnyMo, a unified multimodal framework combining a Residual FSQ-based motion tokenizer with a scalable masked modeling transformer, enabling high-quality motion synthesis under arbitrary modality combinations. Extensive experiments show that AnyMo achieves high-fidelity synthesis while offering flexible control over both spatial and stylistic attributes.

</details>


### [461] [GiPL: Generative augmented iterative Pseudo-Labeling for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29539)
*Jiacong Liu,Shu Luo,Yikai Qin,Yaze Zhao,Yongwei Jiang,Yixiong Zou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GiPL提出双分支训练框架，通过迭代伪标签自训练充分利用支持集数据，结合大视觉语言模型生成数据增强抑制过拟合，在CD-FSOD任务上显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言基础模型在跨域小样本目标检测微调时面临两个关键挑战：支持集利用不充分（稀疏单实例标注）和目标域样本极有限导致的严重过拟合。

Method: 提出GiPL双分支框架：1) 迭代伪标签自训练分支，在支持集上进行零样本推理生成可靠伪标注并与真实标签融合，迭代优化模型；2) 生成式数据增强分支，利用大视觉语言模型合成领域对齐、多目标标注的图像来丰富训练样本。

Result: 在RUOD、CARPK、CarDD三个CD-FSOD数据集上的1/5/10-shot设置下，GiPL一致超越现有最先进方法，取得显著性能提升。

Conclusion: 本文提出的GiPL框架有效解决了跨域小样本目标检测中支持集利用不足和过拟合问题，验证了结合伪标签自训练与生成式数据增强的有效性。

Abstract: Vision-language foundation models have shown promising zero-shot generalization for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Object Detection (CD-FSOD). However, they face two critical challenges in fine-tuning: insufficient support set utilization due to sparse single-instance annotations, and severe overfitting under extremely limited target-domain samples. To address these issues, this paper proposes GiPL, an efficient two-branch training framework. In the first branch, we design an iterative pseudo-label self-training paradigm, which performs zero-shot inference on the support set to generate reliable pseudo-annotations, fuses them with ground-truth labels, and iteratively optimizes the model to fully exploit support set data.
