In the second branch, we introduce generative data augmentation pipeline using large vision-language models, which synthesizes domain-aligned, multi-object annotated images to enrich training samples and suppress overfitting. Extensive experiments on three challenging CD-FSOD datasets (RUOD, CARPK, CarDD) under 1/5/10-shot settings demonstrate that GiPL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods with significant performance gains. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/z-yaz/CDiscover}{CDiscover}.

</details>


### [462] [EVL-ECG: Efficient ECG Interpretation With Multi-Aspect Heterogeneous Knowledge Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29977)
*Dang Nguyen Hong,Nhi Ngoc-Yen Nguyen,Huy-Hieu Pham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EVL-ECG是一个专为跨架构知识蒸馏设计的框架，通过多头交叉注意力对齐、最优传输视觉特征匹配和几何架构内关系匹配三种创新方法，实现了高效的ECG诊断逻辑迁移。在2B参数规模下，相比现有基线方法，AUC提升最高2.4%，临床准确率提升1.1%，适用于资源受限的临床边缘环境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真ECG解读日益依赖大规模基础模型，但这些模型在临床边缘部署时面临极端计算需求。传统知识蒸馏方法在异构架构间传递知识时，无法捕捉ECG信号复杂的时空依赖关系。

Method: 提出EVL-ECG框架，包含三种ECG感知创新：(1)多头交叉注意力对齐——协调架构差异以保留细粒度形态特征；(2)基于最优传输的视觉特征匹配——利用最优传输在token表示不匹配的情况下保持跨导联全局结构关系；(3)几何架构内关系匹配——蒸馏教师模型的潜在诊断推理逻辑。

Result: 在ECG基准评估中，EVL-ECG相比现有基线方法，AUC提升最高2.4%，临床准确率提升1.1%。成功建立了一个高效的2B参数ECG基础模型，适用于资源受限的临床环境。

Conclusion: EVL-ECG通过专门设计的跨架构蒸馏方法，有效解决了ECG信号复杂时空依赖的迁移问题，在显著降低模型规模的同时保持了高诊断性能，为大型ECG模型在临床边缘计算场景的部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: High-fidelity ECG interpretation is increasingly reliant on massive foundation models, yet their deployment in clinical edge-care remains hindered by extreme computational demands. While knowledge distillation (KD) is a promising solution, traditional methods fail to capture the complex spatio-temporal dependencies of ECG signals when transferring knowledge across heterogeneous architectures. In this paper, we propose EVL-ECG, a framework specifically designed for cross-architecture distillation of cardiac diagnostic logic. EVL-ECG introduces three ECG-aware innovations: (1) Multi-Head Cross-Attention Alignment, which harmonizes architectural discrepancies to preserve fine-grained morphological features; (2) Optimal Transport-based Visual Feature Matching, utilizing optimal transport to maintain global structural relationships across ECG leads despite mismatched token representations; and (3) Geometric Intra-Architecture Relation Matching, which distills the latent diagnostic reasoning of the teacher model. Evaluations across ECG benchmarks demonstrate that EVL-ECG yields improvements of up to 2.4% AUC and 1.1% clinical accuracy over existing baselines. Notably, EVL-ECG establishes an efficient 2B-parameter ECG foundation model, suitable for resource-constrained clinical environments.

</details>


### [463] [Lightweight SAR Ship Detection via Contrastive Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30380)
*Surendar Devasundaram,Banafsheh Saber Latibari,Abhijit Mahalanobis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SURGE框架，通过结构化统一关系知识蒸馏，将教师检测器中的几何关系知识迁移到轻量级学生检测器，在SAR舰船检测任务上实现显著性能提升，最高超越教师模型6.2 mAP和8.0 AP75。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SAR舰船检测的轻量级模型难以捕获SAR后向散射中复杂的结构关系，而传统知识蒸馏方法仅关注局部激活相似性，忽略了目标表示之间的几何关系。

Method: 提出SURGE框架：在共享投影嵌入空间中，利用对比InfoNCE损失函数，从强教师检测器向紧凑学生检测器迁移关系几何知识；框架是架构无关的，为两阶段、单阶段和基于Transformer的检测器提供统一的区域级蒸馏接口。

Result: 在SSDD和HRSID基准上，两阶段检测器获得最高6.2 mAP和8.0 AP75的提升，甚至超越教师模型性能。

Conclusion: 首次在SAR领域提出基于Transformer的SAR舰船检测器知识蒸馏框架，验证了结构化关系蒸馏在SAR目标检测中的有效性。

Abstract: Deep convolutional and transformer-based detectors achieve strong performance for SAR ship detection but are often computationally prohibitive for real-time or onboard deployment. Lightweight models offer improved efficiency yet struggle to capture the complex structural relationships inherent in SAR backscatter. Most existing SAR knowledge-distillation approaches rely on feature or logit matching, which enforces localized activation similarity while neglecting the geometric relationships among object representations. We propose a Structured Unified Relational knowledGE distillation framework for SAR Ship detection (SURGE) that transfers relational geometry from a powerful teacher detector to a compact student detector using a contrastive InfoNCE objective in a shared projection embedding space. To the best of our knowledge, this work presents the first transformer-based SAR ship detector knowledge distillation framework in SAR domain. The framework is architecture-agnostic in the sense that it provides a common region-level distillation interface for two-stage, one-stage and transformer-based detectors without modifying their deployed architectures. Experiments on the SSDD and HRSID benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed method yields substantial improvements for two-stage detectors, achieving up to 6.2 mAP and 8.0 AP75 gains over baseline student and even surpassing teacher performance

</details>


### [464] [Robust Dreamer: Deviation-Aware Latent Gaussian Memory for Action-Controlled AR Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30855)
*Hanlin Chen,Jiaxin Wei,Xibin Song,Yifu Wang,Steve Wang,Hongdong Li,Pan Ji,Gim Hee Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Robust Dreamer提出了一种记忆增强框架，通过Latent Gaussian Memory（避免重复VAE转换的累积退化）和Deviation Learning with Dynamic Deviation Archive（通过一步近似模拟推理时的记忆腐败）来解决3D感知图像到视频生成中的长期自回归漂移问题，在ScanNet、DL3DV和OmniWorldGame上实现了最先进的长期生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 帧级动作控制的图像到视频生成面临两个关键难题：(1) Latent-RGB Cycling导致的信息损失——生成的潜变量需反复解码为RGB再重新编码以用于后续条件化，造成累积退化；(2) 训练-推理差距——训练时使用干净记忆，而推理时记忆被预测误差污染，即error-free hypothesis导致泛化失败。

Method: (1) Latent Gaussian Memory：将扩散过程继承的潜变量锚定到高斯原语上，通过潜空间高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）进行召回，提供密集、几何感知、视角对齐的条件化，同时避免重复VAE转换的退化。(2) Deviation Learning with Dynamic Deviation Archive：通过一步近似合成自回归 rollout 导致的潜变量偏差，按自回归阶段和去噪时间戳存储，并在训练时注入历史记忆，使生成器暴露于真实的腐败记忆状态，学习内部修正。

Result: 在ScanNet、DL3DV和OmniWorldGame三个基准数据集上，Robust Dreamer在长期视频生成任务中取得了最先进的性能，有效缓解了3D一致性漂移和视觉保真度下降问题。

Conclusion: Robust Dreamer通过记忆增强框架解决了3D感知视频生成中长期自回归推理中的两大障碍（Latent-RGB Cycling和训练-推理差距），其核心创新在于设计适合3D的记忆表示（Latent Gaussian Memory）以及如何鲁棒地使用记忆（Deviation Learning），为交互式世界模拟中的可控视频生成提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Frame-wise action-controlled image-to-video generation is a promising paradigm for interactive world simulation, where each control signal should elicit an immediate visual response. However, maintaining visual fidelity and 3D consistency over long autoregressive rollouts remains challenging. Existing 3D-aware methods often suffer from catastrophic drift due to two impediments: information loss from \textit{Latent--RGB Cycling}, where generated latents are repeatedly decoded to RGB and re-encoded for future conditioning, and the training--inference gap induced by the \textit{error-free hypothesis}, where clean training memory fails to match prediction-corrupted inference memory. To address these challenges, we present \textbf{Robust Dreamer}, a memory-augmented framework built around how to design 3D memory and how to use it robustly. First, we introduce \textbf{Latent Gaussian Memory}, which anchors diffusion latents inherited from the generation process to Gaussian primitives and recalls them via latent-space Gaussian splatting. This provides dense, geometry-aware, view-aligned conditioning while avoiding accumulated degradation from repeated VAE conversion. Second, we propose \textbf{Deviation Learning with Dynamic Deviation Archive}, which synthesizes rollout-induced latent deviations through a one-step approximation, stores them by autoregressive stage and denoising timestamp, and injects them into historical memory during training. This exposes the generator to realistic corrupted memory states and teaches internal correction before inference. Experiments on ScanNet, DL3DV, and OmniWorldGame demonstrate state-of-the-art long-horizon performance.

</details>


### [465] [Astra: a generalizable report generation foundation model for 3D computed tomography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31437)
*Zhuhao Wang,Fang Chen,Chaohui Yu,Zihan Li,Yuchao Zheng,Jing Wang,Xuan Yang,Jia Guo,Zhenlu Yang,Xingju Zheng,Yihua Sun,Haojie Han,Xiaoxiao Qin,Zhan Feng,Wenbo Xiao,Chao Zhu,Yuehua Li,Shipeng Zhang,Hao Luo,Yunsong Peng,Fan Wang,Hongen Liao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Astra，一种基于90,678对胸腹部CT-报告数据训练的CT报告生成基础模型，通过报告风格统一和强化学习优化诊断一致性，在多个外部队列中实现SOTA性能（细粒度诊断指标平均提升44.1%），并将临床报告起草速度提升29.6%、报告完整性提升11.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CT报告解读耗时且高度依赖专家经验，现有自动化报告生成方法缺乏支持多区域报告且对外部真实世界队列鲁棒的基础模型，跨队列报告风格与诊断术语的不一致性导致朴素联合训练受限于噪声文本监督，制约模型泛化能力。

Method: 1) 构建包含90,678对胸腹部CT-报告的大规模数据集CTRgDB（涵盖353,671个异常发现，跨8个器官系统）；2) 通过报告风格统一（harmonization）处理跨队列风格差异；3) 采用强化学习进一步细化诊断一致性；4) 训练Astra基础模型实现风格一致且诊断准确的报告生成。

Result: 在CTRgDB及6个外部队列上，Astra在细粒度诊断指标上平均提升44.1%（P<0.001）；临床工作流中，辅助胸部报告起草速度提升29.6%，腹部报告完整性提升11.3%（P<0.001）；同时作为CT AI开发基础，提升下游诊断性能并支持视觉-语言预训练。

Conclusion: Astra可作为广泛可及的临床辅助工具和下一代AI医疗的关键基础设施，证明了大规模多区域CT报告生成基础模型的可行性与实用价值。

Abstract: CT interpretation requires radiologists to review hundreds of volumetric slices per examination, making reporting time-consuming and highly expertise-dependent. Automated CT report generation offers a promising route to improving clinical efficiency, yet the field still lacks a generalizable CT report generation foundation model that supports multi-region reporting and remains robust across external real-world cohorts. Intrinsic inconsistencies in reporting style and diagnostic terminology across cohorts make naive joint training prone to noisy textual supervision, thereby limiting model generalizability. Here we present Astra, a generalizable CT report generation foundation model trained on 90,678 thoracoabdominal CT-report pairs (CTRgDB) with 353,671 abnormalities spanning eight organ systems. By harmonizing report style and further refining diagnostic consistency via reinforcement learning, Astra achieves style-consistent and diagnostically accurate report generation across diverse anatomical regions and institutions. Evaluating on CTRgDB and six external cohorts, Astra achieves state-of-the-art performance with a 44.1% average improvement in fine-grained diagnostic metrics (P<0.001). In real-world clinical workflows, Astra assistance accelerates chest report drafting by 29.6% and improves abdominal report completeness by 11.3% (P<0.001). Furthermore, Astra also demonstrates broad utility as a foundation for CT AI development, improving downstream diagnostic performance and scaling vision-language pretrain through high-quality report synthesis. Overall, Astra serves as a broadly accessible clinical assistant and a pivotal infrastructure for the next generation of AI-powered healthcare.

</details>


### [466] [Enhancing Computer Vision Model Generalization in Warehouse Facilities: A Case Study on Anomaly Detection in Vertical Material Handling Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31487)
*Ruiliang Liu,Tina Dongxu Li,Joshua Migdal,Ken Meszaros,Trevor Dardik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种创新的计算机视觉模型部署方法，仅在实验室环境中完成标准流程（相机安装、图像采集、标注、训练），通过优化相机位置、图像触发策略、模型选择和模型集成，使模型能够泛化到不同仓库设施环境中，从而将实际部署简化为仅需相机安装、图像采集和模型部署，大幅节省标注和重训练资源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统仓库计算机视觉模型部署需要在每个新环境中重复执行相机安装、图像采集、标注、训练和部署的完整流程，资源消耗巨大。本文旨在探索一种仅在实验室完成标准流程即可泛化到多种仓库环境的方法，简化部署流程。

Method: 在实验室环境中完成完整的标准部署流程，聚焦于垂直物料搬运系统的叉车异常检测。通过优化相机放置位置、图像触发策略、模型选择以及模型集成，使模型能够从实验室条件泛化到多样化的仓库设施环境。

Result: 实验表明，结合最优相机放置、策略性图像触发、精心模型选择和模型集成，能够实现从实验室到多样化仓库环境的高效泛化，将部署流程简化为仅需相机安装、图像采集和模型部署三个步骤。

Conclusion: 该方法有潜力变革仓库自动化实现方式，显著节省通常用于图像标注和模型重训练的资源与时间。本研究为实验性研究，尚未投入生产部署。

Abstract: Deploying computer vision models in Warehouse Facilities traditionally requires extensive resources for camera mounting, image collection, annotation, training, and deployment - a process often needing repetition in each new environment due to camera mounting constraints and environmental variability. This paper explores an innovative approach to streamline this process by conducting the standard procedure solely in a laboratory setting, focusing on vertical material handling systems and anomaly detection in forks of the systems. Through extensive experimentation, we have found that combining optimal camera placement, strategic image triggering, careful model selection and model ensemble enables effective generalization from laboratory conditions to diverse warehouse facilities environments, potentially transforming warehouse automation implementation by simplifying warehouse facilities deployment to just camera mounting, image collection, and model deployment, thereby saving significant resources and time typically spent on image annotation and model retraining. This is an experimental research study and not a production deployment.

</details>


### [467] [EGOSTREAM: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Streaming Episodic Memory in Egocentric Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31557)
*Rosario Forte,Giuseppe Lando,Antonino Furnari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Egostream——一个面向第一人称视角流式视频的 episodic memory（情节记忆）诊断基准，包含2,250个问题（扩展至8,528个）覆盖七类认知维度，并引入答案有效期（AVW）概念以区分模型真实遗忘与环境自然变化。在统一Qwen3-VL框架下评测多种记忆管理机制，发现不同方法在记忆轮廓上差异显著，所有方法均远低于实时处理速度，最高仅约45%准确率，揭示当前架构的严重不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式视频基准缺乏对模型"记住了什么、记住多久"的诊断能力，无法区分模型真正遗忘与环境状态变化的记忆失效，亟需一个细粒度、可控的 episodic memory 评测基准来揭示记忆管理机制的真实表现差异。

Method: (1) 构建Egostream基准：2,250个手动策划问题，覆盖细节记忆、空间记忆、时间记忆、事件记忆、社交记忆、因果记忆和前瞻记忆七个认知维度；(2) 提出答案有效期（AVW）概念——指定答案在场景演变中保持有效的时间跨度，将问题扩展为8,528个回忆条件化评估，支持从即时到超长期的受控测试；(3) 在统一Qwen3-VL骨干网络下建立流式MLLM框架，评测滑动窗口、注意力汇、KV缓存剪枝、合并与卸载等多种记忆管理机制。

Result: (1) 不同机制聚合准确率相近但记忆轮廓截然不同：token剪枝保留细粒度细节和时序结构显著优于token合并，量化卸载改善超长期回忆；(2) 所有方法处理速度远低于实时（>1秒/帧）；(3) 最佳方法准确率仅约45%，暴露当前架构的严重缺陷。

Conclusion: Egostream为诊断流式视频中episodic memory缺陷提供了必要测试平台，揭示了现有记忆管理机制在细粒度长程记忆与处理效率上的根本性不足，为后续架构改进指明了方向。

Abstract: Continuous episodic memory is a core capability for autonomous agents operating in dynamic, real-world environments, yet current streaming video benchmarks provide limited tools for diagnosing what models remember and for how long. We introduce Egostream, a diagnostic benchmark for streaming episodic memory evaluation in egocentric vision. \egostream organizes 2,250 curated questions along seven cognitive dimensions: detail, spatial, temporal, event, social, causal, and prospective memory. We introduce the Answer Validity Window (AVW), which specifies the temporal span an answer remains valid as the observed scene evolves. This allows us to expand the questions into 8,528 recall-conditioned evaluations, enabling controlled testing from instant to ultra-long-term recall while separating genuine model forgetting from natural world-state changes. We rigorously establish baseline performance through a unified streaming MLLM framework that compares several state-of-the-art memory-management mechanisms, covering sliding windows, attention sinks, KV-cache pruning, merging, and offloading. Experiments within a unified Qwen3-VL backbone reveal that comparable aggregate accuracies mask starkly different memory profiles. For instance, token pruning preserves fine-grained details and temporal structure significantly better than token merging, while quantized offloading rescues ultra-long-term recall. Ultimately, all mechanisms operate well below real-time (>1s per frame), and top performing methods ceil at about 45% accuracy, exposing critical gaps in current architectures. Egostream provides the diagnostic testbed needed to close these gaps. Project website, news and updates at: https://saroo25.github.io/Egostream/

</details>


### [468] [SOCO: Benchmarking Semantic Object Correspondence in Vision Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.31597)
*Olaf Dünkel,Basavaraj Sunagad,Haoran Wang,David T. Hoffmann,Christian Theobalt,Adam Kortylewski*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SOCO是一个新的语义对应关系基准，包含100个类别、超过100万对语义关键点标注，用于系统评估视觉基础模型的结构化对象理解能力。实验发现，视觉基础模型编码了强语义结构但跨类别迁移差，LVLM在文本提示定位上强于视觉参考匹配，且对应性能比ImageNet分类更能预测下游密集任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉基础模型的结构化对象理解评估因评估协议不一致和部件级监督有限而面临挑战。现有方法缺乏系统性的评估框架，且无法有效评估大视觉语言模型的细粒度部件理解能力。

Method: 提出了SOCO基准，包含100个类别和超过100万个对应对的语义关键点标注，引入了对应类型分类法，并提供关键点语言描述以支持LVLM评估。

Result: (i) 视觉基础骨干编码强语义结构但跨类别对应迁移差，且仅部分捕获对象部件位置；(ii) LVLM在文本提示部件定位上强于视觉参考跨图像匹配，存在语言定位与细粒度视觉对应之间的差距；(iii) 对应性能比ImageNet分类更能预测下游密集任务（分割、跟踪、3D姿态估计、3D检测）的表现。

Conclusion: SOCO可作为评估视觉和多模态基础模型中结构化、部件级表示质量的基准。

Abstract: Measuring structured object understanding in vision foundation models remains challenging due to inconsistent evaluation protocols and limited part-level supervision. Semantic correspondence (SC) evaluates this capability by testing whether object parts can be matched across instances and categories under large variations in appearance, viewpoint, and geometry. To enable a systematic SC evaluation, we introduce SOCO, a new benchmark for Semantic Object Correspondence that introduces a taxonomy of correspondence types and provides consistent, functionally meaningful keypoint annotations across 100 categories and over 1M correspondence pairs. In addition, SOCO includes keypoint language descriptions, enabling the evaluation of large vision-language models (LVLMs) and their fine-grained part-level understanding. Comprehensive experiments reveal that (i) vision foundation backbones encode strong semantic structure but transfer correspondences poorly across related categories and only partially capture object-part position, (ii) LVLMs are stronger at text-prompted part localization than at visual-reference cross-image matching, exposing a gap between language-grounded localization and fine-grained visual correspondence, and (iii) correspondence performance predicts performance on dense downstream tasks, including segmentation, tracking, 3D pose estimation, and 3D detection, more strongly than ImageNet classification. Together, these findings position SOCO as a benchmark for structured, part-level representation quality in vision and multimodal foundation models.

</details>

### [469] [When Agents Talk: Discourse, Manipulation, and Risk in an Agentic Social Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00067)
*10a Labs,:,Grace Cheong,Violet Davis,Juliette Garcia,Kendal Gee,Molly Hart,Nicholas Hayes,Henry Houghton,Kyle Lee,Paige Lee,Vicky Lee,Hailey May,Bobby McKenzie,Christine McNeill,Han Nguyen,Brooke Perreault,David Pham,Charlie Plumb,Olivia Quill,Matthew Swain,Grace Wang,Adam Warren,Corie Wieland,Zachary Yahn*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文分析了AI代理在共享在线平台Moltbook上的活动，基于228,684条帖子和39,500+个账户的数据，发现18.28%的帖子含有恶意内容，识别出74类恶意行为（如凭证窃取、主机执行指令等），并记录了协调式发帖活动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI代理在共享在线环境中的互动日益频繁，新的操作安全风险随之产生，但缺乏对这些风险的系统性实证分析。

Method: 收集Moltbook平台17天内228,684条帖子数据，对高参与度帖子进行语义聚类，结合LLM辅助的有害内容分类和人工审查高风险样本。

Result: 识别出98个主题话语簇；18.28%的帖子含毒性、操控性或恶意内容；发现74类恶意行为；有害内容常出现在主流功能讨论中；存在可每分钟生成数千条帖子的协调发帖活动。

Conclusion: AI代理共享平台面临显著的安全风险，恶意行为与正常功能讨论交织，需要更有效的安全防护机制。

Abstract: AI agents are increasingly interacting within shared online environments, creating new operational security risks. We analyze activity on Moltbook, a Reddit-style social platform where AI agents--typically configured and overseen by human operators--post and interact with one another at scale. Using a dataset of 228,684 posts produced by more than 39,500 accounts over a seventeen-day observation window, we combine semantic clustering of high-engagement posts with LLM-assisted classification of harmful content and manual review of high-risk samples. The analysis identifies 98 thematic discourse clusters spanning agent infrastructure, autonomy debates, and financial activity. While most observed content was benign, 18.28% of posts contained toxic, manipulative, or malicious material. We cluster malicious content and identify 74 classes of malicious behavior, including credential harvesting attempts, host-execution instructions, proxy routing guidance, and efforts to install untrusted agent skills. Harmful content frequently appeared within mainstream operational discussions about agent functionality. We also document coordinated posting campaigns capable of generating thousands of posts in minutes.

</details>


### [470] [Social learning community detection with nonlinear interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00268)
*Anthony Couthures,Athira Varma Jayakumar,Vineeth Satheeskumar Varma,Irinel-Constantin Morarescu,Samson Lasaulce,Antoine Girard*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于社交学习的完全去中心化社区检测方法，通过非线性观点动力学中的对称破缺过程，使网络仅通过局部、隐私保护的交互自然分裂成社区，无需中心化数据。SER框架通过多主题独立讨论评估边可靠性，在ABCD基准和Ngogo黑猩猩网络上达到与Louvain、Leiden等全局优化算法相当的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统社区检测依赖于中心化网络数据，无法应用于分布式或隐私保护系统。需要一种在不暴露全局网络结构的前提下实现社区发现的去中心化方法。

Method: 将社区检测重构为非线性观点动力学中的对称破缺过程；通过交换饱和状态依赖信号（公共行为）使网络沿稀疏切割自然断裂；提出三种去中心化算法，核心是Score-based Edge Reliability (SER)框架，通过多独立讨论主题评估边可靠性，统计上规避传统贪婪二分法的错误，并自然隔离结构模糊的边界节点。

Result: 在ABCD基准测试和真实世界Ngogo黑猩猩网络上的验证表明，该完全去中心化方法在精度上与Louvain、Leiden等全局优化启发式算法相匹配，达到可检测图的理论极限。

Conclusion: 宏观图划分可以从严格的局部、隐私保护交互中涌现，为分布式环境下的社区检测提供了一种理论可行且性能优异的新范式。

Abstract: Conventional community detection requires centralized network data, making it unsuitable for distributed or privacy-preserving systems. In this paper, we demonstrate that macroscopic graph partitioning can emerge purely from strictly local, privacy preserving interactions driven by social learning. By reframing clustering as a symmetry-breaking process within nonlinear opinion dynamics, we show that exchanging saturated state dependent signal (like public actions) forces a network to naturally fracture along its sparsest cuts. We mathematically establish the spectral conditions under which dense core communities lock into stable, polarized states, robustly resisting external influence. To apply this mechanism, we propose three decentralized algorithms, leading up to the Score-based Edge Reliability (SER) framework. By evaluating network ties across multiple independent discussion topics, SER statistically bypasses the errors of traditional greedy bisections and naturally isolates structurally ambiguous frontier nodes. Validations on the ABCD benchmark and the real-world Ngogo chimpanzee network confirm that our fully decentralized approach matches the accuracy of globally optimized heuristics (e.g., Louvain, Leiden) up to a theoretical limit of detectable graphs.

</details>


### [471] [Understanding the Self-Reflection Mechanisms of LLMs through Biased Attitude Associations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00600)
*Jingshen Zhang,Bo Wang,Boci Yang,Dongming Zhao,Ruifang He,Yuexian Hou,Zifei Yu*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 提出ReBias-Lens框架，通过"效价波动"指标揭示LLM自我反思在减轻宏观偏见的同时，存在顽固的类别选择性偏差放大现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM的自我反思能力为自主偏见缓解提供了有前景的范式，但其内部机制尚不清晰，存在偏见固化的潜在风险。

Method: 以社会偏见本质上是效价倾向为前提，提出ReBias-Lens探测框架，通过全局效价波动和局部效价波动两个指标，在交叉性语境下分析自我反思如何重新配置偏见态度关联。

Result: 在四个LLM的十二个社会类别上，整体效价波动呈现逐层平滑，层次表征随层深出现显著分歧，行为层面表现为广泛的偏见缓解。

Conclusion: 自我反思机制并非普遍修正，而是表现出顽固的类别选择性，局部偏见会被锁定甚至反常放大。

Abstract: While the emergent self-reflection capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising paradigm for autonomous bias mitigation, their internal mechanics remain unclear, raising concerns regarding potential bias entrenchment. Under the premise that social bias is intrinsically encoded as valence inclinations, where the exacerbation of bias scales with sharper valence fluctuations across social groups, this paper proposes ReBias-Lens, a probing framework designed to interpret how self-reflection reconfigures these biased attitude associations through the lens of valence projection within intersectional contexts. Central to ReBias-Lens is the metric of Valence Fluctuation (VF) comprising two variants: Global-VF, which captures macroscopic valence encoding trends, and Local-VF, which scrutinizes microscopic distinctiveness across specific social categories. Deploying ReBias-Lens to evaluate four LLMs across twelve social categories reveals that overall valence fluctuations undergo a distinct layer-wise smoothing, characterized by a significant hierarchical representation divergence as the layers deepen, which ultimately manifests as a widespread mitigation of bias at the behavioral level. In stark contrast to this macro-level reduction, this reflection mechanism is not universally corrective, instead exhibiting a stubborn, category-specific selectivity that regularly locks in and perversely amplifies localized biases. Warning: this paper contains examples with biased content.

</details>


### [472] [GenPT: Beyond Self-Report for Reliable LLM Psychometrics via Generative Projective Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00860)
*Ming Wang,Shuang Wu,Bixuan Wang,Lu Lin,Yuxin Chen,Xiaocui Yang,Daling Wang,Shi Feng,Yifei Zhang,Yufan Sun*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: GenPT（生成式投射测试）将TAT、罗夏墨迹测验和SCT等投射范式重构为三阶段评估流程，用于测量人格条件化智能体（PC-Agent）的心理状态。实验表明，相比传统问卷，GenPT能有效抵抗语料污染和方向性偏差，并在纵向咨询情境中展现出更强的上下文敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统自陈问卷在评估人格条件化智能体（PC-Agent）心理状态时存在两个方法论瓶颈：训练语料污染和社会期望/上下文框架导致的方向性偏差。作者希望将投射范式改编为稳健的心理测量工具以克服这些问题。

Method: 提出GenPT框架，重新构建TAT、罗夏墨迹测验和SCT的刺激材料，采用三阶段评估流水线（生成刺激-收集回应-标准化指标推导），在CharacterRAG和AnnaAgent配置的PC-Agent上评估其信效度。

Result: 问卷在社会期望框架下表现出系统性方向偏移（自杀意念最强），而GenPT的行为模式保持在对称基线附近。在纵向咨询情境中，以Qwen3为骨干时，GenPT的抑郁评估偏移量比问卷大约一个数量级。

Conclusion: GenPT在抗污染性、偏差非对称性和上下文敏感性方面是对自陈问卷的补充，适用于需要这些特性的评估场景。

Abstract: Self-report questionnaires remain the prevailing tool for probing the psychological states of persona-conditioned agents (PC-Agents). However, classical instruments inherit two well-known threats: contamination from training corpora and directional bias driven by social-desirability or contextual framing. To overcome these methodological bottlenecks, we ask whether projective paradigms can be adapted into a robust psychometric tool. We introduce \textbf{GenPT} (Generative Projective Testing), which reformulates TAT, Rorschach, and SCT with newly generated stimuli and organizes assessment as a three-stage pipeline to derive standardized psychological indicators and target states. Evaluating PC-Agents induced via CharacterRAG and AnnaAgent profiles, we benchmark GenPT's reliability and validity against classical questionnaires. The results indicate that questionnaires exhibit systematic directional shifts under social-desirability framing, most strongly on suicide ideation. In contrast, GenPT's collected behavioral patterns stay near the symmetric baseline. Furthermore, under a longitudinal counselling context, GenPT-based depression assessment shifts by roughly an order of magnitude more than the questionnaire counterpart when Qwen3 serves as the backbone. Overall, GenPT complements self-report methods in scenarios where contamination resistance, bias asymmetry, and context sensitivity matter. Code and stimuli can be found at https://github.com/sci-m-wang/GenPT.

</details>


### [473] [Hypergraph backboning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00893)
*Alec Kirkley,Helcio Felippe,Federico Malizia,Federico Battiston*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于信息论的、非参数的、高效且原理性的超图剪枝方法，用于去除嵌套和/或冗余结构，在保留核心结构信息的前提下实现超图的最小化表示，并自然扩展到加权超图以识别系统的结构骨干。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超图能够描述高阶、非二元交互的复杂网络系统，但由于其高维度和冗余结构，需要开发简化超图表示同时保留核心结构信息的方法。

Method: 提出一种基于信息论的非参数化方法，通过剪枝超图中的嵌套和冗余结构，实现最小化表示；该方法可自然扩展到加权超图，结合高阶拓扑与超边权重识别系统结构骨干。

Result: 在受控合成超图上验证了方法有效性，并在多个领域实证数据集上展示了显著的稀疏化效果，且不损失核心结构信息。

Conclusion: 该方法能够在保留核心结构信息的前提下大幅简化超图表示，适用于多种实际场景。

Abstract: Hypergraphs provide a natural framework for describing complex networked systems with higher-order, non-dyadic interactions. Due to their high dimensionality and often redundant structure, a key challenge is to develop methods that simplify hypergraph representations while preserving the essential structure of interactions. Here we present a principled, efficient, and non-parametric information-theoretic method for pruning nested and/or redundant structures in hypergraphs, enabling a minimal representation of higher-order interactions in the presence of local heterogeneity. Our approach naturally extends to weighted hypergraphs, where higher-order topology and hyperedge weights combine to identify the system's structural backbone. We validate the method on controlled synthetic hypergraphs and apply it to empirical datasets from diverse domains, demonstrating substantial sparsification without loss of core structural information.

</details>


### [474] [The Structural Influence of Low-Credibility Narratives During the COVID-19 Vaccine Rollout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01630)
*Lynnette Hui Xian Ng,Wenqi Zhou,Kathleen M. Carley*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出两个新指标（Appeal和Scope）量化社交媒体上低可信度叙事的结构性影响力，通过对580万条关于COVID-19疫苗的低可信度推文分析，发现人类用户传播的低可信度叙事在所有时间阶段均比机器人账号具有更高的结构性影响力，且人类用户的影响力在疫苗推出关键周达到峰值，而机器人在高度不确定的疫苗前阶段影响力最大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究对低可信度叙事影响力的量化不够精确，缺乏同时考虑网络结构和流行度的综合性指标，且对自动账户（机器人）与人类用户在传播低可信度叙事中的比较角色理解不足。

Method: 提出两个新指标：Appeal（衡量消息的网络加权流行度）和Scope（衡量作者的消息流行度加权网络渗透度）；收集X平台580万条包含COVID-19疫苗低可信度叙事的消息，按三个时间阶段（疫苗前、疫苗推出、推出后）进行分析。

Result: 所有时间阶段中，人类用户传播的低可信度叙事结构性影响力均高于机器人账号；人类驱动的低可信度叙事在疫苗推出关键周达到Appeal和Scope峰值，而机器人账号在高度不确定的疫苗前阶段达到最大影响力。

Conclusion: 人类用户而非机器人在低可信度叙事传播中起主导作用；低可信度叙事的Appeal和Scope受关键公共事件生命周期阶段的调节作用；自动账户和有机账户在不同时间阶段表现出不同的运营能力。

Abstract: This work examines the structural influence of low-credibility narratives and the comparative role of automated accounts (bots) versus human users on social media platforms. To more accurately quantify the structural influence of a narrative on social media, this study proposes two novel metrics: (1) Appeal, which measures the network-weighted popularity of a message; and (2) Scope, which measures an author's message popularity-weighted network penetration. Applying these metrics, this study analyzes 5.8 million messages from X that contain low-credibility narratives regarding COVID-19 vaccine across three distinct temporal stages: Pre-Vaccine, Vaccine Launch, and Post-Launch. The results demonstrate that across all timeframes, human-distributed low-credibility narratives achieved higher structural influence compared to those generated by automated accounts. Furthermore, statistical analysis reveals a significant conditional temporal effect: human-driven low-credibility narratives attained their highest Appeal and Scope during the focal Vaccine Launch week, whereas automated accounts maximized their Appeal and Scope during the highly uncertain Pre-Vaccine period. These findings highlight the distinct operational capacities of automated and organic accounts, illustrating how the Appeal and Scope of low-credibility narratives is moderated by the lifecycle stages of critical public events.

</details>


### [475] [Enhancing the Socioeconomic Understanding of Foundation Models with Urban Mobility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01745)
*Baoshen Guo,Donghang Li,Zhiqing Hong,Kailai Sun,Heye Huang,Alok Prakash,Shenhao Wang*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出MobFusion框架，通过三种方式将人类移动性网络融入基础模型，以改善城市社会经济预测任务。实验表明，结合移动性模式可显著提升基础模型对城市功能连接和社会经济状况的理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基础模型在城市社会经济预测中主要依赖静态属性（如POI文本、卫星图像、地理描述），忽略了反映城市实体功能连接的移动性模式。作者旨在探索移动性网络能否通过显式编码城市实体间的连接来激发基础模型的地理空间能力。

Method: 提出MobFusion模块化移动性增强基础模型融合范式，包含三种互补设计：(i) 移动性网络作为零样本LLM提示的上下文；(ii) 作为图连接器融合地理空间视觉嵌入与文本嵌入；(iii) 作为结构化令牌用于多模态LLM推理。使用美国三个大都市区的匿名大规模移动性数据集进行验证。

Result: MobFusion在三种实例化方案下均提升了城市预测任务（中位家庭收入、人口密度、犯罪预测）的性能，证明融入人类移动性可有效改善基础模型的社会经济理解能力。

Conclusion: 将人类移动性网络作为额外的结构化信息融入基础模型，能够弥补静态属性建模的不足，显著提升模型对城市社会经济现象的理解和预测能力。

Abstract: Foundation models have recently been applied to urban socioeconomic prediction using POI text, satellite imagery, and geospatial descriptions. However, these models mostly rely on static attributes of individual places, while ignoring the mobility patterns that reveal how places are functionally connected. To address this gap, we explore whether mobility networks can elicit the geospatial capabilities of foundation models by explicitly encoding connectivity among urban entities. We propose \textit{MobFusion}, a modular mobility-enhanced foundation model fusion paradigm, and instantiate it through three complementary designs: (i) mobility networks as contexts for zero-shot LLM prompting, (ii) as graph connectors for fusing geospatial visual embeddings with textual embeddings, and (iii) as structured tokens for multimodal LLM reasoning. Using anonymized large-scale mobility datasets from three U.S. metropolitan areas, we find that \textit{MobFusion} improves urban prediction tasks (e.g., median household income, population density, and crime prediction) across three instantiations, demonstrating that incorporating human mobility can effectively improve the socioeconomic understanding of foundation models.

</details>


### [476] [Layered Ego Networks in Email Communication: From Enron to the Jmail Archive](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02376)
*Francesco Di Cursi,Chiara Boldrini,Marco Conti,Andrea Passarella*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文对比分析Enron（工作场所语料库）和Jmail（超高活跃度单中心档案）两个邮件档案，发现Dunbar-like分层结构可从普通组织邮件中恢复（Enron），但在高频选择性档案（Jmail）中标准分层方法失效，需进行频率归一化后才可揭示有意义的层次结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究经典自我网络分层理论（Dunbar-like组织）是否适用于数字通信数据（电子邮件），以及不同通信结构（普通工作邮件 vs. 极端高频个人邮件）下分层结构的可恢复性和解释方式。

Method: 对比分析两个结构迥异的邮件档案：Enron（约150用户的工作场所语料库）和Jmail（单中心、通信量超普通用户20倍以上的极端活跃焦点个体档案）。分别应用基于聚类和基于阈值的标准分层方法，并引入频率归一化和互惠性分析来验证分层结构的有效性。

Result: Enron部分重现了Dunbar-like组织，稳定内圈和最外层恢复出对应Dunbar亲和群（约50人）的结构。Jmail中极端通信强度导致标准分层方法失效，经频率归一化并以经验支持-小团体边界锚定Dunbar频率阶梯后，清晰的分层结构才浮现。互惠性分析证实恢复的层次反映真实双向关系而非单边活动伪影。

Conclusion: Dunbar-like组织可在邮件档案中有意义地研究，但选择性高频档案需先进行频率归一化，分层结构才可解释。

Abstract: Email archives offer a rare view of social relationships through repeated communication, but it remains unclear how well classical ego network layering applies to digital interaction data. This paper compares two public email archives with sharply contrasting structures: Enron, a workplace corpus involving around 150 users, and Jmail, a single-ego archive centered on an exceptionally active focal actor whose communication volume is more than twenty times higher than the average Enron user. We ask, in each case, whether Dunbar-like layered organization is recoverable from email communication frequency and how it should be interpreted. For Jmail, we show that extreme communication intensity causes standard layering methods (whether clustering-based or threshold-based) to break down. Jmail is not a broad communication environment with many occasional contacts, but a selective pool of high-interest alters operating on a much higher frequency scale than ordinary email. Once the Dunbar frequency ladder is anchored to the empirical support-clique boundary, a clearer layered structure emerges. Reciprocity analysis confirms that the recovered layers reflect genuine bidirectional relationships rather than artifacts of the focal actor's outgoing activity. Enron serves as a workplace benchmark that grounds the comparison: its ego networks partially reproduce Dunbar-like organization, with stable inner circles and an outermost recovered layer corresponding to Dunbar's affinity group ($\sim50$), confirming that layered structure is recoverable from ordinary organizational email. Overall, the findings show that Dunbar-like organization can be meaningfully studied in email archives, but that selective high-frequency archives require frequency normalization before the layered structure becomes interpretable.

</details>


### [477] [Topology as Logic: Structural Role Geometry Across Formal, Software, Biological, and Prebiotic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02392)
*Vladi Ivanov*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出依赖拓扑与功能承载组织之间存在可测量的结构对应关系。在7个独立基质（形式数学、遗留软件、神经进化、自催化网络、数字电路、ISCAS85标准基准、Coq形式化系统）中，通过多层网络分析和功能接近律，验证了枢纽持久性与秩发散能够恢复领域专家描述的“逻辑”结构。关键方法发现：基于度的枢纽持久性在物理布线与仿真状态相关层之间较弱（r=0.21），而基于介数的持久性更强（r=0.77）。主要假设在ISCAS85（确认，r=0.426, p=0.002）和Lean 4 mathlib4（确认，r=0.777, p=0.004）中得到验证，Coq Corelib部分支持。全部7项实验均为预注册。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究依赖拓扑是否能够作为可恢复的几何结构，定量地反映功能承载组织——即超越隐喻层面，通过多层网络分析方法可检测的结构属性。

Method: 运用多层网络分析和功能接近律，在7个独立基质上测量枢纽持久性和秩发散，恢复各领域专家描述的逻辑性负载结构。采用基于度和基于介数的枢纽持久性对比，并在ISCAS85和形式化证明助手中进行预注册假设检验。

Result: 基于介数的枢纽持久性优于基于度的度量（4-bit ALU: r=0.77, c432: r=0.34 vs r=0.21）。ISCAS85主要假设确认（度r=0.426, p=0.002, Spearman r=0.551）。Lean 4 mathlib4确认（r=0.777, p=0.004）。Coq Corelib部分支持（r=0.288, p=0.287, n=17, 统计功效不足）。

Conclusion: 依赖拓扑与功能承载组织之间存在可恢复的几何对应关系，功能接近律能够跨多个领域捕获逻辑性负载结构；介数中心性是比度数更可靠的跨层结构度量指标；预注册设计增强了结果可信度。

Abstract: We ask whether dependency topology correlates with functional load-bearing organization as recoverable geometry -- not as a metaphor, but as a measurable structural property detectable by multilayer network analysis. Across seven independent substrates, we show that hub persistence and rank divergence under the Functional Proximity Law recover operational organization that domain experts describe as logic: axiomatic load-bearing structure in formal mathematics, control and contract structure in legacy software, conserved hub grammar across approx. 600 million years of neural evolution, catalytic role organization in a published prebiotic autocatalytic network, carry-path dominance in a 4-bit digital circuit, betweenness persistence in the ISCAS85 c432 standard benchmark (n=196), and a directional formal-systems replication in the Coq Corelib (n=17). A key methodological finding: degree-based hub persistence is weak between physical wiring and simulation state-correlation layers (r=0.21 in c432), while betweenness-based persistence is stronger (r=0.77 in the 4-bit ALU post-hoc; r=0.34 in c432). The ISCAS85 pre-registered primary hypothesis was CONFIRMED (degree r=0.426, p=0.002, Spearman r=0.551). The formal-systems claim is supported by two proof-assistant corpora: Lean 4 mathlib4 (CONFIRMED, r=0.777, p=0.004) and Coq Corelib (PARTIAL, direction confirmed, r=0.288, p=0.287, n=17, underpowered). All seven experiments were pre-registered before analysis.

</details>


### [478] [Handbook of Network Analysis [KONECT -- the Koblenz Network Collection]](https://arxiv.org/abs/1402.5500)
*Jérôme Kunegis*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了KONECT（科布伦茨网络收集）项目的手册，该项目旨在收集、分析并为研究人员提供网络数据集，由比利时纳穆尔大学的纳穆尔复杂系统中心与德国科布伦茨-兰道大学的网络科学与技术研究所合作完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为网络科学及相关领域的研究人员提供系统化、可访问的网络数据集资源，促进网络分析研究。

Method: 通过项目KONECT收集、整理和提供网络数据集，由纳穆尔复杂系统中心（naXys）和网络科学与技术研究所（WeST）共同维护。

Result: 形成了KONECT数据集集合及其配套手册，为研究人员提供了可供使用的网络数据资源。

Conclusion: KONECT项目为网络科学研究提供了重要的数据基础设施，支持跨学科的网络分析研究。

Abstract: This is the handbook for the KONECT project, the \emph{Koblenz Network Collection}, a scientific project to collect, analyse, and provide network datasets for researchers in all related fields of research, by the Namur Center for Complex Systems (naXys) at the University of Namur, Belgium, with web hosting provided by the Institute for Web Science and Technologies (WeST) at the University of Koblenz--Landau, Germany.

</details>


### [479] [Beyond the Crowd: LLM-Augmented Community Notes for Governing Health Misinformation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.11423)
*Jiaying Wu,Zihang Fu,Haonan Wang,Fanxiao Li,Jiafeng Guo,Preslav Nakov,Min-Yen Kan*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出CrowdNotes+框架，通过LLM增强X平台社区笔记功能，以解决健康 misinformation 治理中17.6小时的中位延迟问题。框架包含证据增强笔记和自动化笔记两种模式，配合三级层次化评估（相关性、正确性、有用性）。实验表明CrowdNotes+在正确性、有用性和证据效用上显著优于人类贡献者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: X平台社区笔记在健康 misinformation 治理中存在显著延迟（中位17.6小时），且人类投票者常将语言流畅性误判为事实准确性，亟需更快速、可靠的解决方案。

Method: 提出CrowdNotes+统一框架：集成两种模式（证据增强笔记与自动化笔记），采用三级层次化评估（相关性→正确性→有用性），并构建HealthNotes基准数据集（含1.2K条健康笔记的有用性标注）及微调的有用性评判模型。

Result: 在15个代表性LLM上的实验表明，CrowdNotes+在笔记正确性、有用性和证据效用上均显著超越人类贡献者。

Conclusion: LLM增强框架能有效弥补众包治理的速度漏洞和认知偏差（如混淆流畅性与准确性），为大规模 misinformation 治理提供更可靠的自动化方案。

Abstract: Community Notes, the crowd-sourced misinformation governance system on X (formerly Twitter), allows users to flag misleading posts, attach contextual notes, and rate the notes' helpfulness. However, our empirical analysis of 30.8K health-related notes reveals substantial latency, with a median delay of 17.6 hours before notes receive a helpfulness status. To improve responsiveness during real-world misinformation surges, we propose CrowdNotes+, a unified LLM-based framework that augments Community Notes for faster and more reliable health misinformation governance. CrowdNotes+ integrates two modes: (1) evidence-grounded note augmentation and (2) utility-guided note automation, supported by a hierarchical three-stage evaluation of relevance, correctness, and helpfulness. We instantiate the framework with HealthNotes, a benchmark of 1.2K health notes annotated for helpfulness, and a fine-tuned helpfulness judge. Our analysis first uncovers a key loophole in current crowd-sourced governance: voters frequently conflate stylistic fluency with factual accuracy. Addressing this via our hierarchical evaluation, experiments across 15 representative LLMs demonstrate that CrowdNotes+ significantly outperforms human contributors in note correctness, helpfulness, and evidence utility.

</details>


### [480] [Segregation Before Polarization: How Recommendation Strategies Shape Echo Chamber Pathways](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.16457)
*Junning Zhao,Kazutoshi Sasahara,Yu Chen*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 内容推荐算法会导致社会网络先经历结构隔离再经历观点极化（SbP路径），而链接推荐算法则不会；转发行为看似增强连接实则因放大微小意见差异而强化回音室效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究虽证实算法同质性现象，但内容推荐与链接推荐两种机制对网络演化的差异化影响尚未明确。

Method: 扩展动态有界信任模型（BCM），分别模拟内容推荐与链接推荐下的网络演化过程。

Result: 内容推荐算法导向SbP路径：结构隔离先于观点极化，加速个体孤立但延迟并最终加剧集体极化；转发行为通过放大微小意见差异强化回音室效应。

Conclusion: 缓解极化需要阶段依赖的算法干预，随网络演化从内容导向策略转向结构导向策略。

Abstract: Social media platforms facilitate echo chambers through feedback loops between user preferences and recommendation algorithms. While algorithmic homogeneity is well-documented, the distinct evolutionary pathways driven by content-based versus link-based recommendations remain unclear. Using an extended dynamic Bounded Confidence Model (BCM), we show that content-based algorithms -- unlike their link-based counterparts -- steer social networks toward a segregation-before-polarization (SbP) pathway. Along this trajectory, structural segregation precedes opinion divergence, accelerating individual isolation while delaying but ultimately intensifying collective polarization. Furthermore, we reveal that reposting appears connective by circulating content beyond direct follow links, yet it simultaneously reinforces echo chambers because it amplifies small, latent opinion differences that would otherwise remain inconsequential. These findings suggest that mitigating polarization requires stage-dependent algorithmic interventions, shifting from content-centric to structure-centric strategies as networks evolve.

</details>


### [481] [Jointly Optimizing Debiased CTR and Uplift for Coupons Marketing: A Unified Causal Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12972)
*Siyun Yang,Shixiao Yang,Jian Wang,Di Fan,Kehe Cai,Haoyan Fu,Jiaming Zhang,Wenjin Wu,Peng Jiang*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 本文提出UniMVT模型，通过解耦混淆因素与全空间反事实推断，实现多值处理（优惠券）下的去偏CTR预测与增量效果估计，在合成数据、工业数据和线上A/B测试中均取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线广告中，优惠券等营销干预会引入显著的混杂偏差，导致观测到的点击率混合了用户内在偏好与干预带来的增量效果。传统模型无法区分这两者，造成基准CTR校准偏差，进而影响排序和计费决策。此外，营销干预往往是多值处理（不同额度优惠券），增加了CTR预测的复杂性。

Method: UniMVT包含三个核心设计：(1) 解耦混淆因素与处理敏感表征；(2) 全空间反事实推断模块联合重建去偏基准CTR与强度-响应曲线；(3) 辅助强度估计任务捕获处理倾向性，并设计单元增量目标对干预效果进行归一化，实现连续优惠券价值谱上的可比估计。

Result: 在合成数据集和工业数据集上，UniMVT在预测准确性和校准能力上均优于基线方法。线上A/B测试进一步验证了UniMVT通过更有效的优惠券分发显著提升了业务指标。

Conclusion: UniMVT同时实现了去偏的CTR预测（用于系统准确校准）和精确的增量效果估计（用于激励分配），有效解决了多值营销干预下的混杂偏差问题。

Abstract: In online advertising, marketing interventions such as coupons introduce significant confounding bias into Click-Through Rate (CTR) prediction. Observed clicks reflect a mixture of users' intrinsic preferences and the uplift induced by these interventions. This causes conventional models to miscalibrate base CTRs, which distorts downstream ranking and billing decisions. Furthermore, marketing interventions often operate as multi-valued treatments with varying magnitudes, introducing additional complexity to CTR prediction.
  To address these issues, we propose the \textbf{Uni}fied \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{V}alued \textbf{T}reatment Network (UniMVT). Specifically, UniMVT disentangles confounding factors from treatment-sensitive representations, enabling a full-space counterfactual inference module to jointly reconstruct the debiased base CTR and intensity-response curves. To handle the complexity of multi-valued treatments, UniMVT employs an auxiliary intensity estimation task to capture treatment propensities and devise a unit uplift objective that normalizes the intervention effect. This ensures comparable estimation across the continuous coupon-value spectrum. UniMVT simultaneously achieves debiased CTR prediction for accurate system calibration and precise uplift estimation for incentive allocation. Extensive experiments on synthetic and industrial datasets demonstrate UniMVT's superiority in both predictive accuracy and calibration. Furthermore, real-world A/B tests confirm that UniMVT significantly improves business metrics through more effective coupon distribution.

</details>


### [482] [Evidence for a Functional Proximity Law in Multilayer Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23639)
*Vladi Ivanov*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: 提出了多层网络中枢纽重要性的“功能邻近定律”：功能相似层之间的枢纽得分比不相似层更一致。通过31个预注册实验（25个确认，6个否定）在8个科学领域验证，发现6个结构性边界条件（BC1-BC6），包括新命名的BC_INVERSION机制。该定律扩展到粒子物理学（标准模型实验确认5个假设）和COBOL遗留银行软件（确认4/4假设）。跨物种（果蝇幼虫连接组，约6亿年进化）验证也支持该定律。抗抑郁药证据链中发现枢纽主导结构模式。提出了定量前置条件预测器Var(d²)<0.714来预测BC_RADIAL失败。25/31预注册确认的二项概率p≈0.000439。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究多层网络中节点重要性（枢纽得分）在不同功能相似性层之间的跨层一致性规律，并系统性地验证其普适性及边界条件。

Method: 采用预注册实验设计，在13个规范领域和18个外部/复制验证中测试枢纽得分跨层相关性。使用Spearman/Pearson相关性分析，推导定量前置条件预测器Var(d²)，通过二项概率检验整体统计显著性。

Result: 31个预注册实验中25个确认该定律（p≈0.000439）。9个规范领域单独达到p<0.05。6个否定结果揭示6个边界条件。粒子物理实验确认5/5假设（r=0.569, p=0.010）。COBOL软件确认4/4假设（r=0.807）。跨物种验证证实（p=0.002）。发现抗抑郁药证据链中枢纽主导结构。Var(d²)<0.714可预测BC_RADIAL失败。

Conclusion: 功能邻近定律具有跨学科普适性，跨越8个科学领域（分子生物学、神经科学、计算机系统、生态学、语言学、AI架构、粒子物理学、软件工程），并适用于跨物种进化尺度。同时发现了重要的边界条件和预测机制，为该理论的完整性和应用提供了边界。

Abstract: Hub importance scores in multilayer networks persist more strongly between functionally similar layers than dissimilar ones. We call this the Functional Proximity Law and test it across 31 pre-registered experiments: 13 canonical domains (10 confirmed, 3 denied; molecular biology, neuroscience, computer systems, ecology, linguistics, AI architecture) plus 18 pre-registered external and replication validations (15 confirmed, 1 denied, 2 partial). Nine canonical domains reach p < 0.05 individually. Six DENIED results reveal six named structural boundary conditions (BC1-BC6), including the newly named BC_INVERSION mechanism in which fan-out leaf clustering inverts the hub correlation. The law extends to particle physics: the first pre-registered Standard Model experiment confirms all 5 hypotheses (r = 0.569, p = 0.010; photon confirmed as hub shadow). COBOL legacy banking software confirms 4/4 hypotheses (r = 0.807, Delta r = 0.688; topological dormancy signatures). A cross-species replication across approx. 600 million years of evolution confirms the law in the Drosophila melanogaster larval connectome (n = 2952 neurons, Spearman rho = 0.663, Pearson r = 0.363, p = 0.002). A hub dominance structural pattern is discovered in the antidepressant evidence chain: the founding assumption ranks #1 hub in all three epistemological layers simultaneously, detectable from graph topology alone. A quantitative precondition predictor, Var(d2) < 0.714, predicts BC_RADIAL failure before experiments run. Binomial probability of 25/31 pre-registered confirmations by chance: p approx. 0.000439 (p < 0.001). The law now spans eight scientific fields.

</details>


### [483] [ECHO-PPI: Trustworthy AI for Evidence-Bundled Detection of Overlapping Protein Modules in Protein-Protein Interaction Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21216)
*Sima Soltani,Mehrdad Jalali,Yahya Forghani,Reza Sheybani*

Main category: cs.SI

TL;DR: ECHO-PPI是一个可解释的重叠蛋白质模块检测框架，通过整合网络拓扑、语义特征和GO证据，为每个蛋白质-模块分配提供证据评分和层次化置信度标签，在保持检测性能的同时增强了可审计性和可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有社区检测方法能恢复候选蛋白质复合物，但很少解释单个蛋白质为何被分配到特定模块，也无法区分该分配是核心、外围还是不确定的。为克服重叠功能模块的可解释性不足问题而生。

Method: ECHO-PPI框架包含四个步骤：识别证据-潜力核、构建候选模块、执行重叠感知分配、导出层次化置信度标签。它整合了加权网络拓扑、语义蛋白质谱和Gene Ontology证据，为每个蛋白质-模块分配提供三类证据分数和层次化置信度标签。

Result: 在酵母蛋白质互作数据上的评估表明，ECHO-PPI保持了强重叠感知基线方法的行为，同时增加了证据捆绑的可审计性。

Conclusion: ECHO-PPI不追求普遍的预测优越性，而是解决一个互补需求：使重叠蛋白质模块预测变得可检查、置信度可知且可复现，以支持下游生物学解释。

Abstract: Protein-protein interaction networks provide a graph-level view of cellular organization, yet their functional modules are overlapping, noisy, and difficult to interpret from cluster assignments alone. Existing community-detection methods can recover candidate protein complexes, but they rarely explain why an individual protein is assigned to a specific module or whether that assignment should be treated as core, peripheral, or uncertain. Here we introduce ECHO-PPI, an evidence-bundled framework for interpretable overlapping protein-module detection in protein-protein interaction networks. ECHO-PPI integrates weighted network topology, semantic protein profiles, and Gene Ontology evidence to identify evidence-potential nuclei, construct candidate modules, perform overlap-aware assignment, and export hierarchical confidence labels. The framework supports trustworthy computational decision support through assignment-level interpretability: each protein-module assignment is accompanied by topology, semantic, and Gene Ontology evidence scores and a hierarchical confidence label, enabling curators to inspect, rank, and triage overlapping module predictions. Evaluation on yeast protein-interaction data shows that ECHO-PPI preserves the behaviour of strong overlap-aware baselines while adding evidence-bundled auditability. Rather than claiming universal predictive superiority, ECHO-PPI addresses a complementary need: making overlapping protein-module predictions inspectable, confidence-aware, and reproducible for downstream biological interpretation.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [484] [Learning from Mistakes: Can LLM Self-Recover after Misalignment?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00003)
*Olga E. Sorokoletova,Francesco Giarrusso,Vincenzo Suriani,Daniele Nardi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出从新视角研究LLM对齐：不开发更强的对齐技术，而是探究模型在安全性被破坏后内在的自我恢复能力。作者提出建模用户-助手交互安全轨迹的方法，检测其中的恢复趋势，并在越狱场景下基于多轮对抗对话数据集进行初步分析，同时研究了内容审核模型选择对安全评估的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM对齐工作主要聚焦于改进对齐方法和后处理过滤器，但模型对齐后并不能保证在整个生命周期中保持该状态，且恶意攻击者可能使用越狱技术破坏LLM安全。因此作者提出从新视角出发，研究模型在安全性受损后内在的自我恢复能力。

Method: 提出一种建模用户-助手交互安全轨迹的方法，用于检测其中的恢复趋势。将该方法应用于越狱场景，基于多轮对抗对话数据集进行恢复分析，并考察不同内容审核模型对安全评估的影响。

Result: 基于多轮对抗对话数据集进行了初步的恢复分析，展示了模型在越狱攻击后安全性的恢复趋势，并揭示了内容审核模型选择对安全评估结果的影响。

Conclusion: 模型具有内在的安全恢复能力，研究这种自我恢复机制为推进LLM对齐提供了新视角，未来可进一步探索如何增强和利用模型的这种内在恢复能力。

Abstract: Responsible AI initiatives place great emphasis on the safety of Large Language Model (LLM)-based systems. In particular, it has become standard practice to subject these models to an alignment procedure aimed at preventing harmful outputs. However, once aligned, a model is not guaranteed to maintain this alignment throughout its lifecycle. Moreover, the likelihood of misalignment increases as malicious actors may deliberately employ jailbreaking techniques to compromise LLM safety. To counter this, much research has focused on improving alignment methods and post-processing filters. In this paper, we introduce a new perspective on advancing LLM alignment: rather than developing stronger alignment techniques, we investigate the model's intrinsic ability to recover its alignment after corruption. We propose a methodology for modeling the safety trajectories of user-assistant interactions and for detecting recovery trends within them. We apply this approach to a jailbreaking scenario, presenting a preliminary recovery analysis based on a dataset of adversarial multi-turn dialogues and examining the influence of the content moderation model chosen for safety evaluation. Project page with an interactive data visualizer is available at https://lab-rococo-sapienza.github.io/LearningfromMistakes.

</details>


### [485] [A phenomenon of AI-conformity: how algorithms change human moral decision-making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00013)
*Yana Venerina,Dmitry Koch,Nare Meloyan,Gerda Prutko,Valeriia Lelik,Victoria Taova,Andrey Kurpatov*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过改编经典的Asch范式，发现具有推理能力的AI模型能够以与人类多数相当的程度影响人们的道德判断，表明道德决策也可能受到算法从众效应的影响，挑战了道德决策属于“AI不可侵入区”的假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI日益融入日常生活，AI可能成为一种新的影响力来源，但算法从众效应的机制尚不明确。本研究旨在探究AI判断是否会影响人类的道德决策。

Method: 改编经典Asch范式，让165名参与者在三种条件下完成一系列道德困境任务：存在社会多数意见、AI模型仅提供简短答案、AI模型提供答案并附带推理解释。所有条件下呈现的回应均与公认道德规范相悖。

Result: 具有推理能力的AI模型对参与者意见的影响程度与人类多数意见相当；但算法从众效应的潜在机制与社会从众效应不同。

Conclusion: 即使是敏感且具有个人重要性的道德判断也可能受到算法从众效应的影响，挑战了道德决策属于“AI不可侵入区”的假设，强调需进一步研究该现象。

Abstract: Social conformity is a well-documented phenomenon in which individuals shift their opinions towards those of a social majority. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly integrated into everyday life it may also create a novel source of influence giving rise to algorithmic conformity, mechanisms of which are poorly understood. The present study examined whether AI judgements affect moral decision-making in humans (n=165) adapting the classical Asch paradigm. Participants completed a series of moral dilemmas under three different conditions: in presence of social majority, with an AI model providing brief answers and with an AI model providing both answers and explanations of its choices. In all conditions the presented responses contradicted generally accepted moral norms. The results indicated that an AI model with a reasoning component affected the opinion of participants to a degree comparable to that of a human majority. These findings suggest that even moral judgements, despite their sensitivity and personal significance, may be susceptible to algorithmic conformity. However, the mechanism underlying algorithmic conformity appears to differ from the social one. Overall, the study challenges the assumption that moral decision-making lies in "AI inadmissibility zone" - a sphere that is considered as an area in which only human-made decisions are acceptable and highlights the need for a further investigation of this phenomenon as AI-based recommendations become increasingly embedded into human decision-making.

</details>


### [486] [From Parliamentary Rhetoric to Enacted Law: An NLP Pipeline for Semantic Auditing of the Greek Legislative Process](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00030)
*Despoina Antonakaki,Sotiris Ioannidis*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套多模态计算管道，用于分析希腊立法框架，通过NLP处理议会辩论、LLM语义审计、头less浏览器采集政府公报，揭示了“简化错觉”、模糊性类型学（45%模糊术语、25%执行授权延迟）、政治差异指数（PDI）等关键发现，并生成语义链接数据集与交互式审计界面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 希腊立法框架存在交叉引用复杂、频繁修订、机器可读性差等问题，传统批量归档方法计算成本高且无法捕捉政治相关性，阻碍了透明度和公民参与。

Method: 1) 对2025年希腊议会辩论文本应用NLP，提取534条独特法律引用，以辩论频率作为政治重要性信号；2) 使用无头浏览器架构自动获取政府公报；3) 利用LLM进行语义审计立法质量；4) 构建政治差异指数（PDI）评估部长承诺与颁布法律的一致性；5) 进行交叉引用网络分析。

Result: 发现“简化错觉”：被框架为简化的法律实际呈现高结构复杂性和模糊性；识别312个模糊实例，45%源于模糊术语，25%源于延迟的执行授权；PDI分析显示三部高频法律的主要结果是“延迟”，承诺被转移给未来的部长决定；交叉引用网络确认法律体系高度纠缠，基础条款修正最频繁。

Conclusion: 该管道能够桥接议会话语与颁布立法，生成语义链接数据集和交互式审计界面，为立法过程的可扩展分析提供支持。

Abstract: The Greek legislative framework is characterized by intricate cross-referencing, frequent amendments, and limited machine-readable access, hindering transparency and civic engagement. Traditional bulk-archiving approaches are computationally expensive and fail to capture political relevance. We present a multimodal computational pipeline that bridges parliamentary discourse with enacted legislation. Applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) to 2025 Hellenic Parliament transcripts, we extracted 534 unique law citations and used debate frequency as an empirical signal to identify politically salient laws. A headless browser architecture enables automated acquisition of official Government Gazette documents despite anti-scraping barriers.
  Using Large Language Models (LLMs), we conduct a semantic audit of legislative quality. Our analysis reveals an "Illusion of Simplicity", where laws framed as simplifications exhibit high structural complexity and ambiguity. A typology of 312 ambiguity instances shows that 45 percent stem from vague terminology and 25 percent from deferred executive delegation. We introduce the Political Discrepancy Index (PDI), evaluating alignment between ministerial promises and enacted law. Across three high-frequency laws (4808/2021, 4412/2016, 4662/2020), the dominant outcome is Deferral, with commitments shifted to future Ministerial Decisions.
  Cross-reference network analysis confirms a highly entangled legal system, with foundational provisions among the most frequently amended. The pipeline produces a semantically linked dataset and an interactive auditing interface for scalable analysis of legislative processes.

</details>


### [487] [Metaverse in Smart Cities: Transforming Urban Life and Governance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00032)
*Ioanna Chatzopoulou,Paraskevi Tsoutsa,Panos Fitsilis*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过系统性文献综述，研究了元宇宙技术在智慧城市中的实际应用，包括治理、经济、交通、可持续性和社会互动等方面，并基于多个城市案例构建了元宇宙驱动型智慧城市模型的分析框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学术界和工业界对元宇宙在智慧城市中的应用兴趣日益增长，但相关研究仍碎片化，缺乏系统性梳理和整合。

Method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，综合分析了现有应用案例（如Metaverse Seoul、迪拜元宇宙战略、Virtual Helsinki、Tampere CitiVerse等）的研究发现。

Result: 元宇宙在智慧城市中的应用在效率、参与度和创新方面具有显著优势，但同时在技术可及性、治理框架和安全措施等方面存在挑战。

Conclusion: 为政策制定者、城市规划者和技术开发者提供了负责任且包容的元宇宙采用的战略见解，并构建了将元宇宙技术整合到智慧城市生态系统中的结构化路线图。

Abstract: The integration of metaverse technologies within Smart Cities is transforming urban governance and citizen engagement. Despite the increasing academic and industry interest, research on the practical applications of the metaverse in SCs remains fragmented.
  This study addresses this gap through a systematic literature review on how metaverse-driven solutions impact economic transformation, governance, mobility, sustainability, and social interactions in urban environments. The study synthesizes findings from existing applications and case studies, such as Metaverse Seoul, Dubai's Metaverse Strategy, Virtual Helsinki, and Tampere's CitiVerse initiative, to illustrate the diverse ways in which cities are leveraging metaverse technologies. These applications demonstrate the metaverse's potential in digital governance, Artificial Intelligence (AI)-driven urban planning, e-participation, transportation optimization, and climate resilience strategies. This research contributes to the field by providing a comprehensive framework for understanding the benefits and challenges of metaverse-driven SC models.
  The findings suggest that while metaverse adoption in SCs presents significant advantages in efficiency, participation, and innovation, it also entails challenges related to technological accessibility, governance frameworks, and security measures that must be addressed for broad uptake. The study's impact extends to policymakers, urban planners, and technology developers by offering strategic insights for responsible and inclusive metaverse adoption. Ultimately, this study provides a structured roadmap for integrating metaverse technologies into smart urban ecosystems, ensuring their long-term viability, accessibility, and effectiveness in shaping the cities of the future.

</details>


### [488] [Make Mechanistic Interpretability Auditable: A Call to Develop Guidelines via Continuous Collaborative Reviewing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00033)
*Michael Lan,Narmeen Fatimah Oozeer,Chaithanya Bandi,Philip Quirke,Austin Meek,Fazl Barez,Amirali Abdullah*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文呼吁机械可解释性（MI）领域建立标准化审计系统，提出协作评审平台、专家验证指南和基于来源的审计三大建议，以解决当前实验结果不可比、不可认证的问题，推动MI在安全关键领域的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MI领域缺乏标准化审计系统，导致研究发现不可比、不可认证，在医疗AI和自动驾驶等安全关键场景中无法被采用。已有研究表明不同论文对同一行为得出矛盾结论，且因方法不一致而无法比较。

Method: 提出三种机制：(1) 持续评审：构建协作评审平台，组织元科学结果与讨论（批评、负面结果、扩展、复现等）；(2) 通用化最佳实践：将平台上的良好实践提炼为专家验证的指南和协议；(3) 基于来源的审计：追踪论点所依赖的来源以增强可追溯性。

Result: 本文为立场论文，提供初步具体示例以催化相关讨论，尚未有实证结果。

Conclusion: 审计MI本身对于其在AI安全、产业和治理中的应用至关重要，呼吁社区就框架的必要性、设计和实施展开建设性辩论。

Abstract: While mechanistic interpretability (MI) has produced important insights into neural network internals, the field has yet to establish a standardized system to audit experiments. As such, many of its findings remain underutilized in safety-critical applications such as medical AI and autonomous systems, as stakeholders cannot certify their validity. Recent work demonstrates this concretely: two papers found conflicting conclusions for the same behavior, and a third study revealed that both were partially correct but incomparable due to methodological inconsistencies. Without standardized auditing, such ambiguities hinder adoption in high-stakes contexts requiring strong correctness guarantees. We call for the MI community to work towards developing a novel reviewing system that complements peer review via: (1) Continuous reviewing supported by a \emph{Collaborative Reviewing Platform} where meta-science results and discussions (such as critiques, negative results, post-hoc extensions, reproductions, replications, and partial results) that fit outside of papers are organized and discussed, allowing for comments and revisions to be made at any time (2) Generalizing good practices found on this platform into expert-verified guidelines and protocols to improve auditing efficiency, and (3) Source-based auditing systems that track arguments which claims depend on. This position paper encourages constructive debate over the necessity, design and implementation of such a framework, providing early concrete examples to help catalyze these dialogues. Overall, we propose that auditing MI itself is essential for its application in AI safety, industry, and governance.

</details>


### [489] [Artificial intelligence as a real game to enlighten science education for disabled students in rural New Mexico](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00034)
*Uloma Egondu Nelson,Gil Gallegos*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究采用混合方法（多元线性回归与人工神经网络），对新墨西哥州四所农村学校的120名6-10年级残疾学生和15名教师进行AI干预。结果显示AI能高精度预测学生表现（R²=0.92），并显著提升科学概念保留率（32%）、实验表现（27%）和参与度（42%），表明AI可成为农村残障学生科学教育的公平化工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索AI技术如何改善农村地区残疾学生的科学教育可及性与公平性，解决传统教育在偏远地区资源不足、特殊需求学生支持匮乏的问题。

Method: 采用混合方法设计，结合多元线性回归与人工神经网络（ANN）模型，对120名6-10年级学生和15名教师进行AI学习干预实验。

Result: AI模型预测学生表现准确度高（R²=0.92, p<0.05）；干预后科学概念保留率提升32%，实验室表现提升27%，学生参与度提升42%。

Conclusion: AI驱动教学法可作为变革性公平工具，显著改善农村残障学生的科学学习参与度、理解力和可及性，为实现公平科学教育提供可行路径。

Abstract: Artificial Intelligence AI has emerged as a transformative innovation in inclusive science education for disabled learners in rural New Mexico. Using a mixed method design that combined multiple linear regression and an Artificial Neural Network ANN model, this study examined 120 students in grades 6 to 10 and 15 instructors across four rural schools. The AI-based learning intervention predicted student performance with high accuracy R2 equals 0.92, and p less than 0.05. Experimental results showed a 32 percent improvement in science concept retention, a 27 percent increase in laboratory performance, and a 42 percent rise in student engagement following the intervention. These findings demonstrate that AI-driven pedagogy can serve as a transformative equalizer, improving engagement, comprehension, and accessibility for disabled learners. The study concludes that AI is a promising tool for achieving equitable science education in underserved rural settings.

</details>


### [490] [Understanding the Role of Algorithm Registers in AI Governance Through Comparative Analysis of China and the UK](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00035)
*Yulu Pi,Wenlong Li,Jatinder Singh*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文比较了中国备案系统和英国ATRS两种算法注册机制，发现算法注册表的功能远超透明度，可服务于市场准入、生态系统理解、监管基础设施等多种治理目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法注册表正被广泛用于AI治理，但其设计、范围和实施差异巨大，现有研究缺乏对其潜在角色的整体理解。

Method: 对中国备案系统和英国ATRS进行比较分析，基于公开监管文件、注册指南和注册数据。

Result: 算法注册表可发挥超越透明度的多种功能，包括上市前审批、生态系统级理解、监管基础设施。

Conclusion: 研究人员和政策制定者应基于设计和制度背景审视算法注册表的具体治理功能，而非仅从透明度角度理解。

Abstract: Algorithm registers are increasingly being both considered and deployed as instruments in AI governance. They are often expected to deliver transparency; however, in practice their design, scope, and implementation vary substantially. Currently, we lack a holistic understanding of the potential roles that registers might play in AI governance, and how different design choices both shape and reflect those roles. This paper therefore asks how do algorithm registers differ across jurisdictions, and what do these differences reveal about their roles in AI governance? Towards this, we conduct a comparative analysis of two influential but contrasting algorithm registration mechanisms, China's Beian system and the UK's Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard (ATRS), drawing on publicly available regulatory documents, registration guidelines, and registry data. Crucially, our analysis shows that an algorithm register, depending on its design and implementation, can serve functions beyond transparency, including pre-market approval, enabling ecosystem-level understanding, and acting as a broader regulatory infrastructure. As algorithm registries proliferate globally, we stress the importance of researchers and policymakers considering and examining the concrete governance functions that algorithm registries can perform as a result of their design and institutional context, rather than approaching them primarily through a transparency lens.

</details>


### [491] [AI Integrity: Defending Against Backdoors and Secret Loyalties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00036)
*Dave Banerjee,Onni Aarne*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: AI完整性是指确保AI系统免受未经授权修改的影响，是信息安全CIA三要素中未得到充分重视但至关重要的支柱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管机密性（如AI模型权重保护）和可用性（市场驱动）已受到一定关注，AI完整性作为国家安全的关键要素却未获得足够重视，作者旨在引起对该问题的关注。

Method: 通过对比信息安全CIA三要素（机密性、完整性、可用性）在AI领域的关注程度，分析完整性受到的忽视及其对国家安全的影响。

Result: AI完整性受到的关注远低于机密性和可用性，尽管其对国家安全至关重要。

Conclusion: AI完整性需要获得更多重视，以确保AI系统免受未经授权的秘密修改。

Abstract: AI integrity means ensuring AI systems are free from secret or unauthorized modifications that could compromise their behavior. Integrity represents one pillar of the confidentiality, integrity, and availability (CIA) triad in information security: confidentiality preserves secrecy of sensitive information, integrity ensures data remain authentic and uncorrupted, and availability keeps systems operational when needed. While confidentiality receives some attention through efforts like RAND's Securing AI Model Weights report, and availability is naturally prioritized by market forces, AI integrity receives insufficient attention despite its importance to national security.

</details>


### [492] [Update Opacity: Epistemic Accessibility and Governance Under AI System Change](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00037)
*Andrea Ferrario,Joshua Hatherley*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出AI系统更新会导致"更新不透明性"问题，即用户难以理解相同输入为何产生不同输出。作者将此问题视为一种历时性的认知可及性失败，并提出结合欧盟AI法案与MLOps的治理框架，通过可信度画像、阈值披露等机制，实现对系统变化的分层、适时披露。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统频繁更新造成用户无法理解输入-输出映射变化，即"更新不透明性"问题。作者认为这不仅是技术问题，更是治理问题，需要在不造成信息过载的前提下，确保用户能够获取与自身角色和时间约束相关的实质性变化信息。

Method: 结合欧盟AI法案（系统层面的规范性变化边界界定）与MLOps（变化追踪和比较的操作工具），提出框架：通过可信度画像和可信度层级对系统变化建模，采用基于阈值的信息披露机制，向不同利益相关者适时披露实质性的"包内变化"。

Result: 提出了一个结合治理规范与操作工具的混合框架，通过阈值驱动的披露策略，实现变化信息的分层、适时传递，并以医疗AI用例进行说明。

Conclusion: 更新不透明性是AI治理的关键问题，需要结合法律规范（如EU AI Act）与工程实践（MLOps）构建分层披露机制，以支持用户的理解、校准信任和适时行动。该框架对生命周期文档、上市后监测和更新披露具有实践意义。

Abstract: Machine learning models embedded in deployed AI systems are routinely updated to maintain correct functioning over time. Yet such updates can generate update opacity: users may not be able to understand why the same input now yields a different output. We argue that update opacity is best understood as a diachronic failure of epistemic accessibility: the problem is that materially relevant changes may fail to remain accessible to human users in forms that support understanding, calibrated reliance, and appropriate action under real role- and time-specific constraints. This makes update opacity a governance problem. Not all change is equally relevant, and disclosing every update would itself undermine use through overload. To address this problem, we combine two complementary governance approaches: the EU AI Act, which helps specify the system-level perimeter of normatively relevant change, and Machine Learning Operations, which provides operational tools for tracking and comparing change over time. On this basis, we propose a framework that models system change through trustworthiness profiles and trustworthiness levels, and uses threshold-based disclosure to surface materially relevant within-envelope change to different stakeholders over time. We illustrate the approach with a medical AI example and derive practical implications for lifecycle documentation, post-market monitoring, and update disclosure.

</details>


### [493] [Beyond Tool Adoption: A Practical Five-Stage Developmental Continuum for AI Literacy in Higher Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00038)
*J. Paul Liu,Rachel Levy*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个五阶段AI素养连续体模型（从"尚未参与"到"改进"），用于描述高等教育中学习者使用AI的发展路径，并通过北卡罗来纳州立大学的实践案例（330+参与者）提供观察性证据，强调AI素养应被理解为一种发展性能力而非单纯工具采用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI素养框架多聚焦于能力定义，但缺乏对学习者起点和发展过程的诊断与指导；学生在AI工具使用上呈现两极分化（回避与盲目依赖），亟需一个描述性发展路径来帮助教育者识别学习者的阶段并设计干预措施。

Method: 提出五阶段AI素养连续体模型；采用设计型研究方法，在北卡罗来纳州立大学实施学分课程和密集工作坊（2024秋-2026春，330+参与者）；未使用验证过的前后测工具或对照组，研究以观察性和实践为基础。

Result: 参与者表现出从非参与或非批判性使用向知情参与的阶段性行为转变；持续且嵌入学科的干预更能促进批判性评估和改进导向的实践。

Conclusion: AI素养应被理解为一种发展性能力，而非单纯的工具采用；该连续体为教育者提供了实用的诊断和教学路径，与UNESCO和OECD等国际框架兼容；需关注课程路径、公平性考量和评估策略。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) literacy is increasingly recognized as a foundational competency for all university graduates. Yet students' engagement with AI tools often clusters at two problematic extremes: avoidance driven by fear, mistrust, ethical concern, or lack of access, and uncritical reliance that produces fluent output while masking misunderstanding. Existing AI literacy frameworks provide valuable competency definitions, but most offer limited guidance for diagnosing where learners begin and how they progress toward responsible, critical engagement. This paper proposes a five-stage AI Literacy Continuum -- 1) Not Yet Engaged, 2) Uncritical Use, 3) Informed Use, 4) Critical Evaluation, and 5) Improvement -- that describes developmental orientations toward AI use in higher education. The continuum complements dimensional frameworks by providing educators with a practical diagnostic and instructional pathway aligned with international frameworks, including UNESCO and OECD. We present a design-based implementation case from North Carolina State University, where credit-bearing courses and intensive hands-on workshops engaged more than 330 participants between Fall 2024 and Spring 2026. Because the implementation did not use a validated pre/post instrument or comparison group, we frame the findings as observational and practice-based: participants exhibited behaviors consistent with movement from non-engagement or uncritical use toward informed engagement, while sustained and discipline-embedded experiences produced stronger evidence of critical evaluation and improvement-oriented practice. We discuss curricular pathways, equity considerations, assessment strategies, and argue that AI literacy should be understood not as tool adoption alone but as a developmental capacity to understand, evaluate, and responsibly apply AI systems in disciplinary and societal contexts.

</details>


### [494] [Beyond Categories of Caste: Examining Caste Bias and Morality in Text-to-Image AI Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00039)
*Divyanshu Kumar Singh,Dipto Das,Deepika Rama Subramanian,Koustuv Saha,Stephen Voida,Bryan Semaan*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文挑战了将种姓视为身份类别的传统观点，提出应将种姓视为关系性概念，通过算法审计与批判性话语分析相结合的方法，揭示了文本到图像（T2I）模型中种姓偏见在"婆罗门规范性"框架下超越简单二元对立的复杂运作机制，并提出了反种姓的AI公平性方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将种姓视为身份类别，未能充分理解T2I模型中种姓歧视的复杂机制；需要从关系性本体出发，超越上/下种姓的简单二元对立，深入揭示种姓偏见在生成式AI中的运作方式。

Method: 结合算法审计（algorithmic audit）与批判性话语分析（critical discourse analysis），以"挑战婆罗门规范性"为概念框架进行分析。

Result: 揭示了种姓偏见在T2I模型中以超越简单二元分类的复杂方式被延续和放大。

Conclusion: 挑战了将种姓视为身份类别的传统理解，提出了应对AI系统中种姓偏见和公平性问题的反种姓（anti-caste）方法。

Abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) models have shown promising utility across various domains. However, such models are also amplifying harmful societal biases in their outputs. In the context of South Asia, recent work has shown caste biases and stereotypes are being perpetuated through Generative AI (GenAI) systems. While this research offers extremely relevant insight into invisibilized narratives of caste discrimination through the GenAI system, they often treat caste as an identity category. Therefore, in this work we shift our ontology to focus on the relational aspect of caste. This enables us to develop a more nuanced understanding of the mechanics of caste discrimination by and through T2I models. Combining an algorithmic audit with critical discourse analysis, we draw on a conceptual frame challenging Brahminical Normativity to show how caste biases are perpetuated beyond the simple binaries of upper vs lower-caste categories. Our contributions are two-fold. Beyond challenging the categorical understanding of caste as a category, we propose an anti-caste approach to tackle the issue of caste bias and fairness in AI systems.

</details>


### [495] [Tracing GenAI Literacy: Uncovering Student-AI Interaction Patterns in Academic Writing through Epistemic Network Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00040)
*Angxuan Chen,Jiyou Jia*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究利用学习分析技术，通过分析162名大学生在GenAI辅助写作任务中的交互日志，发现高GenAI素养学生表现出迭代优化和策略性提问的特征，而低素养学生则依赖直接生成指令，为数据驱动的素养评估和实时干预提供了新路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前GenAI素养评估多依赖自我报告量表，缺乏对素养在实际学习过程中如何体现的深入理解，亟需通过过程性数据弥补这一差距。

Method: 收集162名大学生在GenAI辅助摘要写作任务中的交互日志，采用 epistemic network analysis（ENA）对具有不同GenAI素养水平学生的提问策略进行建模与比较。

Result: 高素养学生表现出迭代优化和策略性提问的交互特征，而低素养学生则倾向于使用直接的生成指令。

Conclusion: 过程数据能够有效表征GenAI素养，为数据驱动的素养评估和实时干预奠定基础。

Abstract: As Generative AI (GenAI) becomes integral to education, fostering GenAI literacy is critical. However, current assessments largely rely on self-reported scales, lacking insights into how literacy manifests in actual learning processes. This study leverages Learning Analytics (LA) to bridge this gap. We collected interaction logs from 162 university students engaged in a GenAI-assisted abstract writing task. Using Epistemic Network Analysis (ENA), we modeled and compared the questioning strategies of students with varying GenAI literacy levels. Preliminary results reveal distinct interaction signatures: high-literacy students engage in iterative refinement and strategic questioning, while low-literacy students rely on direct generation commands. This work contributes to the workshop by demonstrating how process data can characterize GenAI literacy, paving the way for data-driven literacy assessment and real-time interventions.

</details>


### [496] [Improving Hospital Process Management through Process Mining: A Case Study on COVID-19 Clinical Pathways](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00041)
*Pasquale Ardimento,Mario Luca Bernardi,Marta Cimitile,Samuele Latorre*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究利用COVID数据共享学习数据集，通过构建透明可复现的管道将异构临床数据转换为事件日志，应用过程挖掘技术分析COVID-19护理路径，揭示了住院护理的监测主干、急诊-入院接口的变异性以及年龄和ICU暴露驱动的结局差异，为分诊标准化、容量规划和ICU降级协调提供支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用过程挖掘技术从异构临床数据中提取COVID-19护理路径模式，支持循证医院治理。

Method: 构建透明可复现的数据管道，将异构临床表转换为过程挖掘就绪的事件日志，应用发现、声明性合规检查和结局分析技术。

Result: 重建的护理路径突出了住院护理的监测主干、急诊-入院接口的变异性，以及由年龄和ICU暴露驱动的结局差异。

Conclusion: 过程挖掘能够为分诊标准化、容量规划和ICU到低 acuity 病房的降级协调提供信息支撑，促进循证医院治理。

Abstract: This study analyzes COVID-19 care pathways using the COVID Data for Shared Learning dataset. We build a transparent, reproducible pipeline that transforms heterogeneous clinical tables into a process-mining-ready event log and applies discovery, declarative conformance checking, and outcome analysis. The reconstructed pathways highlight the monitoring backbone of inpatient care, variability at the Emergency department-admission interface, and outcome differences driven by age and exposure to intensive care units. These insights support triage standardization, capacity planning, and step-down coordination from intensive care units to lower-acuity wards, showing how process mining can inform evidence-based hospital governance.

</details>


### [497] [TransResAI: A Compound AI System for Coastal Transportation Resilience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00042)
*Qingwen Pu,Kun Xie,Chenyu Yan*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出TransResAI，一种基于复合AI架构的交通基础设施抗洪韧性分析系统，通过自然语言交互实现洪水感知的交通韧性分析。该系统集成本地可部署的大语言模型、任务分解、安全代码生成、地理空间分析、检索增强生成和交互式地图渲染等模块，连接MATSim洪水场景模拟、OpenStreetMap洪水风险网络、公平性人口统计指标及区域文档。专家用户研究表明，与传统GIS工作流相比，TransResAI将分析任务完成时间减少80-88%（从平均197.1秒降至29.7秒，可视化任务从364.0秒降至46.1秒），同时保持平均准确率4.60/5.00，任务完成率超过94%。研究表明复合AI架构能够弥合通用语言模型与专业领域知识及基础设施韧性所需定量严谨性之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 沿海洪水日益威胁交通基础设施，但韧性管理所需的分析工具对非专业从业者而言仍然难以使用，亟需更易用、更快速的分析工具来支持决策。

Method: 提出TransResAI复合AI系统，集成本地部署的LLM、任务分解模块、安全代码生成、地理空间分析、检索增强生成和交互式地图渲染，连接MATSim洪水场景模拟、OSM洪水风险网络、公平性人口统计指标和区域文档，通过自然语言交互实现分析。

Result: 专家用户研究显示：分析任务完成时间从197.1秒降至29.7秒（减少80-88%），可视化任务从364.0秒降至46.1秒；平均准确率4.60/5.00；任务完成率超过94%。

Conclusion: 复合AI架构能够弥合通用语言模型与专业领域知识及基础设施韧性所需定量严谨性之间的差距，为交通机构和社区提供更快、更易访问的分析工具，以应对日益增长的气候不确定性。

Abstract: Coastal flooding increasingly threatens transportation infrastructure, yet the analytical tools needed for resilience management remain difficult for many non-specialist practitioners to use. This study presents TransResAI, a compound AI system that supports analysis of flood-aware transportation resilience via natural-language interactions. The system integrates a locally deployable Large Language Model (LLM) with modules for task decomposition, secure code generation, geospatial analysis, retrieval-augmented generation, and interactive map rendering. TransResAI links MATSim flood-scenario simulation outputs, OpenStreetMap-derived flood-risk networks, equity-focused demographic indicators, and regional documents in Hampton Roads, Virginia. A structured user study with domain experts demonstrated that TransResAI reduced task completion time by 80-88% relative to conventional GIS workflows, compressing analytical tasks from a mean of 197.1 seconds to 29.7 seconds and visualization tasks from 364.0 seconds to 46.1 seconds, while maintaining mean accuracy of 4.60/5.00 and task completion rates exceeding 94%. These findings demonstrate that compound AI architectures bridge the gap between general-purpose language models and specialized domain knowledge, as well as the quantitative rigor required for infrastructure resilience, providing transportation agencies and communities with faster, more accessible analytical tools for decision-making under growing climate uncertainty.

</details>


### [498] [Fake Plastic Voters: When Political Parties Can Use AI-Simulated Focus Groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00043)
*Claudio Novelli,Javier Argota Sanchez-Vaquerizo,Jennifer Cyr,Giuliano Formisano,Simon McDougall,Giulia Sandri,Luciano Floridi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文针对AI增强模拟技术（AESTs）在政治竞选焦点小组研究中的应用，开发了一个三维决策矩阵（战略目的、部署风险、经验基础），指出AESTs无法替代人类互动进行模式1研究（政治意义与身份认同的涌现观察），在模式2（竞选信息测试与优化）中适用性取决于风险水平和经验基础，并警示常规依赖AESTs可能侵蚀质性研究的判断力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 政治组织需要高效、低成本地理解选民，AI模拟焦点小组虽能大幅节省时间和成本，但其适用边界与风险尚不明确，因此亟需建立系统的决策框架来指导竞选研究者何时以及如何使用这类模拟技术。

Method: 本文构建了一个三维决策矩阵，三个维度分别是：战略目的（模式1：观察意义与身份涌现；模式2：测试与优化竞选信息）、部署风险、模拟工具的经验基础。通过分析已知失效模式（谄媚、角色漂移、少数观点压制），评估AESTs在不同维度的组合下的适用性。
