Result: 1) AESTs在任何风险水平下均无法替代人类互动进行模式1研究；2) 在模式2中，适用性取决于部署风险和经验基础的综合评估；3) 即便在模式2中适用，常规依赖AESTs可能侵蚀质性研究的专业判断力。

Conclusion: AI模拟焦点小组在竞选研究中的应用存在根本性局限，尤其无法替代人类互动来观察政治意义的涌现过程；研究者应依据三维决策矩阵审慎选择技术，并在必要时升级为混合或完全人工的焦点小组。

Abstract: Political parties strive to understand their electorates, and focus groups are a vital tool in these efforts. AI-enhanced simulation technologies (AESTs) enable synthetic focus groups in a fraction of the time (and cost), raising the question of when and how such simulated evidence can be used in campaign research. This paper develops a decision matrix to help party strategists match research needs to appropriate simulation technologies and to identify when to escalate to hybrid or fully human focus groups. The matrix combines three dimensions: strategic purpose, deployment risk, and empirical grounding of the simulation tool. Strategic purpose is the decisive dimension, as it determines what kind of evidence the focus group is meant to produce: observing how political meanings and identities emerge through interaction (Mode 1) or testing and refining campaign messages (Mode 2). The matrix shows that, given documented failure modes such as sycophancy, persona drift, and the suppression of minority viewpoints, AESTs cannot replace human interaction in Mode 1 at any risk level. Within Mode 2, suitability depends instead on deployment risk and on the empirical grounding. Yet even here, we caution that routine reliance on AESTs may erode the qualitative craft on which sound judgment depends.

</details>


### [499] [Algorithmic Authority and the Clinical Standard of Care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00044)
*Aizierjiang Aiersilan*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨AI融入临床医学引发的算法概率推理与专家直觉间的张力，运用Lessig的"代码即法律"框架论证临床AI架构已成为事实上的医疗监管；将AI"幻觉"类比于人类的认知偏差，提出将AI-医生联合体视为单一诊断责任主体的辩证性注意标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示AI系统融入临床医学时，算法概率推理与医生经验直觉之间的根本性张力，以及AI系统架构已实际发挥医疗监管功能这一被忽视的现象。

Method: 运用Lessig的"代码即法律"理论框架，将AI"幻觉"与人类的确认偏误、过早诊断闭合等认知失败进行结构类比分析。

Result: 指出AI与人类的两种失败模式需要统一的治理回应，而非分别处理。

Conclusion: 提出将AI-医生联合体视为单一责任诊断实体的辩证性注意标准，要求算法精确性与人类解释权威在数据治理和隐私保护框架下实现综合。

Abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence into clinical medicine creates a fundamental tension between algorithmic probabilistic reasoning and the experiential intuition of expert physicians; applying Lawrence Lessig's \enquote{Code is Law} framework, I argue that the architecture of clinical AI systems already functions as de facto medical regulation, reshaping liability and the standard of care. Reframing AI \enquote{hallucination} as structurally analogous to well-documented human cognitive failures such as confirmation bias and premature diagnostic closure, I show that both failure modes demand a unified governance response. I therefore propose a dialectical standard of care that treats the integrated AI-physician dyad as the singular responsible diagnostic entity, mandating the synthesis of algorithmic precision with human interpretive authority within robust data governance and patient privacy frameworks.

</details>


### [500] [Comprehensive AI governance requires addressing non-model gains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00047)
*Arthur Goemans,Dan Altman,Noemi Dreksler,Jonas Freund,Milan Gandhi,Zhengdong Wang,Sarah Cogan,Sebastien Krier,Demetra Brady,Lewis Ho,Allan Dafoe*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文论证了前沿AI治理中仅关注模型层面的治理范式存在不足，因为能力进步越来越多地由“非模型增益”（如推理计算扩展、后训练增强、受限制资产）驱动，并提出了超越模型层面的治理框架（系统、实体、智能体、云治理），强调社会韧性的重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI治理过于聚焦模型层面（预训练阶段的算力和数据），忽视了能力进步中独立于基础模型改进的“非模型增益”带来的治理挑战。

Method: 形式化定义了“非模型增益”概念，提出了三种能力增益向量的分类法（推理增益、系统增益、资产增益），并结合具体案例分析了这些向量如何削弱依赖预部署评估的风险管理策略。

Result: 识别出非模型增益（推理、系统、资产增益）以及具身化、持续学习、AI扩散等未来影响可能削弱基于预部署评估的风险管理；提出了系统治理、实体治理、智能体治理、云治理等超越模型层面的治理框架。

Conclusion: 需要超越模型层面的治理，并强调社会韧性作为各治理层的补充。

Abstract: Frontier AI governance often centres on the model-level governance paradigm, which assumes that a model's capability profile is primarily a function of the compute and data used during training. This position paper argues that model-level governance becomes less effective when capability progress is increasingly driven by "non-model gains"--improvements that are independent from advances in the base model. We formalise the concept of non-model gains and provide a taxonomy of three distinct vectors of capability gain: inference gain (scaling compute at test-time), systems gain (post-training enhancements such as scaffolds), and asset gain (enhancing a model with restricted assets). We demonstrate how these vectors--alongside potential future impacts from embodiment, continual learning, and AI diffusion--may undermine risk management strategies that hinge mostly on pre-deployment evaluation and mitigation. We provide an overview of governance approaches that go beyond the model level: system, entity, agent, and cloud governance. Finally, we emphasise the importance of societal resilience as a complement to these governance layers.

</details>


### [501] [Measuring and Mitigating Bias in Code Generated by Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00049)
*Yuxi Chen,Yutian Tang,Timothy Storer*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出评估框架，对GPT-4o和Gemini在代码生成中的偏差进行量化分析，发现即使采用Few-Shot、Chain-of-Thought等轻量级缓解策略，偏差仍然普遍存在。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在代码生成任务中广泛应用，但其输出存在偏差问题尚未得到充分研究，尤其缺乏针对代码生成场景的系统性偏差评估框架。

Method: 提出两个量化指标：代码偏差分数(CBS)衡量偏差普遍性，属性变化比率(ACR)衡量不同属性的影响程度；评估四种缓解策略（Few-Shot、Chain-of-Thought、Few-Shot Chain-of-Thought、Multi-agent）的效果。

Result: 不同保护属性和数据集上偏差依然普遍存在，现有轻量级缓解策略无法有效消除偏差。

Conclusion: 当前AI代码生成系统中的偏差问题严峻，需要开发更有效的偏差缓解方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely recognised for their applications in natural language generation and are increasingly used for code generation tasks. However, concerns about bias in their generated outputs remain significant. This paper focuses on GPT-4o and Gemini, mainstream tools for code generation, and proposes a framework for evaluating bias in LLM-generated code, specifically examining the influence of protected attributes, prompts and web-search capability. We use two metrics: the code bias score (CBS) and the attribute change ratio (ACR), to quantify the prevalence of bias and the degree of influence of different attributes, respectively. In addition, we investigate four lightweight mitigation strategies: Few-Shot, Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot Chain-of-Thought, and Multi-agent, aimed at mitigating bias in generated code. Our findings reveal that bias remains prevalent across different protected attributes and datasets even after applying mitigation strategies, highlighting the need for more effective approaches to reduce bias in AI-driven code generation systems.

</details>


### [502] [Business Utility of Large Language Models as Exploratory Data Analysis Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00051)
*Rafał Łabędzki,Patryk Miziuła,Hubert Rutkowski,Szymon Betlewski,Cezary Depta,Szymon Janowski,Jarosław Kochanowicz,Jan Kanty Milczek*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文评估了大语言模型作为商业探索性数据分析代理的可靠性，发现大多数配置（即使平均表现尚可）因重复性不足而无法自主使用。GPT-5.4（高推理努力）表现最佳，平均Jaccard指数0.8748、Business utility 0.6952。研究提出应将平均质量、可重复性和条件敏感性作为EDA代理操作可信度的互补评估维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于分析工作流，但其作为商业探索性数据分析(EDA)代理的适用性仍不确定。可部署的EDA代理不仅需要提供有用的平均性能，还需要足够的可重复性来支持对其输出的信任。

Method: 在基于代理的供应链模拟基准上，评估15种模型-变体配置（来自8个模型家族）在四种实验条件下的表现（改变数据表示、提示清晰度和信号强度），每种条件5条轨迹。使用Jaccard指数评分，并通过结合均值分数、变异系数、探索性交叉条件显著性检验以及提出的Business utility（风险调整指标）框架进行评估。

Result: 大多数配置不足以自主用于EDA。GPT-5.4（超高推理努力）表现最佳：实验平均ms=0.8748，实验平均Business utility=0.6952。次优配置在变异折扣后损失显著更多效用。

Conclusion: 评估EDA代理应将平均质量、可重复性和条件敏感性视为操作可信度的互补维度。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in analytical workflows, but their suitability as exploratory data analysis (EDA) agents in business settings remains uncertain. In practice, a deployable EDA agent must provide not only useful average performance but also sufficient repeatability to support trust in its outputs. We evaluate this requirement in a controlled, business-relevant benchmark built on an agent-based supply chain simulation. The task is to identify supplier-product combinations responsible for low quality and downstream sales loss by reasoning from indirect operational traces rather than from explicit labels. Fifteen model-variant configurations from eight model families were evaluated under four experimental conditions that varied data representation, prompt clarity, and signal strength, with five trajectories per condition. Outputs were scored against deterministic ground truth using the Jaccard index and assessed through a framework that combines mean score (ms), coefficient of variation (CV), exploratory cross-condition significance tests, and Business utility, a risk-adjusted metric that we propose to summarise quality and repeatability in a single operational measure. The results show that most configurations are not reliable enough for autonomous EDA use, even when their average scores appear acceptable. GPT-5.4 with extra-high reasoning effort achieved the strongest overall profile, with an experiment-averaged ms of 0.8748 and an experiment-averaged Business utility of 0.6952, while the next-best configurations lost substantially more utility after variability discounting. Our findings suggest that evaluation of EDA agents should treat average quality, repeatability, and condition sensitivity as complementary dimensions of operational trustworthiness.

</details>


### [503] [Student Competency Assessment and Presentation Methods Based on Algorithm Courses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00200)
*Yingqi Zhang,Ninghan Zheng,Shanshan Li,Weidong Liu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该研究基于CC2020能力模型，通过分析169名学生的编程实验和书面作业数据，运用马尔可夫过程建模、多方法量化能力（知识、技能、态度）以及主动性指标评估课程难度，构建了一个可扩展的算法课程能力评估框架，为个性化教学和课程优化提供了可行方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 弥合学术训练与行业需求之间的差距，推动能力本位教育在计算机科学中的发展，需要建立一个综合评估知识、技能和态度的框架。

Method: 收集169名学生的编程实验和书面作业数据，适配xAPI规范；使用马尔可夫过程建模分析行为序列；多方法量化知识、技能、态度能力；基于提交及时性的主动性指标量化课程难度；识别学生聚类。

Result: 揭示了编程任务中的认知模式；识别出不同的学生能力聚类；通过主动性指标量化了课程实验难度。

Conclusion: 贡献了一个可扩展的算法课程能力评估框架，支持教师根据学生聚类实施个性化干预和优化任务难度；未来将整合更多学生数据以验证能力模型，并扩展到更广泛的计算机科学课程。

Abstract: This full research paper describes the assessment and presentation of student competencies in algorithm courses, grounded in the CC2020 competency model. With the growing emphasis on bridging the gap between academic training and industry demands, competency-based education, which integrates knowledge, skills, and dispositions, has become pivotal in computer science education. To bridge the gap, we need to develop a comprehensive framework to evaluate competencies (knowledge, skills, and dispositions) in computer science education.
  The research aims to analyze learning behavior patterns, design methods for competency assessment in algorithm courses, and evaluate the difficulty of course experiments to inform curriculum design. We collected programming experiment and written assignment data from 169 students, adapting it to the xAPI specification for unified analysis. In this work, Markov process modeling was employed to analyze behavioral sequences, revealing cognitive patterns during programming tasks. Multiple methods were applied to quantify competencies (knowledge, skills, dispositions) and identify distinct student clusters. Course difficulty was quantified using proactiveness metrics derived from submission timeliness.
  This work contributes a scalable framework for competency assessment in algorithm courses and offers actionable insights for personalized teaching and curriculum optimization. Practically, it enables instructors to tailor interventions based on student clusters and optimize task difficulty. Future work will integrate more students' performance to validate competency models and extend the framework to broader computer science curricula.

</details>


### [504] [Next-Billion AI Index: The compass for AI utility and adoption in the global majority](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00359)
*Ambrish Rawat,Jessica He,Subhabrata Majumdar,Claudio Pinhanez,Yann Le Beux,Satyapriya Krishna,Rahul Gupta,Rumman Chowdhury,Kush R. Varshney*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出Next Billion AI Index (nexbax)，这是首个将经济可行性、运营可部署性和治理对齐视为同等重要因素的诊断框架，用于评估生成式AI在下一十亿用户场景中的实用性，并通过10个维度和专家访谈验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式AI评估过度依赖前沿能力基准，未能有效衡量系统在本地化、基础设施受限环境中的可持续部署、适应性和可信度，缺乏针对下一十亿用户场景的实用性评估框架。

Method: 提出nexbax框架，将经济可行性、运营可部署性和治理对齐作为三个主题，细化为10个维度，并配套弱、中、强三级评分标准；通过11位下一十亿市场从业者的半结构化访谈进行形成性专家评估。

Result: 专家认为该框架有助于推理采用权衡，能有效捕捉影响AI实际采用的关键因素（成本、可用性、可靠性、信任），同时指出需要上下文解释、领域特定证据和更广泛利益相关者验证。

Conclusion: Nexbax不是普遍的社会价值评分，而是一种诊断工具，用于揭示使包容性AI部署更可行的技术、经济和治理属性，目标是有用的人工智能（artificial useful intelligence）而非通用人工智能。

Abstract: Generative AI assessments remain dominated by frontier capability benchmarks that often fail to capture whether systems can be sustainably deployed, adapted, and trusted in locally grounded and infrastructure-constrained settings. This paper introduces the Next Billion AI Index (nexbax), which we believe is the first diagnostic framework to treat economic viability, operational deployability, and governance alignment as co-equal determinants of AI utility in next-billion-user contexts. Rather than treating usefulness as a single outcome, nexbax operationalizes the preconditions for useful AI through 10 dimensions organized under three themes: Effective Efficiency, Operational Practicality, and Societal Integrity. These dimensions assess whether systems are economically viable, deployable under infrastructure and workflow constraints, and aligned with local needs, user expectations, and collaborative development practices. We pair the framework with rubrics for weak, moderate, and strong performance, and conduct a formative expert evaluation through eleven semi-structured interviews with founders, developers, product leaders, and technical practitioners building AI systems for next-billion markets. Participants found the index useful for reasoning about adoption trade-offs and effective at capturing factors shaping real-world AI uptake -- particularly cost, usability, reliability, and trust. They also identified the need for contextual explanations, domain-specific evidence, and broader stakeholder validation. Nexbax is therefore proposed not as a universal score of social value, but as a diagnostic for artificial useful intelligence: a way to make visible the technical, economic, and governance properties that make inclusive AI deployment more viable.

</details>


### [505] [Quantifying the Salience of Geo-Cultural Values for Pluralistic Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00369)
*Arkadiy Saakyan,Charvi Rastogi,Lora Aroyo*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过元分析发现，AI安全评估数据集普遍缺乏地理文化信息，且文化区域归属对安全评分的解释力显著高于标准人口统计变量。约10%的测试项因缺乏文化代表性可能被误分类为安全，而当前LLM无法可靠替代人类评分者，但可辅助筛选文化敏感项。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI模型的全球安全部署需要与跨文化的人类价值观对齐，但现有安全评估数据集的评分者群体在地理文化上高度同质化，且不清楚在控制人口统计变量后文化差异是否仍然存在。

Method: 对安全数据集进行元分析，使用Inglehart-Welzel跨文化变异维度，通过多层次模型分析文化区域归属对安全评分的影响，并评估LLM作为评分替代和分类工具的表现。

Result: 多数数据集未报告地理文化信息；文化区域归属对安全评分的解释力显著高于年龄、性别、种族等人口统计变量（p<0.05）；约10%的测试项存在文化敏感性；当前LLM无法可靠替代人类评分者，但可辅助筛选文化敏感项。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持构建更具文化多元性的安全评估体系，并提供了可行的实践建议。

Abstract: Safe global deployment of AI models requires alignment with human values that vary across cultures. Yet rater pools in safety evaluation datasets remain largely geographically homogeneous, failing to capture geo-cultural differences. Further, it remains unclear whether such differences persist after controlling for demographics such as age, gender, and ethnicity. Through a meta-analysis of safety datasets, we find that most do not report geo-cultural information, and those that do lack a unified methodology to jointly analyze geo-cultural and demographic correlates. Using the Inglehart-Welzel dimensions of cross-cultural variation, we demonstrate via multilevel modeling that cultural zone membership explains variance in safety ratings beyond standard demographics (p<0.05 across 6 datasets). Moreover, our analysis indicates that roughly 10% of items in the datasets we examined are culturally sensitive: likely to be misclassified as safe without adequate cultural representation. We evaluate LLMs as both rater surrogates and triage tools, finding that current LLMs do not reliably stand in for raters, though they can help prioritize culturally sensitive items for human annotation. Our findings motivate more culturally pluralistic safety evaluation and offer practical takeaways to support it.

</details>


### [506] [Toward Agentic Governance: What Shapes LLM-Agent Intervention in Public Forums?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00603)
*Luyang Zhang,Yi-Yun Chu,Ramayya Krishnan*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: LLM智能体在论坛审核工作流中存在行为不一致问题，四种部署选择（模型版本、权重开放状态、服务提供商、系统提示策略）各自独立影响其响应率，且权重开放状态与可见/隐藏挑战的拒绝倾向相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体被越来越多地用于公共论坛审核，但其对相同内容返回不同响应，导致基于行为进行防御不可靠，需要揭示这种变异的来源。

Method: 通过系统性地改变四种部署选择（模型版本、权重开放状态、服务提供商、系统提示策略），在开放权重和封闭权重模型家族中进行对比实验，分析不同条件下智能体对可见与隐藏挑战的响应差异。

Result: 四种部署选择各自独立且显著地改变智能体的响应率；封闭权重模型对可见挑战的拒绝率高于隐藏挑战，而开放权重模型则相反或无明显差异；这种差异与开放/封闭权重边界强相关，而非访问界面。

Conclusion: 可审计的论坛智能体治理需要关注所有四种部署选择，而非仅模型名称，因为每个因素都独立地改变行为。

Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used in moderation-relevant public forum workflows, where their choices to answer, acknowledge, repair, or decline are routinely challenged by users, platforms, and regulators. The same agent often returns different responses on identical content, so any defense based on the agent's behavior cannot be reliably reproduced. The variation is structural. Four deployment choices typically invisible to the operator each shift the agent's response rate, and their combinations can produce substantially different interventions on the same forum posts. The four choices are (1) which model version is currently served, which can change between calls without notice; (2) the model's weight-release status (open-weight, with weights publicly downloadable, vs. closed-weight, with weights held by the provider); (3) which provider serves the request; and (4) which system-prompt policy is in force. Across LLMs spanning both open-weight and closed-weight families, we find that the previously reported tendency to decline more on visible than hidden challenges aligns with the open/closed weight boundary in our panel more than with access surface. Every closed-weight cell declines more on visible challenges; every open-weight cell reverses this or shows no gap. Auditable forum-agent governance requires awareness of all four choices, not just the model name, since each independently shifts behavior.

</details>


### [507] [Global Patterns in Student Stress and Academic Performance: A Machine Learning Study Using PISA 2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00791)
*Ani Ghazanchyan,Sachin Kumar*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文利用机器学习分析PISA 2022数据集，研究六大洲学生压力相关因素（如焦虑、自信心、归属感等）对学业表现的影响，发现压力对成绩的负面影响在全球范围内具有一致性，非洲虽因数据缺失和教育水平较低成为例外，但仍呈现相同趋势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证压力相关因素对学生成绩的影响是否在全球范围内存在一致的模式，将已有发现进行泛化推广。

Method: 采用机器学习方法分析PISA 2022大规模数据集，按六大洲划分六个案例研究，对各地区进行手动特征工程，并训练相同的基线模型以确保公平比较。

Result: 压力对学业表现的负面影响在所有大洲均一致存在；非洲因教育水平低、幸福感低及缺失数据多而成为离群点，但负相关关系依然可观察。

Conclusion: 压力对学生成绩的负面影响具有全球一致性，尽管存在误差（部分由于压力并非唯一影响因素），整体模式清晰明确。

Abstract: Machine learning was applied to examine whether stress-related factors influence student performance in a consistent way across the world. The main goal of this project is to confirm or reject the existence of a similar global pattern by generalizing the findings that already exist in this field. We focused on various psychological indicators such as anxiety score, test anxiety, math anxiety, math confidence, wellbeing, and sense of belonging, along with several non-psychological factors for context. Machine learning was chosen due to the extremely large size of the PISA 2022 dataset and its ability to capture complex relationships that simpler methods may overlook. The analysis was conducted across six continents by splitting the dataset into six separate case studies. Feature engineering was performed manually for each region, while the same baseline models were trained to ensure a fair comparison. The results show that the negative effect of stress on performance is present and fairly consistent across all continents. Although some error remains, partly because stress is not the only factor shaping academic outcomes, the overall pattern is clear. Africa stood out as an outlier due to lower average educational and wellbeing levels and a higher proportion of missing data, yet even there the negative relationship remained observable.

</details>


### [508] [Prompts for Public-Sector LLMs Should Be Governed as Commons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00873)
*Rashid Mushkani*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出，在公共部门部署大语言模型时使用的提示词应被视为受治理的工件，而非私有的临时输入。提示词编码了角色指令、决策框架和价值主张；即使模型权重和输入记录固定，提示词的选择也会实质性改变输出。现有治理工具很少使部署中的本地提示词集合透明、可争议或可审计。作者提出Prompt Commons：一个版本化、社区维护的提示词模板库，包含来源元数据、许可和审核日志。通过北美某大城市的试点数据集（443条人工提示词，增强后3,317条），展示了三种治理状态（开放、策展、可否决）和一种面向协商的集成方法（聚合利益相关者提示词为折衷建议）。最后给出可证伪的推论和提示层治理的评估议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM在公共部门部署中，提示词作为影响模型输出的关键因素却缺乏透明性、可审计性和可争议性，现有的模型文档、组织策略和对齐方法均未覆盖这一层面，亟需建立提示词层的治理机制。

Method: 提出Prompt Commons框架——一个版本化、社区维护的提示词模板仓库，包含来源元数据、许可信息和审核日志；通过北美某大城市社区合作的试点数据集进行实验；设计了三种治理状态（开放、策展、可否决）和一种协商导向的集成方法（聚合多方利益相关者提示词生成折衷建议）。

Result: 基于443条原始人工提示词（增强后3,317条）的试点数据集，展示了三种治理状态和协商集成方法的可行性。

Conclusion: 提示词应被视为公共治理工件而非私有输入；提示层治理需要独立的透明性、可争议性和可审计性机制；未来需通过可证伪的推论和评估议程来验证该框架的有效性。

Abstract: This paper argues that prompts used to deploy large language models (LLMs) in public-sector settings should be treated as governed artefacts rather than private, transient inputs. Prompts encode role instructions, decision framings, and value claims; prompt choice can materially shift outputs even when model weights and input records are held fixed. Existing governance tools, including model and dataset documentation, organisation-level policies, and post-training alignment, rarely make the local prompt collections used in deployment transparent, contestable, or auditable. We propose Prompt Commons: a versioned, community-maintained repository of prompt templates with provenance metadata, licensing, and moderation logs. Using a pilot dataset collected with community partners in a large North American city (443 human prompts; 3,317 after augmentation), we illustrate three governance states (open, curated, veto-enabled) and a negotiation-oriented ensemble method that aggregates stakeholder prompts into compromise recommendations. We close with falsifiable implications and an evaluation agenda for prompt-layer governance.

</details>


### [509] [ASE-26: a curriculum for agentic software engineering as a discipline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01152)
*Mikael Gorsky*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出ASE-26，一个面向智能体软件工程的本科课程体系，旨在通过结构化实践训练弥补当前行业缺乏的工程师技能，而非依赖更强大的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件工程师的工作正从编写代码转向引导AI智能体，但行业缺乏结构化实践技能。现有文献表明，缺失的能力不是更好的模型，而是学科化的从业者纪律。

Method: 提出ASE-26课程，包含学科框架、概念贡献（意图与构建共同进化的进化螺旋）、21个模块的教学结构、与智能体共同产出工作的教学承诺，以及超越当前模型局限性的设计原则。

Result: 课程已存档于Zenodo（CC BY-ND 4.0），包含完整的学科框架、教学结构和毕业生能力画像。

Conclusion: 行业缺乏的恰恰是这一学科所定义的从业者技能，结构化的本科课程是弥合这一差距的主要机制。

Abstract: The work of a professional software engineer has begun to consist, increasingly, of directing agents rather than writing code, and the empirical evidence for the shift is now several years deep. Anthropic's Economic Index puts automation at 79 per cent of Claude Code interactions [2]; Handa and colleagues at Anthropic find AI exposure for Computer Programmer tasks at approximately 75 per cent of the role's distinct activities [3]; Brynjolfsson and colleagues at Stanford's Digital Economy Lab report a 13 per cent relative decline in employment for workers aged 22 to 25 in occupations most exposed to AI [4]. The shift is also unfinished, and the academic literature on agentic software engineering converges on the finding that the missing capability is not better models but structured practitioner discipline. This paper presents ASE-26, a comprehensive undergraduate curriculum for agentic software engineering as a discipline, deposited as a citable reference on Zenodo under CC BY-ND 4.0 [12]. The paper sets out the discipline framing the curriculum rests on, the conceptual contributions it makes (most importantly, the evolutionary spiral as the operational form of the co-evolution of intent and build), the twenty-one-module structure that organises the discipline for teaching, the pedagogical commitments that follow from grading work co-produced with an agent, what graduates leave with, and how the discipline as taught is designed to outlast the specific capabilities of today's models. The position the paper takes is that the practitioner skills the industry currently lacks are precisely the skills the discipline names, and that structured undergraduate curricula in agentic software engineering are the principal mechanism by which the gap closes.

</details>


### [510] [AI From the Margins (AIM): Rethinking Participatory AI Design Through the Lived Experience of Minoritized Communities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01171)
*Tijs Portegies,Laureanne Willems,Maaike Harbers,Giovanni Sileno,Roland van Dierendonck,Mayesha Tasnim,Lotte Willemsen,Sennay Ghebreab*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出"来自边缘的AI"（AIM）方法论立场，阐明如何激发、聚焦并传递边缘化社区的生活经验以指导参与式AI设计。在荷兰医疗场景中与13名有色人种女性和非二元性别者及5名政策工作者进行8次实践，通过叙事激发、共同制定规则、参与者自主决定AI介入方式以及将生活经验转化为AI政策对话，展示了基于生活经验的预备导向如何塑造参与式AI设计的目的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参与式AI通常是在问题定义和成功标准设定后才开始，边缘化群体几乎没有机会重新塑造AI系统的目的。现有方法未能充分让边缘化社区的生活经验从源头影响AI设计。

Method: 提出AIM方法论立场（非固定协议，而是一套可通过不同技术实现的前提条件），并在荷兰医疗场景中通过8次实践（13名有色人种女性和非二元性别者、5名市政政策工作者）实施四种技术：（1）使用BNIM进行叙事激发；（2）共同制定规则；（3）参与者自主决定AI是否、何处及如何介入；（4）通过与政策制定者对话将生活经验转化为AI政策。

Result: 参与者在反思中描述这种参与是实质性的，并呼吁继续开展，表明基于生活经验的预备导向能够塑造参与式AI设计的目的。

Conclusion: AIM方法通过让边缘化社区的生活经验在AI设计之初就发挥核心作用，而非在问题已被框定后才参与，能够更根本地重塑参与式AI的方向和目的。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) can reproduce and amplify the structural inequities faced by minoritized communities. Participatory AI has been proposed as a response, but participation typically starts after problem definitions and success criteria have been set, leaving limited room for minoritized communities to reshape what an AI system is for. We propose AI From the Margins (AIM): a methodological stance that articulates the conditions under which lived experiences of minoritized communities can be elicited, centered, and carried forward to inform participatory AI design. AIM is not a fixed protocol; it articulates a set of preconditions that can be enacted through different techniques in different settings. We applied AIM in a Dutch healthcare context in eight sessions with 13 women and non-binary people of color and five municipal policy workers, namely through (1) narrative elicitation using the Biographic Narrative Interpretive Method (BNIM); (2) co-constructed rule-making; (3) participants' determination of whether, where, and how AI should be involved; and (4) translating lived experience into AI policy through dialogue with policymakers. In their reflections on the sessions, participants described the engagement as substantive and called for its continuation, demonstrating how preparatory orientation fundamentally grounded in lived experience shapes what participatory AI design is for.

</details>


### [511] [Institutional Trust and the Domestic AI Advantage: Evidence from DeepSeek and ChatGPT Users in China](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01228)
*Jiashen Huang,Yu Jia,Xu Pan*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究提出"制度棱镜"框架，通过对405名中国用户的调查，发现制度信任正向影响用户对国产大语言模型（DeepSeek）的情感信任和认知评价，而在制度信任较低时，国产模型优势减弱，揭示了制度信任是AI信任形成的核心维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究忽视宏观结构性力量对AI信任差异的影响，作者旨在从制度层面解释生成式AI信任在不同国家背景下的分化现象。

Method: 基于认知-情感信任理论，提出"制度棱镜"框架，收集405名中国用户的调查数据，分析制度信任与用户对国内（DeepSeek）和全球（ChatGPT）大语言模型信任之间的关系。

Result: 制度信任越高，用户对国内AI模型的情感信任越强，认知评价也越有利；制度信任较低时，国内模型优势减弱。

Conclusion: 制度信任已成为AI信任形成的核心维度，将微观心理判断与宏观治理联系起来，为人机传播提供了新视角。

Abstract: Public trust in generative artificial intelligence exhibits increasingly divergent patterns across national contexts, yet prevailing research largely overlooks the macro-structural forces underlying this divergence. This study argues that trust in AI is not merely a technical response to performance but a product of institutional refraction. We propose an ``Institutional Prism'' framework to demonstrate how institutional trust shapes user trust in domestic (DeepSeek) and global (ChatGPT) large language models. Drawing on Cognitive-Affective Trust Theory, we distinguish between cognitive and affective dimensions of trust and analyze survey data from 405 Chinese users. The findings show that higher institutional trust is positively associated with stronger affective trust in domestic AI models and shifts cognitive evaluations in a more favorable direction. While under lower institutional trust, this domestic advantage weakens. These findings reveal that institutional trust has emerged as a core dimension of AI trust formation. By linking micro-level psychological judgments with macro-level governance, this research contributes a new perspective to human-machine communication.

</details>


### [512] [Beyond Access: Guided LLM Scaffolding for Independent Learning in Undergraduate Statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01375)
*Mohammad Amanlou,Yasaman Amou-Jafari,Mehrad Livian,Fatemeh Boloukazari,Fereshte Bagheri,Behnam Bahrak*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过在本科概率与统计课程中开展为期四周的准实验，对比无LLM访问、无限制LLM访问和引导式LLM访问三种条件，发现引导式使用能促进以推理为导向的交互模式，提升无辅助测验表现，而单纯开放LLM访问不足以构成有效的教育干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM正逐步进入学生学习实践，但其教育价值取决于是否支持推理而非仅完成任务。现有研究缺乏对"分配访问权限"与"实际交互质量"之间差距的深入理解，亟需考察如何设计LLM使用方式以促进真正的学习。

Method: 采用四周准实验设计，将学生分为三组：无LLM访问组、无限制LLM访问组、引导式LLM访问组。引导组接受明确培训与规则，强调以推理为导向的求助、逐步提示、验证和伦理使用。所有测验和延迟期末考试均不允许使用LLM，以区分AI辅助练习与独立学习的效果。

Result: 引导式LLM使用比无限制访问展现出更清晰的学习导向交互模式（优先推理而非答案、请求逐步支持）。引导组在干预阶段的无辅助测验表现更强；无限制访问对辅助任务完成更有效，但对独立表现提升不持续。时间测量不支持简单时长解释，引导组的自我评估校准更佳。

Conclusion: LLM访问本身是不完整的教育干预。AIED的核心设计挑战在于构建学生使用LLM的支架，使其成为推理伙伴而非答案获取工具。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly entering students' learning practices, but their educational value depends on whether they support reasoning or enable task completion without engagement. This study examines guided LLM use in an undergraduate Probability and Statistics course, focusing on the gap between assigned access and actual interaction quality. In a four-week quasi-experimental summer program, students were organized into three balanced conditions: no LLM access, unrestricted LLM access, and guided LLM access. The guided condition used the same LLM platform as the unrestricted condition, but students received explicit training and rules promoting reasoning-focused help-seeking, stepwise hints, verification, and ethical use. All quizzes and the delayed final exam were completed without LLM or external assistance, allowing us to distinguish AI-supported practice performance from independent learning. Results show that guided use was associated with clearer learning-oriented interaction patterns than unrestricted access, especially in prioritizing reasoning over final answers and requesting stepwise support. Guided-LLM students showed stronger no-help quiz performance during the intervention phase, whereas unrestricted access appeared more useful for assisted practice completion than for consistently improving independent performance. Available time measures did not support a simple duration-based explanation, and self-assessment calibration suggested better alignment between perceived and demonstrated understanding in the Guided-LLM condition. Overall, LLM access alone appears to be an incomplete educational intervention. For Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED), the central design challenge is to scaffold how students use LLMs so that these systems function as partners in reasoning rather than answer-getting tools.

</details>


### [513] [Engineering Students' Self-Efficacy, Perceptions, and Performance in a Flipped CS1 Course](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01471)
*Griffin Pitts,Ashish Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究调查了工程专业学生在翻转式编程入门课程中，与课程相关的信念（自我效能感、学习态度、感知编程难度）如何影响考试成绩。通过对602名学生的调查和考试数据进行分析，发现自我效能感与成绩正相关，感知难度与成绩负相关，且不同人口学群体在信念上存在差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往关于编程课程学习表现的研究多聚焦于计算机科学专业学生，但如今越来越多的工程等其他专业学生选修编程入门课程，其信念和动机可能与计算机专业学生不同。因此，本研究旨在工程背景的CS1课程中探索学生信念与考试成绩之间的关系。

Method: 对602名工程专业学生的问卷和考试数据进行分析，采用探索性因子分析识别出三个潜在因子（自我效能感、学习态度、感知编程难度），并检验这些信念因子与考试成绩之间的关联，同时考察不同人口学群体间的信念差异。

Result: 自我效能感与考试成绩呈正相关，感知编程难度与考试成绩呈负相关。不同人口学群体在信念上存在差异，但成绩表现相似。

Conclusion: 研究结果与以往研究一致，并进一步拓展了相关发现，强调了自我效能感在编程教育中对学业成就和坚持性的重要作用。

Abstract: This full research paper investigates how engineering students' course-related beliefs relate to exam performance in a flipped introductory programming course. Understanding factors that influence student learning and performance has long been a focus of computing education research. While prior studies have identified psychological and contextually relevant predictors of success, much of this work has examined students majoring in computer science. Yet introductory programming courses now serve many students from other disciplines, whose beliefs and motivations may differ. To examine these relationships in an engineering-focused CS1 context, we analyze survey and exam data from 602 students. An exploratory factor analysis identified three latent factors: self-efficacy, attitudes toward learning, and perceived programming difficulty. Self-efficacy was positively associated with exam performance, while perceived difficulty was negatively associated. Differences in reported beliefs were also observed across demographic groups, even when performance outcomes were similar. These findings align with and extend prior research, highlighting the role of self-efficacy in achievement and persistence in computing education.

</details>


### [514] [An LLM-based Chain-of-Response Counter-Scam System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01475)
*Heedou Kim,Mogan Gim,Donghee Choi,Hoonick Lee,Soonil Bae,Mi-Young Kim,Jaewoo Kang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出Counter Scam，一个基于LLM的多智能体框架，实现从检测到调查的端到端在线诈骗响应。框架包含安全数据指南、CSRA多智能体缓解、CSRT九大NLP任务及CSRD数据集（18.5万诈骗案例）。实验表明，微调小模型在CSRT任务上超越商业模型10%以上，F1提升0.24。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨国网络诈骗快速演化，传统检测速度受限，而LLM在加速整合响应框架中的作用尚未充分探索。

Method: 提出统一LLM多智能体框架Counter Scam，包含：安全数据指南与诈骗特定NER；CSRA多智能体缓解机制；CSRT九角色NLP任务；CSRD大规模数据集（185,300诈骗案例+38,587知识条目）。基于37位利益相关者洞察开发。

Result: 微调小模型在全部CSRT任务上超越商业模型10%以上，诈骗特定NER的F1值提升0.24。

Conclusion: 该框架能够实现快速、协作的在线诈骗缓解，提升跨机构响应效率。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of online scams, driven by transnational networks and mass produced social engineering scenarios, has exposed the speed limitations of conventional detection, necessitating tighter interagency coordination. While LLMs show promise in scam identification, their role in accelerating integrated response frameworks remains underexplored. We propose Counter Scam, a unified LLM based multiagent framework that orchestrates end to end response from initial detection to crime investigation. The framework first proposes safe data guidelines, emphasizing nonpublic scam data and secure dataset construction via scam specific NER. Developed with insights from 37 stakeholders to reduce delays and improve analytical efficiency, the system integrates CSRA for multiagent mitigation, CSRT comprising nine role aligned NLP tasks, and CSRD, a corpus of 185,300 scam cases and 38,587 knowledge entries. Experiments show that fine tuned sLLMs surpass commercial models by more than 10% across all CSRT tasks and achieve a 0.24 F1 improvement in scam specific NER. These results demonstrate the framework's capability to enable rapid and collaborative mitigation of online scams.

</details>


### [515] [The Main Barrier to AI Adoption in the Public Sector is Lack of Training: How a Structured Method Increased Productivity in Two Brazilian Government Cases Without Incidents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01517)
*Vinicius Santana Gomes*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文基于巴西公共服务的两个可审计案例，论证了生成式人工智能在公共部门采用的主要障碍并非技术问题，而是培训问题。作者提出的四层结构化教学法在两个不同机构中应用后，分别实现了平均处理时间下降18.2%和50%、技术报告产量增加92%等可验证指标提升，且未发生信息安全事件或合规挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将公共部门采用生成式人工智能主要视为技术问题，期望随着模型能力提升自然带来生产力增长。作者基于实际案例发现，真正的采用障碍在于培训而非技术，因此需要开发针对性的教学方法。

Method: 采用四层结构化教学法（four-layer structured pedagogical methodology），在巴西联邦区卫生部内部审计办公室（SES/CONT，2024年全年）和联邦区经济发展、劳动与收入部内部控制单元（UCI/SEDET，2025年全年）两个不同机构进行应用，使用免费AI模型，并通过联邦区政府电子信息系统（SEI-GDF）的官方指标进行第三方可验证的效果评估。

Result: SES/CONT平均处理时间下降18.2%；UCI/SEDET平均处理时间下降50%，技术报告产量增加92%，向公共管理者发出288项正式建议，分析案件涉及财务总额1.043亿美元。两个单位均未发生信息安全事件、敏感数据泄露或外部监管机构的合规挑战。

Conclusion: 该方法具有跨机构可移植性，在预算受限条件下（使用免费AI模型）可行，并符合国际及国家数据保护法律与公共行政原则。

Abstract: The adoption of generative artificial intelligence in the public sector has been treated predominantly as a technological problem, with the expectation that productivity gains would follow from the availability of increasingly capable models. This paper argues, drawing on two auditable cases in the Brazilian Public Service, that the determining barrier to adoption observed in these units was not technological but training-related, and describes the four-layer structured pedagogical methodology developed by the author. The method was applied in two units with distinct institutional profiles: the Sectoral Internal Control Office of the Federal District Department of Health (SES/CONT) throughout 2024, and the Internal Control Unit of the Federal District Department of Economic Development, Labor and Income (UCI/SEDET) throughout 2025. In both cases, the official indicators from the Electronic Information System of the Federal District Government (SEI-GDF), verifiable by third parties, recorded substantial gains: average processing time fell by 18.2% at SES/CONT and by 50% at UCI/SEDET, with UCI also recording a 92% increase in technical-report production, the issuance of 288 formal recommendations to public managers, and the analysis of cases totaling USD 104.3 million in financial volume. In neither unit did internal control mechanisms identify any information-security incident, sensitive-data leakage, or formal compliance challenge from external oversight bodies during the period examined. The analysis is consistent with the hypothesis that the method is portable across agencies with distinct mandates, operates within protocols designed to comply with international and national data-protection law and with the principles of public administration, and is accessible to public entities under budget constraints, since it used free AI models.

</details>


### [516] [Question Type, Cognitive Load, and CEFR Alignment: Evaluating LLM-Generated EFL Grammar Drill Exercises](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01592)
*Steve Woollaston,Brendan Flanagan,Yuko Toyokawa,Hiroaki Ogata*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究评估了LLM生成英语作为外语(EFL)学习内容的教学可行性。通过分析日本初中生在语法练习应用上的日志数据，研究了不同题目模态对学生表现的影响，以及CEFR-J难度层级是否能准确预测任务难度。结果表明：多项选择题认知负荷最低，填空任务对主动回忆障碍最大，拖拽练习时间成本最高；学习数据验证了CEFR-J语法框架，准确率随水平提升下降，响应时间增加。LLM能成功生成学习内容，但开发者需策略性地安排题目模态以引导学生从被动识别过渡到主动语言产出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究LLM生成EFL学习内容的教学可行性，验证不同题目模态对学生表现的影响，以及理论化的CEFR难度层级能否准确预测实证任务难度。

Method: 利用日本初中生在语法练习应用上的日志数据，分析多项选择、填空和拖拽三种题目模态对学生表现的影响，并验证CEFR-J语法框架的预测准确性。

Result: 多项选择题认知负荷最低，填空任务对主动回忆障碍最大，拖拽练习时间成本最高；CEFR-J框架得到验证，准确率随水平提升下降，响应时间增加。

Conclusion: LLM能成功生成EFL学习内容，但开发者需策略性地安排题目模态，以引导学生从被动识别过渡到主动语言产出。

Abstract: This study evaluates the pedagogical viability of LLM-generated English as a Foreign Language (EFL) learning content. Utilising log data from Japanese junior high school students practicing on a grammar drilling application, we analysed how different question modalities impact student performance and whether theoretical localised CEFR difficulty tiers accurately predict empirical task difficulty. Results reveal a clear performance hierarchy: multiple-choice questions carried the lowest cognitive load, cloze tasks posed the greatest barrier to active recall, and drag-and-drop exercises incurred the heaviest time penalties. Furthermore, learner data validated the CEFR-J grammar framework, showing a steady decline in accuracy and increased response times as proficiency levels advanced. These findings demonstrate that LLMs can successfully generate learning content, while highlighting the need for developers to strategically sequence question modalities to transition learners from passive recognition to active linguistic production.

</details>


### [517] [The Use of Computational Thinking Skills, Difficulties, and Strategies of Introductory Programming Students Solving Bebras Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02175)
*Enrico Benedetti,Isaac Alpizar-Chacon,Johan Jeuring*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究调查了非计算机专业的大一编程学生在解决Bebras计算思维任务时，如何应用计算思维技能、遇到的困难以及采用的策略。分析241份提交材料发现，算法思维、抽象和分解是最常见的技能，而评估和泛化较少出现；计算思维技能与正确答案正相关。学生面临理解任务和制定计划等四类挑战，并报告了多种问题解决策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算思维被视为每个人都应学习的基本技能，但高等教育中初学编程的学生（非计算机专业）在深度应用计算思维技能方面尚未被充分探索。识别学生何时以及如何使用计算思维技能对于设计支持其发展的干预措施至关重要。

Method: 在非计算机专业的编程入门课程中，收集学生对Bebras任务（短问题，用于引出计算思维技能）的解决方案和计划，共计58名学生的241份提交材料，以及任务后的评论和反思。采用描述性统计、已有的编码方案识别计算思维技能，并进行主题分析以识别困难和策略。

Result: 提交材料在结构和详细程度上各异。最常见的计算思维技能是算法思维、抽象和分解，而评估和泛化出现频率较低。计算思维技能的存在与正确答案呈正相关。学生在理解任务和制定计划等四个领域面临挑战，并报告了多种问题解决策略。

Conclusion: 巩固并拓展了先前关于计算思维技能和问题解决的研究，发现编程入门学生会应用计算思维技能，但在系统解决问题和解释推理过程方面存在困难。Bebras任务为这一人群提供了参与计算思维技能的机会，可用于未来研究。

Abstract: Computational thinking (CT) is regarded as a fundamental skill set everyone should learn. Identifying when and how CT skills are used is challenging but important to inform interventions supporting their development. Previous research has examined how students and experts apply CT skills when solving introductory computational problems. However, the extent to which higher education students in introductory programming courses do so in depth is underexplored. We address this gap by examining how those students apply CT skills when solving computational problems, the difficulties they encounter, and the strategies they employ. We collected plans and solutions to Bebras tasks (short problems introducing CS concepts and considered effective for eliciting CT skills) in an introductory programming course for non-CS majors. We gathered 241 submissions from 58 students across five tasks, along with post-task comments and reflections on strategies. We analyzed the data using descriptive statistics, applied an existing coding scheme to identify CT skills, and conducted thematic analysis to identify difficulties and strategies. Submissions varied in structure and level of detail. The most prevalent CT skills were algorithmic thinking, abstraction, and decomposition, while evaluation and generalization appeared much less frequently. CT skill presence was positively associated with correct answers. Students faced challenges in four areas, including understanding the tasks and making a plan, and reported various problem-solving strategies. Consolidating and extending prior research on CT skills and problem solving, our findings show that students in introductory programming apply CT skills but can struggle to solve problems systematically and explain their reasoning. Furthermore, Bebras tasks create opportunities for this population to engage CT skills and could be used in future research.

</details>


### [518] [Are Algorithm Registers Transparent? Perspectives from Germany](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02347)
*Iman Peljto,Xenia Heilmann,Mattia Cerrato*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文基于Lorenz (2025)提出的德国国家AI透明度登记概念框架，将其转化为审计工具，对德国现有的两个主要透明度倡议（MaKI和Lernende Systeme）进行外部审计，发现它们在满足透明度目标方面存在不足，并提出了改进建议和可视化方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 德国缺乏联邦级AI算法登记册，现有州级和联邦级倡议碎片化严重，其透明度有效性存疑，因此需要系统性的审计框架来评估现有登记册的实际透明度水平。

Method: 将Lorenz (2025)的概念性提案转化为结构化检查清单作为审计工具，对德国两个主要AI透明度倡议（MaKI和Lernende Systeme）进行外部审计。

Result: 审计发现现有登记册需要多项调整才能成为有效的透明度工具；提出了登记册透明度水平的可视化方案，并推导出改进现有德国平台的具体行动项。

Conclusion: 当前德国AI透明度登记册在实现透明度目标方面存在不足，需要系统性的改进；所开发的审计框架和检查清单可公开获取，以支持从业者审计或设计类似登记册。

Abstract: Algorithm registers are public-facing databases that display basic information about algorithms employed in public administration. While several such registers exist across Europe and globally, their capacity to deliver meaningful transparency remains contested. In Germany, the landscape is notably fragmented: no federal-level register exists, yet at least five state- and federal-level initiatives publish information about AI systems with varying scopes and objectives. A recent conceptual proposal by Alina Lorenz (2025), outlines technical and governance requirements for a national AI transparency register in Germany. We repurpose this proposal as an audit instrument, extracting structured checklists from the transparency goals and subgoals it formulates. The resulting checklists, translated from German into English, is made publicly available to support practitioners auditing existing registers or designing new ones. We apply this framework to conduct an external audit of the two main existing German transparency initiatives, MaKI and Lernende Systeme, evaluating the extent to which they fulfill the proposed goals. Our audit reveals that several adaptations are likely needed for these registers to serve as an useful transparency instrument. We further propose a visualization of register transparency levels and derive concrete action items for improving existing German platforms.

</details>


### [519] [A Model for Calculating Cost of Applying Electronic Governance and Robotic Process Automation to a Distributed Management System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.00828)
*Bonny Banerjee,Saurabh Pahune*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个在分布式管理系统中应用电子政务和机器人流程自动化完成任务的成本计算数学模型，是该领域的首个模型，有望推动组织效率成本分析的进一步研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子政务和机器人流程自动化有潜力彻底改变组织的运营方式，但在分布式管理背景下缺乏成本分析模型，因此需要建立一个定量模型来评估这些技术带来的效率提升。

Method: 采用数学建模方法，构建了一个用于计算在分布式管理系统中应用电子政务和RPA完成任务成本的数学模型。

Result: 提出了该领域首批成本计算模型之一。

Conclusion: 该模型填补了电子政务和RPA在分布式管理中成本分析的空白，有望激发更多关于组织效率成本分析的研究。

Abstract: Electronic Governance (eGov) and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) are two technological advancements that have the potential to revolutionize the way organizations manage their operations. When applied to Distributed Management (DM), these technologies can further enhance organizational efficiency and effectiveness. In this brief article, we present a mathematical model for calculating the cost of accomplishing a task by applying eGov and RPA in a DM system. This model is one of the first of its kind, and is expected to spark further research on cost analysis for organizational efficiency given the unprecedented advancements in electronic and automation technologies.

</details>


### [520] [If open source is to win, it must go public](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.09296)
*Joshua Tan,Nicholas Vincent,Katherine Elkins,Magnus Sahlgren,Joseph Low,David Pham,Sampo Pyysalo,Jenia Jitsev*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文主张开源AI需要由公共AI（公共基础设施和机构）来补充，以解决开源AI在资源获取、可持续性和公共治理方面的局限性，从而实现AI作为公共物品的承诺。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管开源项目在机器学习模型和系统方面取得了显著进展，但开源AI模型在预训练、后训练和部署等方面需要大量资源（数据和计算），只有少数参与者能够提供，这限制了AI的全面民主化。

Method: 本文为一篇立场论文（position paper），通过分析开源AI与以往开源软件的区别，指出开源AI面临的资源瓶颈，进而提出公共AI作为补充方案。

Result: 论证了开源AI本身不足以实现AI的全面民主化，需要建设公共基础设施来驱动和交付开源软件与模型。

Conclusion: 为实现AI模型作为亲社会公共物品的全部潜力，必须构建公共AI基础设施和治理机构，确保模型的可访问性、可持续性和公共利益导向的治理。

Abstract: Open source projects have made incredible progress in producing widely usable machine learning models and systems, but open source alone will face challenges in fully democratizing access to AI. Unlike previous generations of open source software, open source and open weight AI models require substantial resources to activate and maintain -- e.g., data and compute for pre-training, post-training, and deployment -- which only a few actors can currently provide. This position paper argues that open source AI must be complemented by public AI: infrastructure and institutions that ensure models are accessible, sustainable, and governed in the public interest. To achieve the full promise of AI models as prosocial public goods, we need to build public infrastructure to power and deliver open source software and models.

</details>


### [521] [Position: Beyond Sensitive Attributes, ML Fairness Should Quantify Structural Injustice via Social Determinants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.08337)
*Zeyu Tang,Alex John London,Atoosa Kasirzadeh,Sarah Stewart de Ramirez,Peter Spirtes,Kun Zhang,Sanmi Koyejo*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文批判了算法公平研究将不公平性局限于敏感属性（如种族、性别）的范式，主张应通过社会决定因素（如经济状况、地理环境等结构性变量）来量化结构性不公正。作者通过理论模型、人口普查数据分析和医疗应用案例证明，仅关注敏感属性的缓解策略可能引入新的结构性不公正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有算法公平研究过度聚焦于敏感属性歧视，忽视了结构性不公正（由社会决定因素驱动）的根源性影响，导致公平干预措施治标不治本。

Method: 跨学科理论论述结合三组实证分析：大学录取理论模型、美国人口普查数据的人口学研究、美国综合医疗系统乳腺癌筛查应用案例。

Result: 仅以敏感属性为中心的缓解策略可能引入新的结构性不公正；社会决定因素在审计结构性不公平时比敏感属性更具诊断价值。

Conclusion: 审计结构性不公正应当优先于缓解措施，算法公平研究需要超越"非歧视"范式，发展基于社会决定因素的技术新框架。

Abstract: Algorithmic fairness research has largely framed unfairness as discrimination along sensitive attributes. However, this approach limits visibility into unfairness as structural injustice instantiated through social determinants, which are contextual variables that shape attributes and outcomes without pertaining to specific individuals. This position paper argues that the field should quantify structural injustice via social determinants, beyond sensitive attributes. Drawing on cross-disciplinary insights, we argue that prevailing technical paradigms fail to adequately capture unfairness as structural injustice, because contexts are potentially treated as noise to be normalized rather than signal to be audited. We further demonstrate the practical urgency of this shift through a theoretical model of college admissions, a demographic study using U.S. census data, and a high-stakes domain application regarding breast cancer screening within an integrated U.S. healthcare system. Our results indicate that mitigation strategies centered solely on sensitive attributes can introduce new forms of structural injustice. We contend that auditing structural injustice through social determinants must precede mitigation, and call for new technical developments that move beyond sensitive-attribute-centered notions of fairness as non-discrimination.

</details>


### [522] [Who Evaluates AI's Social Impacts? Mapping Coverage and Gaps in First and Third Party Evaluations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.05613)
*Anka Reuel,Avijit Ghosh,Jenny Chim,Andrew Tran,Yanan Long,Jennifer Mickel,Usman Gohar,Srishti Yadav,Pawan Sasanka Ammanamanchi,Mowafak Allaham,Hossein A. Rahmani,Mubashara Akhtar,Felix Friedrich,Robert Scholz,Michael Alexander Riegler,Jan Batzner,Eliya Habba,Arushi Saxena,Anastassia Kornilova,Kevin Wei,Prajna Soni,Yohan Mathew,Kevin Klyman,Jeba Sania,Subramanyam Sahoo,Olivia Beyer Bruvik,Pouya Sadeghi,Sujata Goswami,Angelina Wang,Yacine Jernite,Zeerak Talat,Stella Biderman,Mykel Kochenderfer,Sanmi Koyejo,Irene Solaiman*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究首次全面分析了基础模型的社会影响评估报告，发现第一方报告稀疏且流于表面，而第三方评估更广泛深入，但关键信息披露不足，呼吁政策强制开发者透明化并加强独立评估生态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管基础模型在高风险AI系统中日益重要，现有治理框架依赖评估来管理风险，但社会影响评估（涵盖偏见、公平性、隐私、环境成本、劳动力等）覆盖不均衡且缺乏系统性分析，因此需要全面审视当前评估报告现状。

Method: 分析了186份第一方发布报告和248份第三方评估来源，并辅以开发者访谈，对社会影响评估报告进行首次全面分析。

Result: 第一方报告稀疏、流于表面且部分领域（如环境影响、偏见）呈下降趋势；第三方评估更广泛、严格地覆盖偏见、有害内容及性能差异。关键信息（数据来源、内容审核劳动力、成本、基础设施）只有开发者能权威披露，但访谈显示这些披露被低优先级对待。

Conclusion: 当前实践在社会影响评估方面存在重大缺口，需要政策强制开发者透明化、加强独立评估生态系统，并创建共享基础设施以聚合第三方评估。

Abstract: Foundation models are increasingly central to high-stakes AI systems, and governance frameworks now depend on evaluations to assess their risks and capabilities. Although general capability evaluations are widespread, social impact assessments covering bias, fairness, privacy, environmental costs, and labor remain uneven. To characterize this landscape, we conduct the first comprehensive analysis of social impact evaluation reporting, examining 186 first-party release reports and 248 third-party evaluation sources, supplemented by developer interviews. We find a stark division of labor: first-party reporting is sparse, often superficial, and declining in areas like environmental impact and bias, while third-party evaluators provide broader, more rigorous coverage of bias, harmful content, and performance disparities. However, only developers can authoritatively report on data provenance, content moderation labor, costs, and infrastructure, yet interviews reveal these disclosures are deprioritized unless tied to product adoption or compliance. Current practices leave major gaps in assessing societal impacts, underscoring the need for policies that mandate developer transparency, strengthen independent evaluation ecosystems, and create shared infrastructure for aggregating third-party evaluations.

</details>


### [523] [Knowing Isn't Understanding: Re-grounding Generative Proactivity with Epistemic and Behavioral Insight](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15259)
*Kirandeep Kaur,Xingda Lyu,Chirag Shah*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出生成式AI代理需应对"认知不完整性"（用户无法意识到自己未知的内容），并主张主动性行为必须同时基于认知和行为双重重锚定，以负责任地促进人机伙伴关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式AI代理将理解等同于解决显式查询，当用户自身缺乏对缺失、风险或值得考虑之处的认知时，这种假设失效。在此条件下，主动性不仅是效率提升，更是认知上的必要性。

Method: 借鉴无知哲学（philosophy of ignorance）和主动性行为研究（proactive behavior research），提出生成式主动性必须在认知和行为两个层面进行锚定，为智能代理设计原则性约束。

Result: 指出现有主动性方法仅停留在狭隘的预测性，从过去行为外推并预设目标已明确定义，无法有意义地支持用户；同时指出无约束的主动干预可能误导注意力、使用户不堪重负或引入危害。

Conclusion: 生成式主动性必须同时基于认知和行为双重重锚定，无知哲学和主动性行为研究为设计能够负责任地参与并促进有意义伙伴关系的代理提供了关键指导。

Abstract: Generative AI agents equate understanding with resolving explicit queries, an assumption that confines interaction to what users can articulate. This assumption breaks down when users themselves lack awareness of what is missing, risky, or worth considering. In such conditions, proactivity is not merely an efficiency enhancement, but an epistemic necessity. We refer to this condition as epistemic incompleteness: where progress depends on engaging with unknown unknowns for effective partnership. Existing approaches to proactivity remain narrowly anticipatory, extrapolating from past behavior and presuming that goals are already well defined, thereby failing to support users meaningfully. However, surfacing possibilities beyond a user's current awareness is not inherently beneficial. Unconstrained proactive interventions can misdirect attention, overwhelm users, or introduce harm. Proactive agents, therefore, require behavioral grounding: principled constraints on when, how, and to what extent an agent should intervene. We advance the position that generative proactivity must be grounded both epistemically and behaviorally. Drawing on the philosophy of ignorance and research on proactive behavior, we argue that these theories offer critical guidance for designing agents that can engage responsibly and foster meaningful partnerships.

</details>


### [524] [rt2gtfs: A scalable framework for correcting public transport timetables using real-time data for accessibility analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11477)
*Zihao Chen,Federico Botta*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个名为 rt2gtfs 的开源 Python 工具包，用于从高频车辆定位数据中重建真实的公共交通时刻表，从而支持更准确的路径规划、出行时间计算和可达性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的可达性分析依赖静态时刻表数据，假设公交服务严格按照计划运行，忽略了运营条件和服务中断带来的出行时间波动，导致可达性评估不准确。

Method: 开发了 rt2gtfs 开源 Python 包，从英国公交开放数据服务（BODS）收集 GTFS-Realtime 车辆位置数据，将观测到的车辆位置与计划中的 GTFS 行程和站点匹配，推断站点级到达和离开时间，并输出修正后的 GTFS 格式时刻表。

Result: 利用 BODS 全国规模的实时公交数据流，展示了 rt2gtfs 可生成适合路径规划、起讫点出行时间计算和可达性分析的观测时刻表。

Conclusion: 该工具以可复用软件的形式发布，支持更具可复现性和现实性的可达性分析，为研究人员和从业者将观测到的公交运行表现纳入交通规划提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Travel time is a fundamental component of accessibility measurement, yet most accessibility analyses rely on static timetable data that assume public transport services operate exactly as scheduled. Such representations overlook the substantial variability in travel times arising from operational conditions and service disruptions. In this paper, we present rt2gtfs, an open-source Python package for reconstructing empirical public transport timetables from high-frequency vehicle location data. The package provides a configurable and scalable workflow for collecting GTFS-Realtime vehicle position feeds from the UK Bus Open Data Service (BODS), matching observed vehicle locations to scheduled GTFS trips and stops, inferring stop-level arrival and departure times, and exporting corrected GTFS format timetable bundles. Using national-scale real-time bus data feeds from BODS, we demonstrate how rt2gtfs can be used to generate observed timetables suitable for routing and origin-destination travel time calculation, as well as accessibility analysis. By packaging the framework as reusable software, this work supports more reproducible and realistic accessibility analysis and provides a practical tool for researchers and practitioners seeking to incorporate observed public transport performance into transport planning.

</details>


### [525] [Ethical Fairness in Ubiquitous Health Sensing without Known Attributes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13373)
*Shaily Roy,Harshit Sharma,Daniel A. Adler,Srijan Sen,Tanzeem Choudhury,Asif Salekin*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: Flare是一个不依赖人口统计或异构属性的公平性框架，通过Fisher信息引导的潜在子群学习与无伤害正则化，在普适移动感知系统中提升伦理公平性，并引入BHE指标套件超越传统统计奇偶性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在普适和移动健康系统中，高准确率不足以确保模型在不同人群、情境和设备间公平运作。传统公平方法依赖训练时获取的人口统计或异构属性，但这些属性常不可用、涉及隐私、受监管或不宜收集；且基于奇偶性的公平可能牺牲子群体性能，违背伦理原则。

Method: 提出Flare框架，利用Fisher信息（优化几何中的曲率）无需求助人口统计属性即可发现潜在子群性能差异；结合表征、损失和曲率信号识别隐藏性能层次，通过协作但无伤害优化提升子群性能；并引入BHE指标套件（Beneficence-Harm Avoidance-Equity）量化伦理公平性。

Result: 在EDA、OhioT1DM、IHS和Percept-R等多个移动生理、行为和临床传感数据集上，Flare在伦理公平性上超越现有基线。消融研究、可解释性和损失景观分析表明，性能提升源于更平坦的优化几何、更简单的决策规则和无伤害的潜在子群适应。运行时分析支持其在资源受限传感部署中的实用性。

Conclusion: Flare提供了一种不依赖敏感属性、对齐伦理原则的公平性方法，通过优化几何约束实现无伤害的潜在子群适应，在移动健康等感知系统中兼顾准确性与伦理公平。

Abstract: In ubiquitous and mobile health systems, computational models infer human states from wearable, behavioral, and physiological sensing data. In these settings, high accuracy alone is insufficient; models must act ethically and equitably across diverse people, contexts, and devices. However, fairness methods that rely on demographic or heterogeneous attributes during training are difficult to enforce because such attributes are often unavailable, privacy-sensitive, regulated, or undesirable to collect. Conventional parity-based fairness can also violate ethical principles by trading off subgroup performance. To address this challenge, we present Flare, Fisher-guided LAtent-subgroup learning with do-no-harm REgularization, a demographic- and heterogeneous-attribute-agnostic framework that aligns human-centered fairness with ethical principles for ubiquitous and mobile sensing. Flare leverages optimization geometry, particularly Fisher Information, to regularize curvature and uncover latent disparities in model behavior without demographic or heterogeneous attributes. By integrating representation, loss, and curvature signals, it identifies hidden performance strata and refines them through collaborative but do-no-harm optimization, enhancing subgroup performance while preserving ethical balance. We also introduce BHE (Beneficence-Harm Avoidance-Equity), a metric suite that operationalizes ethical fairness beyond statistical parity. Across mobile physiological, behavioral, and clinical sensing datasets, including EDA, OhioT1DM, IHS, and Percept-R, Flare improves ethical fairness over state-of-the-art baselines. Ablation, interpretability, and loss-landscape analyses show that these gains arise from flatter optimization geometry, simpler decision rules, and do-no-harm latent-subgroup adaptation. Runtime analysis supports the practicality of Flare for resource-constrained sensing deployments.

</details>


### [526] [Dissociative Identity: Language Model Agents Lack Grounding for Reputation Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30169)
*Botao Amber Hu,Helena Rong,Max Van Kleek*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文论证了将人类身份验证和声誉机制（如“了解你的客户”和信用评分）直接扩展到自主语言模型智能体（“了解你的智能体”）存在根本性缺陷。由于语言模型智能体在本体论上是“解离性”的——由可变的模块（基础模型、系统提示、工具访问策略、外部记忆等）组成，具有流动的人格且易受攻击，无法维持声誉机制所需的持久身份、行为连续性、制裁敏感性和成本不可替代性。因此，基于身份的、事后、监管、制裁型治理（如声誉）在结构上不适用于解离性智能体，应转向基于可观察性的、事前、构成性、协议型行为约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着自主语言模型智能体的激增并形成具有现实世界后果的“智能体网络”，如何信任和委托任务给未知智能体成为关键问题。自然的思路是扩展人类信任机制（如身份验证和声誉），但作者认为这一类比存在根本性缺陷，需要重新审视智能体的本体论特性。

Method: 概念分析和类比论证。作者从“解离性身份障碍”法学理论出发，分析语言模型智能体的本体论特性——解离性（dissociativity），即由可变模块组成的流动人格，缺乏行为连续性、制裁敏感性和持久身份，从而与声誉机制的前提条件不兼容。

Result: 揭示了声誉机制依赖的四个核心属性（可识别性、可预测性、可信性、可康复性）在解离性智能体上无法成立，导致信任崩塌。提出身份治理方案的不可行性，并建议转向基于可观察性的、事前、构成性、协议型行为约束。

Conclusion: 基于身份的事后制裁型治理（如声誉）在结构上不适用于解离性语言模型智能体；需要转向基于可观察性的事前协议型行为约束来建立信任基础。

Abstract: As autonomous language model agents proliferate, forming an emerging agentic web with real-world consequences, what credibility signals can you use to decide whether to trust an unfamiliar agent in the wild and delegate to it? A natural governance intuition is to extend human identity verification and reputation mechanisms, from ``Know Your Customer'' and credit scores to ``Know Your Agent'' regimes. However, we argue that this analogy is fundamentally incomplete. Reputation mechanisms function both as social signals and as corrective feedback that sustain an equilibrium of trustworthy behavior, presuming a persistent identity associated with behavioral continuity, sanction sensitivity, and costly non-fungibility. Yet language model agents are ontologically \emph{dissociative}: they are essentially an assemblage of mutable modules -- foundation models, system prompts, tool-access policies, external memory, and, in some cases, a multi-agent system as a whole -- any of which may change agent behavior -- with a fluid persona that is also vulnerable to adversarial attack and may not internalize sanctions. Drawing on dissociative identity disorder jurisprudence, this dissociativity leaves agents without grounding for identifiability, predictability, credibility, and rehabilitability -- the very properties that reputation mechanisms aim to sustain -- thereby collapsing trust. We argue that identity-based, ex post, regulative, sanction-based governance, such as reputation, is structurally inapplicable to dissociative agents, and we suggest a shift to observability-based, ex ante, constitutive, protocol-based behavioral harnesses.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [527] [BitsMoE: Efficient Spectral Energy-Guided Bit Allocation for MoE LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00079)
*Jiayu Zhao,Zihan Teng,Minhao Fan,Tianrui Ma,Wentao Ren,Song Chen,Weichen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BitsMoE提出了一种基于谱能量引导的比特分配框架，通过SVD分解将MoE层分解为共享基和专家特定谱因子，并利用整数线性规划在极低比特下实现混合精度量化，在2比特量化下相比GPTQ加速12.3倍、平均准确率提升27.83个百分点、解码速度提升1.76倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE大语言模型虽能减少每Token计算量，但所有专家权重需常驻内存导致部署内存开销大。现有压缩方法在超低比特场景下效果不佳：剪枝不可逆地移除模型容量，粗粒度量化无法根据专家和权重的异构重要性分配比特。

Method: 1) 对每个MoE层进行SVD分解，得到共享基（不量化以保留跨专家共性结构）和专家特定谱因子（作为细粒度量化单元）；2) 将谱感知混合精度量化建模为激活感知的重建损失代理，通过求解整数线性规划在固定比特预算下最小化估计重建损失，确定每个单元的比特宽度。

Result: 在多个MoE大语言模型上，BitsMoE在超低比特场景下显著降低下游任务精度损失。在Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base的2比特量化中，相比GPTQ，量化加速12.3倍，平均准确率提升27.83个百分点，解码速度提升1.76倍。

Conclusion: BitsMoE通过谱能量引导的比特分配有效解决了MoE模型超低比特量化的难题，兼顾了量化效率和模型性能，代码和模型已开源。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models reduce per-token computation through sparse expert activation, but their deployment remains memory-intensive because all expert weights must be kept resident in memory. Existing MoE compression methods struggle in the ultra-low-bit regime: pruning irreversibly removes model capacity, while coarse-grained quantization fails to allocate bits according to heterogeneous expert and weight-direction importance. We propose BitsMoE, a spectral-energy-guided bit-allocation framework for MoE LLM quantization. BitsMoE decomposes each MoE layer by SVD into a shared basis and expert-specific spectral factors, retaining the shared basis without quantization to preserve common cross-expert structure and using the expert-specific factors as fine-grained quantization units. To determine the bit-width of each unit, BitsMoE formulates spectrum-wise mixed-precision quantization as an activation-aware reconstruction surrogate and solves an integer linear program that minimizes estimated reconstruction loss under a fixed bit budget. Experiments across multiple MoE LLMs show that BitsMoE substantially reduces downstream task accuracy degradation in ultra-low-bit regimes. Under 2-bit quantization on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, BitsMoE accelerates quantization by 12.3$\times$, improves average accuracy by 27.83 percentage points, and increases decoding speed by 1.76$\times$ over GPTQ. Our model and code are publicly available at https://github.com/zjiayu064/BitsMoE.

</details>


### [528] [DAStatFormer: A Hybrid Multibranch Transformer with Statistical Feature Integration for DAS-Based Pattern Recognitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00081)
*Michel Dione,Jerry Lonlac,Hélène Louis,Anthony Fleury,Stephane Lecoeuche*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DAStatFormer提出了一种混合多分支Transformer架构，通过提取每个通道的24个ANOVA筛选的多域统计特征（时域、波形、频域）替代原始DAS信号，结合门控机制融合各域注意力分支，在Φ-OTDR基准和真实DAS数据集上达到99.4%准确率，大幅降低参数和推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DAS数据高维且时空模式复杂，现有深度学习方法（CNN、RNN、Transformer变体）要么无法捕获长程依赖，要么处理原始DAS矩阵计算成本过高，亟需一种高效且可扩展的实时监测方案。

Method: 提出DAStatFormer混合多分支Transformer，核心步骤：1) 从每个通道提取时域、波形、频域共24个ANOVA筛选的统计特征；2) 各域通过专用的逐步骤和逐通道注意力分支处理；3) 自适应门控机制融合多分支输出。

Result: 在开源Φ-OTDR基准和真实DAS数据集上，DAStatFormer达到最高99.4%准确率，真实场景接近完美性能，参数量和推理成本显著低于DASFormer和DeepViT等模型。

Conclusion: DAStatFormer通过紧凑的多域统计特征与门控Transformer结合，实现了高精度、低开销的DAS事件分类，适用于大规模实时光纤监测场景。

Abstract: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) enables large-scale monitoring through optical fibers, but its high dimensionality and complex spatio-temporal patterns make event classification demanding. Existing deep learning approaches-CNNs, recurrent models, and Transformer variants-either fail to capture long-range dependencies or require processing raw DAS matrices at prohibitive cost. We propose DAStatFormer, a hybrid multibranch Transformer that combines compact multidomain statistical features with Gated Transformer Networks. Instead of raw signals, we extract 24 ANOVA-selected attributes per channel from the temporal, waveform, and spectral domains, reducing data size by orders of magnitude while preserving discriminative information. Each domain is processed via dedicated step-wise and channel-wise attention branches, fused by an adaptive gating mechanism. Experiments on the open $Φ$-OTDR benchmark and a real-scenario DAS dataset show that DAS-tatFormer achieves up to 99.4% accuracy and near-perfect real-world performance, while using significantly fewer parameters and lower inference cost than models such as DASFormer and DeepViT. These results demonstrate its suitability for scalable, real-time DAS-based monitoring. We release our code at https://github.com/MichelD-git/DAStatFormer

</details>


### [529] [Hoeffding Concept Bottleneck Models with Applications to Overhead Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00082)
*Clément Bénard,Manon Arfib,Christophe Labreuche,Victor Quétu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Hoeffding概念瓶颈模型（HCBM），利用梯度提升树的Hoeffding泛函分解对概念分数进行非线性、稀疏聚合，并生成主蕴含式进行紧凑预测。HCBM能抵抗概念间信息泄露，在分类和目标检测任务中均优于传统线性CBM方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBM）使用线性聚合方式预测，导致需要使用大量概念才能达到良好性能，这削弱了可解释性并容易产生信息泄露问题；此外，概念与输出logits之间的关系本质上并非线性。

Method: 基于Hoeffding泛函分解对梯度提升树进行分解，实现对概念分数的非线性、稀疏聚合，并利用主蕴含式（prime implicants）生成紧凑预测结果。

Result: HCBM在对抗概念间信息泄露方面具有鲁棒性，在大量实验中优于标准线性CBM方法，并在具有挑战性的遥感目标检测任务中展现出高性能。

Conclusion: HCBM通过非线性稀疏聚合有效解决了线性CBM的可解释性下降和信息泄露问题，不仅能用于分类任务，还能扩展至目标检测场景。

Abstract: Explainability of deep learning algorithms is critical for computer-vision applications with high-stake decisions. Concept bottleneck models (CBM) have recently shown promising performance to provide explainable and accurate predictions for classification problems, based on a bottleneck of high-level concepts. Existing CBM methods rely on a linear aggregation of the concept scores to compute predictions. However, a large number of concepts is often used in this linear approach, which undermines explainability and favors information leakage. In general, the underlying relation between concepts and output logits is not linear. Therefore, we introduce Hoeffding Concept Bottleneck Models (HCBM), which build on the Hoeffding functional decomposition of gradient-boosted trees to provide non-linear and sparse aggregations of concept scores, and generate compact predictions using prime implicants. HCBM are proved to be robust to interconcept leakage, and outperform standard linear CBM in practice, as shown in extensive experiments. Beyond classification, HCBM can be adapted to object detection, and we focus on a challenging case with overhead images to show the high performance of HCBM in these settings.

</details>


### [530] [From Demonstrations to Rewards: Test-Time Prompt Optimization for VLM Reward Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00083)
*Christian Gumbsch,Leonardo Barcellona,Lennard Schünemann,Platon Karageorgis,Andrii Zadaianchuk,Zehao Wang,Sergey Zakharov,Fabien Despinoy,Rahaf Aljundi,Efstratios Gavves*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Demo2Reward是一种基于少量演示轨迹优化VLM奖励模型语言指令的测试时自适应技术，在不增加策略学习计算成本的前提下，有效减少假阳性奖励，显著提升了机器人策略学习效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本VLM作为奖励模型时，需要精心设计提示词，否则会产生次优奖励，其中假阳性预测会严重降低下游策略学习性能。

Method: 提出Demo2Reward，一种测试时自适应技术，利用少量专家演示轨迹（3-10条）优化奖励模型的语言指令，以减少假阳性同时保留真阳性，无需额外模型训练或计算资源。

Result: 在多项模拟机器人任务和不同策略骨干网络上，Demo2Reward一致优于现有的零样本和少样本VLM奖励模型，并成功迁移到真实机器人学习场景。

Conclusion: Demo2Reward通过少量演示即可有效优化VLM奖励模型，无需人工设计奖励函数，即可实现高效策略学习。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning relies on accurate reward functions, which are often hand-crafted or even unavailable in real-world applications, such as robotics. Recent work has explored the zero-shot reasoning capabilities of pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as reward models. However, without careful prompt engineering, these approaches tend to produce suboptimal rewards, where false positive predictions can severely degrade downstream policy learning. In robotics, limited datasets comprising expert demonstrations are often collected to bootstrap policy learning. This scenario provides an opportunity to optimize a reward model prior policy training. We propose Demo2Reward a test-time adaptation technique to optimize the language instruction of a reward model based on a few demonstrations (3-10 trajectories) to reduce false positives while preserving true positives. Crucially, this requires no additional model training or computation resources during policy learning. We show that Demo2Reward consistently outperforms existing zero- and few-shot VLM reward models across a range of simulated robotic tasks and policy backbones. Finally, we demonstrate that Demo2Reward effectively transfers to a real-world robotic learning scenario, enabling policy learning without manually engineering a reward function.

</details>


### [531] [A Shared Valence Axis Across Modern LLMs and Human EEG: The Saturation Regularity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00129)
*Yousef A. Radwan,Xuhui Liu,Kilichbek Haydarov,Yuqian Fu,Mohamed Elhoseiny*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型(LLM)内部表征与人类脑电(EEG)中情感效价表征的对齐关系。利用仅9个情感句子构建的LLM效价轴(V-axis)可直接映射到脑电神经活动，且36个脑电解码器在无暴露情况下自发重现该方向。但进一步的对齐策略（25种）均无法提升解码性能，作者提出"饱和规律"：当任务标签已驱动网络到达目标方向时，额外监督会扭曲已饱和的损失盆地。基于此，作者提出通过集成残差多样性来提升性能，在FACED和SEED-V数据集上分别提升10.5%的平衡准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索现代大语言模型能否作为理解人类大脑神经表征（特别是EEG中的情感效价）的透镜，验证LLM与人类神经活动在情感表征结构上的趋同性与对齐程度。

Method: 1) 从9个情感句子构建LLM的V-axis（效价轴），通过零样本迁移和跨14个LLM的一致性验证；2) 在123名受试者的EEG数据集上，用线性投影验证LLM的V-axis与神经活动的映射关系；3) 测试25种对齐策略（知识蒸馏、表征相似性、对比学习、拓扑损失等）观察解码性能变化；4) 提出"饱和规律"理论解释，并基于残差多样性集成策略提升性能。

Result: 1) LLM构建的V-axis可通过线性投影映射到EEG神经活动；2) 36个情感分类器自发重现V-axis方向；3) 25种对齐策略无一提升解码性能，16种显著降低准确率；4) 基于残差多样性的集成策略在FACED上提升10.5%平衡准确率，在SEED-V上复现同样效果。

Conclusion: LLM与人类脑电在情感效价表征上存在结构趋同，但直接的对齐监督已饱和且有害；改进应来自监督不可达的残差子空间，通过残差多样性集成可有效提升解码性能。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful representation learners whose internal features increasingly align with human cognition. We study whether modern LLMs can serve as a lens for understanding neural representations in the human brain, focusing on emotional valence in EEG.
  We first build a one-dimensional valence direction, the V-axis, from modern LLMs using only nine emotion-evocative sentences. We validate it through zero-shot transfer to sentiment benchmarks and cross-model consistency across fourteen LLMs. We then show that this LLM-derived direction maps onto human neural activity. On a public EEG cohort of 123 subjects watching affective videos, a single linear projection on EEG features tracks the V-axis position of each stimulus. Moreover, 36 EEG emotion classifiers trained without exposure to the V-axis spontaneously rediscover the same direction in their internal representations, suggesting that the same valence structure emerges in both language models and human electrophysiology.
  Yet this convergence does not provide an effective training signal. We test twenty-five alignment strategies, including knowledge distillation, representational similarity, contrastive, and topographic losses; none improve decoding, and sixteen significantly reduce accuracy. We formalize this result as the saturation regularity: once task labels alone drive a brain-decoding network onto the target direction, additional supervision mainly distorts an already-saturated basin, while the load-bearing within-class residual receives little useful gradient.
  This regularity also indicates where improvement should come from: the residual subspace unreachable by supervision. Motivated by this insight, we ensemble across residual diversity rather than supervising the basin, improving balanced accuracy by 10.5% over the prior best on FACED, with the same effect replicated on SEED-V.

</details>


### [532] [Automatically Differentiable Nonlinear Tensor Networks (ADNTNs) for Exponential Compression of Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00130)
*Andrzej Cichocki,Michal Wietczak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出可自动微分的非线性张量网络（ADNTNs），通过反向模式自动微分端到端训练紧凑核张量，在AlexNet和VGG-16上实现2000倍至77000倍的每层压缩比，且在多个VGG-16设置中准确率匹配甚至优于密集基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展低秩适应和张量分解方法，通过层级化小核、非线性激活和横向混合张量构建大型权重张量，实现更高效的结构化权重生成，同时保持可微分性以支持端到端训练。

Method: 提出可自动微分的非线性张量网络（ADNTNs）框架，包含三种架构：树张量网络（TTN）、增强型TTN（aTTN，带边界解缠层）和多尺度纠缠重整化拟设（MERA）。支持非线性激活、任务感知目标、批处理和硬件感知执行调度。明确指出自动微分不等同于无代价收缩——大中间张量、劣质收缩顺序和一般环状张量网络的精确收缩代价仍然存在。

Result: 在AlexNet和VGG-16各层上的实验显示，每层压缩比约2000倍至77000倍，准确率通常匹配密集基线，多个VGG-16案例中甚至有所提升。

Conclusion: ADNTNs是一条有前景、数学结构清晰且硬件感知的神经网络轻量化路径，但需要将优化、收缩调度和部署内核协同设计才能发挥全部潜力。

Abstract: We study Automatically Differentiable Nonlinear Tensor Networks (ADNTNs), a family of structured weight generators whose compact core tensors are trained end-to-end by reverse-mode automatic differentiation (AD). The approach can be viewed as a natural extension of low-rank adaptation and tensor factorisation: instead of using one low-rank matrix update, an ADNTN builds a large weight tensor through a hierarchy of small cores, nonlinear activations, and optional lateral mixing tensors. The paper focuses on three architectures: Tree Tensor Networks (TTNs), augmented TTNs (aTTNs) with boundary disentanglers, and Multi-scale Entanglement Renormalisation Ansatze (MERA).
  The formulation supports nonlinear activations, task-aware objectives, batching, and hardware-aware execution schedules. At the same time, the paper keeps a clear distinction between \emph{differentiating} a contraction program and making contraction free: AD does not remove the cost of large intermediates, poor contraction orders, or exact contraction of general loopy tensor networks.
  Extensive simulations on AlexNet and VGG-16 layers show per-layer compression ratios from roughly $2000\times$ to $77000\times$ in the studied settings, with accuracy often matching the dense baseline and, in several VGG-16 cases, improving it. These results are encouraging rather than final: they suggest that ADNTNs are a promising, mathematically structured, and hardware-aware route toward much smaller neural networks, provided that optimisation, contraction schedules, and deployment kernels are designed together.

</details>


### [533] [Foundation-Preserving Adaptation via Generalized Rayleigh-Quotient Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00132)
*Dongjun Kim,Adrian de Wynter,Huancheng Chen,Heasung Kim,Haris Vikalo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FoLoRA是一种基于遗忘感知优化的LoRA变体，通过广义Rayleigh商计算方向效用/遗忘比，并结合门控Adam更新来平衡下游任务适应性与预训练能力保持，实验表明其在数学、代码和指令跟随任务上取得了最优的保持-适应平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遗忘感知方法通常通过特殊初始化或固定约束寻求更安全的更新，但未能动态调节适应性与知识保持之间的权衡，导致非目标能力的退化。

Method: 提出FoLoRA框架：1) 基于一阶保持条件定义遗忘惩罚（预训练代理激活）和任务效用（下游任务激活）；2) 通过广义Rayleigh商对更新方向按单位遗忘惩罚的任务效用进行评分；3) 构建谱坐标系实现方向加权门控Adam更新，衰减低效用-惩罚比的方向；4) 从预训练模型采样构造代理校准数据替代单一代理数据集。

Result: 在数学、代码和指令跟随任务上，FoLoRA相比基线方法取得了最强的最优保存-适应平衡，即在提升目标任务性能的同时最好地保持了非目标能力。

Conclusion: 通过方向级别的遗忘感知优化和代理数据采样策略，FoLoRA能够有效缓解微调中的灾难性遗忘问题，实现更好的能力保持与任务适应的权衡。

Abstract: While finetuning effectively adapts foundation models to specialized downstream tasks, it can degrade nontarget capabilities acquired during pretraining. Existing forgetting aware methods typically seek safer updates through specialized initialization or fixed constraints, but do not regulate the adaptation preservation trade-off during training. We propose Foundation Preserving LoRA (FoLoRA), a forgetting aware optimization framework. Guided by a first order preservation condition, FoLoRA defines a forgetting penalty over pretraining-proxy activations and a task utility over downstream task activations. It then scores update directions by task utility per unit forgetting penalty via a generalized Rayleigh quotient. The resulting spectral coordinate system enables direction wise gated Adam updates, attenuating low utility to penalty directions during training. To estimate the forgetting penalty, FoLoRA constructs pretraining proxy calibration data by sampling from the pretrained model rather than relying on a single proxy dataset. Experiments on math, code, and instruction following adaptation show that FoLoRA achieves the strongest preservation adaptation balance over baselines, improving target task performance with best aggregate preservation of non target capabilities.

</details>


### [534] [World Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Architectures, Methodologies, Reasoning Paradigms, and Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00133)
*Arif Hassan Zidan,Yi Pan,Hanqi Jiang,Ruiyu Yan,Wei Ruan,Zihao Wu,Lifeng Chen,Weihang You,Xinliang Li,Bowen Chen,Huawen Hu,Peilong Wang,Sizhuang Liu,Jing Zhang,Siyuan Li,Zhengliang Liu,Yu Bao,Lin Zhao,Lichao Sun,Dajiang Zhu,Xiang Li,Jinglei Lv,Quanzheng Li,Wei Liu,Tianming Liu,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了世界模型领域的研究进展，提出了一个涵盖架构、方法论家族、推理策略和应用领域的四维分类体系，并总结了从早期认知科学基础到PlaNet、Dreamer、MuZero、Sora等里程碑系统的发展脉络，指出了复合预测误差、仿真到现实迁移等开放挑战及未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型作为智能体预测、规划和推理的核心范式，在强化学习、机器人、自动驾驶等多个领域快速发展，但缺乏统一的理论框架来整合多样的架构选择、训练方法、推理机制和应用场景，亟需系统性梳理与分类。

Method: 提出了一个多轴分类法，沿四个维度组织：(i)架构（表示格式、动态形式化、输入模态、学习范式和下游应用）；(ii)方法论家族（状态空间/循环方法、Transformer、扩散生成器、物理信息网络、语言增强多模态系统）；(iii)推理策略（基于想象的计划、潜在策略学习、反事实推理、不确定性下的规划）；(iv)应用领域（机器人、自动驾驶、视频预测、多模态智能体、强化学习、科学建模、医学影像、教育测量、商业金融）。
