Abstract: We present a multi-task optimization approach based on a deep learning architecture for time series forecasting. We leverage large collections of time series to identify the weights of forecasting models that can be combined to produce forecasts for each series. This method jointly addresses two tasks: the selection of different forecasting models, and their effective combination. In doing so, it keeps into account, in an original way, both the accuracy and diversity of the forecasting methods. For a given time series, the model combination module extracts features and uses them to optimize the weights of the forecasting methods. Simultaneously, the model selection module extracts other features to identify the subset of methods to be used for the prediction. This selection process is framed as a classification problem, with the labels representing the set of models to be used for a series. These labels are determined by solving an auxiliary optimization problem that identifies accurate and diverse methods for each time series. The outputs of the two modules are then combined and the entire neural network is jointly trained by minimizing a custom loss function via gradient descent optimization. Experimental results on a large set of series from the M4 competition dataset and from real road traffic data show that our proposal enhances point forecast accuracy compared to state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [831] [MACCA: Offline Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning with Causal Credit Assignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.03644)
*Ziyan Wang,Yali Du,Yudi Zhang,Meng Fang,Biwei Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为MACCA的离线多智能体强化学习框架，通过动态贝叶斯网络建模生成过程，利用因果分析实现智能体间的信用分配，在理论上证明了因果结构和个体奖励函数的可识别性，实验表明该方法优于现有方法且可模块化集成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线多智能体强化学习中，由于无法与环境交互，独立学习下的信用分配面临挑战，现有方法难以准确评估各智能体的贡献。

Method: 将生成过程建模为动态贝叶斯网络，捕捉环境变量、状态、动作和奖励之间的因果关系，通过离线数据估计模型，利用因果分析学习各智能体的个体奖励贡献。

Result: 在离线数据集设置下，证明了底层因果结构和智能体个体奖励生成函数的可识别性；实验表明MACCA在性能上超越现有方法，并能作为模块增强其他基线方法。

Conclusion: MACCA通过因果建模实现了准确且可解释的信用分配，具有良好的模块化特性，为离线MARL提供了一种有效且通用的解决方案。

Abstract: Offline Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is valuable in scenarios where online interaction is impractical or risky. While independent learning in MARL offers flexibility and scalability, accurately assigning credit to individual agents in offline settings poses challenges because interactions with an environment are prohibited. In this paper, we propose a new framework, namely Multi-Agent Causal Credit Assignment (MACCA), to address credit assignment in the offline MARL setting. Our approach, MACCA, characterizing the generative process as a Dynamic Bayesian Network, captures relationships between environmental variables, states, actions, and rewards. Estimating this model on offline data, MACCA can learn each agent's contribution by analyzing the causal relationship of their individual rewards, ensuring accurate and interpretable credit assignment. Additionally, the modularity of our approach allows it to integrate with various offline MARL methods seamlessly. Theoretically, we proved that under the setting of the offline dataset, the underlying causal structure and the function for generating the individual rewards of agents are identifiable, which laid the foundation for the correctness of our modeling. In our experiments, we demonstrate that MACCA not only outperforms state-of-the-art methods but also enhances performance when integrated with other backbones.

</details>


### [832] [AutoEval Done Right: Using Synthetic Data for Model Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.07008)
*Pierre Boyeau,Anastasios N. Angelopoulos,Nir Yosef,Jitendra Malik,Michael I. Jordan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出利用AI标注的合成数据（自动评估）来减少机器学习模型评估所需的人工标注量，并设计了高效且统计无偏的算法，在GPT-4实验中有效人工样本量提升高达50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用人工标注的验证数据评估机器学习模型成本高且耗时，因此希望利用AI生成的合成数据来减少所需的人工标注量，降低评估成本。

Method: 提出高效且统计上有原则的算法，利用AI标注的合成数据（自动评估）来减少人工标注需求，同时保持无偏性，提升样本效率。

Result: 在GPT-4的实验中，有效人工标注样本量提升了高达50%。

Conclusion: 所提出的算法能够在保持无偏性的前提下显著提高样本效率，有效降低模型评估中的人工标注成本。

Abstract: The evaluation of machine learning models using human-labeled validation data can be expensive and time-consuming. AI-labeled synthetic data can be used to decrease the number of human annotations required for this purpose in a process called autoevaluation. We suggest efficient and statistically principled algorithms for this purpose that improve sample efficiency while remaining unbiased. These algorithms increase the effective human-labeled sample size by up to 50% on experiments with GPT-4.

</details>


### [833] [Practical Aspects on Solving Differential Equations Using Deep Learning: A Primer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.11266)
*Georgios Is. Detorakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为数学、物理等专业的学生和教师提供了深度学习求解偏微分方程的入门指南，涵盖神经网络、反向传播、通用逼近定理等核心概念，重点介绍了Deep Galerkin方法及其在科学计算中的应用，所有示例均可在无GPU的机器上运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 帮助数学、物理及相关领域的本科生和研究生学习如何使用深度学习求解偏微分方程，并为教师提供教学材料，降低科学深度学习的入门门槛。

Method: 通过介绍深度学习核心概念（神经网络、反向传播、通用逼近定理），重点讲解Deep Galerkin方法，并讨论超参数选择、精度提升和收敛加速等实践问题。

Result: 所有示例问题无需GPU即可求解，使任何学生都能复现文中的方法论。

Conclusion: 本文为科学深度学习提供了易于上手的教学资源，降低了深度学习求解微分方程的学习门槛。

Abstract: Deep learning is now common across many scientific fields, including the study of partial differential equations. This article provides a brief, accessible introduction to core deep learning concepts, including neural networks, backpropagation, and the universal approximation theorem. It mainly covers how to use deep learning in solving differential equations. The article aims to help undergraduate and graduate students in mathematics, physics, and related areas learn how to use Deep Learning to solve partial differential equations. Instructors in mathematics or physics can also use this article to introduce students to Deep Galerkin method and scientific deep learning. We focus on key questions: What is deep learning, and how can it help solve mathematical or physical problems? How can you implement a neural network and choose the right numerical method to solve differential equations? How do you select the best hyperparameters? How can you improve accuracy and speed up convergence? We should mention that all the problems in this article can be solved on a machine without a GPU, so any student can follow the presented methodology.

</details>


### [834] [Random Erasing vs. Model Inversion: A Promising Defense or a False Hope?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.01062)
*Viet-Hung Tran,Ngoc-Bao Nguyen,Son T. Mai,Hans Vandierendonck,Ira Assent,Alex Kot,Ngai-Man Cheung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现随机擦除（Random Erasing, RE）作为一种数据增强技术，能有效防御模型反转（Model Inversion, MI）攻击。通过特征空间分析发现，RE训练后的模型会使MI重构图像与真实私有数据的特征产生显著偏差，同时保持私有图像特征的类别可分性。部分擦除和随机位置这两个关键特性分别破坏了MI重构完整目标和实现隐私-效用权衡。在37种实验设置下达到SOTA性能，首次实现了不降低模型效用的情况下显著降低攻击精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MI防御主要关注模型层面的方法，数据对MI鲁棒性的影响尚未被充分探索。本文旨在探索数据增强技术——随机擦除（RE）对MI攻击的防御效果及其内在机制。

Method: 1) 将随机擦除（RE）应用于训练数据；2) 通过特征空间分析揭示RE的防御机制：RE使MI重构图像与真实私有数据的特征产生显著偏差，同时保持私有图像特征的类别可分性；3) 探究RE的两个关键属性：部分擦除（防止模型看到完整物体）和随机位置（实现强隐私-效用权衡）。

Result: 在37种实验设置下达到SOTA隐私-效用权衡性能；首次实现不降低模型效用的情况下显著降低攻击精度；在不同MI攻击方法、网络架构和攻击配置下均优于现有防御方法。

Conclusion: 随机擦除是一种简单而有效的MI防御机制，可以轻松与现有隐私保护技术集成，为数据层面的隐私保护提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Model Inversion (MI) attacks pose a significant privacy threat by reconstructing private training data from machine learning models. While existing defenses primarily concentrate on model-centric approaches, the impact of data on MI robustness remains largely unexplored. In this work, we explore Random Erasing (RE), a technique traditionally used for improving model generalization under occlusion, and uncover its surprising effectiveness as a defense against MI attacks. Specifically, our novel feature space analysis shows that models trained with RE-images introduce a significant discrepancy between the features of MI-reconstructed images and those of the private data. At the same time, features of private images remain distinct from other classes and well-separated from different classification regions. These effects collectively degrade MI reconstruction quality and attack accuracy while maintaining reasonable natural accuracy. Furthermore, we explore two critical properties of RE including Partial Erasure and Random Location. Partial Erasure prevents the model from observing entire objects during training. We find this has a significant impact on MI, which aims to reconstruct the entire objects. Random Location of erasure plays a crucial role in achieving a strong privacy-utility trade-off. Our findings highlight RE as a simple yet effective defense mechanism that can be easily integrated with existing privacy-preserving techniques. Extensive experiments across 37 setups demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in the privacy-utility trade-off. The results consistently demonstrate the superiority of our defense over existing methods across different MI attacks, network architectures, and attack configurations. For the first time, we achieve a significant degradation in attack accuracy without a decrease in utility for some configurations.

</details>


### [835] [Towards Stable, Globally Expressive Graph Representations with Laplacian Eigenvectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.09737)
*Junru Zhou,Cai Zhou,Xiyuan Wang,Pan Li,Muhan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种利用拉普拉斯特征向量生成稳定且全局表达性强的图表示的新方法。核心创新包括：(i) 使用可学习的O(p)群不变编码器处理p维特征空间，替代传统朴素方法；(ii) 对数值相近的特征值进行平滑处理，增强对扰动的鲁棒性。实验表明该方法在各类图学习基准上具有竞争力，尤其擅长学习图的全局属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拉普拉斯特征向量作为附加节点特征虽能提升GNN表达能力，但其正交群对称性处理不当会导致表达性损失和数值不稳定性。现有方法使用朴素的O(p)-群不变编码器存在性能瓶颈，亟需一种既能保持O(p)不变性又能提升表达能力和数值稳定性的方法。

Method: (i) 利用成熟的O(p)等变神经网络层构建可学习的O(p)不变表示，用于每个p维拉普拉斯特征空间；(ii) 对数值接近的特征值采用平滑处理策略，提高对扰动的鲁棒性。

Result: 在多种图学习基准上取得具有竞争力的性能，尤其在捕捉图的全局属性方面表现出色。

Conclusion: 可学习的O(p)不变编码器结合特征值平滑处理，能有效提升拉普拉斯特征向量增强型GNN的表达能力和稳定性，为图表示学习提供了一种兼顾全局表达性与鲁棒性的新范式。

Abstract: A popular way to improve the expressive power of graph neural networks (GNNs) is to use Laplacian eigenvectors as additional node features, since they can serve both as structural identifiers and global coordinates of nodes. Properly handling the orthogonal group symmetry among eigenvectors is crucial for the stability and generalizability of Laplacian eigenvector augmented GNNs. Previous studies have shown that using a naive $O(p)$-group invariant encoder for each $p$-dimensional eigenspace often leads to expressivity loss and numerical instability. In this paper, we propose a novel method exploiting Laplacian eigenvectors to generate \emph{stable} and globally \emph{expressive} graph representations. The main difference from previous works is that (i) our method utilizes \textbf{learnable} $O(p)$-invariant representations for each Laplacian eigenspace of dimension $p$, which are built upon powerful orthogonal group equivariant neural network layers already well studied in the literature, and that (ii) our method deals with numerically close eigenvalues in a \textbf{smooth} fashion, ensuring its better robustness against perturbations. Experiments on various graph learning benchmarks witness the competitive performance of our method, especially its great potential to learn global properties of graphs.

</details>


### [836] [Learning Fine-grained Parameter Sharing via Sparse Tensor Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.09816)
*Cem Üyük,Mike Lasby,Mohamed Yassin,Utku Evci,Yani Ioannou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FiPS（细粒度参数共享）框架，通过跨块参数共享、低秩分解和稀疏性的联合优化，实现了对Transformer MLP层的高效压缩。FiPS在ViT上最高压缩57%仅损失<1%精度，在LLM上压缩20%且优于现有SVD方法，结合量化训练可在3-bit下达到8倍压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型神经网络在资源受限设备上部署困难，现有压缩方法中跨层参数共享在Transformer模型上探索不足。

Method: 将多个Transformer块的MLP权重矩阵拼接后分解为共享基矩阵和稀疏的层特定投影矩阵，通过SVD初始化，以块级重构误差最小化联合优化，同时支持与量化感知训练结合。

Result: ViT上压缩33%~57%仅损失<1%精度；LLM上压缩20%且困惑度与下游基准优于现有SVD方法；3-bit FiPS在Gemma-2-2B上以8倍压缩优于2-bit QAT的困惑度。

Conclusion: 细粒度参数共享是一种实用且有效的Transformer MLP压缩方法。

Abstract: Large neural networks achieve state-of-the-art performance on many tasks, yet their sheer size hinders deployment on resource-constrained devices. Among existing compression approaches, cross-layer parameter sharing remains relatively unexplored for transformer models. In this paper, we introduce Fine-grained Parameter Sharing (FiPS), a unified framework for compressing transformer Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) that combines cross-block parameter sharing, low-rank factorization, and sparsity in a single optimization. FiPS concatenates MLP weight matrices across a group of transformer blocks and factorizes them into a shared basis and sparse, layer-specific projection matrices. Both factors are initialized via singular value decomposition (SVD) and jointly optimized by block-wise reconstruction error minimization. FiPS compresses Vision Transformers (ViTs) by up to 33% with less than 1% top-1 accuracy loss on ImageNet-1k, and by up to 57% when combined with fine-tuning. It also compresses Large Language Models (LLMs) by up to 20% while outperforming existing SVD-based methods in perplexity and downstream benchmarks at matched compression. Combined with Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), 3-bit FiPS on Gemma-2-2B achieves lower perplexity than 2-bit QAT alone while matching the same 8x compression. These results establish fine-grained parameter sharing as a practical and effective approach for transformer MLP compression.

</details>


### [837] [Implicit Regularization for Multi-label Feature Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.11436)
*Dou El Kefel Mansouri,Khalid Benabdeslem,Seif-Eddine Benkabou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于隐式正则化和标签嵌入的多标签特征选择方法，通过Hadamard积参数化替代传统的显式正则化项（如l_{2,1}范数、MCP、SCAD），并利用多标签信息的潜在语义指导特征选择。实验表明该方法偏差更小，且可能导致良性过拟合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多标签学习中特征选择问题，传统稀疏特征选择方法使用显式正则化项（如l_{2,1}范数、MCP、SCAD）会引入额外偏差，需要探索一种减少偏差的特征选择方法。

Method: 基于Hadamard积参数化的隐式正则化方法，结合多标签信息的潜在语义（标签嵌入）来指导特征选择过程。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，该方法相比传统显式正则化方法偏差更小，且可能产生良性过拟合现象。

Conclusion: 隐式正则化结合标签嵌入的Hadamard积参数化方法是一种有效的多标签特征选择替代方案，能减少额外偏差。

Abstract: In this paper, we address the problem of feature selection in the context of multi-label learning, by using a new estimator based on implicit regularization and label embedding. Unlike the sparse feature selection methods that use a penalized estimator with explicit regularization terms such as $l_{2,1}$-norm, MCP or SCAD, we propose a simple alternative method via Hadamard product parameterization. In order to guide the feature selection process, a latent semantic of multi-label information method is adopted, as a label embedding. Experimental results on some known benchmark datasets suggest that the proposed estimator suffers much less from extra bias, and may lead to benign overfitting.

</details>


### [838] [Nonlinear Equilibrium Transitions in a Potential Game Model for Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.11793)
*Kang Liu,Ziqi Wang,Enrique Zuazua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种势博弈框架来研究联邦学习中客户端基于理性自利选择训练努力的问题，证明了纳什均衡的存在性、唯一性条件，发现了奖励因子临界值导致的非光滑跃迁现象，并验证了最佳响应算法的收敛性及临界奖励因子的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从市场导向视角出发，研究联邦学习中客户端基于理性自利独立选择训练努力的问题，而非传统FL中由中央服务器统一分配训练任务。

Method: 提出势博弈框架，客户端收益由个体努力和服务器奖励共同决定；建立纳什均衡存在性及唯一性条件；分析奖励因子临界值处的非线性跃迁；证明最佳响应算法收敛性。

Result: 纳什均衡随奖励因子呈非线性变化，在临界值处出现非光滑跃迁，低努力和高努力分支间存在跳跃；最佳响应算法收敛；临界奖励因子在真实数据集上得到验证。

Conclusion: 该势博弈框架有效刻画了理性客户端在FL中的自利行为，临界奖励因子可作为激励机制设计的重要参考。

Abstract: In federated learning (FL), a central server typically allocates training efforts to clients. However, from a market-oriented perspective, clients may independently choose their training efforts based on rational self-interest. To study this setting, we propose a potential game framework in which each client's payoff is determined by its individual effort and the rewards provided by the server. The rewards are influenced by the collective efforts of all clients and can be modulated by a reward factor. We first establish the existence of Nash equilibria (NEs) and then investigate their uniqueness in a stationary setting. We show that the NEs depend nonlinearly on the reward factor and exhibit a nonsmooth transition at a critical value, where the stationary potential loses strict curvature, leading to nonunique NEs and a jump between low-effort and high-effort branches. Furthermore, we prove the convergence of the best-response algorithm for computing NEs in our FL game. Finally, we apply the clients' rational efforts derived from the NEs to FL training with various datasets and models, thereby validating the effectiveness of the identified critical reward factor.

</details>


### [839] [A Foundation Model for Wearable Movement Data in Mental Health Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.15240)
*Franklin Y. Ruan,Aiwei Zhang,Jenny Y. Oh,SouYoung Jin,Nicholas C. Jacobson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Pretrained Actigraphy Transformer (PAT)，一种基于自监督掩码自编码器预训练的穿戴式运动时间序列基础模型，在NHANES队列（21,538名参与者）上预训练，在精神健康预测任务（苯二氮卓类药物使用、SSRI使用、抑郁、睡眠异常）中显著优于LSTM、1D-CNN和ConvLSTM等非基础模型，并提供可解释的注意力图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 穿戴式运动数据虽广泛可用且蕴含细粒度行为信息，但健康穿戴建模领域的基础模型发展远落后于临床图像和文本分析，缺乏可复现、可部署的时序基础模型。

Method: 采用带补丁嵌入的Transformer架构，结合自监督掩码自编码器预训练策略，在分钟级、周长的体动记录仪（actigraphy）序列上进行预训练。

Result: 在苯二氮卓类药物预测任务中，PAT较LSTM提升55.6%，较1D-CNN提升21.4%，较ConvLSTM提升14.8%；在SSRI使用、抑郁、睡眠异常等任务中也持续优于基线模型。

Conclusion: PAT是一种易于部署、可扩展的开源基础模型，能够从穿戴式传感器数据中提取临床洞察，兼具预测性能与模型可解释性。

Abstract: Wearable movement data is collected by nearly all commercially available smartwatches and is a valuable resource for mental health research, reflecting fine-grained temporal behavioral trends. Despite its promise, the development of foundation models for health wearable modeling remains limited when compared to clinical image and text analysis. We designed transformers with patch embeddings and used self-supervised masked autoencoder pretraining on minute-level week-long actigraphy (physical activity intensity measurement) sequences to develop and evaluate the Pretrained Actigraphy Transformer (PAT). PAT is an open-source foundation model for wearable movement time series that combines week-long temporal modeling, psychiatric outcome evaluation, and reproducibility on public data. Pretrained on data from 21,538 U.S. participants in a nationally representative cohort from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES), PAT consistently outperformed non-foundation-model baselines across mental health prediction tasks-including benzodiazepine and SSRI use, depression, and sleep abnormalities. During the benzodiazepine medication usage prediction task, PAT demonstrated the largest improvement over non-foundational deep learning models commonly used for time-series modeling (i.e., 55.6% improvement over the LSTM, 21.4% improvement over the 1-D CNN, 14.8% improvement over the ConvLSTM). Beyond predictive accuracy, PAT provides interpretable attention maps highlighting specific periods of daily activity most important for clinical predictions, offering model transparency and potential clinical insights. The results suggest that PAT offers an easy-to-deploy, adaptable and scalable solution to advance clinical insight from wearable sensor data for researchers and clinicians.
  GitHub: https://github.com/njacobsonlab/Pretrained-Actigraphy-Transformer/

</details>


### [840] [Fixed-Mean Gaussian Processes for Post-hoc Bayesian Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.04177)
*Luis A. Ortega,Simón Rodríguez-Santana,Daniel Hernández-Lobato*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为固定均值高斯过程（FMGP）的方法，通过将预训练深度神经网络的输出固定为高斯过程的后验均值，利用稀疏变分推断高效估计预测方差，从而在不影响原始模型精度的前提下实现后验不确定性估计，方法架构无关且可扩展至ImageNet等大规模数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对预训练深度神经网络的后验不确定性估计需求日益增长，现有方法需在不损害原始模型精度的情况下添加置信度度量（如误差棒），亟需一种高效、架构无关且可扩展的方法。

Method: 提出固定均值高斯过程（FMGP），使用通用核函数将GP的后验均值固定为预训练DNN的输出函数，通过变分推断（VI）进行高效随机优化，训练成本与训练样本数量无关，仅依赖预训练模型输出调整预测方差。

Result: 实验表明，FMGP在不确定性估计和计算效率上均优于现有的DNN后验贝叶斯推断方法。

Conclusion: FMGP是一种架构无关、高效可扩展的后验不确定性估计方法，为预训练DNN提供有效的置信度度量，适合大规模数据集应用。

Abstract: Recently, there has been an increasing interest in performing post-hoc uncertainty estimation about the predictions of pre-trained deep neural networks (DNNs). Given a pre-trained DNN via back-propagation, these methods enhance the original network by adding output confidence measures, such as error bars, without compromising its initial accuracy. In this context, we introduce a novel family of sparse variational Gaussian processes (GPs), where the posterior mean is fixed to any continuous function when using a universal kernel. Specifically, we fix the mean of this GP to the output of the pre-trained DNN, allowing our approach to effectively fit the GP's predictive variances to estimate the DNN prediction uncertainty. Our approach leverages variational inference (VI) for efficient stochastic optimization, with training costs that remain independent of the number of training points, scaling efficiently to large datasets such as ImageNet. The proposed method, called fixed-mean GP (FMGP), is architecture-agnostic, relying solely on the pre-trained model's outputs to adjust the predictive variances. Experimental results demonstrate that FMGP improves both uncertainty estimation and computational efficiency when compared to state-of-the-art methods for DNN post-hoc Bayesian inference.

</details>


### [841] [OP-LoRA: The Blessing of Dimensionality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.10362)
*Piotr Teterwak,Kate Saenko,Bryan A. Plummer,Ser-Nam Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OP-LoRA提出用额外的MLP预测LoRA适配器权重，训练后丢弃MLP，在不增加推理开销的情况下改善优化条件，在图像生成任务上CMMD分数提升高达15点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA适配器常面临病态损失景观（ill-conditioned loss landscape），导致优化困难。现有方法通过自定义优化器对齐适配器更新与全微调梯度，但缺乏对新适配器架构的灵活性且计算成本高。

Method: 用额外的MLP预测每个LoRA适配器的权重，训练后丢弃MLP。MLP在训练期间引入额外参数以改善优化，扩展到新适配器只需修改预测头大小。该方法允许优化自适应调整步长。

Result: 在小规模和大规模LoRA微调任务中持续优于LoRA及其变体；图像生成任务中CMMD分数提升高达15点；可使用一半推理参数达到LoRA的性能。

Conclusion: OP-LoRA是一种灵活、计算高效的方法，能改善LoRA优化条件，降低对学习率的敏感性，且零额外推理成本。

Abstract: Low-rank adapters (LoRA) enable finetuning of large models with only a small number of parameters. However, they often suffer from an ill-conditioned loss landscape, leading to difficult optimization. Prior work addresses these challenges by aligning adapter updates with full finetuning gradients via custom optimizers, but these methods lack the flexibility to accommodate new adapter architectures and are computationally expensive. We instead introduce OP-LoRA, a novel method which replaces each LoRA adapter with weights predicted by an extra MLP, which is discarded after training. This temporarily allows additional parameters during training to improve optimization, yet requires less wall time than custom optimizers and zero extra cost at inference time because the MLP is discarded. Crucially, extending OP-LoRA to other adapters is as simple as modifying the size of the prediction head for each new adapter type. We show that OP-LoRA allows the optimization to adaptively increase or decrease step size, improving performance and decreasing sensitivity to learning rate. On both small and large-scale LoRA tuning tasks, we observe consistent performance gains of OP-LoRA relative to LoRA and its variants. We achieve especially notable improvements in image generation, with OP-LoRA CMMD scores improving by up to 15 points relative to LoRA. This allows OP-LoRA to achieve the performance of LoRA with half of the inference parameters.

</details>


### [842] [Challenges in the calibration of tree-based models for imbalanced classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.16209)
*Nathan Phelps,Daniel J. Lizotte,Douglas G. Woolford*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了随机森林在类别不平衡问题中使用下采样策略后，再进行解析校准会导致严重问题：患病率估计受到随机森林中每次分裂考虑的预测变量数量和采样率的双重影响，且决策树可能存在偏向少数类的偏差，表明基于树的模型不应使用解析校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决机器学习中不平衡二分类问题时，常用下采样技术平衡训练数据，但这会导致模型预测偏差。虽然已有通过采样率进行解析映射的校准方法，但其在树模型上的适用性和潜在问题尚未被充分研究。

Method: 通过理论分析和实验验证，研究随机森林在下采样后使用解析校准的影响，揭示预测变量数量（mtry）和采样率如何影响校准结果，并证明决策树可能存在偏向少数类的偏差。

Result: 解析校准后的随机森林存在两个问题：1）患病率估计依赖于mtry参数；2）决策树可能存在偏向少数类的偏差，这与多数文献观点相悖。这些问题表明解析校准不适用于树模型。

Conclusion: 基于树的模型（如随机森林）在欠采样后不应使用解析校准，而应改用能够学习原始模型中校准偏差模式的方法（如beta校准）。

Abstract: When using machine learning for imbalanced binary classification problems, it is common to subsample the majority class to create a (more) balanced training dataset. This biases the model's predictions because the model learns from data that is not fully representative of the underlying population of interest. One way of accounting for this bias is analytically mapping the resulting predictions to new values based on the sampling rate for the majority class. We show that calibrating a random forest this way has negative consequences, including prevalence estimates that depend on both the number of predictors considered at each split in the random forest and the sampling rate used. We explain the former using known properties of random forests and analytical calibration and the latter by demonstrating a bias in decision trees. In contradiction with much of the existing literature, we show that decision trees can be biased towards the minority class. These issues indicate that tree-based models trained on undersampled data should not be calibrated analytically. Calibration approaches that can learn a miscalibration pattern in the original model (e.g., beta calibration) are more suitable.

</details>


### [843] [Introduction to Graph Neural Networks for Machine Learning Engineers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.19419)
*James H. Tanis,Chris Giannella,Adrian V. Mariano,Daoud Meerzaman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过编码器-解码器框架系统综述了图神经网络，并通过理论和大量实验分析了不同训练规模和图复杂度下模型的行为，特别关注过平滑和过挤压问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络在多种任务上表现优异，相关研究快速增长，但缺乏对其在不同训练条件和图复杂度下行为的系统理解，特别是过平滑和过挤压等关键问题。

Method: 采用编码器-解码器框架统一介绍图神经网络，针对同质图设计多种解码器用于不同图分析任务，并通过理论分析和大量实验研究训练规模与图复杂度的影响。

Result: 揭示了图神经网络在不同训练规模和图复杂度下的行为特征，重点阐明过平滑和过挤压现象的发生机制与影响。

Conclusion: 图神经网络的性能受训练规模和图复杂度显著影响，过平滑和过挤压是限制模型深度的关键问题，为图神经网络的设计和优化提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Graph neural networks are deep neural networks designed for graphs with attributes attached to nodes or edges. The number of research papers in the literature concerning these models is growing rapidly due to their impressive performance on a broad range of tasks. This survey introduces graph neural networks through the encoder-decoder framework and provides examples of decoders for a range of graph analytic tasks. It uses theory and numerous experiments on homogeneous graphs to illustrate the behavior of graph neural networks under different training sizes and degrees of graph complexity, with an emphasis on oversmoothing and oversquashing.

</details>


### [844] [Towards Simple and Provable Parameter-Free Adaptive Gradient Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.19444)
*Yuanzhe Tao,Yifeng Liu,Huizhuo Yuan,Xun Zhou,Yuan Cao,Quanquan Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AdaGrad++和Adam++，是AdaGrad和Adam的简单且免调参变体，具有收敛保证，实验证明性能优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有优化算法如AdaGrad和Adam需要手动调整学习率，效率低下；现有免调参变体过于复杂或缺乏收敛保证。

Method: 提出AdaGrad++和Adam++，作为AdaGrad和Adam的简单免调参变体，并提供收敛性理论证明。

Result: AdaGrad++在凸优化中达到与AdaGrad相当的收敛率，无需预定义学习率假设；Adam++匹配Adam的收敛率且无需学习率条件。实验验证Adam++性能有竞争力。

Conclusion: 提出的免调参优化器简单有效，兼具理论保证和实际性能。

Abstract: Optimization algorithms such as AdaGrad and Adam have significantly advanced the training of deep models by dynamically adjusting the learning rate during the optimization process. However, ad-hoc tuning of learning rates poses a challenge and leads to inefficiencies in practice. To address this issue, recent research has focused on developing ``parameter-free'' algorithms that operate effectively without the need for learning rate tuning. Despite these efforts, existing parameter-free variants of AdaGrad and Adam tend to be overly complex and/or lack formal convergence guarantees. In this paper, we present AdaGrad++ and Adam++, novel and simple parameter-free variants of AdaGrad and Adam with convergence guarantees. We prove that AdaGrad++ achieves comparable convergence rates to AdaGrad in convex optimization without predefined learning rate assumptions. Similarly, Adam++ matches the convergence rate of Adam without relying on any conditions on the learning rates. Experimental results across various deep learning tasks validate the competitive performance of Adam++.

</details>


### [845] [Quantum Reservoir Computing and Risk Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.08640)
*Naomi Mona Chmielewski,Nina Amini,Joseph Mikael*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文利用Rademacher复杂度对几类量子储层计算模型的泛化误差进行上界估计，给出了两类特定量子储层的参数依赖界，分析了泛化界随量子比特数增长的标度律，发现多项式读出函数类的风险界随训练样本数收敛，但泛化界随量子比特数n呈指数增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子储层计算作为量子机器学习的重要范式，其泛化能力缺乏严格的理论保证。作者旨在建立量子储层学习理论的统计学习基础，通过Rademacher复杂度工具定量刻画不同量子储层类的泛化误差上界。

Method: 采用统计学习理论中的Rademacher复杂度框架，对量子储层的动力学过程和读出函数施加若干假设条件，推导出泛化误差的泛化界。针对两类具体的量子储层模型（含多项式读出函数）给出参数依赖的显式界，并分析其与量子比特数n、训练样本数等关键参数的标度关系。

Result: 得到了两类量子储层的参数依赖泛化界；多项式读出函数类的风险界随训练样本数收敛；但泛化界随量子比特数n呈指数增长。所提出的Rademacher复杂度上界方法可推广至满足相关假设的其他量子储层类。

Conclusion: Rademacher复杂度为量子储层泛化分析提供了有效工具，所得界中的显式参数依赖可用于一定程度上控制泛化误差，但指数量子比特依赖表明量子优势可能面临泛化瓶颈，需要进一步研究更紧的界或特殊结构的量子储层。

Abstract: We propose a way to bound the generalisation errors of several classes of quantum reservoirs using the Rademacher complexity. We give specific, parameter-dependent bounds for two particular quantum reservoir classes. We analyse how the generalisation bounds scale with growing numbers of qubits. Applying our results to classes with polynomial readout functions, we find that the risk bounds converge in the number of training samples. The explicit dependence on the quantum reservoir and readout parameters in our bounds can be used to control the generalisation error to a certain extent. It should be noted that the bounds scale exponentially with the number of qubits n. The upper bounds on the Rademacher complexity can be applied to other reservoir classes that fulfill a few hypotheses on the quantum dynamics and the readout function.

</details>


### [846] [Efficient Weighted Sampling via Score-based Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.04646)
*Heasung Kim,Taekyun Lee,Hyeji Kim,Gustavo de Veciana*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需额外训练的加权采样框架，通过向预训练得分生成模型(SGM)的逆向扩散过程添加轻量级辅助引导项，实现了对目标分布的加权采样，避免了粒子重采样或Hessian计算，在Stable Diffusion XL等大规模任务上实现1.2×到4.7×加速并保持或超越基线性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加权采样是方差缩减、有偏采样、数据增强等任务中的基础技术，现有方法通常依赖粒子重采样或Hessian评估，计算成本高。随着预训练SGM的普及，如何利用已有生成模型高效实现加权采样成为关键问题。

Method: 提出两个核心组件：1）轻量级引导近似，避免对得分函数和权函数的高阶导数计算；2）不确定性感知调度器，基于近似误差的时间分析动态调整引导强度，实现无需训练的加权采样。

Result: 在合成数据到大规模Stable Diffusion XL任务中，该方法实现1.2×到4.7×的加速，且性能一致匹配或超越现有最先进基线方法。

Conclusion: 该方法是一种可扩展且推理高效的解决方案，适用于任务自适应和时间敏感的生成式采样应用。

Abstract: Weighted sampling -- sampling from a probability density function (PDF) proportional to the product of a base PDF and a weight function -- is a fundamental technique with wide-ranging applications in variance reduction, biased sampling, data augmentation, and more. Leveraging the increasing availability of pretrained score-based generative models (SGMs), we propose a training-free weighted sampling framework that approximates the backward diffusion process of the target distribution by augmenting the pretrained base score function with an auxiliary guidance term, in a principled and computationally efficient manner. Our approach builds on two key components: a lightweight approximation of the guidance that avoids costly higher-order derivatives of both the score and weight functions, and an uncertainty-aware scheduler that dynamically adjusts the guidance strength based on a temporal analysis of approximation error. Together, these components enable accurate and stable sampling without relying on particle-based resampling or Hessian evaluations commonly required by existing methods. We validate the effectiveness of our method from synthetic to large-scale settings such as Stable Diffusion XL, where our framework achieves $1.2\times$ to $4.7\times$ speedups while consistently matching or outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in task performance. These results position our method as a scalable and inference-efficient solution for task-adaptive, time-sensitive sampling in generative applications.

</details>


### [847] [Efficient LLM Moderation with Multi-Layer Latent Prototypes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.16174)
*Maciej Chrabąszcz,Filip Szatkowski,Bartosz Wójcik,Jan Dubiński,Tomasz Trzciński,Sebastian Cygert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为MLPM的轻量级、高可定制性的输入审核工具，通过利用多层中间表示的原型来提升审核质量，在保持高效率的同时实现最先进的性能，并能无缝集成到端到端审核流程中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型对齐方法在部署时仍需安全审核，但现有方法存在性能与效率的权衡问题，且难以根据用户特定需求进行定制化。

Method: MLPM（多层原型审核器）：利用多层级中间表示的原型（prototype）进行输入审核，设计轻量级结构，对生成流水线增加极少开销，可无缝应用于任何模型。

Result: 在多个审核基准上达到最先进性能，在不同规模模型家族上展现出强可扩展性，并能与输出审核技术结合进一步提升响应安全性。

Conclusion: MLPM为大语言模型的安全、鲁棒且高效的部署提供了一种实用且可适配的解决方案。

Abstract: Although modern LLMs are aligned with human values during post-training, robust moderation remains essential to prevent harmful outputs at deployment time. Existing approaches suffer from performance-efficiency trade-offs and are difficult to customize to user-specific requirements. Motivated by this gap, we introduce Multi-Layer Prototype Moderator (MLPM), a lightweight and highly customizable input moderation tool. We propose leveraging prototypes of intermediate representations across multiple layers to improve moderation quality while maintaining high efficiency. By design, our method adds negligible overhead to the generation pipeline and can be seamlessly applied to any model. MLPM achieves state-of-the-art performance on diverse moderation benchmarks and demonstrates strong scalability across model families of various sizes. Moreover, we show that it integrates smoothly into end-to-end moderation pipelines and further improves response safety when combined with output moderation techniques. Overall, our work provides a practical and adaptable solution for safe, robust, and efficient LLM deployment.

</details>


### [848] [Position: Neglecting the Sustainability of AI is Fuelling a Global AI Arms Race](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.20016)
*Pedram Bakhtiarifard,Pınar Tözün,Christian Igel,Raghavendra Selvan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出当前可持续AI讨论过度聚焦环境维度而忽视社会与经济维度，并基于马克思历史唯物主义的底座-上层建筑框架分析AI发展中的物质条件与意识形态矛盾，提出气候与资源感知机器学习（CARAML）框架，涵盖个人到全球层面的可操作建议，以调和气候意识与资源意识，实现真正可持续的AI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可持续AI话语主要关注环境可持续性，忽视了经济和社会维度，尤其是环境可持续性（减缓气候影响）与社会可持续性（公平获取AI开发资源）之间存在根本性张力，推动资源可及性常以牺牲环境为代价，这种失衡加剧了全球AI军备竞赛，亟需系统性解决方案。

Method: 采用立场论文形式，运用马克思历史唯物主义的底座-上层建筑框架（base-superstructure）分析AI进展及其话语背后的物质条件塑造作用，并提出CARAML框架，在个人、社区、产业、政府和全球层面给出可操作建议。

Result: 识别出气候意识与资源意识之间的矛盾是可持续AI的核心张力，揭示当前AI发展中的物质条件（计算资源、能源消耗、硬件制造等）与意识形态（发展话语、公平诉求）之间的结构性冲突。

Conclusion: 实现真正可持续的AI必须同时兼顾气候意识与资源意识，忽视这一平衡将加剧全球AI军备竞赛；CARAML框架为不同层面的行动者提供了调和两者矛盾的具体路径。

Abstract: Sustainability encompasses three key facets: economic, environmental, and social. However, the nascent discourse on sustainable artificial intelligence (AI) predominantly focuses on the environmental sustainability of AI, neglecting the economic and social aspects. Achieving truly sustainable AI necessitates addressing the tension between its environmental sustainability, which emphasises mitigating AI's climate impact, and its social sustainability, hinging on equitable access to AI development resources. This push for increased accessibility, however, often overlooks the environmental costs of expanding such resource usage. This position paper argues that reconciling climate awareness and resource awareness is essential to realising truly sustainable AI, and neglecting these factors fuels a global AI arms race. Applying Karl Marx's base-superstructure framework from historical materialism, we analyse how the material conditions are shaping the current AI progress and the discourse surrounding it. Further, we introduce the Climate and Resource Aware Machine Learning (CARAML) framework with actionable recommendations spanning individual, community, industry, government, and global levels to achieve sustainable AI.

</details>


### [849] [Ideas in Inference-time Scaling can Benefit Generative Pre-training Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.07154)
*Jiaming Song,Linqi Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文批判了自回归模型与扩散模型的虚假二分法，指出真正的区别在于离散token的交叉熵学习与连续token的扩散目标学习，以及相应的推理算法。主张应优先设计推理过程，再设计训练目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前学界常将生成式预训练置于自回归模型（离散信号）与扩散模型（连续信号）的二分框架下，作者认为这一二分法是误导性的，因为它混淆了模型族、数据表示、训练目标和推理过程四个不同维度。

Method: 通过概念辨析，将自回归定义为通过归一化条件采样进行序列扩展的推理过程，将扩散定义为反复修正现有状态的细化过程。提出应按推理效率的两个轴（序列扩展与状态细化）来指导算法设计，并主张先设计推理过程再设计训练目标。

Result: 揭示了DDIM风格采样器的目标时间限制、多token预测的联合分布限制，以及流映射和少步蒸馏方法通过直接参数化长程推理移动来克服这些限制。

Conclusion: 训练方法无法弥补推理映射中缺失必要参数或施加错误因式分解的问题，因此算法进步应优先关注推理时效率。

Abstract: Generative pre-training is often framed through a false dichotomy between autoregressive models for discrete signals and diffusion models for continuous signals. We argue that the dichotomy is false because it conflates model family, data representation, training objective, and inference procedure. Autoregression is an inference procedure that expands a sequence through normalized conditional draws, while diffusion is a refinement procedure that repeatedly revises an existing state. The more useful contrast is therefore not autoregressive versus diffusion, but discrete tokens learned with cross-entropy versus continuous tokens learned with diffusion-style objectives, together with the inference algorithms used to sample from them. From this perspective, algorithmic progress should prioritize inference-time efficiency along two axes: sequence expansion and state refinement. We advocate designing the inference procedure before the training objective, because a training method cannot compensate for an inference map that omits necessary arguments or imposes an incorrect factorization. We illustrate this principle through a target-time limitation of DDIM-style samplers, a joint-distribution limitation of multi-token prediction, and recent flow-map and few-step distillation methods that directly parameterize long-range inference moves.

</details>


### [850] [Non-vacuous Generalization Bounds for Deep Neural Networks without any modification to the trained models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.07325)
*Khoat Than,Dat Phan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一类新的数据依赖泛化界，可直接应用于未经任何修改的已训练深度神经网络（包括6亿参数的ImageNet规模模型），且在所有评估网络上均非平凡可计算。该方法将泛化误差分解为分布复杂度项和局部模型行为项，揭示了数据几何与模型行为的交互是泛化的关键驱动力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代深度神经网络的泛化行为理解与认证仍是可靠机器学习的基本挑战，现有方法难以对未经修改的大型深度网络提供有意义的泛化保证。

Method: 提出数据依赖的泛化界，将泛化误差分解为两个可解释分量：分布复杂度项（度量数据质量在输入空间的分布）和局部模型行为项（捕捉网络在局部区域内的行为），通过数据划分与内在数据几何的对齐来收紧界限。

Result: 所提泛化界在所有评估网络上（包括6亿参数的ImageNet模型）均非平凡可计算；部分分量对真实测试误差具有高度预测性；当划分与数据内在几何对齐时界更紧。

Conclusion: 数据依赖的局部正则性是泛化的关键驱动因素，首次证明即使对大规模、未经修改的深度网络也能获得有意义的泛化保证。

Abstract: Understanding and certifying the behavior of modern deep neural networks remains a fundamental challenge in reliable machine learning. We introduce a new class of data-dependent generalization bounds that apply directly to trained models, without any modification. In particular, we present an exactly computable bound that is non-vacuous across all evaluated networks, including ImageNet-scale models with 600M parameters. This this is the first work showing that meaningful generalization guarantees are achievable even for large, unaltered deep networks.
  Our approach reveals that generalization is governed by the interaction between the trained model and the geometry of the data distribution. We decompose the generalization error into two interpretable components: a distributional complexity term, capturing how the data mass is distributed across the input space, and local model-behavior terms, capturing the network's behavior within individual regions. This joint dependence identifies where and why generalization gaps arise. Empirically, some components of our bound are highly predictive of the true test error, and the bound tightens when the partition aligns with the intrinsic data geometry, highlighting data-dependent local regularity as a key driver of generalization.

</details>


### [851] [Interpretable Graph Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Multi-Cancer Classification and Biomarker Identification using Multi-Omics Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.22939)
*Fadi Alharbi,Nishant Budhiraja,Aleksandar Vakanski,Boyu Zhang,Murtada K. Elbashir,Harshith Guduru,Mohanad Mohammed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MOGKAN框架，整合mRNA、miRNA、DNA甲基化等多组学数据与PPI网络，利用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络架构进行31种癌症分类，准确率达96.28%，并通过功能富集分析验证了所识别生物标志物的临床相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构多组学数据在系统层面的整合仍是精准癌症诊断中分析与计算模型开发的中心挑战，现有方法在可解释性和特征分析方面存在不足。

Method: 使用DESeq2、LIMMA和LASSO进行差异表达分析与特征选择降维；构建基于Kolmogorov-Arnold定理的图神经网络架构，利用可训练单变量函数增强可解释性；整合PPI网络与多组学数据进行图级癌症分类。

Result: 在31种癌症类型分类中达到96.28%准确率，实验变异性低；通过GO和KEGG富集分析验证了所识别生物标志物为癌症相关标记。

Conclusion: MOGKAN通过多组学数据与图深度学习的整合，展现出鲁棒的预测性能和可解释性，有望推动复杂多组学数据向临床可操作的癌症诊断转化。

Abstract: The integration of heterogeneous multi-omics datasets at a systems level remains a central challenge for developing analytical and computational models in precision cancer diagnostics. This paper introduces Multi-Omics Graph Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (MOGKAN), a deep learning framework that utilizes messenger-RNA, micro-RNA sequences, and DNA methylation samples together with Protein-Protein Interaction (PPI) networks for cancer classification across 31 different cancer types. The proposed approach combines differential gene expression with DESeq2, Linear Models for Microarray (LIMMA), and Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO) regression to reduce multi-omics data dimensionality while preserving relevant biological features. The model architecture is based on the Kolmogorov-Arnold theorem principle and uses trainable univariate functions to enhance interpretability and feature analysis. MOGKAN achieves classification accuracy of 96.28 percent and exhibits low experimental variability in comparison to related deep learning-based models. The biomarkers identified by MOGKAN were validated as cancer-related markers through Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analysis. By integrating multi-omics data with graph-based deep learning, our proposed approach demonstrates robust predictive performance and interpretability with potential to enhance the translation of complex multi-omics data into clinically actionable cancer diagnostics.

</details>


### [852] [Scalable Ride-Sourcing Vehicle Rebalancing with Service Accessibility Guarantee: A Constrained Mean-Field Reinforcement Learning Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.24183)
*Matej Jusup,Kenan Zhang,Zhiyuan Hu,Barna Pásztor,Andreas Krause,Francesco Corman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于连续状态平均场控制(MFC)和平均场强化学习(MFRL)的网约车车辆再平衡方法，通过引入可访问性约束实现效率与公平的权衡，在深圳数据驱动仿真中可扩展到数万辆车，训练时间与线性规划相当，并在车队利用率、请求完成率和接驾距离等关键指标上优于传统基准方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网约车平台面临车辆再平衡这一核心运营挑战，即如何战略性地重新定位车队以解决供需时空错配问题。不充分的再平衡不仅导致乘客等待时间延长和车辆利用率低下，还会引发公平性问题，如服务分布不均和司机收入差距。

Method: 采用连续状态平均场控制(MFC)和平均场强化学习(MFRL)模型，通过每辆车与车辆分布的交互而非个体车辆交互来建模，缓解多智能体维数灾难。并引入可访问性约束，推导出在满足乘客需求与公平覆盖车辆供给之间取得平衡的再平衡策略。

Result: 在深圳数据驱动仿真中，该方法可扩展到数万辆车，训练时间与线性规划再平衡相当；所提策略能有效探索效率-公平帕累托前沿，在车队利用率、请求完成率和接驾距离等指标上优于传统基准方法，同时确保公平的服务可访问性。

Conclusion: 平均场控制与强化学习框架为大规模网约车再平衡问题提供了可扩展的解决方案，无需因车队规模变化而重新训练模型，并能有效兼顾运营效率与公平性。

Abstract: The expansion of ride-sourcing services such as Uber and Lyft has reshaped urban transportation by offering flexible, on-demand mobility via mobile applications. Despite convenience, these platforms confront significant operational challenges, particularly vehicle rebalancing-strategic repositioning of a fleet of vehicles to address spatiotemporal mismatches in supply and demand. Inadequate rebalancing results in prolonged rider waiting times and inefficient vehicle utilization, but also leads to fairness issues, such as the inequitable distribution of service and disparities in driver income. To tackle these, we introduce continuous-state mean-field control (MFC) and mean-field reinforcement learning (MFRL) models with continuous repositioning actions. MFC and MFRL offer scalable solutions by modeling each vehicle's behavior through interaction with the vehicle distribution, rather than with individual vehicles. This mitigates the curse of dimensionality with respect to the number of agents, enabling coordination across large fleets with significantly reduced computational complexity and eliminating the need to retrain the model when fleet size changes. To ensure equitable service access across geographic regions, we integrate an accessibility constraint into models and derive rebalancing policies that strike a balance between high fulfillment of rider demand and fair coverage of vehicle supply. Extensive evaluation using data-driven simulation of Shenzhen demonstrates the efficiency and robustness of our approach. Remarkably, it scales to tens of thousands of vehicles, with training times comparable to linear programming rebalancing. Besides, our policies effectively explore the efficiency-equity Pareto front, outperforming conventional benchmarks across key metrics like fleet utilization, fulfilled requests, and pickup distance, while ensuring equitable service access.

</details>


### [853] [GRANITE : a Byzantine-Resilient Dynamic Gossip Learning Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.17471)
*Yacine Belal,Mohamed Maouche,Sonia Ben Mokhtar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GRANITE是一个用于去中心化Gossip学习的鲁棒框架，通过动态调整聚合阈值和累积节点标识知识，有效防御拜占庭攻击和恶意节点对随机对等采样协议的操纵，在30%拜占庭节点下收敛精度接近非拜占庭场景的95%，同时降低9倍通信成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于动态通信图的Gossip学习方法虽然通过随机对等采样（RPS）加速了收敛，但易遭受双重攻击：拜占庭节点既投毒模型，又操纵对等采样以放大其影响力。现有方法缺乏对这种组合威胁的防御机制。

Method: GRANITE框架通过以下机制实现鲁棒学习：(1) 累积已知节点标识符的历史知识；(2) 基于估计的局部拜占庭密度动态调整聚合阈值，使得拜占庭节点在局部邻域中的存在呈现指数级衰减。

Result: (1) 拜占庭节点在局部邻域中的存在呈指数衰减；(2) 推导了GRANITE生成图的鲁棒性条件；(3) 在30%拜占庭节点下，收敛精度达到非拜占庭场景的95%以内；(4) 收敛速度更快；(5) 通信成本降低9倍。

Conclusion: GRANITE有效解决了去中心化Gossip学习中对双重攻击（模型投毒+对等采样操纵）的防御问题，实现了在稀疏动态图上的鲁棒学习，显著降低通信开销的同时保持了高精度和快速收敛。

Abstract: Gossip Learning (GL) is a decentralized learning paradigm where users iteratively exchange and aggregate models with a small set of neighboring peers. Recent approaches rely on dynamic communication graphs built using Random Peer Sampling (RPS) protocols which have been proven to accelerate convergence. However, we show that these approaches are vulnerable to a dual attack: Byzantine nodes can poison models and manipulate peer sampling to amplify their influence. We address this combination of threats with GRANITE, a framework for robust learning over sparse, dynamic graphs in the presence of Byzantine nodes. GRANITE accumulates knowledge about encountered node identifiers over time and dynamically adjusts local aggregation thresholds based on estimated Byzantine density in the neighbourhood of each node. We demonstrate that under GRANITE, the Byzantine presence in local neighborhoods exhibits an exponential decay. We further derive the robustness conditions of the graphs generated by GRANITE. Empirically, our results indicate that GRANITE converges within 5% of non-Byzantine accuracy under 30% Byzantines nodes, offers faster convergence and operates on graphs with up to 9x lower communication cost.

</details>


### [854] [Advancing Local Clustering on Graphs via Compressive Sensing: Semi-supervised and Unsupervised Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.19419)
*Zhaiming Shen,Sung Ha Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于图拉普拉斯线性系统稀疏解的局部聚类方法，首先在少量标签数据下实现半监督局部聚类，然后扩展到无监督设置。方法通过随机采样、扩散和局部簇提取及重叠分析来识别聚类，并严格证明了节点共成员条件的正确性，实验表明在低标签率下达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有局部聚类方法通常需要额外图结构信息或大量标签数据，而实际场景中标签数据稀缺且图结构信息有限，因此需要一种在极少标签甚至无标签条件下仍能有效识别局部子结构的方法。

Method: 首先提出半监督局部聚类方法（给定少量标签数据），然后将其扩展到无监督设置（无先验标签信息）。具体步骤包括：对图进行随机采样，通过局部簇提取应用扩散过程，然后检查不同结果之间的重叠以发现每个簇。同时建立了任意节点对的共成员条件，并给出了严格的正确性证明。

Result: 在低标签率条件下，所提出的方法达到了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 本文提出的局部聚类方法在标签数据极少甚至无标签的情况下仍能有效识别图局部子结构，并通过理论证明和实验验证了其有效性和优越性。

Abstract: Local clustering aims to identify specific substructures within a large graph without any additional structural information of the graph. These substructures are typically small compared to the overall graph, enabling the problem to be approached by finding a sparse solution to a linear system associated with the graph Laplacian. In this work, we first propose a method for identifying specific local clusters when very few labeled data are given, which we term semi-supervised local clustering. We then extend this approach to the unsupervised setting when no prior information on labels is available. The proposed methods involve randomly sampling the graph, applying diffusion through local cluster extraction, then examining the overlap among the results to find each cluster. We establish the co-membership conditions for any pair of nodes, and rigorously prove the correctness of our methods. Additionally, we conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate that the proposed methods achieve state of the art results in the low-label rates regime.

</details>


### [855] [Global Convergence of Adaptive Sensing for Principal Eigenvector Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.10882)
*Alex Saad-Falcon,Brighton Ancelin,Justin Romberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了压缩Oja算法在每样本仅用两次自适应测量时估计主特征向量的性能，证明收敛率为$\mathcal{O}(λ_1λ_2 d^2 / (Δ^2 t))$，并给出了匹配的信息论下界，揭示了压缩PCA相比全观测PCA额外多出一个$d$因子的根本代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬件限制下每个样本仅能获取少量标量测量值，传统PCA需要全维样本，因此需要研究压缩感知框架下的主成分分析方法。

Method: 分析压缩Oja算法：每轮迭代沿当前估计方向做一次自适应测量，再沿随机正交方向做一次测量；利用信息论推导匹配的下界。

Result: 自适应压缩方案的收敛率$\mathcal{O}(λ_1λ_2 d^2 / (Δ^2 t))$，信息论下界$\Omega(λ_1λ_2 d^2 / (Δ^2 t))$；非自适应方案下界为$\Omega(λ_2^2 d^3 / (Δ^2 t))$。全观测、自适应压缩、非自适应压缩分别对应$d^1, d^2, d^3$三个幂次区分。

Conclusion: $d^2$因子是压缩不可避免的代价；自适应方案优于非自适应方案一个$d$因子；分析可推广到含噪声非零尾特征值的场景。

Abstract: Principal component analysis classically requires full $d$-dimensional samples, yet in various applications hardware limits acquisition to a few scalar measurements per sample. We analyze a compressed variant of Oja's algorithm for estimating the principal eigenvector of the data covariance matrix using only two adaptive measurements per sample. At each iteration, we observe one measurement along the current estimate and one in a random orthogonal direction. We prove that after $t$ iterations, the expected sine-squared error to the true eigenvector is $\mathcal{O}(λ_1λ_2 d^2 / (Δ^2 t))$, where $d$ is the ambient dimension, $λ_1, λ_2$ are the leading eigenvalues, and $Δ= λ_1 - λ_2$ is the eigengap. We complement this with a matching information-theoretic lower bound of $Ω(λ_1λ_2 d^2 / (Δ^2 t))$ -- the first for compressed eigenvector estimation -- proving that the $d^2$ factor, an additional factor of $d$ compared to the fully-observed minimax rate $Θ(λ_1λ_2 d / (Δ^2 t))$, is the fundamental cost of compression and cannot be improved. In contrast, any non-adaptive scheme with two measurements per iteration suffers $Ω(λ_2^2 d^3 / (Δ^2 t))$, an additional power of $d$. This separates fully-observed, adaptive-compressed, and non-adaptive-compressed PCA across three powers of $d$. Our analysis handles the noisy setting where the covariance has nonzero trailing eigenvalues, providing the first convergence guarantee for adaptive compressed subspace tracking beyond the noiseless case.

</details>


### [856] [Byte Pair Encoding for Efficient Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.14411)
*Leon Götz,Marcel Kollovieh,Stephan Günnemann,Leo Schwinn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个基于模式的时序分词方法，利用频繁模式的离散词汇表将样本自适应合并为token，结合条件解码显著提升预测性能与计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时序分词方法固定编码样本数量，产生过多冗余token导致计算开销大，缺乏对简单模式（如常数序列）的自适应压缩能力。

Method: 借鉴字节对编码，构建频繁模式离散词汇表，将具有底层模式的样本合并为token实现自适应压缩；提出条件解码作为轻量级后优化方法，无需梯度计算。

Result: 在时序基础模型上，预测性能提升40%，效率平均提升2314%；条件解码进一步降低MSE最高达48%。

Conclusion: 该方法能自适应不同时序模式，泛化到未见数据，且token表示能捕获统计矩、趋势等不同时序属性。

Abstract: Existing time series tokenization methods predominantly encode a constant number of samples into individual tokens. This inflexible approach can generate excessive tokens for even simple patterns like extended constant values, resulting in substantial computational overhead. Inspired by the success of byte pair encoding, we propose the first pattern-centric tokenization scheme for time series analysis. Based on a discrete vocabulary of frequent motifs, our method merges samples with underlying patterns into tokens, compressing time series adaptively. Exploiting our finite set of motifs and the continuous properties of time series, we further introduce conditional decoding as a lightweight yet powerful post-hoc optimization method, which requires no gradient computation and adds no computational overhead. On recent time series foundation models, our motif-based tokenization improves forecasting performance by 40% and boosts efficiency by 2314% on average. Conditional decoding further reduces MSE by up to 48%. In an extensive analysis, we demonstrate the adaptiveness of our tokenization to diverse temporal patterns, its generalization to unseen data, and its meaningful token representations capturing distinct time series properties, including statistical moments and trends.

</details>


### [857] [LLMSynthor: Macro-Aligned Micro-Records Synthesis with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.14752)
*Yihong Tang,Menglin Kong,Junlin He,Tong Nie,Wei Ma,Lijun Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LLMSynthor利用预训练LLM作为宏观感知模拟器，通过迭代生成与目标宏观统计一致的微观记录，解决微观数据难以大规模收集的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社会科学和城市研究中需要宏观对齐的微观记录以实现可信模拟（如疫情模型），但大规模收集细粒度微观数据不切实际，研究者仅有宏观数据可用。

Method: 将LLM视为非参数copula，通过迭代批量生成记录以最小化合成数据与目标宏观统计之间的差异；提出LLM Proposal Sampling引导LLM提出有针对性的记录批次（指定变量范围和计数），高效纠正差异同时保持基于模型先验的真实性。

Result: 在流动性、电子商务、人口等多个领域的评估表明，LLMSynthor实现了强真实性、统计保真度和实用效用。

Conclusion: LLMSynthor可广泛适用于经济学、社会科学和城市研究领域。

Abstract: Macro-aligned micro-records are crucial for credible simulations in social science and urban studies. For example, epidemic models are only reliable when individual-level mobility and contacts mirror real behavior, while aggregates match real-world statistics like case counts or travel flows. However, collecting such fine-grained data at scale is impractical, leaving researchers with only macro-level data. LLMSynthor addresses this by turning a pretrained LLM into a macro-aware simulator that generates realistic micro-records consistent with target macro-statistics. It iteratively builds synthetic datasets: in each step, the LLM generates batches of records to minimize discrepancies between synthetic and target aggregates. Treating the LLM as a nonparametric copula allows the model to capture realistic joint dependencies among variables. To improve efficiency, LLM Proposal Sampling guides the LLM to propose targeted record batches, specifying variable ranges and counts, to efficiently correct discrepancies while preserving realism grounded in the model's priors. Evaluations across domains (mobility, e-commerce, population) show that LLMSynthor achieves strong realism, statistical fidelity, and practical utility, making it broadly applicable to economics, social science, and urban studies.

</details>


### [858] [Human in the Loop Adaptive Optimization for Improved Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.15354)
*Malik Tiomoko,Hamza Cherkaoui,Giuseppe Paolo,Zhang Yili,Yu Meng,Zhang Keli,Hafiz Tiomoko Ali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需重新训练或改变架构的轻量级、模型无关的后训练自适应优化框架，通过强化学习、上下文Bandit或遗传算法自动学习表达性变换来修正时序预测模型的系统误差；理论上证明了仿射校正总能降低MSE，并支持人类专家通过自然语言指导校正。在电力、天气、交通等基准上取得一致性精度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序预测模型即使在能源、金融、医疗等关键领域也会产生系统性、可预测的误差，现有方法难以在不重新训练或改变架构的情况下高效修正这些误差。

Method: 后训练自适应优化框架：采用强化学习、上下文Bandit或遗传算法自动学习表达性变换（如仿射变换等）对模型输出进行校正；理论上证明仿射校正总能降低MSE；支持人类专家通过自然语言（由语言模型解析为动作）进行人机交互引导。

Result: 在电力、天气、交通等多个基准数据集上取得一致的精度提升，计算开销极小；交互式演示验证了实时可用性。

Conclusion: 该后验修正结合自动化、可解释、可扩展机制，为实用时序预测系统提供了新的有效方向。

Abstract: Time series forecasting models often produce systematic, predictable errors even in critical domains such as energy, finance, and healthcare. We introduce a novel post training adaptive optimization framework that improves forecast accuracy without retraining or architectural changes. Our method automatically applies expressive transformations optimized via reinforcement learning, contextual bandits, or genetic algorithms to correct model outputs in a lightweight and model agnostic way. Theoretically, we prove that affine corrections always reduce the mean squared error; practically, we extend this idea with dynamic action based optimization. The framework also supports an optional human in the loop component: domain experts can guide corrections using natural language, which is parsed into actions by a language model. Across multiple benchmarks (e.g., electricity, weather, traffic), we observe consistent accuracy gains with minimal computational overhead. Our interactive demo shows the framework's real time usability. By combining automated post hoc refinement with interpretable and extensible mechanisms, our approach offers a powerful new direction for practical forecasting systems.

</details>


### [859] [Beyond Discreteness: Sample Complexity Analysis of Straight-Through Estimator for 1-bit Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18113)
*Halyun Jeong,Jack Xin,Penghang Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次对直通估计器（STE）在神经网络量化中的样本复杂度进行分析，证明样本量对STE成功的关键作用，推导了双层二值神经网络在遍历与非遍历分析下的收敛样本复杂度界，发现标签噪声下STE梯度法的迭代循环往复特性，并通过实验表明STE在非高斯数据上失效但可通过归一化恢复有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有STE理论分析主要关注无限训练数据下的泛化误差，缺乏对有限样本场景的理论理解。本文旨在填补这一空白，从样本复杂度角度揭示样本量在STE成功中的关键作用。

Method: 对双层二值权重和激活的神经网络进行量化感知训练分析，推导保证STE优化收敛到全局最小值的样本复杂度界（遍历与非遍历分析）；在标签噪声下分析STE梯度法的动态特性；通过实验验证理论发现。

Result: 1) 给出了STE收敛到全局最优所需的样本复杂度界（与数据维度相关）；2) 发现标签噪声下STE梯度法的迭代会在最优二值权重附近反复逃离和返回；3) 实验表明STE在非高斯数据上失效，但数据归一化可恢复其有效性。

Conclusion: 样本大小是STE成功的关键因素，理论分析证实了有限样本下STE的可收敛性；标签噪声引起特殊的循环动力学；实际应用中需注意数据分布对STE的影响，归一化是一种有效的补救措施。

Abstract: Training quantized neural networks requires addressing the non-differentiable and discrete nature of the underlying optimization problem. To tackle this challenge, the straight-through estimator (STE) has become the most widely adopted heuristic, allowing backpropagation through discrete operations by introducing biased yet valid surrogate gradients. However, its theoretical properties remain largely unexplored, with few existing analyses focus on the generalization error by assuming an infinite amount of training data. In contrast, this work presents the first sample complexity analysis of STE in the context of neural network quantization. Our theoretical results highlight the critical role of sample size in the success of STE, a key insight absent from existing studies. Specifically, by analyzing the quantization-aware training of a two-layer neural network with binary weights and activations, we derive the sample complexity bounds in terms of the data dimensionality that guarantee the convergence of STE-based optimization to the global minimum for both ergodic and non-ergodic analyses. Moreover, in the presence of label noises, we prove an intriguing recurrence property of STE-gradient method, where the iterate repeatedly escape from and return to the optimal binary weights. Finally, we empirically demonstrate that STE fails for general non-Gaussian data but its effectiveness can be restored through normalization, underscoring its practical importance in effective quantization.

</details>


### [860] [RefLoRA: Refactored Low-Rank Adaptation for Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18877)
*Yilang Zhang,Bingcong Li,Georgios B. Giannakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RefLoRA方法，通过在每步优化中找到最优低秩分解以最小化损失上界，解决LoRA因非唯一低秩分解导致的更新不一致和性能下降问题，在多种大语言模型上实现了更快收敛和更优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA虽能降低微调大模型的计算和内存开销，但其非唯一低秩分解导致权重更新不一致且不平衡，造成收敛次优和性能明显下降。

Method: 每步优化中识别最优低秩分解以最小化损失上界，促进更平坦的损失景观，实现一致且平衡的权重更新。

Result: 在DeBERTaV3、LLaMA-7B、LLaMA2-7B和LLaMA3-8B上的自然语言理解和常识推理任务中，RefLoRA收敛更快，性能超越多种基准，且计算开销可忽略不计。

Conclusion: RefLoRA通过重构低秩分解有效克服了LoRA的固有缺陷，实现了更快的稳定收敛和更优的性能表现。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) lowers the computational and memory overhead of fine-tuning large models by updating a low-dimensional subspace of the pre-trained weight matrix. Albeit efficient, LoRA exhibits suboptimal convergence and noticeable performance degradation, due to inconsistent and imbalanced weight updates induced by its nonunique low-rank factorizations. To overcome these limitations, this article identifies the optimal low-rank factorization per step that minimizes an upper bound on the loss. The resultant refactored low-rank adaptation (RefLoRA) method promotes a flatter loss landscape, along with consistent and balanced weight updates, thus speeding up stable convergence. Extensive experiments evaluate RefLoRA on natural language understanding, and commonsense reasoning tasks with popular large language models including DeBERTaV3, LLaMA-7B, LLaMA2-7B and LLaMA3-8B. The numerical tests corroborate that RefLoRA converges faster, outperforms various benchmarks, and enjoys negligible computational overhead compared to state-of-the-art LoRA variants.

</details>


### [861] [Cooperation of Experts: Fusing Heterogeneous Information with Large Margin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20853)
*Shuo Wang,Shunyang Huang,Jinghui Yuan,Zhixiang Shen,Zhao Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CoE（专家协作）框架，通过构建异构多路网络并让领域专用编码器以大间隔机制协作，有效融合多类型异构信息，在多个基准上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法未能充分考虑不同语义空间中对象模式的固有异构性，导致异构信息融合效果不佳。

Method: 将多类型信息编码为统一的异构多路网络；设计领域专用编码器作为专家分别学习不同语义空间的关系模式；通过大间隔机制和定制优化策略实现专家间的协作与互补知识提取。

Result: 严格的理论分析保证了框架的可行性和稳定性；在多个多样化基准上的广泛实验证明了其优越性能和广泛适用性。

Conclusion: CoE框架能够有效克服模态和连接差异，为真实世界复杂数据的结构建模提供了强大且灵活的解决方案。

Abstract: Fusing heterogeneous information remains a persistent challenge in modern data analysis. While significant progress has been made, existing approaches often fail to account for the inherent heterogeneity of object patterns across different semantic spaces. To address this limitation, we propose the Cooperation of Experts (CoE) framework, which encodes multi-typed information into unified heterogeneous multiplex networks. By overcoming modality and connection differences, CoE provides a powerful and flexible model for capturing the intricate structures of real-world complex data. In our framework, dedicated encoders act as domain-specific experts, each specializing in learning distinct relational patterns in specific semantic spaces. To enhance robustness and extract complementary knowledge, these experts collaborate through a novel large margin mechanism supported by a tailored optimization strategy. Rigorous theoretical analyses guarantee the framework's feasibility and stability, while extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate its superior performance and broad applicability. Our code is available at https://github.com/strangeAlan/CoE.

</details>


### [862] [Can LLMs Reason Structurally? Benchmarking via the Lens of Data Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.24069)
*Yu He,Yingxi Li,Colin White,Ellen Vitercik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DSR-Bench基准测试，基于数据结构评估大语言模型的多步推理能力，发现当前最强模型在困难实例上仅得0.46分，且在空间数据、上下文丰富场景和代码推理方面存在显著缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型被部署在需要多步决策的复杂任务上，但缺乏诊断性基准来评估其算法推理能力。

Method: 以数据结构为原则性视角，提出DSR-Bench基准，涵盖20种数据结构、35种操作和4,140个问题实例，具有层次化任务组织、全自动生成与评估、细粒度诊断特性。

Result: 评估13个最先进LLM，最优模型在困难实例上仅达0.46/1；三个辅助探针暴露了模型在空间数据、上下文丰富场景及自身代码推理方面的弱点。

Conclusion: 当前大语言模型在结构化推理方面存在显著局限性，尤其处理空间关系、复杂上下文和代码推理时表现欠佳。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are deployed on increasingly complex tasks that require multi-step decision-making. Understanding their algorithmic reasoning abilities is therefore crucial. However, we lack a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating these capabilities. We propose to use data structures as a principled lens: as fundamental building blocks of algorithms, they naturally probe structural reasoning - the ability to understand and manipulate relationships such as order, hierarchy, and connectivity that underpin algorithmic reasoning. We introduce DSR-Bench (Data Structure Reasoning Benchmark), spanning 20 data structures, 35 operations, and 4,140 problem instances. DSR-Bench features hierarchical task organization, fully automated generation and evaluation, and fine-grained diagnostics. Evaluating 13 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals critical limitations: the top-performing model achieves only 0.46/1 on challenging instances. Three auxiliary probes targeting more realistic usages expose further weaknesses: models perform poorly on spatial data and context-rich scenarios, and they struggle to reason over their own code.

</details>


### [863] [Value-Free Policy Optimization via Reward Partitioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.13702)
*Bilal Faye,Hanane Azzag,Mustapha Lebbah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Reward Partition Optimization (RPO)，一种无需值函数估计的奖励驱动偏好优化方法，通过在提示级奖励分布上做分区归一化，避免了DRO等方法的方差和复杂性，在多个语言模型上优于SFT、KTO和DRO基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单轨迹偏好优化方法（如DRO）依赖值函数估计，引入额外方差、优化复杂度且对离策略数据敏感，亟需一种稳定、简单且可扩展的奖励驱动目标函数。

Method: RPO通过基于分区的公式直接从提示级奖励分布中归一化奖励，得到一个稳定的有监督优化目标，无需辅助模型或强化学习循环。

Result: 在多个编码器-解码器和仅解码器语言模型上，RPO在自动指标、LLM-as-a-judge评估和优化稳定性分析中一致优于SFT、KTO和DRO，生成更对齐、更多样化且毒性更低的文本。

Conclusion: RPO通过消除值函数学习，提供了一种更简单、更稳定的单轨迹偏好优化方案，在多个维度上取得了更好的性能。

Abstract: Single-trajectory preference optimization methods learn from datasets of ((prompt, response, reward)) tuples, offering a practical alternative to pairwise preference learning by directly leveraging scalar feedback. Existing approaches such as Direct Reward Optimization (DRO) have demonstrated promising results but rely on value function estimation, introducing additional variance, optimization complexity, and sensitivity to off-policy data. We introduce Reward Partition Optimization (RPO), a simple and scalable reward-driven objective that eliminates the need for value function learning. RPO normalizes rewards through a partition-based formulation estimated directly from prompt-level reward distributions, yielding a stable supervised optimization objective without auxiliary models or reinforcement learning loops. We evaluate RPO across multiple encoder-decoder and decoder-only language models using automatic metrics, LLM-as-a-judge evaluations, and optimization stability analyses. Experimental results show that RPO consistently outperforms strong baselines, including SFT, KTO, and DRO, while producing more aligned, diverse, and less toxic generations.

</details>


### [864] [Unlearning Isn't Invisible: Detecting Unlearning Traces in LLMs from Model Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.14003)
*Yiwei Chen,Soumyadeep Pal,Yimeng Zhang,Qing Qu,Sijia Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现大语言模型在机器遗忘后会产生可检测的“指纹”痕迹，即使面对与遗忘无关的输入，也能通过输出或内部表征以超过90%的准确率识别模型是否经过遗忘处理，且模型越大痕迹越明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器遗忘对保护数据隐私、执行版权和减轻社会技术危害至关重要，但作者发现遗忘后会留下可检测的痕迹，这可能带来逆向工程遗忘信息的新风险。

Method: 通过监督分类器，利用模型预测logits或文本输出判断模型是否经过遗忘；进一步分析中间激活层，发现这些痕迹形成低维可学习流形。

Result: 即使面对与遗忘无关的输入，遗忘痕迹检测准确率超过90%；大型模型的可检测性更强。

Conclusion: 遗忘会在LLM中留下可测量的签名，引入逆向工程遗忘信息的新风险。

Abstract: Machine unlearning (MU) for large language models (LLMs), commonly referred to as LLM unlearning, seeks to remove specific undesirable data or knowledge from a trained model, while maintaining its performance on standard tasks. While unlearning plays a vital role in protecting data privacy, enforcing copyright, and mitigating sociotechnical harms in LLMs, we identify a new vulnerability post-unlearning: unlearning trace detection. We discover that unlearning leaves behind persistent "fingerprints" in LLMs, detectable traces in both model behavior and internal representations. These traces can be identified from output responses, even when prompted with forget-irrelevant inputs. Specifically, even a simple supervised classifier can determine whether a model has undergone unlearning, using only its prediction logits or even its textual outputs. Further analysis shows that these traces are embedded in intermediate activations and propagate nonlinearly to the final layer, forming low-dimensional, learnable manifolds in activation space. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that unlearning traces can be detected with over 90% accuracy even under forget-irrelevant inputs, and that larger LLMs exhibit stronger detectability. These findings reveal that unlearning leaves measurable signatures, introducing a new risk of reverse-engineering forgotten information when a model is identified as unlearned, given an input query.

</details>


### [865] [How Many Domains Suffice for Domain Generalization? A Tight Characterization via the Domain Shattering Dimension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.16704)
*Cynthia Dwork,Lunjia Hu,Han Shao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了域泛化中的样本复杂度问题，提出了一种新的组合度量——域破碎维度（domain shattering dimension），并证明该维度能够刻画域样本复杂度，同时建立了其与经典VC维度之间的紧致定量关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在域泛化场景中，我们需要从多个域（数据分布）中收集数据以训练一个模型，使其在可见和不可见的域上都能表现良好。一个核心开放问题是：至少需要从多少个随机采样的域中收集数据才能保证模型的泛化能力？本文旨在从理论层面回答这一问题。

Method: 作者将问题建模在PAC框架下，提出了一种新的组合度量——域破碎维度（domain shattering dimension）。通过该维度来刻画域样本复杂度，并推导了其与VC维度之间的定量关系。

Result: 证明了域破碎维度可以刻画域泛化中的域样本复杂度；给出了域破碎维度与经典VC维度之间的紧致定量关系；表明任何在标准PAC设置中可学习的假设类，在该域泛化设置中也是可学习的。

Conclusion: 域破碎维度是域泛化场景下刻画所需域数量的关键组合度量，且标准PAC可学习性蕴含域泛化可学习性。

Abstract: We study a fundamental question of domain generalization: given a family of domains (i.e., data distributions), how many randomly sampled domains do we need to collect data from in order to learn a model that performs reasonably well on every seen and unseen domain in the family? We model this problem in the PAC framework and introduce a new combinatorial measure, which we call the domain shattering dimension. We show that this dimension characterizes the domain sample complexity. Furthermore, we establish a tight quantitative relationship between the domain shattering dimension and the classic VC dimension, demonstrating that every hypothesis class that is learnable in the standard PAC setting is also learnable in our setting.

</details>


### [866] [Model Parallelism With Subnetwork Data Parallelism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.09029)
*Vaibhav Singh,Zafir Khalid,Pietro Cagnasso,Edouard Oyallon,Eugene Belilovsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出子网络数据并行（SDP）框架，通过结构化子网络分区训练，无需交换激活值，在多种模型和任务上实现28%-60%的每设备内存节省，同时保持或提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模神经网络预训练面临巨大的内存需求和昂贵的通信开销，现有分布式训练方法难以在降低内存占用的同时保持训练效率和模型性能。

Method: 提出SDP框架，将模型划分为结构化子网络，在多个工作节点上独立训练。设计了两种掩码机制：后向掩码（仅在反向传播施加稀疏性，保持无偏梯度）和前向掩码（前向传播也移除参数，提升效率并提供正则化）。还探索了神经元级别和块级别两种子网络构建策略，适用于Transformer和CNN。

Result: 在1B LLaMA预训练（FineWeb）和ResNet-18（CIFAR）等实验中，SDP在FLOP匹配设置下将每设备内存使用量降低28%-60%，同时保持或提升模型性能。

Conclusion: SDP通过结构化子网络并行训练有效降低了分布式训练的内存需求，无需激活值通信，适用于多种架构和规模，是一种高效且可扩展的分布式训练框架。

Abstract: Pre-training large neural networks at scale imposes heavy memory demands on accelerators and often requires costly communication. We introduce Subnetwork Data Parallelism (SDP), a distributed training framework that partitions a model into structured subnetworks trained across workers without exchanging activations. We study two complementary masking regimes: backward masking, which applies sparsity only in the backward step to retain unbiased gradients, and forward masking, which also removes parameters in the forward pass to deliver stronger efficiency gains while providing additional regularization. We further explore two subnetwork construction strategies: neuron level and block level, applied across both transformers and CNNs. In experiments spanning 1B LLaMA pre-training on FineWeb to ResNet-18 on CIFAR, SDP reduces per device memory usage by 28%-60% while maintaining or improving performance under FLOP-matched settings.

</details>


### [867] [Toward accurate RUL and SoH estimation using reinforced graph-based physics-informed neural networks enhanced with dynamic weights](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.09766)
*Mohamadreza Akbari Pour,Ali Ghasemzadeh,Mohamad Ali Bijarchi,Mohammad Behshad Shafii*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为RGPD的统一框架，通过图表示学习、SAC模块和自适应Q学习权重策略，实现跨资产类型的时空退化建模与物理引导正则化，在C-MAPSS、PHM2012和XJTU数据集上相比基线方法RMSE降低12%、MAPE降低20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有混合模型在跨资产迁移时因固定损失权重而精度下降，需要一种能够自适应调整物理正则化权重的统一框架。

Method: RGPD框架包含三部分：图表示学习捕捉传感器间退化结构；SAC模块在噪声条件下精炼潜在特征；轻量Q学习策略自适应平衡单调性、平滑性和潜在动力学残差损失。

Result: 在C-MAPSS和PHM2012上平均RMSE降低12%，在XJTU上平均MAPE降低20%，优于基准表中的最强对比方法。

Conclusion: 该框架在异构退化系统上展现良好泛化性，物理引导部分通过退化一致性先验和深度隐物理模型残差实现，无需完整第一性原理模型。

Abstract: Accurate estimation of Remaining Useful Life (RUL) and State of Health (SoH) is essential for reliable Prognostics and Health Management (PHM), supporting timely maintenance and dependable industrial operation. However, hybrid models that combine data-driven learning with physics-based regularization often rely on fixed loss weights and therefore lose accuracy when transferred across assets with different degradation behaviors. This study introduces Reinforced Graph-based Physics-informed Networks with Dynamic Weighting (RGPD), a unified framework for spatio-temporal degradation modeling and adaptive physics-guided regularization. Graph-based representation learning captures inter-sensor degradation structure, a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) module refines latent features under noisy conditions, and a lightweight Q-learning policy adaptively balances monotonicity, smoothness, and latent-dynamics residual losses during training. The framework is evaluated on the C-MAPSS, PHM2012, and XJTU datasets, which represent engine, bearing, and battery degradation processes. Relative to the strongest compared baselines reported in the corresponding benchmark tables, RGPD improves average RMSE by up to 12 percent on PHM2012 and C-MAPSS, and reduces average MAPE by 20 percent on XJTU compared with the second-best reported model. Performance on these heterogeneous benchmarks further suggests the model's generalizability across degradation systems. The physics-informed component is implemented through degradation-consistent priors together with a Deep Hidden Physics Model-style residual, which improves physical plausibility without requiring a full first-principles model for each asset type.

</details>


### [868] [Beyond Model Base Retrieval: Weaving Knowledge to Master Fine-grained Neural Network Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.15336)
*Jialiang Wang,Hanmo Liu,Shimin Di,Zhili Wang,Jiachuan Wang,Lei Chen,Xiaofang Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出M-DESIGN框架，将架构修改视为编辑效应证据，通过检索增强的模型精炼方法，在严格预算下高效发现近优架构，在33个案例中26个达到搜索空间最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在优化质量与搜索效率之间难以平衡：神经架构搜索计算成本高，模型检索往往只能得到次优的静态检查点。

Method: 1) 将细粒度架构修改带来的性能增益建模为编辑效应证据，构建历史任务证据图；2) 提出检索增强的模型精炼框架M-DESIGN，动态融合历史证据以发现近优修改路径；3) 设计自适应检索机制，快速校准不同来源编辑效应证据的可迁移性；4) 引入预测性任务规划器，通过多跳证据外推增益以处理分布外偏移。

Result: 在涵盖22个数据集的67,760个图神经网络模型知识库上，M-DESIGN在33个案例中26个达到搜索空间最优性能，一致优于基线方法。

Conclusion: M-DESIGN通过检索增强和编辑效应证据建模，在不依赖穷举搜索库的情况下，实现了优化质量与搜索效率的有效平衡。

Abstract: Designing high-performance neural networks for new tasks requires balancing optimization quality with search efficiency. Current methods fail to achieve this balance: neural architectural search is computationally expensive, while model retrieval often yields suboptimal static checkpoints. To resolve this dilemma, we model the performance gains induced by fine-grained architectural modifications as edit-effect evidence and build evidence graphs from prior tasks. By constructing a retrieval-augmented model refinement framework, our proposed M-DESIGN dynamically weaves historical evidence to discover near-optimal modification paths. M-DESIGN features an adaptive retrieval mechanism that quickly calibrates the evolving transferability of edit-effect evidence from different sources. To handle out-of-distribution shifts, we introduce predictive task planners that extrapolate gains from multi-hop evidence, thereby reducing reliance on an exhaustive repository. Based on our model knowledge base of 67,760 graph neural networks across 22 datasets, extensive experiments demonstrate that M-DESIGN consistently outperforms baselines, achieving the search-space best performance in 26 out of 33 cases under a strict budget.

</details>


### [869] [Evaluating and Learning Robust Bandit Policies Under Uncertain Causal Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.02812)
*Katherine Avery,Chinmay Pendse,David Jensen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种因果多臂老虎机评估与学习算法，利用条件独立性检验选择变量进行建模，采用结构方程模型（SEM）方法在因果机制不确定的情况下进行有效推理。实验表明，SEM方法相比传统方法能提供更准确的评估，尤其在因果机制范围增大时表现更优，学习到低方差策略，并在模型充分指定时学到最优策略，而传统方法可能收敛到局部极值或无法收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然因果图模型可以编码领域专家背景知识和从实验/观测数据中发现的结构知识，但因果关系的具体机制往往未知，现有方法在这种不确定性下难以有效推理。

Method: 提出一种因果多臂老虎机评估与学习算法，利用条件独立性检验来选择用于建模的变量，采用结构方程模型（SEM）方法处理条件概率分布的不确定性。

Result: SEM方法比传统方法给出更准确的评估，尤其在因果机制范围扩大时优势明显；SEM方法学到的策略方差低；在模型充分指定时能学到最优策略；传统方法可能收敛到局部极值或完全无法收敛。

Conclusion: 基于结构方程模型的因果多臂老虎机方法在因果机制不确定的情况下优于传统方法，能够实现更准确评估和更优策略学习。

Abstract: Causal graphical models can encode large amounts structural knowledge, both from the background knowledge of domain experts and the structural knowledge discovered from randomized experiments or observational data. However, though we may know the general structure of causal relationships, we often do not know the exact causal mechanisms. In this work, we propose a causal multi-armed bandit evaluation and learning algorithm that can reason effectively despite uncertainty over conditional probability distributions. Further, we show how conditional independence testing can be used to choose variables for modeling. We find that the structural equation model (SEM) approach gives more accurate evaluations compared to traditional approaches, particularly as the range of possible causal mechanisms grows. Further, the SEM approach learns low-variance policies, and it learns an optimal policy, assuming the model is sufficiently well-specified. Traditional approaches can converge to local extrema or fail to converge at all.

</details>


### [870] [VRPRM: Process Reward Modeling via Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.03556)
*Xinquan Chen,Chongying Yue,Bangwei Liu,Xuhong Wang,Yingchun Wang,Chaochao Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出VRPRM，一种通过视觉推理增强的过程奖励模型，采用两阶段训练策略（少量CoT-PRM SFT数据+非CoT PRM RL数据），以极低的标注成本实现了超越大规模数据训练的PRM的性能提升（最高达118%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PRM缺乏长期推理和深度思考能力，而引入CoT能力的PRM又面临数据标注成本过高的问题，亟需一种高效的数据利用方案。

Method: 提出VRPRM（视觉推理过程奖励模型），设计两阶段训练策略：第一阶段使用3.6K CoT-PRM数据进行监督微调（SFT），第二阶段使用50K非CoT PRM数据进行强化学习（RL）训练。

Result: 仅用3.6K CoT-PRM SFT数据和50K非CoT PRM RL数据（总计53.6K），即可超越使用400K数据训练的非思考PRM，在BoN实验中相对基线模型提升高达118%。

Conclusion: 提出的组合训练策略能够以更低的数据标注成本实现更高质量的推理能力，为PRM训练提供了更高效数据利用的新范式。

Abstract: Process Reward Model (PRM) is widely used in the post-training of Large Language Model (LLM) because it can perform fine-grained evaluation of the reasoning steps of generated content. However, most PRMs lack long-term reasoning and deep thinking capabilities. On the other hand, although a few works have tried to introduce Chain-of-Thought (CoT) capability into PRMs, the annotation cost of CoT-PRM data is too expensive to play a stable role in various tasks. To address the above challenges, we propose VRPRM, a process reward model via visual reasoning, and design an efficient two-stage training strategy.
