Experimental results show that using only 3.6K CoT-PRM Supervised Fine-Tuning(SFT) data and 50K non-CoT PRM Reinforcement Learning (RL) training data, VRPRM can surpass the non-thinking PRM with a total data volume of 400K and achieved a relative performance improvement of up to 118\% over the base model in the BoN experiment. This result confirms that the proposed combined training strategy can achieve higher quality reasoning capabilities at a lower data annotation cost, thus providing a new paradigm for PRM training with more efficient data utilization.

</details>


### [871] [Graph is a Natural Regularization: Revisiting Vector Quantization for Graph Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.06588)
*Zian Zhai,Fan Li,Xingyu Tan,Xiaoyang Wang,Wenjie Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了图数据向量量化中码本坍塌问题，提出RGVQ框架通过Gumbel-Softmax软分配和结构感知对比正则化来提升码本利用率与令牌多样性，在多个下游任务中显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图向量量化（VQ）在压缩和离散图表示方面有前景，但码本坍塌问题在图领域未被充分探索，严重限制了图令牌的表达能力和泛化性。

Method: 提出RGVQ框架：1) 使用Gumbel-Softmax重参数化实现软分配，确保所有码字获得梯度更新；2) 引入结构感知对比正则化，惩罚将相同令牌分配给不相似节点对，融合图拓扑与特征相似性作为显式正则化信号。

Result: RGVQ显著提升码本利用率，在多个下游任务上一致提升现有图VQ骨干网络的性能，生成更具表达力和可迁移性的图令牌表示。

Conclusion: 码本坍塌在图VQ中普遍存在且难以用视觉/语言领域策略缓解，其与图数据属性（特征冗余、连接密度）及确定性硬分配的训练动态有关；RGVQ有效解决了这一问题。

Abstract: Vector Quantization (VQ) has recently emerged as a promising approach for learning compressed and discrete representations for graph-structured data. However, a fundamental challenge, i.e., codebook collapse, remains underexplored in the graph domain, significantly limiting the expressiveness and generalization of graph tokens.In this paper, we present an empirical study and observe that codebook collapse consistently occurs when training VQ jointly with Graph Neural Networks under graph reconstruction tasks, even with mitigation strategies proposed in vision or language domains. Moreover, we provide a diagnosis of collapse from data and optimization perspectives, showing that collapse is associated with graph data properties such as feature redundancy and connectivity density, and is further reinforced by the training dynamics of deterministic hard assignment. To address these issues, we propose RGVQ, a novel framework that integrates graph topology and feature similarity as explicit regularization signals to enhance codebook utilization and promote token diversity. RGVQ introduces soft assignments via Gumbel-Softmax reparameterization, ensuring that all codewords receive gradient updates. In addition, RGVQ incorporates a structure-aware contrastive regularization to penalize assigning the same token to dissimilar node pairs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RGVQ substantially improves codebook utilization and consistently boosts the performance of state-of-the-art graph VQ backbones across multiple downstream tasks, enabling more expressive and transferable graph token representations.

</details>


### [872] [An Improved Algorithm for Adversarial Linear Contextual Bandits via Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.11931)
*Tim van Erven,Jack Mayo,Julia Olkhovskaya,Chen-Yu Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对线性上下文赌博机（含对抗性损失和随机动作集）的近最优、预言机高效算法，仅需线性优化预言机，在无需上下文分布知识的情况下实现了$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\min\{d^2\sqrt{T}, \sqrt{d^3T\log K}\})$的遗憾界，解决了Liu等人(2023)的公开问题，并首次在组合赌博机设置中以多项式时间取得$\mathrm{poly}(d)\sqrt{T}$遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决线性上下文赌博机在对抗性损失和随机动作集设置下的高效算法设计问题，回应Liu等人(2023)提出的公开问题——是否能在与动作数量无关的多项式时间内获得$\mathrm{poly}(d)\sqrt{T}$遗憾。

Method: 将问题归约为带误分类鲁棒性的固定动作集对抗性线性赌博机问题，利用线性优化预言机处理每轮随机动作集，无需知道上下文分布或使用上下文模拟器。

Result: 算法实现了$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\min\{d^2\sqrt{T}, \sqrt{d^3T\log K}\})$的遗憾界，运行时间为$\mathrm{poly}(d,T)$加$\mathrm{poly}(d,T)$次线性优化预言机调用。当模拟器可用时，遗憾界可改进为$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{L^\star})$。

Conclusion: 该工作解决了开放的理论问题，为对抗性线性上下文赌博机提供了首个与动作数量无关的多项式时间算法，并首次在组合赌博机中取得了多项式时间下的$\mathrm{poly}(d)\sqrt{T}$遗憾（此前没有算法能在多项式时间达到$o(T)$遗憾）。

Abstract: We present an oracle-efficient, near-optimal algorithm for linear contextual bandits with adversarial losses and stochastic action sets, only requiring a linear optimization oracle for the action sets in each round. Our approach reduces this setting to misspecification-robust adversarial linear bandits with fixed action sets. Without knowledge of the context distribution or access to a context simulator, the algorithm achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\min\{d^2\sqrt{T}, \sqrt{d^3T\log K}\})$ regret and runs in $\mathrm{poly}(d,T)$ time plus $\mathrm{poly}(d,T)$ calls to the linear optimization oracles, where $d$ is the feature dimension, $K$ is an upper bound on the number of actions in each round, and $T$ is number of rounds. This resolves the open question by Liu et al. (2023) on whether one can obtain $\mathrm{poly}(d)\sqrt{T}$ regret in polynomial time independent of the number of actions. For the important class of combinatorial bandits with adversarial losses and stochastic action sets, our algorithm is the first to achieve $\mathrm{poly}(d)\sqrt{T}$ regret in polynomial time, while no prior algorithm achieves even $o(T)$ regret in polynomial time to our knowledge. When a simulator is available, the regret bound can be improved to $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{L^\star})$, where $L^\star$ is the cumulative loss of the best policy.

</details>


### [873] [TuneAgent: Agentic Operating System Kernel Tuning with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.12551)
*Hongyu Lin,Yuchen Li,Haoran Luo,Zhenghong Lin,Libo Zhang,Mingjie Xing,Yanjun Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TuneAgent是一个基于规则强化学习的智能Linux内核调优框架，通过将内核空间构建为约束强化学习环境，设计结构化奖励函数和两阶段训练策略，使大语言模型能够自主探索内核并进行有效配置优化，在实际应用中实现了最高5.6%的相对性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Linux内核调优对优化操作系统性能至关重要，但面临内核空间复杂、性能反馈稀疏、工作负载敏感性强的挑战，现有方法难以有效解决这些问题。

Method: 提出TuneAgent框架：1) 将内核空间建模为约束强化学习环境，使LLM能自主探索并执行有效配置修改；2) 设计结构化奖励函数，联合促进推理标准化、配置正确性和性能感知；3) 采用两阶段训练策略，先确保格式和语义正确性，再过渡到性能驱动的探索。

Result: TuneAgent在多个基准测试中一致优于现有方法，达到最高5.6%的相对整体性能提升，同时保持高配置有效性；在多种真实应用中验证了其鲁棒性和适应性。

Conclusion: TuneAgent通过基于规则强化学习的智能体框架有效解决了Linux内核调优中的关键挑战，展示了在实际部署环境中的实用性和可推广性。

Abstract: Linux kernel tuning is essential for optimizing operating system (OS) performance, yet remains challenging due to the complex kernel space, sparse performance feedback, and strong workload sensitivity. We present TuneAgent, an agentic Linux kernel tuning framework powered by rule-based reinforcement learning (RL). TuneAgent formulates the kernel space as a constrained RL environment, enabling large language models (LLMs) to autonomously explore the kernel while enforcing valid and precise configuration modifications. To address sparse performance feedback, we design structured reward functions that jointly promote reasoning standardization, configuration correctness, and performance awareness. Furthermore, we propose a two-phase training strategy that first ensures format and semantic correctness and then transitions to performance-driven exploration, accelerating convergence and reducing overhead. Experimental results show that TuneAgent consistently outperforms existing baselines, achieving up to 5.6% relative overall performance improvement while maintaining high configuration validity. We further demonstrate its robustness across multiple real-world applications, highlighting its practicality and adaptability in diverse deployment environments.

</details>


### [874] [AdaptiveK: Complexity-Driven Sparse Autoencoders for Interpretable Language Model Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.17320)
*Yifei Yao,Hanrong Zhang,Mengnan Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AdaptiveK SAE，一种根据输入语义复杂度动态调整稀疏水平的自编码器框架，通过线性探针利用LLM表示中编码的复杂度信号指导特征分配，在10个语言模型上优于固定稀疏方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有稀疏自编码器依赖固定的稀疏约束，无法适应输入复杂度的变化，导致在简单输入上过度稀疏或在复杂输入上欠稀疏，且需要大量超参数调优。

Method: 提出AdaptiveK SAE，利用线性探针从LLM表示中提取编码的上下文复杂度信号，据此动态调整每个输入的Top K稀疏水平，从而自适应分配特征。

Result: 在10个语言模型上，AdaptiveK SAE在重建保真度、解释方差、余弦相似度和可解释性指标上均优于固定稀疏方法，同时消除了大量超参数调优的需求。

Conclusion: 输入语义复杂度在LLM表示中是线性编码的，利用这一信号进行自适应稀疏控制可以有效提升SAE的性能和实用性，减少人工调参负担。

Abstract: Understanding the internal representations of large language models (LLMs) remains a central challenge for interpretability research. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) offer a promising solution by decomposing activations into interpretable features, but existing approaches rely on fixed sparsity constraints that fail to account for input complexity. We propose AdaptiveK SAE (Adaptive Top K Sparse Autoencoders), a novel framework that dynamically adjusts sparsity levels based on the semantic complexity of each input. Leveraging linear probes, we demonstrate that context complexity is linearly encoded in LLM representations, and we use this signal to guide feature allocation during training. Experiments across ten language models demonstrate that this complexity-driven adaptation outperforms fixed-sparsity approaches on reconstruction fidelity, explained variance, cosine similarity and interpretability metrics while eliminating the burden of extensive hyperparameter tuning. Our code is available at: https://github.com/hiyukie/adaptiveK.

</details>


### [875] [Fundamental bounds on efficiency-confidence trade-off for transductive conformal prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.04631)
*Arash Behboodi,Alvaro H. C. Correia,Fabio Valerio Massoli,Christos Louizos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了转导式保形预测中置信度与效率之间的基本权衡，推导出严格有限样本界：在数据存在固有不确定性的情况下，任何非平凡置信水平都会导致预测集大小呈指数增长，其指数与样本数线性相关且与条件熵成正比，并包含二阶项“离散度”。基于近似条件分布的转导方法可逼近该下界，所提算法优于Bonferroni方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 转导式保形预测需同时为多个数据点构建预测集，但置信度与效率（预测集大小）之间的理论关系尚不明确，现有方法缺乏对最优性的理论刻画。

Method: 推导了置信度与预测集大小的严格有限样本下界，证明其由条件熵和离散度（条件对数概率分布的方差）共同决定；基于近似条件分布设计转导预测算法以逼近该下界。

Result: 非平凡置信水平下，预测集大小随样本数指数增长，指数与条件熵成正比；所提算法在效率上超越Bonferroni方法。

Conclusion: 转导式保形预测存在置信度-效率的固有权衡，条件熵和离散度是决定预测集规模的关键因素；近似条件分布方法可接近理论最优，实际算法具有竞争优势。

Abstract: Transductive conformal prediction addresses the simultaneous prediction for multiple data points. Given a desired confidence level, the objective is to construct a prediction set that includes the true outcomes with the prescribed confidence. We demonstrate a fundamental trade-off between confidence and efficiency in transductive methods, where efficiency is measured by the size of the prediction sets. Specifically, we derive a strict finite-sample bound showing that any non-trivial confidence level leads to exponential growth in prediction set size for data with inherent uncertainty. The exponent scales linearly with the number of samples and is proportional to the conditional entropy of the data. Additionally, the bound includes a second-order term, dispersion, defined as the variance of the log conditional probability distribution. We show that the transductive methods based on the approximate conditional distribution can approach this bound. Inspired by this setup, we introduce a practical transductive prediction algorithm that surpasses Bonferroni methods.

</details>


### [876] [Towards a Physics Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.13805)
*Florian Wiesner,Zoë J. Gray,Matthias Wessling,Stephen Baek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了通用物理变换器（GPhyT），这是一个在1.8TB多样化仿真数据上训练的物理基础模型。该模型通过上下文学习推断动力学规律，无需知晓底层方程即可模拟流体-固体相互作用、冲击波、热对流和多相动力学等多种物理系统，在多个物理领域超越专用架构7倍以上，并实现零样本泛化到未见物理系统以及更稳定的长期预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前物理感知的机器学习方法局限于单一狭窄领域，每个新系统都需要重新训练。而自然语言处理领域的基础模型已实现"一次训练，随处部署"的范式，因此将这一范式引入物理模拟将极大 democratize 高保真仿真访问、加速科学发现，并消除专用求解器开发的需求。

Method: GPhyT基于Transformer架构，在1.8TB的多样化仿真数据上进行训练。核心创新在于Transformer能够从上下文中学习推断控制动力学规律，从而无需被告知底层方程即可模拟多种物理系统（流体-固体相互作用、冲击波、热对流、多相动力学等）。

Result: （1）在多个物理领域超越专用架构7倍以上；（2）通过上下文学习实现零样本泛化到完全未见过的物理系统；（3）通过长程推演实现更稳定的长期预测。

Conclusion: 本文证明了单一模型可以从数据中学习可泛化的物理原理，为迈向能够变革计算科学与工程的通用物理基础模型开辟了道路。

Abstract: Foundation models have revolutionized natural language processing through a ``train once, deploy anywhere'' paradigm, where a single pre-trained model adapts to countless downstream tasks without retraining. Access to a Physics Foundation Model (PFM) would be transformative - democratizing access to high-fidelity simulations, accelerating scientific discovery, and eliminating the need for specialized solver development. Yet current physics-aware machine learning approaches remain fundamentally limited to single, narrow domains and require retraining for each new system. We present the General Physics Transformer (GPhyT), trained on 1.8 TB of diverse simulation data, that demonstrates foundation model capabilities are achievable for physics. Our key insight is that transformers can learn to infer governing dynamics from context, enabling a single model to simulate fluid-solid interactions, shock waves, thermal convection, and multi-phase dynamics without being told the underlying equations. GPhyT achieves three critical breakthroughs: (1) superior performance across multiple physics domains, outperforming specialized architectures by more than 7x, (2) plausible zero-shot generalization to entirely unseen physical systems through in-context learning, and (3) more stable long-term predictions through long-horizon rollouts. By establishing that a single model can learn generalizable physical principles from data alone, this work opens the path toward a universal PFM that could transform computational science and engineering.

</details>


### [877] [VMDNet: Temporal Leakage-Free Variational Mode Decomposition for Electricity Demand Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.15394)
*Weibin Feng,Ran Tao,John Cartlidge,Jin Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出VMDNet框架，通过样本级VMD避免信息泄露、频率感知嵌入+并行TCN建模模态、以及Stackelberg博弈优化超参数，在三个电力需求数据集上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于VMD的电力需求预测方法存在信息泄露和不恰当的超参数调优问题，需要一种因果保持的分解框架来有效建模电力需求序列的多周期特性。

Method: (i) 样本级VMD避免时序泄露；(ii) 频率感知嵌入表示每个分解模态，并行TCN解码以保证模态独立性和高效学习；(iii) Stackelberg博弈启发双层方案指导VMD两个关键超参数的选择。

Result: 在三个广泛使用的电力需求数据集上，VMDNet一致性地优于最先进的基线方法。

Conclusion: VMDNet通过因果保持的分解、频率感知建模和博弈论优化的超参数选择，有效解决了VMD在电力负荷预测中的信息泄露和调参问题，显著提升预测性能。

Abstract: Accurate electricity demand forecasting is challenging due to the strong multi-periodicity of real-world demand series, which makes effective modeling of recurrent temporal patterns crucial. Decomposition techniques make such structure explicit and thereby improve predictive performance. Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) is a powerful signal-processing method for periodicity-aware decomposition and has seen growing adoption in recent years. However, existing studies often suffer from information leakage and rely on inappropriate hyperparameter tuning. To address these issues, we propose VMDNet, a causality-preserving framework that (i) applies sample-wise VMD to avoid temporal leakage; (ii) represents each decomposed mode with frequency-aware embeddings and decodes it using parallel temporal convolutional networks (TCNs), ensuring mode independence and efficient learning; and (iii) introduces a Stackelberg game inspired bilevel scheme to guide the selection of VMD's two key hyperparameters. Experiments on three widely used electricity demand datasets show that VMDNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [878] [d2: Improving Reasoning in Diffusion Language Models via Trajectory Likelihood Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.21474)
*Guanghan Wang,Gilad Turok,Yair Schiff,Marianne Arriola,Volodymyr Kuleshov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出d²，一个专为掩码扩散语言模型设计的推理框架，其核心是一种新的策略梯度算法。针对不同模型类别，分别提出d²-AnyOrder（精确轨迹似然，单次模型前向传播）和d²-StepMerge（近似轨迹似然，可分析控制计算-精度权衡）。实验表明d²显著优于现有RL基线，在逻辑推理和数学推理任务上达到新SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型在文本生成上表现优异，但如何利用强化学习提升其推理能力仍是一个活跃但未充分解决的研究问题。现有方法缺乏针对掩码DLM特点设计的推理框架。

Method: 提出d²推理框架，核心是新的策略梯度算法，关键在于准确估计采样轨迹似然。针对支持任意顺序解码的DLM提出d²-AnyOrder，通过单次模型前向传播实现精确轨迹似然；针对标准掩码扩散模型提出d²-StepMerge，以可分析的方式近似轨迹似然，实现计算与精度的权衡。

Result: d²显著优于广泛使用的RL基线；在Countdown、Sudoku、GSM8K和MATH500等逻辑推理和数学推理基准上达到新的SOTA性能。

Conclusion: d²为掩码扩散语言模型提供了一种有效的强化学习推理框架，通过针对不同模型特性设计的轨迹似然估计方法，实现了推理能力的显著提升。同时指出任意顺序解码在实践中并非普遍支持。

Abstract: While diffusion language models (DLMs) have achieved competitive performance in text generation, improving their reasoning ability with reinforcement learning remains an active research area. Here, we introduce d2, a reasoning framework tailored for masked DLMs. Central to our framework is a new policy gradient algorithm that relies on accurate estimates of the sampling trajectory likelihoods. Because computing these likelihoods naively is computationally expensive for masked DLMs, we develop a family of estimators tailored to distinct model classes. For DLMs that support a sampling algorithm called any-order decoding, we propose d2-AnyOrder, which achieves exact trajectory likelihood with a single model pass. Through an empirical study of widely used DLMs, we show that any-order decoding is not universally supported in practice. For standard masked diffusion models, we propose d2-StepMerge, which approximates the trajectory likelihood, trading off compute for approximation accuracy in an analytically tractable manner. Empirically, d2 significantly outperforms widely-used RL baselines when applied to popular DLMs, and sets a new state-of-the-art performance for DLMs on logical reasoning tasks (Countdown and Sudoku) and math reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K and MATH500). We provide the code along with a blog post on the project page: https://guanghanwang.com/d2

</details>


### [879] [FedCF: Fair Federated Conformal Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22907)
*Anutam Srinivasan,Aditya T. Vadlamani,Amin Meghrazi,Srinivasan Parthasarathy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在联邦学习环境中扩展共形公平性（CF）框架的方法，通过分析不同人口统计组的公平性差距来审计联邦模型的公平性，并在多个数据集上进行了实证验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准共形预测（CP）对敏感属性不可知，无法保证不同子组的条件覆盖，现有工作虽引入公平性CP，但尚未在联邦学习场景中充分研究，因此需要将共形公平性扩展到联邦学习设置中。

Method: 在联邦学习框架下扩展Conformal Fairness（CF）方法，利用可交换性假设，通过分析不同人口统计组之间的公平性相关差距来审计联邦模型的公平性。

Result: 在多个领域的数据集上进行实证实验，验证了所提出的联邦共形公平性框架的有效性。

Conclusion: 成功将共形公平性扩展到联邦学习环境，实现了对联邦模型公平性的审计，为分布式场景下的不确定性量化与公平性保障提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Conformal Prediction (CP) is a widely used technique for quantifying uncertainty in machine learning models. In its standard form, CP offers probabilistic guarantees on the coverage of the true label, but it is agnostic to sensitive attributes in the dataset. Several recent works have sought to incorporate fairness into CP by ensuring conditional coverage guarantees across different subgroups. One such method is Conformal Fairness (CF). In this work, we extend the CF framework to the Federated Learning setting and discuss how we can audit a federated model for fairness by analyzing the fairness-related gaps for different demographic groups. We empirically validate our framework by conducting experiments on several datasets spanning multiple domains, fully leveraging the exchangeability assumption.

</details>


### [880] [Interpretable Self-Supervised Learning via Representer Landmarks and Nyström Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.24467)
*Maedeh Zarvandi,Michael Timothy,Theresa Wasserer,Debarghya Ghoshdastidar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KREPES是一个统一框架，通过核方法（神经正切核+表示定理）解释SimCLR、BYOL、VICReg等自监督学习目标，将潜在空间表示为"表示地标"（有影响力的无标签训练样本的表示），并引入新指标量化表征透明性，支持大规模数据集上的无监督审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督学习从海量无标签数据中学习表征，但模型通常是黑箱，缺乏可解释性，需要领域特定的解释方法。

Method: 将经验神经正切核近似与核的表示定理结合，将学习到的潜在空间表示为"表示地标"（有影响力的无标签训练样本的表示）；引入"样本特定影响分数"、"概念条件影响分数"和"特征对齐差距"三个新指标；提出基于Nyström近似的分析推理框架，支持百万级样本规模。

Result: KREPES能够在无监督条件下直接审计潜在空间，例如揭示Adult-1M数据集中SSL使用人口统计代理变量来推断收入这一算法偏差。

Conclusion: KREPES为自监督学习提供了一种可扩展的、无监督的透明性量化分析框架，能够审计潜在空间中的偏差。

Abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) learns representations from massive unlabeled data, yet the resulting models typically operate as black boxes, necessitating domain-specific explanations. We introduce KREPES, a unified framework to analytically interpret the learned representations of SSL objectives, including SimCLR, BYOL, and VICReg. By bridging empirical neural tangent kernel approximations of neural networks with the Representer Theorem for kernels, we express the learned latent space directly via "Representer Landmarks", which are the representations of influential unlabeled training examples. We introduce novel metrics, "Sample-Specific Influence Score", "Concept-Conditioned Influence Score" and "Feature Alignment Gap", to quantify the transparency of the learned representations. KREPES enables direct audit of the latent space without supervision, for example, revealing an algorithmic bias in the Adult-1M dataset where SSL uses demographic proxies for income. Finally, to ensure scalability to benchmarks with 1M+ samples (ImageNet-1K, Adult-1M), KREPES introduces a novel Nyström approximation-based analytical inference framework for SSL objectives.

</details>


### [881] [Learning Hamiltonian Dynamics at Scale: A Differential-Geometric Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.24627)
*Katharina Friedl,Noémie Jaquier,Alyx Liao,Danica Kragic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RO-HNN结合哈密顿力学守恒律与模型降阶技术，通过几何约束辛自编码器学习低维结构保持子流形，并利用几何哈密顿神经网络在该子流形上建模动力学，实现了对高维复杂动力系统的物理一致、稳定且泛化的预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将物理直觉嵌入网络架构可学习遵循能量守恒等基本规律的动力系统，但现有方法难以扩展到高维动力系统。本文旨在解决哈密顿神经网络在复杂高维物理系统中的可扩展性问题。

Method: 提出RO-HNN，包含两个核心组件：1）几何约束辛自编码器，学习低维且保持辛结构的子流形；2）几何哈密顿神经网络，在该子流形上建模动力学，从而结合哈密顿力学的守恒律与模型降阶的可扩展性。

Result: RO-HNN能够对复杂高维动力学提供物理一致、稳定且泛化的预测，有效将哈密顿神经网络的适用范围扩展到高维物理系统。

Conclusion: 通过结合守恒律与降阶技术，RO-HNN成功克服了哈密顿神经网络在高维系统中的扩展瓶颈，为学习高维物理系统动力学提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Embedding physical intuition into network architectures allows the learning of dynamics that enforce fundamental properties, such as energy conservation laws, thereby leading to physically-plausible predictions. Yet, scaling these models to high-dimensional dynamical systems remains a significant challenge. This paper introduces Reduced-order Hamiltonian Neural Network (RO-HNN), a novel physics-inspired neural network that combines the conservation laws of Hamiltonian mechanics with the scalability of model order reduction. RO-HNN is built on two core components: a novel geometrically-constrained symplectic autoencoder that learns a low-dimensional, structure-preserving symplectic submanifold, and a geometric Hamiltonian neural network that models the dynamics on the submanifold. Our experiments demonstrate that RO-HNN provides physically-consistent, stable, and generalizable predictions of complex high-dimensional dynamics, thereby effectively extending the scope of Hamiltonian neural networks to high-dimensional physical systems.

</details>


### [882] [T-POP: Test-Time Personalization with Online Preference Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.24696)
*Zikun Qu,Min Zhang,Mingze Kong,Xiang Li,Zhiwei Shang,Zhiyong Wang,Yikun Ban,Shuang Qiu,Yao Shu,Zhongxiang Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对大语言模型个性化中的冷启动问题，本文提出T-POP算法，通过在线成对偏好反馈，在测试时结合对决老虎机学习奖励函数来引导冻结LLM的解码过程，无需微调即可实现快速且数据高效的个性化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM个性化方法需要大量预存用户数据或耗时的微调，对新用户存在严重的冷启动问题，无法实现实时个性化。

Method: 提出T-POP算法，将测试时对齐与对决老虎机相结合：在不更新LLM参数的前提下，通过在线收集成对偏好反馈，学习一个奖励函数来引导冻结LLM的解码过程，利用对决老虎机在探索用户偏好与利用已学知识之间高效平衡。

Result: 实验表明T-POP实现了快速且数据高效的个性化，显著优于现有基线，且随着用户交互次数增加表现持续提升。

Conclusion: T-POP为LLM实时个性化提供了新范式，通过在线偏好反馈和测试时对齐有效解决了冷启动问题，同时保持计算高效性。

Abstract: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) to individual user preferences is a critical step beyond generating generically helpful responses. However, current personalization methods are ill-suited for new users, as they typically require either slow, resource-intensive fine-tuning or a substantial amount of pre-existing user data, creating a significant cold-start problem. To address this challenge, we introduce a new paradigm for real-time personalization by learning from online pairwise preference feedback collected during text generation. We propose T-POP (Test-Time Personalization with Online Preference Feedback}), a novel algorithm that synergistically combines test-time alignment with dueling bandits. Without updating the LLM parameters, T-POP steers the decoding process of a frozen LLM by learning a reward function online that captures user preferences. By leveraging dueling bandits, T-POP intelligently queries the user to efficiently balance between exploring their preferences and exploiting the learned knowledge to generate personalized text. Extensive experiments demonstrate that T-POP achieves rapid and data-efficient personalization, significantly outperforming existing baselines and showing consistent improvement with more user interactions.

</details>


### [883] [Distillation of Large Language Models via Concrete Score Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.25837)
*Yeongmin Kim,Donghyeok Shin,Mina Kang,Byeonghu Na,Il-Chul Moon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Concrete Score Distillation (CSD)，一种离散分数匹配目标函数，用于大语言模型知识蒸馏。CSD克服了softmax导致的logit信息模糊和直接logit蒸馏忽略平移不变性的问题，通过对齐师生模型间所有词汇对的相对logit差异，实现了更优的蒸馏效果。实验表明CSD在指令遵循和任务特定蒸馏上均优于现有方法，并可与on-policy技术互补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏目标函数存在两个主要问题：(1) 使用softmax匹配师生概率会模糊有价值的logit信息；(2) 直接logit蒸馏未考虑logit平移不变性，限制了最优解空间。因此需要一种能同时克服这两个局限性的蒸馏目标。

Method: 提出Concrete Score Distillation (CSD)，一种离散分数匹配目标函数。具体做法：(1) 解决自回归LLM中离散分数匹配的训练不稳定和二次复杂度问题；(2) CSD目标对齐师生模型所有词汇对间的相对logit差异，并支持灵活加权；(3) 框架内提供mode-seeking和mode-covering两种实例。

Result: 在GPT-2-1.5B、OpenLLaMA-7B和GEMMA-7B-IT上，CSD在任务无关的指令遵循和任务特定蒸馏中均一致超越近期知识蒸馏目标，实现更优的保真度-多样性权衡，且与on-policy技术结合可获得互补性增益。

Conclusion: CSD是一种可扩展且有效的LLM蒸馏方法，通过离散分数匹配克服了softmax平滑和最优解空间限制问题，在多种模型规模和任务上均优于现有蒸馏目标。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) deliver remarkable performance but are costly to deploy, motivating knowledge distillation (KD) for efficient inference. Existing KD objectives typically match student and teacher probabilities via softmax, which blurs valuable logit information. While direct logit distillation (DLD) mitigates softmax smoothing, it fails to account for logit shift invariance, thereby restricting the solution space. We propose Concrete Score Distillation (CSD), a discrete score-matching objective that overcomes both softmax-induced smoothing and restrictions on the optimal solution set. We resolve the training instability and quadratic complexity of discrete score-matching in autoregressive LLMs, and the resulting CSD objective aligns relative logit differences across all vocabulary pairs between student and teacher with flexible weighting. We provide both mode-seeking and mode-covering instances within our framework and evaluate CSD on task-agnostic instruction-following and task-specific distillation using GPT-2-1.5B, OpenLLaMA-7B, and GEMMA-7B-IT. Experiments show that CSD consistently surpasses recent KD objectives, achieves favorable fidelity-diversity trade-offs, and yields complementary gains when combined with on-policy techniques, demonstrating its scalability and effectiveness for LLM distillation. Code: https://github.com/aailab-kaist/CSD.

</details>


### [884] [Simultaneous Multi-objective Alignment Across Verifiable and Non-verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.01167)
*Yiran Shen,Yu Xia,Jonathan Chang,Prithviraj Ammanabrolu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MAHALO是一个统一框架，通过多动作头DPO和PRM引导解码，实现跨可验证奖励、主观偏好和复杂交互场景的多目标对齐，在数学推理、人类价值观对齐和多轮辅导中同时提升多个目标且干扰有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型对齐方法将异质信号压缩为单一目标，导致多目标对齐中个体目标相互冲突，训练效率低下且推理时用户控制有限。

Method: 提出MAHALO框架，包含三部分：(1) 标准化PRM训练，统一可验证和非可验证场景的步骤级监督；(2) 多动作头DPO实现向量化多目标对齐；(3) 通过目标特定权重和PRM引导解码实现可控推理。

Result: 在数学推理、人类价值观对齐和多轮辅导实验中，MAHALO能够同时提升多个目标，目标间干扰有限，具有良好的泛化性和领域适应性，并在推理时提供灵活的用户控制。

Conclusion: MAHALO有效解决了多目标对齐中的冲突问题，实现了高效的多维度对齐训练和可控推理，且框架具有通用性。

Abstract: Aligning large language models to human preferences is inherently multidimensional, yet most pipelines collapse heterogeneous signals into a single objective. We seek to answer what it would take to simultaneously align a model across various domains spanning those with: verifiable rewards, non-verifiable subjective preferences, and complex interactive scenarios. Such multi-objective alignment setups are often plagued by individual objectives being at odds with each other, resulting in inefficient training and limited user control during inference. To address these issues, we propose $\textbf{M}$ulti-$\textbf{A}$ction-$\textbf{H}$ead $\textbf{AL}$ignment with PRM-guided Dec$\textbf{O}$ding ($\textbf{MAHALO}$), a unified framework that standardizes PRM training across verifiable and non-verifiable settings for step-level supervision, performs vectorized multi-objective alignment with Multi-Action-Head DPO, and enables controllable inference through objective-specific weighting and PRM-guided decoding. Experiments across math reasoning, human values alignment, and multi-turn tutoring show that MAHALO jointly improves multiple objectives simultaneously with limited interference, while remaining generalizable and adaptable across domains and offering flexible user control at inference time. Our code is available at: https://github.com/pearls-lab/multiobj-align.

</details>


### [885] [Chaining 2-FWL GNNs for Combinatorial Graph Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03086)
*Marc Lelarge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出链式Folklore型GNN（2-FWL）用于图对齐问题，通过序列化训练、非可微排序注入离散组合反馈，在稀疏Erdos-Renyi图、相关正则图和三个真实世界基准上显著优于FAQ及现有GNN方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合图对齐问题中，FAQ（分拆二次分配）仍是强经典基线，而现有GNN方法在纯结构环境下表现不佳；且先前比较低估了FAQ的性能（因使用均匀初始化），需要一种能有效结合离散组合反馈的GNN方法。

Method: 提出链式过程：一系列Folklore型（2-FWL）GNN序列，每个网络在前一个网络的相似度矩阵解码后进行交叉熵训练，通过非可微排序步骤按当前对齐质量对节点排序，在每个环节注入离散组合反馈；推理时迭代最终网络并保留最高nce的候选解。可与FAQ后处理结合。

Result: 在噪声0.25的稀疏Erdos-Renyi图上，链式FGNN+FAQ后处理达85%准确率，FAQ凸松弛初始化仅13%，先前GNN方法约0%；在相关正则图上（MPNN恒定特征、1-WL失效、FAQ凸初始化退化），链式方法是唯一恢复非平凡对齐的方法；在三个真实基准上，FAQ用凸松弛初始化已超越先前报告数字，链式FGNN进一步提升。

Conclusion: 链式FGNN通过离散排序反馈有效增强了GNN在图对齐中的组合推理能力，在经典基准和真实数据上均显著优于现有方法，同时修正了先前工作中FAQ被低估的问题。

Abstract: For the combinatorial graph alignment problem (GAP) -- finding the node correspondence that maximizes the number of common edges (nce) between two unlabeled graphs -- properly initialized FAQ remains a strong classical baseline, while existing GNN approaches struggle in the purely structural setting. We introduce a chaining procedure: a sequence of Folklore-type (2-FWL) GNNs in which each network is trained with cross-entropy after decoding the previous network's similarity matrix and ranking nodes by their current alignment quality. This non-differentiable ranking step injects discrete combinatorial feedback at every link; at inference, we iterate the final network and keep the candidate with highest observed nce. On sparse Erdos-Renyi graphs at noise level 0.25, chained FGNNs with FAQ post-processing reach 85% accuracy versus 13% for FAQ initialized from the convex relaxation, and essentially 0% for prior GNN methods. On correlated regular graphs, where MPNNs with constant features produce identical node embeddings (1-WL fails to refine) and FAQ's convex initialization is degenerate, chaining is the only method we know that recovers a non-trivial alignment. On three real-world benchmarks (yeast PPI, coauthorship, and road networks), we show that recent comparisons underestimate FAQ by initializing it from a uniform doubly stochastic matrix; once FAQ is initialized from the convex relaxation it already surpasses prior reported numbers, and dataset-specific chained FGNNs further improve on this strengthened baseline.

</details>


### [886] [Verifying Meta-Awareness via Predictive Rewards in Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03259)
*Yoonjeon Kim,Doohyuk Jang,Eunho Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MAPR通过引入元感知预测奖励（预测生成长度、通过率和所用概念），让推理模型具备元认知能力，显著提升推理准确率和训练效率，在AIME25上准确率提升83.18%，六个数学基准平均提升13.04%，训练速度提升1.28倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大型推理模型仅依赖基于答案的验证，缺乏对自身推理过程和知识边界的元认知意识，导致推理效率低下且无法动态调整思考策略。

Method: 提出MAPR框架，让模型自生成任务来预测推理的展开统计量（长度、通过率、所用概念），并与实际统计量进行对比验证；利用自我预测能力实现：(i)过滤无意义或不可解提示，(ii)减少长但不正确的生成，(iii)生成与问题相关的提示。

Result: 在AIME25上准确率提升83.18%，六个数学基准平均提升13.04%；训练速度提升1.28倍（同等性能下GRPO训练加速）。

Conclusion: 引入元感知目标可以显著提升推理模型的性能和训练效率，验证了元认知能力对推理模型的重要性。

Abstract: Recent research on reasoning models explores the meta-awareness of language models, including their ability to determine optimal thinking duration, recognize knowledge boundaries, and structure concept-level thinking. While current large reasoning models depend solely on answer-based verification, we show that adding meta-awareness objectives leads to significant performance gains over models without such meta-knowledge. MAPR (Meta-Awareness via Predictive Reward) utilizes a self-generated task of predicting rollout statistics - specifically length, pass-rate, and concepts used - allowing for verification against the actual statistics. Furthermore, by leveraging this self-predictive capability, the model can regulate its reasoning behavior by i) filtering out trivial or unsolvable prompts, ii) reducing lengthy generations that tend to be incorrect, and iii) generating hints relevant to the problem. The results are inspiring: MAPR yields significant improvements in both accuracy and training efficiency on various reasoning benchmarks. More specifically, our method can speed up GRPO training by over 1.28x to reach the same performance, and achieve 83.18% gain in accuracy on AIME25, and a 13.04% average gain over six mathematics benchmarks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/akatigre/MAPR-RL.

</details>


### [887] [Trajectory Data Suffices for Statistically Efficient Policy Evaluation in Fixed-Horizon Offline RL with Linear $q^π$-Realizability and Concentrability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03494)
*Volodymyr Tkachuk,Csaba Szepesvári,Xiaoqi Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了有限时域离线强化学习中策略评估与策略优化问题，在线性可表示性和轨迹数据假设下，提出了统计高效的策略评估算法，并改进了策略优化的样本复杂度分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作表明，仅依靠数据覆盖性和线性可表示性假设无法实现统计高效的离线强化学习。近期Tkachuk等人(2024)在额外假设数据以轨迹形式给出的条件下实现了策略优化的统计高效学习。本文旨在将该结果推广到策略评估问题，并进一步改进策略优化的样本复杂度。

Method: 在有限时域离线强化学习设定下，假设数据以轨迹形式给出，且状态-动作值函数满足线性可表示性。针对策略评估问题设计了统计高效的学习器；对策略优化问题，通过更紧的分析改进了Tkachuk等人(2024)方法的样本复杂度。

Result: 在轨迹数据和线性可表示性假设下，实现了策略评估的统计高效学习；同时将策略优化的样本复杂度进行改进。

Conclusion: 离线强化学习在更合理的假设下（轨迹数据+线性可表示性）可以实现策略评估和策略优化的统计高效学习，且策略优化的样本复杂度可以进一步优化。

Abstract: We study finite-horizon offline reinforcement learning (RL) with function approximation for both policy evaluation and policy optimization. Prior work established that statistically efficient learning is impossible for either of these problems when the only assumptions are that the data has good coverage (concentrability) and the state-action value function of every policy is linearly realizable ($q^π$-realizability) (Foster et al., 2021). Recently, Tkachuk et al. (2024) gave a statistically efficient learner for policy optimization, if in addition the data is assumed to be given as trajectories. In this work we present a statistically efficient learner for policy evaluation under the same assumptions. Further, we show that the sample complexity of the learner used by Tkachuk et al. (2024) for policy optimization can be improved by a tighter analysis.

</details>


### [888] [From Moments to Models: Graphon-Mixture Learning for Mixup and Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03690)
*Ali Azizpour,Reza Ramezanpour,Santiago Segarra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出统一框架，将图数据建模为图生成模型（graphon）的混合分布，利用图矩（motif密度）进行聚类，并推导更紧的误差界。基于此开发了图混合感知的mixup增强（GMAM）和模型感知的图对比学习（MGCL），在监督和无监督任务上均取得优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实图数据常来自混合分布，不同图由多个不同的底层生成模型产生，而现有方法未有效建模这种异质性。

Method: 将图数据建模为graphon混合模型，利用motif密度（图矩）聚类，推导graphon相似性与motif密度一致性的高概率紧界；据此提出GMAM（mixup增强）和MGCL（对比学习）两种下游方法。

Result: GMAM在7个数据集的6个上取得SOTA准确率；MGCL在7个基准数据集上平均排名最低。

Conclusion: 显式建模图生成模型的混合分布能有效提升图增强和对比学习的性能，理论分析与实验均验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: Real-world graph datasets often arise from mixtures of populations, where graphs are generated by multiple distinct underlying distributions. In this work, we propose a unified framework that explicitly models graph data as a mixture of probabilistic graph generative models represented by graphons. To characterize and estimate these graphons, we leverage graph moments (motif densities) to cluster graphs generated from the same underlying model. We establish a novel theoretical guarantee, deriving a tighter bound showing that graphs sampled from structurally similar graphons exhibit similar motif densities with high probability. This result enables principled estimation of graphon mixture components. We show how incorporating estimated graphon mixture components enhances two widely used downstream paradigms: graph data augmentation via mixup and graph contrastive learning. By conditioning these methods on the underlying generative models, we develop graphon-mixture-aware mixup (GMAM) and model-aware graph contrastive learning (MGCL). Extensive experiments on both simulated and real-world datasets demonstrate strong empirical performance. In supervised learning, GMAM outperforms existing augmentation strategies, achieving new state-of-the-art accuracy on 6 out of 7 datasets. In unsupervised learning, MGCL performs competitively across seven benchmark datasets and achieves the lowest average rank overall.

</details>


### [889] [Neural Low-Discrepancy Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03745)
*Michael Etienne Van Huffel,Nathan Kirk,Makram Chahine,Daniela Rus,T. Konstantin Rusch*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NeuroLDS，首个基于机器学习的有限低差异序列生成框架，通过两阶段学习（监督逼近+无监督微调）使点序列在所有前缀上达到低差异，在数值积分、机器人运动规划和科学机器学习等任务中显著优于传统方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低差异点集生成方法（如MPMC）基于机器学习取得了优于传统方法的结果，但局限于生成点集而非序列；而低差异序列（LDS）要求所有前缀都具有低差异特性，对许多应用至关重要，目前尚无基于机器学习的方法能实现这一点。

Method: 两阶段学习框架：第一阶段通过监督学习逼近经典LDS构造方法，第二阶段通过无监督微调最小化所有前缀的差异度量。

Result: NeuroLDS在差异度量上显著优于所有传统LDS构造方法，并在数值积分、机器人运动规划和科学机器学习等应用中验证了有效性。

Conclusion: NeuroLDS是首个基于机器学习的LDS生成框架，展示了机器学习在序列设计领域的巨大潜力，具有广泛的应用前景。

Abstract: Low-discrepancy points are designed to efficiently fill the space in a uniform manner. This uniformity is highly advantageous in many problems in science and engineering, including in numerical integration, computer vision, machine perception, computer graphics, machine learning, and simulation. Whereas most previous low-discrepancy constructions rely on abstract algebra and number theory, Message-Passing Monte Carlo (MPMC) was recently introduced to exploit machine learning methods for generating point sets with lower discrepancy than previously possible. However, MPMC is limited to generating point sets and cannot be extended to low-discrepancy sequences (LDS), i.e., sequences of points in which every prefix has low discrepancy, a property essential for many applications. To address this limitation, we introduce Neural Low-Discrepancy Sequences (NeuroLDS), the first machine learning-based framework for generating finite LDS. Drawing inspiration from classical LDS, we train a neural network to map indices to points such that the resulting sequences exhibit minimal discrepancy across all prefixes. To this end, we deploy a two-stage learning process: supervised approximation of classical constructions followed by unsupervised fine-tuning to minimize prefix discrepancies. We demonstrate that NeuroLDS outperforms all previous LDS constructions by a significant margin with respect to discrepancy measures. Moreover, we demonstrate the effectiveness of NeuroLDS across diverse applications, including numerical integration, robot motion planning, and scientific machine learning. These results highlight the promise and broad significance of Neural Low-Discrepancy Sequences. Our code can be found at https://github.com/camail-official/neuro-lds.

</details>


### [890] [Margin Adaptive DPO: Leveraging Reward Model for Granular Control in Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.05342)
*Hyung Gyu Rho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MADPO是一种通过在实例级别自适应调整DPO损失权重的对齐方法，能根据偏好边际对困难样本放大权重、对简单样本降低权重，从而解决DPO中固定温度参数导致的过拟合和欠学习问题，在摘要任务上优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO依赖固定温度参数，在多样化偏好数据上训练次优，导致对简单样本过拟合、对信息性样本学习不足。现有方法如IPO过于保守，β-DPO存在批次级适应导致折衷、线性更新产生不稳定负β值、过滤机制丢弃有用信号等问题。

Method: MADPO采用两步法：先训练奖励模型估计偏好边际，再基于边际对每个训练样本的DPO损失施加连续自适应权重。该重加权方案为困难对放大目标边际、为简单对压缩目标边际，实现对学习信号的细粒度控制。

Result: 在人类偏好数据的摘要任务中，MADPO在多个解码温度下始终优于DPO、IPO、β-DPO等强基线方法。

Conclusion: MADPO提供了稳定、数据保留、实例级别的解决方案，具有良定义的优化景观和对奖励模型估计误差的鲁棒性，理论与实验均验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as a simple and effective method for aligning large language models. However, its reliance on a fixed temperature parameter leads to suboptimal training on diverse preference data, causing overfitting on easy examples and under-learning from informative ones. Recent methods have emerged to counter this. While IPO addresses general overfitting, its uniform regularization can be overly conservative. The more targeted approach of $β$-DPO suffers from its own limitations: its batch-level adaptation applies a single, compromised temperature to mixed-margin pairs, its linear update rule can produce unstable negative $β$ values, and its filtering mechanism discards potentially useful training signals. In this work, we introduce Margin-Adaptive Direct Preference Optimization (MADPO), a method that provides a stable, data-preserving, and instance-level solution. MADPO employs a practical two-step approach: it first trains a reward model to estimate preference margins and then uses these margins to apply a continuous, adaptive weight to the DPO loss for each individual training sample. This re-weighting scheme creates an effective target margin that is amplified for hard pairs and dampened for easy pairs, allowing for granular control over the learning signal. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis, proving that MADPO has a well-behaved optimization landscape and is robust to reward model estimation errors. We validate our theory with experiments on a summarization task using human preference data. MADPO consistently outperforms strong baselines across a comprehensive sweep of decoding temperatures.

</details>


### [891] [Generalization of Gibbs and Langevin Monte Carlo Algorithms in the Interpolation Regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.06028)
*Andreas Maurer,Erfan Mirzaei,Massimiliano Pontil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提供了过参数化插值场景下Gibbs算法期望误差的数据依赖界，证明低温区间的泛化能力可通过高温区间的低训练误差信号预测，并设计了在MNIST、CIFAR-10、SVHN上能对真实标签给出接近测试误差的预测、同时对随机标签保持正确上界的算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在过参数化插值场景中，模型即使拟合随机标签也能达到零训练误差，这使得传统泛化界失效。本文旨在利用Gibbs算法在不同温度下的行为，建立能够区分真实数据与随机标签的泛化界，并设计可实际计算的算法。

Method: 利用Gibbs算法在高、低温区间的统计力学性质，建立数据依赖的泛化误差上界；通过Langevin Monte Carlo近似验证界的稳定性；基于理论分析设计可计算泛化界的算法。

Result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10、SVHN数据集上，算法对真实标签数据给出的测试误差预测接近真实值，同时对随机标签数据保持了正确的上界。

Conclusion: 低温区间的泛化能力可由高温区间的训练误差信号预测，且所提方法能在过参数化插值场景下有效区分真实数据与随机标签，为理解深度学习中的泛化机制提供了新的理论工具。

Abstract: This paper provides data-dependent bounds on the expected error of the Gibbs algorithm in the overparameterized interpolation regime, where low training errors are also obtained for impossible data, such as random labels in classification. The results show that generalization in the low-temperature regime is already signaled by small training errors in the noisier high-temperature regime. The bounds are stable under approximation with Langevin Monte Carlo algorithms. The analysis motivates the design of an algorithm to compute bounds, which on the MNIST, CIFAR-10, and SVHN datasets yield nontrivial, close predictions on the test error for true labeled data, while maintaining a correct upper bound on the test error for random labels.

</details>


### [892] [BLISS: A Lightweight Bilevel Influence Scoring Method for Data Selection in Language Model Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.06048)
*Jie Hao,Rui Yu,Wei Zhang,Huixia Wang,Jie Xu,Mingrui Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BLISS是一种轻量级数据选择方法，无需外部预训练模型，通过双层优化和代理模型估计数据样本的长期影响，在LLM预训练中实现了1.7倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据选择方法依赖外部预训练模型，难以分离数据选择与模型本身的影响，且忽略数据在模型训练至收敛时的长期影响。

Method: 使用小型代理模型作为LLM的替代，通过双层优化：上层优化评分模型以分配样本重要性权重，下层优化训练代理模型至收敛。最终用训练的评分模型预测数据的影响分数，选择高质量样本用于LLM预训练。

Result: 在410M/1B/2.8B Pythia和LLaMA-0.5B模型上验证，在1B模型设置下，达到相同性能比现有最优方法快1.7倍。

Conclusion: BLISS无需外部预训练模型即可有效进行数据选择，且能考虑长期影响，显著提升LLM预训练效率。

Abstract: Effective data selection is essential for pretraining large language models (LLMs), enhancing efficiency and improving generalization to downstream tasks. However, existing approaches often require leveraging external pretrained models, making it difficult to disentangle the effects of data selection from those of the external pretrained models. In addition, they often overlook the long-term impact of selected data if the model is trained to convergence, primarily due to the prohibitive cost of full-scale LLM pretraining. In this paper, we introduce BLISS (\textbf{B}ileve\textbf{L} \textbf{I}nfluence \textbf{S}coring method for data \textbf{S}election): a lightweight data selection method that operates entirely \emph{from scratch}, without relying on any external pretrained oracle models, while explicitly accounting for the long-term impact of selected data. BLISS leverages a small proxy model as a surrogate for the LLM and employs a score model to estimate the long-term influence of training samples if the proxy model is trained to convergence. We formulate data selection as a bilevel optimization problem, where the upper-level objective optimizes the score model to assign importance weights to training samples, ensuring that minimizing the lower-level objective (i.e., training the proxy model over the weighted training loss until convergence) leads to best validation performance. Once optimized, the trained score model predicts influence scores for the dataset, enabling efficient selection of high-quality samples for LLM pretraining. We validate BLISS by pretraining 410M/1B/2.8B Pythia and LLaMA-0.5B models on selected subsets of the C4 dataset. Notably, under the 1B model setting, BLISS achieves $1.7\times$ speedup in reaching the same performance as the state-of-the-art method, demonstrating superior performance across multiple downstream tasks.

</details>


### [893] [Value Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.07650)
*Perry Dong,Chongyi Zheng,Chelsea Finn,Dorsa Sadigh,Benjamin Eysenbach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Value Flows方法，利用流匹配模型估计完整回报分布，并通过流导数ODE量化回报不确定性以优先级采样，在62项基准任务中平均成功率提升1.3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分布强化学习方法（如分类分布或分位数估计）无法捕捉回报分布的精细结构，也难以区分高回报不确定性的状态用于决策，因此需要更灵活的方法来建模完整回报分布并量化不确定性。

Method: 提出新的流匹配目标生成满足分布贝尔曼方程的概率密度路径；利用流模型学习完整回报分布；通过流导数ODE估计各状态的回报不确定性；利用该不确定性优先学习某些转移上的更精确回报估计。

Result: 在37个状态空间任务和25个图像空间任务上，Value Flows平均成功率相比现有方法提升1.3倍。

Conclusion: 基于流的分布强化学习方法在离线与在线转在线设置下均优于现有方法，验证了流模型在回报分布建模与不确定性量化中的有效性。

Abstract: While most reinforcement learning methods today flatten the distribution of future returns to a single scalar value, distributional RL methods exploit the return distribution to provide stronger learning signals and to enable applications in exploration and safe RL. While the predominant method for estimating the return distribution is by modeling it as a categorical distribution over discrete bins or estimating a finite number of quantiles, such approaches leave unanswered questions about the fine-grained structure of the return distribution and about how to distinguish states with high return uncertainty for decision-making. The key idea in this paper is to use modern, flexible flow-based models to estimate the full future return distributions and identify those states with high return variance. We do so by formulating a new flow-matching objective that generates probability density paths satisfying the distributional Bellman equation. Building upon the learned flow models, we estimate the return uncertainty of distinct states using a new flow derivative ODE. We additionally use this uncertainty information to prioritize learning a more accurate return estimation on certain transitions. We compare our method (Value Flows) with prior methods in the offline and online-to-online settings. Experiments on $37$ state-based and $25$ image-based benchmark tasks demonstrate that Value Flows achieves a $1.3\times$ improvement on average in success rates. Website: https://pd-perry.github.io/value-flows Code: https://github.com/chongyi-zheng/value-flows

</details>


### [894] [FM-IRL: Flow-Matching for Reward Modeling and Policy Regularization in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.09222)
*Zhenglin Wan,Jingxuan Wu,Xingrui Yu,Chubin Zhang,Mingcong Lei,Bo An,Ivor Tsang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对Flow Matching策略在离线模仿学习中缺乏环境交互和泛化能力差的问题，提出使用简单MLP结构的学生策略进行在线探索，并通过与教师FM模型关联的奖励模型进行RL更新，同时利用教师FM模型约束学生行为以稳定学习，从而提升学习效率、泛化性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FM策略在离线模仿学习（行为克隆）中表现出色，但由于缺乏环境交互和探索，在未见过的场景中泛化能力差。而直接对FM策略进行在线交互优化存在梯度计算不稳定和推理成本高的问题，亟需一种既能利用FM表达能力又能实现高效在线探索的方法。

Method: 提出教师-学生框架：1）学生策略采用简单MLP结构，负责与环境交互探索；2）通过RL算法（基于与教师FM模型关联的奖励模型）对学生进行在线更新；3）教师FM模型同时作为正则化项约束学生行为，稳定策略学习。学生简单架构避免了FM的梯度不稳定问题，教师FM保留了专家数据分布的丰富信息。

Result: 大量实验表明该方法显著提升了学习效率、泛化性和鲁棒性，尤其在次优专家数据场景下表现突出。

Conclusion: 通过解耦表达能力（教师FM）与探索效率（学生MLP），实现了对FM策略在线优化的突破，验证了教师-学生框架在模仿学习中结合离线表达与在线探索的有效性。

Abstract: Flow Matching (FM) has shown remarkable ability in modeling complex distributions and achieves strong performance in offline imitation learning for cloning expert behaviors. However, despite its behavioral cloning expressiveness, FM-based policies are inherently limited by their lack of environmental interaction and exploration. This leads to poor generalization in unseen scenarios beyond the expert demonstrations, underscoring the necessity of online interaction with environment. Unfortunately, optimizing FM policies via online interaction is challenging and inefficient due to instability in gradient computation and high inference costs. To address these issues, we propose to let a student policy with simple MLP structure explore the environment and be online updated via RL algorithm with a reward model. This reward model is associated with a teacher FM model, containing rich information of expert data distribution. Furthermore, the same teacher FM model is utilized to regularize the student policy's behavior to stabilize policy learning. Due to the student's simple architecture, we avoid the gradient instability of FM policies and enable efficient online exploration, while still leveraging the expressiveness of the teacher FM model. Extensive experiments show that our approach significantly enhances learning efficiency, generalization, and robustness, especially when learning from suboptimal expert data.

</details>


### [895] [Safety Game: Inference-Time Alignment of Black-Box LLMs via Constrained Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.09330)
*Tuan Nguyen,Long Tran-Thanh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种黑盒、模型无关的推理时安全对齐框架，通过双人零和博弈的极小化极大均衡来平衡LLM的安全性与有用性，无需重新训练或访问模型内部结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全对齐方法（微调、RLHF）成本高、不灵活，需重新训练；推理时对齐方法仍需访问模型内部，不适合第三方利益相关者。亟需一种无需重新训练且不依赖模型内部结构的黑盒安全对齐方案。

Method: 将安全与有用性之间的权衡建模为双人零和博弈，其极小化极大均衡对应最优平衡；使用线性规划求解器在推理时计算均衡策略，LLM智能体据此生成响应。

Result: 实验证明了黑盒安全对齐的可行性，提供了一种可扩展、易访问的安全对齐路径，尤其适用于资源受限的小型组织。

Conclusion: 黑盒推理时安全对齐是一种可行且可扩展的方案，能使第三方利益相关者在无需访问模型内部或重新训练的情况下，对快速演变的LLM生态系统施加安全约束。

Abstract: Ensuring that large language models (LLMs) comply with safety requirements is a central challenge in AI deployment. Existing alignment approaches primarily operate during training, such as through fine-tuning or reinforcement learning from human feedback, but these methods are costly and inflexible, requiring retraining whenever new requirements arise. Recent efforts toward inference-time alignment mitigate some of these limitations but still assume access to model internals, which is impractical, and not suitable for third party stakeholders who do not have access to the models. In this work, we propose a model-independent, black-box framework for safety alignment that does not require retraining or access to the underlying LLM architecture. As a proof of concept, we address the problem of trading off between generating safe but uninformative answers versus helpful yet potentially risky ones. We formulate this dilemma as a two-player zero-sum game whose minimax equilibrium captures the optimal balance between safety and helpfulness. LLM agents operationalize this framework by leveraging a linear programming solver at inference time to compute equilibrium strategies. Our results demonstrate the feasibility of black-box safety alignment, offering a scalable and accessible pathway for stakeholders, including smaller organizations and entities in resource-constrained settings, to enforce safety across rapidly evolving LLM ecosystems.

</details>


### [896] [Rethinking RL Evaluation: Can Benchmarks Truly Reveal Failures of RL Methods?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.10541)
*Zihan Chen,Yiming Zhang,Hengguang Zhou,Zenghui Ding,Yining Sun,Cho-Jui Hsieh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 当前用于评估大语言模型强化学习的基准测试存在严重缺陷——在训练集上训练与在测试集上训练性能几乎相同，无法可靠衡量进步。作者提出OPG指标量化这一现象，并通过压力测试揭示现有RL方法在分布偏移、难度变化和反事实场景下泛化能力不足的问题，最后提出更可靠基准设计的三个核心原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准测试无法有效评估大语言模型强化学习的真实进展，训练集与测试集上训练的性能差距极小，导致基准无法区分真正的进步。

Method: 提出Oracle Performance Gap (OPG)指标量化训练集与测试集训练的性能差异；设计诊断套件和压力测试（分布偏移、难度变化、反事实场景）分析现有RL方法的泛化能力。

Result: 现有RL方法在基准上得分虽高，但在分布偏移、不同难度级别和反事实场景下泛化能力差，这些缺陷未被当前基准揭示；训练集与测试集训练性能几乎一致。

Conclusion: 当前基准不足以评估泛化能力，提出三个核心原则：足够难度、平衡评估、分布鲁棒性，以设计更可靠的基准。

Abstract: Current benchmarks are inadequate for evaluating progress in reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs).Despite recent benchmark gains reported for RL, we find that training on these benchmarks' training sets achieves nearly the same performance as training directly on the test sets, suggesting that the benchmarks cannot reliably separate further progress.To study this phenomenon, we introduce a diagnostic suite and the Oracle Performance Gap (OPG) metric that quantifies the performance difference between training on the train split versus the test split of a benchmark. We further analyze this phenomenon with stress tests and find that, despite strong benchmark scores, existing RL methods struggle to generalize across distribution shifts, varying levels of difficulty, and counterfactual scenarios: shortcomings that current benchmarks fail to reveal.We conclude that current benchmarks are insufficient for evaluating generalization and propose three core principles for designing more faithful benchmarks: sufficient difficulty, balanced evaluation, and distributional robustness.

</details>


### [897] [Catch-Only-One: Non-Transferable Examples for Model-Specific Authorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.10982)
*Zihan Wang,Zhiyong Ma,Zhongkui Ma,Shuofeng Liu,Akide Liu,Derui Wang,Minhui Xue,Guangdong Bai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出非可迁移样本（NTEs），通过在模型特定的低敏感子空间中重新编码数据，使数据只能被授权模型正确解码，而未经授权模型性能崩溃，从而在保持数据可用性的同时防止滥用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI法规强调用途限制，但实践中发布的数据可被任意模型使用。现有方法（数据扰动、模型重训练）无法防御未知或外部训练的模型，且依赖对训练/部署的控制。

Method: 提出非可迁移样本（NTEs），利用模型特定的低敏感子空间对数据进行重编码。这是一种无需训练、与数据无关的方法，通过子空间失配使授权模型保持输出，而未授权模型性能下降。

Result: 在多种视觉骨干网络和视觉-语言模型上，NTEs在常见预处理下保持授权模型性能，同时使未授权模型性能崩溃，甚至能抵御自适应重建攻击。

Conclusion: NTEs提供了一种实用的方法，在保持数据预期用途的同时防止未经授权的利用。

Abstract: Recent AI regulations increasingly emphasize the need for mechanisms that preserve the utility of data for AI innovation while preventing misuse, particularly by enforcing purpose limitation in downstream AI applications. In practice, enforcing this principle remains challenging, as released data can be trivially fed into arbitrary models beyond its declared intent. Existing approaches attempt to mitigate this risk by either perturbing data or retraining models to limit unintended use. These strategies, however, offer no protection against inference by unknown or externally trained models, or fundamentally rely on control over the training or deployment. In this work, we introduce non-transferable examples (NTEs), recoded data that act as a task-level "ciphertext" decodable only by a designated model. Whereas adversarial examples exploit directions of high model sensitivity, NTEs leverage the complementary insensitive subspace. We propose a training-free, data-agnostic method that recodes data within a model-specific low-sensitivity subspace, preserving outputs for the authorized model while degrading unauthorized ones through subspace misalignment. We establish formal bounds certifying authorized-model fidelity and showing that unauthorized degradation scales with measurable spectral misalignment between models. Empirically, NTEs preserve performance across diverse vision backbones and state-of-the-art vision-language models under common preprocessing, while unauthorized models collapse even under adaptive reconstruction attacks. These results establish NTEs as a practical means to preserve intended data utility while preventing unauthorized exploitation. Our project is available at https://trusted-system-lab.github.io/model-specificity

</details>


### [898] [Optimal Regularization for Performative Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.12249)
*Edwige Cyffers,Alireza Mirrokni,Marco Mondelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在高维岭回归中，正则化如何帮助应对“表演性学习”（即数据分布随部署模型变化）带来的影响。研究发现，虽然表演性效应在总体设置下会恶化测试风险，但在过参数化（特征数超过样本数）情况下反而有益。最优正则化参数与表演性效应的整体强度成比例，可据此预先设定正则化参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在表演性学习中，数据分布会响应部署的模型（如策略用户调整特征以博弈），这种动态比传统监督学习更复杂。模型不仅需要适应当前数据，还需考虑模型可能改变数据分布的方向，但又不清楚这种变化的确切性质。因此需要探索正则化如何帮助应对表演性效应。

Method: 通过研究高维岭回归中的正则化影响，分析表演性效应在不同参数化条件下的表现，推导最优正则化参数与表演性效应强度的关系，并在合成与真实数据集上进行实证评估。

Result: 在总体设置下表演性效应会恶化测试风险，但在过参数化（特征数超过样本数）条件下反而有益。最优正则化参数与表演性效应的整体强度呈比例关系。

Conclusion: 可以通过预估表演性效应的强度来提前设定合适的正则化参数，从而在表演性学习中获得更好的性能。

Abstract: In performative learning, the data distribution reacts to the deployed model - for example, because strategic users adapt their features to game it - which creates a more complex dynamic than in classical supervised learning. One should thus not only optimize the model for the current data but also take into account that the model might steer the distribution in a new direction, without knowing the exact nature of the potential shift. We explore how regularization can help cope with performative effects by studying its impact in high-dimensional ridge regression. We show that, while performative effects worsen the test risk in the population setting, they can be beneficial in the over-parameterized regime where the number of features exceeds the number of samples. We show that the optimal regularization scales with the overall strength of the performative effect, making it possible to set the regularization in anticipation of this effect. We illustrate this finding through empirical evaluations of the optimal regularization parameter on both synthetic and real-world datasets.

</details>


### [899] [Learning-To-Measure: In-Context Active Feature Acquisition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.12624)
*Yuta Kobayashi,Zilin Jing,Jiayu Yao,Hongseok Namkoong,Shalmali Joshi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出元主动特征获取问题，并设计L2M方法，通过自回归预训练实现不确定性引导的上下文特征获取，在标签稀缺和高缺失率场景下超越任务特定基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动特征获取方法局限于单任务场景，缺乏跨任务的扩展性；同时面临回顾性数据中系统性特征缺失和标签稀缺的挑战。

Method: 形式化元AFA问题；提出L2M框架包含：(i) 基于自回归预训练的不确定性量化模块，可处理任意缺失模式；(ii) 以条件互信息最大化为目标的不确定性引导贪心特征获取智能体。L2M以上下文学习方式执行元AFA，无需逐任务重新训练。

Result: 在合成和真实表格基准上，L2M匹配或超越任务特定基线，尤其在标签稀缺和高缺失率场景下表现优异。

Conclusion: 自回归预训练能在回顾性缺失数据上实现可靠的不确定性量化，从而支持跨任务的元主动特征获取，提升可扩展性和样本效率。

Abstract: Active feature acquisition (AFA) is a sequential decision-making problem where the goal is to improve model performance for test instances by adaptively selecting which features to acquire. In practice, AFA methods often learn from retrospective data with systematic missingness in the features and limited task-specific labels. Most prior work addresses acquisition for a single predetermined task, limiting scalability. To address this limitation, we formalize the meta-AFA problem, where the goal is to learn acquisition policies across various tasks. We introduce Learning-to-Measure (L2M), which consists of i) reliable uncertainty quantification over unseen tasks, and ii) an uncertainty-guided greedy feature acquisition agent that maximizes conditional mutual information. We demonstrate a sequence-modeling or autoregressive pre-training approach that underpins reliable uncertainty quantification for tasks with arbitrary missingness. L2M operates directly on datasets with retrospective missingness and performs the meta-AFA task in-context, eliminating per-task retraining. Across synthetic and real-world tabular benchmarks, L2M matches or surpasses task-specific baselines, particularly under scarce labels and high missingness.

</details>


### [900] [UrbanFusion: Stochastic Multimodal Fusion for Contrastive Learning of Robust Spatial Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.13774)
*Dominik J. Mühlematter,Lin Che,Ye Hong,Martin Raubal,Nina Wiedemann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UrbanFusion是一个空间表示模型，通过随机多模态融合（SMF）框架整合街景图像、遥感数据、地图和POI等多模态地理空间数据，在56个城市41项任务中表现出优于现有GeoAI模型的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法主要使用任务特定模型，而通用空间表示模型仅支持有限模态且缺乏多模态融合能力，亟需一种能有效整合多种地理空间数据的统一表示模型。

Method: 提出UrbanFusion模型，采用模态特定编码器处理不同类型输入（街景图像、遥感数据、地图、POI），并通过基于Transformer的融合模块学习统一表示，支持随机多模态融合（SMF），可在预训练和推理阶段灵活使用任意可用模态子集。

Result: 在56个城市41项任务上的广泛评估表明，UrbanFusion在位置编码、多模态推理和未见过区域泛化方面均优于现有GeoAI模型。

Conclusion: UrbanFusion通过随机多模态融合机制实现了灵活、通用的空间表示学习，能够适应多样化的数据可用性场景，具有广泛的应用前景。

Abstract: Forecasting urban phenomena such as housing prices and public health indicators requires the effective integration of various geospatial data. Current methods primarily utilize task-specific models, while recent generic models for spatial representations often support only limited modalities and lack multimodal fusion capabilities. To overcome these challenges, we present UrbanFusion, a spatial representation model that features Stochastic Multimodal Fusion (SMF). The framework employs modality-specific encoders to process different types of inputs, including street view imagery, remote sensing data, cartographic maps, and points of interest (POIs) data. These multimodal inputs are integrated via a Transformer-based fusion module that learns unified representations. An extensive evaluation across 41 tasks in 56 cities worldwide demonstrates UrbanFusion's strong generalization and predictive performance compared to state-of-the-art GeoAI models. Specifically, it 1) outperforms prior models on location-encoding, 2) allows multimodal input during inference, and 3) generalizes well to regions unseen during training. UrbanFusion can flexibly utilize any subset of available modalities for a given location during both pretraining and inference, enabling broad applicability across diverse data availability scenarios.

</details>


### [901] [Symmetries in PAC-Bayesian Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.17303)
*Armin Beck,Peter Ochs*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在PAC-Bayes框架下将对称性泛化保证从紧致群和非不变数据分布扩展至非紧致对称性（如平移），实验验证了对称模型在更广泛场景下的优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对称性理论主要集中在紧致群且假设数据分布具有不变性，但这些假设在真实应用中很少成立，需要扩展至非紧致对称性和非不变分布。

Method: 基于PAC-Bayes框架，调整并收紧McAllester's PAC-Bayes界等现有界限，使其适用于非紧致群（如平移）和非不变数据分布。

Result: 在多个非均匀、非紧致变换数据集上，推导的泛化保证不仅成立，且优于先前结果。

Conclusion: 对称模型在更广泛的条件下（非紧致群和非不变分布）理论上仍优于非对称模型，为机器学习中对称性的通用理解开辟了道路。

Abstract: Symmetries are known to improve the empirical performance of machine learning models, yet theoretical guarantees explaining these gains remain limited. Prior work has focused mainly on compact group symmetries and often assumes that the data distribution itself is invariant, an assumption rarely satisfied in real-world applications. In this work, we extend generalization guarantees to the broader setting of non-compact symmetries, such as translations and to non-invariant data distributions. Building on the PAC-Bayes framework, we adapt and tighten existing bounds, demonstrating the approach on McAllester's PAC-Bayes bound while showing that it applies to a wide range of PAC-Bayes bounds. We validate our theory with experiments on several datasets with non-uniform and non-compact transformations, where the derived guarantees not only hold but also improve upon prior results. These findings provide theoretical evidence that, for symmetric data, symmetric models are preferable beyond the narrow setting of compact groups and invariant distributions, opening the way to a more general understanding of symmetries in machine learning.

</details>


### [902] [Tractable Shapley Values and Interactions via Tensor Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22138)
*Farzaneh Heidari,Chao Li,Guillaume Rabusseau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TN-SHAP方法，利用张量网络(TN)代理模型将Shapley值和Shapley交互指数计算中的O(2^n)联盟枚举替换为少量定向评估，实现指数级加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Shapley值计算需要对n个特征进行O(2^n)次联盟枚举，计算成本极高，难以应用于高维特征场景。现有近似方法仍存在精度或速度瓶颈。

Method: 将预测器的局部行为表示为因子化多线性映射（张量网络代理），使联盟量成为系数张量的线性探针。通过少量定向评估提取k阶Shapley交互，其中一阶和二阶计算复杂度为O(n·poly(χ)+n²)，χ为最大截断秩。

Result: 在UCI数据集上，TN-SHAP在匹配代理模型枚举精度的同时，将评估量减少数个数量级；与KernelSHAP-IQ相比，在可比精度下实现25-1000倍墙钟加速，且训练可在局部群体间摊销。

Conclusion: 张量网络代理可高效逼近Shapley值及其交互指数，为高维特征可解释性提供理论保证和实际加速方案。

Abstract: We show how to replace the O(2^n) coalition enumeration over n features behind Shapley values and Shapley-style interaction indices with a few-evaluation scheme on a tensor-network (TN) surrogate: TN-SHAP. The key idea is to represent a predictor's local behavior as a factorized multilinear map, so that coalitional quantities become linear probes of a coefficient tensor. TN-SHAP replaces exhaustive coalition sweeps with just a small number of targeted evaluations to extract order-k Shapley interactions. In particular, both order-1 (single-feature) and order-2 (pairwise) computations have cost O(n*poly(chi) + n^2), where chi is the TN's maximal cut rank. We provide theoretical guarantees on the approximation error and tractability of TN-SHAP. On UCI datasets, our method matches enumeration on the fitted surrogate while reducing evaluation by orders of magnitude and achieves 25-1000x wall-clock speedups over KernelSHAP-IQ at comparable accuracy, while amortizing training across local cohorts.

</details>


### [903] [Symbolic Neural Generation with Applications to Lead Discovery in Drug Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.23379)
*Ashwin Srinivasan,Tirtharaj Dash,A Baskar,Michael Bain,Sanjay Kumar Dey,Mainak Banerjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出符号神经生成器(SNGs)，一种混合神经符号模型，结合符号学习（ILP）与神经推理（LLM）生成满足形式正确性标准的数据生成器。在早期药物设计中，其性能在已知靶点上与SOTA相当，在未知靶点上生成分子的结合亲和力与领先临床候选药物持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索一类相对未被充分研究的混合神经符号模型，该模型将符号学习与神经推理相结合，以构建满足形式正确性标准的数据生成器。

Method: SNG包含一个符号学习器（从少量实例中检查可行数据的逻辑规范）和一个基于神经的生成器（接收条件信息并拒绝违反符号规范的实例）。结合受限的归纳逻辑编程(ILP)与大语言模型(LLM)实现，并基于偏序集构建语义框架。

Result: 在基准问题上（靶点已知），SNG性能与SOTA方法统计上相当；在探索性问题中（靶点未知），生成分子的结合亲和力与领先临床候选药物持平。专家认为符号规范作为初步过滤器有用，多个生成分子被识别为可合成并适合湿实验测试。

Conclusion: SNG有效结合了符号与神经方法的互补优势，既能生成满足形式规范的新数据，又能提供可解释的符号描述，在药物设计等领域具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: We investigate a relatively under-explored class of hybrid neurosymbolic models that integrate symbolic learning with neural reasoning to construct data generators meeting formal correctness criteria. In Symbolic Neural Generators (SNGs), symbolic learners examine logical specifications of feasible data from a small set of instances -- sometimes just one. Each specification in turn constrains the conditional information supplied to a neural-based generator, which rejects any instance violating the symbolic specification. Like other neurosymbolic approaches, SNG exploits the complementary strengths of symbolic and neural methods. The outcome of an SNG is a pair $(H, X)$, where $H$ is a symbolic description of feasible instances constructed from data, and $X$ a set of generated new instances that satisfy the description. We introduce a semantics for such systems, based on the construction of appropriate base and fibre partially-ordered sets combined into an overall partial order. We implement an SNG combining a restricted form of Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) with a large language model (LLM) and evaluate it on early-stage drug design. Our main interest is the description and the set of potential inhibitor molecules generated by the SNG. On benchmark problems -- where drug targets are well understood -- SNG performance is statistically comparable to state-of-the-art methods. On exploratory problems with poorly understood targets, generated molecules exhibit binding affinities on par with leading clinical candidates. Experts further find the symbolic specifications useful as preliminary filters, with several generated molecules identified as viable for synthesis and wet-lab testing.

</details>


### [904] [The Geometry of Grokking: Norm Minimization on the Zero-Loss Manifold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.01938)
*Tiberiu Musat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从约束优化的视角解释了神经网络中的"领悟"（grokking）现象：梯度下降在零损失流形上有效最小化权重范数，从而驱动延迟泛化。作者在极小学习率和权重衰减系数极限下给出了形式化证明，并提出一种近似方法解耦参数学习动态，导出了两层网络第一层在记忆后阶段的闭式动力学表达式。实验验证了该框架能复现延迟泛化和表征学习特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将延迟泛化归因于权重衰减驱动的表征学习，但精确的底层动态仍不清楚。本文旨在从约束优化的角度提供严格的数学解释。

Method: 1) 在极小学习率和权重衰减系数极限下，形式化证明梯度下降在零损失流形上最小化权重范数；2) 提出一种近似方法，将部分参数的学习动态与网络其余部分解耦；3) 将该框架应用于两层网络，推导第一层在记忆后阶段的闭式动力学表达式。

Result: 实验表明，使用预测梯度模拟训练过程能够复现领悟现象中的延迟泛化和表征学习特征。

Conclusion: 约束优化视角能够有效解释领悟现象背后的机制，为理解神经网络中的延迟泛化提供了理论基础。

Abstract: Grokking is a puzzling phenomenon in neural networks where full generalization occurs only after a substantial delay following the complete memorization of the training data. Previous research has linked this delayed generalization to representation learning driven by weight decay, but the precise underlying dynamics remain elusive. In this paper, we argue that post-memorization learning can be understood through the lens of constrained optimization: gradient descent effectively minimizes the weight norm on the zero-loss manifold. We formally prove this in the limit of infinitesimally small learning rates and weight decay coefficients. To further dissect this regime, we introduce an approximation that decouples the learning dynamics of a subset of parameters from the rest of the network. Applying this framework, we derive a closed-form expression for the post-memorization dynamics of the first layer in a two-layer network. Experiments confirm that simulating the training process using our predicted gradients reproduces both the delayed generalization and representation learning characteristic of grokking.

</details>


### [905] [DuetServe: Harmonizing Prefill and Decode for LLM Serving via Adaptive GPU Multiplexing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.04791)
*Lei Gao,Chaoyi Jiang,Hossein Entezari Zarch,Daniel Wong,Mark Hill,Murali Annavaram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DuetServe是一个统一的LLM服务框架，通过动态SM级GPU空间复用实现单GPU内的预填充和解码阶段隔离，在不浪费资源的前提下，相比现有方案吞吐量提升最高1.3倍，同时保持低生成延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM服务系统面临两难：共享GPU上混合执行预填充和解码阶段会导致干扰（TBT退化），而将两阶段分离到不同GPU虽能改善延迟但浪费资源（模型副本和KV缓存传输）。亟需一种既能提供隔离性又不浪费资源的统一方案。

Method: DuetServe默认以聚合模式运行，当预测到TBT退化时动态激活SM级GPU空间复用。核心方法包括：(1)注意力感知的roofline模型用于预测迭代延迟；(2)分区优化器在TBT约束下选择最优SM分配以最大化吞吐；(3)无中断执行引擎消除CPU-GPU同步开销。

Result: 相比最先进的框架，DuetServe在保持低生成延迟的同时，总吞吐量提升最高达1.3倍。

Conclusion: 通过细粒度自适应的SM分区，在需要时才解耦预填充和解码执行，既实现了类似分离部署的隔离效果，又避免了资源浪费，为LLM服务提供了一种高效统一的解决方案。

Abstract: Modern LLM serving systems must sustain high throughput while meeting strict latency SLOs across two distinct inference phases: compute-intensive prefill and memory-bound decode phases. Existing approaches either (1) aggregate both phases on shared GPUs, leading to interference between prefill and decode phases, which degrades Time-Between-Tokens (TBT); or (2) disaggregate the two phases across GPUs, improving latency but wasting resources through duplicated models and KV cache transfers. We present DuetServe, a unified LLM serving framework that achieves disaggregation-level isolation within a single GPU. DuetServe operates in aggregated mode by default and dynamically activates SM-level GPU spatial multiplexing when TBT degradation is predicted. Its key idea is to decouple prefill and decode execution only when needed through fine-grained, adaptive SM partitioning that provides phase isolation only when contention threatens latency service level objectives. DuetServe integrates (1) an attention-aware roofline model to forecast iteration latency, (2) a partitioning optimizer that selects the optimal SM split to maximize throughput under TBT constraints, and (3) an interruption-free execution engine that eliminates CPU-GPU synchronization overhead. Evaluations show that DuetServe improves total throughput by up to 1.3x while maintaining low generation latency compared to state-of-the-art frameworks.

</details>


### [906] [Scaling depth capacity via zero/one-layer model expansion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.04981)
*Zhiqi Bu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了大规模模型的深度扩展，提出了零/单层渐进训练策略，在GPT2上实现约5倍加速且损失与全训练模型相当，在LLAMA3和DeepSeekV3上展现出3~5倍的计算效率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型深度在深度学习中是一把双刃剑：更深的模型精度更高但计算成本也更高。为了高效训练大规模模型，需要研究如何通过渐进训练（模型扩展）在减少计算开销的同时保持性能。

Method: 从优化理论和特征学习的角度研究大规模模型的深度扩展，提出零/单层渐进训练策略，包括新层的初始化、超参数迁移、学习率调度和模型扩展时机的设计，并进行了全面的消融实验。

Result: 在GPT2上节省约80%计算量（约5倍加速），损失与全训练的60层7B参数模型相当；在LLAMA3和DeepSeekV3上展现3~5倍计算效率提升，且优势随规模增大而增加。

Conclusion: 零/单层渐进训练策略能够在计算和损失之间实现最优权衡，在大规模模型训练中显著提升计算效率，并且规模越大优势越明显。

Abstract: Model depth is a double-edged sword in deep learning: deeper models achieve higher accuracy but require higher computational cost. To efficiently train models at scale, progressive training (also known as model expansion) scales up model capacity during training and significantly reduces computation with little performance degradation. In this work, we study the depth expansion of large-scale models through the lens of optimization theory and feature learning, offering insights on the initialization of new layers, hyperparameter transfer, learning rate schedule, and timing of model expansion. Specifically, we propose zero/one-layer progressive training to achieve an optimal tradeoff between computation and loss, with a comprehensive ablations on our expansion strategy. For example, zero/one-layer progressive training on GPT2 can save $\approx 80\%$ compute, or equivalently achieve an $\approx 5\times$ acceleration, while attaining a loss comparable to that of a fully trained 60-layer model with 7B parameters, thus demonstrating a mixing behavior in terms of loss. Furthermore, scaling laws on LLAMA3 and DeepSeekV3 models show a $3\sim 5\times$ improvement in compute efficiency, with an increasing advantage at larger scales.

</details>


### [907] [Iterated Population Based Training with Task-Agnostic Restarts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.09190)
*Alexander Chebykin,Tanja Alderliesten,Peter A. N. Bosman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出迭代式群体基础训练（IPBT），一种能自动调整超参数更新间隔的新型PBT变体，通过任务无关的重用权重信息和时变贝叶斯优化重新初始化超参数，在8个图像分类和强化学习任务上平均优于或媲美5种PBT变体及其他HPO算法，且无需增加预算或调整自身超参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PBT族HPO算法中超参数更新的步数间隔是一个重要的元超参数，会显著影响算法性能，但尚无方法或直觉来高效设置其值。

Method: 提出IPBT算法，通过重启动机制以任务无关方式重用权重信息，并利用时变贝叶斯优化重新初始化超参数，从而自动调整超参数更新间隔。

Result: 在8个图像分类和强化学习任务上，IPBT平均匹配或优于5种PBT变体及其他HPO算法（随机搜索、ASHA、SMAC3），且无需增加预算或调整自身超参数。

Conclusion: IPBT通过自动调整超参数更新间隔，有效提升了PBT族算法的效率与性能，消除了手动设置该重要元超参数的需求。

Abstract: Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO) can lift the burden of tuning hyperparameters (HPs) of neural networks. HPO algorithms from the Population Based Training (PBT) family are efficient thanks to dynamically adjusting HPs every few steps of the weight optimization. Recent results indicate that the number of steps between HP updates is an important meta-HP of all PBT variants that can substantially affect their performance. Yet, no method or intuition is available for efficiently setting its value. We introduce Iterated Population Based Training (IPBT), a novel PBT variant that automatically adjusts this HP via restarts that reuse weight information in a task-agnostic way and leverage time-varying Bayesian optimization to reinitialize HPs. Evaluation on 8 image classification and reinforcement learning tasks shows that, on average, our algorithm matches or outperforms 5 previous PBT variants and other HPO algorithms (random search, ASHA, SMAC3), without requiring a budget increase or any changes to its HPs. The source code is available at https://github.com/AwesomeLemon/IPBT.

</details>


### [908] [FIRM: Federated In-client Regularized Multi-objective Alignment for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.16992)
*Fatemeh Nourzad,Amirhossein Roknilamouki,Eylem Ekici,Jia Liu,Ness Shroff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FIRM是一种联邦多目标对齐算法，通过客户端本地正则化解决客户端分歧漂移，无需传输多个梯度，仅需传输单组参数，实现通信高效性，并收敛到帕累托稳定点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦多目标优化方法存在严重通信瓶颈，因为需要传输多个梯度到服务器，对于大模型不可扩展；同时需解决客户端分歧漂移问题。

Method: 每个客户端本地求解正则化多目标优化问题，通过客户端内正则化直接缓解分歧漂移，消除多梯度传输需求，仅传输单组适配参数。

Result: FIRM收敛到帕累托稳定点，提供了首次有限时间收敛保证；实验显示训练动态更平滑、客户端分歧漂移减少、奖励权衡优于基线，且能根据偏好平滑适应目标间权衡。

Conclusion: FIRM通过客户端内正则化同时解决了通信效率和客户端分歧漂移问题，实现了高效、隐私保护的联邦多目标对齐。

Abstract: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human values often involves balancing multiple, conflicting objectives such as helpfulness and harmlessness. Training these models is computationally intensive, and centralizing the process raises significant data privacy concerns. Federated Learning (FL) offers a compelling alternative, but existing Federated Multi-Objective Optimization (FMOO) methods face severe communication bottlenecks as their reliance on transmitting multiple gradients to a server is unscalable for large models. We introduce FIRM (Federated In-client Regularized Multi-objective alignment), a novel algorithm that achieves both client disagreement drift mitigation and communication efficiency. In FIRM, each client locally solves a regularized multi-objective optimization problem. By directly mitigating client disagreement drift through in-client regularization, our method eliminates the need for the multi-gradient transmissions common in prior works. Consequently, clients need only to transmit a single set of adapted parameters, maintaining high communication efficiency. We prove that our algorithm converges to Pareto-stationary points and, to our knowledge, provide the first finite-time convergence guarantees for this federated multi-objective alignment setting. Empirically, we show that FIRM leads to smoother training dynamics, reduced client disagreement drift, and improved reward trade-offs compared to baselines. We further propose a method to incorporate a preference over the objectives and report empirical Pareto plots, demonstrating that FIRM can smoothly adapt trade-offs between objectives in response to specified preferences.

</details>


### [909] [How to Correctly Report LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.21140)
*Chungpa Lee,Thomas Zeng,Jongwon Jeong,Jy-yong Sohn,Kangwook Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于LLM评分的偏差校正框架，能构建置信区间并自适应分配校准样本，在统计上比纯人工评估更可靠，且对分布偏移具有鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为评估器存在敏感性和特异性的缺陷，导致评估分数存在偏差；现有方法缺乏统计原则的不确定性量化能力。

Method: 提出一个即插即用框架，利用人工标注的校准数据集构建置信区间，校正LLM评估偏差；采用自适应策略分配校准样本以缩小区间；理论上刻画了LLM评估优于纯人工评估的参数条件。

Result: 在测试数据和校准数据存在分布偏移的情况下，该框架仍保持无偏性；通过参数分析确定了LLM评估比纯人工评估更可靠的参数区间。

Conclusion: 该框架为LLM作为评估器提供了统计上严谨的偏差校正和不确定性量化方法，显著优于现有方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are widely used as scalable evaluators of model responses in lieu of human annotators. However, imperfect sensitivity and specificity of the LLM judges induce bias in naive evaluation scores. We propose a simple plug-in framework that corrects this bias and enables statistically principled uncertainty quantification. Our framework constructs confidence intervals that account for uncertainty from both the test dataset and a human-labeled calibration dataset.
