Additionally, it uses an adaptive strategy to allocate calibration samples for tighter intervals. Importantly, we characterize parameter regimes defined by the true evaluation score and the LLM judge's sensitivity and specificity in which our LLM-based evaluation yields more reliable estimates than human-only evaluation. Moreover, we show that our framework remains unbiased under distribution shift between the test and calibration datasets, in contrast to existing approaches.

</details>


### [910] [WUSH: Near-Optimal Adaptive Transforms for LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.00956)
*Jiale Chen,Vage Egiazarian,Roberto L. Castro,Torsten Hoefler,Dan Alistarh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出WUSH变换，结合Hadamard骨干与数据依赖的二阶矩分量，实现了对权重-激活联合量化的近最优线性块变换，在W4A4量化下相比Hadamard基线显著提升精度（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上MXFP4格式平均提升+2.8点），并通过FP4矩阵乘实现最高5.8倍吞吐加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于Hadamard旋转等变换的量化缓解方法是固定的且与数据无关，其对于量化的最优性尚不明确，需要一种数据自适应的最优变换来减少极端离群值对低比特量化的精度损失。

Method: 推导了标准RTN AbsMax缩放块量化器下联合权重-激活量化的闭式最优线性块变换（WUSH），该变换由Hadamard骨干与数据依赖的二阶矩分量组合而成，是一种非正交变换，在温和假设下对FP和INT量化器均具有近最优性，并支持高效的融合GPU实现。

Result: 在W4A4量化下，WUSH在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的MXFP4格式上平均提升+2.8点（RTN）和+0.7点（GPTQ），FP4矩阵乘相比BF16实现最高5.8倍单层吞吐加速。

Conclusion: WUSH作为数据自适应的非正交变换，在理论和实践上均优于固定Hadamard基线，为低比特联合量化提供了一种高效且近最优的变换方案。

Abstract: Quantizing LLM weights and activations is a standard approach for efficient deployment, but a few extreme outliers can stretch the dynamic range and amplify low-bit quantization errors. Prior transform-based mitigations (e.g., Hadamard rotations) are fixed and data-agnostic, and their optimality for quantization has remained unclear. We derive closed-form optimal linear blockwise transforms for joint weight-activation quantization under standard RTN AbsMax-scaled block quantizers, covering both integer and floating-point formats. The resulting construction, WUSH, combines a Hadamard backbone with a data-dependent second-moment component to form a non-orthogonal transform that is provably near-optimal for FP and INT quantizers under mild assumptions while admitting an efficient fused GPU implementation. Empirically, WUSH improves W4A4 accuracy over the strongest Hadamard-based baselines (e.g., on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct in MXFP4, it gains +2.8 average points with RTN and +0.7 with GPTQ) while delivering up to 5.8$\times$ per-layer throughput over BF16 via FP4 MatMul. Source code is available at https://github.com/IST-DASLab/WUSH.

</details>


### [911] [Position: Current Benchmarking Hinders Real Progress in Deep Learning for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.22702)
*Valentina Moretti,Ivan Marisca,Cesare Alippi,Andrea Cini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出当前时间序列深度学习模型的基准测试实践未能识别导致性能差异的关键因素，并证明被视为"实现细节"的设计选择（如全局性与局部性）对模型性能的影响可能超过特定的序列建模层本身，因此需要重新思考基准测试方法，并提出辅助预测模型卡作为规范化设计选择的工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大量新提出的时间序列深度学习架构以及经常相互矛盾的实验结果，使得评估哪种设计选择和模型组件真正驱动性能变得困难。当前的基准测试实践未能识别导致性能差异的因素，这阻碍了领域的进展。

Method: 通过实证分析展示被视为"实现细节"的设计维度（如全局性与局部性）对性能的影响超过特定的序列建模层；讨论这些被忽视的方面如何从根本上改变预测方法的类别并显著影响实验结果；提出辅助预测模型卡作为规范化描述架构设计选择的模板。

Result: 发现关键设计维度（如全局性与局部性）的差异对预测性能的影响大于特定序列建模层的选择；这些被忽视的设计选择不仅从根本上改变预测方法的类别，还会显著影响实验结果。

Conclusion: 需要重新思考当前的基准测试实践，在设计比较架构时应聚焦于预测问题的基本方面；提出辅助预测模型卡作为促进这一转变的具体步骤。

Abstract: Deep learning models have grown popular in time series applications. However, the large quantity of newly proposed architectures and the often contradictory empirical results make it difficult to assess which design choice and model component drives performance. In this position paper, we argue that current benchmarking practices fail to identify the factors responsible for performance differences, thus slowing down progress in the field. In particular, differences in crucial design dimensions are overlooked when comparing architectures, ultimately leading to inconsistent outcomes. To support our position, we show that such differences-often treated as mere implementation details-can have a greater impact than adopting specific sequence modeling layers. We discuss how overlooked aspects (such as globality and locality) can (1) fundamentally change the class of the forecasting method and (2) drastically affect empirical results. Our findings suggest rethinking our benchmarking practices and focusing on the foundational aspects of the forecasting problem when designing and comparing architectures. As a concrete step, we propose an auxiliary forecasting model card, i.e., a template with a set of fields to characterize existing and new forecasting architectures based on key design choices.

</details>


### [912] [Early Prediction of Liver Cirrhosis Up to Two Years in Advance: A Machine Learning Study Benchmarking Against the FIB-4 and APRI Scores](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.00175)
*Zhuqi Miao,Ahmed G Qasem,Sujan Ravi,Jason T. Cheng,Abdulaziz Ahmed,Courtney W. Houchen,Sumayah Abed,Dilorom Azimdjanovna Zuparova,Abdulaziz Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究利用电子健康记录数据开发XGBoost机器学习模型，在诊断前1年和2年预测肝硬化发生风险，其性能显著优于传统的FIB-4和APRI临床评分（1年AUC: 0.872 vs 0.756/0.798；PR AUC: 0.657 vs 0.456/0.504）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肝硬化的早期发现对改善患者预后至关重要，但传统临床评分（FIB-4、APRI）在早期风险识别上存在局限性。作者旨在探索机器学习方法能否利用常规电子健康记录数据实现更早、更准确的肝硬化预测。

Method: 采用回顾性队列研究设计，从大型学术医疗系统的去标识化EHR数据中提取样本；使用XGBoost算法构建1年和2年预测模型；进行模型特异性特征选择和贝叶斯超参数调优；在留出测试集上与FIB-4和APRI进行性能比较，评估指标包括准确率、精确率、召回率、F1、PR AUC和AUC。

Result: 1年预测队列60,481例，2年预测队列47,322例。XGBoost模型1年和2年预测AUC分别为0.872和0.839，优于FIB-4（0.756/0.723）和APRI（0.798/0.761）；PR AUC分别为0.657和0.562，显著高于FIB-4（0.456/0.373）和APRI（0.504/0.421）。性能优势在更长预测窗口仍然保持。

Conclusion: 基于常规EHR数据的机器学习模型在肝硬化早期预测上显著优于传统FIB-4和APRI评分，能够实现更早、更准确的风险分层，可作为临床工作流中的自动化决策支持工具，助力肝硬化的主动预防和管理。

Abstract: Objective: Develop and evaluate machine learning (ML) models for predicting incident liver cirrhosis (LC) one and two years prior to diagnosis using routinely collected electronic health record (EHR) data and benchmark their performance against the FIB-4 and APRI clinical scores. Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using de-identified EHR data from a large academic health system. XGBoost models were developed for 1- and 2-year prediction horizons, with model-specific feature selection and Bayesian hyperparameter tuning applied to improve predictive performance. The model was then evaluated on held-out test sets, and its performance was compared with FIB-4 and APRI using accuracy, precision, recall, F1, area under the precision-recall curve (PR AUC), and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). Results: Final modeling cohorts included 60,481 patients for the 1-year prediction and 47,322 for the 2-year prediction. Across both prediction windows, the tuned ML models consistently outperformed FIB-4 and APRI. The XGBoost models achieved AUCs of 0.872 and 0.839 for the 1- and 2-year predictions, respectively, compared with 0.756 and 0.723 for FIB-4 and 0.798 and 0.761 for APRI. Improvements were larger on the precision-recall metric, with PR AUCs of 0.657 and 0.562 for XGBoost compared with 0.456 and 0.373 for FIB-4 and 0.504 and 0.421 for APRI. Performance gains persisted with longer prediction horizons, indicating maintained early risk discrimination. Conclusions: Machine learning models leveraging routine EHR data substantially outperform the traditional FIB-4 and APRI scores for early prediction of liver cirrhosis. These models enable earlier and more accurate risk stratification and can be integrated into clinical workflows as automated decision-support tools to support proactive cirrhosis prevention and management.

</details>


### [913] [Avatar Forcing: Real-Time Interactive Head Avatar Generation for Natural Conversation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.00664)
*Taekyung Ki,Sangwon Jang,Jaehyeong Jo,Jaehong Yoon,Sung Ju Hwang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Avatar Forcing框架，通过扩散强制（diffusion forcing）实现实时交互式头像生成，支持低延迟（约500ms）的多模态输入处理，并利用直接偏好优化方法无需标注数据即可学习富有表现力的交互反应，相比基线方法速度提升6.8倍，用户偏好超过80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有说话头像生成模型仅能生成单向反应，缺乏情感互动，无法实现真正交互式通信的体验。核心挑战在于：1) 在因果约束下实时生成运动；2) 无需额外标注数据学习富有表现力的动态反应。

Method: 1) 提出Avatar Forcing框架，采用扩散强制（diffusion forcing）建模实时用户-头像交互；2) 支持实时多模态输入（用户音频和运动），低延迟响应言语和非言语线索（语音、点头、大笑等）；3) 引入直接偏好优化（DPO）方法，通过丢弃用户条件构建合成负样本，实现无标签学习表现力交互。

Result: 实时交互延迟约500ms，相比基线实现6.8倍加速，生成的头像运动具有反应性和表现力，用户偏好率超过80%。

Conclusion: Avatar Forcing框架有效解决了实时交互式头像生成的关键挑战，在低延迟、高反应性和表现力方面均显著超越现有方法，为真正交互式虚拟通信提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Talking head generation creates lifelike avatars from static portraits for virtual communication and content creation. However, current models do not yet convey the feeling of truly interactive communication, often generating one-way responses that lack emotional engagement. We identify two key challenges toward truly interactive avatars: generating motion in real-time under causal constraints and learning expressive, vibrant reactions without additional labeled data. To address these challenges, we propose Avatar Forcing, a new framework for interactive head avatar generation that models real-time user-avatar interactions through diffusion forcing. This design allows the avatar to process real-time multimodal inputs, including the user's audio and motion, with low latency for instant reactions to both verbal and non-verbal cues such as speech, nods, and laughter. Furthermore, we introduce a direct preference optimization method that leverages synthetic losing samples constructed by dropping user conditions, enabling label-free learning of expressive interaction. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework enables real-time interaction with low latency (approximately 500ms), achieving 6.8X speedup compared to the baseline, and produces reactive and expressive avatar motion, which is preferred over 80% against the baseline.

</details>


### [914] [Multigrade Neural Network Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.16884)
*Shijun Zhang,Zuowei Shen,Yuesheng Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种称为多级深度学习（MGDL）的原则性框架，通过逐级冻结先前学习的层级并训练新层级拟合残差，实现对深度神经网络的结构化误差精炼。作者建立了算子理论基础，并证明对于超立方体上的任意连续目标函数，存在一种固定宽度的多级ReLU方案，其残差在每级严格衰减并均匀收敛到零。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络训练面临高度非凸和病态优化的挑战，而浅层网络（如单隐层ReLU模型）在适当条件下可得到凸重构和全局保证。这促使研究者探索一种既能扩展深度又能保持稳定性的学习范式。

Method: MGDL以逐级方式训练深度网络：冻结已学习的层级，将新添加的级间子网络堆叠在已学层级之上，训练其拟合当前近似留下的残差，形成结构化和可解释的层级精炼过程。作者建立了该方法的算子理论基础。

Result: 对于定义在超立方体上的任意连续目标函数，存在固定宽度的多级ReLU方案，其残差点态非增且均匀收敛到零，并且在每个非平凡级别上实现严格的L^p范数衰减（p∈[1,∞)）。

Conclusion: 该工作首次提供了严格的构造性逼近保证，证明逐级残差精炼方案能在固定宽度的多级ReLU架构中实现误差消失。

Abstract: We study multigrade deep learning (MGDL) as a principled framework for structured error refinement in deep neural networks. While the approximation power of neural networks is now relatively well understood, training very deep architectures remains challenging due to highly nonconvex and often ill-conditioned optimization landscapes. In contrast, for relatively shallow networks, most notably certain one-hidden-layer ReLU models, training admits convex reformulations with global guarantees under appropriate settings, motivating learning paradigms that improve stability while scaling to depth. MGDL builds on this insight by training deep networks grade by grade: previously learned grades are frozen, and each newly added grade-wise subnetwork is composed on top of the previously learned grades and trained to fit the residual left by the current approximation, yielding a structured and interpretable hierarchical refinement process. We develop an operator-theoretic foundation for MGDL and prove that, for any continuous target function defined on a hypercube, there exists a fixed-width multigrade ReLU scheme whose residuals are pointwise nonincreasing in magnitude and converge uniformly to zero, with strict $L^p$-norm decay at every nontrivial grade for $p\in [1,\infty)$. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first rigorous constructive approximation guarantee showing that a grade-wise residual refinement scheme can achieve vanishing error in a fixed-width multigrade ReLU architecture.

</details>


### [915] [Physics-Encoded Inverse Modeling for Arctic Snow Depth Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.17074)
*Akila Sampath,Vandana Janeja,Jianwu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PhysE-Inv框架，结合LSTM编码器-解码器与对比学习正则化，利用物理信息约束解决稀疏观测下时变反问题（如雪深估计），在各项基线中实现MSE平均降低24.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时变反问题在稀疏观测条件下准确估计参数（如雪深）极具挑战，现有方法难以有效融合物理信息与时间序列学习的优势。

Method: 构建LSTM编码器-解码器捕获时间依赖；引入对比学习正则化保证潜表示对噪声不变；联合观测输入与物理信息约束进行潜参数学习，重建目标变量（如雪深）。

Result: PhysE-Inv在所有评估基线上表现最优，平均MSE降低24.7%，相比最强基线提升17.3%。

Conclusion: PhysE-Inv为数据稀缺领域提供了一种可泛化的反演建模范式，能够有效将物理信息融入稀疏观测场景。

Abstract: Accurate estimation in time-varying inverse problems under limited and sparse observations remains a fundamental challenge across scientific domains. For example, snow depth estimation requires inferring hidden parameters governing sea ice physics, which can be incorporated through physics-informed encoding. To address this challenge, we introduce Physics-Encoded Inversion (PhysE-Inv), a novel framework that combines deep sequential learning with physics-informed inference for solving inverse problems under real-world sparse observational settings. PhysE-Inv integrates an LSTM encoder-decoder to capture temporal dependencies, together with contrastive learning regularization that enforces noise-invariant latent representations. The framework learns latent parameters that, when combined with observational inputs, reconstruct snow depth while incorporating physics-informed guidance. PhysE-Inv consistently outperforms all evaluated baselines, achieving an average MSE reduction of 24.7\% across all baseline models and a 17.3\% improvement over the strongest baseline under parameter estimation settings. Overall, our work demonstrates a generalizable inverse modeling paradigm for data-scarce domains where physics-informed guidance can be incorporated into sparse observations.

</details>


### [916] [Robust Learning of a Group DRO Neuron](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18115)
*Guyang Cao,Shuyao Li,Sushrut Karmalkar,Jelena Diakonikolas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在任意标签噪声和组级别分布偏移下，通过平方损失学习单个神经元的问题，提出了一种计算高效的原偶算法，能够输出与最优解在 worst-case 组权重下常数因子竞争的估计量，并在 LLM 预训练基准上展示了潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在存在任意标签噪声和组级别分布偏移的情况下，学习一个表现良好的神经元参数，以应对最具挑战性的组重加权场景。

Method: 提出了一个群组分布鲁棒优化（Group DRO）框架，采用 f-散度惩罚偏离均匀组权重的行为，并设计了一个计算高效的原偶算法来逼近最优解。

Result: 算法输出的估计量在 worst-case 组权重下与最优解达到常数因子竞争比；算法框架在 LLM 预训练基准上表现良好。

Conclusion: 该方法能够直接应对损失函数固有的非凸性，在标签损坏和组特定分布偏移下提供鲁棒学习保证。

Abstract: We study the problem of learning a single neuron under standard squared loss in the presence of arbitrary label noise and group-level distributional shifts, for a broad family of covariate distributions. Our goal is to identify a ''best-fit'' neuron parameterized by $\mathbf{w}_*$ that performs well under the most challenging reweighting of the groups. Specifically, we address a Group Distributionally Robust Optimization problem: given sample access to $K$ distinct distributions $\mathcal p_{[1]},\dots,\mathcal p_{[K]}$, we seek to approximate $\mathbf{w}_*$ that minimizes the worst-case objective over convex combinations of group distributions $\boldsymbolλ \in Δ_K$, where the objective is $\sum_{i \in [K]}λ_{[i]}\,\mathbb E_{(\mathbf x,y)\sim\mathcal p_{[i]}}(σ(\mathbf w\cdot\mathbf x)-y)^2 - νd_f(\boldsymbolλ,\frac{1}{K}\mathbf1)$ and $d_f$ is an $f$-divergence that imposes (optional) penalty on deviations from uniform group weights, scaled by a parameter $ν\geq 0$. We develop a computationally efficient primal-dual algorithm that outputs a vector $\widehat{\mathbf w}$ that is constant-factor competitive with $\mathbf{w}_*$ under the worst-case group weighting. Our analytical framework directly confronts the inherent nonconvexity of the loss function, providing robust learning guarantees in the face of arbitrary label corruptions and group-specific distributional shifts. The implementation of the dual extrapolation update motivated by our algorithmic framework shows promise on LLM pre-training benchmarks.

</details>


### [917] [Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Tactical Decision Making for Trucks in Highway Traffic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.18783)
*Deepthi Pathare,Leo Laine,Morteza Haghir Chehreghani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于PPO的多目标强化学习框架，用于重型卡车在高速公路驾驶中平衡安全、效率和运营成本，学习一组帕累托最优策略以清晰表征不同目标间的权衡关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统标量奖励函数无法有效揭示安全、效率与成本之间的结构性权衡关系，导致重型卡车在高速公路决策中难以平衡这些相互冲突的目标。

Method: 基于Proximal Policy Optimization（PPO）的多目标强化学习框架，在可扩展的仿真平台上学习一组帕累托最优策略，显式表征安全（碰撞与完成率）、能量效率和时间效率三个冲突目标间的权衡。

Result: 学习得到平滑且可解释的帕累托前沿，能够在不重新训练的情况下实现不同驾驶策略间的无缝切换，形成鲁棒且自适应的决策策略。

Conclusion: 该框架能够有效处理多目标权衡问题，在保证安全性的同时优化效率与成本，为自动驾驶卡车应用提供灵活、鲁棒的战术决策方案。

Abstract: Balancing safety, efficiency, and operational costs in highway driving poses a challenging decision-making problem for heavy-duty vehicles. A central difficulty is that conventional scalar reward formulations, obtained by aggregating these competing objectives, often obscure the structure of their trade-offs. We present a Proximal Policy Optimization based multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that learns a set of policies explicitly representing these trade-offs and evaluates it on a scalable simulation platform for tactical decision making in trucks. The proposed approach learns a set of Pareto-optimal policies that capture the trade-offs among three conflicting objectives: safety, quantified in terms of collisions and successful completion; energy efficiency and time efficiency, quantified using energy cost and driver cost, respectively. The resulting Pareto frontier is smooth and interpretable, enabling flexibility in choosing driving behavior along different conflicting objectives. This framework allows seamless transitions between different driving policies without retraining, yielding a robust and adaptive decision-making strategy for autonomous trucking applications.

</details>


### [918] [When Does Predictive Inverse Dynamics Outperform Behavior Cloning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21718)
*Lukas Schäfer,Pallavi Choudhury,Abdelhak Lemkhenter,Chris Lovett,Somjit Nath,Luis França,Matheus Ribeiro Furtado de Mendonça,Alex Lamb,Riashat Islam,Siddhartha Sen,John Langford,Katja Hofmann,Sergio Valcarcel Macua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出预测逆动力学模型（PIDM）相比行为克隆（BC）的优势在于其引入了偏差-方差权衡：未来状态预测虽引入偏差，但能显著降低方差，从而在少样本场景下实现更低预测误差和更高样本效率。二维导航任务中BC需5倍（平均3倍）于PIDM的演示数据，三维复杂环境中BC需多66%以上样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为克隆（BC）在专家演示数据有限时性能不佳；尽管预测逆动力学模型（PIDM）在实践中优于BC，但其成功原因缺乏理论解释。

Method: 从理论上建立PIDM的偏差-方差权衡分析框架，推导状态预测器偏差的条件，使得PIDM相比BC具有更低的预测误差和更高的样本效率；并在2D导航任务和3D视频游戏环境中进行实验验证。

Result: 2D导航任务中，BC需要多达5倍（平均3倍）于PIDM的演示数据才能达到相当性能；3D复杂环境中，BC需要比PIDM多66%以上的样本。

Conclusion: PIDM通过偏差-方差权衡在少样本离线模仿学习中优于BC，且当额外数据源可用时优势进一步扩大。

Abstract: Behavior cloning (BC) is a practical offline imitation learning method, but it often fails when expert demonstrations are limited. Recent works have introduced a class of architectures named predictive inverse dynamics models (PIDM) that combine a future state predictor with an inverse dynamics model. While PIDM often outperforms BC, the reasons behind its benefits remain unclear. In this paper, we provide a theoretical explanation: PIDM introduces a bias-variance tradeoff. While predicting the future state introduces bias, conditioning the IDM on the prediction can significantly reduce variance. We establish conditions on the state predictor bias for PIDM to achieve lower prediction error and higher sample efficiency than BC, with the gap widening when additional data sources are available. We validate the theoretical insights empirically in 2D navigation tasks, where BC requires up to five times (three times on average) more demonstrations than PIDM to reach comparable performance; and in a complex 3D environment in a modern video game with high-dimensional visual inputs and stochastic transitions, where BC requires over 66% more samples than PIDM.

</details>


### [919] [SurrogateSHAP: Training-Free Contributor Attribution for Text-to-Image (T2I) Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22276)
*Mingyu Lu,Soham Gadgil,Chris Lin,Chanwoo Kim,Su-In Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SurrogateSHAP是一个无需重训练的框架，通过预训练模型推理和梯度提升树近似效用函数来高效计算Shapley值，用于评估T2I扩散模型中数据贡献者的价值，在图像质量、美学评估和产品多样性等任务上显著优于现有方法，并可用于检测临床图像中的虚假相关性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: T2I扩散模型在现实创意工作流中广泛应用，需要为提供数据集的贡献者建立公平的补偿机制和可持续的数据市场。Shapley值虽理论上合理，但面临双重计算瓶颈：穷举子集重训练的高昂成本以及估算边际贡献所需的组合爆炸式子集数量。

Method: 提出SurrogateSHAP框架：1) 通过预训练模型推理替代昂贵的重训练过程，实现无需重训练的近似；2) 使用梯度提升树（Gradient-Boosted Tree）近似效用函数，并基于树模型解析推导Shapley值。该方法同时解决了重训练成本和子集组合爆炸两个计算瓶颈。

Result: 在三个不同归因任务（CIFAR-20上的DDPM-CFG图像质量、后印象派艺术作品上的Stable Diffusion美学评估、Fashion-Product数据上的FLUX.1产品多样性）中，SurrogateSHAP均优于先前方法，同时大幅降低计算开销。此外，在临床图像中有效定位了导致虚假相关性的数据源。

Conclusion: SurrogateSHAP提供了一条可扩展的路径，用于高效评估数据贡献者价值并审计安全关键的生成模型，为公平数据市场和模型可审计性奠定了方法基础。

Abstract: As Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models are increasingly used in real-world creative workflows, a principled framework for valuing contributors who provide a collection of data is essential for fair compensation and sustainable data marketplaces. While the Shapley value offers a theoretically grounded approach to attribution, it faces a dual computational bottleneck: (i) the prohibitive cost of exhaustive model retraining for each sampled subset of players (i.e., data contributors) and (ii) the combinatorial number of subsets needed to estimate marginal contributions due to contributor interactions. To this end, we propose SurrogateSHAP, a retraining-free framework that approximates the expensive retraining game through inference from a pretrained model. To further improve efficiency, we employ a gradient-boosted tree to approximate the utility function and derive Shapley values analytically from the tree-based model. We evaluate SurrogateSHAP across three diverse attribution tasks: (i) image quality for DDPM-CFG on CIFAR-20, (ii) aesthetics for Stable Diffusion on Post-Impressionist artworks, and (iii) product diversity for FLUX.1 on Fashion-Product data. Across settings, SurrogateSHAP outperforms prior methods while substantially reducing computational overhead, consistently identifying influential contributors across multiple utility metrics. Finally, we demonstrate that SurrogateSHAP effectively localizes data sources responsible for spurious correlations in clinical images, providing a scalable path toward auditing safety-critical generative models.

</details>


### [920] [Knowledge-Informed Kernel State Reconstruction from Heterogeneous Partial Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22328)
*Luca Muscarnera,Silas Ruhrberg Estévez,Samuel Holt,Evgeny Saveliev,Mihaela van der Schaar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MAAT是一个知识信息化的核状态重建框架，能在部分观测、含噪声的异构测量数据中重构出平滑、物理一致的完整状态轨迹及其解析时间导数，在多个科学基准和真实COVID-19数据集上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实科学系统中的测量通常是部分、有噪声且异构的，无法直接获得完整、规则采样的状态轨迹，这限制了后续的机械论发现方法（如符号回归）的应用。

Method: 在再生核希尔伯特空间中构建状态重建，融合异构观测算子以及语义和结构先验（如非负性、守恒约束、领域特定测量模型），生成具有解析时间导数的平滑物理一致状态估计。

Result: 在九个科学基准、多个噪声水平以及真实COVID-19数据集上，MAAT在轨迹和导数重建误差方面显著优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: MAAT为碎片化测量与下游机械论发现方法之间提供了原则性的接口，能够有效从部分观测数据中恢复完整的动力学状态。

Abstract: Real-world scientific systems are rarely observed through complete, regularly sampled state trajectories. Instead, measurements are often partial, noisy, and heterogeneous, providing fragmented views of latent dynamical states. We introduce MAAT (Model Aware Approximation of Trajectories), a framework for knowledge-informed Kernel State Reconstruction in partially observed dynamical systems. MAAT formulates reconstruction in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space and incorporates heterogeneous observation operators together with semantic and structural priors, including non-negativity, conservation constraints, and domain-specific measurement models. This yields smooth, physically consistent state estimates with analytic time derivatives, providing a principled interface between fragmented measurements and downstream mechanistic discovery methods such as symbolic regression. Across nine scientific benchmarks, multiple noise regimes, and a real-world COVID-19 dataset, MAAT substantially reduces trajectory and derivative reconstruction error relative to strong baselines.

</details>


### [921] [GUDA: Counterfactual Group-wise Training Data Attribution for Diffusion Models via Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22651)
*Naoki Murata,Yuhta Takida,Chieh-Hsin Lai,Toshimitsu Uesaka,Bac Nguyen,Stefano Ermon,Yuki Mitsufuji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GUDA利用机器遗忘技术近似留一组法（LOGO）重训练，高效实现扩散模型的组级训练数据归因，在CIFAR-10和Stable Diffusion艺术风格归因任务上比现有方法更可靠，并带来约100倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉生成模型的训练数据归因方法大多针对单个样本，但实际应用中常需要组级归因（如艺术风格或物体类别）。实现组级反事实归因的LOGO重训练计算成本过高，亟需高效近似方法。

Method: 提出GUDA方法，对共享的全数据模型应用机器遗忘（而非从头训练）来近似每个反事实模型；通过计算全模型与每个遗忘后模型在似然评分规则（ELBO）上的差异来量化组级影响力。

Result: 在CIFAR-10和Stable Diffusion艺术风格归因实验中，GUDA在识别主要贡献组方面优于语义相似度、梯度归因和实例级遗忘方法，并在CIFAR-10上相比LOGO重训练实现了约100倍加速。

Conclusion: GUDA提供了一种高效且可靠的组级训练数据归因方案，弥合了单样本归因与组级反事实分析之间的差距，适用于扩散模型。

Abstract: Training-data attribution for vision generative models aims to identify which training data influenced a given output. While most methods score individual examples, practitioners often need group-level answers (e.g., artistic styles or object classes). Group-wise attribution is counterfactual: how would a model's behavior on a generated sample change if a group were absent from training? A natural realization of this counterfactual is Leave-One-Group-Out (LOGO) retraining, which retrains the model with each group removed; however, it becomes computationally prohibitive as the number of groups grows. We propose GUDA (Group Unlearning-based Data Attribution) for diffusion models, which approximates each counterfactual model by applying machine unlearning to a shared full-data model instead of training from scratch. GUDA quantifies group influence using differences in a likelihood-based scoring rule (ELBO) between the full model and each unlearned counterfactual. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and artistic style attribution with Stable Diffusion show that GUDA identifies primary contributing groups more reliably than semantic similarity, gradient-based attribution, and instance-level unlearning approaches, while achieving ~100x speedup on CIFAR-10 over LOGO retraining.

</details>


### [922] [Quartet II: Accurate LLM Pre-Training in NVFP4 by Improved Unbiased Gradient Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.22813)
*Andrei Panferov,Erik Schultheis,Soroush Tabesh,Dan Alistarh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种新型无偏量化方法MS-EDEN（针对微缩放格式，量化误差比随机舍入降低2倍以上），并集成到全NVFP4线性层量化方案Quartet II中，在NVIDIA Blackwell GPU上实现LLM端到端预训练精度提升与4.2倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NVFP4低精度格式虽支持大规模模型全量化预训练，但现有方法为无偏梯度估计（使用随机舍入）牺牲了格式表示能力，导致精度仍低于FP16/FP8训练；亟需一种在保持无偏性的同时降低量化误差的方案。

Method: 1) 提出MS-EDEN，一种针对微缩放格式（micro-scaled formats）的新型无偏量化例程，量化误差仅为随机舍入的一半以下；2) 将其集成到Quartet II，一个完全基于NVFP4的线性层量化方案，覆盖前向和反向传播的所有主要矩阵乘法；3) 与近期面向NVFP4的训练改进技术协同配合。

Result: 理论分析显示Quartet II在所有主要矩阵乘法上均实现更优梯度估计；端到端LLM训练（1.9B参数/38B token）验证有效性；NVIDIA Blackwell GPU上相比于BF16实现最高4.2倍加速。

Conclusion: MS-EDEN和Quartet II显著提升了NVFP4格式的量化训练精度与效率，是首个兼顾无偏估计与低量化误差的全NVFP4训练方案。

Abstract: The NVFP4 lower-precision format, supported in hardware by NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, promises to allow, for the first time, end-to-end fully-quantized pre-training of massive models such as LLMs. Yet, existing quantized training methods still sacrifice some of the representation capacity of this format in favor of more accurate unbiased quantized gradient estimation by stochastic rounding (SR), losing noticeable accuracy relative to standard FP16 and FP8 training. In this paper, improve the state of the art for quantized training in NVFP4 via a novel unbiased quantization routine for micro-scaled formats, called MS-EDEN, that has more than 2x lower quantization error than SR. We integrate it into a novel fully-NVFP4 quantization scheme for linear layers, called Quartet II. We show analytically that Quartet II achieves consistently better gradient estimation across all major matrix multiplications, both on the forward and on the backward passes. In addition, our proposal synergizes well with recent training improvements aimed specifically at NVFP4. We further validate Quartet II on end-to-end LLM training with up to 1.9B parameters on 38B tokens. We provide kernels for execution on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs with up to 4.2x speedup over BF16. Our code is available at https://github.com/IST-DASLab/Quartet-II .

</details>


### [923] [LRAgent: Efficient KV Cache Sharing for Multi-LoRA LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01053)
*Hyesung Jeon,Hyeongju Ha,Jae-Joon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LRAgent框架，通过将KV缓存分解为共享的基座组件和低秩适配器组件，实现多LoRA智能体系统中KV缓存的高效共享，在保持准确率的同时显著降低内存和计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多LLM智能体系统中，基于多LoRA的角色特化导致每个智能体独立构建并存储各自完整的KV缓存，造成大量内存和计算资源的冗余浪费。现有KV缓存共享方法未能针对这一多LoRA场景进行优化。

Method: 将KV缓存分解为共享基座组件（来自预训练权重）和适配器相关组件（来自LoRA权重）；基座组件在智能体间共享，适配器组件以其固有能力低秩形式存储；采用shared-A多LoRA架构共享低秩缓存；提出Flash-LoRA-Attention内核，重新排序注意力计算以避免将低秩缓存扩展到全维度。

Result: 在吞吐量和首Token延迟方面接近完全共享缓存的性能，同时在智能体问答基准测试中保持接近非共享缓存基线的准确率。

Conclusion: LRAgent有效解决了多LoRA智能体系统中的KV缓存冗余问题，实现了存储和计算效率的大幅提升，同时不牺牲模型精度，为大规模多智能体部署提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Role specialization in multi-LLM agent systems is often realized via multi-LoRA, where agents share a pretrained backbone and differ only by lightweight adapters. Despite sharing base model weights, each agent independently builds and stores its own KV cache for the same long, tool-augmented trajectories, incurring substantial memory and compute overhead. Existing KV cache sharing methods largely overlook this multi-LoRA setting. We observe that, cache differences across agents are dominated by adapter outputs, while activations from the shared pretrained backbone remain highly similar. Based on this observation, we propose LRAgent, a KV cache sharing framework for multi-LoRA agents. It decomposes the cache into two components, a shared base component derived from pretrained weights and an adapter-dependent component derived from LoRA weights. LRAgent reduces memory overhead by sharing the base component across agents and storing the adapter component in its inherent low-rank form. It also reduces computational overhead by sharing the low-rank cache, enabled by a shared-A multi-LoRA architecture. This avoids redundant computations for contexts that have already been processed by other agents. To efficiently reconstruct adapter contributions at runtime, we introduce Flash-LoRA-Attention, a kernel that reorders attention computation to avoid materializing the low-rank cache to full dimension. LRAgent achieves throughput and time-to-first-token latency close to fully shared caching, while preserving accuracy near the non-shared caching baseline across agentic question-answering benchmarks.

</details>


### [924] [Zero-Shot Off-Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01962)
*Arip Asadulaev,Maksim Bobrin,Salem Lahlou,Dmitry Dylov,Fakhri Karray,Martin Takac*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将后继度量与稳态密度比理论连接的方法，实现在零样本强化学习中无需额外训练即可适应新任务的离策略学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离策略学习方法面临分布偏移和价值函数过估计偏差的挑战，这些问题在零样本强化学习中尤为突出——智能体在奖励无关数据上训练后需在测试时适应新任务而无额外训练。

Method: 发现了后继度量与稳态密度比之间的理论联系，据此算法可以推断最优重要性采样比，对任意任务实时执行最优策略的稳态分布校正。该方法无缝集成到前向-后向表示框架中。

Result: 在SMPL人体运动跟踪、ExoRL连续控制和OGBench长视界任务上进行了基准测试，实现了无需训练即可快速适应新任务。

Conclusion: 本工作桥接了离策略学习与零样本适应两个研究领域，为两者带来互利。

Abstract: Off-policy learning methods seek to derive an optimal policy directly from a fixed dataset of prior interactions. This objective presents significant challenges, primarily due to the inherent distributional shift and value function overestimation bias. These issues become even more noticeable in zero-shot reinforcement learning, where an agent trained on reward-free data must adapt to new tasks at test time without additional training. In this work, we address the off-policy problem in a zero-shot setting by discovering a theoretical connection of successor measures to stationary density ratios. Using this insight, our algorithm can infer optimal importance sampling ratios, effectively performing a stationary distribution correction with an optimal policy for any task on the fly. We benchmark our method in motion tracking tasks on SMPL Humanoid, continuous control on ExoRL, and for the long-horizon OGBench tasks. Our technique seamlessly integrates into forward-backward representation frameworks and enables fast-adaptation to new tasks in a training-free regime. More broadly, this work bridges off-policy learning and zero-shot adaptation, offering benefits to both research areas.

</details>


### [925] [Probabilistic Performance Guarantees for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02098)
*Yannik Schnitzer,Mathias Jackermeier,Alessandro Abate,David Parker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种新方法，能够为多任务强化学习策略在未见任务上的表现提供高置信度的形式化保证，通过组合有限 rollout 的每任务置信下界和有限采样任务的任务级泛化，在任意未知分布下给出保证，并在多种 SOTA 方法上验证了理论有效性和实际样本量下的信息量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大多数多任务强化学习方法缺乏正式的性能保证，这在安全关键场景中是不可接受的，因此需要一种能够为多任务策略在未见任务上提供可靠性能保证的方法。

Method: 提出了一种新的泛化界限，将 (i) 有限次 rollout 得到的每任务置信下界与 (ii) 有限采样任务的任务级泛化结合起来，从而对来自任意未知分布的新任务给出高置信度保证。

Result: 在多种 SOTA 多任务 RL 方法上验证了该保证在理论上是合理的，并且在现实的样本量下具有信息量。

Conclusion: 该方法能够为多任务强化学习策略在未见任务上的性能提供可计算的、高置信度的形式化保证，弥补了现有方法在安全性关键部署中缺乏性能保障的不足。

Abstract: Multi-task reinforcement learning trains generalist policies that can execute multiple tasks. While recent years have seen significant progress, existing approaches rarely provide formal performance guarantees, which are indispensable when deploying policies in safety-critical settings. We present an approach for computing high-confidence guarantees on the performance of a multi-task policy on tasks not seen during training. Concretely, we introduce a new generalisation bound that composes (i) per-task lower confidence bounds from finitely many rollouts with (ii) task-level generalisation from finitely many sampled tasks, yielding a high-confidence guarantee for new tasks drawn from the same arbitrary and unknown distribution. Across state-of-the-art multi-task RL methods, we show that the guarantees are theoretically sound and informative at realistic sample sizes.

</details>


### [926] [Interpretability in Deep Time Series Models Demands Semantic Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02239)
*Giovanni De Felice,Riccardo D'Elia,Alberto Termine,Pietro Barbiero,Giuseppe Marra,Silvia Santini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出深度时间序列模型的解释性应追求语义对齐，即预测应基于用户有意义的变量，并受时空机制约束，且这种对齐必须在时间演化中保持不变。作者给出了形式化定义、构建蓝图、支持信任的属性及对模型设计的启示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法聚焦于解释模型内部计算，但未检验这些解释是否与人类对研究现象的推理方式一致，导致黑箱模型部署受限。

Method: 形式化定义了语义对齐要求，指出其在时间演化中必须保持不变的独特约束（静态设置中无此类比），并据此提出了语义对齐深度时间序列模型的构建蓝图。

Result: 明确了语义对齐的形式化定义及其在时间演化中的不变性约束，提出了支持信任的属性集合，并讨论了这些要求对模型设计的影响。

Conclusion: 语义对齐是深度时间序列模型可解释性的关键方向，其时间不变性约束对模型设计具有重要指导意义，未来应以此为目标进行模型构建。

Abstract: Deep time series models continue to improve predictive performance, yet their deployment remains limited by their black-box nature. In response, existing interpretability approaches in the field keep focusing on explaining the internal model computations, without addressing whether they align or not with how a human would reason about the studied phenomenon. Instead, we state interpretability in deep time series models should pursue semantic alignment: predictions should be expressed in terms of variables that are meaningful to the end user, mediated by spatial and temporal mechanisms that admit user-dependent constraints. In this paper, we formalize this requirement and state that, once established, semantic alignment must be preserved under temporal evolution: a constraint with no analog in static settings. Provided with this definition, we outline a blueprint for semantically aligned deep time series models, identify properties that support trust, and discuss implications for model design.

</details>


### [927] [naPINN: Noise-Adaptive Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Recovering Physics from Corrupted Measurement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02547)
*Hankyeol Kim,Pilsung Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: naPINN通过嵌入能量模型学习预测残差的潜在分布，利用可训练的可信门自适应过滤高能量数据点，并引入拒绝代价正则化防止丢弃有效数据，从而在复杂噪声和异常值下鲁棒地恢复物理解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准PINNs在复杂测量噪声和严重异常值下性能显著退化，且缺乏对噪声分布的先验知识，需要一种能自适应处理未知噪声分布的鲁棒求解方法。

Method: 1) 在训练循环中嵌入能量模型学习预测残差的潜在分布；2) 基于学习到的能量景观，设计可训练的可信门自适应过滤高能量数据点；3) 引入拒绝代价正则化以防止有效数据被丢弃。

Result: 在多种受非高斯噪声和不同比例异常值污染的基准偏微分方程上，naPINN显著优于现有鲁棒PINN基线，成功分离异常值并在严重数据损坏下准确重建动力学。

Conclusion: naPINN是一种无需噪声分布先验知识的鲁棒PINN框架，能有效处理复杂噪声和异常值，显著提升了PINNs在真实世界噪声环境下的适用性。

Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are effective methods for solving inverse problems and discovering governing equations from observational data. However, their performance degrades significantly under complex measurement noise and gross outliers. To address this issue, we propose the Noise-Adaptive Physics-Informed Neural Network (naPINN), which robustly recovers physical solutions from corrupted measurements without prior knowledge of the noise distribution. naPINN embeds an energy-based model into the training loop to learn the latent distribution of prediction residuals. Leveraging the learned energy landscape, a trainable reliability gate adaptively filters data points exhibiting high energy, while a rejection cost regularization prevents trivial solutions where valid data are discarded. We demonstrate the efficacy of naPINN on various benchmark partial differential equations corrupted by non-Gaussian noise and varying rates of outliers. The results show that naPINN significantly outperforms existing robust PINN baselines, successfully isolating outliers and accurately reconstructing the dynamics under severe data corruption.

</details>


### [928] [The Alignment Curse: Modality Alignment Supercharges Audio Attacks via Text Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02557)
*Yupeng Chen,Junchi Yu,Aoxi Liu,Baoyuan Wu,Philip Torr,Adel Bibi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"对齐诅咒"原则，证明更强的文本-音频模态对齐会使文本攻击更有效地迁移到音频领域，导致端到端全模态模型面临跨模态安全漏洞转移风险。实验表明文本迁移的音频攻击效果与原生音频攻击相当甚至更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索端到端训练的全模态模型中，文本-音频模态对齐是否会在无意中促进安全漏洞跨模态转移，因为文本越狱攻击比音频攻击成熟得多，若系统性转移则当前音频安全评估可能低估源自文本模态的风险。

Method: 形式化定义并实证验证"对齐诅咒"原则；在Qwen2.5-Omni、Qwen3-Omni等模型上进行黑盒评估，对比文本攻击、文本迁移音频攻击和原生音频攻击三类攻击方法。

Result: 文本迁移的音频攻击表现与原生音频攻击相当甚至更优，在仅音频访问条件下具有明显优势；更强的模态对齐导致更有效的跨模态攻击迁移。

Conclusion: 文本模态的漏洞在塑造音频安全风险中起关键作用；模态对齐越紧密，跨模态攻击迁移越有效，揭示了能力与安全性之间的根本矛盾。

Abstract: Recent advances in end-to-end trained omni-models have substantially improved audio capabilities by strengthening text-audio modality alignment. However, whether such alignment inadvertently facilitates the transfer of safety vulnerabilities across modalities remains underexplored. This question is critical as text-based jailbreak attacks are considerably more mature than audio-based ones; if they transfer systematically, current audio safety evaluations may underestimate risks originating from the text modality. In this paper, we introduce the Alignment Curse, a formally characterized and empirically validated principle showing that stronger modality alignment enables more effective transfer of attacks from text to audio, revealing a fundamental tension between capability and safety. Motivated by this principle, we conduct a comprehensive black-box evaluation of three attack categories on recent omni-models (e.g., Qwen2.5-Omni, Qwen3-Omni): text attacks, text-transferred audio attacks, and audio attacks. We find that text-transferred audio attacks perform comparably to, and often better than, audio-based attacks, exhibiting a clear advantage under audio-only access. This suggests that text-based vulnerabilities play a pivotal role in shaping audio safety risks. Finally, we empirically analyze the relationship between modality alignment and transfer effectiveness across attack methods and models, observing consistent support for the Alignment Curse: tighter modality alignment leads to more effective cross-modality attack transfer.

</details>


### [929] [Exposing Vulnerabilities in Explanation for Time Series Classifiers via Dual-Target Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02763)
*Bohan Wang,Zewen Liu,Lu Lin,Hui Liu,Li Xiong,Ming Jin,Wei Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示时间序列深度学习中的解释稳定性不能作为决策鲁棒性的可靠代理，并提出TSEF（时间序列解释欺骗器）这一双目标攻击方法，能够在对分类器进行目标性误分类的同时，保持解释与参考理由一致且看似合理，从而证明预测与解释可以被对抗性解耦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前可解释时间序列深度学习系统常以解释的时间一致性作为鲁棒性指标，但这一假设可能不成立——解释稳定未必意味着决策鲁棒，因此需要验证这种代理指标的有效性。

Method: 提出TSEF（Time Series Explanation Fooler），一种双目标攻击方法，同时操控分类器输出和解释器输出，在实现目标性预测改变的同时，保持解释与所选参考理由一致且不引入广泛的注意力质量扩散。

Result: 在多个数据集和解释器主干上的实验一致表明，解释稳定性是决策鲁棒性的误导性代理指标；TSEF成功实现了预测与解释的对抗性解耦。

Conclusion: 解释了稳定性不能作为时间序列深度学习系统决策鲁棒性的可靠度量，建议在可信时间序列任务中引入耦合感知的鲁棒性评估。

Abstract: Interpretable time series deep learning systems are often assessed by checking temporal consistency on explanations, implicitly treating this as evidence of robustness. We show that this assumption can fail: Predictions and explanations can be adversarially decoupled, enabling targeted misclassification while the explanation remains plausible and consistent with a chosen reference rationale. We propose TSEF (Time Series Explanation Fooler), a dual-target attack that jointly manipulates the classifier and explainer outputs. In contrast to single-objective misclassification attacks that disrupt explanation and spread attribution mass broadly, TSEF achieves targeted prediction changes while keeping explanations consistent with the reference. Across multiple datasets and explainer backbones, our results consistently reveal that explanation stability is a misleading proxy for decision robustness and motivate coupling-aware robustness evaluations for trustworthy time series tasks.

</details>


### [930] [Causal Evaluation of Membership Inference Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02819)
*Mathieu Even,Clément Berenfeld,Linus Bleistein,Tudor Cebere,Julie Josse,Aurélien Bellet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过因果推断框架重新定义成员推断攻击评估，提出单次训练和零训练评估方法的偏差来源，并给出具有非渐近一致性保证的实用估计器，无需重训练即可可靠评估隐私风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准MIA评估需要重复训练，计算成本高昂；单次/零次运行方法虽常用但统计有效性不明确。作者旨在填补这一理论空白，为隐私评估提供原则性基础。

Method: 将MIA评估形式化为因果推断问题，将记忆定义为数据点纳入训练集的因果效应，推导偏差来源（干扰/混杂），提出多轮、单轮、零轮三种场景下的因果度量估计器，并提供非渐近一致性保证。

Result: 在预训练/微调LLM等多个设置中验证，表明该方法无需重训练即可可靠测量MIA性能，且能处理分布偏移。

Conclusion: 该因果框架为现代AI系统的隐私评估提供了原则性基础，实现了无需重训练且能处理分布偏移的可靠MIA评估。

Abstract: Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) aim to distinguish training points (members) from unseen data (non-members), and are widely used to quantify memorization and assess privacy risks. Standard MIA evaluation requires repeated retraining, which is computationally costly for large models. One-run (single training with randomized data inclusion) and zero-run (post hoc evaluation) methods are often used instead, but their statistical validity remains unclear. We address this gap by framing MIA evaluation as a causal inference problem, defining \emph{memorization as the causal effect of including a data point in the training set}. This novel formulation reveals and formalizes key sources of bias in existing protocols: one-run methods suffer from interference between jointly included points, while zero-run evaluations are additionally confounded by distribution shift between member and non-member evaluation data. We derive causal analogues of standard MIA metrics and propose practical estimators for multi-run, one-run, and zero-run regimes with non-asymptotic consistency guarantees. We validate our approach in several settings, including pretrained and fine-tuned LLMs, showing that it enables reliable measurement of MIA performance without retraining and under distribution shift. Overall, our framework provides a principled foundation for privacy evaluation in modern AI systems.

</details>


### [931] [Mixture of Concept Bottleneck Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02886)
*Francesco De Santis,Gabriele Ciravegna,Giovanni De Felice,Arianna Casanova,Francesco Giannini,Michelangelo Diligenti,Johannes Schneider,Danilo Giordano,Mateo Espinosa Zarlenga,Pietro Barbiero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: M-CBE框架通过引入多个概念瓶颈专家（线性或符号表达式）来泛化概念瓶颈模型，在准确性与可解释性之间实现灵活权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBMs）的任务预测器仅使用单一预定义函数形式的表达式，限制了预测精度和适应不同用户需求的能力。

Method: 提出混合概念瓶颈专家（M-CBE）框架，沿两个维度泛化CBMs：表达式的数量（专家数量）和每个表达式的函数形式。具体实例化为Linear M-CBE（学习有限集线性表达式）和Symbolic M-CBE（利用符号回归从数据中发现专家函数，受用户指定运算符词汇表约束）。

Result: 实验表明，改变表达式数量及其函数形式为导航准确率-可解释性权衡提供了稳健框架。

Conclusion: M-CBE通过扩展表达式的多样性和函数形式，有效地探索了CBMs设计空间中此前未被充分研究的区域，实现了更灵活的准确率与可解释性平衡。

Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) promote interpretability by grounding predictions in human-understandable concepts. However, existing CBMs typically constrain their task predictor to a single expression whose functional form is set a priori, limiting both predictive accuracy and adaptability to diverse user needs. We propose Mixture of Concept Bottleneck Experts (M-CBE), a framework that generalizes existing CBMs along two dimensions: the number of expressions, referred to as experts, employed by the task predictor to map concepts to the task, and the functional form each expression takes, thus exposing an underexplored region of this design space. We investigate this region by instantiating two novel models: Linear M-CBE, which learns a finite set of linear expressions, and Symbolic M-CBE, which leverages symbolic regression to discover expert functions from data subject to user-specified operator vocabularies. Empirical evaluation demonstrates that varying the number of expressions and their functional form provides a robust framework for navigating the accuracy-interpretability trade-off.

</details>


### [932] [From Zero to Hero: Advancing Zero-Shot Foundation Models for Tabular Outlier Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03018)
*Xueying Ding,Haomin Wen,Simon Klüttermann,Leman Akoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OUTFORMER是一种基于基础模型的离群检测方法，通过混合合成先验和自演进课程训练，仅使用合成数据预训练，通过上下文学习实现零样本推理，在AdBench和两个新的大规模基准测试（1500+数据集）上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离群检测在实际应用中广泛使用，但缺乏标注离群样本使得算法选择和超参数调优极其困难，阻碍了其在新任务上的有效部署。

Method: (1) 混合合成先验（mixture of synthetic priors）；(2) 自演进课程训练（self-evolving curriculum training）。仅使用合成标注数据集预训练，通过将新任务的训练数据作为上下文输入来推断测试标签，推理仅需前向传播，无需标注离群样本。

Result: 在AdBench以及新引入的两个大规模OD基准测试（共1500+数据集）上达到SOTA性能，同时推理速度快。

Conclusion: OUTFORMER实现了真正即插即用的离群检测部署，零额外工作（无需模型训练或模型选择），推理快速且为零样本。

Abstract: Outlier detection (OD) is widely used in practice; but its effective deployment on new tasks is hindered by lack of labeled outliers, which makes algorithm and hyperparameter selection notoriously hard. Foundation models (FMs) have transformed ML, and OD is no exception: Shen et. al. (2025) introduced FoMo-0D, the first FM for OD, achieving remarkable performance against numerous baselines. This work introduces OUTFORMER, which advances FoMo-0D with (1) a mixture of synthetic priors and (2) self-evolving curriculum training. OUTFORMER is pretrained solely on synthetic labeled datasets and infers test labels of a new task by using its training data as in-context input. Inference is fast and zero-shot, requiring merely forward pass and no labeled outliers. Thanks to in-context learning, it requires zero additional work-no OD model training or bespoke model selection-enabling truly plug-and-play deployment. OUTFORMER achieves state-of-the-art performance on the prominent AdBench, as well as two new large-scale OD benchmarks that we introduce, comprising over 1,500 datasets, while maintaining speedy inference.

</details>


### [933] [Consistency Deep Equilibrium Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03024)
*Junchao Lin,Zenan Ling,Jingwen Xu,Robert C. Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一致性深度均衡模型（C-DEQ），通过一致性蒸馏将DEQ的迭代求解过程转化为沿固定ODE轨迹向均衡点演化的过程，训练模型将中间状态直接映射到固定点，实现少步推理，在相同推理预算下相比隐式DEQ获得2-20倍的精度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DEQ模型虽能以恒定内存建模无限深度网络，但其固定点求解器的迭代特性导致严重的推理延迟，亟需加速方法。

Method: 将DEQ迭代推理过程视为沿固定ODE轨迹向均衡点演化，沿此轨迹训练C-DEQ将中间状态一致性地直接映射到固定点，支持少步推理和多步评估以灵活权衡计算与性能。

Result: 在多种领域任务上，C-DEQ在相同少步推理预算下相比隐式DEQ取得2-20倍的精度提升。

Conclusion: 一致性蒸馏能有效加速DEQ推理，实现少步推理且保持教师DEQ性能，同时支持多步评估实现计算与性能的灵活权衡。

Abstract: Deep Equilibrium Models (DEQs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm in deep learning, offering the ability to model infinite-depth networks with constant memory usage. However, DEQs incur significant inference latency due to the iterative nature of fixed-point solvers. In this work, we introduce the Consistency Deep Equilibrium Model (C-DEQ), a novel framework that leverages consistency distillation to accelerate DEQ inference. We cast the DEQ iterative inference process as evolution along a fixed ODE trajectory toward the equilibrium. Along this trajectory, we train C-DEQs to consistently map intermediate states directly to the fixed point, enabling few-step inference while preserving the performance of the teacher DEQ. At the same time, it facilitates multi-step evaluation to flexibly trade computation for performance gains. Extensive experiments across various domain tasks demonstrate that C-DEQs achieve consistent 2-20$\times$ accuracy improvements over implicit DEQs under the same few-step inference budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/landrarwolf/CDEQ.

</details>


### [934] [Lookahead Sample Reward Guidance for Test-Time Scaling of Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03211)
*Yeongmin Kim,Donghyeok Shin,Byeonghu Na,Minsang Park,Richard Lee Kim,Il-Chul Moon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LiDAR采样方法，利用预训练扩散模型的边际样本直接计算期望未来奖励（EFR），无需反向传播或反向 rollout，通过少步前瞻采样和精确求解器引导粒子向高奖励区域移动，在GenEval基准上达到与最新梯度引导方法相同性能且实现9.5倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型生成的样本往往不能完全符合人类意图，现有计算期望未来奖励的方法存在采样成本高（反向rollout）或存在偏差和采样问题（Tweedie类方法包括序列蒙特卡洛和梯度引导），因此需要一种高效的测试时缩放方法从更高人类对齐奖励值的区域采样。

Method: 利用预训练扩散模型的边际样本直接计算任意x_t处的期望未来奖励，实现无需神经反向传播的闭式奖励引导；引入少步前瞻采样和精确求解器，将粒子引导向高奖励前瞻样本。

Result: LiDAR方法在GenEval基准上与最新梯度引导方法（SDXL）达到相同性能，同时实现9.5倍加速。

Conclusion: LiDAR采样是一种高效的测试时缩放方法，通过边际样本计算EFR避免了现有方法的局限，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升采样效率。

Abstract: Diffusion models have demonstrated strong generative performance; however, generated samples often fail to fully align with human intent. This paper studies an efficient test-time scaling method for sampling from regions with higher human-aligned reward values. Existing methods for computing the expected future reward (EFR) face important limitations: backward rollout incurs prohibitively high sampling costs, while Tweedie-based approaches, including Sequential Monte Carlo and gradient guidance, suffer from bias and inherent sampling issues. We show that the EFR at any $\mathbf{x}_t$ can be computed using only marginal samples from a pre-trained diffusion model, enabling closed-form reward guidance without neural backpropagation. To further improve efficiency, we introduce a few-step lookahead sampling and an accurate solver that guides particles toward high-reward lookahead samples. We refer to this sampling scheme as LiDAR sampling. LiDAR achieves the same GenEval performance as the latest gradient guidance method for SDXL with a 9.5x speedup. We release the code at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/Diffusion-LiDAR-Sampling.

</details>


### [935] [When Single Answer Is Not Enough: Rethinking Single-Step Retrosynthesis Benchmarks for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03554)
*Bogdan Zagribelnyy,Ivan Ilin,Maksim Kuznetsov,Nikita Bondarev,Mathieu Reymond,Roman Schutski,Thomas MacDougall,Rim Shayakhmetov,Zulfat Miftakhutdinov,Mikolaj Mizera,Vladimir Aladinskiy,Alex Aliper,Alex Zhavoronkov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的单步逆合成分析基准框架，使用基于化学合理性的ChemCensor指标替代传统的Top-K精确匹配评估，并构建了包含数百万经ChemCensor验证反应的CREED数据集，训练出优于现有LLM基线的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有逆合成分析评估依赖已发表合成程序和基于单一真实答案的Top-K准确率，无法捕捉真实合成规划的开放本质，缺乏对化学合理性的客观评估。

Method: 提出ChemCensor指标（基于化学合理性而非精确匹配），构建CREED数据集（数百万经ChemCensor验证的反应记录），在该基准下评估通用型和化学专用型LLM。

Result: 使用CREED数据集训练的模型在ChemCensor基准下优于现有的LLM基线模型。

Conclusion: 基于化学合理性的评估比精确匹配更符合人类合成规划实践，为LLM在逆合成分析中的客观评估提供了新范式。

Abstract: Recent progress has expanded the use of large language models (LLMs) in drug discovery, including synthesis planning. However, objective evaluation of retrosynthesis performance remains limited. Existing benchmarks and metrics typically rely on published synthetic procedures and Top-K accuracy based on single ground-truth, which does not capture the open-ended nature of real-world synthesis planning. We propose a new benchmarking framework for single-step retrosynthesis that evaluates both general-purpose and chemistry-specialized LLMs using ChemCensor, a novel metric for chemical plausibility. By emphasizing plausibility over exact match, this approach better aligns with human synthesis planning practices. We also introduce CREED, a novel dataset comprising millions of ChemCensor-validated reaction records for LLM training, and use it to train a model that improves over the LLM baselines under this benchmark.

</details>


### [936] [Equilibrium Propagation for Non-Conservative Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03670)
*Antonino Emanuele Scurria,Dimitri Vanden Abeele,Bortolo Matteo Mognetti,Serge Massar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了非保守系统（包括非互易相互作用和前馈网络）的均衡传播算法扩展版本，通过在学习阶段引入与非互易部分成正比的项，实现成本函数精确梯度的计算，并在数值实验中取得了更优的性能和更快的收敛速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始的均衡传播算法仅限于保守系统（即存在能量函数的动力学系统），而许多实际应用涉及非保守系统（非互易相互作用）。先前将EP推广到此类系统的尝试未能计算成本函数的精确梯度。

Method: 提出一个框架将EP扩展到任意非保守系统（包括前馈网络），保留使用稳态进行推理和学习的核心特性，但在学习阶段通过在动力学中引入与非互易部分成正比的项来获得成本函数的精确梯度。该算法还可通过变分公式推导，即在增广状态空间上定义能量函数来生成学习动力学。

Result: 数值实验表明该算法相比先前方案实现了更好的性能和更快的学习速度。

Conclusion: 该工作成功将均衡传播推广到非保守系统，解决了先前方法无法计算精确梯度的问题，并通过变分框架提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: Equilibrium Propagation (EP) is a physics-inspired learning algorithm that uses stationary states of a dynamical system both for inference and learning. In its original formulation it is limited to conservative systems, $\textit{i.e.}$ to dynamics which derive from an energy function. Given their applications, it is important to extend EP to non-conservative systems, $\textit{i.e.}$ systems with non-reciprocal interactions. Previous attempts to generalize EP to such systems failed to compute the exact gradient of the cost function. Here we propose a framework that extends EP to arbitrary non-conservative systems, including feedforward networks. We keep the key property of equilibrium propagation, namely the use of stationary states both for inference and learning. However, we modify the dynamics in the learning phase by a term proportional to the non-reciprocal part of the interaction so as to obtain the exact gradient of the cost function. This algorithm can also be derived using a variational formulation that generates the learning dynamics through an energy function defined over an augmented state space. Numerical experiments show that this algorithm achieves better performance and learns faster than previous proposals.

</details>


### [937] [Universal One-third Time Scaling in Learning Peaked Distributions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03685)
*Yizhou Liu,Ziming Liu,Cengiz Pehlevan,Jeff Gore*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过理论分析和实验验证，揭示了大型语言模型训练中损失函数呈幂律收敛的根本原因在于softmax和交叉熵的组合使用，并推导出损失随训练时间呈指数为1/3的幂律缩放规律，为改进LLM训练效率提供了新方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型训练计算成本高昂，部分原因是损失函数呈现缓慢的幂律收敛，但其根本原因尚存争议。本研究旨在揭示这一现象的深层机制。

Method: 通过对玩具模型进行系统分析以及对大型语言模型进行实证评估，研究softmax和交叉熵在训练动力学中的作用机制。

Result: 发现softmax和交叉熵组合在学习尖峰概率分布（如下一个token分布）时，普遍导致损失和梯度呈幂律消失，形成根本性的优化瓶颈，最终产生指数为1/3的通用幂律时间缩放规律。

Conclusion: 该结果为观察到的神经缩放现象提供了机制性解释，并为提高LLM训练效率指明了新的改进方向。

Abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) is computationally expensive, partly because the loss exhibits slow power-law convergence whose origin remains debatable. Through systematic analysis of toy models and empirical evaluation of LLMs, we show that this behavior can arise intrinsically from the use of softmax and cross-entropy. When learning peaked probability distributions, e.g., next-token distributions, these components generically yield power-law vanishing losses and gradients, regardless of many microscopic details, creating a fundamental optimization bottleneck. This ultimately leads to power-law time scaling of the loss with a universal exponent of $1/3$. Our results provide a mechanistic explanation for observed neural scaling and suggest new directions for improving LLM training efficiency.

</details>


### [938] [Echo State Networks for Time Series Forecasting: Hyperparameter Sweep and Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03912)
*Alexander Häußer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了简单的一阶自回归回声状态网络（ESN）在M4竞赛数据集上对月度与季度时间序列进行单变量预测的性能，发现其在MASE指标下与ARIMA、TBATS等方法表现相当，且在季度数据上取得了最低的平均MASE，同时训练和预测时间较低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估简单的一阶自回归ESN是否能够成为广泛应用于时间序列预测的竞争性替代方法。

Method: 采用两阶段设计：使用参数数据集分析ESN的泄漏率、谱半径、储备池规模和正则化选择等配置，并在独立的预测数据集上进行样本外基准测试。预测精度使用MASE和sMAPE衡量，与ARIMA、ETS、Theta方法和TBATS等基准模型比较。

Result: 月度数据偏好中等持久性的储备池，季度数据偏好更具收缩性的动力学；高频泄漏率在两种频率下均被偏好。ESN在月度数据上与ARIMA、TBATS表现相当，在季度数据上取得最低的平均MASE，但未在所有指标上一致最优。

Conclusion: 简单的自回归ESN可以在M4子集上提供有竞争力的预测精度，尤其在MASE指标下表现突出，且一旦配置固定，训练和预测时间要求较低。

Abstract: This paper investigates the performance of Echo State Networks (ESNs) for univariate forecasting of monthly and quarterly time series from the M4 Forecasting Competition dataset. We evaluate whether a simple first-order autoregressive ESN can serve as a competitive alternative to widely used forecasting methods. The study uses a two-stage design: a Parameter dataset is used to analyze ESN model configurations over leakage rate, spectral radius, reservoir size, and regularization selection, while a disjoint Forecast dataset is reserved for out-of-sample benchmarking. Forecast accuracy is measured using mean absolute scaled error (MASE) and symmetric mean absolute percentage error (sMAPE) and compared with simple benchmarks and statistical models including autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA), exponential smoothing state space (ETS), the Theta method, and TBATS. The model-configuration analysis reveals frequency-specific patterns: monthly series tend to favor moderately persistent reservoirs, whereas quarterly series favor more contractive dynamics; across both frequencies, high leakage rates are generally preferred. In the final benchmark, the ESN performs on par with ARIMA and TBATS for monthly data and achieves the lowest mean MASE for quarterly data, although it is not uniformly best across all metrics. Overall, the results indicate that a simple autoregressive ESN can provide competitive forecast accuracy on the considered filtered M4 subsets, particularly under MASE, while requiring low training and forecasting time once the ESN configuration has been fixed.

</details>


### [939] [From Evaluation to Design: Using Potential Energy Surface Smoothness Metrics to Guide Machine Learning Interatomic Potential Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.04861)
*Ryan Liu,Eric Qu,Tobias Kreiman,Samuel M. Blau,Aditi S. Krishnapriyan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的键平滑度表征测试（BSCT），该基准通过受控键变形高效检测势能面的非平滑性（如不连续性、伪极小值和虚假力），与微正则分子动力学稳定性强相关但计算成本极低，并展示了通过BSCT指导Transformer架构优化（可微k近邻和温度控制注意力）可同时获得低回归误差、稳定MD模拟和鲁棒的物性预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLIP在能量/力回归评估中表现良好，但在下游模拟中可能出现非物理行为；标准的微正则MD评估计算昂贵且主要探测近平衡态，缺乏高效、全面评估势能面平滑性的基准。

Method: 提出BSCT基准，通过受控键变形系统地探测势能面，检测不连续性、伪极小值和虚假力等非平滑特征；使用无约束Transformer作为测试平台，引入可微k近邻算法和温度控制注意力来减少BSCT检测到的伪影。

Result: BSCT与MD稳定性强相关，但计算成本仅为MD的一小部分；基于BSCT优化的MLIP同时实现了低能量/力回归误差、稳定的MD模拟和鲁棒的原子属性预测。

Conclusion: BSCT可作为MLIP实用性的验证指标，也可作为模型设计代理，提醒开发者注意现有基准无法高效评估的物理挑战。

Abstract: Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials (MLIPs) sometimes fail to reproduce the physical smoothness of the quantum potential energy surface (PES), leading to erroneous behavior in downstream simulations that standard energy and force regression evaluations can miss. Existing evaluations, such as microcanonical molecular dynamics (MD), are computationally expensive and primarily probe near-equilibrium states. To improve evaluation metrics for MLIPs, we introduce the Bond Smoothness Characterization Test (BSCT). This efficient benchmark probes the PES via controlled bond deformations and detects non-smoothness, including discontinuities, artificial minima, and spurious forces, both near and far from equilibrium. We show that BSCT correlates strongly with MD stability while requiring a fraction of the cost of MD. To demonstrate how BSCT can guide iterative model design, we utilize an unconstrained Transformer backbone as a testbed, illustrating how refinements such as a new differentiable $k$-nearest neighbors algorithm and temperature-controlled attention reduce artifacts identified by our metric. By optimizing model design systematically based on BSCT, the resulting MLIP simultaneously achieves a low conventional E/F regression error, stable MD simulations, and robust atomistic property predictions. Our results establish BSCT as both a validation metric for practitioners to assess MLIP utility and as an "in-the-loop" model design proxy that alerts MLIP developers to physical challenges that cannot be efficiently evaluated by current MLIP benchmarks. The BSCT dataset and evaluation are available on https://github.com/ryanliu30/bsct.git

</details>


### [940] [Adaptive Exploration for Latent-State Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05139)
*Jikai Jin,Kenneth Hung,Sanath Kumar Krishnamurthy,Baoyi Shi,Congshan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对奖励依赖于独立于学习者动作演变的隐马尔可夫状态的bandit问题，本文提出了向LinUCB馈送两种隐状态摘要（滞后动作-奖励对和探测指纹）的算法，并通过自适应更新机制在合成压力测试中相比多种基线降低了动态遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在奖励由独立于学习者动作的隐马尔可夫状态决定的bandit场景中，最优臂会随着状态变化而改变，而学习者只能观测到过去的动作和奖励。现有标准、对抗和非平稳bandit方法无法有效处理这种隐状态驱动的奖励变化，因此需要专门设计算法来推断隐状态并降低动态遗憾。

Method: 提出将LinUCB与两种隐状态摘要结合：1) 滞后动作-奖励对作为历史信息摘要；2) 可用的探测指纹（由多个臂的奖励构成）。自适应变体通过残差检验、边际检验和陈旧性测试来刷新指纹。算法利用这些摘要区分不同隐状态，指导臂选择。

Result: 在状态数量、转移速率、噪声和时域跨度等维度的合成压力测试中，当摘要能够有效区分状态且更新频率足够时，所提方法在动态遗憾上优于标准bandit、对抗bandit和非平稳bandit基线。消融实验和误设定测试揭示了主要失败模式：指纹区分度弱、噪声过高以及顺序探测过程中的状态变化。

Conclusion: 本文验证了通过隐状态摘要增强LinUCB可有效应对隐马尔可夫奖励下的非平稳bandit问题，但方法性能受限于指纹区分度、噪声水平和探测期间的状态稳定性，为后续改进指明了方向。

Abstract: We study bandits whose rewards depend on an unobserved Markov state that evolves independently of the learner's actions. The optimal arm can change even though the learner observes only past actions and rewards. We propose algorithms that feed LinUCB with two summaries of the hidden state: a lagged action-reward pair and, when available, a probe fingerprint formed from rewards of multiple arms. The adaptive variants refresh the fingerprint using residual, margin, and staleness tests. In synthetic stress tests over state count, transition rate, noise, and horizon, these methods reduce dynamic regret relative to standard, adversarial, and non-stationary bandit baselines when the summaries distinguish states and are updated often enough. Ablations and misspecification tests identify the main failure modes: weak fingerprint separation, high noise, and state changes during sequential probes.

</details>


### [941] [Inverse Depth Scaling From Most Layers Being Similar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.05970)
*Yizhou Liu,Sara Kangaslahti,Ziming Liu,Jeff Gore*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过分析大型语言模型和残差网络，发现损失与深度成反比，这种关系可能源于功能相似层的集成平均效应，而非组合学习或平滑动力学离散化，表明需要架构创新以提高深度利用效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经缩放定律通常关联损失与模型规模，但深度和宽度对性能的贡献不同，需要更细致的研究来量化深度对损失的影响。

Method: 通过对大型语言模型和玩具残差网络进行分析，量化深度如何影响损失。

Result: 发现损失与深度成反比；这种关系可能源自功能相似层的集成平均效应，而非组合学习或平滑动力学的离散化。

Conclusion: 当前深度利用效率低下但鲁棒；提高LLM效率需要架构创新以鼓励深度的组合式利用。

Abstract: Neural scaling laws relate loss to model size in large language models (LLMs), yet depth and width may contribute to performance differently, requiring more detailed studies. Here, we quantify how depth affects loss via analysis of LLMs and toy residual networks. We find loss scales inversely proportional to depth in LLMs, probably due to functionally similar layers reducing error through ensemble averaging rather than compositional learning or discretizing smooth dynamics. This regime is inefficient yet robust and may arise from the architectural bias of residual networks and target functions incompatible with smooth dynamics. The findings suggest that improving LLM efficiency may require architectural innovations to encourage compositional use of depth.

</details>


### [942] [Can Vision Language Models Learn Intuitive Physics from Interaction?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.06033)
*Luca M. Schulze Buschoff,Konstantinos Voudouris,Can Demircan,Eric Schulz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过强化学习与环境交互训练的视觉语言模型虽然能提升特定任务表现，但无法学习到可泛化的物理直觉，在不同任务间表现不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练的视觉语言模型缺乏对物理世界的直观理解，先前有监督微调方法无法让模型学到可泛化的物理规则，受认知科学启发，假设模型需要与环境交互才能学习物理动态。

Method: 在模拟环境中使用强化学习训练模型，通过与环境的交互来学习物理动态。

Result: 交互学习能提升模型在任务内的表现；但模型无法在相关任务间可靠地泛化，即使这些任务共享视觉统计特征和物理原理，且无论模型是否通过交互训练。

Conclusion: 仅通过与模拟环境交互的强化学习不足以让视觉语言模型获得可泛化的物理直觉，模型未能学到鲁棒的物理规则。

Abstract: Pre-trained vision language models do not have good intuitions about the physical world. Recent work has shown that supervised fine-tuning can improve model performance on simple physical tasks. However, fine-tuned models do not appear to learn robust physical rules that can generalize to new contexts. Based on research in cognitive science, we hypothesize that models need to interact with an environment to properly learn its physical dynamics. We train models that learn through interaction with a simulated environment using reinforcement learning. While learning from interaction allows models to improve their within-task performance, it fails to produce models with generalizable physical intuitions. We find that models trained on one task do not reliably generalize to related tasks, even if the tasks share visual statistics and physical principles, and regardless of whether the models are trained through interaction.

</details>


### [943] [Tempora: Characterising the Time-Contingent Utility of Online Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.06136)
*Sudarshan Sreeram,Young D. Kwon,Cecilia Mascolo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Tempora 提出了一个评估测试时自适应（TTA）方法在时间压力下表现的框架，通过三种时间效用度量（离散效用、连续效用、摊销效用）来量化准确率-延迟权衡。对11种TTA方法的750+实验表明，传统排名无法预测时间压力下的排名，最高效用方法随数据偏移和时间压力变化，无明确胜者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TTA评估不切实际地假设无限处理时间，忽视了准确率-延迟权衡。随着ML部署于延迟敏感场景，时间压力使适应性推理的可行性受限，过晚的预测毫无价值。

Method: 提出Tempora框架，包含：(1) 时间场景（模拟部署约束），(2) 评估协议（可操作化测量），(3) 时间条件效用度量：离散效用（异步流+硬截止时间）、连续效用（交互式+延迟衰减）、摊销效用（预算约束）。对11种TTA方法在750+时间评估下进行系统性比较。

Result: 传统排名无法预测时间压力下的排名；最高效用方法随数据偏移和时间压力变化，无明确胜者；排名不稳定性在多种数据集、模型和硬件平台上持续存在。

Conclusion: Tempora首次实现了跨不同时间约束的系统性评估，揭示排名变化的原因，为实践者提供方法选择视角，为研究者提供可部署适应的目标。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a compelling remedy for machine learning (ML) models that degrade under domain shifts, improving generalisation on-the-fly with only unlabelled samples. This flexibility suits real deployments, yet conventional evaluations unrealistically assume unbounded processing time, overlooking the accuracy-latency trade-off. As ML increasingly underpins latency-sensitive and user-facing use-cases, temporal pressure constrains the viability of adaptable inference; predictions arriving too late to act on are futile. We introduce Tempora, a framework for evaluating TTA under this pressure. It consists of temporal scenarios that model deployment constraints, evaluation protocols that operationalise measurement, and time-contingent utility metrics that quantify the accuracy-latency trade-off. We instantiate the framework with three such metrics: (1) discrete utility for asynchronous streams with hard deadlines, (2) continuous utility for interactive settings where value decays with latency, and (3) amortised utility for budget-constrained deployments. By applying Tempora to 11 TTA methods, we find that rank instability persists across 750+ temporal evaluations spanning diverse datasets, models, and hardware platforms; i.e., conventional rankings do not predict rankings under temporal pressure. The highest-utility method varies with the shift and temporal pressure, with no clear winner. By enabling systematic evaluation across diverse temporal constraints for the first time, Tempora reveals when and why rankings change, offering practitioners a lens for method selection and researchers a target for deployable adaptation. Code: https://github.com/sudotensor/tempora.

</details>


### [944] [Principle-Evolvable Scientific Discovery via Uncertainty Minimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.06448)
*Yingming Pu,Tao Lin,Hongyu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PiEvo提出了一种原则可演化的科学发现框架，将科学发现视为在扩展的原则空间上的贝叶斯优化，通过信息导向假设选择和异常驱动增强机制，使智能体能够自主完善理论世界观，在四个基准上平均解决方案质量达90.81%~93.15%，比SOTA提升29.7%~31.1%，收敛速度提升83.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的科学智能体因固守初始先验而导致效率低下，方法仅在静态假设空间内运行，限制了新现象的发现，并在基线理论失效时造成计算浪费。

Method: 提出PiEvo框架，将科学发现视为在扩展原则空间上的贝叶斯优化。核心包括：(1) 通过高斯过程进行信息导向假设选择；(2) 异常驱动增强机制，使智能体自主完善理论世界观。

Result: (1) 平均解决方案质量达90.81%~93.15%，比SOTA提升29.7%~31.1%；(2) 收敛步骤加速83.3%，样本复杂度显著降低；(3) 在不同科学领域和LLM骨干下保持鲁棒性能。

Conclusion: PiEvo通过从搜索假设转向演化科学原则，有效解决了静态假设空间的限制，提升了科学发现的效率和效果。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based scientific agents have accelerated scientific discovery, yet they often suffer from significant inefficiencies due to adherence to fixed initial priors. Existing approaches predominantly operate within a static hypothesis space, which restricts the discovery of novel phenomena, resulting in computational waste when baseline theories fail. To address this, we propose shifting the focus from searching hypotheses to evolving the underlying scientific principles. We present PiEvo, a principle-evolvable framework that treats scientific discovery as Bayesian optimization over an expanding principle space. By integrating Information-Directed Hypothesis Selection via Gaussian Process and an anomaly-driven augmentation mechanism, PiEvo enables agents to autonomously refine their theoretical worldview. Evaluation across four benchmarks demonstrates that PiEvo (1) achieves an average solution quality of up to 90.81%~93.15%, representing a 29.7%~31.1% improvement over the state-of-the-art, (2) attains an 83.3% speedup in convergence step via significantly reduced sample complexity by optimizing the compact principle space, and (3) maintains robust performance across diverse scientific domains and LLM backbones. Code is publicly available at \hyperlink{https://github.com/amair-lab/PiEvo}{github.com/amair-lab/PiEvo}.

</details>


### [945] [Sharpness-Aware Hybrid Model Learning for Architecture-Agnostic Parameter Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.06837)
*Naoya Takeishi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种架构无关的混合建模方法，通过锐度感知最小化(SAM)实现科学参数的正确估计，防止机器学习模型主导预测而忽略科学模型部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合模型中机器学习部分的灵活性可能导致科学模型部分被有效忽略，使其未知参数无法被正确估计。传统正则化方法依赖模型架构和领域知识，缺乏通用性。

Method: 基于奥卡姆剃刀原则，利用损失极小值的平坦性（flatness）实现模型简洁性。将锐度感知最小化（SAM）思想适配到混合建模场景中，使科学参数能够被正确学习。

Result: 数值实验证明基于SAM的混合模型学习方法能有效估计科学参数。

Conclusion: 提出了一种架构无关的通用方法，通过平坦极小值正则化解决了混合模型中科学参数估计困难的问题，为混合建模提供了新的训练范式。

Abstract: Hybrid modeling, the combination of machine learning models and scientific mathematical models, enables flexible and robust data-driven prediction with partial interpretability. However, the unknown parameters of the scientific model cannot necessarily be estimated properly, since the flexibility of the machine learning model might make the scientific model part effectively ignored in prediction. We may avoid it by applying some regularization, but the formulation of such regularizers typically depends on model architectures and domain knowledge. In this paper, we propose an architecture-agnostic method to learn hybrid models while properly estimating the scientific parameters. The idea is to use the flatness of loss minima to achieve model simplicity, based upon the Occam's razor principle. We employ the idea of sharpness-aware minimization and adapt it to the hybrid modeling setting. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the SAM-based hybrid model learning for scientific parameter estimation.

</details>


### [946] [Collaborative and Efficient Fine-tuning: Leveraging Task Similarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07218)
*Gagik Magakyan,Amirhossein Reisizadeh,Chanwoo Park,Pablo A. Parrilo,Asuman Ozdaglar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CoLoRA是一种利用任务相似性进行协作式参数高效微调的方法，通过共享适配器和个性化适配器来缓解数据稀缺问题，在理论和实验上均证明了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型微调面临标注数据稀缺问题，现有参数高效微调方法（如LoRA）依赖高质量但稀缺的任务数据。为缓解数据稀缺，论文提出利用多个下游用户之间的任务相似性，使得相似任务的用户能够相互辅助，扩大有效微调数据规模。

Method: 提出Collaborative Low-Rank Adaptation (CoLoRA)，训练一个捕获所有任务间底层相似性的共享适配器，以及针对每个用户特定任务的个性化适配器。在异构线性回归上给出理论保证，并进行自然语言实验验证。

Result: 在异构线性回归上证明了CoLoRA能够实现真实参数的恢复；在自然语言实验中，当相似任务共同训练时，个体性能显著提升。

Conclusion: CoLoRA通过协作式低秩适配有效利用任务相似性缓解数据稀缺，能够提升个性化基础模型微调的性能，理论和实验共同验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Adaptability has been regarded as a central feature in the foundation models, enabling them to effectively acclimate to unseen downstream tasks. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as celebrated LoRA facilitate efficient adaptation of large foundation models using labeled, high-quality and generally scarce task data. To mitigate data scarcity in fine-tuning of foundation models, we propose to leverage task similarity across multiple downstream users. Intuitively, users with similar tasks must be able to assist each other in boosting the effective fine-tuning data size. We propose Collaborative Low-Rank Adaptation, or CoLoRA, which exploits task similarity to collaboratively and efficiently fine-tune personalized foundation models. The main idea in CoLoRA is to train one shared adapter capturing underlying task similarities across all tasks, and personalized adapters tailored to user-specific tasks. We theoretically study CoLoRA on heterogeneous linear regression and provide provable guarantees for ground truth recovery. We also conduct several natural language experiments with varying task similarity, which further demonstrate that when trained together with similar tasks, individual performances are significantly boosted.

</details>


### [947] [Vegas: Self-Speculative Decoding with Verification-Guided Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07223)
*Yikang Yue,Yuqi Xue,Jian Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Vegas是一种基于验证引导的稀疏注意力的自推测解码方法，通过利用验证过程中自然计算出的KV条目关键性来选择稀疏注意力子集，从而提升长上下文LLM推理的吞吐量，相比vLLM实现1.25-2.81倍加速，相比现有稀疏注意力自推测解码方法实现1.15-1.29倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM推理中KV缓存的内存需求快速增长，成为瓶颈。现有自推测解码方法依赖独立的KV选择算法来选择用于草稿的KV条目，忽略了验证过程中已自然计算出的每个KV条目的关键性，导致额外的选择开销且降低了草稿令牌接受率。

Method: Vegas提出验证引导的稀疏注意力机制：在验证阶段计算每个KV条目的关键性作为副产品，并利用这些关键性信息指导后续草稿令牌生成时只对关键KV条目计算注意力。该方法无需独立的KV选择算法，降低了选择开销，同时提高了草稿令牌的接受率。

Result: Vegas在解码吞吐量上相比默认vLLM实现1.25×-2.81×加速，相比最先进的基于稀疏注意力的自推测解码方法实现1.15×-1.29×加速。

Conclusion: Vegas通过验证引导的稀疏注意力有效提升了自推测解码的吞吐量，验证了利用验证过程中自然产生的关键性信息来指导稀疏注意力选择的可行性。

Abstract: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference has become the norm for today's AI applications. However, it is severely bottlenecked by the increasing memory demands of its KV cache. Previous works have shown that self-speculative decoding with sparse attention, where tokens are drafted using a subset of the KV cache and verified in parallel against the full KV cache, speeds up inference in a lossless manner. However, they rely on a standalone KV selection algorithm to select the KV entries used for drafting and overlook the fact that the criticality of each KV entry is inherently computed during verification. In this paper, we propose Vegas, a self-speculative decoding method with verification-guided sparse attention. Vegas identifies critical KV cache entries as a byproduct of verification and computes attention only over these entries when drafting subsequent tokens. This not only improves the draft token acceptance rate but also incurs low KV selection overhead, thereby improving decoding throughput. Vegas achieves a 1.25$\times$-2.81$\times$ speedup in decoding throughput over default vLLM and a 1.15$\times$-1.29$\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art sparse attention-based self-speculative decoding methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/platformxlab/vegas.

</details>


### [948] [Controllable Value Alignment in Large Language Models through Neuron-Level Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.07356)
*Yonghui Yang,Yihui Wang,Junwei Li,Jilong Liu,Fengbin Zhu,Weibiao Huang,Le Wu,Richang Hong,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出价值泄漏（value leakage）概念来刻画LLM价值对齐中非目标价值的意外激活问题，并设计了一种基于神经元级别激活编辑的框架NeVA，通过识别稀疏的价值相关神经元并在推理时进行编辑，实现了更可控的价值对齐，同时减少了价值泄漏和对通用能力的损害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于steering的LLM价值对齐方法存在可控性不足的问题：操控某个目标价值时往往会意外激活其他非目标价值。论文旨在刻画并解决这一局限性。

Method: 提出NeVA（Neuron-level Value Alignment）框架，核心步骤包括：(1) 识别稀疏的、与特定价值相关的神经元；(2) 在推理时对这些神经元进行激活编辑（activation editing），无需参数更新或重新训练。

Result: 实验表明NeVA在实现更强目标价值对齐的同时，对通用能力的性能下降更小；显著降低了平均价值泄漏，且残余泄漏主要局限于语义相关的价值类别。

Conclusion: NeVA提供了一种更可控、更具可解释性的价值对齐机制，在可控性和透明度上优于现有方法。

Abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values has become increasingly important as their influence on human behavior and decision-making expands. However, existing steering-based alignment methods suffer from limited controllability: steering a target value often unintentionally activates other, non-target values. To characterize this limitation, we introduce value leakage, a diagnostic notion that captures the unintended activation of non-target values during value steering, along with a normalized leakage metric grounded in Schwartz's value theory. In light of this analysis, we propose NeVA, a neuron-level editing framework for controllable value alignment in LLMs. NeVA identifies sparse, value-relevant neurons and performs inference-time activation editing, enabling fine-grained control without parameter updates or retraining. Experiments show that NeVA achieves stronger target value alignment while incurring smaller performance degradation on general capability. Moreover, NeVA significantly reduces the average leakage, with residual effects largely confined to semantically related value classes. Overall, NeVA offers a more controllable and interpretable mechanism for value alignment.

</details>


### [949] [Predicting Future Utility: Global Combinatorial Optimization for Task-Agnostic KV Cache Eviction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08585)
*Ziyao Tang,Pengkun Jiao,Xinhang Chen,Wei Liu,Shiyong Li,Jingjing Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LU-KV框架，通过将注意力头的预算分配建模为全局组合优化问题，最大化保留令牌的长期边际贡献，在LongBench和RULER上实现80% KV缓存压缩且性能损失极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KV缓存淘汰方法依赖瞬时启发式指标，假设所有注意力头的分数幅度重要性一致，忽视了不同头在预测保真度上的异质性——某些头关注即时贡献，另一些头捕捉长期效用。

Method: 将头级预算分配建模为最大化长期边际贡献的全局组合优化问题；采用凸包松弛和基于边际效用的贪心求解器获得近似最优解；实现数据驱动的离线分析协议以支持实际部署。

Result: 在LongBench和RULER基准上，LU-KV将KV缓存大小减少80%且性能下降极小，同时降低了推理延迟和GPU内存占用。

Conclusion: 最优预算分配应由保留长期语义信息的边际效用决定，而非各头统一的即时重要性指标。

Abstract: Given the quadratic complexity of attention, KV cache eviction is vital to accelerate model inference. Current KV cache eviction methods typically rely on instantaneous heuristic metrics, implicitly assuming that score magnitudes are consistent proxies for importance across all heads. However, this overlooks the heterogeneity in predictive fidelity across attention heads. While certain heads prioritize the instantaneous contribution of tokens, others are dedicated to capturing long-horizon utility. In this paper, we propose that optimal budget allocation should be governed by the marginal utility in preserving long-term semantic information.
