Building on this insight, we propose LU-KV, a novel framework that formulates head-level budget allocation as a global combinatorial optimization problem to maximize the long-horizon marginal contribution of reserved tokens. To solve this non-convex problem, we employ a convex-hull relaxation and a marginal-utility-based greedy solver, achieving near-optimal solutions. Furthermore, we implement a data-driven offline profiling protocol to facilitate the practical deployment of LU-KV. Evaluations on LongBench and RULER benchmarks demonstrate that LU-KV reduces KV cache size by 80% with minimal performance degradation, while also decreasing inference latency and GPU memory footprint.

</details>


### [950] [Gradient Preconditioning for Efficient and Reliable Reward-Guided Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08646)
*Jisung Hwang,Minhyuk Sung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种梯度预处理方法，通过将奖励梯度投影到精心设计的白高斯噪声可行集上，使单步生成模型的奖励引导生成既高效又可靠，在FLUX模型上仅用30%时间就达到可比的美学分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时噪声优化能解锁更优的奖励引导生成，但容易引发奖励黑客问题（降低生成质量）且速度过慢，不适合实际使用。

Method: 将奖励梯度投影到一个紧凑的谱集上（具有分块范数约束），该集合紧密捕捉白高斯噪声的统计特性和空间不相关性。投影具有闭式解，计算复杂度为O(N log N)，与FFT相当。

Result: 在FLUX模型上结合四种奖励模型，该方法仅用最先进正则化方法30%的墙钟时间就达到了可比的美学分数。

Conclusion: 该预处理方法将每次梯度更新重塑为噪声对齐方向，实现更快更有效的奖励上升，同时防止奖励黑客问题。

Abstract: We propose a gradient preconditioning method that makes reward-guided generation with one-step generative models both efficient and reliable. Test-time noise optimization can unlock substantially better reward-guided generations from pretrained generative models, but it is prone to reward hacking that degrades quality and is often too slow for practical use. We precondition reward gradients by projecting them onto a carefully designed white Gaussian noise feasible set, a compact spectral set with blockwise norm constraints that tightly captures the statistics and spatial uncorrelatedness of white Gaussian noise. This preconditioning reshapes each gradient update into a noise-aligned direction, driving faster and more effective reward ascent while preventing reward hacking. The projection is closed-form and matches the $O(N \log N)$ complexity of FFT, adding negligible overhead in practice. In experiments on FLUX with four reward models, our approach reaches a comparable Aesthetic Score using only 30% of the wall-clock time required by the state-of-the-art regularization-based method.

</details>


### [951] [Learning To Sample From Diffusion Models Via Inverse Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08689)
*Constant Bourdrez,Alexandre Vérine,Olivier Cappé*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于逆强化学习的框架，用于学习扩散模型的采样策略（如噪声调度、引导尺度、随机性配置），无需重新训练去噪器。通过将采样过程建模为离散时间有限视野马尔可夫决策过程，并利用策略梯度方法直接匹配目标采样行为，在ImageNet-64上以9倍更低的搜索成本实现了与精细调优采样器相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型的采样过程（包括噪声调度、引导尺度、随机性配置等）需要精细调优，传统方法依赖昂贵的人工网格搜索，成本高昂且效率低下。

Method: 将扩散采样过程建模为离散时间有限视野MDP，动作对应采样动力学的可选修改；采用逆强化学习框架，避免定义显式奖励函数，而是通过策略梯度方法直接匹配采样器期望的目标行为来优化动作调度。

Result: 在ImageNet-64上，单次训练即可替代穷举搜索，搜索成本降低9倍，推理时仅增加16%的计算开销。

Conclusion: 该逆强化学习框架能够在无需重新训练去噪器的情况下学习有效的采样策略，以较低成本匹配精心调优的采样器效果，为扩散模型采样自动化调优提供了新思路。

Abstract: Diffusion models generate samples through an iterative denoising process guided by a pretrained neural network. Once the denoiser is fixed, the sampling algorithm itself (noise schedules, guidance scales, stochasticity profiles) still requires careful tuning, a process typically carried out through costly empirical grid search. In this work, we introduce an inverse reinforcement learning framework for learning sampling strategies without retraining the denoiser. We formulate the diffusion sampling procedure as a discrete-time finite-horizon Markov Decision Process, where actions correspond to optional modifications of the sampling dynamics. To optimize action scheduling, we avoid defining an explicit reward function and instead directly match the target behavior expected from the sampler using policy gradient techniques. We provide experimental evidence that this approach matches fine-tuned samplers and comes at a modest cost compared to grid search: on ImageNet-64, a single training run replaces exhaustive search at up to 9x lower cost, with only 16% overhead at inference.

</details>


### [952] [AnomSeer: Reinforcing Multimodal LLMs to Reason for Time-Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08868)
*Junru Zhang,Lang Feng,Haoran Shi,Xu Guo,Han Yu,Yabo Dong,Duanqing Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AnomSeer利用多模态大模型进行时间序列异常检测，通过专家思维链推理和基于最优传输的时间序列接地策略优化（TimerPO），在分类、定位和解释上优于GPT-4o等更大基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM在时间序列异常检测中依赖粗粒度启发式策略，缺乏多维、细粒度的结构化推理能力，难以理解复杂时间序列数据的细节。

Method: 提出AnomSeer框架，核心包括：(1) 专家链式思维轨迹生成，从统计分析、频率变换等经典方法中产生可验证的细粒度推理；(2) 时间序列接地策略优化（TimerPO），在标准强化学习基础上引入基于最优传输的时间序列接地优势项和正交投影约束，确保辅助细粒度信号不干扰主检测目标。

Result: 在多种异常场景下，基于Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B-Instruct的AnomSeer在分类和定位精度上超越GPT-4o等更大商业模型，尤其在点驱动和频率驱动的异常上表现突出，并能生成合理的推理轨迹。

Conclusion: 通过将模型推理锚定于时间序列的精确结构细节，并设计专用策略优化方法，可显著提升MLLM在时间序列异常检测中的细粒度推理能力，实现分类、定位与解释的统一。

Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is an emerging area, yet a persistent challenge remains: MLLMs rely on coarse time-series heuristics but struggle with multi-dimensional, detailed reasoning, which is vital for understanding complex time-series data. We present AnomSeer to address this by reinforcing the model to ground its reasoning in precise, structural details of time series, unifying anomaly classification, localization, and explanation. At its core, an expert chain-of-thought trace is generated to provide a verifiable, fine-grained reasoning from classical analyses (e.g., statistical measures, frequency transforms). Building on this, we propose a novel time-series grounded policy optimization (TimerPO) that incorporates two additional components beyond standard reinforcement learning: a time-series grounded advantage based on optimal transport and an orthogonal projection to ensure this auxiliary granular signal does not interfere with the primary detection objective. Across diverse anomaly scenarios, AnomSeer, with Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B-Instruct, outperforms larger commercial baselines (e.g., GPT-4o) in classification and localization accuracy, particularly on point- and frequency-driven exceptions. Moreover, it produces plausible time-series reasoning traces that support its conclusions.

</details>


### [953] [Learning to Remember, Learn, and Forget in Attention-Based Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09075)
*Djohan Bonnet,Jamie Lohoff,Jan Finkbeiner,Elidona Skhikerujah,Emre Neftci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Palimpsa提出了一种将上下文学习视为持续学习问题的自注意力模型，通过贝叶斯元可塑性（Bayesian metaplasticity）来应对稳定性-可塑性困境，显著扩展了记忆容量，并在MQAR和常识推理任务上持续优于基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在门控线性注意力模型中，ICL的联想记忆容量固定且易受干扰（尤其对于长序列），现有方法未能有效解决稳定性-可塑性困境。

Method: 提出Palimpsa模型：将ICL建模为持续学习问题，利用贝叶斯元可塑性机制，使每个注意力状态的可塑性与由先验分布（捕获累积知识）驱动的重要性状态绑定，从而在记忆稳定性和可塑性之间取得平衡。

Result: 各种门控线性注意力模型可视为Palimpsa的特定架构选择和后验近似；Mamba2是其中遗忘主导的特例；将非元可塑性模型转化为元可塑性模型可显著扩展记忆容量；在MQAR基准和常识推理任务上持续优于基线。

Conclusion: Palimpsa通过贝叶斯元可塑性有效解决了ICL中的记忆干扰问题，建立了与现有门控线性注意力模型的理论联系，并证明了元可塑性机制对扩展记忆容量的有效性。

Abstract: In-Context Learning (ICL) in transformers acts as an online associative memory and is believed to underpin their high performance on complex sequence processing tasks. However, in gated linear attention models, this memory has a fixed capacity and is prone to interference, especially for long sequences. We propose Palimpsa, a self-attention model that views ICL as a continual learning problem that must address a stability-plasticity dilemma. Palimpsa uses Bayesian metaplasticity, where the plasticity of each attention state is tied to an importance state grounded by a prior distribution that captures accumulated knowledge. We demonstrate that various gated linear attention models emerge as specific architecture choices and posterior approximations, and that Mamba2 is a special case of Palimpsa where forgetting dominates. This theoretical link enables the transformation of any non-metaplastic model into a metaplastic one, significantly expanding its memory capacity. Our experiments show that Palimpsa consistently outperforms baselines on the Multi-Query Associative Recall (MQAR) benchmark and on Commonsense Reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [954] [Online Learning in MDPs with Partially Adversarial Transitions and Losses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09474)
*Ofir Schlisselberg,Tal Lancewicki,Yishay Mansour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了一种混合型MDP，其转移函数在大部分步骤随机、但在每轮固定的Λ个步骤可能对抗。作者引入“条件占优测度”来设计两种算法，分别处理任意和连续的对抗步骤，并给出了几乎紧的上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实环境中，大多数步骤是稳定的（随机），但少数关键点可能受到对抗干扰（如系统漏洞）。现有RL理论或假设完全随机，或假设完全对抗，无法捕捉这种“局部脆弱”的场景。作者希望建模并解决这种混合型MDP中的强化学习问题。

Method: 1) 引入“条件占优测度”（conditioned occupancy measures），它在对抗步骤下仍能跨回合保持稳定。2) 基于此设计两种算法：第一种处理任意位置的Λ个对抗步骤，获得regret $\tilde{O}(H S^Λ\sqrt{K S A^{Λ+1}})$；第二种针对对抗步骤连续的情况，将S的依赖改进为$\tilde{O}(H\sqrt{K S^{3} A^{Λ+1}})$。3) 给出$K^{2/3}$-regret的归约方法，无需知道哪些步骤是对抗的。4) 在完全对抗设置（Λ=H-1）下，分别针对全信息和bandit反馈刻画了regret，给出几乎匹配的上下界。

Result: 提出了两种算法及其regret界，并在完全对抗设置下给出了接近紧的上下界（略微加强了现有下界，澄清了不同反馈结构对学习难度的影响）。

Conclusion: 混合随机-对抗MDP是可学习的，条件占优测度是处理局部对抗性的有效工具。完全对抗情形下的界限几乎紧，且反馈结构显著影响学习难度。

Abstract: We study reinforcement learning in MDPs whose transition function is stochastic at most steps but may behave adversarially at a fixed subset of $Λ$ steps per episode. This model captures environments that are stable except at a few vulnerable points. We introduce \emph{conditioned occupancy measures}, which remain stable across episodes even with adversarial transitions, and use them to design two algorithms. The first handles arbitrary adversarial steps and achieves regret $\tilde{O}(H S^Λ\sqrt{K S A^{Λ+1}})$, where $K$ is the number of episodes, $S$ is the number of state, $A$ is the number of actions and $H$ is the episode's horizon. The second, assuming the adversarial steps are consecutive, improves the dependence on $S$ to $\tilde{O}(H\sqrt{K S^{3} A^{Λ+1}})$. We further give a $K^{2/3}$-regret reduction that removes the need to know which steps are the $Λ$ adversarial steps. We also characterize the regret of adversarial MDPs in the \emph{fully adversarial} setting ($Λ=H-1$) both for full-information and bandit feedback, and provide almost matching upper and lower bounds (slightly strengthen existing lower bounds, and clarify how different feedback structures affect the hardness of learning).

</details>


### [955] [Beware of the Batch Size: Hyperparameter Bias in Evaluating LoRA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09492)
*Sangyoon Lee,Jaeho Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现批次大小是影响LoRA及其变体性能的关键因素，当批次大小经过适当调优后，标准LoRA通常能达到与更复杂变体相当的性能，并提出了基于代理的成本高效批次大小调优策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA的众多变体在相同基准上报告了相互矛盾的实验结果，现有研究忽视了批次大小这一关键因素导致结论不一致，亟需厘清真正的性能差异来源。

Method: 通过系统性实验验证批次大小对LoRA性能的主导影响，并提出了一种基于代理的成本高效批次大小调优策略，同时研究了秩、数据集大小和模型容量对最优批次大小的影响。

Result: 适当调优批次大小后，标准LoRA的性能与更复杂的变体相当；批次大小应从次要实现细节提升为一阶设计参数。

Conclusion: 批次大小是LoRA变体性能差异的主要来源，未来对LoRA变体的评估应将批次大小作为关键设计参数进行规范调优，以确保结论的可靠性。

Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is a standard approach for fine-tuning large language models, yet its many variants report conflicting empirical gains, often on the same benchmarks. We show that these contradictions arise from a single overlooked factor: the batch size. When properly tuned, vanilla LoRA often matches the performance of more complex variants. We further propose a proxy-based, cost-efficient strategy for batch size tuning, revealing the impact of rank, dataset size, and model capacity on the optimal batch size. Our findings elevate batch size from a minor implementation detail to a first-order design parameter, reconciling prior inconsistencies and enabling more reliable evaluations of LoRA variants.

</details>


### [956] [A Task-Centric Theory for Iterative Self-Improvement with Easy-to-Hard Curricula](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10014)
*Chenruo Liu,Yijun Dong,Yiqiu Shen,Qi Lei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文建立了自举式大语言模型自我改进的理论框架，证明了奖励过滤下的最大似然微调能实现持续改进但最终会饱和，并揭示了易到难课程训练相比固定混合训练具有更优的理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管迭代自我改进方法在经验上取得了显著成功，但其在有限样本设定下的理论基础仍然薄弱，缺乏对收敛性、饱和机制以及课程学习策略的理论分析。

Method: 将每轮自我改进建模为对奖励过滤后的分布进行最大似然微调，推导期望奖励的有限样本保证；采用任务中心视角，考虑多难度推理任务，证明易到难课程训练的量化条件。

Result: 发现了显式反馈循环：更好的模型每轮接受更多数据，支持持续改进但最终饱和；证明了在模型初始化、任务难度和样本预算的量化条件下，易到难课程训练优于固定混合训练。通过蒙特卡洛模拟、合成图推理任务和标准数学推理基准验证了分析结论。

Conclusion: 成功建立了自我改进过程的理论基础，揭示了其持续改进与饱和的内在机制，并给出了课程学习策略的理论优越性条件，为实际应用提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Iterative self-improvement fine-tunes an autoregressive large language model (LLM) on reward-verified outputs generated by the LLM itself. In contrast to the empirical success of self-improvement, the theoretical foundation of this generative, iterative procedure in a practical, finite-sample setting remains limited. We make progress toward this goal by modeling each round of self-improvement as maximum-likelihood fine-tuning on a reward-filtered distribution and deriving finite-sample guarantees for the expected reward. Our analysis reveals an explicit feedback loop where better models accept more data per iteration, supporting sustained self-improvement while explaining eventual saturation of such improvement. Adopting a task-centric view by considering reasoning tasks with multiple difficulty levels, we further prove quantifiable conditions on model initialization, task difficulty, and sample budget where easy-to-hard curricula provably achieve better guarantees than training on fixed mixtures of tasks. Our analyses are validated through Monte-Carlo simulations and experiments spanning a synthetic graph-based reasoning task and multiple standard mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [957] [WildCat: Near-Linear Attention in Theory and Practice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10056)
*Tobias Schröder,Lester Mackey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WildCat是一种通过随机枢轴Cholesky算法选择加权核心集来近似注意力机制的方法，在保持超多项式误差衰减的同时实现近线性时间复杂度，并在图像生成、分类和语言模型KV缓存压缩任务中验证了效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准注意力机制的计算和内存需求随输入序列长度n呈二次方增长，这严重限制了其在长序列任务中的部署。现有近似方法要么缺乏误差保证，要么需要二次方运行时间才能保证高保真度。

Method: WildCat通过随机枢轴Cholesky算法快速且谱精确地选择一个小型加权核心集（coreset），仅对该核心集施加注意力机制，并以最小化重构误差的方式对核心集元素进行最优加权。

Result: 在有界输入下，WildCat能以超多项式误差衰减率O(n^{-√(log(log(n)))})近似精确注意力，同时运行时间仅为近线性O(n^{1+o(1)})。在图像生成、图像分类和语言模型KV缓存压缩等基准实验中取得了良好效果。

Conclusion: WildCat实现了高精度与低成本的兼顾，为注意力机制的高效近似提供了理论保证和实用方案，GPU优化实现进一步增强了其实用性。

Abstract: We introduce WildCat, a high-accuracy, low-cost approach to compressing the attention mechanism in neural networks. While attention is a staple of modern network architectures, it is also notoriously expensive to deploy due to resource requirements that scale quadratically with the input sequence length $n$. WildCat avoids these quadratic costs by only attending over a small weighted coreset. Crucially, we select the coreset using a fast but spectrally-accurate subsampling algorithm -- randomly pivoted Cholesky -- and weight the elements optimally to minimise reconstruction error. Remarkably, given bounded inputs, WildCat approximates exact attention with super-polynomial $O(n^{-\sqrt{\log(\log(n))}})$ error decay while running in near-linear $O(n^{1+o(1)})$ time. In contrast, prior practical approximations either lack error guarantees or require quadratic runtime to guarantee such high fidelity. We couple this advance with a GPU-optimized PyTorch implementation and a suite of benchmark experiments demonstrating the benefits of WildCat for image generation, image classification, and language model KV cache compression.

</details>


### [958] [Mitigating Reward Hacking in RLHF via Bayesian Non-negative Reward Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10623)
*Zhibin Duan,Guowei Rong,Zhuo Li,Bo Chen,Mingyuan Zhou,Dandan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BNRM框架，通过贝叶斯非负因子分析与Bradley-Terry偏好模型结合，实现解耦-去偏的鲁棒奖励学习，有效缓解奖励黑客攻击并提升可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类偏好学习的奖励模型容易因噪声标注和系统性偏差（如长度、风格）导致奖励黑客攻击，现有方法缺乏对奖励的鲁棒解耦和隐式去偏机制。

Method: 将非负因子分析融入Bradley-Terry模型，构建两层生成过程：实例级潜变量实现奖励解耦，全局因子稀疏性作为隐式去偏机制；并设计基于深度表示的条件变分推理网络实现端到端训练。

Result: 实验表明BNRM显著缓解奖励过度优化，提升分布偏移下的鲁棒性，并生成比强基线更可解释的奖励分解。

Conclusion: BNRM通过解耦-去偏的贝叶斯框架有效解决了奖励模型的不鲁棒问题，兼顾了不确定性建模与可解释性。

Abstract: Reward models learned from human preferences are central to aligning large language models (LLMs) via reinforcement learning from human feedback, yet they are often vulnerable to reward hacking due to noisy annotations and systematic biases such as response length or style. We propose Bayesian Non-Negative Reward Model (BNRM), a principled reward modeling framework that integrates non-negative factor analysis into Bradley-Terry (BT) preference model. BNRM represents rewards through a sparse, non-negative latent factor generative process that operates at two complementary levels: instance-specific latent variables induce disentangled reward representations, while sparsity over global latent factors acts as an implicit debiasing mechanism that suppresses spurious correlations. Together, this disentanglement-then-debiasing structure enables robust uncertainty-aware reward learning. To scale BNRM to modern LLMs, we develop an amortized variational inference network conditioned on deep model representations, allowing efficient end-to-end training. Extensive empirical results demonstrate that BNRM substantially mitigates reward over-optimization, improves robustness under distribution shifts, and yields more interpretable reward decompositions than strong baselines.

</details>


### [959] [Both Topology and Text Matter: Revisiting LLM-guided Out-of-Distribution Detection on Text-attributed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11641)
*Yinlin Zhu,Di Wu,Xu Wang,Guocong Quan,Miao Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LG-Plug，一种基于LLM引导的即插即用框架，通过对齐拓扑与文本表示、聚类迭代提示生成伪OOD样本，在不依赖专用架构的前提下提升TAG上的OOD检测性能，在六个基准上降低FPR95超过5-7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有拓扑驱动方法将文本编码为浅层特征，语义信息利用不充分；LLM方法虽能生成伪OOD先验，但存在可靠性与信息量的权衡（生成样本或偏离真实OOD语义，或引入大量ID噪声），且依赖专用架构，难以兼容已有拓扑级方法。

Method: (1) 对齐拓扑与文本表示获得细粒度节点嵌入；(2) 通过聚类迭代LLM提示构建共识驱动的OOD暴露样本；(3) 引入轻量级簇内码本和启发式采样降低LLM查询成本；(4) 生成的OOD暴露作为正则化项，分离ID和OOD节点，可无缝集成现有检测器。

Result: 在六个TAG基准数据集上，LG-Plug一致提升了拓扑驱动OOD检测器的性能（FPR95降低>7%），并超越了先前基于LLM的方法（FPR95降低>5%）。

Conclusion: LG-Plug通过LLM引导的即插即用框架，有效解决了TAG上OOD检测中语义利用不足与架构兼容性问题，在保持与现有方法兼容的同时显著提升了检测性能。

Abstract: Text-attributed graphs (TAGs) associate nodes with textual attributes and graph structure, enabling GNNs to jointly model semantic and structural information. Although effective on in-distribution (ID) data, GNNs often fail on out-of-distribution (OOD) nodes with unseen textual or structural patterns, producing overconfident predictions without reliable OOD detection. Existing topology-driven methods mitigate node-level bias through neighboring structures, but typically encode texts as shallow features, underutilizing semantic information. Recent LLM-based approaches instead synthesize pseudo OOD priors from textual knowledge, yet suffer from two key limitations: (1) a trade-off between reliability and informativeness, where generated OOD exposures either deviate from true OOD semantics or introduce substantial ID noise; and (2) dependence on specialized architectures, limiting compatibility with topology-level advances validated in prior work. To address these issues, we propose LG-Plug, an LLM-Guided Plug-and-play framework for TAG OOD detection. LG-Plug aligns topology and text representations to obtain fine-grained node embeddings, then constructs consensus-driven OOD exposure through clustered iterative LLM prompting. To reduce LLM query cost, it further adopts lightweight in-cluster codebooks and heuristic sampling. The generated OOD exposure acts as a regularizer that separates ID and OOD nodes, enabling seamless integration with existing detectors. Experiments on six TAG benchmarks demonstrate that LG-Plug consistently improves topology-driven OOD detectors (>7% FPR95 reduction) and surpasses prior LLM-based methods (>5% FPR95 reduction).

</details>


### [960] [PathCRF: Ball-Free Soccer Event Detection via Possession Path Inference from Player Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12080)
*Hyunsung Kim,Kunhee Lee,Sangwoo Seo,Sang-Ki Ko,Jinsung Yoon,Chanyoung Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出PathCRF框架，仅利用球员追踪数据（无需球追踪）即可检测足球控球事件，通过将球员轨迹建模为动态全连接图，并利用条件随机场确保边序列的逻辑一致性，实验表明该方法能生成准确、逻辑一致的控球路径，大幅减少人工标注需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前足球事件数据收集严重依赖人工标注，而自动事件检测方法需要球员和球轨迹数据，但球追踪由于基础设施和运营成本高难以规模化，导致数据驱动分析仅限于顶级赛事。因此需要一种仅依赖球员追踪数据即可检测控球事件的方法。

Method: 将球员轨迹建模为全连接动态图，将事件检测建模为每时间步选择一条对应当前控球状态的边；利用条件随机场（CRF）禁止相邻边之间不可能的转移，发射分数和转移分数由社会-时间骨干架构生成的边嵌入动态计算；推理时通过维特比解码获得最可能的边序列，当所选边在相邻时间步变化时检测到控球或传球事件。

Result: PathCRF能够生成准确且逻辑一致的控球路径，实现可靠的后续分析，同时显著减少人工事件标注需求。

Conclusion: 仅利用球员追踪数据即可有效检测足球控球事件，为降低数据收集门槛、推动数据驱动分析在足球领域的更广泛应用提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Despite recent advances in AI, event data collection in soccer still relies heavily on labor-intensive manual annotation. Although prior work has explored automatic event detection using player and ball trajectories, ball tracking also remains difficult to scale due to high infrastructural and operational costs. As a result, comprehensive data collection in soccer is largely confined to top-tier competitions, limiting the broader adoption of data-driven analysis in this domain. To address this challenge, this paper proposes PathCRF, a framework for detecting on-ball soccer events using only player tracking data. We model player trajectories as a fully connected dynamic graph and formulate event detection as the problem of selecting exactly one edge corresponding to the current possession state at each time step. To ensure logical consistency of the resulting edge sequence, we employ a Conditional Random Field (CRF) that forbids impossible transitions between consecutive edges, where emission and transition scores are dynamically computed from edge embeddings produced by a socio-temporal backbone architecture. During inference, the most probable edge sequence is obtained via Viterbi decoding, and events such as ball controls or passes are detected whenever the selected edge changes between adjacent time steps. Experiments show that PathCRF produces accurate, logically consistent possession paths, enabling reliable downstream analyses while substantially reducing the need for manual event annotation. The source code is available at https://github.com/hyunsungkim-ds/pathcrf.git.

</details>


### [961] [iML: Executable, Problem-Grounded, and Broadly Exploratory Code-Driven AutoML](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13937)
*Dat Le,Duc-Cuong Le,Anh-Son Nguyen,Tuan-Dung Bui,Thu-Trang Nguyen,Son Nguyen,Hieu Dinh Vo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: iML是一个多智能体代码驱动AutoML框架，通过任务分析、数据结构化蓝图生成、多轨道模块化代码合成及迭代调试，在MLE-BENCH上实现90%有效提交率、45%奖牌率和0.82 APS，较基线提升52%-273%，在iML-BENCH上也取得最高APS，展现出高可靠性、灵活性和竞争性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AutoML技术灵活性、透明度和执行可靠性有限；LLM生成代码虽文本合理但执行脆弱、缺乏数据接地或限制于狭窄解路径，亟需一个满足可执行性、问题接地和广泛解空间探索的框架。

Method: iML采用多智能体架构：首先分析任务并剖析数据，合成结构化蓝图；然后沿传统ML、预训练适配和自定义神经网络等多条轨道进行模块化代码生成；最后通过接口检查、动态执行和迭代调试确保代码可靠集成。

Result: 在MLE-BENCH上：有效提交率90%，奖牌率45%，APS为0.82，较LLM基线提升52%-273%。在iML-BENCH上取得最高APS，且在任务描述大幅简化时仍表现稳健。

Conclusion: iML被验证为一个可靠且具有竞争力的代码驱动AutoML框架，有效解决了可执行性、问题接地和广泛探索三大关键需求。

Abstract: Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) has improved access to machine learning, yet existing techniques often remain limited in flexibility, transparency, and execution reliability. Code-driven AutoML offers a promising direction by synthesizing executable code for preprocessing, model training, and evaluation. However, current LLM-based approaches frequently generate code that is plausible in text yet brittle in execution, insufficiently grounded in the actual dataset, or restricted to narrow solution paths. In this paper, we introduce iML, a multi-agent code-driven AutoML framework designed around three requirements: executability, problem grounding, and broad exploration of valid solutions. iML first analyzes the task and profiles the data, then synthesizes a structured blueprint that guides modular code generation across multiple implementation tracks, including traditional ML,pretrained adaptation, and custom neural architectures. To improve reliability, iML enforces interface checking, dynamic execution, and iterative debugging during integration. We evaluate iML on MLE-BENCH and the newly introduced iML-BENCH, covering diverse Kaggle-style tasks. On MLE-BENCH, iML attains a 90% valid submission rate and a 45% medal rate, and an APS of 0.82, improving the average standardized performance score (APS) over the LLM-based baselines by 52%-273%. On iML-BENCH, it achieves the highest APS and demonstrates robust performance even when task descriptions are substantially stripped. These results establish iML as a reliable and competitive framework for code-driven AutoML.

</details>


### [962] [You Can Learn Tokenization End-to-End with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.13940)
*Sam Dauncey,Roger Wattenhofer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出使用得分函数估计（score function estimates）来学习大语言模型中的离散分词边界，并引入强化学习中的时间折扣（time discounting）技术降低方差，在1亿参数规模上优于先前的直通估计（straight-through estimates）方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分词（tokenization）是LLM训练流程中一个硬编码的压缩步骤，与当前架构向端到端发展的趋势相悖。先前工作尝试将压缩步骤纳入架构内部，但使用直通估计将离散分词边界问题当作连续问题处理，缺乏严谨的理论保证。

Method: 使用得分函数估计（score function estimates）直接优化离散分词边界的绘制问题以最小化损失；引入强化学习中的时间折扣（time discounting）技术来降低得分函数估计的方差，使其变得可行。

Result: 在1亿参数规模下，所提方法在定性和定量评估上均优于先前提出的直通估计方法。

Conclusion: 得分函数估计结合时间折扣能够更有效地学习离散分词边界，为LLM去分词化（tokenization-free）提供了更优的技术路径。

Abstract: Tokenization is a hardcoded compression step which remains in the training pipeline of Large Language Models (LLMs), despite a general trend towards architectures becoming increasingly end-to-end. Prior work has shown promising results at scale in bringing this compression step inside the LLMs' architecture with heuristics to draw token boundaries, and also attempts to learn these token boundaries with straight-through estimates, which treat the problem of drawing discrete token boundaries as a continuous one. We show that these token boundaries can instead be learned using score function estimates, which have tighter theoretical guarantees due to directly optimizing the problem of drawing discrete token boundaries to minimize loss. We observe that techniques from reinforcement learning, such as time discounting, are necessary to reduce the variance of this score function sufficiently to make it practicable. We demonstrate that the resultant method outperforms prior proposed straight-through estimates, both qualitatively and quantitatively at the $100$ million parameter scale.

</details>


### [963] [Atomix: Timely, Transactional Tool Use for Reliable Agentic Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14849)
*Bardia Mohammadi,Nearchos Potamitis,Lars Klein,Akhil Arora,Laurent Bindschaedler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Atomix通过进度感知事务（progress-aware transactions）将LLM代理工作流中的效果聚集（哪些效果必须一起结算）和冲突耗尽（何时早期冲突工作已结束）解耦，实现正确的最终结算，在故障、并发和推测场景下提升恢复能力并防止不可逆操作泄漏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM代理编排器将工具返回作为结算触发点，导致故障、推测和并发代理可能遗留部分效果、分支残留、过期写入或不可逆发送。重试、检查点回放、锁和补偿机制都混淆了"哪些效果必须一起结算"和"何时早期冲突工作已耗尽"这两个关键事实。

Method: Atomix提出进度感知事务：运行时在执行过程中记录读取和效果，当完整足迹形成时密封事务，仅当每个资源的前沿（frontier）显示没有更早的冲突工作仍可能到达时才提交。提交代表最终结算（释放可缓冲效果、接受可逆外部效果为最终、放行不可逆效果），中止则抑制未释放效果并尽可能补偿已外部化的可逆效果。

Result: 在代表性代理工作负载上，Atomix在注入故障下提高了干净恢复能力，隔离了竞争和推测工作，防止了正确分类的不可逆动作泄漏；微基准测试显示相对工具延迟的封装开销在微秒级。

Conclusion: 将效果聚集与冲突耗尽显式解耦的进度感知事务机制，为LLM代理的多步工具编排提供了正确的结算语义，兼顾了故障恢复、并发隔离和不可逆操作的安全性。

Abstract: LLM agents execute multi-step workflows that mutate external state through tools. Common orchestrators treat tool return as the settlement trigger, so faults, speculation, and concurrent agents can leave partial effects, losing-branch residue, stale writes, or irreversible sends. Correct settlement needs two facts that retries, checkpoint replay, locks, and compensation each conflate: which effects must settle together, and when earlier conflicting work is exhausted. Atomix makes this split explicit with progress-aware transactions. The runtime records reads and effects during execution, seals a transaction when its footprint is complete, and commits only after per-resource frontiers show that no earlier conflicting work can still arrive. Commit is final settlement: Atomix releases bufferable effects, accepts reversible external effects as final, and lets irreversible effects leave the gate. Abort suppresses unreleased effects and compensates externalized reversible effects where possible. On representative agent workloads, this composition improves clean recovery under injected faults, isolates contending and speculative work, and prevents correctly classified irreversible actions from leaking; microbenchmarks show microsecond-scale wrapper overhead relative to tool latency.

</details>


### [964] [SEMixer: Semantics Enhanced MLP-Mixer for Multiscale Mixing and Long-term Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16220)
*Xu Zhang,Qitong Wang,Peng Wang,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SEMixer是一个轻量级多尺度时间序列预测模型，通过随机注意力机制和多尺度渐进混合链解决多尺度模式建模中的冗余、噪声和语义鸿沟问题，在10个公开数据集和CCF AlOps挑战赛中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列中的冗余和噪声，以及非相邻尺度间的语义鸿沟，使得高效对齐和整合多尺度时序依赖关系具有挑战性。

Method: 提出SEMixer模型，包含两个核心组件：1) 随机注意力机制(RAM)在训练时捕捉多样化的时间补丁交互，推理时通过dropout集成进行聚合；2) 多尺度渐进混合链(MPMC)以内存高效方式堆叠RAM和MLP-Mixer，实现更有效的时序混合，弥合跨尺度语义鸿沟。

Result: 在10个公开数据集上验证了有效性，并在基于21GB真实无线网络数据的2025 CCF AlOps挑战赛中取得第三名。

Conclusion: SEMixer通过创新的RAM和MPMC组件，有效解决了多尺度时序建模中的冗余、噪声和语义鸿沟问题，在长期时间序列预测任务上表现优异。

Abstract: Modeling multiscale patterns is crucial for long-term time series forecasting (TSF). However, redundancy and noise in time series, together with semantic gaps between non-adjacent scales, make the efficient alignment and integration of multi-scale temporal dependencies challenging. To address this, we propose SEMixer, a lightweight multiscale model designed for long-term TSF. SEMixer features two key components: a Random Attention Mechanism (RAM) and a Multiscale Progressive Mixing Chain (MPMC). RAM captures diverse time-patch interactions during training and aggregates them via dropout ensemble at inference, enhancing patch-level semantics and enabling MLP-Mixer to better model multi-scale dependencies. MPMC further stacks RAM and MLP-Mixer in a memory-efficient manner, achieving more effective temporal mixing. It addresses semantic gaps across scales and facilitates better multiscale modeling and forecasting performance. We not only validate the effectiveness of SEMixer on 10 public datasets, but also on the \textit{2025 CCF AlOps Challenge} based on 21GB real wireless network data, where SEMixer achieves third place. The code is available at the link https://github.com/Meteor-Stars/SEMixer.

</details>


### [965] [Amortized Predictability-aware Training Framework for Time Series Forecasting and Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16224)
*Xu Zhang,Peng Wang,Yichen Li,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种通用的可预测性感知训练框架（APTF），通过分层可预测性感知损失（HPL）和摊销模型，在时间序列预测与分类任务中动态识别并惩罚低可预测性样本，提升模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列数据易受噪声干扰，低可预测性样本会导致训练不稳定或收敛到较差的局部最优解，而现有深度学习方法很少从训练角度考虑如何识别并惩罚这些样本。

Method: 提出APTF框架，包含两个核心设计：(i) 分层可预测性感知损失（HPL），动态识别低可预测性样本并随训练进程逐步扩大其损失惩罚；(ii) 摊销模型，缓解模型偏差导致的可预测性估计误差，增强HPL效果。

Result: 在时间序列预测（TSF）和时间序列分类（TSC）任务上验证了有效性，代码已开源。

Conclusion: APTF作为一个通用训练框架，能够使模型聚焦高可预测性样本，同时适当学习低可预测性样本，是一种从训练视角提升时间序列分析模型性能的有效方法。

Abstract: Time series data are prone to noise in various domains, and training samples may contain low-predictability patterns that deviate from the normal data distribution, leading to training instability or convergence to poor local minima. Therefore, mitigating the adverse effects of low-predictability samples is crucial for time series analysis tasks such as time series forecasting (TSF) and time series classification (TSC). While many deep learning models have achieved promising performance, few consider how to identify and penalize low-predictability samples to improve model performance from the training perspective. To fill this gap, we propose a general Amortized Predictability-aware Training Framework (APTF) for both TSF and TSC. APTF introduces two key designs that enable the model to focus on high-predictability samples while still learning appropriately from low-predictability ones: (i) a Hierarchical Predictability-aware Loss (HPL) that dynamically identifies low-predictability samples and progressively expands their loss penalty as training evolves, and (ii) an amortization model that mitigates predictability estimation errors caused by model bias, further enhancing HPL's effectiveness. The code is available at https://github.com/Meteor-Stars/APTF.

</details>


### [966] [PETS: A Principled Framework Towards Optimal Trajectory Allocation for Efficient Test-Time Self-Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16745)
*Zhangyi Liu,Huaizhi Qu,Xiaowei Yin,He Sun,Yanjun Han,Tianlong Chen,Zhun Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PETS 提出了一种基于优化框架的测试时自一致性方法，通过将推理轨迹分配建模为众包问题，在离线与在线两种场景下实现样本高效的自一致性，在 GPQA 上减少最高 75%（离线）和 55%（在线）的采样预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在有限预算下实现样本高效的测试时自一致性仍是一个未解决的挑战。

Method: 引入自一致性率作为新度量，将推理轨迹分配建模为优化问题；离线场景下连接众包理论并设计基于多数投票的分配算法；在线流式场景下提出自适应预算分配方法。

Result: 在 GPQA 上，离线设置减少 75% 采样预算，在线设置减少 55% 采样预算，均达到完美自一致性。

Conclusion: PETS 在理论上为测试时自一致性提供了严谨框架，实验上显著优于均匀分配策略。

Abstract: Test-time scaling can improve model performance by aggregating stochastic reasoning trajectories. However, achieving sample-efficient test-time self-consistency under a limited budget remains an open challenge. We introduce PETS (Principled and Efficient Test-TimeSelf-Consistency), which initiates a principled study of trajectory allocation through an optimization framework. Central to our approach is the self-consistency rate, a new measure defined as agreement with the infinite-budget majority vote. This formulation makes sample-efficient test-time allocation theoretically grounded and amenable to rigorous analysis. We study both offline and online settings. In the offline regime, where all questions are known in advance, we connect trajectory allocation to crowdsourcing, a classic and well-developed area, by modeling reasoning traces as workers. This perspective allows us to leverage rich existing theory, yielding theoretical guarantees and an efficient majority-voting-based allocation algorithm. In the online streaming regime, where questions arrive sequentially and allocations must be made on the fly, we propose a novel method inspired by the offline framework. Our approach adapts budgets to question difficulty while preserving strong theoretical guarantees and computational efficiency. Experiments show that PETS consistently outperforms uniform allocation. On GPQA, PETS achieves perfect self-consistency in both settings while reducing the sampling budget by up to 75% (offline) and 55% (online) relative to uniform allocation. Code is available at https://github.com/ZDCSlab/PETS.

</details>


### [967] [Parallel Complex Diffusion for Scalable Time Series Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17706)
*Rongyao Cai,Yuxi Wan,Kexin Zhang,Ming Jin,Zhiqiang Ge,Qingsong Wen,Yong Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PaCoDi（Parallel Complex Diffusion），一种在频域构建扩散路径的时间序列生成框架。通过离散傅里叶变换将时间相关解耦为谱模态，并用并行实值估计器替代复值估计器，解决了频域扩散中复值动力学的数学障碍。理论证明了谱高斯噪声的统计正交性，建立了离散和连续时间谱扩散过程，并引入平均场理论近似处理边缘耦合。实验在5个基准上超越5个SOTA基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在时间序列生成中面临"纠缠诅咒"——强时间依赖性迫使噪声/分数估计器恢复高度纠缠的跨时间关系。现有频域感知方法主要在时间域DDPM/SDE框架下用DFT设计估计器模块，而频域原生扩散路径面临复值动力学的数学障碍。

Method: 1) 在谱域构建扩散路径，用并行实值估计器分别处理实部和虚部；2) 理论证明谱高斯噪声的统计正交性；3) 建立离散二阶跃迁和条件反向分解；4) 扩展到连续时间谱SDE（通过谱维纳过程）；5) 引入平均场理论近似+交互校正分支处理边缘耦合；6) 利用厄米对称性减少50%注意力FLOPs。

Result: 在5个基准数据集上的无条件/条件时间序列生成实验中，PaCoDi在生成质量和计算效率上均超越5个SOTA基线。

Conclusion: 改变扩散空间的拓扑结构（从时域到频域）可以有效缓解时间序列生成中的"纠缠诅咒"，而并行实值估计器策略成功绕过了频域原生扩散的复值障碍，兼顾了理论严谨性和实际效率。

Abstract: Diffusion models learn data distributions indirectly through denoising, making the difficulty of generative modeling closely tied to the dependency structure of data. For time series, strong temporal dependence forces the noise / score estimator to recover highly entangled cross-time relationships, leading to the curse of entanglement. We mitigate this burden by changing the topology of the diffusion space: the Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) decomposes temporal dependencies into spectral modes, diagonalizing second-order dependency structure and better aligning the data manifold with isotropic Gaussian noise and homogeneous diffusion dynamics. However, existing frequency-aware diffusion methods mainly use the DFT to design estimator blocks under temporal DDPM/SDE frameworks, while frequency-native diffusion paths face a mathematical barrier from complex-valued dynamics. We propose PaCoDi (Parallel Complex Diffusion), a frequency-native diffusion framework that constructs the diffusion path in the spectral domain while replacing the complex-valued estimator with parallel real-valued estimators for real and imaginary components. Theoretically, we prove the statistical orthogonality of spectral Gaussian noise, establish quadrature forward transitions and conditional reverse factorization, and extend discrete PaCoDi to continuous-time spectral SDEs through a Spectral Wiener Process. We further introduce a Mean Field Theory approximation with an Interactive Correction Branch to handle marginal coupling, and exploit Hermitian symmetry to reduce 50% attention FLOPs without information loss. Extensive experiments on unconditional and conditional time series generation demonstrate superior generative quality and computational efficiency against 5 SOTA baselines in 5 benchmarks, respectively. Code is available at https://github.com/RongyaoCai/PaCoDi.

</details>


### [968] [Are LLMs Ready for Neural-integrated Mechanistic Modeling? A Benchmark and Agentic Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18008)
*Zihan Guan,Rituparna Datta,Mengxuan Hu,Shunshun Liu,Aiying Zhang,Prasanna Balachandran,Sheng Li,Anil Vullikanti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出了神经集成机制建模（NIMM）基准，用于评估LLM在真实科学建模中构建神经-机制混合模型的能力，并针对现有方法搜索稳定性差、解质量低的问题，提出了树引导的智能体框架NIMMGen，通过分支级搜索和原子级模型精化实现了最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在科学建模中的评估多集中于简化场景，无法捕捉真实世界中神经-机制混合建模的复杂性，缺乏针对这类复杂搜索空间的系统性评估方法。

Method: 提出NIMM基准（涵盖三个科学领域），以及NIMMGen框架：采用树引导的智能体架构，通过分支级搜索实现多样化探索，并通过原子级模型精化提升解质量。

Result: 在NIMM基准上，NIMMGen相比现有LLM方法显著提升了搜索稳定性和解质量，达到最先进水平。

Conclusion: 神经-机制混合建模的搜索空间复杂性是当前LLM方法的主要瓶颈，树引导的多样化探索与原子级精化策略可有效突破这一限制。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in constructing mechanistic models from data. However, existing evaluations largely focus on simplified settings and fail to capture the complexity of real-world scientific modeling. In practice, such modeling often involves neural-integrated formulations, where a mechanistic model component and a neural network component are jointly constructed, leading to a significantly more complex search space. Motivated by this gap, we introduce the Neural-Integrated Mechanistic Modeling (NIMM) benchmark, which evaluates LLM-generated neural-integrated mechanistic models across three scientific domains. Experiments on NIMM reveal that existing LLM-based approaches struggle to effectively explore this complex space, resulting in limited search stability and solution quality. To address this challenge, we propose NIMMGen, a tree-guided agentic framework that enables diversified exploration via branch-level search and improves solutions through atomic model refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NIMMGen achieves state-of-the-art performance on NIMM, significantly improving search stability and solution quality.

</details>


### [969] [LERD: Latent Event-Relational Dynamics for Neurodegenerative Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18195)
*Yicheng Feng,Hairong Chen,Ziyu Jia,Samir Bhatt,Hengguan Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LERD，一种端到端贝叶斯潜事件-关系动态系统模型，用于从多通道EEG中推断潜神经事件及其关系结构，无需事件或交互标注，在合成基准和真实AD脑电数据集上优于强基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG诊断方法多为黑盒分类器，未显式建模潜事件时序和跨通道协调机制，难以提供可解释的临床相关信息。

Method: 结合连续时间事件推理模块与随机事件生成过程，融入电生理启发的动态先验，并推导出基于初值问题的KL正则化项及稳定性保证。

Result: 在合成基准和两个真实AD脑电数据集上持续优于强基线方法，生成与生理一致的率、时序和图摘要，可表征群体级动态差异。

Conclusion: LERD为基于EEG的AD诊断提供了可解释的潜事件与关系结构推断框架，有助于疾病筛查和监测。

Abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) alters brain electrophysiology and disrupts multichannel EEG dynamics, making accurate and clinically useful EEG-based diagnosis increasingly important for screening and disease monitoring. However, many existing approaches rely on black-box classifiers and do not explicitly model the latent event timing and cross-channel coordination behind their decisions. To address these limitations, we propose LERD, an end-to-end Bayesian latent event--relational dynamical system that infers latent neural events and their relational structure directly from multichannel EEG without event or interaction annotations. LERD combines a continuous-time event inference module with a stochastic event-generation process to capture flexible temporal patterns, while incorporating an electrophysiology-inspired dynamical prior to guide learning in a principled way. We further provide theoretical analysis that yields a tractable IVP-based KL regularizer and stability guarantees for the inferred relational dynamics. Extensive experiments on synthetic benchmarks and two real-world AD EEG cohorts demonstrate that LERD consistently outperforms strong baselines and yields physiology-aligned rate, timing, and graph summaries that help characterize group-level dynamical differences.

</details>


### [970] [Adaptive Time Series Reasoning via Segment Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18645)
*Shvat Messica,Jiawen Zhang,Kevin Li,Theodoros Tsiligkaridis,Marinka Zitnik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ARTIST提出了一种基于强化学习的时序推理框架，通过控制器-推理器架构和层次化策略优化，在推理过程中自适应选择时间序列中的关键片段，显著提升了多片段推理和罕见事件定位任务的准确性，平均准确率提升6.46个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在推理前将整个时间序列编码为固定表示，无论是否相关都处理全部序列，导致计算浪费且难以聚焦关键信息。因此，需要一种能够根据问题自适应选择信息性片段的推理方法。

Method: ARTIST采用控制器-推理器架构，将时序推理建模为顺序决策问题。控制器通过强化学习训练来选择信息性片段，推理器则基于所选片段生成推理轨迹和最终答案。提出层次化策略优化方法，使模型同时在片段选择和问答行为上表现优异。

Result: 在六个时序推理基准上评估，ARTIST相比最强基线平均准确率提升6.46个百分点，在罕见事件定位和多片段推理任务上提升最大。监督微调提升性能，强化学习通过优化问题自适应片段选择进一步带来增益。

Conclusion: 选择性数据使用是驱动有效时序推理的关键，ARTIST通过自适应片段选择和强化学习优化，在时序推理任务上取得了显著优于现有方法的效果。

Abstract: Time series reasoning tasks often start with a natural language question and require targeted analysis of a time series. Evidence may span the full series or appear in a few short intervals, so the model must decide what to inspect. Most existing approaches encode the entire time series into a fixed representation before inference, regardless of whether or not the entire sequence is relevant. We introduce ARTIST, which formulates time-series reasoning as a sequential decision problem. ARTIST interleaves reasoning with adaptive temporal segment selection. It adopts a controller-reasoner architecture and uses reinforcement learning to train the controller role to select informative segments and the reasoner role to generate segment-conditioned reasoning traces and final answers. During inference, the model actively acquires task-relevant information instead of relying on a static summary of the full sequence. We use a novel hierarchical policy optimization approach for post-training that allows the model to excel in both segment selection and question-answering behavior. We evaluate ARTIST on six time-series reasoning benchmarks and compare it with large language models, vision-language models, and prior time-series reasoning systems. ARTIST improves average accuracy by 6.46 absolute percentage points over the strongest baseline. The largest gains appear on rare event localization and multi-segment reasoning tasks. Supervised fine-tuning improves performance, and reinforcement learning provides additional gains by optimizing question-adaptive segment selection. These results show that selective data use drives effective time-series reasoning.

</details>


### [971] [IDLM: Inverse-distilled Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.19066)
*David Li,Nikita Gushchin,Dmitry Abulkhanov,Eric Moulines,Ivan Oseledets,Maxim Panov,Alexander Korotin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出IDLM方法，将逆蒸馏技术扩展到离散扩散语言模型，通过理论证明解的唯一性并引入梯度稳定松弛训练，在保持生成质量的同时将推理步数减少4-64倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型多步采样导致推理速度慢，限制了实际应用。现有逆蒸馏技术仅适用于连续扩散模型，直接扩展到离散设置面临理论（解不唯一）和实践（离散空间反向传播困难）双重挑战。

Method: 1) 理论证明逆蒸馏目标在离散扩散模型中具有唯一解，确保优化有效性；2) 引入梯度稳定的松弛方法，解决离散空间中反向传播不稳定的问题；3) 将上述方法应用于多个扩散语言模型进行加速。

Result: 在多种扩散语言模型上，IDLM将推理步数减少4倍至64倍，同时保持了教师模型的生成质量。

Conclusion: 逆蒸馏技术可有效加速离散扩散语言模型，且理论保证了解的唯一性，为扩散语言模型的实际部署提供可行方案。

Abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have recently achieved strong results in text generation. However, their multi-step sampling leads to slow inference, limiting practical use. To address this, we extend Inverse Distillation, a technique originally developed to accelerate continuous diffusion models, to the discrete setting. Nonetheless, this extension introduces both theoretical and practical challenges. From a theoretical perspective, the inverse distillation objective lacks uniqueness guarantees, which may lead to suboptimal solutions. From a practical standpoint, backpropagation in the discrete space is non-trivial and often unstable. To overcome these challenges, we first provide a theoretical result demonstrating that our inverse formulation admits a unique solution, thereby ensuring valid optimization. We then introduce gradient-stable relaxations to support effective training. As a result, experiments on multiple DLMs show that our method, Inverse-distilled Diffusion Language Models (IDLM), reduces the number of inference steps by 4x-64x, while preserving the teacher model's generation quality. We provide the code, model checkpoints, and video tutorials on the project page: https://david-cripto.github.io/idlm-project-page

</details>


### [972] [Robust Predictive Uncertainty and Double Descent in Contaminated Bayesian Random Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.19126)
*Michele Caprio,Katerina Papagiannouli,Siu Lun Chau,Sayan Mukherjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了随机特征回归的鲁棒贝叶斯形式化方法，通过Huber型污染集明确处理先验和似然的错误指定，推导出后验预测密度的上下界，并引入Imprecise Highest Density Region (IHDR)进行鲁棒不确定性量化，证明了该方法在计算高效的同时保留了经典RF模型的渐近特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有随机特征回归的贝叶斯解释假设先验和似然完全正确，但在实际中这些假设可能被违反（即误指定），导致预测不确定性估计不可靠。本文旨在建立一种对先验和似然误指定具有鲁棒性的贝叶斯随机特征框架。

Method: 使用ε-污染先验集和η-污染似然集（Huber型污染）替代单一先验和似然，通过悲观广义贝叶斯更新进行推理；推导后验预测密度的上下界；提出Imprecise Highest Density Region (IHDR)用于鲁棒不确定性量化，并给出其高斯近似形式。

Result: 得到了后验预测密度的显式可处理边界；IHDR可通过调整的高斯置信区间高效近似；在温和截断近似下获得预测方差边界；保留了RF模型已知的主阶比例增长渐近性；继承了经典的双下降相位结构。

Conclusion: 建立了贝叶斯随机特征的鲁棒性理论：预测不确定性在计算上可处理，保留了经典的双下降相位结构，并在先验和似然有界误指定下具有显式的最大保证。

Abstract: We propose a robust Bayesian formulation of random feature (RF) regression that accounts explicitly for prior and likelihood misspecification via Huber-style contamination sets. Starting from the classical equivalence between ridge-regularized RF training and Bayesian inference with Gaussian priors and likelihoods, we replace the single prior and likelihood with $ε$- and $η$-contaminated credal sets, respectively, and perform inference using pessimistic generalized Bayesian updating. We derive explicit and tractable bounds for the resulting lower and upper posterior predictive densities. These bounds show that, when contamination is moderate, prior and likelihood ambiguity effectively acts as a direct contamination of the posterior predictive distribution, yielding uncertainty envelopes around the classical Gaussian predictive. We introduce an Imprecise Highest Density Region (IHDR) for robust predictive uncertainty quantification and show that it admits an efficient approximation via an adjusted Gaussian credible interval. We further obtain predictive variance bounds (under a mild truncation approximation for the upper bound) and prove that they preserve the leading-order proportional-growth asymptotics known for RF models. Together, these results establish a robustness theory for Bayesian random features: predictive uncertainty remains computationally tractable, inherits the classical double-descent phase structure, and is improved by explicit worst-case guarantees under bounded prior and likelihood misspecification.

</details>


### [973] [Learning Discriminative and Generalizable Anomaly Detector for Dynamic Graph with Limited Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.20019)
*Yuxing Tian,Yiyan Qi,Fengran Mo,Weixu Zhang,Jian Guo,Jian-Yun Nie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向动态图异常检测的通用框架，通过残差表示编码、限制损失和双边界优化策略，在利用有限标注异常的同时保持对未见异常的良好泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态图异常检测方法存在两难困境：无监督方法无需标注异常但边界模糊，半监督方法易过拟合有限标注异常且泛化能力差。本文旨在解决从正常/未标注数据中学习判别性边界的同时，有效利用有限标注异常且不牺牲对未见异常的泛化能力这一未被充分探索的问题。

Method: 提出一个通用、模型无关的框架，包含三个核心组件：(i) 残差表示编码——捕获当前交互与历史上下文之间的偏差，提供异常相关信号；(ii) 限制损失——将正常表示约束在两个共心超球面之间的区间内，保持尺度一致性同时使异常可分；(iii) 双边界优化策略——利用归一化流建模的对数似然分布，学习判别性且鲁棒的边界。

Result: 在多种评估设置下的广泛实验表明，该框架在性能上优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 所提框架能够在有限标注异常可用时有效利用其信息，同时不牺牲对未见异常的泛化能力，为动态图异常检测提供了一种兼具判别性和鲁棒性的解决方案。

Abstract: Dynamic graph anomaly detection is critical for many real-world applications but remains challenging due to the scarcity of labeled anomalies. Existing methods are either unsupervised or semi-supervised: unsupervised methods avoid the need for labeled anomalies but often produce ambiguous boundary, whereas semi-supervised methods can overfit to the limited labeled anomalies and generalize poorly to unseen anomalies. To address this gap, we consider a largely underexplored problem: learning a discriminative boundary from normal/unlabeled data, while leveraging limited labeled anomalies \textbf{when available} without sacrificing generalization to unseen anomalies. In this paper, we propose an effective, generalizable, and model-agnostic framework with three main components: (i) residual representation encoding that capture deviations between current interactions and their historical context, providing anomaly-relevant signals; (ii) a restriction loss that constrain the normal representations within an interval bounded by two co-centered hyperspheres, ensuring consistent scales while keeping anomalies separable; (iii) a bi-boundary optimization strategy that learns a discriminative and robust boundary using the log-likelihood distribution modeled by a normalizing flow. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our framework across diverse evaluation settings.

</details>


### [974] [On Imbalanced Regression with Hoeffding Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.22101)
*Pantia-Marina Alchirch,Dimitrios I. Diochnos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对流式回归任务，将核密度估计（KDE）通过 telescoping 公式扩展到在线场景，并将分层收缩（HS）集成到增量决策树中。实验表明KDE能持续提升早期流性能，而HS收益有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线回归方法中，Hoeffding树等增量模型性能有待提升，而离线场景中KDE和HS已被证明有效，但尚未被适配到流式环境。作者希望将这两种技术迁移到在线学习中以改善回归性能。

Method: (1) 提出telescoping（望远镜式）公式将核密度估计扩展到流式设定； (2) 将分层收缩（Hierarchical Shrinkage）集成到增量决策树中，作为后处理正则化手段而不改变树结构。

Result: 在标准在线回归基准上，KDE显著提升了早期流（early-stream）阶段的性能；HS带来的改进有限。

Conclusion: KDE的流式扩展是有效的，尤其适合早期数据不足的场景；HS在在线决策树中效果不如离线场景理想，可能需要进一步适配。

Abstract: Many real-world applications generate continuous data streams for regression. Hoeffding trees and their variants have a long-standing tradition due to their effectiveness, either alone or as base models in broader ensembles. Recent batch-learning work shows that kernel density estimation (KDE) improves smoothed predictions in imbalanced regression [Yang et al., 2021], while hierarchical shrinkage (HS) provides post-hoc regularization for decision trees without modifying their structure [Agarwal et al., 2022]. We extend KDE to streaming settings via a telescoping formulation and integrate HS into incremental decision trees. Empirical evaluation on standard online regression benchmarks shows that KDE consistently improves early-stream performance, whereas HS provides limited gains. Our implementation is publicly available at: https://github.com/marinaAlchirch/DSFA_2026.

</details>


### [975] [Induction Meets Biology: Mechanisms of Repeat Detection in Protein Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.23179)
*Gal Pomerants,Yaniv Nikankin,Anja Reusch,Tomer Tsaban,Ora Schueler-Furman,Yonatan Belinkov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了蛋白质语言模型通过结合通用位置注意力头、编码氨基酸相似性的生物特化神经元以及归纳头，分两阶段检测精确和近似重复序列的内部机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质序列中大量存在重复片段（精确或近似重复），这些重复对蛋白质结构与功能至关重要。尽管已有数十年的算法研究和近期PLM在掩码预测中能识别重复的发现，但其内部工作机制尚不明确。

Method: 通过分析PLM在掩码词预测任务中的行为，研究其检测精确和近似重复序列的内部机制，发现近似重复的机制功能上包含了精确重复的机制，并揭示了两阶段过程：首先利用通用位置注意力头和生物特化组件（如编码氨基酸相似性的神经元）构建特征表示，然后通过归纳头对齐重复片段中的对应token以促进正确答案。

Result: 发现PLM检测重复的机制分为两个阶段：第一阶段构建特征表示（涉及位置注意力头和编码氨基酸相似性的生物特化神经元），第二阶段通过归纳头对齐重复片段中的对应token。近似重复检测机制功能上包含了精确重复检测机制。

Conclusion: PLM通过将基于语言的模式匹配与专门的生物学知识相结合来解决重复检测这一生物学任务，为研究PLM中更复杂的进化过程奠定了基础。

Abstract: Protein sequences are abundant in repeating segments, both as exact copies and as approximate segments with mutations. These repeats are important for protein structure and function, motivating decades of algorithmic work on repeat identification. Recent work has shown that protein language models (PLMs) identify repeats, by examining their behavior in masked-token prediction. To elucidate their internal mechanisms, we investigate how PLMs detect both exact and approximate repeats. We find that the mechanism for approximate repeats functionally subsumes that of exact repeats. We then characterize this mechanism, revealing two main stages: PLMs first build feature representations using both general positional attention heads and biologically specialized components, such as neurons that encode amino-acid similarity. Then, induction heads attend to aligned tokens across repeated segments, promoting the correct answer. Our results reveal how PLMs solve this biological task by combining language-based pattern matching with specialized biological knowledge, thereby establishing a basis for studying more complex evolutionary processes in PLMs.

</details>


### [976] [LK Losses: Direct Acceptance Rate Optimization for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.23881)
*Alexander Samarin,Sergei Krutikov,Anton Shevtsov,Sergei Skvortsov,Filipp Fisin,Alexander Golubev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LK损失函数，直接优化推测解码中的接受率而非传统的KL散度，在多种模型架构上实现8-10%的接受长度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准推测解码训练使用KL散度作为代理目标，但小规模草稿模型容量有限，最小化KL并不保证最大化接受率，导致次优解。

Method: 提出LK损失（LK losses），一种直接以接受率为优化目标的训练目标函数，可无缝集成到现有推测解码训练框架中。

Result: 在4种草稿架构、6种目标模型（8B-685B参数）上，LK损失在通用、编程和数学领域均一致优于KL基线，平均接受长度提升8-10%。

Conclusion: LK损失作为KL散度的替代训练目标，实现简单、无计算开销，能有效提升推测解码的加速效果。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to propose candidate tokens that are then verified in parallel by the target model. The speedup is significantly determined by the acceptance rate, yet standard training minimizes Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence as a proxy objective. While KL divergence and acceptance rate share the same global optimum, small draft models, having limited capacity, typically converge to suboptimal solutions where minimizing KL does not guarantee maximizing acceptance rate. To address this issue, we propose LK losses, special training objectives that directly target acceptance rate. Comprehensive experiments across four draft architectures and six target models, ranging from 8B to 685B parameters, demonstrate consistent improvements in acceptance metrics across all configurations compared to the standard KL-based training. We evaluate our approach on general, coding and math domains and report gains of up to 8-10% in average acceptance length. LK losses are easy to implement, introduce no computational overhead and can be directly integrated into any existing speculator training framework, making them a compelling alternative to the existing draft training objectives.

</details>


### [977] [Flow-Based Density Ratio Estimation for Intractable Distributions with Applications in Genomics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.24201)
*Egor Antipov,Alessandro Palma,Lorenzo Consoli,Stephan Günnemann,Andrea Dittadi,Fabian J. Theis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于条件感知流匹配的单一动力学公式，用于沿生成轨迹追踪密度比，避免了传统归一化流分别模拟每个分布带来的计算昂贵和离散化误差问题，在模拟基准和单细胞基因组学数据分析中展示了竞争性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 估计难以处理的成对数据分布间的密度比是概率建模的核心问题，但基于精确似然模型（如归一化流）的朴素方法需要独立模拟每个分布，计算成本高且存在离散化误差。

Method: 利用条件感知流匹配（condition-aware flow matching）推导出一个统一的动力学公式，沿着生成轨迹追踪密度比。

Result: 在模拟基准的闭式比率估计任务上表现具有竞争力，并在单细胞基因组学数据分析中支持治疗效应估计和批次校正评估等多种任务。

Conclusion: 所提方法能够高效且准确地估计密度比，在计算效率和应用广度上优于传统方法。

Abstract: Estimating density ratios between pairs of intractable data distributions is a core problem in probabilistic modeling, enabling principled comparisons of sample likelihoods under different data-generating processes across conditions. While exact-likelihood models such as normalizing flows offer a promising approach to density ratio estimation, naive evaluations are computationally expensive and prone to discretization errors because they require simulating each distribution's likelihood independently. In this work, we leverage condition-aware flow matching to derive a single dynamical formulation for tracking density ratios along generative trajectories. We demonstrate competitive performance on simulated benchmarks for closed-form ratio estimation, and show that our method supports versatile tasks in single-cell genomics data analysis, where likelihood-based comparisons of cellular states across experimental conditions enable treatment effect estimation and batch correction evaluation.

</details>


### [978] [Stabilizing Policy Optimization via Logits Convexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00963)
*Hongzhan Chen,Tao Yang,Yuhua Zhu,Shiping Gao,Xiaojun Quan,Ting Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从梯度视角分析了强化学习与监督微调之间的稳定性差距，指出SFT损失关于模型logits的凸性是稳定训练的关键。基于此，提出Logits凸优化框架（LCO），通过将学习策略对齐到最优目标来模拟logits级凸性的稳定效果，实验表明LCO在多个模型家族和基准上均提升训练稳定性并优于传统RL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习在LLM训练中虽然成功，但相比监督微调存在显著的不稳定性问题，理解并弥合这一稳定性差距对提升RL训练效果至关重要。

Method: 首先从梯度视角理论分析SFT损失关于模型logits的凸性如何带来稳定的梯度方向性，并指出PPO的裁剪代理目标缺乏此性质。随后提出Logits凸优化（LCO）框架，通过将所学策略对齐到从原始RL目标导出的最优目标，模拟logits级凸性的稳定效果。

Result: 在多个模型家族上的大量实验表明，LCO框架持续提升训练稳定性，并在广泛基准上优于传统RL方法。

Conclusion: SFT与RL的稳定性差距源于损失函数关于logits的凸性差异，通过LCO框架模拟该凸性可有效提升RL训练的稳定性与性能。

Abstract: While reinforcement learning (RL) has been central to the recent success of large language models (LLMs), RL optimization is notoriously unstable, especially when compared to supervised fine-tuning (SFT). In this work, we investigate the stability gap between SFT and RL from a gradient-based perspective, and show that the convexity of the SFT loss with respect to model logits plays a key role in enabling stable training. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that this property induces favorable gradient directionality during optimization. In contrast, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), a widely adopted policy gradient algorithm utilizing a clipped surrogate objective, lacks this stabilizing property. Motivated by this observation, we propose Logits Convex Optimization (LCO), a simple yet effective policy optimization framework that aligns the learned policy with an optimal target derived from the original RL objective, thereby emulating the stabilizing effects of logits-level convexity. Extensive experiments across multiple model families show that our LCO framework consistently improves training stability and outperforms conventional RL methods on a broad range of benchmarks.

</details>


### [979] [Understanding LoRA as Knowledge Memory: An Empirical Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01097)
*Seungju Back,Dongwoo Lee,Naun Kang,Taehee Lee,S. K. Hong,Youngjune Gwon,Sungjin Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统性研究了将LoRA作为模块化知识记忆用于大语言模型持续知识更新的方法，通过实证分析探索了存储容量、内化优化、多模块扩展和长上下文推理等设计空间，为LoRA记忆的操作边界提供了实践指导，并将其定位为与RAG和ICL互补的记忆轴。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于上下文的持续知识更新方法（ICL、RAG）受限于上下文预算、成本和检索碎片化问题，而基于参数的LoRA记忆方法虽被初步探索，但其容量和可组合性的基本机制尚不明确，缺乏系统性研究。

Method: 采用系统性实证研究，从四个方面映射LoRA记忆的设计空间：1) 表征存储容量特性；2) 优化知识内化过程；3) 扩展多模块系统的可组合性；4) 评估长上下文推理能力。通过实验分析提供操作边界的实践指导。

Result: 明确了LoRA作为模块化知识记忆在存储容量、内化效率和可组合性方面的操作边界，揭示了其与RAG和ICL的互补优势，并提供了开源代码和数据集。

Conclusion: LoRA可作为与RAG和ICL互补的独立记忆轴，在上下文无关的参数化知识更新范式下具有独特优势，为LLM持续知识更新提供了新的实践路径。

Abstract: Continuous knowledge updating for pre-trained large language models (LLMs) is increasingly necessary yet remains challenging. Although inference-time methods like In-Context Learning (ICL) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) are popular, they face constraints in context budgets, costs, and retrieval fragmentation. Departing from these context-dependent paradigms, this work investigates a parametric approach using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) as a modular knowledge memory. Although few recent works examine this concept, the fundamental mechanics governing its capacity and composability remain largely unexplored. We bridge this gap through the first systematic empirical study mapping the design space of LoRA-based memory, ranging from characterizing storage capacity and optimizing internalization to scaling multi-module systems and evaluating long-context reasoning. Rather than proposing a single architecture, we provide practical guidance on the operational boundaries of LoRA memory. Overall, our findings position LoRA as the complementary axis of memory alongside RAG and ICL, offering distinct advantages. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/ahn-ml/Understanding-LoRA-as-Knowledge-Memory.

</details>


### [980] [Concept Heterogeneity-aware Representation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02237)
*Laziz U. Abdullaev,Noelle Y. L. Wong,Ryan T. Z. Lee,Shiqi Jiang,Khoi N. M. Nguyen,Tan M. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CHaRS方法，通过最优传输理论将表示引导建模为高斯混合模型间的离散OT问题，并利用重心投影推导出输入依赖的引导映射，从而克服传统全局引导方向在非均匀表示空间中的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表示引导方法大多依赖单一的全局引导方向（如通过差异均值法获得），但LLM的表示往往是非均匀的、具有聚类和上下文依赖的结构，导致全局引导方向脆弱且效果有限。本文旨在提出一种能适应表示异质性的引导方法。

Method: 将源和目标表示建模为高斯混合模型，将引导问题形式化为离散最优传输问题；通过重心投影从传输计划中导出显式的、输入依赖的引导映射，生成平滑的、核加权的聚类级平移组合。

Result: 在多个实验设置中，CHaRS相比全局引导方法实现了更有效的行为控制。

Conclusion: CHaRS通过考虑表示空间的异质性结构，在LLM行为控制任务上优于传统的全局引导方法。

Abstract: Representation steering offers a lightweight mechanism for controlling the behavior of large language models (LLMs) by intervening on internal activations at inference time. Most existing methods rely on a single global steering direction, typically obtained via difference-in-means over contrastive datasets. This approach implicitly assumes that the target concept is homogeneously represented across the embedding space. In practice, however, LLM representations can be highly non-homogeneous, exhibiting clustered, context-dependent structure, which renders global steering directions brittle. In this work, we view representation steering through the lens of optimal transport (OT), noting that standard difference-in-means steering implicitly corresponds to the OT map between two identical distributions with differing first moments, yielding a global translation. To relax this restrictive assumption, we theoretically model source and target representations as Gaussian mixture models and formulate steering as a discrete OT problem between semantic latent clusters. From the resulting transport plan, we derive an explicit, input-dependent steering map via barycentric projection, producing a smooth, kernel-weighted combination of cluster-level shifts. We term this method Concept Heterogeneity-aware Representation Steering (CHaRS). Through numerous experimental settings, we show that CHaRS yields more effective behavioral control than global steering.

</details>


### [981] [Length Generalization Bounds for Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02238)
*Andy Yang,Pascal Bergsträßer,Georg Zetzsche,David Chiang,Anthony W. Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了C-RASP（与Transformer紧密相关的语言类）的长度泛化界不可计算，并给出了正片段的可计算指数长度泛化界及最优性证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长度泛化是学习算法的关键性质，但C-RASP（关联Transformer的语言类）的长度泛化界可计算性此前仅为开放问题，仅有一层及两层受限情形的部分正结果。本文旨在完全解决该可计算性问题。

Method: 通过理论证明，给出C-RASP（两层及以上）长度泛化界不可计算的主导结果；同时针对C-RASP正片段（等价于固定精度Transformer）证明可计算指数长度界，并证明其最优性。

Result: 主要结果：C-RASP（两层及以上）不存在可计算的长度泛化界，因此Transformer也不存在。正片段结果：C-RASP正片段（等价于固定精度Transformer）存在可计算的指数长度泛化界，且该界最优。

Conclusion: 完全解决了C-RASP长度泛化界可计算性的开放问题：两层以上不可计算，正片段（固定精度Transformer）可计算且指数最优，揭示了Transformer长度泛化能力的理论极限。

Abstract: Length generalization is a key property of a learning algorithm that enables it to make correct predictions on inputs of any length, given finite training data. To provide such a guarantee, one needs to be able to compute a length generalization bound, beyond which the model is guaranteed to generalize. This paper concerns the open problem of the computability of such generalization bounds for C-RASP, a class of languages which is closely linked to transformers. A positive partial result was recently shown by Chen et al. for C-RASP with only one layer and, under some restrictions, also with two layers. We provide complete answers to the above open problem. Our main result is the non-existence of computable length generalization bounds for C-RASP (already with two layers) and hence for transformers. To complement this, we provide a computable bound for the positive fragment of C-RASP, which we show equivalent to fixed-precision transformers. For both positive C-RASP and fixed-precision transformers, we show that the length complexity is exponential, and prove optimality of the bounds.

</details>


### [982] [Heterogeneous Decentralized Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06741)
*Zhiying Jiang,Raihan Seraj,Marcos Villagra,Bidhan Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出高效的去中心化扩散模型训练框架，相比先前工作减少16倍计算量和14倍数据量，支持异构训练目标（DDPM和Flow Matching），单GPU（24-48GB VRAM）即可参与训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿扩散模型训练需要大量计算资源集中在紧密耦合的集群中，限制了参与机构范围；现有去中心化方法资源需求高（1176 GPU-天）且要求所有专家使用同质训练目标。

Method: (1) 异构去中心化训练范式，允许专家使用不同目标（DDPM和Flow Matching），推理时无需重新训练即可统一；(2) 预训练检查点从ImageNet-DDPM转换为Flow Matching目标，加速收敛；(3) 采用PixArt-α的高效AdaLN-Single架构，减少参数同时保持质量。

Result: 在LAION-Aesthetics上，相比先前DDM工作减少16倍计算量和14倍数据量；在统一推理设置下，异构配置比同质基线获得更好的FID和更高的提示内多样性。

Conclusion: 本框架消除了同步需求，支持混合DDPM/FM目标，使得去中心化生成模型训练对仅拥有单GPU（24-48GB VRAM）的贡献者成为可能。

Abstract: Training frontier-scale diffusion models often requires substantial computational resources concentrated in tightly-coupled clusters, limiting participation to well-resourced institutions. While Decentralized Diffusion Models (DDM) enable training multiple experts in isolation, existing approaches require 1176 GPU-days and homogeneous training objectives across all experts. We present an efficient framework that dramatically reduces resource requirements while supporting heterogeneous training objectives. Our approach combines three key contributions: (1) a heterogeneous decentralized training paradigm that allows experts to use different objectives (DDPM and Flow Matching), unified at inference time without any retraining; (2) pretrained checkpoint conversion from ImageNet-DDPM to Flow Matching objectives, accelerating convergence and enabling initialization without objective-specific pretraining; and (3) PixArt-$α$'s efficient AdaLN-Single architecture, reducing parameters while maintaining quality. Experiments on LAION-Aesthetics show that, relative to the training scale reported for prior DDM work, our approach reduces the compute by 16$\times$ and data by 14$\times$. Under aligned inference settings, our heterogeneous configuration achieves better FID and higher intra-prompt diversity than the homogeneous baseline. By eliminating synchronization requirements and enabling mixed DDPM/FM objectives, our framework makes decentralized generative model training accessible to contributors with single GPUs requiring only 24--48GB VRAM.

</details>


### [983] [Step-Level Sparse Autoencoder for Reasoning Process Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03031)
*Xuan Yang,Jiayu Liu,Yuhang Lai,Hao Xu,Zhenya Huang,Ning Miao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出步级稀疏自编码器(SSAE)，通过将大语言模型推理步骤中的信息解耦为稀疏特征，解决了传统基于token级别的可解释性方法与步级推理信息（如推理方向和语义转换）之间的粒度不匹配问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于稀疏自编码器(SAE)的可解释性方法主要工作在token级别，无法捕捉推理过程中更关键的步级信息（如推理方向和语义转换），存在粒度不匹配问题。

Method: 提出步级稀疏自编码器(SSAE)，通过精确控制步特征关于其上下文的稀疏性，构建步重建的信息瓶颈，将增量信息与背景信息分离并解耦为若干稀疏激活的维度。

Result: 在多个基础模型和推理任务上的实验表明，通过线性探针可轻松预测生成长度、首词分布等表层信息，以及步骤正确性和逻辑性等复杂属性。

Conclusion: LLM在生成过程中至少部分已知这些属性，这为LLM的自我验证能力提供了基础。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong complex reasoning capabilities through Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, their reasoning patterns remain too complicated to analyze. While Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a powerful tool for interpretability, existing approaches predominantly operate at the token level, creating a granularity mismatch when capturing more critical step-level information, such as reasoning direction and semantic transitions. In this work, we propose step-level sparse autoencoder (SSAE), which serves as an analytical tool to disentangle different aspects of LLMs' reasoning steps into sparse features. Specifically, by precisely controlling the sparsity of a step feature conditioned on its context, we form an information bottleneck in step reconstruction, which splits incremental information from background information and disentangles it into several sparsely activated dimensions. Experiments on multiple base models and reasoning tasks show the effectiveness of the extracted features. By linear probing, we can easily predict surface-level information, such as generation length and first token distribution, as well as more complicated properties, such as the correctness and logicality of the step. These observations indicate that LLMs should already at least partly know about these properties during generation, which provides the foundation for the self-verification ability of LLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/Miaow-Lab/SSAE.

</details>


### [984] [Reward Score Matching: Unifying Reward-based Fine-tuning for Flow and Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17415)
*Jeongjae Lee,Jinho Chang,Jeongsol Kim,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出奖励分数匹配（RSM）统一框架，将多种基于奖励的扩散/流模型微调方法归结为价值引导下的分数匹配，并基于此简化设计，提升效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于奖励的扩散/流模型微调方法看似分散，源自不同视角，缺乏统一理解，难以比较和优化其偏差-方差-计算权衡。

Method: 提出奖励分数匹配（RSM）框架，将多种微调方法统一为价值引导下的分数匹配，区分核心优化组件与辅助机制，并据此设计更简单高效的重新实现。

Result: 统一了多种现有方法，明确了偏差-方差-计算权衡，简化了设计空间，并在可微和黑盒奖励对齐任务上实现了更高效的重新设计。

Conclusion: RSM框架将碎片化的奖励微调方法转化为更小、更可解释、更可操作的设计空间，代码已开源。

Abstract: Reward-based fine-tuning steers a pretrained diffusion or flow-based generative model toward higher-reward samples while remaining close to the pretrained model. Although existing methods are derived from different perspectives, we show that many can be written under a common framework, which we call reward score matching (RSM). Under this view, alignment becomes score matching against a value-guided target, and the main differences across methods reduce to the construction of the value-guidance estimator and the effective optimization strength across timesteps. This unification clarifies the bias-variance-compute tradeoffs of existing designs, and distinguishes core optimization components from auxiliary mechanisms that add complexity without clear benefit. Guided by this perspective, we develop simpler, more efficient redesigns across representative differentiable and black-box reward alignment tasks. Overall, RSM turns a seemingly fragmented collection of reward-based fine-tuning methods into a smaller, more interpretable, and more actionable design space. Code is available at https://github.com/jaylee2000/rsm

</details>


### [985] [Flowers: A Warp Drive for Neural PDE Solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.04430)
*Till Muser,Alexandra Spitzer,Matti Lassas,Maarten V. de Hoop,Ivan Dokmanić*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Flowers架构，一种完全基于多头扭曲（multihead warps）的神经算子，用于学习PDE解算子。它使用点级通道混合和多尺度残差块，通过预测位移场扭曲输入特征，以线性成本实现自适应全局交互。在2D/3D时变PDE基准测试中表现优异，17M参数模型超越同类基线，150M参数模型超越更大规模的Transformer基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子架构（如Fourier神经算子、注意力机制等）在建模PDE解算子时存在计算效率低或全局交互能力不足的问题。受物理中守恒律的流映射、非均匀介质中的波动以及动理学理论连续极限的启发，作者希望设计一种兼具计算效率和强大全局建模能力的架构。

Method: Flowers架构完全由多头扭曲（multihead warps）构建。每个头预测一个位移场并对混合后的输入特征进行扭曲操作。位移场以点级方式预测（无空间聚合），非局部性通过每个头在源坐标处的稀疏采样引入。将扭曲操作堆叠在多尺度残差块中，实现线性复杂度的自适应全局交互。

Result: 在2D和3D时变PDE基准测试（特别是流和波问题）上表现卓越。17M参数模型持续优于相同规模的Fourier、卷积和注意力基线；150M参数模型超越参数量更大、数据和训练计算更多的近期Transformer基础模型。

Conclusion: Flowers架构验证了纯粹基于扭曲操作的神经算子在PDE求解中的有效性，在计算效率和预测精度之间取得了优越平衡，为神经算子设计提供了全新的思路。

Abstract: We introduce Flowers, a neural architecture for learning PDE solution operators built entirely from multihead warps. Aside from pointwise channel mixing and a multiscale scaffold, Flowers use no Fourier multipliers, no dot-product attention, and no convolutional mixing. Each head predicts a displacement field and warps the mixed input features. Motivated by physics and computational efficiency, displacements are predicted pointwise, without any spatial aggregation, and nonlocality enters only through sparse sampling at source coordinates, one per head. Stacking warps in multiscale residual blocks yields Flowers, which implement adaptive, global interactions at linear cost. We theoretically motivate this design through three complementary lenses: flow maps for conservation laws, waves in inhomogeneous media, and a kinetic-theoretic continuum limit. Flowers achieve excellent performance on a broad suite of 2D and 3D time-dependent PDE benchmarks, particularly flows and waves. A compact 17M-parameter model consistently outperforms Fourier, convolution, and attention-based baselines of similar size, while a 150M-parameter variant improves over recent transformer-based foundation models with much more parameters, data, and training compute.

</details>


### [986] [Possibilistic Predictive Uncertainty for Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00600)
*Yao Ni,Jeremie Houssineau,Yew Soon Ong,Piotr Koniusz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DAPPr框架，通过可能性理论中的supremum算子将参数后验投影到预测空间，并用可学习的Dirichlet可能性函数近似，在保持计算高效的同时实现了原则性的 epistemic 不确定性量化，实验表现优于现有二阶预测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有不确定性建模方法面临两难困境：贝叶斯方法原则性强但计算代价高，二阶预测器高效但缺乏与其目标函数和不确定性量化之间的严格理论联系。需要一种兼具原则性和计算效率的方法。

Method: 提出Dirichlet-近似可能性后验预测（DAPPr）框架：基于可能性理论定义参数上的可能性后验，通过supremum算子将其投影到预测空间，再用可学习的Dirichlet可能性函数近似投影后的后验，最终形成具有闭式解的简单训练目标。

Result: 在多种基准测试上的大量实验表明，DAPPr在不确定性量化性能上达到了与最先进二阶预测器相当或更优的水平，同时保持了原则性的推导过程和计算效率。

Conclusion: DAPPr成功解决了贝叶斯方法和二阶预测器之间的根本困境，提供了一个兼具理论原则性和实际计算效率的不确定性量化框架。

Abstract: Deep neural networks achieve impressive results across diverse applications, yet their overconfidence on unseen inputs necessitates reliable epistemic uncertainty modeling. Existing methods for uncertainty modeling face a fundamental dilemma: Bayesian approaches provide principled estimates but remain computationally prohibitive, while efficient second-order predictors lack rigorous connections between their specific objectives and epistemic uncertainty quantification. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce Dirichlet-approximated possibilistic posterior predictions (DAPPr), a principled framework grounded in possibility theory. We define a possibilistic posterior over parameters, project it to the prediction space via supremum operators, and approximate the projected posterior using learnable Dirichlet possibility functions. This projection-and-approximation strategy yields a simple training objective with closed-form solutions. Despite its simplicity, extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks show that DAPPr achieves competitive or superior uncertainty quantification performance over state-of-the-art second-order predictors while maintaining both principled derivation and computational efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/MaxwellYaoNi/DAPPr.

</details>


### [987] [Divergence is Uncertainty: A Closed-Form Posterior Covariance for Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00941)
*Jiarui Xing,Song Wang,Jian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过扩展Tweedie公式到流匹配插值框架，推导出生成轨迹上每一点的后验协方差的精确闭式解，仅需计算学习速度场的散度，无需重新训练或修改架构，即可在预训练流匹配模型上实现不确定性量化，计算成本较集成方法降低约10^4倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配生成模型缺乏有效的不确定性量化方法，现有方法（辅助方差头、集成、协方差传播）在训练成本、推理成本或精度之间存在权衡。

Method: 将Tweedie公式从去噪设置扩展到流匹配插值框架，推导出生成轨迹上后验协方差的精确闭式表达式，该表达式仅依赖于学习速度场的散度，可在任意预训练流匹配模型上事后计算。

Result: 在MNIST上验证，得到的逐像素不确定性图具有语义意义，集中在数字边界（样本间变异最大区域）；标量不确定性分数与实际预测误差相关；总计算量比集成或MC Dropout低约10^4倍。

Conclusion: 无需在训练成本、推理成本与精度之间取舍，即可高效实现流匹配模型的不确定性量化，且对一步生成器（如MeanFlow）可在单次前向传播中获得端到端生成不确定性。

Abstract: Flow matching has become a leading framework for generative modeling, but quantifying the uncertainty of its samples remains an open problem. Existing approaches retrain the model with auxiliary variance heads, maintain costly ensembles, or propagate approximate covariance through many integration steps, trading off training cost, inference cost, or accuracy. We show that none of these trade-offs is necessary. By extending Tweedie's formula from the denoising setting to the flow matching interpolant, we derive an exact, closed-form expression for the posterior covariance at every point along the generative trajectory. The result depends on a single quantity, namely the divergence of the learned velocity field, which can be computed post-hoc on any pre-trained flow matching model, requiring no retraining and no architectural modification. For one-step generators such as MeanFlow, the same formula yields the end-to-end generation uncertainty in a single forward pass, eliminating the multi-step variance propagation required by all prior methods. Experiments on MNIST confirm that the resulting per-pixel uncertainty maps are semantically meaningful, concentrating on digit boundaries where inter-sample variation is highest, and that the scalar uncertainty score tracks actual prediction error, all at roughly $10^4 \times$ less total compute than ensembling or Monte Carlo dropout.

</details>


### [988] [ActiveUltraFeedback: Efficient Preference Data Generation using Active Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09692)
*Davit Melikidze,Marian Schneider,Jessica Lam,Martin Wertich,Ido Hakimi,Barna Pásztor,Andreas Krause*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ACTIVEULTRAFEEDBACK，一种基于主动学习的偏好数据标注管线，通过不确定性估计动态选择最具信息量的回应进行标注，在仅需静态基线六分之一标注数据的情况下达到可比或更优的下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLHF中偏好数据获取成本高昂，尤其在低资源和专家领域，亟需高效的数据选择方法来降低标注开销。

Method: 提出ACTIVEULTRAFEEDBACK模块化主动学习管线，利用不确定性估计动态选择信息量最大的回应进行标注；引入DOUBLE REVERSE THOMPSON SAMPLING (DRTS)和DELTAUCB两种新方法，优先选择预测质量差距大的回应对进行标注。

Result: 仅需静态基线六分之一的标注数据即可达到可比或更优的下游性能。

Conclusion: ACTIVEULTRAFEEDBACK能高效生成高质量偏好数据集，显著降低RLHF中的数据标注成本。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) has become the standard for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its efficacy is bottlenecked by the high cost of acquiring preference data, especially in low-resource and expert domains. To address this, we introduce ACTIVEULTRAFEEDBACK, a modular active learning pipeline that leverages uncertainty estimates to dynamically identify the most informative responses for annotation. Our pipeline facilitates the systematic evaluation of standard response selection methods alongside DOUBLE REVERSE THOMPSON SAMPLING (DRTS) and DELTAUCB, two novel methods prioritizing response pairs with large predicted quality gaps, leveraging recent results showing that such pairs provide good signals for fine-tuning.
