Our experiments demonstrate that ACTIVEULTRAFEEDBACK yields high-quality datasets that lead to significant improvements in downstream performance, notably achieving comparable or superior results with as little as one-sixth of the annotated data relative to static baselines. Our pipeline is available at https://github.com/lasgroup/ActiveUltraFeedback and our preference datasets at https://huggingface.co/ActiveUltraFeedback.

</details>


### [989] [Exploring and Exploiting Stability in Latent Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08398)
*Rania Briq,Michael Kamp,Ohad Fried,Sarel Cohen,Stefan Kesselheim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明潜流匹配（LFM）模型对数据缩减和模型容量收缩等扰动具有稳健性，表现为在相同噪声种子下生成相似输出。这种稳定性源于流匹配目标的固有特性，并可用于提升训练和推理效率：1）在缩减数据集上训练可保持性能，且计算受限时收敛更快；2）利用架构收缩特性提出粗细两阶段推理策略（轻量模型+高容量模型），实现两倍以上推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究潜流匹配模型在面对数据缩减和模型容量收缩时的稳定性特性，并利用该特性设计更高效的训练和推理算法。

Method: 1) 从流匹配理论角度解释稳定性根源；2) 在缩减数据集上训练LFM模型验证性能保持性；3) 提出粗细两阶段推理方法（轻量架构用于流匹配轨迹第一阶段，高容量模型用于第二阶段）；4) 引入三种样本评分准则筛选信息量高的样本。

Result: 在多个数据集上验证了：数据节省效果显著；推理速度提升两倍以上且生成质量可比较。

Conclusion: LFM模型的稳定性具有实际优势，可实现训练数据节省和推理加速，同时保持生成质量。

Abstract: In this work, we show that Latent Flow-Matching (LFM) models are robust to different types of perturbations, including data reduction and model capacity shrinkage. We characterize this stability by these models' tendency to generate similar outputs under identical noise seeds. We provide a perspective relating this phenomenon to flow matching theory, which indicates that this stability is inherent to the FM objective. We further exploit this stability to derive practical algorithms for more efficient training and inference. Concretely, first, we show that by training LFM models on significantly reduced datasets, performance is preserved, and in compute-constrained regimes, the model converges faster while maintaining quality. This yields multiple advantages, including savings in the training time due to faster convergence, and alleviating annotation effort when training conditional models. Second, LFM stability under architectural shrinkage gives rise to a two-model coarse-to-fine approach, one using a light-weight architecture for the first phase of the FM trajectory, and one with higher capacity for the second, thereby reducing the inference cost substantially. To determine which samples are informative, we introduce three sample-scoring criteria and evaluate them under standard metrics for generative models. Our results are thoroughly evaluated on multiple datasets, demonstrating the practical advantage of this stability, including data savings and a more than two-fold inference speedup while generating comparable outputs.

</details>


### [990] [A Grammar of Machine Learning Workflows: Rejecting Data Leakage at Call Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10742)
*Simon Roth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于有向无环图的语法结构，通过八种类型化原语和四项硬约束，使最严重的数据泄露类型在语法层面不可表达。核心机制是终端评估门——据我所知，这是截至2026年5月同行评审的ML方法论文献中首个在调用时强制执行的评估/评估边界，并提供了足够精确的规范供独立重实现。基于2,047个数据集的配套景观研究将约束与测量效应量相联系。提供了Python和R两种参考实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据泄露问题在648篇已发表论文中被发现，涵盖30个科学领域。尽管防止数据泄露的知识已存在十多年，但由于工具未能强制执行教科书所教授的原则，问题持续存在。本文旨在通过形式化语法结构从根本上解决这一问题。

Method: 提出一个包含八种类型化原语的语法，这些原语通过有向无环图连接，并施加四项硬约束。核心是引入终端评估门（terminal assessment gate），这是首个在调用时强制执行的评估/评估边界机制，并提供了足够精确的规范供独立重实现。同时通过2,047个数据集的景观研究来验证约束的合理性。

Result: 该语法能够使最严重的数据泄露类型在其作用域内变得结构上不可表达。提供了Python和R两种参考实现。

Conclusion: 通过形式化语法和强制执行机制，可以有效防止数据泄露，解决长期存在于ML社区的方法论问题。

Abstract: Data leakage has been identified in 648 published papers across 30 scientific fields. The knowledge to prevent it has existed for over a decade; the problem persists because the tools do not enforce what the textbooks teach. This paper presents a grammar (eight typed primitives connected by a directed acyclic graph with four hard constraints) that makes the most damaging leakage types structurally unrepresentable within the grammar's scope. The core mechanism is a terminal assessment gate: the first call-time-enforced evaluate/assess boundary documented in the peer-reviewed ML methodology literature (to my knowledge, as of May 2026), backed by a specification precise enough for independent reimplementation. A companion landscape study across 2,047 datasets grounds the constraints in measured effect sizes. Two reference implementations (Python, R) are available.

</details>


### [991] [Learning-Augmented Scalable Linear Assignment Problem Optimization via Neural Dual Warm-Starts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.09382)
*Ilay Yavlovich,Jad Agbaria,Muhamed Mhamed,Nir Weinberger,Jose Yallouz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种学习增强框架，通过轻量级行独立架构RowDualNet预测对偶变量来热启动线性分配问题的精确求解器，配合回退机制保证最坏情况下的最优性，在N=16,384规模下实现超2倍加速，且零样本泛化到真实场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性分配问题的经典精确求解器（如LAPJV）虽保证最优性，但存在O(N³)计算瓶颈；近年神经方法虽尝试加速，但在可扩展性和最优性保证上存在不足。本文旨在结合两者优势，在保持严格最优性的同时加速精确求解过程。

Method: 提出学习增强框架RowDualNet：(1) 采用行独立架构，避免O(N²)内存瓶颈，支持高达N=16,384的规模；(2) 通过Min-Trick机制保证对偶变量可行性，无需迭代投影；(3) 预测对偶变量作为热启动输入精确求解器，配合回退机制保留最坏情况保证。

Result: 在复杂合成数据上实现超2倍端到端加速，真实跟踪场景1.25倍，交通网络1.5倍；具有严格的零样本泛化能力和最优性保证。

Conclusion: 本文证明通过轻量级神经预测器为精确组合优化求解器提供热启动是一种实用且可扩展的范式，在保持理论保证的同时显著提升实际求解效率。

Abstract: The Linear Assignment Problem is a fundamental combinatorial optimization task where classical exact solvers ensure optimality but suffer from an $\mathcal{O}(N^{3})$ bottleneck, while recent neural approximations struggle with scalability and exactness. We propose a learning-augmented framework that accelerates exact solvers by predicting dual variables to warm-start the search, backed by a fallback mechanism to preserve worst-case guarantees. Central to our approach is RowDualNet, a lightweight, row-independent architecture that avoids the $\mathcal{O}(N^{2})$ memory bottleneck of graph models, enabling scalable neural warm-starting up to $N=16{,}384$. Feasibility is guaranteed by construction via the Min-Trick mechanism, completely eliminating the need for costly iterative projections. Empirically, our method drastically reduces the search effort of the Jonker-Volgenant (LAPJV) algorithm, yielding robust zero-shot generalization with strict optimality and end-to-end speedups of over 2x on complex synthetic data, 1.25x on real-world tracking, and 1.5x on transportation networks.

</details>


### [992] [Geometry-Aware Probabilistic Circuits via Voronoi Tessellations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11946)
*Sahil Sidheekh,Sriraam Natarajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出将Voronoi镶嵌引入概率电路以捕获数据流形的局部几何结构，并解决由此导致的推理可追踪性问题，包括近似推理的上下界保证和精确可追踪推理的结构条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准概率电路使用与数据无关的混合权重，无法捕捉数据流形的局部几何结构。

Method: 将Voronoi镶嵌引入概率电路的求和节点；提出近似推理框架以提供推理的上下界保证；推导Voronoi镶嵌下恢复精确可追踪推理的结构条件；引入可微松弛以实现梯度学习。

Result: 在标准密度估计任务上进行了实证验证。

Conclusion: Voronoi镶嵌能够自然地将几何结构引入概率电路，且通过所提出的方法可在保持可追踪性的同时提升模型对数据局部几何的建模能力。

Abstract: Probabilistic circuits (PCs) enable exact and tractable inference but employ data independent mixture weights that limit their ability to capture local geometry of the data manifold. We propose Voronoi tessellations (VT) as a natural way to incorporate geometric structure directly into the sum nodes of a PC. However, naïvely introducing such structure breaks tractability. We formalize this incompatibility and develop two complementary solutions: (1) an approximate inference framework that provides guaranteed lower and upper bounds for inference, and (2) a structural condition for VT under which exact tractable inference is recovered. Finally, we introduce a differentiable relaxation for VT that enables gradient-based learning and empirically validate the resulting approach on standard density estimation tasks.

</details>


### [993] [Frequentist Consistency of Prior-Data Fitted Networks for Causal Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.12037)
*Valentyn Melnychuk,Vahid Balazadeh,Stefan Feuerriegel,Rahul G. Krishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了基于先验数据拟合网络（PFNs）的因果估计量在频率学派视角下的一致性，发现现有PFN作为贝叶斯ATE估计量存在先验诱导的混杂偏差，导致频率不一致。为此提出了一阶后验校正（OSPC）校准程序，结合鞅后验方法恢复功能 nuisance 后验，证明了校准后的PFN可满足半参数Bernstein-von Mises定理，实现与经典半参数有效估计量在分布上依样本量收敛。实验表明校准后的PFN在渐近和有限样本下均能产生与频率学派一致的不确定性量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然PFN在因果推断中表现优异，但尚不明确其不确定性量化是否与经典频率学派估计量一致，即缺乏频率一致性分析的理论保证。

Method: (1) 理论分析了PFN作为贝叶斯ATE估计量时存在先验诱导混杂偏差；(2) 提出OSPC校准程序恢复频率一致性，并证明半参数Bernstein-von Mises定理；(3) 在PFN上定制鞅后验以恢复OSPC所需的功能nuisance后验。

Result: 校准后的PFN在渐近下与频率学派不确定性匹配，在有限样本下相比其他贝叶斯ATE估计量校准更优。

Conclusion: OSPC校准能有效消除PFN的先验诱导混杂偏差，使PFN的因果不确定性量化在频率学派框架下具有一致性保证。

Abstract: Foundation models based on prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) have shown strong empirical performance in causal inference by framing the task as an in-context learning problem. However, it is unclear whether PFN-based causal estimators provide uncertainty quantification that is consistent with classical frequentist estimators. In this work, we address this gap by analyzing the frequentist consistency of PFN-based estimators for the average treatment effect (ATE). (1) We show that existing PFNs, when interpreted as Bayesian ATE estimators, can exhibit prior-induced confounding bias: the prior is not asymptotically overwritten by data, which, in turn, prevents frequentist consistency. (2) As a remedy, we suggest employing a calibration procedure based on a one-step posterior correction (OSPC). We show that the OSPC helps to restore frequentist consistency and can yield a semi-parametric Bernstein-von Mises theorem for calibrated PFNs (i.e., both the calibrated PFN-based estimators and the classical semi-parametric efficient estimators converge in distribution with growing data size). (3) Finally, we implement OSPC through tailoring martingale posteriors on top of the PFNs. In this way, we are able to recover functional nuisance posteriors from PFNs, required by the OSPC. In multiple (semi-)synthetic experiments, PFNs calibrated with our martingale posterior OSPC produce ATE uncertainty that (i) asymptotically matches frequentist uncertainty and (ii) is well calibrated in finite samples in comparison to other Bayesian ATE estimators.

</details>


### [994] [DAPD: Dependency-Aware Parallel Decoding via Attention for Diffusion LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.12996)
*Bumjun Kim,Dongjae Jeon,Moongyu Jeon,Albert No*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DAPD是一种无需训练的解码方法，通过自注意力机制构建条件依赖图，选择独立集并行解码扩散LLM中的掩码token，有效避免强耦合token同时更新，在LLaDA和Dream上提升了精度-步数权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散LLM的并行解码困难，因为每一步去噪仅提供token级别的边缘分布，而同时解掩多个token需要考虑token间的依赖关系。

Method: 利用自注意力构建掩码token上的条件依赖图，图中边捕获强交互token，非边表示弱依赖；然后将并行解码简化为在图上选择独立集，并行解掩选中的token。

Result: 在LLaDA和Dream上的实验表明，DAPD改进了现有方法的精度-步数权衡，能够实现更全局分布的并行更新，更好地利用dLLM的任意顺序生成能力。

Conclusion: DAPD是一种简单、无需训练的解码方法，有效解决了扩散LLM并行解码中token依赖问题，无需辅助模型或重新训练。

Abstract: Parallel decoding for Diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) is difficult because each denoising step provides only token-wise marginal distributions, while unmasking multiple tokens simultaneously requires accounting for inter-token dependencies. We propose Dependency-Aware Parallel Decoding (DAPD), a simple, training-free decoding method that uses self-attention to induce a conditional dependency graph over masked tokens. At each iteration, edges in this graph capture strong token interactions, while non-edges indicate weak dependence. Parallel decoding is then reduced to selecting an independent set on the graph and unmasking the selected tokens in parallel. This avoids co-updating strongly coupled tokens without auxiliary models or retraining. Experiments on LLaDA and Dream show that DAPD improves the accuracy-steps trade-off over existing methods and enables more globally distributed parallel updates that better exploit the any-order generation capability of dLLMs. The project is available at https://ai-isl.github.io/dapd

</details>


### [995] [ES-Merging: Biological MLLM Merging via Embedding Space Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14405)
*Wonbin Lee,Dongki Kim,Sung Ju Hwang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ES-Merging框架，通过嵌入空间信号（而非参数空间）估计合并系数，实现多模态大模型的高效合并，在跨模态推理和单模态知识保留上均优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生物多模态大模型专注于单一模态，无法解决跨模态科学问题；模型合并虽可整合多模态，但现有方法依赖与输入无关的参数空间启发式方法，未能准确捕捉模态专化特性。

Method: ES-Merging框架：利用嵌入空间中的粗粒度信号估计层-wise合并系数，细粒度信号估计元素-wise合并系数，两者联合实现互补性系数估计，将合并范式从参数信号迁移到嵌入信号。

Result: ES-Merging在跨模态推理和单模态知识保留任务上均优于现有合并方法。

Conclusion: 嵌入空间信号为多模态大模型合并提供了有原则且有效的基础，证明了从参数信号到嵌入信号这一范式转换的有效性。

Abstract: Biological multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have emerged as powerful foundation models for scientific discovery. However, existing models are specialized to a single modality, limiting their ability to solve inherently cross-modal scientific problems. While model merging is an efficient method to combine the different modalities into a unified MLLM, existing methods rely on input-agnostic parameter space heuristics that fail to faithfully capture modality specialization. To overcome this limitation, we propose the Embedding-Signal-based MLLM Merging (ES-Merging), a framework that estimates merging coefficients from embedding space signals, moving the merging paradigm from the parameter signals to the embedding signals. ES-Merging exploits coarse-grained and fine-grained signals from embedding space to estimate the layer-wise and element-wise merging coefficients, respectively, which are jointly combined for complementary coefficient estimation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that ES-Merging outperforms existing merging methods not only on the cross-modal reasoning but also on the single-modal knowledge preservation, establishing that embedding space signals provide a principled and effective foundation for MLLM merging.

</details>


### [996] [AgentDS Technical Report: Benchmarking the Future of Human-AI Collaboration in Domain-Specific Data Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19005)
*An Luo,Jin Du,Xun Xian,Robert Specht,Fangqiao Tian,Ganghua Wang,Xuan Bi,Charles Fleming,Ashish Kundu,Jayanth Srinivasa,Mingyi Hong,Rui Zhang,Tianxi Li,Galin Jones,Jie Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AgentDS是一个评估AI智能体与人类-AI协作在领域特定数据科学任务中表现的基准和竞赛。通过17个跨六大行业的挑战、29支队伍和80名参与者的开放竞赛，发现当前AI智能体在领域特定推理上表现不足，纯AI基线低于竞赛参与者前25%的水平，而最强解决方案来自人机协作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管大语言模型和AI智能体在自动化数据科学工作流程方面取得了显著进展，但目前尚不清楚AI智能体在领域特定数据科学任务上能在多大程度上匹配人类专家的表现，以及人类专业知识在哪些方面仍然具有优势。因此需要系统性的基准来评估和比较AI智能体与人类专家的能力差异。

Method: 构建了包含17个挑战的AgentDS基准，涵盖商业、食品生产、医疗、保险、制造和零售银行六大行业。通过开放竞赛形式，收集29支队伍80名参与者的数据，系统比较了人类-AI协作方法与纯AI基线方法的表现。

Result: 当前AI智能体在领域特定推理上表现不佳；纯AI基线方法表现低于竞赛参与者的前25%；人类-AI协作方法产生了最强的解决方案。

Conclusion: 这些发现挑战了AI完全自动化的叙事，强调了人类专业知识在数据科学中持续的重要性，同时为下一代AI的发展指明了方向。

Abstract: Data science plays a critical role in transforming complex data into actionable insights across numerous domains. Recent developments in large language models (LLMs) and artificial intelligence (AI) agents have significantly automated data science workflow. However, it remains unclear to what extent AI agents can match the performance of human experts on domain-specific data science tasks, and in which aspects human expertise continues to provide advantages. We introduce AgentDS, a benchmark and competition designed to evaluate both AI agents and human-AI collaboration performance in domain-specific data science. AgentDS consists of 17 challenges across six industries: commerce, food production, healthcare, insurance, manufacturing, and retail banking. We conducted an open competition involving 29 teams and 80 participants, enabling systematic comparison between human-AI collaborative approaches and AI-only baselines. Our results show that current AI agents struggle with domain-specific reasoning.AI-only baselines perform below the top quartile of competition participants, while the strongest solutions arise from human-AI collaboration. These findings challenge the narrative of complete automation by AI and underscore the enduring importance of human expertise in data science, while illuminating directions for the next generation of AI. Visit the AgentDS website here: https://agentds.org/ and open source datasets here: https://huggingface.co/datasets/lainmn/AgentDS .

</details>


### [997] [Graph Energy Matching: Transport-Aligned Energy-Based Modeling for Graph Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23398)
*Michal Balcerak,Suprosanna Shit,Chinmay Prabhakar,Sebastian Kaltenbach,Michael S. Albergo,Yilun Du,Bjoern Menze*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出图能量匹配（GEM）框架，通过JKO传输映射优化视角学习置换不变势能，结合能量基切换采样策略，在分子图生成任务上达到或超越离散扩散模型性能，同时支持组合生成、属性约束采样和图间插值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散能量基模型（EBM）在采样时易陷入支撑区域外的伪局部极小值，导致训练不稳定和生成质量低于离散扩散模型，亟需弥合这一保真度差距。

Method: 从JKO传输映射优化角度出发，学习置换不变势能函数，同时引导离散传输从噪声向高似然图区域移动并优化样本；引入能量基切换采样策略，结合快速梯度引导传输与局部混合探索。

Result: 在分子图基准上，GEM在多数指标上匹配或超越强离散扩散基线；支持组合生成、属性约束采样和图间插值等目标导向探索任务。

Conclusion: GEM通过JKO视角和能量基切换采样有效弥合了离散EBM与扩散模型之间的保真度差距，同时保留了EBM在可组合概率推理方面的天然优势。

Abstract: Generative modeling of discrete data, such as graphs, underpins many scientific and industrial applications, including molecular discovery and materials design. In these domains, probabilistic inference is particularly valuable, as it enables composable generation and principled incorporation of desired constraints, such as structural or functional properties. Energy-based models naturally support this goal by capturing relative likelihoods and enabling composable inference by directly enforcing constraints during inference. However, discrete energy-based models typically struggle with efficient and high-quality sampling, as off-support regions often contain spurious local minima, trapping samplers and causing training instabilities, resulting in a fidelity gap compared to discrete diffusion models. To address this gap, we introduce Graph Energy Matching (GEM), a discrete generative framework inspired by the Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) transport-map optimization perspective. GEM learns a permutation-invariant potential energy that simultaneously guides discrete transport from noise toward high-likelihood graph regions and refines samples within these regions. We further introduce a sampling protocol leveraging an energy-based switching strategy, seamlessly bridging rapid, gradient-guided transport and a local mixing regime for effective exploration. On molecular graph benchmarks, GEM matches or surpasses strong discrete diffusion baselines on most reported metrics. Beyond improving generation quality, GEM's relative likelihood modeling enables targeted exploration, facilitating compositional generation, property-constrained sampling, and interpolation between graphs. Project page: https://michalbalcerak.ai/graph-energy-matching/.

</details>


### [998] [Large Language Model Guided Incentive Aware Reward Design for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.24324)
*Dogan Urgun,Gokhan Gungor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用大语言模型（LLM）自动生成合作多智能体系统辅助奖励信号的框架，通过形式化有效性约束和基于稀疏任务回报的选择机制，在Overcooked-AI环境中相比手工设计奖励显著提升了任务回报与协调效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体合作系统中，手工设计辅助奖励耗时且易导致激励错配，尤其是在稀疏任务奖励无法有效引导协调行为时，亟需一种自动化的奖励设计方法。

Method: 利用LLM从环境仪表数据合成可执行的奖励程序，将候选程序限制在形式化有效性包络内；使用MAPPO在固定计算预算下从头训练策略；仅基于稀疏任务回报对候选奖励进行跨代选择。

Result: 在四个Overcooked-AI布局上，该方法一致获得了更高的任务回报和交付数量，在交互瓶颈主导的环境（高走廊拥堵、交接依赖、结构不对称）中提升最为显著，且合成的塑形信号在动作选择依赖性和信号对齐方面优于手工设计。

Conclusion: LLM引导的奖励搜索框架在有限预算下自动生成与协作学习兼容的塑形信号，减少了对人工设计的依赖。

Abstract: Designing effective auxiliary rewards for cooperative multi-agent systems remains challenging, as misaligned incentives can induce suboptimal coordination, particularly when sparse task rewards provide insufficient grounding for coordinated behavior. This study introduces an autonomous reward design framework that uses large language models (LLMs) to synthesize executable reward programs from environment instrumentation. The procedure constrains candidate programs within a formal validity envelope and trains policies from scratch using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO) under a fixed computational budget. The candidates are then evaluated on the basis of their performance, and selection across generations solely based on the sparse task returns. The framework is evaluated in four Overcooked-AI layouts characterized by varying levels of corridor congestion, handoff dependencies, and structural asymmetries. The proposed reward design approach consistently yields higher task returns and delivery counts, with the most pronounced gains observed in environments dominated by interaction bottlenecks. Diagnostic analysis of the synthesized shaping components reveals stronger interdependence in action selection and improved signal alignment in coordination-intensive tasks. These results demonstrate that the proposed LLM-guided reward search framework mitigates the need for manual engineering while producing shaping signals compatible with cooperative learning under finite budgets.

</details>


### [999] [Claudini: Autoresearch Discovers State-of-the-Art Adversarial Attack Algorithms for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.24511)
*Alexander Panfilov,Peter Romov,Igor Shilov,Yves-Alexandre de Montjoye,Jonas Geiping,Maksym Andriushchenko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文展示了AI智能体能够自主发现针对LLM的新型对抗攻击算法，在白盒越狱和提示注入攻击上超越了现有方法。通过在自动研究循环中部署前沿智能体（如Claude Code和Codex），该方法在GPT-OSS-Safeguard-20B上达到了80%的攻击成功率（CBRN查询），在Meta-SecAlign-70B上达到100%攻击成功率，远超现有方法。作者主张自动研究应成为防御评估的最低标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗性机器学习领域长期以来认为防御必须针对其定制的攻击进行评估，但手动设计攻击算法效率低且难以覆盖所有可能性。作者希望利用AI智能体的自动化研究能力，自主发现新型对抗攻击算法，从而更严格地评估LLM防御机制的有效性。

Method: 部署前沿AI智能体（Claude Code和Codex）在自动研究循环中运行，智能体可访问30多种现有攻击方法的库和一个固定计算预算的评估脚本。智能体在无关的替代模型上针对纯随机目标令牌强制任务开发攻击方法，然后将发现的攻击方法直接迁移到目标模型上进行白盒越狱和提示注入评估。

Result: 在GPT-OSS-Safeguard-20B上，智能体发现的最佳方法在CBRN查询上达到80%攻击成功率，而现有方法低于50%。在Meta-SecAlign-70B上达到100%攻击成功率，而最佳先前的自动化方法仅达到82%。攻击方法在替代模型上开发后能直接泛化到对抗训练的目标模型。

Conclusion: AI智能体能够自主发现超越现有水平的对抗攻击算法。自动研究（autoresearch）应成为防御评估的最低标准，取代当前依赖人工设计攻击的评估方式。

Abstract: We show that AI agents are capable of discovering novel algorithms for adversarial attacks against LLMs, advancing the state of the art on white-box jailbreaking and prompt injection evaluations. We deploy frontier agents, such as Claude Code and Codex, in an autoresearch loop with access to a library of 30+ prior methods and an evaluation script with a fixed compute budget. We show this pipeline to be effective in jailbreaking OpenAI's GPT-OSS-Safeguard-20B and in prompt injections against Meta-SecAlign-70B, an adversarially robust model. For GPT-OSS-Safeguard, the best agent-discovered method achieves up to 80\% attack success rate on CBRN queries, compared to <50\% for existing methods. For SecAlign, it achieves 100\% ASR, while the best prior automated methods only achieve 82\%. Notably, in our setting, attack methods are developed on unrelated surrogate models for a pure random-target token-forcing task, yet generalize directly to prompt injection on the adversarially trained model. Finally, we trace the lineage of methods developed during autoresearch, characterizing the agents' strategies and failure modes. Adversarial ML has long held that defenses must be evaluated against attacks tailored to them; autoresearch automates this principle, and we argue it should be the minimum bar for defense evaluation going forward.

</details>


### [1000] [What Cosine Similarity of Label Representations Can and Cannot Tell us](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.29488)
*Beatrix M. G. Nielsen,Andreas Grivas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明，对于softmax分类器（包括图像分类器和自回归语言模型），标签表示（即unembeddings）之间的余弦相似度无法提供模型概率的任何信息；而对于sigmoid分类器，所有unembedding对之间的余弦相似度定义了可能的标签组合集合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 余弦相似度常被用来衡量神经网络模型向量表示的相似性，但其与模型概率之间的关系尚不明确，可能存在误导性解释。

Method: 通过理论证明：对于softmax分类器，给定两个unembeddings，可以构造另一个模型在相同输入下产生相同概率，但余弦相似度变为1或-1；对于sigmoid分类器，所有unembedding对的余弦相似度定义了可能的标签组合；对于softmax分类器，需要所有unembedding差值的余弦相似度才能确定可能的排名。

Result: Softmax分类器的unembedding余弦相似度与模型概率无关；Sigmoid分类器的unembedding余弦相似度与标签组合集合相关。

Conclusion: 在未参考产生这些unembeddings的分类器时，直接解释unembedding之间的余弦相似度是具有误导性的。

Abstract: Cosine similarity is often used to measure the similarity of vector representations of neural network models. However, the cosine similarity of representations is not guaranteed to tell us anything about model probabilities. In this paper we show that for a softmax classifier, be it an image classifier or an autoregressive language model, the cosine similarity between label representations (called unembeddings in the paper) does not give any information on the probabilities assigned by the model. Specifically, we prove that given two unembeddings, it is possible to create another model which assigns the same probabilities for all inputs, but where the cosine similarity between the representations is now either 1 or -1. We also show that for a sigmoid classifier (where each input can be assigned multiple labels), all pairwise cosine similarities between the unembeddings define the set of possible label combinations. However, for softmax classifiers (where each input is assigned a ranking of the labels from most to least likely), we need all pairwise cosine similarities between all differences of unembeddings to know which rankings the model can predict. We conclude that it is misleading to interpret the cosine similarity between unembeddings without reference to the classifier that produced them.

</details>


### [1001] [Real-Time Sensing of Inaccessible Physical Fields via an Edge-Deployable Hardware-Portable Graph Neural Operator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.01802)
*William Howes,Jason Yoo,Kazuma Kobayashi,Subhankar Sarkar,Farid Ahmed,Souvik Chakraborty,Syed Bahauddin Alam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VIRSO是一种面向边缘部署的神经算子，通过图谱-空间协同架构实现稀疏边界观测到内部多物理场的实时推理，在百倍加速和超低功耗下达到低于1%的误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子在精度上表现优异，但忽略了在嵌入式边缘平台上的部署问题，无法满足安全关键型监测应用对实时推理和低功耗的实际需求。

Method: 提出VIRSO，采用谱-空分解架构：计算受限的图谱通路和内存带宽受限的空间聚合通路，分别适配数据中心和嵌入式加速器；同时引入网格密度自适应的图构建策略V-KNN减少边数并提升精度。

Result: 推理能效积降低29倍（206→7.0 J·ms）；在Jetson Orin Nano上实现17.0 samples/s、7.06 W板级功耗的嵌入式推理；V-KNN减少34%图边数；三个基准上重建比47:1至156:1，相对L2误差低于1%，参数量更少，推理加速约10^4倍。

Conclusion: 首次实现单瓦级神经算子，证明了硬件协同设计是算子推理中缺失的关键要素，为实时部署提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Real-time inference of inaccessible interior physical fields from sparse boundary observations is a fundamental but unresolved problem in scientific machine learning, with direct relevance to safety-critical monitoring across many engineering applications. Existing neural operators achieve high accuracy but leave deployment to embedded edge platforms unaddressed. Here we introduce VIRSO (Virtual Irregular Real-Time Sparse Operator), the first neural operator with a unique spatial-spectral architecture that explicitly addresses edge-deployment hardware. VIRSO learns a nonlinear mapping from sparse, geometrically disjoint boundary inputs to spatially continuous interior multiphysics fields on irregular unstructured meshes through a spectral-spatial decomposition explicitly aligned with hardware execution: a compute-bound graph spectral pathway and a memory-bandwidth-bound spatial-aggregation pathway, each independently characterized on datacenter and embedded accelerators. The design reduces the inference energy-delay product by 29$\times$ relative to the vanilla graph-operator baseline (206 J$\cdot$ms $\to$ 7.0 J$\cdot$ms on an NVIDIA H200) and enables 17.0 samples/s embedded inference on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano within 7.06 W board-level power, without modification. A mesh-density-adaptive graph construction strategy (V-KNN) simultaneously improves accuracy and reduces graph edge count by 34%. Across three benchmarks with reconstruction ratios from 47:1 to 156:1, VIRSO achieves mean relative $L_2$ errors below 1% with fewer parameters than operator baselines and delivers an inference speedup of $\approx 10^4$ times over the high-fidelity reference solver. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of a single-digit-watt neural operator, establishing hardware co-design as a missing ingredient in operator-based inference and a tractable path to real-time deployment.

</details>


### [1002] [Automated Conjecture Resolution with Formal Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03789)
*Haocheng Ju,Guoxiong Gao,Jiedong Jiang,Bin Wu,Zeming Sun,Shurui Liu,Leheng Chen,Yutong Wang,Yuefeng Wang,Zichen Wang,Wanyi He,Peihao Wu,Liang Xiao,Ruochuan Liu,Bryan Dai,Bin Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个集成非正式推理与形式化验证的自动化框架，由非正式推理智能体Rethlas（结合定理搜索引擎Matlas）和形式化验证智能体Archon（配备LeanSearch，将非正式论证转化为Lean 4形式化证明）组成，成功解决了一个交换代数开放问题并在Lean 4中完成形式化验证，展示了非正式与形式化推理系统协同进行可验证数学研究的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在数学推理方面取得进展，但依赖自然语言推理存在固有的歧义性，导致可靠地求解和验证研究级数学问题仍然困难。

Method: 提出双智能体框架：(1) Rethlas智能体融合推理原语与定理搜索引擎Matlas，探索求解策略并构建候选证明；(2) Archon智能体配备LeanSearch，通过任务分解、迭代细化和自动化证明合成，将非正式论证转化为形式化Lean 4项目，实现机器可验证的正确性。

Result: 该框架解决了一个交换代数开放问题并在Lean 4中完成形式化验证，几乎无需人工介入。额外案例展示了Rethlas在非正式数学推理与发现中的能力，以及Archon将研究级证明形式化为Lean 4的能力。

Conclusion: 强大的定理检索工具能够促进跨领域数学技术的发现与应用，形式化智能体可自主填补非正式论证中的非平凡漏洞。该工作展示了非正式与形式化推理系统配备定理检索工具后协同工作、减少人工投入并支持人机协作数学研究的可行范式。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models have significantly improved their ability to perform mathematical reasoning, extending from elementary problem solving to increasingly capable performance on research-level problems. However, reliably solving and verifying such problems remains challenging due to the inherent ambiguity of natural language reasoning. In this paper, we propose an automated framework that integrates natural language reasoning with formal verification to tackle research-level mathematical problems. Our framework consists of two components: an informal reasoning agent, Rethlas, and a formal verification agent, Archon. Rethlas combines reasoning primitives with our theorem search engine, Matlas, to explore solution strategies and construct candidate proofs. Archon, equipped with LeanSearch, translates informal arguments into formalized Lean 4 projects through task decomposition, iterative refinement, and automated proof synthesis, ensuring machine-checkable correctness. Using this framework, we resolve an open problem in commutative algebra and formally verify the resulting proof in Lean 4 with essentially no human involvement. Additional case studies illustrate the capabilities of Rethlas in informal mathematical reasoning and discovery, as well as the ability of Archon to formalize research-level proofs in Lean 4. Our experiments demonstrate that strong theorem retrieval tools enable the discovery and application of cross-domain mathematical techniques, while the formal agent can autonomously fill nontrivial gaps in informal arguments. More broadly, our work illustrates a promising paradigm for mathematical research in which informal and formal reasoning systems, equipped with theorem retrieval tools, operate in tandem to produce verifiable results, reduce human effort, and support human-AI collaborative mathematical research.

</details>


### [1003] [Which Leakage Types Matter? A Quantitative Landscape Across 2,047 Benchmark Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04199)
*Simon Roth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过28个受试者内反事实实验（涵盖2,047个iid表格数据集）和1个边界实验（129个时序数据集），系统测量了机器学习中四类数据泄漏的严重程度：I类（估计泄漏：在全数据上拟合 scaler）可忽略（|ΔAUC|≤0.005）；II类（选择泄漏：窥探、种子挑选）影响显著，约90%的噪声被利用以虚报分数；III类（记忆泄漏）随模型容量增加（10%重复时，朴素贝叶斯d_z=0.37，决策树d_z=1.11）；IV类（边界泄漏）在随机交叉验证下不可见。在该iid表格数据场景下，教科书的重点被颠覆：归一化泄漏最不重要，而实际数据集规模下的选择泄漏最为重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化机器学习中不同数据泄漏类别的实际影响严重程度，挑战教科书中对各类泄漏重要性的传统排序。

Method: 采用受试者内反事实实验设计，在2,047个iid表格数据集上进行28个实验，并在129个时序数据集上进行边界实验，系统比较四类数据泄漏（估计、选择、记忆、边界）的性能影响。

Result: I类泄漏影响极小（|ΔAUC|≤0.005）；II类泄漏影响最显著（约90%噪声被利用）；III类泄漏影响随模型容量增大；IV类泄漏在随机CV下不可见。教科书传统排序被颠覆：归一化泄漏最不重要，选择泄漏最重要。

Conclusion: 在iid表格数据场景下，数据泄漏的重要性排序与教科书相反：选择泄漏的危害最大，而通常被强调的归一化泄漏影响可忽略。

Abstract: Twenty-eight within-subject counterfactual experiments across 2,047 iid tabular datasets, plus a boundary experiment on 129 temporal datasets, measure the severity of four data leakage classes in machine learning. Class I (estimation: fitting scalers on full data) is negligible: all nine conditions produce $|ΔAUC| \leq 0.005$. Class II (selection: peeking, seed cherry-picking) is substantial: the measured effect is consistent with about 90% noise exploitation inflating reported scores. Class III (memorization) scales with model capacity: $d_z$ = 0.37 (Naive Bayes) to 1.11 (Decision Tree) at 10% duplication. Class IV (boundary) is invisible under random cross-validation. Within this iid tabular regime, the textbook emphasis is inverted: normalization leakage matters least; selection leakage at practical dataset sizes matters most.

</details>


### [1004] [A Theoretical Framework for Statistical Evaluability of Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.05324)
*Shashaank Aiyer,Yishay Mansour,Shay Moran,Han Shao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了生成模型评估的理论框架，证明了有界测试类的积分概率度量（IPMs）可从有限样本中可靠评估（具有乘性和加性近似误差），且当测试类具有有限fat-shattering维数时可任意精度评估；而Rényi散度和KL散度因稀有事件的决定性影响无法从有限样本中评估；同时分析了困惑度的潜力与局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成模型的评估因模型本身的开放性而面临挑战：目前尚不清楚哪些指标是合适的，以及这些指标能否从有限样本中可靠地评估。本文旨在从理论上解决这一基础性问题。

Method: 建立了生成模型评估的理论框架，将评估指标分为两类——基于测试的指标（包括积分概率度量IPMs）和Rényi散度，分别分析其有限样本下的可评估性。对于IPMs，证明了有界测试类下的可评估性及fat-shattering维数有限时的任意精度评估；对于Rényi散度和KL散度，分析其因稀有事件导致的不可评估性；并分析了困惑度。

Result: 1) IPMs（有界测试类）可从有限样本中评估，具有乘性和加性近似误差；若测试类fat-shattering维数有限，可任意精度评估。2) Rényi散度和KL散度不可从有限样本评估，其值被稀有事件关键决定。3) 困惑度存在其潜力与局限。

Conclusion: 生成模型评估并非所有常用指标都可行：基于测试类的IPMs是可评估的，而基于散度的指标（如KL、Rényi）则不可靠。这为实际评估生成模型提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Statistical evaluation aims to estimate the generalization performance of a model using held-out i.i.d. test data sampled from the ground-truth distribution. In supervised learning settings such as classification, performance metrics such as error rate are well-defined, and test error reliably approximates population error given sufficiently large datasets. In contrast, evaluation is more challenging for generative models due to their open-ended nature: it is unclear which metrics are appropriate and whether such metrics can be reliably evaluated from finite samples.
  In this work, we introduce a theoretical framework for evaluating generative models and establish evaluability results for commonly used metrics. We study two categories of metrics: test-based metrics, including integral probability metrics (IPMs), and Rényi divergences. We show that IPMs with respect to any bounded test class can be evaluated from finite samples up to multiplicative and additive approximation errors. Moreover, when the test class has finite fat-shattering dimension, IPMs can be evaluated with arbitrary precision. In contrast, Rényi and KL divergences are not evaluable from finite samples, as their values can be critically determined by rare events. We also analyze the potential and limitations of perplexity as an evaluation method.

</details>


### [1005] [A Direct Approach for Handling Contextual Bandits with Latent State Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08149)
*Zhen Li,Gilles Stoltz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了上下文线性赌博机模型，其中上下文和奖励由有限隐马尔可夫链控制。首先改进了Nelson等人简化模型的理论分析，考虑了HMM参数估计和概率界。其次研究了更复杂的依赖隐状态的模型，提出周期性更新奖励模型参数的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究隐马尔可夫链控制下的线性上下文赌博机模型，解决现有理论分析中未充分考虑HMM参数估计影响以及更复杂隐状态依赖模型的处理问题。

Method: 1) 对简化模型（奖励基于后验信念而非隐状态）进行理论扩展，纳入HMM参数估计的遗憾界分析，提供不依赖奖励函数的高概率界。2) 对更复杂的隐状态直接依赖模型，利用经典HMM遗忘条件，提出周期性更新奖励模型参数的算法。

Result: 简化模型实现了将HMM参数估计纳入遗憾界的理论分析；复杂模型下通过周期性参数更新有效应对统计依赖问题。

Conclusion: 本文为隐马尔可夫控制下的线性上下文赌博机提供了更完善的理论分析框架，特别是对更自然的隐状态依赖模型提出了可行的算法方案。

Abstract: We consider a linear contextual bandit model where contexts and rewards are governed by a finite hidden Markov chain. We first revisit the simplified model by Nelson et al. (2022), in which rewards are linear functions of the posterior probabilities over the hidden states given the observed contexts (called beliefs), rather than functions of the hidden states themselves. This simplified model may be handled through a direct reduction to standard linear contextual bandits. We extend the theoretical analysis of this reduction to take into account the estimation of the parameters of the hidden Markov model [HMM] in the regret bound and to provide high-probability bounds not depending anymore on the reward functions and only depending on the model through the estimation of the HMM parameters. Second, and most importantly, we instead study the more natural and more complex model incorporating direct dependencies in the hidden states (on top of dependencies on the observed contexts, as is natural for contextual bandits). Under a classic HMM forgetting condition, the main algorithmic tool introduced to cope with the various statistical dependencies that the reward structure introduces is to only periodically update reward-model parameters.

</details>


### [1006] [U-Cast: A Surprisingly Simple and Efficient Frontier Probabilistic AI Weather Forecaster](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09041)
*Salva Rühling Cachay,Duncan Watson-Parris,Rose Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出U-Cast，一种基于标准U-Net架构的概率天气预报模型，通过MAE确定性预训练+CRPS概率微调的简单训练策略，在1.5°分辨率下匹配甚至超越GenCast和IFS ENS的预报技巧，同时训练计算量降低10倍以上，推理延迟降低10倍以上，仅需不到12个H200 GPU天即可完成训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目前SOTA的AI天气预报模型（如GenCast）依赖专用架构和巨大计算预算，门槛极高。作者认为这种复杂性并非实现前沿性能的必要条件，旨在用标准架构和高效训练策略降低门槛。

Method: 采用标准U-Net骨干网络；两阶段训练策略：先以MAE损失进行确定性预训练，再以CRPS（连续排序概率评分）进行短时间概率微调；使用Monte Carlo Dropout引入随机性实现概率预测。

Result: 在1.5°分辨率下匹配或超越GenCast和IFS ENS的概率预报技巧；训练计算量比领先的CRPS模型降低10倍以上；推理延迟比扩散模型降低10倍以上；训练仅需不到12个H200 GPU天；生成15天集合预报仅需3秒。

Conclusion: 可扩展的通用架构配合高效训练策略能够以极低成本匹配复杂领域专用设计的性能，为更广泛的社区打开了训练前沿概率天气预报模型的大门。

Abstract: AI-based weather forecasting now rivals traditional physics-based ensembles, but state-of-the-art (SOTA) models rely on specialized architectures and massive computational budgets, creating a high barrier to entry. We demonstrate that such complexity is unnecessary for frontier performance. We introduce \ours, a probabilistic forecaster built on a standard U-Net backbone trained with a simple recipe: deterministic pre-training on Mean Absolute Error followed by short probabilistic fine-tuning on the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) using Monte Carlo Dropout for stochasticity. As a result, our model matches or exceeds the probabilistic skill of GenCast and IFS ENS at $1.5^\circ$ resolution while reducing training compute by over $10\times$ compared to leading CRPS-based models and inference latency by over $10\times$ compared to diffusion-based models. U-Cast trains in under 12 H200 GPU-days and generates a 15-day ensemble forecast in 3 seconds. These results suggest that scalable, general-purpose architectures paired with efficient training curricula can match complex domain-specific designs at a fraction of the cost, opening the training of frontier probabilistic weather models to the broader community.

</details>


### [1007] [SCOPE: Signal-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation Enhancement with Dual-Path Adaptive Weighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10688)
*Binbin Zheng,Xing Ma,Yiheng Liang,Jingqing Ruan,Xiaoliang Fu,Kepeng Lin,Benchang Zhu,Ke Zeng,Xunliang Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SCOPE提出了一种双路径自适应训练框架，通过将on-policy rollout按正确性路由到两个互补监督路径（错误轨迹使用教师困惑度加权KL蒸馏，正确轨迹使用学生困惑度加权MLE），并采用组级归一化校准权重分布，在六个推理基准上实现了显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy强化学习已成为大语言模型推理对齐的主流范式，但其稀疏的outcome-level奖励导致token-level信用分配困难。现有的On-Policy Distillation虽然引入了密集的token级KL监督，但均匀地应用在所有rollout上，忽略了信号质量的根本差异。

Method: SCOPE采用双路径自适应训练框架：(1) 错误轨迹路径：使用教师困惑度加权KL蒸馏，优先关注教师具有真正纠正能力的实例，降低不可靠指导的权重；(2) 正确轨迹路径：使用学生困惑度加权MLE，集中强化能力边界上的低置信度样本。两条路径均采用组级归一化自适应校准权重分布，以考虑不同提示间的内在难度差异。

Result: 在六个推理基准上的实验表明，SCOPE在Avg@32和Pass@32指标上分别实现了11.42%和7.30%的平均相对提升，优于竞争基线，证明了其一致的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过信号校准的自适应蒸馏机制，SCOPE有效解决了on-policy蒸馏中信号质量差异问题，为LLM推理对齐提供了一种更高效的token级信用分配方法。

Abstract: On-policy reinforcement learning has become the dominant paradigm for reasoning alignment in large language models, yet its sparse, outcome-level rewards make token-level credit assignment notoriously difficult. On-Policy Distillation (OPD) alleviates this by introducing dense, token-level KL supervision from a teacher model, but typically applies this supervision uniformly across all rollouts, ignoring fundamental differences in signal quality. We propose Signal-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation Enhancement (SCOPE), a dual-path adaptive training framework that routes on-policy rollouts by correctness into two complementary supervision paths. For incorrect trajectories, SCOPE performs teacher-perplexity-weighted KL distillation to prioritize instances where the teacher demonstrates genuine corrective capability, while down-weighting unreliable guidance. For correct trajectories, it applies student-perplexity-weighted MLE to concentrate reinforcement on low-confidence samples at the capability boundary rather than over-reinforcing already mastered ones. Both paths employ a group-level normalization to adaptively calibrate weight distributions, accounting for the intrinsic difficulty variance across prompts. Extensive experiments on six reasoning benchmarks show that SCOPE achieves an average relative improvement of 11.42% in Avg@32 and 7.30% in Pass@32 over competitive baselines, demonstrating its consistent effectiveness.

</details>


### [1008] [Necessary and sufficient conditions for universality of Kolmogorov-Arnold networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.23765)
*Vugar Ismailov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KANs）的通用逼近性质，证明了只要存在一个非仿射的边缘函数，深层KAN即可实现通用逼近；对于两层KAN则需要非多项式函数；此外，仿射函数可用有限集替代而不影响通用性，且基于样条的KAN也是通用逼近器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究KANs中边缘函数的仿射性对其通用逼近能力的影响，明确需要多少非仿射函数才能保证通用逼近性质。

Method: 理论分析与证明：分别针对深度KAN和两层KAN，证明了通用逼近成立的充要条件；构造了有限仿射函数族并证明其可行性；分析样条参数化KAN的经典通用逼近性质。

Result: （1）深度KAN中只需一个非仿射连续函数σ即可实现通用逼近，当且仅当σ非仿射；（2）两层KAN中通用逼近成立当且仅当σ非多项式；（3）仿射函数类可用五个固定仿射函数替代；（4）对任意非仿射σ，存在有限仿射族A_σ使得通用性保持；（5）固定样条次数和节点序列的KAN仍是经典通用逼近器。

Conclusion: KANs的通用逼近性质对边缘函数的仿射性高度敏感，但仅需极少的非仿射函数即可实现通用逼近，且仿射函数集可大幅简化。

Abstract: We analyze the universal approximation property of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) in terms of their edge functions. If these functions are all affine, then universality clearly fails. How many non-affine functions are needed, in addition to affine ones, to ensure universality? We show that a single one suffices. More precisely, we prove that deep KANs in which all edge functions are either affine or equal to a fixed continuous function $σ$ are dense in $C(K)$ for every compact set $K\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ if and only if $σ$ is non-affine. In contrast, for KANs with exactly two hidden layers, universality holds if and only if $σ$ is nonpolynomial. We further show that the full class of affine functions is not required; it can be replaced by a finite set without affecting universality. In particular, in the nonpolynomial case, a fixed family of five affine functions suffices when the depth is arbitrary. More generally, for every continuous non-affine function $σ$, there exists a finite affine family $A_σ$ such that deep KANs with edge functions in $A_σ\cup\{σ\}$ remain universal. We also prove that KANs with the spline-based edge parameterization introduced by Liu et al.~\cite{Liu2024} are universal approximators in the classical sense, even when the spline degree and knot sequence are fixed in advance.

</details>


### [1009] [Consistent Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00161)
*Hasan Amin,Yuan Gao,Yaser Souri,Subhojit Som,Ming Yin,Rajiv Khanna,Xia Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出多路径离散一致性（MPDC）原理，并实例化为一致扩散语言模型（CDLM），通过训练去噪器在精确后验桥上实现路径不变性，实现单阶段、无需教师模型的快速离散文本生成，在少步采样下取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型虽具亚线性并行生成潜力，但高质量样本仍需大量精炼步骤；连续域的一致性训练依赖概率流ODE，而离散扩散不存在样本空间ODE，导致直接迁移不可行。

Method: 提出多路径离散一致性（MPDC），利用精确后验桥（closed-form条件律）作为离散域的替代，训练去噪器在随机桥路径上期望路径不变；实例化为CDLM，采用单阶段训练框架，无需预训练教师模型。

Result: 在条件和无条件文本生成任务上均达到新SOTA，一致优于强基线离散扩散模型及多阶段蒸馏基线，在少步采样场景下增益最大。

Conclusion: CDLM为快速、高保真离散生成建模提供了有原则且可扩展的基础框架。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) are an attractive alternative to autoregressive models because they promise sublinear-time, parallel generation, yet practical gains remain elusive as high-quality samples still demand hundreds of refinement steps. In continuous domains, consistency training along the probability-flow ODE is a popular recipe to accelerate diffusion. For discrete diffusion, no analogous sample-space ODE exists, making direct adaptation ill-defined. We argue that the right discrete substitute is the exact posterior bridge, the closed-form conditional law linking any two noise levels, which is available for broad corruptions including masked and uniform diffusion. Building on this observation, we introduce Multi-Path Discrete Consistency (MPDC), a new principle that trains a denoiser to be path-invariant in expectation across these stochastic bridges, and instantiate it as the Consistent Diffusion Language Model (CDLM), a single-stage training framework that does not require an already trained teacher model. Our CDLM objective recovers masked diffusion, continuous consistency models, and progressive or discrete distillation as analytic limits or empirical approximations of one common view. Empirically, CDLM establishes a new state of the art on both conditional and unconditional text-generation, consistently outperforming strong base discrete diffusion models and often even multi-stage distilled baselines across sampling budgets, with the largest gains in the few-step regime. Together, these results position CDLM as a principled and scalable foundation for the next generation of fast, high-fidelity discrete generative modeling.

</details>


### [1010] [Mesh Field Theory: Port-Hamiltonian Formulation of Mesh-Based Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00394)
*Satoshi Noguchi,Yoshinobu Kawahara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Mesh Field Theory (MeshFT)及其神经实现MeshFT-Net，通过将网格物理的拓扑结构与度量结构分离，在最小物理原则约束下证明物理动力学可分解为端口-哈密顿形式，实现近乎零能量漂移、高物理保真度和数据效率的物理仿真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的物理仿真方法常将拓扑与度量结构混杂，导致模型需要学习大量非物理自由度，物理一致性差、数据效率低。本文旨在通过理论分析明确物理仿真中哪些结构是固定的（拓扑），哪些是可学习的（度量），从而提供一种具有原则性归纳偏置的框架。

Method: 从最小物理原则（局域性、置换等变性、定向协变性、能量平衡/耗散不等式）出发，通过归约定理证明网格物理动力学可分解为端口-哈密顿形式：保守互连由网格拓扑唯一确定，度量效应仅通过本构关系和耗散项进入。基于此理论设计MeshFT-Net，仅学习与度量相关的结构。

Result: 在解析和真实数据集上，MeshFT-Net实现近乎零能量漂移、正确的色散关系和动量守恒，具备鲁棒的外推能力和高数据效率，通过物理一致性测试和分布外验证。

Conclusion: 通过消除非物理自由度并仅学习度量依赖的结构，MeshFT为基于学习的物理仿真提供了原则性的归纳偏置，实现了稳定、忠实且数据高效的仿真。

Abstract: We present Mesh Field Theory (MeshFT) and its neural realization, MeshFT-Net: a structure-preserving framework for mesh-based continuum physics that cleanly separates the physics' topological structure from its metric structure. Imposing minimal physical principles (locality, permutation equivariance, orientation covariance, and energy balance/dissipation inequality), we prove a reduction theorem for mesh-based physics. Under these conditions, the physical dynamics admit a local factorization into a port-Hamiltonian form: the conservative interconnection is fixed uniquely by mesh topology, whereas metric effects enter only through constitutive relations and dissipation. This reduction clarifies what must be fixed and what should be learned, directly informing MeshFT-Net's design. Across evaluations on analytic and realistic datasets, physics-consistency tests, and out-of-distribution validation, MeshFT-Net achieves near-zero energy drift and strong physical fidelity (correct dispersion and momentum conservation) along with robust extrapolation and high data efficiency. By eliminating non-physical degrees of freedom and learning only metric-dependent structure, MeshFT provides a principled inductive bias for stable, faithful, and data-efficient learning-based physical simulation.

</details>


### [1011] [Continuous Temporal Representations of Event-Based Signals via Interference-Based Wave Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01270)
*Magnus Bengtsson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于干涉波表示的连续时间建模框架，将事件驱动的生物信号（如sEMG）映射到复值潜在波场中，通过相位调制和分量间相互作用编码时间结构，无需显式递归或因果状态传播即可实现结构化激活模式，实验证明该方法在表征质量和计算效率上优于纯实值表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统离散或纯实值表示难以有效建模表面肌电信号（sEMG）等事件驱动生物过程中产生的异步、高度结构化的时空激活模式。

Method: 提出基于干涉波表示的连续时间建模框架：将事件输入信号映射到复值潜在波场，通过相位调制和潜在分量间的相互作用编码时间结构，随后将波场投影到能量域以诱导结构化激活模式，无需显式递归或因果状态传播。

Result: 实验结果表明，所提出的干涉波模型相比纯实值表示提供了更优的表征质量，同时保持了适合实际部署的计算效率。

Conclusion: 基于干涉波的连续表示方法特别适合事件驱动的生物信号处理，可实现高效梯度优化和鲁棒特征提取，在下游生物力学系统控制任务（如假肢和外骨骼）中具有应用潜力。

Abstract: Spatio-temporal signals arising from event-driven biological processes, such as surface electromyography (sEMG), exhibit asynchronous and highly structured activation patterns that are challenging to model using conventional discrete or purely real-valued representations.
  In this work, we propose a continuous temporal modeling framework based on interference-based wave representations. The approach maps event-like input signals into a complex-valued latent wave field, where temporal structure is encoded through phase modulation and interactions between latent components.
  By projecting the resulting wave field onto an energy domain, the model induces structured activation patterns that capture both temporal localization and relational dependencies within finite observation windows, without relying on explicit recurrence or causal state propagation.
  The proposed formulation is particularly suited for event-driven biosignals, where continuous representations enable efficient gradient-based optimization and robust feature extraction. In particular, the method is designed to support learning from sEMG data for downstream control tasks in biomechanical systems, such as prosthetic devices and exoskeletons.
  Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed interference-based wave model provides improved representation quality compared to purely real-valued representations, while maintaining computational efficiency suitable for practical deployment.

</details>


### [1012] [Robust Linear Dueling Bandits with Post-serving Context under Unknown Delays and Adversarial Corruptions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01752)
*Youngmin Oh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了易变环境下的线性对抗型老虎机问题，同时面临服务后上下文、延迟反馈和对抗性损坏三种挑战，提出了RCDP-UCB算法，实现了$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d(\sqrt{T} + \mathcal{C} + \mathcal{D}))$的遗憾上界，且损坏与延迟之间呈加性成本结构，避免了乘性退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有线性对抗型老虎机算法通常假设反馈即时到达且环境无损坏，但在实际应用中（如推荐系统、在线广告）普遍存在服务后上下文（如用户后续行为）、反馈延迟和恶意攻击。亟需一种能同时处理这三种挑战的鲁棒算法。

Method: 提出RCDP-UCB算法，包含两个核心设计：(1) 学习一个近似器，从服务前信息预测服务后上下文；(2) 采用自适应加权策略对特征向量进行裁剪，同时缓解损坏和延迟观测的影响。

Result: 在标准正则性条件和参数化服务后映射下，算法达到延迟-体制无关的$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d(\sqrt{T} + \mathcal{C} + \mathcal{D}))$遗憾上界；建立了匹配的下界（仅差$\sqrt{d}$因子）；损坏与延迟呈加性而非乘性关系。

Conclusion: RCDP-UCB是首个同时处理服务后上下文、延迟反馈和对抗性损坏的线性对抗型老虎机算法，其加性成本结构显著优于先前工作的乘性退化。

Abstract: We study linear dueling bandits in volatile environments characterized by the simultaneous presence of post-serving contexts, delayed feedback, and adversarial corruption. Feedback is subject to unknown stochastic or adversarial delays and a cumulative corruption budget $\mathcal{C}$. To address these challenges, we propose e RCDP-UCB, which integrates a learned approximator that predicts post-serving contexts from pre-serving information. It further employs an adaptive weighting strategy that clips feature vectors to mitigate the impact of corrupted and delayed observations simultaneously. Under standard regularity conditions and a parametric post-serving mapping, we rigorously establish that our algorithm is delay-regime-agnostic, achieving a regret upper bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(d(\sqrt{T} + \mathcal{C} + \mathcal{D}))$, where $d$ is the total feature dimension and $\mathcal{D}$ encapsulates the delay complexity. Crucially, our analysis reveals an additive cost structure between corruption and delay, avoiding the multiplicative degradation typical of prior works. We further establish lower bounds that nearly match our upper bounds up to a $\sqrt{d}$ factor for adversarial delays in the absence of post-serving contexts. Code is available at https://github.com/youngmin0oh/rcdp-public.

</details>


### [1013] [Unsat Core Prediction through Polarity-Aware Representation Learning over Clause-Literal Hypergraphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04819)
*Zhenchao Sun,Shuai Ma,Ping Lu,Chongyang Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种极性感知的表示学习框架，通过子句-文字超图建模SAT公式，并引入极性分解机制和一致性正则化来更好地捕捉SAT结构中的高阶交互和极性相关特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于GNN的SAT方法将公式建模为二分图或有向无环图，难以直接捕获子句级和高阶的文字-子句交互，且对SAT中固有的极性相关性质（如正负文字间的互补关系）建模不足。

Method: 1) 将SAT公式建模为子句-文字超图，并通过子句关联图增强以捕获高阶结构交互；2) 提出极性感知分解机制，将变量表示分解为极性不变和极性等变两部分，显式建模正负文字关系；3) 引入极性翻转一致性正则化强化训练中的极性一致表示。

Result: 在多个SAT数据集上的实验结果表明所提方法有效。

Conclusion: 通过超图建模和极性感知机制，该方法能够更有效地捕获SAT公式的结构信息和极性特性，优于现有建模方法。

Abstract: Graph neural networks have been widely used in Boolean satisfiability (SAT) tasks to learn structural information from SAT formulas. The goal of these studies is to solve SAT instances or to enhance SAT solvers, including tasks such as unsat-core prediction. However, most existing approaches model a SAT formula as a bipartite graph or a directed acyclic graph, which are less direct in capturing clause-level and higher-order interactions among literals and clauses. Moreover, these approaches are limited in modeling intrinsic polarity-related properties of SAT, such as the complementary relationship between the positive and negative literals of a variable. To address these limitations, we propose a polarity-aware representation learning framework over clause-literal hypergraphs. We model SAT formulas as clause-literal hypergraphs augmented with a clause incidence graph to capture higher-order structural interactions. We then introduce a polarity-aware decomposition mechanism that separates variable representations into polarity invariant and equivariant components, explicitly modeling the relationship between positive and negative literals, with the resulting literal representations propagated along the hypergraph structure. We further incorporate a polarity-inversion consistency regularization to reinforce polarity-consistent representations during training. Experimental results on multiple SAT datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [1014] [MidSteer: Optimal Affine Framework for Steering Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05220)
*Tatiana Gaintseva,Andrew Stepanov,Ziquan Liu,Martin Benning,Gregory Slabaugh,Jiankang Deng,Ismail Elezi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文形式化了概念引导（concept steering）的理论框架，证明标准引导方法是LEACE的特例，提出LEACE-Switch实现最优概念切换，并引入更通用的MidSteer框架，在多种模型和模态中取得优异效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管概念引导在生成模型的后部署对齐和安全设置中取得了经验成功，但缺乏系统的理论框架，作者旨在弥合这一差距。

Method: 1) 建立引导与仿射概念擦除（LEACE）之间的理论联系；2) 提出LEACE-Switch实现最优仿射概念切换；3) 引入MidSteer（最小扰动概念引导）作为更通用的仿射框架，放宽假设条件，支持定向最小扰动变换。

Result: MidSteer在多种任务、模态和架构（包括视觉扩散模型和大语言模型）上表现优越。

Conclusion: 本文为概念引导提供了统一的理论基础，提出的MidSteer框架在保持最小扰动的同时实现了灵活可控的概念操作，具有广泛的适用性。

Abstract: Steering intermediate representations has emerged as a powerful strategy for controlling generative models, particularly in post-deployment alignment and safety settings. However, despite its empirical success, it currently lacks a comprehensive theoretical framework. In this paper, we bridge this gap by formalizing the theory of concept steering. First, we establish a link between steering and affine concept erasure, proving that the standard approach for removing unwanted behaviors is a special case of LEACE (a closed-form method for affine erasure). Next, we formulate a principled theoretical framework for concept switching, LEACE-Switch, and characterize the assumptions under which it provides an optimal affine solution. Building on this analysis, we then introduce MidSteer (Minimal Disturbance concept Steering), a more general affine framework for concept manipulation that relaxes these assumptions and enables directed, minimal-disturbance transformations. We demonstrate that MidSteer performs favorably across a range of tasks, modalities, and architectures, including vision diffusion models and large language models.

</details>


### [1015] [Why Self-Inconsistency Arises in GNN Explanations and How to Exploit It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07527)
*Wenxin Tai,Yaqian Liu,Ting Zhong,Fan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对自解释图神经网络(SI-GNNs)中解释自不一致性问题，提出再解释诱导的上下文扰动是分数变化的直接原因，并引入潜在信号分配假设解释边缘敏感性的差异，最后提出无需训练的后处理策略Self-Denoising(SD)来校准解释，仅需一次额外前向传播即可提升解释质量，计算开销仅增加约4-6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自解释图神经网络产生的解释存在自不一致性——当模型重新应用于其自身的解释子图时，可能产生不同的解释。然而，这种自不一致性产生的根本原因尚不清楚。

Method: 1) 识别再解释诱导的上下文扰动为分数变化的直接原因；2) 提出潜在信号分配假设解释边缘敏感性的差异；3) 分析简洁性正则化对潜在信号分配的影响；4) 提出Self-Denoising(SD)，一种模型无关、无需训练的后处理策略，通过一次额外前向传播校准解释。

Result: 实验支持了提出的假设，SD方法在多种SI-GNN框架、骨干架构和基准数据集上 consistently 提升了解释质量，且计算开销仅增加约4-6%。

Conclusion: 自不一致性源于上下文扰动导致的部分边缘分数变化，SD方法能有效过滤不稳定的边缘证据，以极低的计算成本提升解释质量。

Abstract: Recent work has observed that explanations produced by Self-Interpretable Graph Neural Networks (SI-GNNs) can be self-inconsistent: when the model is reapplied to its own explanatory graph subset, it may produce a different explanation. However, why self-inconsistency arises remains poorly understood. In this work, we first identify re-explanation-induced context perturbation as the direct cause of score variation. We then introduce a latent signal assignment hypothesis to explain why only some edges are sensitive to this perturbation, and analyze how conciseness regularization affects latent signal assignment. Given that self-inconsistent edges do not provide stable evidence for the model's prediction, we propose Self-Denoising (SD), a model-agnostic and training-free post-processing strategy that calibrates explanations with only one additional forward pass. Experiments across representative SI-GNN frameworks, backbone architectures, and benchmark datasets support our hypothesis and show that SD consistently improves explanation quality while adding only about 4--6\% computational overhead in practice.

</details>


### [1016] [Prune-OPD: Efficient and Reliable On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07804)
*Zhicheng Yang,Zhijiang Guo,Yifan Song,Minrui Xu,Yongxin Wang,Yiwei Wang,Xiaodan Liang,Jing Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Prune-OPD通过动态监控师生预测的局部兼容性（如top-k重叠），在检测到前缀漂移时自动截断无效生成并降低不可靠奖励的权重，从而将计算资源重新分配给可用的教师监督，在长程任务上减少37.6%-68.0%训练时间的同时保持或提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy distillation (OPD)在长程任务中面临前缀漂移问题：学生生成轨迹偏离教师思维过程后，教师提供的密集奖励丧失局部可利用性，继续在漂移轨迹上生成和评估token不仅降低奖励质量，还造成巨大计算浪费。

Method: 提出Prune-OPD框架，通过持续监控学生与教师预测之间的局部兼容性（如top-k重叠）实时检测前缀漂移事件；一旦检测到严重漂移，单调降低后续不可靠奖励的权重并触发动态展开截断，从而停止无效生成并将计算重新分配到可靠的教师监督上。

Result: 在多种师生组合上，Prune-OPD将训练时间减少37.6%-68.0%，同时在AMC、AIME、HMMT等挑战性基准上保持甚至提升性能。当师生兼容性高时，它自动保留长上下文监督并扩展训练窗口。

Conclusion: Prune-OPD改进OPD的关键不在于盲目缩短展开长度，而在于将计算重新分配到局部可用的教师奖励上，实现了训练预算与监督质量的对齐。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) leverages dense teacher rewards to enhance reasoning models. However, scaling OPD to long-horizon tasks exposes a critical flaw: as the student's generated prefix inevitably diverges from the teacher's thought process, the teacher's dense reward loses local exploitability. Continuing to generate and evaluate tokens on these ``drifted'' trajectories not only degrades reward quality but also incurs massive computational waste. To address this, we introduce \textbf{Prune-OPD}, a framework that dynamically aligns training budgets with supervision quality. By continuously monitoring the local compatibility between student and teacher predictions (e.g., via top-$k$ overlap), Prune-OPD detects prefix-drift events in real time. Upon detecting severe drift, it monotonically down-weights subsequent unreliable rewards and triggers dynamic rollout truncation. This allows the training process to halt futile generation and reallocate compute strictly to reliable teacher supervision. Across diverse teacher-student combinations, Prune-OPD consistently aligns computation with supervision reliability. When prefix drift makes dense teacher rewards unreliable, it reduces training time by 37.6\%--68.0\% while preserving, and often improving, performance on challenging benchmarks (AMC, AIME, HMMT). When student-teacher compatibility remains high, it automatically preserves long-context supervision by expanding the training window. These results suggest that Prune-OPD improves OPD not by blindly shortening rollouts, but by reallocating computation toward locally exploitable teacher rewards.

</details>


### [1017] [Language Modeling with Hyperspherical Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11125)
*Justin Deschenaux,Caglar Gulcehre*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出S-FLM，一种在超球面潜空间中进行连续流语言建模的方法，通过旋转向量而非处理one-hot编码来生成序列，在保持并行生成能力的同时，显著提升了大词汇表推理任务上的性能，缩小了与掩码扩散模型在标准温度采样下的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型由于因子化采样表达能力弱于自回归模型；连续流语言模型（FLM）虽避免了因子化采样，但需要处理与词汇表大小成比例的one-hot向量，训练成本高，且高斯噪声在高维one-hot空间中缺乏语义解释。

Method: 将序列生成建模为超球面S^{d-1}上的向量旋转过程，通过交叉熵损失学习速度场，避免了显式one-hot向量的计算开销。

Result: S-FLM在标准温度采样（T=1）下显著改进了连续流语言模型在大词汇表推理任务上的性能，缩小了与掩码扩散模型的差距；但在优化后的低温解码（T=0.1）下仍存在差距。

Conclusion: 超球面潜空间中的连续流语言模型是一种有前景的替代方案，在推理任务上优于传统FLM，但在低温解码场景下仍需进一步改进。

Abstract: Discrete Diffusion Language Models progressed rapidly as an alternative to autoregressive (AR) models, motivated by their parallel generation abilities. However, for tractability, discrete diffusion models sample from a factorized distribution, which is less expressive than AR. Recent Flow Language Models (FLMs) apply continuous flows to language, transporting noise to data with a deterministic ODE that avoids factorized sampling. FLMs operate on one-hot vectors whose dimension scales with the vocabulary size, making FLMs costly to train. Moreover, since all distinct one-hot embeddings are equidistant in $\ell_2$, adding Gaussian noise does not have a clear semantic interpretation (unlike images, where Gaussian noise progressively degrades structure). We introduce $\mathbb{S}$-FLM, a latent FLM in the hypersphere. $\mathbb{S}$-FLM generates sequences by rotating vectors in $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}$ along a velocity field learned with cross-entropy, avoiding the overhead of materializing one-hot vectors. Previous FLMs match AR in Generative Perplexity (Gen.\ PPL), but samples with high likelihood are not necessarily correct in verifiable domains such as math and code. $\mathbb{S}$-FLM substantially improves continuous flow language models on large-vocabulary reasoning and closes the gap to masked diffusion under standard-temperature sampling ($T=1$), while a gap remains under optimized low-temperature ($T=0.1$) decoding.

</details>


### [1018] [Test-Time Compute for Frozen Embedding Models through Agentic Program Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11374)
*Han Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文论证小型嵌入模型同样能从测试时计算中获益：通过在大语言模型编码器API上编写程序（无参数训练），探索出144个候选程序中的12个帕累托最优程序，在所有14个发现任务上提升nDCG@10，且这些程序无需修改即可迁移到19个未见任务和3种未见编码器家族上，而同等预算下的学习型投影头则无法实现跨编码器迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战"测试时计算仅对大型推理模型有益"的普遍认知，探索小型嵌入模型在推理阶段是否也能通过增加计算量来提升检索质量，且无需额外模型或参数训练。

Method: 采用智能体循环方式，让大语言模型在冻结的编码器API上编写程序，探索144个候选程序，得到12个帕累托最优程序。这些程序使用经典检索原语（如倒数排名融合、Fisher线性判别、Rocchio伪相关反馈、句子级MaxSim），无任何可训练参数。

Result: 所有12个帕累托最优程序在全部14个发现任务上均提升nDCG@10，成本比从1.2到14.7。单个固定程序在19个未见任务上提升多数任务，中位ΔnDCG@10为正，在c≥4时胜率54-57%。在未见编码器家族上增益最大。而学习型投影头在域内提升0.20-0.25 nDCG@10，但在所有未见编码器上均低于基线。

Conclusion: 小型嵌入模型继承了可用的测试时计算潜力，冻结编码器可将推理计算转化为检索增益，且能迁移到新的语料库和编码器上，无需每域标签。

Abstract: Test-time compute is widely believed to benefit only large reasoning models, leaving small models with nothing to gain. We argue the opposite for dense retrieval, since modern small embedding models are distilled or adapted from large language model backbones and can inherit their latent test-time-compute potential. We ask how much retrieval quality a frozen embedding model gains at inference alone, with no auxiliary model and no parameters trained at deployment. An agentic loop in which a large language model writes programs over a frozen encoder API explores 144 candidates and yields twelve Pareto-optimal programs that trade inference compute for quality across cost ratios from $c{=}1.2$ to $14.7$, every one improving nDCG@10 on all 14 discovery tasks. The programs use no trainable parameters and recover classical retrieval primitives, among them reciprocal rank fusion, the Fisher linear discriminant, Rocchio pseudo-relevance feedback, and sentence-level MaxSim. Applied unmodified to nineteen held-out tasks and three unseen encoder families, a single fixed program improves the majority of tasks, with a positive median $Δ$nDCG@10 and a 54 to 57% win-rate at $c{\ge}4$, and the gains are largest on encoder families never seen during discovery. A matched-budget learned projection head trained on the same tasks does not transfer this way, improving in-domain retrieval by $+0.20$ to $+0.25$ nDCG@10 yet falling below baseline on every held-out encoder. Small embedding models therefore inherit usable test-time-compute potential, and a frozen encoder converts inference compute into retrieval gains that transfer to new corpora and encoders with no per-domain labels.

</details>


### [1019] [OGLS-SD: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Outcome-Guided Logit Steering for LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12400)
*Yuxiao Yang,Xiaoyun Wang,Weitong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出OGLS-SD框架，通过结果引导的逻辑导向来解决基于策略的自蒸馏（OPSD）中教师与学生响应模式不匹配导致的训练不稳定问题，在数学推理基准上提升了性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPSD中教师自省响应会引入反射偏差和响应模板，导致token级监督失准，损害学生推理能力，亟需缓解训练不稳定问题。

Method: 提出OGLS-SD（结果引导的逻辑导向框架），利用可验证的结果奖励校准特权教师logits，通过对比成功与失败策略轨迹诱导的教师logits构建结果判别性导向方向，实现token级指导。

Result: 在数学推理基准上，OGLS-SD稳定了自蒸馏过程，性能优于标准OPSD及其他变体。

Conclusion: OGLS-SD通过结果引导的logits校准有效缓解了OPSD中模式不匹配问题，提升了自蒸馏的稳定性和学生推理能力。

Abstract: We study on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), where a language model improves its reasoning ability by distilling privileged teacher distributions along its own on-policy trajectories. Despite its promise, OPSD can suffer from training instability due to a pattern mismatch between teacher and student responses. Self-reflected teacher responses may introduce reflection-induced biases and response templates that miscalibrate token-level supervision, ultimately harming the student's reasoning ability. To mitigate this issue, we propose OGLS-SD, an outcome-guided logit-steering framework that leverages verifiable outcome rewards to calibrate privileged teacher logits. Specifically, OGLS-SD contrasts teacher logits induced by successful and failed on-policy trajectories, constructing an outcome-discriminative steering direction for token-level guidance. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that OGLS-SD stabilizes self-distillation and improves performance over standard OPSD and other variants.

</details>


### [1020] [Multi-Rollout On-Policy Distillation via Peer Successes and Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12652)
*Weichen Yu,Xiaomin Li,Yizhou Zhao,Xiaoze Liu,Ruowang Zhang,Haixin Wang,Yinyi Luo,Chen Henry Wu,Gaurav Mittal,Matt Fredrikson,Yu Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出多 rollout 在线策略蒸馏（MOPD），通过将同一提示的多次学生 rollout（包括成功和失败）作为上下文输入教师模型，构建更密集、更具适应性的 token 级监督信号，在编程、数学推理、科学问答和工具使用等基准上持续优于标准在线策略基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型后训练常依赖稀疏的验证器奖励信号（仅指示轨迹是否成功），缺乏对推理过程成功/失败位置的细粒度指导。现有在线策略蒸馏方法虽提供更密集的 token 级监督，但每个 rollout 被独立蒸馏，忽略了同一提示下多次尝试之间的有用信息。

Method: 提出 MOPD 框架，利用学生模型对同一提示的多次 rollout 组成局部 rollout 组，将成功和失败的 peer rollout 作为上下文条件输入教师模型。两种 peer-context 构建方式：正样本模仿（positive peer imitation）和对比性成功-失败条件（contrastive success-failure conditioning）。教师模型基于该上下文生成更准确、实例自适应的 token 级监督信号。

Result: 在竞争性编程、数学推理、科学问答和工具使用基准上，MOPD 持续优于标准在线策略基线。教师信号分析表明，混合成功-失败上下文能更好地使教师评分与验证器奖励对齐，表明性能提升源于更忠实、实例自适应的监督。

Conclusion: 有效的在线策略蒸馏应利用学生多次 rollout 的试错行为，而非将 rollout 视为孤立样本独立处理。

Abstract: Large language models are often post-trained with sparse verifier rewards, which indicate whether a sampled trajectory succeeds but provide limited guidance about where reasoning succeeds or fails. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers denser token-level supervision by training on student-generated trajectories, yet existing methods typically distill each rollout independently and ignore the other attempts sampled for the same prompt. We introduce Multi-Rollout On-Policy Distillation (MOPD), a peer-conditioned distillation framework that uses the student's local rollout group to construct more informative teacher signals. MOPD conditions the teacher on both successful and failed peer rollouts: successes provide positive evidence for valid reasoning patterns, while failures provide structured negative evidence about plausible mistakes to avoid. We study two peer-context constructions: positive peer imitation and contrastive success-failure conditioning. Experiments on competitive programming, mathematical reasoning, scientific question answering, and tool-use benchmarks show that MOPD consistently improves over standard on-policy baselines. Further teacher-signal analysis shows that mixed success-failure contexts better align teacher scores with verifier rewards, indicating that the gains arise from more faithful, instance-adaptive supervision. These results indicate that effective on-policy distillation should exploit the student's multi-rollout trial-and-error behavior rather than treating rollouts as isolated samples.

</details>


### [1021] [Revisiting Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards from a Contrastive Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12969)
*Feng Zhang,Xinhong Ma,Ziqiang Dong,Xi Leng,Jianfei Zhao,Xin Sun,Yang Yang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出现有GRPO算法存在两个目标层面的局限：可能性错位的代理分数和分数不敏感的信用分配。为此提出ConSPO方法，使用长度归一化的序列对数概率作为分数，并通过对比学习和课程学习机制来优化。实验表明ConSPO在推理任务上优于强基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO作为最广泛使用的RLVR算法之一，存在两个目标层面的局限性：1) 似然错位的代理分数（优化裁剪比率分数而非控制生成的序列似然）；2) 分数不敏感的信用分配（卷积分数的分配不反映当前正负样本的分数差距）。

Method: 提出ConSPO方法：1) 使用长度归一化的序列对数概率作为卷积分；2) 在同一组内对比验证过的正样本与负样本；3) 优化组级InfoNCE风格目标函数，自适应地增强对分离度差的正样本和高分负样本的更新；4) 引入课程调度边距，在训练过程中保持分离压力。

Result: 在多种设置下的实验表明，ConSPO在具有挑战性的推理基准测试上优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: ConSPO通过对比序列级策略优化有效解决了GRPO的目标层面局限性，在推理任务上取得了更好性能。

Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is one of the most widely adopted RLVR algorithms for post-training large language models on reasoning tasks. We first show that GRPO admits an equivalent discriminative reformulation, in which policy optimization maximizes the expected score gap between verified positive and negative rollouts. This reformulation reveals two objective-level limitations: likelihood-misaligned surrogate scores, in which clipped ratio-based scores are optimized rather than the sequence likelihoods that govern generation, and score-insensitive credit assignment, in which rollout-level credit does not reflect the current score gaps between positive and negative rollouts. To address these limitations, we propose ConSPO, a Contrastive Sequence-level Policy Optimization method that uses length-normalized sequence log-probabilities as rollout scores and contrasts verified positive rollouts against negative distractors within the same group. ConSPO optimizes a group-wise InfoNCE-style objective to adaptively strengthen updates for poorly separated positives and high-scoring negatives, together with a curriculum-scheduled margin that preserves separation pressure as training progresses. Experiments across diverse settings show that ConSPO outperforms strong baselines on challenging reasoning benchmarks. Code will be released upon paper acceptance.

</details>


### [1022] [Do Heavy Tails Help Diffusion? On the Subtle Trade-off Between Initialization and Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13175)
*Hamza Cherkaoui,Hélène Halconruy,Antonio Ocello*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过理论和实验证明，在扩散模型中使用重尾噪声虽然直观上有利于恢复目标分布的尾部，但实际上会使统计估计问题变得更困难，导致更差的采样误差界，挑战了当前生成建模中使用重尾噪声提升稀有区域探索的设计趋势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究提出在扩散和流式生成模型中使用重尾噪声，旨在更好地恢复目标分布的尾部并提高生成多样性。这种动机直观上合理——如果数据本身是重尾的，重尾噪声可能比轻尾高斯噪声更匹配。然而，替换高斯噪声为重尾噪声也改变了底层的估计问题，本文旨在重新审视这一范式。

Method: 通过结合理论和实证研究，建立两种代表性扩散模型（分别由重尾和轻尾噪声驱动）的采样误差界，并在合成和真实数据集上进行实验验证。

Result: 重尾噪声使统计估计问题更难，导致更不利的采样误差界；实验在合成和真实数据集上验证了预测的误差权衡。

Conclusion: 本文结果质疑了生成建模中日益增长的重尾噪声设计趋势，挑战了使用重尾噪声改善稀有区域探索的有效性。

Abstract: Recent works have proposed incorporating heavy-tailed (HT) noise into diffusion- and flow-based generative models, with the goals of better recovering the tails of target distributions and improving generative diversity. This motivation is intuitive: if the data are heavy-tailed, HT noise may appear better matched than light-tailed (LT) Gaussian noise. However, replacing Gaussian noise by HT noise also changes the underlying estimation problem. In this paper, we revisit this paradigm through a combined theoretical and empirical study, establishing sampling-error bounds for two representative diffusion models driven by HT and LT noise. We show that HT noise makes the statistical estimation problem harder, leading to less favorable sampling-error bounds. We support these findings with experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets, empirically recovering the predicted error trade-off. Our results call into question a growing design trend in generative modeling and challenge the use of HT noise to improve rare-region exploration.

</details>


### [1023] [Topology-Preserving Neural Operator Learning via Hodge Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13834)
*Dongzhe Zheng,Tao Zhong,Christine Allen-Blanchette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从函数空间视角研究几何网格上的物理场方程求解算子，揭示了Hodge正交性通过将不可学习的拓扑自由度与可学习的几何动力学分离，从根本上解决频谱干扰问题，从而实现在结构保持子空间上的加性逼近。基于Hodge理论和算子分裂，推导出算子级分解，提出混合欧拉-拉格朗日架构及代数级归纳偏置——Hodge谱对偶（HSD）。该方法利用离散微分形式捕捉拓扑主导成分，并用正交辅助环境空间表示复杂局部动力学，在几何图上实现了更优的精度、效率和物理不变量保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在几何网格上求解物理场方程时，频谱干扰导致可学习的几何动力学与不可学习的拓扑自由度相互耦合，难以实现高效且保结构的学习。

Method: 从函数空间视角出发，利用Hodge正交性分离拓扑自由度与几何动力学；基于Hodge理论和算子分裂进行算子级分解；设计混合欧拉-拉格朗日架构，其中离散微分形式捕捉拓扑成分，正交辅助环境空间表示局部动力学；引入代数级归纳偏置Hodge谱对偶（HSD）。

Result: 在几何图上，该方法相比现有方法取得了更高的精度和计算效率，同时对物理不变量具有更强的保真度。

Conclusion: Hodge正交性可有效解决频谱干扰问题，基于Hodge理论的结构保持分解方法能够提升物理场方程求解的准确性和效率，为几何图上的物理学习提供了新的范式。

Abstract: In this paper, we study solution operators of physical field equations on geometric meshes from a function-space perspective. We reveal that Hodge orthogonality fundamentally resolves spectral interference by isolating unlearnable topological degrees of freedom from learnable geometric dynamics, enabling an additive approximation confined to structure-preserving subspaces. Building on Hodge theory and operator splitting, we derive a principled operator-level decomposition. The result is a Hybrid Eulerian-Lagrangian architecture with an algebraic-level inductive bias we call Hodge Spectral Duality (HSD). In our framework, we use discrete differential forms to capture topology-dominated components and an orthogonal auxiliary ambient space to represent complex local dynamics. Our method achieves superior accuracy and efficiency on geometric graphs with enhanced fidelity to physical invariants. Our code is available at https://github.com/ContinuumCoder/Hodge-Spectral-Duality

</details>


### [1024] [OgBench: A Framework for Evaluating Graph Neural Networks on Omics Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15511)
*Louisa Cornelis,Johan Mathe,Louis Van Langendonck,Guillermo Bernárdez,Nina Miolane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出OgBench（Omics-Graph Bench），首个面向组学数据中n≪p（样本少、节点多）场景的图级预测基准平台。通过对经典GNN、面向大图的GNN、MLP及传统机器学习方法进行标准化评测，发现广泛使用的GNN往往不及简单MLP和传统基线，挑战了图结构在该领域天然有效的假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图学习基准大多关注n≫p（图数量远大于每图节点数）的场景，而组学数据（如基因、转录本、蛋白质网络）处于相反的n≪p（少量样本、大量节点）区间，这一低样本高节点场景下GNN的表现尚未被系统研究。

Method: 构建了从原始组学数据到多种结构化特征图谱的端到端标准化模块化基础设施，设计并实施了涵盖经典GNN、面向大图的GNN、组学专用GNN、MLP及传统机器学习基线的全面基准实验。

Result: 广泛使用的GNN在组学n≪p场景下往往无法超越简单的MLP和经典机器学习基线方法。

Conclusion: 挑战了图结构在组学领域天然具有价值的普遍假设，促进对当前学习范式的批判性反思；同时提供了一个开源生态系统，供社区开发并验证专门针对生物图的新型架构。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have become the dominant framework for inductive graph-level learning. Yet most benchmarks focus on the regime $n \gg p$, where the number of graphs $n$ greatly exceeds the number of nodes per graph $p$. This overlooks biological domains such as omics, which operate in the opposite $n \ll p$ regime, characterized by large graphs of genes, transcripts, or proteins across few patient samples. This raises the question: \textit{how do GNNs perform in this low-sample, high-node omics setting?} We introduce \texttt{OgBench} (Omics-Graph Bench), the first benchmarking platform for graph-level prediction in the $n \ll p$ regime characteristic of omics data. We provide a standardized, end-to-end modular infrastructure from raw omics data to families of featured graphs with varied structural properties. We benchmark classical GNNs, as well as GNNs designed for large graphs and omics applications, alongside MLPs and machine learning baselines to establish reference performances. Our results show that widely used GNNs often do not outperform simple MLPs and classical baselines. These findings challenge the prevailing assumption that graph structure inherently adds value in this domain, fostering a critical reassessment of current learning paradigms. Ultimately, by exposing these limitations, OgBench provides the open-source ecosystem necessary for the community to develop and validate novel architectures explicitly tailored for biological graphs. The code is available at https://github.com/geometric-intelligence/ogbench.

</details>


### [1025] [Avoiding Structural Failure Modes in Tabular Fair SSL: Online Primal-Dual Allocation under Confidence Gating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16446)
*Hangchuan Liang,Changchun Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对表格数据公平半监督学习中的结构冲突，提出在线原始-对偶分配（OPDA）控制器，通过调度公平性和熵稳定性惩罚避免掩码崩溃和平凡饱和两种失效模式，无需逐数据集调参即可实现非退化运行点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在医疗、信贷、再犯预测等高风险表格数据应用中，半监督学习虽能利用有限标签进行预测，但需要统计公平性保证。现有基于置信度门控伪标签的公平半监督学习方法中，矩匹配公平正则化器会触发掩码崩溃（公平性侵蚀置信度，导致伪标签饥饿）和平凡饱和（漂移至常数预测器）两种失效模式。

Method: 提出在线原始-对偶分配（OPDA）控制器，利用违反度、风险和伪标签健康信号动态调度公平性和熵稳定性惩罚，避免在诊断区间内使用固定公平权重。通过在线控制替代静态加权和简单单信号自适应基线。

Result: 在Adult、ACSIncome、COMPAS三个表格基准数据集上，OPDA缓解了静态权重和简单自适应基线下的退化问题。在Adult和COMPAS上达到与静态λ经验前沿竞争的非退化运行点；在ACSIncome上保持了更宽的公平-效用权衡范围。

Conclusion: OPDA可作为无需校准的控制器，在表格公平半监督学习中实现非退化运行点，无需逐数据集调参。

Abstract: Semi-supervised learning (SSL) enables prediction with limited labels, but high-stakes tabular applications (medical, credit, recidivism) require statistical fairness guarantees. We identify a structural conflict in tabular fair SSL through a diagnostic stress test: under confidence-gated pseudo-labeling, moment-matching fairness regularizers can trigger two failure modes -- Masking Collapse (fairness erodes confidence, starving pseudo-labels) and Trivial Saturation (drift to constant predictors). We propose Online Primal-Dual Allocation (OPDA), an online controller that schedules fairness and entropy-based stability penalties using violation, risk, and pseudo-label health signals, avoiding per-dataset selection of a fixed fairness weight within this diagnostic regime. On the evaluated tabular benchmarks (Adult, ACSIncome, COMPAS), OPDA mitigates the degenerate regimes observed under static weighting and simple single-signal adaptive baselines. On Adult and COMPAS, it yields non-degenerate operating points competitive with the empirical static-$λ$ frontier; on ACSIncome, it preserves utility with a wider fairness-utility spread. Relative to OPDA-lite, the full controller mainly shifts the operating point toward higher utility on ACSIncome, while Adult highlights the fairness-utility trade-off between the two variants. These results position OPDA as a calibration-free controller for non-degenerate operating points in tabular fair SSL without per-dataset tuning.
