</details>


### [1026] [Physics-Guided Geometric Diffusion for Macro Placement Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16451)
*Jongho Yoon,Jinsung Jeon,Seokhyeong Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MacroDiff+ 是一个用于 VLSI 宏单元布局的物理引导几何扩散框架，通过双域去噪架构（异构图神经网络+Transformer）和物理引导采样策略，在 ISPD2005 MMS 基准上实现线长减少 6.1-6.2%，并在大规模设计中展现出优异的稳定性和可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动布局方法难以处理序列依赖，且无法平衡拓扑连接性与物理约束，亟需一种能够同时建模拓扑与几何约束的布局方法。

Method: 提出 MacroDiff+ 框架，包含：(1) 双域去噪架构，耦合异构 GNN 编码的拓扑连接性与 Transformer 建模的全局几何上下文；(2) 物理引导采样（Physics-Guided Sampling），在推理阶段利用显式梯度引导生成，确保统计合理性和物理有效性。

Result: 在 ISPD2005 MMS 基准上，线长比 SOTA 基线降低 6.1-6.2%；在大规模设计中表现出优越的稳定性和可扩展性，先前方法无法收敛的场景下 MacroDiff+ 仍能有效工作。

Conclusion: MacroDiff+ 通过物理引导的几何扩散框架有效解决了宏单元布局中的拓扑-几何平衡问题，在性能、稳定性和可扩展性上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Macro placement is a pivotal stage in VLSI physical design, fundamentally determining the overall chip performance. Recent data-driven placement methods have demonstrated significant potential, yet they often struggle to handle sequential dependencies and to balance topological connectivity with physical constraints. To bridge this gap, we propose MacroDiff+, a physics-guided geometric diffusion framework. Specifically, we design a dual-domain denoising architecture that couples topological connectivity encoded by heterogeneous GNNs with global geometric context modeled by a Transformer. Furthermore, we introduce Physics-Guided Sampling, an inference strategy that actively steers the generation using explicit gradients to ensure both statistical plausibility and physical validity. On the ISPD2005 MMS benchmarks, MacroDiff+ outperforms state-of-the-art baselines with a 6.1-6.2% reduction in wirelength. Notably, it exhibits superior stability and scalability on large-scale designs where prior methods fail to converge. The source code is available at https://github.com/jhy00n/MacroDiff-plus.

</details>


### [1027] [Privacy Policy Enforcement Guardrails for Data-Sensitive Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17034)
*Osama Zafar,Alexander Nemecek,Yiqian Zhang,Wenbiao Li,Debargha Ganguly,Vikash Singh,Vipin Chaudhary,Erman Ayday*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于双单类密度估计器的隐私策略执行（PPE）框架，用于检测RAG系统中非标准属性的上下文数据泄露，在医学、金融和法律领域的合成数据上，T3+OCSVM检测器在边界安全样本上达到0.93+ AUROC，误报率降低44-55个百分点，同时保持毫秒级延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准PII过滤器通常遗漏RAG系统中非受监管属性聚类的上下文数据泄露，需要更鲁棒的隐私保护方法。

Method: 提出PPE框架，使用双单类密度估计器结合融合文本嵌入和校准的回绝区域处理分布外输入；通过轴分层、多LLM合成数据管道生成医学、金融和法律领域的训练数据；提出T3+OCSVM检测器。

Result: T3+OCSVM在边界安全样本上AUROC达到0.93+，误报率降低44-55个百分点，毫秒级延迟；优于传统高斯混合基线、监督MLP分类器和14B参数LLM评判器。

Conclusion: 该方法为任何基于合成数据训练的分类器提供了鲁棒的应力测试标准，在实际部署中具有优越的操作适用性。

Abstract: Standard PII filters often miss contextual data leakage in RAG systems, such as non-regulated attribute clusters that collectively identify individuals. We introduce a Privacy Policy Enforcement (PPE) framework using dual one-class density estimators with fused text embeddings and a calibrated abstain region for out-of-distribution inputs. Using an axis-stratified, multi-LLM synthetic data pipeline across medicine, finance, and law, we found that traditional Gaussian Mixture baselines fail on borderline-safe stress tests by focusing on linguistic register rather than content.
  Our proposed T3+OCSVM detector, trained on safe and borderline-safe data, achieves a borderline AUROC of 0.93+ while reducing false positives by 44-55 percentage points and maintaining millisecond latency. Compared to supervised MLP classifiers or 14B-parameter LLM judges, our framework offers superior operational suitability, as the former suffers from high abstention rates and the latter from latency and calibration issues. This methodology provides a robust stress-testing standard for any synthetic-data-trained classifier.

</details>


### [1028] [DynMuon: A Dynamic Spectral Shaping View of Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17109)
*Fangzhou Wu,Rikhav Shah,Sandeep Silwal,Qiuyi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DynMuon，一种动态谱整形方法，通过将优化器更新矩阵的奇异值指数p从正值调度到轻微负值，在训练大语言模型时相比Muon方法降低验证损失，并减少10.6-26.5%的训练步数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon方法通过将梯度更新矩阵替换为其极因子UV^T在LLM训练中取得主导地位，但现有方法忽视了更新矩阵奇异值谱的整形对训练动态的影响。作者旨在探索如何根据局部曲率、随机梯度噪声和训练阶段自适应地选择谱整形参数p，以进一步优化训练效率。

Method: 提出一类Muon-like更新：将更新矩阵M替换为UΣ^p V^T（谱整形）。理论上分析p的选择依赖于(a)损失函数局部曲率、(b)随机梯度和标签噪声、(c)训练阶段。基于理论发现（正p早期强调高曲率方向加速信号收缩，轻微负p后期将更新强度重新分配至仍含有效信号的低曲率方向），提出DynMuon，动态地将p从正值调度到轻微负值。

Result: 跨模型规模、架构和训练设置的大量实验表明，DynMuon相比Muon持续取得更低的验证损失，且达到相同目标损失所需的训练步数减少10.6-26.5%。

Conclusion: 谱整形策略p的动态调度能有效提升Muon类优化器的训练效率，早期强调高曲率方向、后期利用低曲率方向中的有效信号。

Abstract: In recent years, Muon has emerged as the dominant method for training large language models, and transformers more broadly. The essential difference, when compared to standard gradient descent methods, is to replace the usual update matrix $M=UΣV^\top$ with its polar factor $UV^\top$. In this work, we consider a class of Muon-like updates, where we replace the update $M$ with $UΣ^p V^\top$ for some parameter $p$. We call this a "spectral-shaping" operation, and develop a theory of how to pick $p$ which depends on (a) local curvature of the loss function, (b) noise stemming from stochastic gradients and label noise, and (c) training stage. Our theory and experimentation reveal a previously overlooked behavior: positive $p$ helps early by emphasizing high-curvature directions and accelerating signal contraction, while mildly negative $p$ helps later by reallocating update strength toward low-curvature directions that still contain useful training signals. Building on the insight, we propose DynMuon, an efficient dynamic spectral shaping method that schedules $p$ from positive to mildly negative over training. Extensive experiments across model sizes, architectures, and training settings show that DynMuon consistently achieves lower validation loss than Muon, while requiring 10.6-26.5% fewer steps to reach the same target loss. Our code is available at https://github.com/fzwark/DynMuon.

</details>


### [1029] [Balancing Knowledge Distillation for Imbalance Learning with Bilevel Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17839)
*Anh B. H. Nguyen,Ba Tho Phan,Viet Cuong Ta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BiKD双层框架，通过权重生成网络为每个样本动态调整硬损失和软损失的权重，利用小规模平衡验证集指导训练，并在长尾CIFAR-10/100上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏方法在长尾数据上使用固定的硬/软损失权重，无法适应样本级别的差异，且未考虑学生模型在训练中的动态行为。

Method: 提出BiKD双层优化框架：1）权重生成网络为每个样本生成自适应权重；2）利用小规模平衡验证集引导权重网络训练；3）采用多步SGD策略优化权重模型。

Result: 在长尾CIFAR-10/100数据集上，BiKD在不同不平衡因子下均超越了现有平衡蒸馏方法。

Conclusion: 样本级别的自适应损失权重机制能有效提升长尾数据上的知识蒸馏性能。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation transfers knowledge from a high capacity teacher to a compact student using a mixture of hard and soft losses. On imbalanced data, a fixed weighting between hard and soft losses becomes brittle the learning process. Recent studies try to reweight these components in long-tailed settings. However, most of these methods do not adapt weights at the sample-wise level and do not take into account the students behavior during training. To address this, we propose BiKD -- a bilevel framework that dynamically balances hard and soft losses for each sample. We employ a weight generation network that produces adaptive per-sample weights, guided by a small balanced validation set. The student is now trained with an unconstrained combination of weighted hard and soft losses, allowing the student to relax both terms. We further propose a multi-step SGD strategy to optimize the weight model more accurately and efficiently. Experiments on long-tailed CIFAR-10/100 show that our approach surpasses recent balanced distillation methods across imbalance factors.

</details>


### [1030] [Lying Is Just a Phase: The Hidden Alignment Transition in Language Model Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18838)
*Adil Amin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文发现推理能力与真实性之间存在相变关系：在小规模模型（低于家族特定临界规模N_c）中两者负相关（r=-0.989），在大规模模型中正相关。通过宽度归一化可消除负相关，支持输出投影瓶颈假说。仅需公开基准分数即可诊断，并在前沿模型中验证了合作相的存在。提出一种无需重训练的单向量干预方法，可纠正60%的错位输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有缩放定律仅预测损失与计算量的关系，无法解释能力间的相互作用。论文旨在揭示推理能力与真实性之间的耦合关系及其相变机制。

Method: 对16个系列63个基础模型进行测量，使用非参数置换检验分析推理与真实性的相关性；通过宽度归一化、注意力头分析、稀疏回归ODE等方法验证输出投影瓶颈假说；设计单向量干预方法进行验证。

Result: 发现临界规模N_c约3.5B参数，低于此规模时推理与真实性强负相关（r=-0.989），高于时转为正相关；架构、数据筛选、训练方法可独立移动N_c；宽度归一化消除所有系列的负相关；38/40模型无竞争注意力头；ODE交叉预测误差5.6%；前沿模型验证合作相（r=+0.72）；单向量干预纠正60%错位输出。

Conclusion: 推理与真实性之间存在由输出投影瓶颈导致的相变，可通过架构改进或数据筛选消除负相关，并提出一种轻量级、无需重训练的干预方法进行后训练修正。

Abstract: Scaling laws predict loss from compute but not how capabilities interact. We measure the coupling between reasoning and truthfulness across 63 base models from 16 families and find a regime change invisible to loss curves: below a family-dependent critical scale N_c, capabilities anticorrelate (r = -0.989, p = 4 x 10^{-5} nonparametric permutation test); above it, they cooperate. N_c ~ 3.5B parameters [2.9B, 13.4B] (bootstrap 95% CI), but model size is not the only variable that determines phase. Architecture, data curation, and training recipe each shift N_c independently: curated training eliminated the coupling dip between Qwen generations (0.025 to 0.830 at matched scale), Gemma-4 at 4B achieves coupling 0.871, characteristic of 13B+ standard-trained models, through distillation and architectural innovation, and Phi at 1B matches web-trained coupling at 10B through data curation alone. Width normalization eliminates the anticorrelation across all tested families, supporting an output-projection bottleneck. Internally, 38 of 40 models show zero competing attention heads. A sparse-regression ODE cross-predicts held-out Llama-2 at 5.6% error. The diagnostic requires no model internals -- only public benchmark scores across a model family. The cooperative regime extends to the frontier (r = +0.72, 34 models, 10 labs). A proof-of-concept intervention confirms the bottleneck is exploitable: adding a single truth-direction vector at the identified layer corrects 60% of misaligned outputs in the tax phase with zero retraining -- a surgical, per-inference correction that requires no weight modification. Code, data, an open-source steering CLI for any open-weight model, and an interactive dashboard for phase diagnosis are released: https://zehenlabs.com/cape/.

</details>


### [1031] [Decision-Path Patterns as Tree Reliability Signals: Path-based Adaptive Weighting for Random Forest Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20716)
*Youngjoon Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于决策路径结构模式的实例自适应可靠性信号，用于对随机森林中每棵树进行差异化加权投票，从而纠正集体正确但多数树错误的区域，在36个二分类基准上取得显著准确率提升（Wilcoxon p<0.0001），且未出现少数类召回率退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机森林中每棵树使用不同的随机化特征表示，均匀投票机制无法纠正"多数错误树压倒少数正确树"区域的误差，即使集成整体持有足够正确的信息——这是一种可降误差，现有方法未能有效解决。

Method: 利用每棵树决策路径的结构模式作为实例自适应可靠性信号，识别并差异化加权更可靠的树。路径级可靠性比树级加权粒度更细，能够反映每棵树对当前样本决策的实际可靠性。

Result: 在36个二分类基准上准确率显著提升（Wilcoxon p<0.0001）；零次少数类召回率退化，仅1次多数类召回率退化（阈值0.2pp）；可降误差估计与数据集增益强相关（Pearson r=+0.840, p<0.0001）；识别的高增益子集上平均提升+0.99 pp（7/0/0严格胜出），可选放大机制可提升至+1.48 pp。

Conclusion: 路径级可靠性加权能有效降低随机森林的可降误差，在提升整体准确率的同时避免传统纠偏方法中常见的类别召回率权衡问题，且方法增益可通过可降误差估计进行预测。

Abstract: Random forests construct each tree with a different, randomised representation of the feature space. Their uniform voting cannot correct errors in regions where trees with incorrect representations probabilistically outnumber correct ones, even when the ensemble collectively holds enough correct information - a reducible error that this paper addresses. We propose using the structural pattern of each tree's decision path as an instance-adaptive reliability signal to identify and differentially weight the more reliable trees. At inference, a random forest reaches its prediction through the root-to-leaf path the sample traverses in each tree, so path-level reliability offers a finer granularity than tree-level weighting can access. We show that this signal reflects the actual reliability of each tree's decision, and that using it yields a statistically significant accuracy improvement over RF on 36 binary classification benchmarks (Wilcoxon p < 0.0001). Class-recall regression - the typical failure mode of RF correction methods - is measured: zero minority-recall regressions and a single majority-recall regression at the 0.2 pp threshold, indicating bias reduction rather than a class trade-off. We further quantify the reducible error accessible to the method from the fitted RF alone; this estimate correlates strongly with per-dataset gain (Pearson r = +0.840, p < 0.0001). On the qualifying group it identifies, the method delivers a mean +0.99 pp accuracy improvement with strict wins on every dataset (7/0/0); an optional amplification mechanism further raises this to +1.48 pp.

</details>


### [1032] [Finite-Time Regret Analysis of Retry-Aware Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20854)
*Bingkui Tong,Junpei Komiyama,Soichiro Nishimori,Paavo Parmas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了重试感知目标下的随机bandit算法ReMax，该算法通过最大化M次虚拟采样中后验期望最大奖励来选择采样分布。在高斯奖励和M=2情况下，本文刻画了最优ReMax分布的期望改进平衡条件，并证明了首个次线性遗憾界。分析揭示了次优臂的饱和行为与ReMax特有的低估效应（最优臂因不利估计被过少采样）之间的分离，解释了ReMax比汤普森采样更具剥削性及其遗憾分析的技术难点。实验表明在轻度低估下ReMax常优于KL-UCB和汤普森采样，后验方差缩放可缓解严重低估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索重试感知目标（如pass@k和max@k）下ReMax算法在bandit问题中的遗憾性质，这是此前未被充分研究的问题。

Method: 针对高斯奖励和M=2情形，通过期望改进平衡条件刻划最优ReMax分布，并对遗憾进行理论分析，分离次优臂饱和行为与ReMax特有的低估效应。

Result: 证明了首个次线性遗憾界，揭示了ReMax比TS更具剥削性的原因，以及其遗憾分析的技术难点。

Conclusion: ReMax在轻度低估下优于KL-UCB和TS，后验方差缩放可缓解严重低估问题。

Abstract: We study a stochastic bandit algorithm motivated by retry-aware objectives that value the best outcome among multiple attempts, such as pass@$k$ and max@$k$. Given a posterior over arm values, ReMax chooses a sampling distribution that maximizes the posterior expected maximum reward over $M$ virtual draws. Although this objective was introduced in reinforcement learning as an exploration mechanism under uncertainty, its regret properties in bandit problems have remained unclear. For Gaussian rewards and the first nontrivial case $M=2$, we characterize the optimal ReMax distribution through an expected-improvement balance condition and prove the first sublinear regret bound for ReMax. Our analysis separates the usual saturation behavior of suboptimal arms from a ReMax-specific underestimation effect, in which the optimal arm may be sampled too rarely after an unfavorable estimate. This explains why ReMax can be more exploitative than Thompson sampling (TS) and why its regret analysis is technically delicate. Experiments support this picture: ReMax often outperforms KL-UCB and Thompson sampling under mild underestimation, while posterior-variance scaling empirically mitigates severe underestimation.

</details>


### [1033] [Advantage Collapse in Group Relative Policy Optimization: Diagnosis and Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21125)
*Xixiang He,Qiyao Sun,Ao Cheng,Xingming Li,Xuanyu Ji,Hailun Lu,Runke Huang,Qingyong Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出优势崩溃率（ACR）作为首个诊断GRPO算法中优势崩溃问题的指标，并设计了自适应虚拟样本策略优化（AVSPO）方法，通过注入虚拟奖励样本将优势崩溃减少58-63%，并在多规模模型上实现4-6%的准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO算法在RLVR框架中提升LLM推理能力时存在优势崩溃问题——组内同质化奖励导致近零优势值和梯度消失，严重影响训练效果，但缺乏有效诊断和解决方案。

Method: 提出ACR指标量化训练批次中梯度无效的比例；基于ACR实时监控，设计AVSPO方法向同质化组中注入虚拟奖励样本，无需额外模型 rollout 即可恢复有效学习信号。

Result: 在0.5B至14B参数模型上，ACR能强预测训练停滞和最终性能；AVSPO相比GRPO减少58-63%的优势崩溃，在所有模型规模上持续获得4-6%的准确率提升，且在域外任务上保持良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: ACR是诊断优势崩溃的有效指标，AVSPO是轻量级、高效的GRPO增强方案，能显著缓解优势崩溃并提升推理能力。

Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a prominent algorithm within the Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) framework, has achieved strong results in improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, GRPO is prone to advantage collapse, a failure mode where homogeneous rewards within a group (e.g., all correct or all incorrect answers) yield near-zero advantages and vanishing gradients. To address this, we introduce the Advantage Collapse Rate (ACR), the first diagnostic metric quantifying the proportion of training batches with ineffective gradients. Across models from 0.5B to 14B parameters on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, we show that ACR strongly predicts training stagnation and final performance. We then propose Adaptive Virtual Sample Policy Optimization (AVSPO), a lightweight extension of GRPO that injects virtual reward samples, guided by real-time ACR monitoring, to enable learning from homogeneous groups without additional model rollouts. AVSPO reduces advantage collapse by 58-63% relative to GRPO and yields consistent accuracy gains of 4-6 percentage points across all model scales, while maintaining generalization on the evaluated out-of-domain task. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/hexixiang/Advantage-Collapse-Rate.

</details>


### [1034] [Graph Navier Stokes Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21247)
*Zexing Zhao,Guangsi Shi,Yu Gong,Tianyu Wang,Shirui Pan,Hongye Cheng,Yuxiao Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出图纳维-斯托克斯网络（GNSN），通过引入对流机制超越传统基于扩散的消息传递，有效缓解过平滑问题，在12个真实数据集上取得最优分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于图信号处理与扩散方程的GNN方法存在过平滑问题，即随着网络加深节点特征变得无法区分。受纳维-斯托克斯方程启发，作者希望引入对流机制来突破这一局限。

Method: GNSN在图上定义动态速度场来控制对流，实现了比传统扩散更高效、更直接的传播。通过自适应平衡对流与扩散，该方法能灵活处理不同同质性水平的数据集。

Result: 在12个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，GNSN在分类准确率上持续优于最先进基线方法，并且有效缓解了过平滑问题。

Conclusion: 将流体力学中的纳维-斯托克斯方程引入GNN设计是可行且有效的，对流机制的加入为克服过平滑问题提供了新思路，同时增强了模型对异质性图的适应能力。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as a cornerstone of deep learning, with most existing methods rooted in graph signal processing and diffusion equations to model message passing. However, these approaches inherently suffer from the oversmoothing problem, where node features become indistinguishable as the network depth increases. Inspired by the Navier Stokes equations, we introduce Graph Navier Stokes Networks (GNSN), a novel architecture that transcends conventional diffusion-based message passing by incorporating convection into graph structures. GNSN defines a dynamic velocity field on the graph to govern convection, enabling more efficient and direct message propagation. By adaptively balancing convection and diffusion, GNSN is able to efficiently handle datasets with varying levels of homophily. Extensive evaluations across twelve real-world datasets demonstrate that GNSN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in classification accuracy. Moreover, experimental results further emphasize its effectiveness in alleviating the oversmoothing problem.

</details>


### [1035] [PRISM: Preference-Aware Influence Function Based Data Selection Method for Efficient Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21422)
*Qihao Lin,Guanxu Chen,Dongrui Liu,Jing Shao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRISM是一种基于偏好感知影响函数的数据选择方法，通过为目标示例分配权重来构建偏好感知的目标方向，从而优先选择能有效推动模型匹配目标行为的高价值训练数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据选择方法将所有目标示例视为同等重要，忽略了不同示例与模型优化之间相关性的差异——与模型固有行为一致的目标示例提供强监督信号，而差异大的示例仅产生弱且无效的局部指导。

Method: 提出PRISM方法，利用模型偏好为目标示例分配权重，构建偏好感知的目标方向；然后根据候选训练样本对该方向的影响程度进行评估，优先分配数据预算给能有效驱动模型匹配预期目标行为的样本。

Result: 在多种模型架构和参数规模上的大量实验表明，PRISM在高效微调和安全对齐的监督微调修正中取得了更好的性能。

Conclusion: 对目标行为的准确刻画是成本效益数据选择的核心，理论分析验证加权偏好构建比统一聚合策略能产生更优的一阶梯度方向以提升目标偏好。

Abstract: As LLMs continue to scale up, improving training efficiency heavily relies on effective data utilization. Data selection mitigates this issue by allocating the limited training budget to high-value examples that optimally facilitate the model's target behavior. Most existing approaches define target behavior via a set of target examples and score candidate training data based on their estimated influence on these samples. However, such methods uniformly treat all target examples as equally important, ignoring the varying relevance of individual examples to model optimization. Specifically, target examples that align closely with the model's inherent behavior deliver stronger supervisory signals, whereas discrepant examples yield only weak and ineffective local guidance. We propose PRISM, a Preference-aware Influence function based Data Selection Method. It leverages model preference to assign weights to target examples and builds a preference-aware target direction. PRISM evaluates candidate training samples according to their influence on this direction, and prioritizes data budget allocation to samples that effectively drive the model to match expected target behavior. Theoretical analysis verifies that weighted preference construction generates a superior first-order gradient direction for boosting target preference, compared with uniform aggregation strategies. Extensive experiments covering diverse model architectures and parameter scales demonstrate that PRISM achieves better performance in efficient fine-tuning and safety-aligned supervised fine-tuning rectification. The results validate that accurate characterization of target behavior serves as the core of cost-effective data selection.

</details>


### [1036] [Dropout Universality: Scaling Laws and Optimal Scheduling at the Edge-of-Chaos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21648)
*Lucas Fernandez Sarmiento*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于平均场理论的dropout微扰理论，证明在临界信号传播边缘，dropout会改变完美对齐不动点，导致信息传播深度尺度有限。理论预测并验证了前置加载的dropout调度策略在固定预算下可将测试损失降低18-35%，并揭示了平滑激活函数与kinked激活函数分属不同普适类，具有不同临界指数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索dropout在临界信号传播（边缘混沌）条件下的微扰理论，揭示dropout对信息传播深度的影响机制，并基于理论推导出更优的dropout调度策略以提升模型性能。

Method: (1) 建立dropout作为临界信号传播微扰的平均场理论；(2) 推导相关函数衰减的临界标度律和交叉标度律；(3) 分析平滑激活函数与ReLU类kinked激活函数的解析结构差异；(4) 通过正则化-覆盖论证选择前置加载调度策略；(5) 将理论从MLP扩展到CNN和残差架构。

Result: (1) 前置加载dropout调度在MLP和Vision Transformer上相比固定dropout降低测试损失18-35%；(2) 平滑激活与kinked激活分属不同普适类，具有不同临界指数，且展示出失谐与dropout强度的通用双参数标度坍塌；(3) 在固定预算下得到饱和dropout分布，准确性提升作为一致性的次要效应。

Conclusion: 理论分析表明，dropout改变了临界初始化的对齐不动点结构，使信息传播深度有限，而前置加载调度是最优策略。该框架还可通过高斯核结构扩展到CNN和残差网络，具有较好的普适性。

Abstract: We develop a mean-field theory of dropout as a perturbation of critical signal propagation at the edge of chaos, and show that it predicts a simple, no-cost change to standard practice: \emph{front-loaded} dropout schedules cut test loss by \(18\)--\(35\%\) over constant dropout in MLPs and Vision Transformers at fixed budget. The theoretical mechanism is that dropout shifts the perfect-alignment fixed point, making the depth scale for information propagation finite even at critical initialization. We derive critical and crossover scaling laws for correlation decay and establish that smooth activations and kinked, \relu{}-like activations constitute distinct universality classes, with different critical exponents and a universal two-parameter scaling collapse in detuning and dropout strength. The distinction traces to the analytic structure of the correlation map: smooth activations admit a Taylor expansion near perfect alignment, while kinked activations develop a branch point with universal non-analyticity. As a corollary, the framework yields saturated dropout profiles under fixed budget; a regularization-reach argument then selects front-loaded schedules, with accuracy gains as a consistent secondary effect. We also discuss how the same Gaussian-kernel structure extends the theory beyond MLPs toward CNNs and residual architectures.

</details>


### [1037] [Chebyshev Policies and the Mountain Car Problem: Reinforcement Learning for Low-Dimensional Control Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22305)
*Stefan Huber,Hannes Unger,Georg Schäfer,Jakob Rehrl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文解析求解了强化学习经典基准任务Mountain Car的最优控制（填补了36年的空白），发现最优控制非常简单但现代RL算法存在巨大差距。受此启发，从第一性原理推导出Chebyshev策略作为通用策略类，其作为神经网络替代品可将遗憾降低4.18倍，同时参数减少277倍，在多个RL任务中一致优于神经网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 填补Mountain Car问题36年来缺乏解析最优解的空白，并揭示现代RL算法与最优控制之间的差距，进而寻求更高效、可解释的策略表示方法。

Method: 1) 解析求解Mountain Car的最优控制问题；2) 基于最优控制分析，从第一性原理引入Chebyshev多项式作为策略函数类；3) 将Chebyshev策略作为神经网络的替代品，结合PPO、ARS、REINFORCE等算法进行训练。

Result: Chebyshev策略相比神经网络：遗憾降低4.18倍，参数减少277倍；在多个RL任务（包括真实非线性运动控制测试平台）上一致优于神经网络。

Conclusion: Chebyshev策略是低维控制任务中神经网络的一种有说服力的轻量级替代方案，可提升样本效率、可解释性和实时性能。

Abstract: We analytically solve the Mountain Car problem, a canonical benchmark in RL, and derive an optimal control solution, closing a gap after 36 years. This enables us to reveal two surprising insights: The optimal control is quite simple, yet modern RL agents display a large gap to optimality. Motivated by the analysis of the optimal control, we introduce Chebyshev policies as a universal (i.e. dense) class of RL policies from first principles. They can be trained as drop-in replacements of neural nets, reducing the regret by a factor of 4.18, while requiring 277 times fewer parameters, fostering sample efficiency, explainability and realtime capability. Chebyshev policies are evaluated on further RL tasks, including a real-world nonlinear motion control testbed. They consistently improve performance over neural nets with PPO, ARS and REINFORCE. Our results demonstrate how Chebyshev policies offer a compelling and lightweight alternative or addition to neural nets for low-dimensional control tasks.

</details>


### [1038] [The Attribution Contract: Feature Attribution for Generative Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23080)
*Giang Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出现有特征归因方法在生成式语言模型中存在概念性局限，并提出“归因契约”（Attribution Contract）规范框架，明确归因声明中的输出、特征、生成过程、固定条件和模型分数等要素。通过自回归和扩散语言模型案例，论证归因方法应作为“方法-契约对”进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式语言模型中，特征的定义存在歧义：自回归模型中早期生成的token既是输出又是输入，扩散模型中归因对象可能是扩散状态而非下一个token。这种歧义并非实现细节，而是将分类器时代的特征归因直接移植到生成式语言建模中的概念性局限。

Method: 提出Attribution Contract规范，明确归因声明的五个要素：被解释的输出、可获得归因的特征、假设的生成过程、固定不变的内容、被归因的模型分数。以自回归和扩散语言模型为案例，分析归因到早期生成token、中间状态或去噪阶段何时有效、何时误导。

Result: 同一归因方法因实例化方式不同可回答不同问题；许多关于生成式语言模型特征归因的争议实质是对未言明的归因契约的分歧，而非归因算法本身的分歧。特征归因方法应作为“方法-契约对”进行评估。

Conclusion: 特征归因方法在生成式语言模型中的应用需要明确的契约规范，以避免概念混淆和误导性解释。归因方法的评价必须同时考察其所隐含的契约假设。

Abstract: Feature attribution methods promise to identify which input features matter for a model output. In generative language models, however, it is often unclear what should count as a feature in the first place. In autoregressive language models, earlier generated tokens are both outputs of the model and inputs to later predictions. In diffusion language models, generation proceeds through iterative denoising or unmasking rather than fixed left-to-right prediction, so local explanation may target a state of diffusion rather than a next token. We argue that this ambiguity is not merely an implementation detail, but a conceptual limitation of carrying classifier-era feature attribution directly into generative language modeling. We introduce the Attribution Contract, a specification for feature-attribution claims that names what output is being explained, which features are eligible to receive attribution, what generative process is assumed, what is held fixed, and what model score is being attributed. The contract clarifies why the same attribution method can answer different questions depending on how it is instantiated. We argue that many disagreements about feature attribution in generative language models are not disagreements about attribution algorithms, but about unstated explanatory contracts. Using autoregressive and diffusion language models as case studies, we show when attribution to earlier generated tokens, intermediate states, or denoising stages is informative, when it is misleading, and why feature-attribution methods in generative language models should be evaluated as method-contract pairs.

</details>


### [1039] [Treatment Effect Estimation with Differentiated Networked Effect on Graph Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24358)
*Xiaofeng Lin,Han Bao,Hisashi Kashima*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的干扰建模机制，通过两个部分注意力机制和消息放大器来捕获差异化网络效应（DNE），从而更准确地从图数据中估计个体处理效应（ITE）。实验证明该方法在三个真实世界图上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在从图数据估计个体处理效应时，忽视了一个关键问题：由不同重要性和规模的邻居构成的局部网络所产生的差异化网络效应（DNE），导致干扰建模不准确和ITE估计偏差。

Method: 提出结合两个部分注意力机制（自动估计不同邻居在干扰中的重要性）和消息放大器（根据邻居规模调整干扰建模结果）的新型干扰建模机制，以捕获DNE。

Result: 在三个真实世界图数据集上的实验表明，该方法在ITE估计任务上优于现有方法，验证了显式捕获DNE的重要性。

Conclusion: 显式建模差异化网络效应对于从图数据准确估计个体处理效应至关重要，所提方法通过注意力机制和消息放大器有效解决了这一被忽视的问题。

Abstract: Estimating individual treatment effect (ITE) from observational graph data is crucial for decision-making in the fields such as commerce and medicine. This task is challenging due to interference, where individual outcomes can be influenced by the treatments and covariates of their neighbors. Existing methods attempt to model such interference for accurate ITE estimation. However, a critical issue is often overlooked: differentiated networked effect (DNE), an effect caused by local networks consisting of neighbors with varying importance and scales. Capturing DNE is vital; otherwise, we will end up with imprecise ITE estimation due to an erroneous characterization of interference, which can result in misguided decisions. To address this challenge, we propose a novel interference modeling mechanism that incorporates two partial attention mechanisms and a message amplifier. The partial attention mechanisms automatically estimate the importance of different neighbors in contributing to interference, while the message amplifier adjusts the results of the interference modeling mechanism based on the scale of neighbors, all of which enables the model to capture DNE. Experiments on three real-world graphs demonstrate that our methods outperform existing approaches for ITE estimation from graph data, which corroborates the importance of explicitly capturing DNE.

</details>


### [1040] [Measuring Alignment-Induced Activation Shifts Correctly: A Template-Controlled Difference-in-Differences Protocol](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24583)
*Yuki Nakamura*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了安全对齐前后模型激活差异分析中存在聊天模板混淆的问题，并提出四变体分解方法（DiD）来分离对齐效应与模板效应，通过实验验证了该方法的有效性，并给出了测量建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通过比较对齐前后模型内部激活差异来分析安全训练带来的变化，但忽略了聊天模板这一混淆变量，导致测量结果被显著膨胀，需要一种能够正确分离两种效应的方法。

Method: 提出四变体分解方法：朴素差异、模板控制、对齐内差异、双重差分（DiD），通过控制聊天模板来分离对齐效应与格式效应，并在Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-2-9B、Qwen-2.5-7B三个模型家族上进行验证。

Result: 模板控制消除了有效秩2.0-3.9倍的膨胀；DiD对比将拒绝方向的余弦对齐度从0.18-0.39提升至0.50-0.86；投影消融实验证实恢复的子空间具有行为活跃性，且奇异值顺序不代表因果顺序。

Conclusion: 模板混淆是对齐激活差异分析中的关键混杂因素，DiD方法能有效分离对齐效应，为后续激活差异研究提供了测量协议建议。

Abstract: Comparing a model's internal activations before and after alignment is a natural way to ask what safety training changes: one forms the matrix of paired aligned-minus-base activations on safety-relevant inputs and reads off its effective rank or top direction. We show the obvious way to form this matrix is confounded. The aligned model is evaluated under a chat template the base model never saw, so the naive difference conflates the alignment shift with chat formatting. We introduce a four-variant decomposition of the modification matrix (naive, template-controlled, within-aligned, and difference-in-differences, DiD) that separates the two effects. Template control alone removes a 2.0-3.9x inflation of the measured effective rank across Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B, and Qwen-2.5-7B; the DiD contrast is what recovers the refusal direction of Arditi et al. (2024), lifting its cosine alignment from 0.18-0.39 to 0.50-0.86. Projection-ablation across the three families confirms the recovered subspace is behaviorally active and that singular-value order is not causal order. We validate the protocol on a controlled testbed and distill it into measurement recommendations for activation-difference studies of alignment.

</details>


### [1041] [Rethinking Weak Supervision in Anomaly Detection: A Comprehensive Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26068)
*Xu Yao,Siyuan Zhou,Zhenbo Wu,Chaochuan Hou,Shuang Liang,Shiping Wang,Hailiang Huang,Songqiao Han,Minqi Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WSADBench是首个统一评估弱监督异常检测（WSAD）的基准，涵盖不完整、不精确和不准确三种监督场景，通过70万+实验评估36种算法在4种模态下的表现，发现当前研究方向存在强内在关联，专用WSAD方法仅在极端标签稀缺时优势明显，无监督数据效用有限，模型对不同类型的标签噪声具有非对称敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WSAD的三种主要研究方向（不完整、不精确、不准确监督）长期相互孤立，缺乏统一框架来评估它们是否解决独特的挑战或共享基础机制，因此需要建立一个统一的基准来系统比较这些方法。

Method: 建立了WSADBench统一基准，通过系统改变标签数量、粒度和质量，在4种模态上评估36种算法（包括专用WSAD方法、表格基础模型和通用分类方法），进行了超过70万次实验，建立标准化评估协议。

Result: (i)弱监督场景存在强内在相关性；(ii)专用WSAD算法仅在极端标签稀缺时表现优异，但在监督增强或OOD场景中被基础模型和通用方法超越；(iii)无标签数据效用不稳定，相比标签精炼增益有限；(iv)模型对不同类型标签噪声具有非对称敏感性。

Conclusion: WSADBench揭示了当前WSAD研究方向的孤立性不应继续，为未来研究提供了统一的评估框架和重要见解，相关代码和数据集已开源。

Abstract: Weakly supervised anomaly detection (WSAD) has developed in three primary directions: incomplete, inexact, and inaccurate supervision. However, these directions remain isolated, lacking a unified framework to assess whether they address unique challenges or share fundamental mechanisms. This paper introduces WSADBench, the first benchmark that unifies evaluation across distinct weakly supervised scenarios, benchmarking diverse approaches from specialized WSAD methods to advanced tabular foundation models. WSADBench establishes standardized protocols to evaluate 36 algorithms across 4 modalities by systematically varying label quantity, granularity, and quality, revealing the performance boundaries of various methods. Based on over 700K experiments, WSADBench reveals four critical insights: (i) Strong intrinsic correlations exist between these weak supervision scenarios, challenging the isolation of current research directions. (ii) Specialized WSAD algorithms excel only in extreme label-scarcity regimes but are quickly dominated by tabular foundation models and general classification methods as supervision increases or in OOD scenarios. (iii) Unlabeled data shows inconsistent utility across settings, with marginal gains compared to label refinement. (iv) Models exhibit asymmetric sensitivity to different types of label noise. We release WSADBench as an open-source benchmark with code and datasets to facilitate future WSAD research: https://github.com/SUFE-AILAB/WSADBench.

</details>


### [1042] [GoQuant: Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection for Multiplier-Free Power-of-Two Transformer Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26092)
*Maoyang Xiang,Tao Luo,Bo Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GoQuant是一种算法-硬件协同设计框架，通过几何正交残差投影量化方法，在超低位宽（<4-bit）下用移位-加法操作替代传统MAC运算，有效缓解了LLM和ViT在边缘设备部署时的内存和时序瓶颈，在3-bit条件下LLaMA-2-7B达到6.10 perplexity，关键路径延迟降至0.35ns。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM和ViT在边缘设备部署面临严重的内存限制和密集MAC阵列带来的时序瓶颈。现有对数Power-of-Two（PoT）量化在超低位宽（<4-bit）下存在"低角度分辨率 regime"的结构缺陷，导致高维特征流形的显著退化。

Method: 提出Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection Quantization (GoQuant)，将量化建模为双基几何投影，自适应地合成更高分辨率的残差格点，仅使用移位-加法操作。采用解析求解器替代计算密集的梯度优化，将LLaMA-2-7B的全模型校准时间压缩至约15分钟。

Result: 3-bit (W3/A16)条件下，LLaMA-2-7B perplexity达6.10，优于传统MAC密集型基线如AWQ；4-bit场景保持竞争精度。28nm工艺下，并行移位-加法数据通路将关键路径延迟降至0.35ns，有效缓解密集乘法器树的时序瓶颈。

Conclusion: GoQuant通过算法-硬件协同设计，有效解决了超低位宽量化中的角度分辨率问题，在保持精度的同时显著提升硬件效率，为边缘端大模型部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) on edge devices is significantly constrained by memory limitations and the critical timing bottlenecks introduced by dense Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) arrays. In the ultra-low bit regime, logarithmic Power-of-Two (PoT) quantization provides a hardware-efficient alternative by replacing MAC operations with bit-shifts. However, the non-uniform exponential lattice is inherently limited by a \textbf{Low Angular Resolution Regime}, a structural flaw that becomes particularly pronounced at sub-4-bit thresholds, leading to a notable degradation of high-dimensional feature manifolds. To address this geometric limitation, we propose Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection Quantization (GoQuant), an algorithm-hardware co-design framework. By formulating quantization as a dual-basis geometric projection, GoQuant adaptively synthesizes a higher-resolution residual lattice using strictly shift-and-add operations. Furthermore, its analytical solver offers a practical alternative to computationally intensive gradient-based optimization, reducing the full-model calibration time for LLaMA-2-7B to approximately 15 minutes. Extensive evaluations demonstrate GoQuant's applicability across modalities and its hardware efficiency. Under the 3-bit (W3/A16) constraint, it achieves a perplexity of 6.10 on LLaMA-2-7B, comparing favorably to conventional MAC-intensive baselines like AWQ without relying on asymmetric scaling, while maintaining competitive accuracy in 4-bit scenarios. At the silicon level, standard-cell RTL synthesis at a 28nm node indicates that GoQuant effectively mitigates the timing bottlenecks associated with dense multiplier trees. By flattening the combinational logic depth, our parallel shift-and-add datapath reduces the critical path delay to 0.35 ns.

</details>


### [1043] [Classification and detection of multiple UAVs using rational Gaussian wavelet neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26310)
*Ungvári Gergő,Ferenc Braun,Attila Ámon,Péter Kackstädter,János Volk,Péter Kovács,Tamás Dózsa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于声音信号的经济型无人机检测系统，采用可解释的自适应有理高斯小波变换结合小型神经网络，不仅能检测和分类单个无人机，还能识别无人机集群，在室内外环境下均优于传统机器学习方法，且保持高可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 保护民用和军事基础设施需要有效的无人机检测手段，现有方法成本较高，亟需一种经济高效且可解释的解决方案。

Method: 使用麦克风采集声音信号，通过可解释的自适应特征提取器（有理高斯小波变换）进行信号处理，将自适应小波变换嵌入小型神经网络中联合训练，实现基于特征的无人机检测与分类。

Result: 在室内录音棚和嘈杂室外环境下的实验表明，该方法在检测和分类单个无人机及无人机集群方面均优于传统机器学习方法，同时保持高度可解释性。

Conclusion: 提出的方法在性能和可解释性之间取得了良好平衡，代码已公开以支持可复现性。

Abstract: The detection of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is important for the protection of civilian and military infrastructure. In this paper we propose a cost effective UAV detection system using sound signals obtained from microphones. The recorded signals are passed through a signal processing pipeline which employs interpretable adaptive feature extractors using so-called rational Gaussian wavelets. These adaptive wavelet transformations are embedded into and trained together with an underlying small neural network which detects and classifies UAVs based on the obtained features. This leads to a physically interpretable machine learning algorithm that in addition to classifying UAVs is also capable of detecting UAV swarms. We demonstrate our results using data collected in indoor studio and noisy outdoor environments. We conclude that the proposed method outperforms traditional machine learning approaches for detecting and classifying single UAVs as well as drone swarms, while retaining a high degree of interpretability. Our implementation of the proposed methods is made publicly available for reproducibility.

</details>


### [1044] [RT-Lynx: Putting the GEMM Sparsity In a Right Way for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26632)
*Xing Cong,Hanlin Tang,Kan Liu,Lan Tao,Lin Qu,Chenhao Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RT-Lynx方法，将N:M半结构化稀疏从权重转移到激活值，结合误差补偿技术，在保持扩散模型生成质量的同时实现线性层最高1.55倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通过量化、蒸馏等方式降低DiT推理成本，但半结构化稀疏在扩散模型中研究不足，因为权重稀疏化会严重损害生成质量。作者发现激活值具有内在稀疏性且对稀疏化更鲁棒，因此提出从权重稀疏化转向激活稀疏化。

Method: 1) 在DiT的激活值上应用N:M半结构化稀疏；2) 引入误差补偿技术缓解精度损失；3) 针对该场景设计高度优化的CUDA内核。

Result: 在多个扩散模型上的实验表明，该方法在保持原有生成质量的同时，线性层平均实现1.55倍的实际加速。

Conclusion: 激活稀疏化比权重稀疏化更适合DiT的加速，RT-Lynx方法有效利用激活值的稀疏性，在不牺牲生成质量的前提下显著提升推理速度。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve strong performance in image generation but incur substantial inference costs. While prior work has reduced this cost via quantization and distillation, semi-structured sparsity, which can nearly halve FLOPs, remains underexplored. A key reason is that most existing approaches focus on weight sparsification, and pruning 50% of the weights can remove critical model capacity and degrade generation quality. Our study, however, shows that DiT activations are intrinsically sparse and significantly more robust to N:M semi-structured sparsification than weights. Motivated by this observation, we advocate a paradigm shift from weight sparsification to activation sparsification. We propose RT-Lynx, which applies N:M sparsification to activations and incorporates error-compensation techniques to mitigate accuracy loss. We further implement highly optimized CUDA kernels tailored to this setting, achieving up to a 1.55x speedup on average in linear layers. Extensive experiments across multiple diffusion models demonstrate that our method preserves the generation quality of the original models while substantially accelerating inference.

</details>


### [1045] [WINDQuant: Weight-Informed Neural Decision-Making for Global Mixed-Precision LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26660)
*Phong Nam Huu Nguyen,Khoi M. Le,Cong-Duy T Nguyen,Anh Tuan Luu,Thong Thanh Nguyen,Tho Quan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WINDQuant是一种基于强化学习的超低位LLM量化分配控制器，通过PPO和激活感知校准在列块级别学习混合精度分配，在超低位设置下取得竞争性能并降低优化开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练量化方法在超低位宽下精度严重下降，量化感知训练需要昂贵的重训练和额外资源，混合精度策略大多依赖粗粒度或启发式敏感性分析，无法捕捉权重矩阵内的细粒度变化。

Method: WINDQuant使用强化学习（PPO）在列块级别学习比特宽度和量化处理方式的分配，结合激活感知校准、轻量级每单元量化器拟合和显式有效比特记账，在全局存储预算下实现细粒度精度分配。

Result: 在LLaMA模型上的实验表明，WINDQuant在超低位设置下实现了竞争性性能，同时相比基于重训练的方法降低了优化开销。

Conclusion: 强化学习可作为自适应混合精度量化的实用控制器，在超低位宽下有效平衡模型性能与优化成本。

Abstract: Quantization is an effective approach to reduce the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), yet maintaining performance in the ultra-low-bit regime remains challenging. Existing post-training methods often suffer from severe accuracy degradation, while quantization-aware training requires costly retraining and additional resources. Moreover, most mixed-precision strategies rely on coarse-grained or heuristic sensitivity analysis that overlooks fine-grained variations within weight matrices. We propose WINDQuant, a reinforcement-learning-based allocation controller for ultra-low-bit LLM quantization. Rather than introducing another low-level quantization operator, WINDQuant learns how to assign bit-widths and quantization treatments to fine-grained column chunks under a global storage budget. By operating at the column-chunk level, WINDQuant enables flexible and fine-grained precision assignment within layers under a global target bit-width. The implementation combines PPO with activation-aware calibration, lightweight per-unit quantizer fitting, and explicit effective-bit accounting of the learned mixed-precision plan. Experiments on LLaMA models demonstrate that WINDQuant achieves competitive performance in ultra-low-bit settings while reducing optimization overhead relative to retraining-based approaches, highlighting reinforcement learning as a practical controller for adaptive mixed-precision quantization.

</details>


### [1046] [Beyond Trajectory-Level Attribution: Graph-Based Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26684)
*Xin Cheng,Shuo He,Lang Feng,HaiYang Xu,Ming Yan,Lei Feng,Bo An*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GraphGPO方法，通过将所有轨迹聚合成统一的状态转移图，利用图结构中的全局信息为每一步分配更细粒度的信用，解决了组级强化学习中粗粒度轨迹级信用分配的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有组级RL方法依赖粗粒度的轨迹级信用分配，仅根据最终结果归因，难以捕捉单个步骤的贡献，尤其是失败轨迹中被掩盖的有价值步骤。

Method: 1) 将所有rollout轨迹聚合成统一的状态转移图；2) 利用图编码的全局信息估计每个状态到任务目标的距离；3) 根据转移行为减少到目标距离的程度，为每条边分配基于图的优势值（graph-based advantage）。

Result: 在多个具有挑战性的基准测试上取得了最先进的性能，显著提升了训练效率。

Conclusion: GraphGPO通过图结构实现了更细粒度、更忠实的步骤级信用分配，有效利用了失败轨迹中的潜在信息，提升了RL训练效率。

Abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods have achieved remarkable success in improving the performance of large language models (LLMs) and have been rapidly extended to agentic tasks. However, their credit assignment relies heavily on coarse-grained trajectory-level attribution according to final outcomes, making it difficult to capture the contribution of individual steps, such as valuable steps obscured within failed trajectories. To uncover latent information and enable more faithful step-level credit assignment, we propose Graph-based Group Policy Optimization (GraphGPO), which first aggregates all rollout trajectories into a unified state-transition graph and then estimates the distance from each state to the task goal using the global information encoded in the graph. Finally, GraphGPO assigns credit to each edge by estimating a graph-based advantage, based on how much the transition reduces the distance to the task goal. In this way, GraphGPO significantly improves training efficiency and achieves state-of-the-art performance across a range of challenging benchmarks.

</details>


### [1047] [Agile Online Model Selection: Resolving Adaptation Lag via Safeguarded Large Learning Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26919)
*Kei Takemura,Ryuta Matsuno,Keita Sakuma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对非平稳环境中在线模型选择存在的鲁棒性与敏捷性权衡问题，提出了一种采用安全大学习率（可达Θ(T)）的乐观在线镜像下降算法，通过事后惩罚机制动态排除过度遗憾的学习率，累计惩罚仅为O(log T)，在保持近最优最坏情况保证的同时显著提升了突变适应速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无调参算法在非平稳环境中面临鲁棒性与敏捷性的根本权衡：为保证动态遗憾界，必须将学习率限制为小常数（如O(1)），这导致在数据分布突变时出现显著的适应滞后。需要一种既能保持理论保证又能快速适应突变的方法。

Method: 提出基于安全大学习率的乐观在线镜像下降算法，核心创新是事后惩罚机制：动态监控不稳定更新，排除导致过度遗憾的学习率，无需严格的事先约束。学习率可高达Θ(T)，累计惩罚仅O(log T)。

Result: 在3个合成数据集和11个真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法将适应滞后从数百轮减少到几轮，一致优于无调参基线方法。在保持近最优最坏情况保证的同时，在良性情况下实现了更优的遗憾率。

Conclusion: 通过事后惩罚机制替代事先约束，成功打破了鲁棒性与敏捷性之间的权衡，在理论上保证了动态遗憾界的同时，实践中大幅提升了模型对分布突变的适应速度。

Abstract: Maintaining predictive accuracy in non-stationary environments requires online model selection to adapt autonomously to unknown distribution shifts. However, existing tuning-free algorithms face a fundamental trade-off between robustness and agility. Specifically, to ensure dynamic regret bounds, they must restrict learning rates to small constants (e.g., $O(1)$). This restriction inevitably causes significant adaptation lag during abrupt changes. To resolve this, we propose a novel optimistic online mirror descent that utilizes safeguarded large learning rates up to $Θ(T)$, where $T$ is the number of rounds. Our key technical contribution is a post-hoc penalty mechanism that dynamically monitors unstable updates and excludes learning rates incurring excessive regret, eliminating the need for restrictive a priori constraints. We show that the cumulative penalty remains $O(\log T)$, allowing our algorithm to match near-optimal worst-case guarantees while achieving superior rates in benign cases. Empirical evaluations on three synthetic and eleven diverse real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach reduces the adaptation lag from hundreds of rounds to a few rounds, consistently outperforming tuning-free baselines.

</details>


### [1048] [Adversarial Dual On-Policy Distillation from Expressive Teacher](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27095)
*Zhenglin Wan,Jingxuan Wu,Xingrui Yu,Chubin Zhang,Mingcong Lei,Bo An,Ivor W. Tsang,Yang You*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FA-OPD方法，通过对抗性双路在线策略蒸馏，将流匹配教师与学生策略协同训练，利用奖励通道和动作通道分别提供探索信号和局部密集目标，在机器人导航、操作和 locomotion 任务上超越强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有行为克隆和扩散/流匹配策略仅作为离线监督学习器，缺乏对学生实际访问状态的纠正信号；标准在线策略蒸馏依赖强固定教师，在仅有演示数据的环境中不可用。

Method: 提出FA-OPD，一种对抗性双路在线策略蒸馏方法。从演示中学习流匹配教师，与轻量级MLP学生协同训练。教师提供两个互补信号：奖励通道学习状态-动作对的专家似然目标，驱动在线探索；动作通道在学生访问状态提供局部密集目标，稳定利用。两者耦合实现泛化与探索平衡。

Result: 在六个机器人导航、操作和 locomotion 基准上，FA-OPD击败强基线，在噪声或有限演示下表现出更强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: FA-OPD通过双路蒸馏信号有效弥补了离线行为克隆与在线策略蒸馏之间的鸿沟，在演示驱动的具身控制中实现了更好的泛化与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Learning from demonstrations in embodied control is often cast as behavioral cloning, and recent diffusion or flow-matching policies improve this paradigm by modeling multi-modal expert actions. Yet these methods remain offline supervised learners: the policy is trained only on expert states and receives no corrective signal on the states it actually visits. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers a natural remedy, but standard OPD assumes a strong fixed teacher, which is unavailable in demonstration-only control. We propose \textbf{FA-OPD}, an \emph{adversarial dual on-policy distillation} method in which a Flow Matching (FM) teacher is learned from demonstrations and co-trained with a lightweight MLP student. The teacher provides two complementary signals on student rollouts. The reward channel learns an expert-likeness objective over state-action pairs and drives online exploration through long-horizon policy optimization. The action channel supplies dense local targets at student-visited states, stabilizing exploitation. FA-OPD couples them so that reward distillation enables generalization beyond point-wise demonstrations, while action distillation keeps exploration anchored near expert-like behavior. Across six robot navigation, manipulation, and locomotion benchmarks, FA-OPD beats strong baselines and shows much stronger robustness under noisy or limited demonstrations. Source code: https://github.com/vanzll/FA-OPD.

</details>


### [1049] [CAREF: Calibration-Aware Regularization for Explanation Faithfulness Without Rationale Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27835)
*Naphat Nithisopa,Teerapong Panboonyuen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CAREF是一个参数高效的微调框架，通过校准感知正则化联合优化预测准确性和解释忠实度，核心是提出统一损失函数LSCED，无需理由监督即可同时控制熵校准和token级稀疏性，在四个NLE基准上以仅6.43%的可训练参数取得了最佳性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型微调方法未能同时兼顾预测准确性和解释忠实度，缺乏统一框架来联合优化这两个目标，且需要大量标注数据。

Method: 提出CAREF框架，核心是LSCED损失函数，将基于熵的校准与token级稀疏性控制耦合在单一训练目标中，通过校准感知正则化实现参数高效微调。

Result: 在COS-E、ECQA、ComVE、e-SNLI四个NLE基准上，CAREF-AQ变体以仅6.43%的可训练参数取得平均准确率89.04和解释对齐分数81.00 nBERT，优于LoRA和AdaLoRA。

Conclusion: CAREF是首个在单一训练目标中统一熵正则化和稀疏正则化的可解释LLM微调方法，证明无需理由监督即可同时提升准确性和解释忠实度。

Abstract: We introduce CAREF, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning framework that jointly optimizes predictive accuracy and explanation faithfulness via calibration-aware regularization. At its core, CAREF couples entropy-based calibration with token-level sparsity control through a single unified loss, the Calibration-Aware Regularization for Explanation Faithfulness (LSCED), without requiring rationale supervision. Evaluated on four NLE benchmarks (COS-E, ECQA, ComVE, e-SNLI) with Flan-T5, our lightweight CAREF-AQ variant attains the best average accuracy (89.04) and explanation alignment (81.00 nBERT) using only 6.43% of trainable parameters, outperforming LoRA and AdaLoRA. To our knowledge, CAREF is the first method to unify entropy and sparsity regularization in a single training objective for interpretable LLM fine-tuning.

</details>


### [1050] [Robust Contrastive Graph Clustering with Adaptive Local-Global Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28209)
*Lei Zhang,Fubo Sun,Haipeng Yang,Zhong Guan,Likang Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种对比图聚类框架，通过注意力机制融合多尺度局部结构（多深度GNN特征自适应加权）与全局语义（动态聚类原型引导节点表示），在双视图对比学习范式下结合实例级和结构感知损失，在8个真实图数据集上取得了有竞争力的聚类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自监督对比图聚类方法难以灵活捕捉高阶局部结构，且常忽略复杂图中的全局语义，导致在结构碎片化、聚类边界模糊的真实图上节点表示次优。

Method: 1) 局部层面：多传播深度的GNN拓扑信号通过注意力加权自适应融合，捕获多尺度邻域特征；2) 全局层面：动态演化的聚类中心作为语义原型，通过注意力机制自适应聚合以引导节点表示并增强类间可分离性；3) 双视图对比学习：混合目标函数结合实例级损失和结构感知损失。

Result: 在8个真实世界图数据集上，该方法达到了有竞争力的聚类性能。

Conclusion: 通过同时建模多尺度局部结构与全局语义，所提框架有效提升了图聚类的表示质量，验证了注意力机制在多粒度特征融合及对比学习框架中的有效性。

Abstract: Graph clustering is essential in graph analysis for revealing structural patterns and node communities. Despite recent advances in self-supervised contrastive learning that have improved clustering via structural and attribute signals, existing methods still struggle to flexibly capture high-order local structures and often overlook global semantics in complex graphs. These limitations lead to suboptimal node representations, especially in real-world graphs with fragmented structures and ambiguous cluster boundaries. To address these limitations, a contrastive graph clustering framework is proposed to jointly integrate multi-scale local structures with global semantics via attention mechanisms. At the local level, GNN-based topological signals extracted from multiple propagation depths are adaptively fused through attention-based weighting to capture multi-scale neighborhood features. At the global level, semantic prototypes derived from dynamically evolving cluster centers are adaptively aggregated through attention to guide node representations and enhance inter-cluster separability. The model is trained under a dual-view contrastive learning paradigm with a hybrid objective that combines instance-level and structure-aware losses to improve representation robustness and discrimination. Experiments on eight real-world graph datasets demonstrate that our method achieves competitive clustering performance. Code is available at https://github.com/vege12138/w2.

</details>


### [1051] [Dimensionality Reduction for Robust Federated Learning: A Theoretical Analysis and Convergence Guarantee](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28335)
*Shiyuan Zuo,Jiashuo Li,Rongfei Fan,Han Hu,Jie Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出投影降维（PDR）框架，通过稀疏随机投影将梯度压缩到低维子空间进行鲁棒聚合，将服务器计算复杂度降至最优的O(Mp)，并在标准联邦学习假设下证明其收敛性，实验表明可实现数量级的加速且不影响收敛性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有抗拜占庭攻击的鲁棒聚合器在处理高维梯度时计算开销巨大，且该开销随模型规模增长而急剧增加，成为训练瓶颈。

Method: 提出PDR（Projected Dimensionality Reduction）通用加速框架，利用稀疏随机投影将梯度压缩到低维子空间，在子空间中进行向量级距离度量以计算可靠性权重，实现高效鲁棒聚合。

Result: 服务器计算复杂度降至O(Mp)，达到理论下界；非凸函数收敛率为O(1/√T)，强凸函数收敛率为O(1/T)；拜占庭误差仅膨胀(1+ε)/(1-ε)倍；实验实现数量级加速。

Conclusion: PDR能以极小的精度代价实现大幅计算加速，是面向大规模联邦学习的高效抗拜占庭攻击通用框架。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables multiple clients to collaboratively train models without sharing raw data, but it is highly vulnerable to Byzantine attacks. Existing robust approaches can neutralize these threats but incur substantial computational overhead during high-dimensional gradient aggregation, an overhead that scales poorly with model size and increasingly dominates the training cost as modern models grow larger. To address this computational bottleneck, we propose Projected Dimensionality Reduction (PDR), a universal acceleration framework for vector-level distance-based robust aggregators, which performs robust aggregation by compressing gradients into a drastically smaller subspace via sparse random projection to efficiently compute reliability weights. This approach reduces the server computational complexity to an optimal $ \mathcal{O}(Mp) $, where $ M $ is the number of clients and $ p $ is the model dimension, matching the theoretical lower bound required merely to read the gradients. We establish convergence guarantees under standard FL assumptions in prior Byzantine-robust FL analyses. By leveraging the Subspace Embedding Theorem, we show that PDR achieves optimal convergence rates of $ \mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T}) $ for non-convex functions and $ \mathcal{O}(1/T) $ for strongly convex functions, where $ T $ denotes the number of iterations. Crucially, we mathematically demonstrate that this massive acceleration comes almost for free, merely inflating the inherent Byzantine error floor by a bounded, tunable factor of $ \frac{1+ε}{1-ε} $. Experimental results on benchmark datasets confirm that integrating PDR with existing aggregators yields orders of magnitude speedups in time efficiency while maintaining highly competitive convergence performance.

</details>


### [1052] [Representation Signatures and Risk-Feedback Alignment in LLM Trading Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.28850)
*Weicheng Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过TradeArena测试平台研究LLM智能体在金融决策环境中的行为对齐与表征动态，发现规划嵌入漂移、融合表示分离及有效秩收缩等故障前兆信号，并验证了结构化风险反馈作为外部对齐信号的有效性及局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM智能体在金融决策中的应用缺乏系统性的失效前兆分析与行为对齐研究，尤其是在市场压力条件下的表征动态变化尚不明确。

Method: 构建TradeArena可审计交易智能体测试平台，包含风险报告、执行模拟、记忆与可回放轨迹；使用哈希、LSA、Transformer及白盒隐藏状态探针等多种方法分析规划嵌入漂移、融合表示分离与有效秩收缩等表征动态；通过无思维链、词汇控制、OHLCV噪声及虚假审计等压力测试验证鲁棒性。

Result: 发现故障前存在规划嵌入漂移、融合表示分离及有效秩收缩的一致模式；无思维链时理由层收缩消失；真实审计反馈改善部分模型的校准度或其他模型的收益，但存在相关盲区（理由层解释耦合资产暴露而风险层限制）。

Conclusion: 可审计的风险反馈与表征轨迹能够揭示LLM金融推理何时对齐、漂移或失效，支持研究性主张而非盈利性主张。

Abstract: We study behavioral alignment and representation dynamics of large language model (LLM) agents in financial decision environments. TradeArena, an auditable trading-agent testbed with risk reports, execution simulation, memory, and replayable trajectories, lets us analyze how rationales, positions, and interventions evolve under market stress. Code and data artifacts are available through the \href{https://github.com/weich97/TradeArena.git}{TradeArena repository}. We find pre-failure signatures: planning embeddings drift from normal centroids, fused plan-risk representations separate normal from pre-drawdown states, and local manifolds exhibit effective-rank contraction. Across 80 rolling failure anchors and eight LLM trajectories, this pattern persists across hash, LSA, Transformer, and white-box hidden-state probes. Stress tests with CoT-free target weights, lexical controls, OHLCV noise, and false audits show that rationale-level contraction can vanish without rationales, while intent-space and fused signatures remain informative. Structured risk feedback can act as an external alignment signal without fine-tuning, but not as a universal performance enhancer: true audit feedback improves calibration for some models, returns for others, and exposes cases where placebo or hidden feedback has higher short-horizon return but weaker alignment diagnostics. A 51-stock intraday experiment reveals a correlation blind spot: LLM rationales justify exposure to coupled assets that the risk layer clips. Finally, a financial-audit task suite shifts comparison from ``which model trades best'' to whether models can audit trajectories, respect execution boundaries, reproduce artifacts, and avoid claim overreach. These results support a research claim, not a profitability claim: auditable risk feedback and representation trajectories reveal when LLM financial reasoning is aligning, drifting, or failing.

</details>


### [1053] [Ensemble Score Filtering for Real-Data Energy Consumption Forecast Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29072)
*Ruoyu Hu,Dahai Yu,Feng Bao,Guang Wang,Guannan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出利用集成得分滤波器（EnSF）对预训练的黑箱时空能耗预测模型进行数据同化校正，在部分、含噪观测下显著优于传统EnKF方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际能耗数据往往存在不完整、含噪声或延迟的问题，单纯的预测模型在长时域上不可靠，需要结合数据同化方法进行序贯修正，以提高状态估计精度。

Method: 将预训练的时空预测模型视为状态传播器，采用EnSF进行数据同化；EnSF利用基于得分的扩散模型近似滤波分布，通过闭式得分表示和蒙特卡洛近似避免重训练神经网络得分模型。

Result: 开环传播的预测模型在长时域上不可靠，EnSF校正显著提升状态估计精度；在非线性观测设置下，EnSF比EnKF提供更强的校正效果。

Conclusion: EnSF能有效融合部分、含噪观测来修正黑箱预测模型的轨迹，在能耗数据的高维数据同化问题中表现优于传统EnKF。

Abstract: Accurate estimation and forecasting of energy consumption are important for power-system operation, planning, and demand-side management. In practice, however, complete and timely measurements may not always be available, and the observed data can be partial, noisy, or delayed. This motivates the use of learned forecasting models for predicting the evolving consumption state, together with data assimilation methods for sequential forecast correction. In this work, we study a high-dimensional data assimilation problem for real energy-consumption data. \modeltext{The forward prediction is supplied by a pretrained black-box spatio-temporal forecasting model, which is treated as the state propagator in the filtering procedure.} We employ the Ensemble Score Filter (EnSF) to assimilate partial and noisy observations and to correct the forecast trajectory over time. The EnSF uses score-based diffusion models to approximate filtering distributions and avoids retraining neural-network score models during assimilation by using a closed-form score representation and Monte Carlo approximation. Numerical experiments demonstrate that open-loop propagation of the learned forecasting model can become unreliable over long horizons, while EnSF-based correction substantially improves state estimation. Comparisons with the Ensemble Kalman Filter (EnKF) further show that EnSF provides stronger correction under the nonlinear observation setting considered in this work.

</details>


### [1054] [TIMEGATE: Sustainable Time-Boxed Promotion Gates for Continual ML Adaptation Under Resource Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29183)
*Abhijit Chakraborty,Suddhasvatta Das,Yash Shah,Vivek Gupta,Kevin A. Gary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TIMEGATE是一种策略管理层，通过预算时间、标注、训练和评估来管理ML系统的持续适应过程。它发出度量可用性信号M用于部分vs完全评估决策。实验验证了：标注优于训练2.3倍；在LLaMA-3.1-8B+QLoRA上迁移（准确率0.80→0.96）；M信号具有信息量；100轮模拟实现66%评估计算节省且无静默误提升；10%切片评估在H200上节省89%的墙钟时间和能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML系统在持续适应过程中，每次重新训练周期都会消耗计算资源、标注资源和能源，需要一种策略来优化这些资源的分配和使用。

Method: 提出TIMEGATE策略管理层，通过预算时间、标注、训练和评估来管理适应过程，并发出度量可用性信号M用于决定进行部分评估还是完全评估。

Result: (i) 标注优于训练2.3倍；(ii) 迁移到LLaMA-3.1-8B+QLoRA准确率从0.80提升至0.96；(iii) M信号具有信息量；(iv) 100轮模拟实现66%评估计算节省且无静默误提升；(v) 10%切片评估在H200上节省89%墙钟时间和能耗，比率一致性达0.2%。

Conclusion: TIMEGATE通过智能分配资源，在保持模型性能的同时显著节省计算和能源成本，为持续学习中的资源优化提供了有效方案。

Abstract: As machine learning(ML) systems evolve to continual adaptation, each re-training cycle uses compute, annotation, and energy. We introduce TIMEGATE, a policy layer managing adaptation by budgeting time, labeling, training, and evaluation. TIMEGATE emits a metric-availability signal M for partial vs. full-evaluation decisions. We validate: (i) labeling outperforms training by 2.3x on Adult tabular; (ii) it transfers to LLaMA-3.1-8B + QLoRA on SST-2 (accuracy 0.80 to 0.96; M =1 in 35/36 runs); (iii) M is informative, 28-cell sensitivity shows M drops to 0.81 at tight thresholds; (iv) 100-cycle simulation achieves 66% evaluation-compute savings with no silent mis-promotions; (v) 10%-slice evaluation on LLaMA uses 89% less wall-clock and energy on a single H200 (ratios agree to 0.2%).

</details>


### [1055] [BlockBatch: Multi-Scale Consensus Decoding for Efficient Diffusion Language Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29233)
*Xiaoyou Wu,Cheng-Jhih Shih,Binfei Ji,Yong Liu,Yingyan Celine Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BlockBatch，一种无需训练的在线推理框架，通过并行执行多个不同块大小的分支来加速扩散语言模型推理，利用块大小分支的互补性，平均减少26.6%的去噪NFE并实现1.33倍端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型在块级推理中存在粒度权衡：小块保留局部条件但需多步去噪，大块并行度高但易过早承诺且累积缓存误差。现有方法为每个请求选择单一块大小，未利用不同块大小之间的互补性。

Method: 提出BlockBatch框架，核心包括：(1) 置信度门控的token合并；(2) 领导者同步机制；(3) 周期性全序列刷新以将局部块更新锚定到全局一致的KV状态。在单个批处理前向传递中并行执行多个块大小分支。

Result: 在3种代表性dLLM和4个数据集上，BlockBatch平均减少26.6%的去噪NFE，相比Fast-dLLM实现1.33倍端到端加速，同时保持准确性。

Conclusion: 块大小多样性是一种实用且此前未被充分探索的轴，可用于分支并行扩散语言模型推理。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising multiple token positions in parallel, offering an attractive alternative to strictly autoregressive decoding. In practice, however, block-wise dLLM inference exposes a difficult granularity trade-off: small blocks preserve local conditioning but require many denoising steps, whereas large blocks expose more parallelism but can make premature commitments and accumulate cache error. Existing acceleration methods typically choose a single block size per request, leaving the complementarity among block sizes unused. We show that block size itself is a useful branching dimension. Different block sizes induce related but non-identical KV-cache trajectories: branches often share an initial prefix, bifurcate at semantically decisive positions, and later agree on syntactically lightweight tokens. Motivated by this structure, we propose BlockBatch, a training-free online inference framework that executes multiple block-size branches for the same request inside a batched forward pass. BlockBatch coordinates these branches through confidence-gated token merging, leader-based synchronization, and periodic full-sequence refreshes that re-anchor local block updates to a globally consistent KV state. Across 3 representative dLLMs and 4 datasets, BlockBatch reduces denoising NFEs by 26.6\% on average and achieves a 1.33$\times$ average end-to-end speedup over Fast-dLLM while preserving accuracy. These results identify block-size diversity as a practical and previously underexplored axis for branch-parallel dLLM inference.

</details>


### [1056] [Robust Frequency-Calibrated Virtual EEG Channel Generation from Four Frontal Electrodes for Wearable EEG Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29263)
*Minghao Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FAVC-Net，一种紧凑的频率校准虚拟通道网络，仅从4个额叶电极（Fp1, Fp2, F7, F8）生成13个未测量的EEG通道，通过联合优化时域保真度、频谱分配和抗扰动能力，在PRED+CT数据集上实现最优的波形-频谱联合性能，尤其将频谱距离和KL散度分别降低30.09%和37.98%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低通道可穿戴EEG（仅4个额叶电极）在长期监测中虽然实用，但空间覆盖稀疏且存在空间偏差，限制了信号分析和诊断能力。现有研究多将稀疏到密集的EEG生成视为纯波形匹配任务，缺乏对频谱保真度和抗干扰能力的联合优化。

Method: FAVC-Net包含以下关键组件：共享多尺度源编码、源状态嵌入、目标条件符号化源块混合、GATv2注意力精炼、注意力一致跳跃融合以及弱Welch功率谱密度校准。该框架将稀疏到密集EEG生成视为双域（时域和频域）增强问题，而非纯波形匹配。

Result: 在PRED+CT数据集上，FAVC-Net取得了最佳波形-频谱联合操作点。时域增益适中，但log谱距离降低30.09%，PSD KL散度降低37.98%（相对于最强非FAVC对照方法）。在可穿戴式源扰动下，模型保持了频谱保真度并抵抗了频谱坍塌。

Conclusion: 虚拟EEG通道生成应被视为双域增强问题。生成的枕区和顶区通道应被解释为源自稀疏额叶测量的频率校准表示，而非独立的物理记录。

Abstract: Low-channel wearable electroencephalography (EEG) is attractive for long-term monitoring, but four frontal electrodes provide only a sparse and spatially biased view of distributed scalp activity. We present FAVC-Net, a compact frequency-calibrated virtual-channel network that generates 13 unmeasured EEG channels from Fp1, Fp2, F7, and F8. The model combines shared multi-scale source encoding, source-state embeddings, target-conditioned signed source-block mixing, GATv2-based attention refinement, attention-consistent skip fusion, and weak Welch power spectral density calibration. Rather than treating sparse-to-dense EEG generation as a purely waveform-matching task, the framework jointly emphasizes amplitude fidelity, spectral allocation, channel-frequency texture, and robustness to corrupted wearable inputs. On the PRED+CT dataset, FAVC-Net achieved the best joint waveform-spectral operating point among neural and interpolation baselines. Its time-domain gains were modest, whereas log-spectral distance and PSD KL divergence were reduced by 30.09% and 37.98% relative to the strongest non-FAVC comparator. Under wearable-like source perturbations, the model preserved spectral fidelity and resisted spectral collapse. These results support virtual EEG channel generation as a dual-domain augmentation problem, while emphasizing that generated posterior and parietal channels should be interpreted as frequency-calibrated representations derived from sparse frontal measurements rather than as independent physical recordings.

</details>


### [1057] [Honest Lying: Understanding Memory Confabulation in Reflexive Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29463)
*Prakhar Dixit,Sadia Kamal,Tim Oates*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了Reflexion型智能体的一种系统性失败模式——记忆虚构（memory confabulation）：智能体会存储自信但错误的自我反思，并在多轮尝试中持续依赖这些错误记忆，即使环境已正确重置。作者提出反射重复率（RRR）指标来检测该问题，并通过程序化故障信号提取替代开放式自我诊断，显著提升了任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 质疑Reflexion型智能体的基本假设——即智能体能够准确诊断自身失败——并证明该假设在多个基准上会系统性失效，智能体的反思性记忆不仅无法纠正错误，反而会强化错误信念。

Method: 1) 提出反射重复率（RRR）指标，检测智能体在多轮尝试中重复依赖错误反思内容的行为；2) 在ALFWorld和HumanEval上验证该现象，发现16个ALFWorld冻结环境和4个HumanEval类似案例；3) 提出替代方案：用程序化提取轨迹级故障信号取代开放式自我诊断。

Result: 在ALFWorld冻结环境中，替代方案将正确目标物体提及率从0%提升至86%，RRR从0.64降至0.10，并成功解决了16个中的3个冻结环境。

Conclusion: 反思性记忆可能强化而非纠正错误信念，单纯依赖自我生成的反思存在根本性局限，需要更可靠的外源故障信号引导。

Abstract: Reflexion-style agents rely on self-generated reflections as memory, implicitly assuming that agents can accurately diagnose their own failures. We show that this assumption can fail systematically: across ALFWorld and HumanEval, agents store confident but incorrect interpretations of the task and continue acting on them across trials, even though the environment resets to the correct task each time. We call this failure mode memory confabulation and introduce the Reflection Repetition Rate (RRR), a log-based metric that detects repeated reliance on incorrect reflective content. Using RRR, we identify 16 frozen environments in ALFWorld, where 0 of 121 reflections mention the correct target object, and 4 analogous cases in HumanEval. Our mitigation replaces open-ended self-diagnosis with programmatic extraction of trajectory-level failure signals, increasing correct object mention from 0% to 86%, reducing RRR from 0.64 to 0.10, and solving 3 of 16 frozen ALFWorld environments, suggesting that reflective memory can reinforce false beliefs rather than correct them.

</details>


### [1058] [Why Larger Models Learn More: Effects of Capacity, Interference, and Rare-Task Retention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29548)
*Jing Huang,Daniel Wurgaft,Rachit Bansal,Laura Ruis,Naomi Saphra,David Alvarez-Melis,Andrew Kyle Lampinen,Christopher Potts,Ekdeep Singh Lubana*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过理论和实验证明，大模型之所以能学到小模型学不到的任务，是因为大模型能够缓解数据引起的资源竞争和梯度干扰，从而更好地学习稀有且复杂的任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究为什么大模型能够学习小模型无法学习的任务，揭示模型规模扩展带来的能力提升背后的根本原因。

Method: 首先提出基于幂律缩放的现象学论证；然后在混合任务的合成数据上研究模型规模的影响；接着在真实场景中预训练OLMo模型（4M到4B参数）进行验证。

Result: 小模型倾向于将神经元分配给高频或低复杂度任务，忽略稀有和复杂任务；大模型通过减少梯度干扰机制，为常见任务分配足够资源使其梯度更新变弱，从而保护稀有任务特征不被覆盖。OLMo实验印证了合成数据的结果。

Conclusion: 大模型的优势源于其对数据驱动瓶颈的缓解能力，这为模型规模选择和训练数据混合策略提供了实践指导。

Abstract: Larger models learn tasks smaller models do not. What drives this phenomenon? We develop a simple phenomenological argument that power-law scaling already suggests that a larger model will be able to learn a part of the data distribution that a smaller model fails to learn, even with infinite training data. To validate this claim and identify its causes, we study the effects of model scaling on a synthetic setup consisting of a mixture of tasks that show monotonic scaling curves. The results point to a data-induced competition over resources (neurons). Specifically, smaller models allocate their neurons to high frequency or low complexity tasks, and so they learn solutions that perform poorly on rare and complex tasks. Moreover, this happens even when solutions capable of expressing the desired task exist. We then assess how a larger model circumvents this data-centric bottleneck, finding that it traces to a reduced interference mechanism: larger models can allocate enough resources to common tasks that the gradient updates for those tasks become weak, which means that they do not overwrite rare-task features as they slowly accumulate. Finally, to further validate these claims, we pretrain OLMo models (4M to 4B parameters) on novel tasks of varying frequency and complexity. The results mirror those from our synthetic data experiments: only the larger OLMo models learn the infrequent and complex tasks, and these larger models embed more task features in their representations and show less gradient interference between tasks. Overall, we offer a data-centric account of why larger models learn tasks that smaller models fail to. This helps explain why larger models are better in practice, and it can inform practical questions concerning model sizing and training data mixtures.

</details>


### [1059] [MIC: Maximizing Informational Capacity in Adaptive Representations via Isotropic Subspace Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.29987)
*Dang Nguyen Hong,Nhi Ngoc-Yen Nguyen,Huy-Hieu Pham*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MIC通过软坍塌正则化（SCR）和频谱各向同性正则化（SIR）优化多粒度嵌入的几何结构，在保持高判别力的同时生成语义密集表示，在高压缩场景下显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多尺度表示学习虽然能实现弹性维度嵌入，但嵌套子空间常面临维度冗余和频谱坍塌问题，导致信息容量下降。

Method: 提出MIC框架，包含两项关键技术：1) 软坍塌正则化（SCR），通过交叉相关惩罚减少前缀子空间与残差子空间之间的冗余；2) 频谱各向同性正则化（SIR），确保低维前缀子空间呈超球面均匀分布。两者通过自蒸馏目标统一优化。

Result: MIC在多个实验场景中显著优于标准基线，特别是在高压缩场景下，维持信息容量的能力最为突出。

Conclusion: 通过各向同性子空间对齐优化多粒度嵌入的几何景观，有效解决了嵌套子空间的冗余与坍塌问题，在高压缩场景下保持高判别力。

Abstract: Although multi-scales representation learning enables elastic-dimension embeddings, nested subspaces often suffer from dimensional redundancy and spectral collapse. To address this, we introduce MIC, a framework that optimizes the geometric landscape of multi-granular embeddings through isotropic subspace alignment. MIC employs Soft Collapse Regularization (SCR) to mitigate redundancy between prefix and residual subspaces via cross-correlation penalties, alongside Spectral Isotropy Regularization (SIR) to ensure hyper-spherical uniformity in low-dimensional prefixes. By unifying these strategies through a self-distillation objective, MIC generates semantically dense representations that maintain high discriminative power. Our experiments demonstrate that MIC significantly outperforms standard baselines, particularly in high-compression scenarios where maintaining informational capacity is most critical.

</details>


### [1060] [Beyond MSE: Improving Precipitation Nowcasting with Multi-Quantile Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30122)
*Gijs van Nieuwkoop,Siamak Mehrkanoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了将确定性降水临近预报模型的训练目标从点态损失（MSE/MAE）改为多分位数回归损失（pinball loss），以SmaAt-UNet为骨干模型在荷兰雷达降水数据上进行实验。结果表明，多分位数训练不仅使中心确定性预报的MSE降低8.6%，还能输出高分位数预报结果，有助于强降水风险预测，且无需改变模型架构或引入生成式采样过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的降水临近预报模型使用MSE或MAE等点态损失函数进行优化，这会导致预报结果过于平滑，对强降水事件的表征能力较差。作者旨在探索一种更优的训练范式，在不引入复杂生成模型或改变架构的前提下，提升确定性预报模型的性能并获取概率信息。

Method: 以SmaAt-UNet为核心模型，在荷兰雷达降水临近预报任务上，分别使用MSE、MAE和多分位数pinball损失进行训练，并对比三种训练策略的预测性能。多分位数回归同时预测多个分位数（如中位数及上下高分位数），从而同时获得确定性预报和概率信息。

Result: 多分位数训练相比MSE训练，测试集MSE降低了8.6%。此外，多分位数模型还能输出高分位数预报结果，这些结果对强降水的风险敏感预测具有实用价值。

Conclusion: 分位数回归为标准的点态损失函数提供了一种简单有效的替代方案，无需新的架构设计或生成式采样过程，即可同时提升确定性预报精度并提供不确定性信息，尤其适用于强降水等风险敏感场景。

Abstract: Deep-learning precipitation nowcasting models are often optimized using pointwise losses such as mean squared error or mean absolute error, which can lead to overly smooth forecasts and poor representation of heavy rainfall. This study investigates whether the predictive performance of an established deterministic nowcasting architecture can be improved by reformulating training as a multi-quantile regression problem. Using SmaAt-UNet as a core model, we compare MSE, MAE, and multi-quantile pinball-loss training on radar precipitation nowcasting over the Netherlands. The results show that multi-quantile training improves the central deterministic forecast, decreasing test-set MSE by 8.6\% compared to a model trained using MSE, while also producing upper-quantile outputs that are useful for risk-sensitive prediction of heavy precipitation. These findings suggest that quantile regression provides a simple alternative to standard pointwise losses without requiring a new architecture or generative sampling procedure. The implementation of our models and training setup is available on \href{https://github.com/gijsvn/Multi-Quantile-Precipitation-Nowcasting}{GitHub}.

</details>


### [1061] [CalArena: A Large-Scale Post-Hoc Calibration Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30188)
*Eugène Berta,David Holzmüller,Francis Bach,Michael I. Jordan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了迄今为止最大规模的后验校准基准（涵盖近2000个实验），通过提出的PHI（Post-Hoc Improvement）指标系统评估了数十种校准方法，发现平滑校准函数优于分箱方法、高维场景需专用多类方法、无校准设计的通用ML模型效果不佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后验校准方法众多但缺乏大规模、标准化的系统比较，小规模和不一致的评估导致难以判断哪些方法在实践中真正有效。

Method: 构建包含表格数据和计算机视觉任务的大规模基准（近2000个实验），覆盖二分类、多分类和大规模分类场景，聚合经典模型、现代深度学习架构和基础模型的预测，在统一框架下实现数十种校准方法，并提出PHI（Post-Hoc Improvement）指标作为传统校准误差估计的替代方案。

Result: 平滑校准函数优于分箱方法；高维场景需要专用多类校准方法；通用机器学习模型若无校准特定设计不具备竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过大规模标准化基准揭示了校准方法在不同场景下的优劣规律，并提供了完整的代码、数据和评估工具以推动后续研究。

Abstract: Reliable probability estimates are critical in many machine learning applications, yet modern classifiers are often poorly calibrated. Post-hoc calibration provides a simple and widely used solution, but the large number of proposed methods, combined with small-scale and inconsistent evaluations, makes it difficult to determine which approaches are truly effective in practice. We introduce a large-scale, standardized benchmark for post-hoc calibration, covering nearly 2000 experiments across tabular and computer vision tasks, including binary, multiclass, and large-scale classification settings. Our benchmark aggregates predictions from a diverse set of classical models, modern deep learning architectures, and foundation models, and provides unified, reproducible implementations of dozens of calibration methods within a common evaluation framework. We argue that Post-Hoc Improvement (PHI) in proper scoring rules offers a principled alternative to traditional calibration error estimators for comparing post-hoc methods, capturing both calibration quality and potential degradation to the model's predictive performance. Using this framework, we conduct the most comprehensive empirical study of post-hoc calibration to date. Our results reveal consistent patterns across domains: smooth calibration functions outperform binning-based approaches, dedicated multiclass methods are essential in high-dimensional settings, and generic machine learning models are not competitive without calibration-specific design. To facilitate future research, we release all data, code, and evaluation tools, providing a plug-and-play benchmark for developing and comparing calibration methods.

</details>


### [1062] [Mean-Field Diffuser: Scaling Offline MARL to Thousands of Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30190)
*Wenhao Li,Xiangfeng Wang,Bo Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MF-Diffuser将扩散规划扩展到多智能体系统，通过在Wasserstein轨迹分布空间中进行规划，利用混沌传播特性，实现了在极端规模（N≥10³）下最优回报的均值场强化学习框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于扩散的规划在单智能体离线强化学习中取得了强结果，但在多智能体系统中由于联合轨迹空间的维度灾难而难以扩展。

Method: 提出MF-Diffuser框架，将轨迹规划提升到Wasserstein轨迹分布空间；设计值加权混沌熵目标以平衡生成逼真度与回报最大化；采用层次化粗到细策略在去噪过程中逐步增长智能体种群。

Result: 在三个均值场RL基准测试（阶段博弈、序列动力学、对抗团队竞争）中，MF-Diffuser在大多数设置下实现了最优回报，在次优离线数据和极端规模（N≥10³）下增益最大。

Conclusion: 建立了端到端次优性界（含四个可解释项），证明均值场近似误差为O(H²/√N)，离线分布偏移不会随种群大小N增长，且生成策略是近似均值场纳什均衡并具有显式收敛保证。

Abstract: Diffusion-based planning has achieved strong results in single-agent offline reinforcement learning, yet scaling to many-agent systems remains intractable due to the curse of dimensionality in the joint trajectory space. We introduce MF-Diffuser, a framework that lifts trajectory planning to the Wasserstein space of trajectory distributions, where the propagation of chaos ensures a small representative subset of agents captures the full population dynamics. Our approach features a value-weighted chaotic entropy objective that reconciles generative fidelity with return maximization, and a hierarchical coarse-to-fine strategy that progressively grows the agent population during denoising. We establish end-to-end suboptimality bounds with four interpretable terms, revealing that mean-field approximation error scales as $O(H^2/\sqrt{N})$ while offline distribution shift provably does not grow with population size $N$, and prove the generated policy is an approximate mean-field Nash equilibrium with explicit convergence guarantees. Experiments on three mean-field RL benchmarks -- spanning stage games, sequential dynamics, and adversarial team competition -- show MF-Diffuser achieves the best return in the majority of settings, with the largest gains on suboptimal offline data and at extreme scales ($N \geq 10^3$).

</details>


### [1063] [Self-Trained Verification for Training- and Test-Time Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.30290)
*Chen Henry Wu,Aditi Raghunathan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出自训练验证（STV）方法，通过让验证器模仿参考解辅助下的自身版本来解决推理模型自我改进中的验证瓶颈问题，在测试时通过验证-精炼循环使困难数学任务准确率翻倍、科学推理任务提升14倍，在训练时通过验证器在环训练（ViL）使pass@1在RL收敛基础上再提升33%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型在测试时（验证-精炼循环）和训练时（自训练）的自我改进均受限于验证器瓶颈：验证器分数膨胀而准确率停滞、反馈过于泛化无法指导改进；自训练则因添加了错误的自我生成数据而失败。核心挑战在于训练验证器捕捉自身错误缺乏训练信号。

Method: 关键发现：模型单独无法捕捉自身错误，但看到参考解后可以。利用这种不对称性构造监督目标，训练验证器模仿一个更知情版本的自身（即能看到参考解的验证器）。在训练时进一步提出验证器在环训练（ViL），在验证-精炼循环内使用STV验证器的反馈对生成器进行强化学习。

Result: 测试时：STV在困难数学任务上使准确率翻倍，在科学推理任务上准确率从1.5%提升至21%（14倍提升），而SFT、RL优化验证器分数甚至元验证器等替代方案均无效。训练时：ViL在RL收敛的生成器基础上使pass@1提升33%，且生成器独立（无验证器）的pass@1相对提升30%。

Conclusion: 推理模型在困难问题上的下一个前沿可能在于如何训练用于验证以及如何与验证协同训练。

Abstract: Self-improvement at scale has been a longstanding goal for reasoning models, and there are two natural places to do it: at test time, through verification-refinement (V-R) loops; and at training time, through self-training methods. Both are gated by the same bottleneck: the verifier.
