We show that this representation is able to accurately predict the fold locations for several simulation clothing datasets. Finally, we also show the strengths of this representation in two relevant applications: semantic labeling and high- and low-level planning. The code and the dataset can be accessed from: https://close-representation.github.io/

</details>


### [1174] [Plan-R1: Safe and Feasible Trajectory Planning as Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.17659)
*Xiaolong Tang,Meina Kan,Shiguang Shan,Xilin Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Plan-R1，一种两阶段轨迹规划框架，将原则对齐与行为学习解耦。第一阶段预训练轨迹预测器学习类人驾驶行为，第二阶段使用基于规则的奖励和GRPO进行微调以对齐安全、舒适等原则。同时针对GRPO在规划中的局限性提出VD-GRPO（方差解耦GRPO），通过中心化+固定缩放替代归一化，保留绝对奖励幅度。在nuBench上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的规划器严重依赖专家演示，缺乏显式安全意识，且可能继承不良驾驶行为（如超速）。受大语言模型成功启发，需要一种将原则对齐与行为学习解耦的规划框架。

Method: 1) 两阶段框架：第一阶段在专家数据上预训练通用轨迹预测器；第二阶段使用基于规则的奖励和GRPO微调模型。2) 提出VD-GRPO，用中心化+固定缩放替代组归一化，保留绝对奖励幅度，解决安全关键目标被抑制的问题。

Result: 在nuPlan基准上，Plan-R1显著提升了规划安全性和可行性，达到SOTA性能，特别是在真实反应式场景中表现突出。

Conclusion: 两阶段范式能保留类人行为的同时增强安全意识、摒弃不良模式；VD-GRPO有效解决了GRPO在规划任务中安全目标被稀释的问题。

Abstract: Safe and feasible trajectory planning is critical for real-world autonomous driving systems. However, existing learning-based planners rely heavily on expert demonstrations, which not only lack explicit safety awareness but also risk inheriting undesirable behaviors such as speeding from suboptimal human driving data. Inspired by the success of large language models, we propose Plan-R1, a two-stage trajectory planning framework that decouples principle alignment from behavior learning. In the first stage, a general trajectory predictor is pre-trained on expert data to capture diverse, human-like driving behaviors. In the second stage, the model is fine-tuned with rule-based rewards using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), explicitly aligning ego planning with principles such as safety, comfort, and traffic rule compliance. This two-stage paradigm retains human-like behaviors while enhancing safety awareness and discarding undesirable patterns from demonstrations. Furthermore, we identify a key limitation of directly applying GRPO to planning: group-wise normalization erases cross-group scale differences, causing rare, high-variance safety-violation groups to have similar advantages as abundant low-variance safe groups, thereby suppressing optimization for safety-critical objectives. To address this, we propose Variance-Decoupled GRPO (VD-GRPO), which replaces normalization with centering and fixed scaling to preserve absolute reward magnitudes, ensuring that safety-critical objectives remain dominant throughout training. Experiments on the nuPlan benchmark demonstrate that Plan-R1 significantly improves planning safety and feasibility, achieving state-of-the-art performance, particularly in realistic reactive settings. Our code is available at https://github.com/XiaolongTang23/Plan-R1.

</details>


### [1175] [A Unified Framework for Probabilistic Dynamic-, Trajectory- and Vision-based Virtual Fixtures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.10239)
*Maximilian Mühlbauer,Bernhard Weber,Sylvain Calinon,Freek Stulp,Alin Albu-Schäffer,João Silvério*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种统一的概率虚拟夹具框架，能够在手动、半自动和全自动模式间无缝切换，通过新颖的概率动态系统虚拟夹具（粗引导）和扩展的概率位置轨迹夹具（精引导），实现了自适应触觉反馈、几何感知和最优阻抗，经多机器人平台和专家用户验证，相比基线方法具有更低的交互力和更好的可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率虚拟夹具能够根据学习或感知的不确定性自适应选择最适合的触觉反馈，但现有方法在手动、半自动与全自动模式间缺乏统一框架。为了在保持人在回路（高精度需求）的同时提升部分任务阶段的自动化效率，亟需一个能够无缝切换多种操作模式的统一框架。

Method: 1) 提出统一框架，支持手动夹具、半自动夹具（人类负责精确操作）和全自动模式间的无缝切换；2) 提出基于概率动态系统的虚拟夹具，用于粗引导阶段，使机器人自主完成任务部分同时保持人在回路；3) 扩展概率位置轨迹夹具，加入自动化能力，实现无缝人机交互、几何感知和最优阻抗增益；4) 扩展视觉伺服夹具，赋予相同的几何感知和阻抗行为。

Result: 在多款机器人上进行验证，包含专家用户评估。展示了不同操作模式、编程简易性，相比基线方法具有更低的交互力和更优的可用性。

Conclusion: 统一概率虚拟夹具框架能够自适应地在手动、半自动和全自动模式间切换，兼顾粗引导与精引导需求，降低了人机交互力，提升了任务效率和用户体验。

Abstract: Probabilistic Virtual Fixtures (VFs) enable the adaptive selection of the most suitable haptic feedback for each phase of a task, based on learned or perceived uncertainty. While keeping the human in the loop remains essential, for instance, to ensure high precision, partial automation of certain task phases is critical for productivity. We present a unified framework for probabilistic VFs that seamlessly switches between manual fixtures, semi-automated fixtures (with the human handling precise tasks), and full autonomy. We introduce a novel probabilistic Dynamical System-based VF for coarse guidance, enabling the robot to autonomously complete certain task phases while keeping the human operator in the loop. For tasks requiring precise guidance, we extend probabilistic position-based trajectory fixtures with automation, allowing for seamless human interaction, geometry-awareness and optimal impedance gains. For manual tasks requiring very precise guidance, we also extend visual servoing fixtures with the same geometry-awareness and impedance behavior. We validate our approach on different robots, including an evaluation with expert users, showcasing operation modes, the ease of programming fixtures and lower interaction forces and favorable usability compared to a baseline.

</details>


### [1176] [RCM-ACT: Imitation Learning with Dynamic RCM Calibration for Autonomous Intraocular Foreign Body Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.19191)
*Yue Wang,Wenjie Deng,Haotian Xue,Di Cui,Yiqi Chen,Mingchuan Zhou,Haochao Ying,Jian Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RCM-ACT模仿学习框架，实现眼内异物自主抓取与定位，在未标定显微镜条件下达到0.686mm平均3D抓取偏差和11/20完整任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有眼内手术机器人依赖手动遥操作，学习曲线陡峭，且面临运动缩放可变和RCM点变化导致的运动学不确定性问题，亟需自主化解决方案。

Method: 提出RCM-ACT框架，包含RCM动态校准模块解决坐标系不一致问题，以及结合动作分块变换器（Action Chunking Transformers）与回合级运动学重对齐的网络架构。仅使用专家演示的立体视觉数据和器械运动学信息进行训练。

Result: 在人工眼模型中完成环形抓取与定位任务，未使用显式深度传感，实现0.686mm平均3D欧氏抓取偏差，20次实验中11次完整任务成功。

Conclusion: 成功实现了未标定显微镜条件下的端到端自主手术操作，为开发能执行复杂眼内手术的智能眼科手术系统提供了可行框架。

Abstract: Intraocular foreign body removal demands millimeter-level precision in confined intraocular spaces, yet existing robotic systems predominantly rely on manual teleoperation with steep learning curves. To address the challenges of autonomous manipulation, particularly kinematic uncertainties from variable motion scaling and Remote Center of Motion (RCM) point variation, we propose RCM-ACT, an imitation learning framework for autonomous intraocular foreign body ring manipulation. Our approach integrates RCM dynamic calibration to resolve coordinate system inconsistencies caused by intraocular instrument variation and introduces the RCM-ACT architecture, which combines action chunking transformers with episode-level kinematic realignment. Trained solely on stereo visual data and instrument kinematics from expert demonstrations in an artificial eye model, RCM-ACT successfully completes ring grasping and positioning tasks without explicit depth sensing. Experimental validation demonstrates the successful implementation of end-to-end autonomy under uncalibrated microscopy conditions, achieving a mean 3-D Euclidean grasp deviation of 0.686 mm and 11/20 full-task successes. The results provide a viable framework for developing intelligent eye surgical systems capable of complex intraocular procedures.

</details>


### [1177] [CrazyMARL: Decentralized Direct Motor Control Policies for Cooperative Aerial Transport of Cable-Suspended Payloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14126)
*Viktor Lorentz,Khaled Wahba,Sayantan Auddy,Marc Toussaint,Wolfgang Hönig*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出CrazyMARL，一种用于多无人机缆系负载协同运输的分散式强化学习框架，在抗干扰、跟踪精度和零样本仿真到现实迁移方面均优于传统方法，尤其在缆索松弛-张紧模式转换等复杂条件下表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多无人机协同运输缆系悬挂负载在灾害救援、精准物流等领域具有重要应用价值，但现有方法多采用刚性连杆简化假设，未能处理缆索松弛-张紧模式转换这一关键挑战，且缺乏应对扰动和非线性负载动力学的有效控制方案。

Method: 提出CrazyMARL，一种分散式强化学习框架，允许多无人机在不依赖全局通信的情况下学习协同控制策略，能够适应缆索动态模式的切换。

Result: 在仿真中，CrazyMARL在恶劣条件下恢复率达80%，远超基线方法的44%；跟踪精度和抗干扰能力均优于经典分散式控制器；成功实现了零样本仿真到现实迁移，在风力、随机外部扰动及缆索松弛-张紧模式转换等恶劣条件下表现出高鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该工作为自主、鲁棒的多无人机团队在非结构化环境中执行复杂负载任务铺平了道路。

Abstract: Collaborative transportation of cable-suspended payloads by teams of UAVs has the potential to enhance payload capacity, adapt to different payload shapes, and provide built-in compliance, making it attractive for applications ranging from disaster relief to precision logistics. However, multi-UAV coordination under disturbances, nonlinear payload dynamics, and slack-taut cable modes remains a challenging control problem. To our knowledge, no prior work has addressed these cable mode transitions in the multi-UAV context, instead relying on simplifying rigid-link assumptions. We propose CrazyMARL, a decentralized RL framework for multi-UAV cable-suspended payload transport. Simulation results demonstrate that the learned policies can outperform classical decentralized controllers in terms of disturbance rejection and tracking precision, achieving an 80% recovery rate from harsh conditions compared to 44% for the baseline method. We also achieve successful zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and demonstrate that our policies are highly robust under harsh conditions, including wind, random external disturbances, and transitions between slack and taut cable dynamics. This work paves the way for autonomous, resilient UAV teams capable of executing complex payload missions in unstructured environments. Code and videos can be found on the website: https://imrclab.github.io/CrazyMARL.

</details>


### [1178] [CLAW: A Vision-Language-Action Framework for Weight-Aware Robotic Grasping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.14143)
*Zijian An,Ran Yang,Yiming Feng,Lifeng Zhou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CLAW框架通过解耦条件评估与动作生成，利用微调CLIP模型监控数字称读数并生成提示，再由π₀流式VLA策略融合多视角视觉信息执行连续机器人动作，在单/双物体抓取等任务中优于传统方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前VLA模型缺乏显式的条件监控机制，难以满足基于数值阈值的精确任务约束（如根据重量停止抓取），其观测到动作的映射隐式受训练数据塑造。

Method: 提出CLAW框架，解耦条件评估与动作生成：1) 微调CLIP模型作为轻量级提示生成器，持续监控数字称读数并根据重量阈值生成离散指令；2) π₀流式VLA策略融合提示与多视角相机观测，生成连续机器人动作。

Result: 在单物体抓取和混合物体双机械臂任务中，CLAW可靠执行基于重量的行为，在各项指标上均优于原始π₀及微调π₀模型。

Conclusion: 将符号化的重量推理与高频视觉运动控制相结合，能显著提升VLA模型在精确任务约束下的表现。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic control, enabling end-to-end policies that ground natural language instructions into visuomotor actions. However, current VLAs often struggle to satisfy precise task constraints, such as stopping based on numeric thresholds, since their observation-to-action mappings are implicitly shaped by training data and lack explicit mechanisms for condition monitoring. In this work, we propose CLAW (CLIP-Language-Action for Weight), a framework that decouples condition evaluation from action generation. CLAW leverages a fine-tuned CLIP model as a lightweight prompt generator, which continuously monitors the digital readout of a scale and produces discrete directives based on task-specific weight thresholds. These prompts are then consumed by $π_0$, a flow-based VLA policy, which integrates the prompts with multi-view camera observations to produce continuous robot actions. This design enables CLAW to combine symbolic weight reasoning with high-frequency visuomotor control. We validate CLAW on three experimental setups: single-object grasping and mixed-object tasks requiring dual-arm manipulation. Across all conditions, CLAW reliably executes weight-aware behaviors and outperforms both raw-$π_0$ and fine-tuned $π_0$ models. A video of our paper is available online https://youtu.be/MuMYj2QgReI.

</details>


### [1179] [Proactive-reactive detection and mitigation of intermittent faults in robot swarms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.19246)
*Sinan Oğuz,Emanuele Garone,Marco Dorigo,Mary Katherine Heinrich*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对机器人蜂群中因网络拓扑瞬变而难以检测的间歇性故障，本文利用自组织神经系统（SoNS）实现持久网络结构，提出基于多路复用网络中自组织备份层与分布式共识的主动-被动结合策略，实现间歇性故障的早期检测与动态路由重规划，并在编队控制场景中验证了高检测精度与低误报率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人蜂群容错研究主要关注永久性故障，忽略了更具挑战性的间歇性故障。原因在于自组织自组织ad-hoc网络中拓扑瞬变且不可预测，使得间歇性故障难以检测。SoNS方法首次使蜂群能够自组织出持久网络结构，为解决间歇性故障检测问题提供了可能。

Method: 提出主动-被动结合策略：(1) 主动层面：在故障发生前自组织动态备份路径，适应主网络拓扑和机器人相对位置的变化；(2) 被动层面：机器人使用一次性似然比检验（one-shot likelihood ratio test）比较多路复用网络中不同路径接收到的信息，实现早期故障检测；(3) 检测到故障后，通信以自组织方式临时重新路由，直至故障恢复。

Result: 在编队控制场景中验证了该方法：(1) 间歇性故障不会破坏期望编队的收敛；(2) 实现了高故障检测准确率；(3) 保持了较低的误报率。

Conclusion: 利用SoNS提供的持久网络结构，所提出的主动-被动策略能够有效解决机器人蜂群中因网络瞬变而难以处理的间歇性故障检测与缓解问题，为在自组织蜂群中实现更鲁棒的容错机制提供了新途径。

Abstract: Intermittent faults are transient errors that sporadically appear and disappear. Although intermittent faults pose substantial challenges to reliability and coordination, existing studies of fault tolerance in robot swarms focus instead on permanent faults. One reason for this is that intermittent faults are prohibitively difficult to detect in the fully self-organized ad-hoc networks typical of robot swarms, as their network topologies are transient and often unpredictable. However, in the recently introduced self-organizing nervous systems (SoNS) approach, robot swarms are able to self-organize persistent network structures for the first time, easing the problem of detecting intermittent faults. To address intermittent faults in robot swarms that have persistent networks, we propose a novel proactive-reactive strategy to detection and mitigation, based on self-organized backup layers and distributed consensus in a multiplex network. Proactively, the robots self-organize dynamic backup paths before faults occur, adapting to changes in the primary network topology and the robots' relative positions. Reactively, robots use one-shot likelihood ratio tests to compare information received along different paths in the multiplex network, enabling early fault detection. Upon detection, communication is temporarily rerouted in a self-organized way, until the detected fault resolves. We validate the approach in representative scenarios of faulty positional data occurring during formation control, demonstrating that intermittent faults are prevented from disrupting convergence to desired formations, with high fault detection accuracy and low rates of false positives.

</details>


### [1180] [LLM Trainer: Automated Robotic Data Generation via Demonstration Augmentation using LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.20070)
*Abraham George,Amir Barati Farimani*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出LLM Trainer，一种利用大语言模型世界知识将少量人类演示（最少一次）自动转化为大规模机器人模仿学习数据集的流水线方法，通过离线标注和在线关键姿态重定向生成新轨迹，并使用汤普森采样优化标注过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人模仿学习需要大量高质量演示数据，而人工收集数据成本高、耗时久。希望利用LLM的世界知识，从极少量人类演示中自动生成大规模多样化数据集，降低数据采集门槛。

Method: 两步分解：(1)离线演示标注——提取关键帧、显著物体和位姿-物体关系；(2)在线关键姿态重定向——根据新场景的初始观测自适应调整关键帧。通过修改关键点扭曲原始演示生成新轨迹并执行，成功则保存。由于标注可跨场景复用，采用汤普森采样优化标注过程以提升生成成功率。此外，将优化的LLM前馈计划与学习的反馈模仿学习控制器组合为集成策略。

Result: 在多种任务上，数据标注方法持续优于专家设计的基线方法。集成策略有效结合前馈计划与反馈控制。在Franka Emika Panda机器人上验证了硬件可行性。

Conclusion: LLM Trainer能以极少量人类演示自动生成大规模机器人训练数据，LLM的世界知识和汤普森采样优化显著提升了数据生成质量和成功率，为机器人学习提供了一种高效的数据生成范式。

Abstract: We present LLM Trainer, a fully automated pipeline that leverages the world knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) to transform a small number of human demonstrations (as few as one) into a large robot dataset for imitation learning. Our approach decomposes demonstration generation into two steps: (1) offline demonstration annotation that extracts keyframes, salient objects, and pose-object relations; and (2) online keypose retargeting that adapts those keyframes to a new scene, given an initial observation. Using these modified keypoints, our system warps the original demonstration to generate a new trajectory, which is then executed, and the resulting demo, if successful, is saved. Because the annotation is reusable across scenes, we use Thompson sampling to optimize the annotation, significantly improving generation success rate. We evaluate our method on a range of tasks, and find that our data annotation method consistently outperforms expert-engineered baselines. We further show an ensemble policy that combines the optimized LLM feed-forward plan with a learned feedback imitation learning controller. Finally, we demonstrate hardware feasibility on a Franka Emika Panda robot. For additional materials and demonstration videos, please see the project website: https://sites.google.com/andrew.cmu.edu/llm-trainer

</details>


### [1181] [Contrastive Representation Regularization for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.01711)
*Taeyoung Kim,Jimin Lee,Myungkyu Koo,Dongyoung Kim,Kyungmin Lee,Changyeon Kim,Younggyo Seo,Jinwoo Shin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出机器人状态感知对比损失（RS-CL），一种轻量级表示正则化方法，通过对齐VLM表示与机器人本体感知状态来增强VLA模型对机器人信号的敏感性，在RoboCasa-Kitchen基准上达到69.7%的SOTA性能，并在真实机器人任务中将成功率从45.0%提升至58.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型虽利用预训练VLM的丰富表示，但其表示对机器人控制信号（如控制动作和本体感知信息）不够敏感，导致性能次优。作者旨在弥合VLM表示与机器人信号之间的鸿沟。

Method: 提出RS-CL（Robot State-aware Contrastive Loss），利用本体感知状态之间的相对距离作为软监督信号，将VLM表示与机器人状态进行对比对齐。该方法作为轻量级正则化项，与原始动作预测目标互补，可无缝集成到标准VLA训练流程中。

Result: 在RoboCasa-Kitchen基准上达到69.7%的SOTA性能；在真实机器人操作任务中，成功率从45.0%提升至58.3%。

Conclusion: RS-CL是一种简单有效的表示正则化方法，能显著提升VLA模型性能，且计算开销小、兼容性强，可作为VLA训练的通用增强组件。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in robot manipulation by leveraging rich representations from pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, their representations arguably remain suboptimal, lacking sensitivity to robotic signals such as control actions and proprioceptive information. To address the issue, we introduce Robot State-aware Contrastive Loss (RS-CL), a simple and effective representation regularization for VLA models, designed to bridge the gap between VLM representations and robotic signals. In particular, RS-CL aligns the representations more closely with the robot's proprioceptive states by using relative distances between the states as soft supervision. Complementing the original action prediction objective, RS-CL enhances control-relevant representation learning, while being lightweight and fully compatible with standard VLA training pipelines. Our empirical results demonstrate that RS-CL substantially improves the performance of state-of-the-art VLA models; it pushes the prior art to 69.7% achieving the state-of-the-art performance on the RoboCasa-Kitchen benchmark, and boosts success rates from 45.0% to 58.3% on challenging real-robot manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [1182] [Feedback Matters: Augmenting Autonomous Dissection with Visual and Topological Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04074)
*Chung-Pang Wang,Changwei Chen,Xiao Liang,Soofiyan Atar,Florian Richter,Michael Yip*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向自主手术组织解剖的反馈驱动框架，通过内窥镜图像推理拓扑变化、引入可见性度量与主动组织操控控制器，结合规划与学习方法，显著提升了解剖自主性、减少了错误并增强了鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有手术机器人反馈机制在处理组织解剖的拓扑与感知挑战方面存在局限，难以适应高度动态的手术环境。

Method: 1) 提出基于内窥镜图像的拓扑变化推理反馈框架；2) 引入量化组织暴露程度的可见性度量；3) 设计主动操控组织以最大化可见性的最优控制器；4) 将上述反馈机制与规划及学习两类解剖方法集成。

Result: 实验表明该框架显著提升了解剖自主性、降低了错误率，并在复杂手术场景中增强了系统鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 结构化拓扑反馈与主动可见性控制能有效弥补现有反馈方法的不足，是提升自主手术系统可靠性的关键途径。

Abstract: Autonomous surgical systems must adapt to highly dynamic environments where tissue properties and visual cues evolve rapidly. Central to such adaptability is feedback: the ability to sense, interpret, and respond to changes during execution. While feedback mechanisms have been explored in surgical robotics, ranging from tool and tissue tracking to error detection, existing methods remain limited in handling the topological and perceptual challenges of tissue dissection. In this work, we propose a feedback-enabled framework for autonomous tissue dissection that explicitly reasons about topological changes from endoscopic images after each dissection action. This structured feedback guides subsequent actions, enabling the system to localize dissection progress and adapt policies online. To improve the reliability of such feedback, we introduce visibility metrics that quantify tissue exposure and formulate optimal controller designs that actively manipulate tissue to maximize visibility. Finally, we integrate these feedback mechanisms with both planning-based and learning-based dissection methods, and demonstrate experimentally that they significantly enhance autonomy, reduce errors, and improve robustness in complex surgical scenarios.

</details>


### [1183] [Seq-DeepIPC: Sequential Sensing for End-to-End Control in Legged Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.23057)
*Oskar Natan,Jun Miura*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Seq-DeepIPC是一种面向足式机器人的时序端到端感知-控制模型，通过多模态感知（RGB-D + GNSS）、时序融合和轻量级编码器实现自主导航，在真实环境中表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将端到端导航从轮式机器人扩展到更通用的足式机器人系统，解决足式机器人在复杂真实环境中的感知与控制集成问题。

Method: 1) 紧耦合多模态感知（RGB-D + GNSS）与时序融合；2) 联合预测语义分割和深度估计以丰富空间特征；3) 使用轻量级编码器适配边缘设备；4) 通过时序GNSS坐标差分分析替代噪声较大的IMU来简化航向估计。

Result: 在机器人狗上的对比和消融实验表明，时序输入提升了感知与控制性能；在合理模型大小下取得竞争性或更优结果；GNSS航向在开阔区域鲁棒，但在高层建筑附近可靠性下降。

Conclusion: Seq-DeepIPC成功将端到端导航扩展到足式机器人，实现了更具时序感知能力的系统，代码将开源在GitHub上。

Abstract: We present Seq-DeepIPC, a sequential end-to-end perception-to-control model for legged robot navigation in real-world environments. Seq-DeepIPC advances intelligent sensing for autonomous legged navigation by tightly integrating multi-modal perception (RGB-D + GNSS) with temporal fusion and control. The model jointly predicts semantic segmentation and depth estimation, giving richer spatial features for planning and control. For efficient deployment on edge devices, we use a lightweight model as the encoder, reducing computation while maintaining accuracy. Heading estimation is simplified by removing the noisy IMU and instead deriving global heading via differential analysis of sequential GNSS coordinates. We collected a larger and more diverse dataset that includes both road and grass terrains, and validated Seq-DeepIPC on a robot dog. Comparative and ablation studies show that sequential inputs improve perception and control in our models, while other baselines do not benefit. Seq-DeepIPC achieves competitive or better results with reasonable model size; although GNSS-only heading is less reliable near tall buildings, it is robust in open areas. Overall, Seq-DeepIPC extends end-to-end navigation beyond wheeled robots to more versatile and temporally-aware systems. To support future research, we will release the codes to our GitHub repo at https://github.com/oskarnatan/Seq-DeepIPC.

</details>


### [1184] [Degeneration of Sliding-Window Factor Graph Optimization into Iterated Extended Kalman Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.00306)
*Baoshan Song,Ruijie Xu,Zhi Zhan,Li-Ta Hsu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文建立了滑窗因子图优化(SW-FGO)与迭代扩展卡尔曼滤波(IEKF)之间的充分条件，通过引入递归因子图优化(Re-FGO)概念，采用两阶段边缘化流程将因子图优化退化为IEKF递推更新，并在马尔可夫假设和单状态窗口下证明了两者的理论等价性。仿真和实车GNSS/INS紧耦合实验验证了Re-FGO精确复现了IEKF的估计行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 澄清SW-FGO与EKF之间长期存在争议的理论关系，建立两者之间的严格数学联系。

Method: 提出Re-FGO概念，采用两阶段边缘化流程，在马尔可夫假设和单状态窗口约束下，从数学上证明因子图优化可退化为IEKF递推更新。

Result: 仿真和实车城市GNSS/INS紧耦合实验表明，Re-FGO精确复现了IEKF的估计行为，验证了理论等价性。

Conclusion: 两阶段边缘化流程是确保结构一致性的基础，成功将基于图的平滑与滤波范式统一在优化原理之下。

Abstract: Sliding window factor graph optimization (SW-FGO) is widely recognized for its robustness, yet its theoretical relationship with the extended Kalman filter (EKF) remains a subject of debate. This paper establishes the sufficient conditions to bridge SW-FGO with the iterated extended Kalman filter (IEKF). We introduce recursive FGO (Re-FGO), a conceptual perspective that employs a two-stage marginalization pipeline to mathematically degenerate the factor graph optimization to the IEKF recursive update. By enforcing the Markov assumption and a single-state window, we prove the theoretical equivalence between the IEKF and Re-FGO. This degeneration is validated through simulations and real-world urban GNSS and INS tightly coupled fusion experiments. The results confirm that Re-FGO exactly reproduces IEKF estimation behavior, demonstrating that the two-stage marginalization pipeline is foundational to enforce structural consistency, thereby successfully uniting graph-based smoothing and filtering paradigms under unified optimization principles.

</details>


### [1185] [RoboBenchMart: Benchmarking Robots in Retail Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.10276)
*Konstantin Soshin,Alexander Krapukhin,Andrei Spiridonov,Gregorii Bukhtuev,Andrey Kuznetsov,Vlad Shakhuro,Denis Shepelev*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RoboBenchMart是一个面向零售暗店环境的开源机器人操作模拟基准，包含程序化布局生成器、轨迹生成管道、评估工具和微调基线模型。实验发现当前通用视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）即使在常见零售任务中仍然表现困难，表明这些模型尚未真正实现跨领域泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人操作基准多集中于桌面或家庭场景，无法检验通用VLA在几何结构、语义和工作流迥异的新领域（如零售暗店）中的真实泛化能力。

Method: 构建了零售暗店环境的模拟基准RoboBenchMart，包含移动机械臂在密集杂乱、多高度深度的杂货物品上执行复杂操作任务。通过生成的轨迹模拟标准微调流程，评估多个当前最先进的通用VLA模型。

Result: 当前最先进的通用VLA模型即使在常见的零售任务上仍然表现困难，说明这些模型尚未真正实现跨领域泛化。

Conclusion: 通用VLA模型在零售领域表现不佳，表明其领域泛化能力仍然有限。RoboBenchMart套件的开源发布将为该方向的进一步研究提供支撑。

Abstract: Most existing robotic manipulation benchmarks focus on tabletop or household scenarios. While these setups have driven impressive progress, it remains unclear whether generalist VLAs that excel there can truly generalize to domains with different geometry, semantics, and workflows. We introduce RoboBenchMart, an open-source simulated benchmark targeting retail dark-store environments, where a mobile manipulator must perform complex manipulation tasks with diverse grocery items. This setting presents significant challenges, including dense object clutter and varied spatial configurations, with items positioned at different heights, depths, and in close proximity. By targeting on the retail domain, our benchmark addresses a setting with strong potential for near-term automation impact. Using generated trajectories, we model a standard, realistic fine-tuning setup for current generalist VLAs and evaluate several state-of-the-art models. We find that they still struggle even on common retail tasks, indicating that these models are not yet truly general across domains. To support further research, we release the RoboBenchMart suite, which includes a procedural store layout generator, a trajectory generation pipeline, evaluation tools, and fine-tuned baseline models.

</details>


### [1186] [RynnVLA-002: A Unified Vision-Language-Action and World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.17502)
*Jun Cen,Siteng Huang,Yuqian Yuan,Kehan Li,Hangjie Yuan,Chaohui Yu,Bohan Hou,Yuming Jiang,Jiayan Guo,Xin Li,Hao Luo,Fan Wang,Deli Zhao,Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: RynnVLA-002是一个统一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）与世界模型框架，通过联合学习环境动力学和动作规划，实现两者的相互增强。在LIBERO仿真基准上达到97.4%的成功率，在真实机器人实验中，世界模型使成功率提升50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型和世界模型通常独立发展，缺乏统一的框架来同时利用环境动力学学习增强动作生成，以及利用动作生成提升视觉理解和图像预测能力。

Method: 提出RynnVLA-002统一框架，包含两个协同模块：世界模型利用动作和视觉输入预测未来图像状态，学习环境物理；VLA模型从图像观测生成后续动作，增强视觉理解并支持世界模型的图像生成。两者在统一框架中联合学习。

Result: 在LIBERO仿真基准上无需预训练即达97.4%成功率；在真实LeRobot实验中，世界模型使整体成功率提升50%。

Conclusion: 统一VLA与世界模型的框架能够实现环境动力学与动作规划的联合学习，两者相互增强，效果优于各自独立运行的模型。

Abstract: We introduce RynnVLA-002, a unified Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and world model. The world model leverages action and visual inputs to predict future image states, learning the underlying physics of the environment to refine action generation. Conversely, the VLA model produces subsequent actions from image observations, enhancing visual understanding and supporting the world model's image generation. The unified framework of RynnVLA-002 enables joint learning of environmental dynamics and action planning. Our experiments show that RynnVLA-002 surpasses individual VLA and world models, demonstrating their mutual enhancement. We evaluate RynnVLA-002 in both simulation and real-world robot tasks. RynnVLA-002 achieves 97.4% success rate on the LIBERO simulation benchmark without pretraining, while in real-world LeRobot experiments, its integrated world model boosts the overall success rate by 50%.

</details>


### [1187] [DIPOLE: Fusing Vision and Geometry for Robust Visuomotor Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.22445)
*Yikai Tang,Haoran Geng,Jindou Jia,Yuxuan Hu,Sheng Zang,Jianfei Yang,Pieter Abbeel,Jitendra Malik*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DIPOLE是一种通过训练时互补模态融合（而非专门架构）的扩散策略，在模拟和真实任务中平均性能提升39.1%，具备跨视觉变化、空间泛化、零样本迁移等能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模仿学习方法在面对测试时条件（如光照、纹理、视角、物体位置或身份）与示范不同的情况时表现欠佳，需要一种能有效融合互补模态以实现策略泛化的方法。

Method: 提出DIPOLE，采用模态级Dropout（每步随机遮蔽一个分支，促使各模态保持信息完整）和轻量级交叉注意力层交换互补线索，在训练时完成模态融合，而非依赖专门的融合架构。

Result: 在18个模拟任务和4个真实任务中，DIPOLE平均优于6个基线方法39.1%；在未见视觉干扰下提升41.5%，随机物体放置下提升15.2%；具备亚厘米级空间泛化、零样本迁移到未见物体等能力。

Conclusion: DIPOLE通过训练时互补融合机制有效提升了视觉运动策略在分布外场景下的鲁棒性和泛化能力，证实了简单机制即可实现强于专门融合架构的效果。

Abstract: Imitation learning has emerged as a crucial approach for acquiring visuomotor skills from demonstrations, where designing effective observation encoders is essential for policy generalization. However, existing methods tend to struggle once test-time conditions differ from the demonstrations, such as changes in lighting, texture, viewpoint, object placement, or object identity. To address this challenge, we propose DIffusion POlicy with compLementarity Encoders (DIPOLE), a visuomotor policy that learns to fuse complementary modalities through a training-time mechanism rather than a specialized fusion architecture. A modality-wise dropout masks one branch at each training step, encouraging each modality to remain individually informative. A lightweight cross-attention layer then exchanges complementary cues between the two. This design endows DIPOLE with five core strengths: stable high performance across diverse tasks, robustness to visual changes, spatial generalization at sub-centimeter precision, emergent capability beyond either modality, and zero-shot transfer to unseen objects. Across 18 simulated and 4 real-world tasks, DIPOLE outperforms six baselines by 39.1% on average, with gains of 41.5% under unseen visual distractors and 15.2% under randomized object placement.

</details>


### [1188] [SpeedAug: Policy Acceleration via Tempo-Enriched Policy and RL Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.00062)
*Taewook Nam,Junmo Cho,Youngsoo Jang,Sung Ju Hwang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SpeedAug框架，通过增强速度的演示学习多样执行节奏的先验策略，再结合强化学习微调优化执行节奏，实现机器人策略的加速执行，在保证成功率的同时显著提升任务吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从人类演示学习的机器人策略执行速度远低于机器人物理能力上限，而现有加速方法通过数据预处理或启发式规则决定执行节奏，未能学习任务最优的执行速度。

Method: SpeedAug首先从速度增强的演示数据中学习包含多样执行节奏的先验策略，再通过强化学习微调引导探索，优化动作轨迹和执行节奏，实现策略加速。

Result: 在机器人操作基准上，SpeedAug显著提高了策略加速的样本效率并保持高成功率；在真实操作任务中，仅用16分钟在线交互便将任务吞吐量提升1.8倍且不降低成功率。

Conclusion: SpeedAug通过结合速度增强演示与强化学习微调，能够有效学习任务最优的执行节奏，实现快速稳定的任务执行，为机器人策略加速提供了一种高效范方法。

Abstract: Robotic policy learning for complex real-world manipulation tasks has seen rapid recent progress, enabled in large part by the ability to collect demonstrations through human operation. However, policies trained from such demonstrations often execute tasks far more slowly than the robot's physical capabilities, as demonstration data is collected under practical constraints that favor conservative, success-oriented trajectories over execution speed. Existing policy acceleration methods determine execution tempo through data preprocessing or heuristic rules, rather than learning execution speed optimized for the task. In this paper, we propose SpeedAug, a policy acceleration framework that enables policies to learn task-optimal execution tempo via reinforcement learning (RL). SpeedAug first learns a tempo-enriched prior policy from speed-augmented demonstrations that captures diverse execution tempos. Building on this tempo-enriched prior, RL fine-tuning guides exploration to refine action trajectories and optimize execution tempo efficiently. Experiments on robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that SpeedAug substantially improves the sample efficiency of policy acceleration while maintaining high success rates, achieving fast and stable task execution. Applied to a real-world manipulation task, SpeedAug improves task throughput by 1.8x using only 16 minutes of online interactions without compromising the success rate.

</details>


### [1189] [LAP: Fast LAtent Diffusion Planner for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.00470)
*Jinhao Zhang,Wenlong Xia,Zhexuan Zhou,Haoming Song,Youmin Gong,Jie Mei*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出LAP框架，在VAE学习到的潜在空间中进行规划，分离高层意图与低层运动学，通过中间特征对齐机制实现单步去噪生成高质量轨迹，在nuPlan上实现SOTA闭环性能并提速10倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在自动驾驶中建模类人驾驶行为时存在两大局限：(1)迭代采样过程导致大量延迟；(2)直接在原始轨迹点上操作迫使模型花费容量在低层运动学而非高层多模态语义上。

Method: (1) 使用VAE学习潜在空间，将高层意图与低层运动学解耦；(2) 引入中间特征对齐机制，弥合高层语义规划空间与向量化场景上下文之间的表征鸿沟；(3) 单步去噪生成高质量规划。

Result: 在nuPlan大规模基准上，LAP在基于学习的规划方法中取得了SOTA闭环性能，推理速度相较于此前SOTA方法提升最多10倍。

Conclusion: LAP通过潜在空间解耦和单步生成有效解决了扩散模型在自动驾驶规划中的延迟和语义表示问题，实现了高效且高质量的规划。

Abstract: Diffusion models have demonstrated strong capabilities for modeling human-like driving behaviors in autonomous driving, but their iterative sampling process induces substantial latency, and operating directly on raw trajectory points forces the model to spend capacity on low-level kinematics, rather than high-level multi-modal semantics. To address these limitations, we propose LAtent Planner (LAP), a framework that plans in a VAE-learned latent space that disentangles high-level intents from low-level kinematics, enabling our planner to capture rich, multi-modal driving strategies. To bridge the representational gap between the high-level semantic planning space and the vectorized scene context, we introduce an intermediate feature alignment mechanism that facilitates robust information fusion. Notably, LAP can produce high-quality plans in one single denoising step, substantially reducing computational overhead. Through extensive evaluations on the large-scale nuPlan benchmark, LAP achieves state-of-the-art closed-loop performance among learning-based planning methods, while demonstrating an inference speed-up of at most 10x over previous SOTA approaches.

</details>


### [1190] [State-Conditional Adversarial Learning: An Off-Policy Visual Domain Transfer Method for End-to-End Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.05335)
*Yuxiang Liu,Shengfan Cao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文针对目标域数据严格离策略、无专家且稀缺的视觉域迁移问题，提出了一种基于状态条件对抗学习的离策略模仿学习框架（SCAL），通过理论分析证明了目标域模仿损失受源域损失与状态条件潜在KL散度的上界约束，实验表明SCAL在自动驾驶场景中实现了鲁棒的迁移和高效的样本利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决视觉域迁移中目标域数据严格离策略、无专家标注且数量稀缺这一现实而困难场景下的端到端模仿学习问题。

Method: 首先理论推导出目标域模仿损失的上界由源域损失与状态条件潜在KL散度组成；据此提出状态条件对抗学习（SCAL），利用基于判别器的条件KL项估计器，在系统状态条件下对齐源域与目标域的潜在分布。

Result: 在基于BARC-CARLA模拟器构建的视觉多样化自动驾驶环境中，SCAL实现了鲁棒的域迁移和良好的样本效率。

Conclusion: SCAL框架在离策略、无专家、数据稀缺的目标域设定下有效实现了视觉域迁移，理论分析与实验结果一致。

Abstract: We study visual domain transfer for end-to-end imitation learning in a realistic and challenging setting where target-domain data are strictly off-policy, expert-free, and scarce. We first provide a theoretical analysis showing that the target-domain imitation loss can be upper bounded by the source-domain loss plus a state-conditional latent KL divergence between source and target observation models. Guided by this result, we propose State- Conditional Adversarial Learning, an off-policy adversarial framework that aligns latent distributions conditioned on system state using a discriminator-based estimator of the conditional KL term. Experiments on visually diverse autonomous driving environments built on the BARC-CARLA simulator demonstrate that SCAL achieves robust transfer and strong sample efficiency.

</details>


### [1191] [Situation-Aware Interactive MPC Switching for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.06182)
*Shuhao Qi,Qiling Aori,Luyao Zhang,Mircea Lazar,Sofie Haesaert*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文通过比较不同MPC公式的交互能力，提出了一种基于神经网络分类器的情境感知切换策略，仅在关键场景使用高级交互MPC，多数场景使用基础MPC，从而在降低计算负载的同时提升整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶在交互式交通场景中面临车辆间相互影响和周围智能体不确定性的挑战，现有MPC方法中高保真交互模型计算成本高，而强交互在实际交通中仅偶发出现，因此需要一种能根据情境需求平衡性能与计算开销的策略。

Method: 首先对不同MPC公式的交互能力进行比较研究并建立层级；在此基础上开发基于神经网络的分类器，用于情境感知地在不同控制器之间切换，仅在罕见但关键的场景中启用最先进的交互MPC，多数场景使用基础MPC。

Result: 情境感知切换策略在显著降低计算负载的同时，有效提升了整体性能。

Conclusion: 通过按需调用适当控制器而非始终使用高计算成本的高级交互MPC，可以在实践中有效平衡自动驾驶交互场景中的性能与计算效率。

Abstract: Autonomous driving in interactive traffic scenarios remains challenging because of the mutual influence among vehicles and the inherent uncertainty of surrounding agents. Several model predictive control (MPC) formulations have been proposed to address this challenge, each adopting a different model of inter-agent interaction. While higher-fidelity interaction models enable more intelligent behavior, they incur substantially greater computational cost. Since strong interactions arise only occasionally in real traffic, a practical strategy for balancing performance and computational overhead is to invoke an appropriate controller based on situational demands. To this end, we first conduct a comparative study to assess and hierarchize the interactive capabilities of different MPC formulations. Building on this hierarchy, we then develop a neural network-based classifier for situation-aware switching among these controllers. We demonstrate that, by invoking the most advanced interactive MPC only in rare but critical situations and relying on a basic MPC in the majority of situations, situation-aware switching substantially improves overall performance while significantly reducing computational load.

</details>


### [1192] [ShelfAware: Real-Time Semantic Localization in Quasi-Static Environments with Low-Cost Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.09065)
*Shivendra Agrawal,Jake Brawer,Ashutosh Naik,Alessandro Roncone,Bradley Hayes*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ShelfAware是一种语义粒子滤波器，通过将场景语义视为类别级别的统计证据而非固定地标，结合深度似然与语义相似度，并利用预计算语义视角进行逆语义提议，在低成本视觉硬件上实现鲁棒的全局定位，在模拟零售环境和真实超市中分别达到97%和显著优于基线的定位成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 室内工作空间准静态，全局几何布局稳定但局部语义持续变化，产生重复几何结构、动态杂乱和感知噪声，使标准视觉定位方法失效。

Method: 提出ShelfAware语义粒子滤波器：(1) 将场景语义视为类别级别的统计证据；(2) 融合深度似然与类别中心的语义相似度；(3) 利用预计算的语义视角库在MCL中执行逆语义提议，实现快速、精准的假设生成。

Result: 模拟零售环境：全局定位成功率97%，跟踪成功率66%（涵盖推车、可穿戴和动态遮挡场景）。真实超市（3500平方英尺）：显著优于几何基线和固定数量语义基线。

Conclusion: 通过分布化语义建模和逆提议机制，ShelfAware消除了几何混淆，为移动和辅助机器人在动态真实环境中的部署提供了无需基础设施的定位方案。

Abstract: Many indoor workspaces are quasi-static: their global geometric layout is stable, but local semantics change continually, producing repetitive geometry, dynamic clutter, and perceptual noise that defeat standard vision-based localization. We present ShelfAware, a semantic particle filter for robust global localization that treats scene semantics as statistical evidence over object categories rather than fixed quantity landmarks. ShelfAware fuses a depth likelihood with a category-centric semantic similarity and uses a precomputed bank of semantic viewpoints to perform inverse semantic proposals inside Monte Carlo Localization (MCL), yielding fast, targeted hypothesis generation on low-cost, vision-only hardware. To demonstrate perception-agnostic scalability, we evaluate ShelfAware across two domains. In a rigorously controlled mock retail environment, ShelfAware achieves a 97% global localization success rate, maintaining the highest tracking success (66%) across cart, wearable, and dynamic occlusion conditions. Furthermore, in a 3,500 sq. ft. operational grocery store leveraging an open-vocabulary vision pipeline, ShelfAware significantly outperforms both geometric and fixed-quantity semantic baselines. By modeling semantics distributionally and leveraging inverse proposals, ShelfAware resolves geometric aliasing, providing an infrastructure-free building block for mobile and assistive robots in dynamic real-world environments.

</details>


### [1193] [Control of a Twin Rotor using Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.13356)
*Zeyad Gamal,Youssef Mahran,Ayman El-Badawy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于TD3强化学习算法的框架，用于控制双旋翼气动系统（TRAS）的俯仰和方位角，实现稳定控制与轨迹跟踪，并通过仿真、抗风扰测试和实验室实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TRAS具有复杂的动力学和非线性特性，传统控制算法难以有效控制；而强化学习在多旋翼控制领域展现潜力，因此探索RL方法解决TRAS控制问题。

Method: 采用Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3)算法训练RL智能体，该算法适用于连续状态和动作空间，且无需系统模型。

Result: 仿真结果表明RL控制方法有效；在风扰等外部干扰下，RL控制器优于传统PID控制器；实验室实物实验进一步验证了控制器在实际环境中的有效性。

Conclusion: 基于TD3的强化学习框架能够有效控制TRAS的俯仰和方位角，实现稳定控制和轨迹跟踪，且在抗干扰能力和实际部署方面均优于传统PID控制方法。

Abstract: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for controlling and stabilizing the Twin Rotor Aerodynamic System (TRAS) at specific pitch and azimuth angles and tracking a given trajectory. The complex dynamics and non-linear characteristics of the TRAS make it challenging to control using traditional control algorithms. However, recent developments in RL have attracted interest due to their potential applications in the control of multirotors. The Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) algorithm was used in this paper to train the RL agent. This algorithm is used for environments with continuous state and action spaces, similar to the TRAS, as it does not require a model of the system. The simulation results illustrated the effectiveness of the RL control method. Next, external disturbances in the form of wind disturbances were used to test the controller's effectiveness compared to conventional PID controllers. Lastly, experiments on a laboratory setup were carried out to confirm the controller's effectiveness in real-world applications.

</details>


### [1194] [Reinforcement Learning Position Control of a Quadrotor Using Soft Actor-Critic (SAC)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.18333)
*Youssef Mahran,Zeyad Gamal,Ayman El-Badawy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的四旋翼飞行器推力矢量控制架构，该架构通过RL agent计算推力百分比及期望俯仰/滚转角，再由PID控制器映射为电机转速，相比直接控制RPM的方法，训练更快且路径跟踪更平滑精准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献主要集中于直接用RL控制四个旋翼的转速，这种方法训练效率较低且控制不够平滑。本文旨在通过控制推力矢量（而非直接控制RPM）来提升训练速度和控制精度。

Method: 采用Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）算法，一种模型无关的离策略随机RL算法。RL agent计算沿四旋翼z轴的总推力百分比以及期望的横滚角（φ）和俯仰角（θ），然后将这些控制信号连同当前偏航角（ψ）发送给姿态PID控制器，由PID控制器映射为电机RPM。

Result: 训练结果表明，所提出的推力矢量控制器相比传统RPM控制器具有更快的训练收敛速度；仿真结果表明，推力矢量控制器在路径跟踪任务上表现出更平滑、更精确的控制效果。

Conclusion: 推力矢量控制架构结合RL与PID控制器，在四旋翼飞行控制中优于直接控制RPM的方法，兼顾了训练效率与跟踪性能。

Abstract: This paper proposes a new Reinforcement Learning (RL) based control architecture for quadrotors. With the literature focusing on controlling the four rotors' RPMs directly, this paper aims to control the quadrotor's thrust vector. The RL agent computes the percentage of overall thrust along the quadrotor's z-axis along with the desired Roll ($φ$) and Pitch ($θ$) angles. The agent then sends the calculated control signals along with the current quadrotor's Yaw angle ($ψ$) to an attitude PID controller. The PID controller then maps the control signals to motor RPMs. The Soft Actor-Critic algorithm, a model-free off-policy stochastic RL algorithm, was used to train the RL agents. Training results show the faster training time of the proposed thrust vector controller in comparison to the conventional RPM controllers. Simulation results show smoother and more accurate path-following for the proposed thrust vector controller.

</details>


### [1195] [Dynamic Entropy Tuning in Reinforcement Learning Low-Level Quadcopter Control: Stochasticity vs Determinism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.18336)
*Youssef Mahran,Zeyad Gamal,Ayman El-Badawy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究了强化学习中的动态熵调节（SAC算法）相较于静态熵和确定性策略（TD3算法）在四旋翼飞行器控制中的效果，结果表明动态熵调节能有效防止灾难性遗忘并提高探索效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索动态熵调节在随机策略强化学习算法中的效果，并与确定性策略算法进行对比，以改善四旋翼飞行器的控制性能。

Method: 使用SAC算法（随机策略，动态熵调节）与TD3算法（确定性策略）进行对比实验，在四旋翼飞行器控制任务中训练并执行确定性动作，比较静态熵、动态熵及确定性策略的表现。

Result: 动态熵调节在四旋翼飞行器控制中展现出积极效果，能够防止灾难性遗忘并提高探索效率。

Conclusion: 动态熵调谐的随机策略算法（SAC）在四旋翼飞行器控制任务上优于静态熵和确定性策略算法（TD3）。

Abstract: This paper explores the impact of dynamic entropy tuning in Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms that train a stochastic policy. Its performance is compared against algorithms that train a deterministic one. Stochastic policies optimize a probability distribution over actions to maximize rewards, while deterministic policies select a single deterministic action per state. The effect of training a stochastic policy with both static entropy and dynamic entropy and then executing deterministic actions to control the quadcopter is explored. It is then compared against training a deterministic policy and executing deterministic actions. For the purpose of this research, the Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) algorithm was chosen for the stochastic algorithm while the Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) was chosen for the deterministic algorithm. The training and simulation results show the positive effect the dynamic entropy tuning has on controlling the quadcopter by preventing catastrophic forgetting and improving exploration efficiency.

</details>


### [1196] [Semantic-Geometric Task Representations for Bimanual Manipulation from Human Demonstrations to Robot Action Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.11460)
*Franziska Herbert,Vignesh Prasad,Han Liu,Dorothea Koert,Georgia Chalvatzaki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种语义-几何图表示方法，结合MPNN编码器和Transformer解码器，从人类演示中学习双臂操作的结构化任务表示，实现任务无关的表示学习，并通过仅微调解码器跨平台迁移，在11个任务上优于多种基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双臂操作中动作顺序、物体参与和交互几何关系在不同执行间变化显著，现有方法难以同时捕获离散语义任务结构与物体中心几何关系的时间演化，且缺乏支持任务推理的紧凑表示。

Method: 构建语义-几何图表示，联合编码物体身份、语义关系和运动历史；采用MPNN编码器（仅处理时间场景图，生成与动作标签解耦的结构化表示）和Transformer解码器（以动作上下文为条件，预测未来动作、关联物体及物体运动）。通过仅微调解码器实现跨平台迁移。

Result: 在11个双臂任务（两个数据集）上，结构化语义-几何表示优于简单序列模型，且优势随任务变异性增大而增长；在真实机器人双臂任务上实现完全成功，优于图消融、Transformer、仅解码器及微调视觉语言模型基线。

Conclusion: 语义-几何解耦表示能学习任务无关特征，支持跨平台迁移和小样本微调；结合概率运动基元可实现真实机器人双臂操作的成功执行。

Abstract: Learning structured task representations from human demonstrations is essential for bimanual manipulation, where action ordering, object involvement, and interaction geometry vary significantly across executions. A key challenge lies in jointly capturing the discrete semantic task structure and the temporal evolution of object-centric geometric relations in a form that supports reasoning over task progression. We introduce a semantic--geometric graph-based task representation that jointly encodes object identities, inter-object semantic relations, and per-object motion histories, via a Message Passing Neural Network (MPNN) encoder and a Transformer-based decoder. The encoder operates solely on the temporal scene graph, producing structured representations decoupled from action labels. The decoder then conditions on action-context to forecast future actions, associated objects, and object motions. This decoupling learns task-agnostic representations, enabling encoder reuse across embodiments through decoder-only finetuning on a small robot dataset. Across eleven bimanual tasks from two datasets, we find that the benefit of structured semantic--geometric representations over simpler sequence-based models grows with task variability in action ordering and object involvement. At deployment, a planner couples the action and motion predictions with learned Probabilistic Movement Primitives, achieving full task success on two real-robot bimanual tasks and outperforming graph ablations, Transformer, decoder-only, and finetuned vision-language model baselines.

</details>


### [1197] [Highly Deformable Proprioceptive Membrane for Real-Time 3D Shape Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.13574)
*Guanyu Xu,Jiaqi Wang,Dezhong Tong,Xiaonan Huang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于光波导传感的软体硅胶膜，通过边缘LED和中心分布的光电二极管感知变形，利用数据驱动模型实时重建3D表面几何，在140mm方形膜上实现90Hz更新率、1.307mm平均重建误差（25mm离面变形）和1.214mm Chamfer距离（75%面内应变）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统视觉方法在低光照或遮挡下退化，而现有的电阻、电容、磁敏等变形感知膜存在结构复杂、大变形下柔顺性不足、易受电磁干扰等问题，因此需要一种高柔顺、抗干扰的本体感知膜来实现3D几何重建。

Method: 设计多层弹性体复合结构，膜边缘集成LED光源，中心区域分布光电二极管（PD）；变形引起光传播路径变化，产生与变形相关的光强信号；通过数据驱动模型（神经网络）将光强信号映射为膜表面几何形状。

Result: 140mm方形膜上实现90Hz实时更新；离面变形（最大25mm）平均重建误差1.307mm；面内应变达75%时平均Chamfer距离1.214mm。

Conclusion: 该光波导本体感知膜可扩展、鲁棒且低剖面，为软体机器人系统中的全局形状感知提供了一种有效解决方案。

Abstract: Reconstructing the three-dimensional (3D) geometry of object surfaces is essential for robot perception, yet vision-based approaches degrade under low illumination or occlusion. This limitation motivates the design of a proprioceptive membrane that conforms to the surface of interest and infers 3D geometry by reconstructing its own deformation. Conventional deformation-aware membranes typically rely on resistive, capacitive, or magneto-sensitive mechanisms, but can suffer from structural complexity, limited compliance during large-scale deformation, and susceptibility to electromagnetic interference. This work presents a soft, flexible, and stretchable proprioceptive silicone membrane based on optical waveguide sensing. The membrane integrates edge-mounted LEDs and centrally-distributed photodiodes (PDs) within a multilayer elastomeric composite. Rich deformation-dependent light-intensity signals are decoded by a data-driven model to recover the membrane geometry. Real-time reconstruction is demonstrated on a customized 140 mm square membrane at an end-to-end update rate of 90 Hz, achieving an average reconstruction error of 1.307 mm for out-of-plane deformation of up to 25 mm. The proposed sensor also demonstrates accurate reconstruction under large in-plane deformation, achieving reliable shape recovery up to 75% strain with an average Chamfer distance of 1.214 mm. The proposed framework provides a scalable, robust, and low-profile solution for global shape perception in deformable robotic systems.

</details>


### [1198] [PLanAR: Planning-Language-Grounded Agentic Reasoning for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.01662)
*Pengyuan Guo,Zhonghao Mai,Zhengtong Xu,Kaidi Zhang,Quan Khanh Luu,Heng Zhang,Zichen Miao,Arash Ajoudani,Zachary Kingston,Qiang Qiu,Yu She*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PLanAR是一个基于规划-语言接口的机器人操作框架，通过定义谓词、动作模式与符号规划，结合逐步验证机制，实现开放词汇的长期操控任务，并在多种机器人平台和任务中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在非结构环境下的长期操控中，难以对变化的场景状态、动作约束和执行结果进行有效推理，纯自然语言推理能力不足。

Method: 提出PLanAR框架，核心是规划-语言接口：用对象谓词表示场景状态、动作模式定义机器人技能（含前置条件和效果）、符号规划提供可执行的中间表征。每步动作后利用机载观测验证符号效果是否达成，支持状态更新、失败检测与重规划。

Result: 在不同机器人平台、VLM后端及多种任务（堆叠、填字游戏、厨房工作流）中展示了强大的真实世界操控能力，同时揭示了当前VLM在具身推理方面的关键局限性。

Conclusion: PLanAR通过结构化的规划-语言接口与逐步验证机制，有效增强了VLM在长期操控任务中的推理与执行鲁棒性，但当前VLM在具身推理上仍存在明显不足。

Abstract: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have enabled increasing progress in real-world robot manipulation. However, long-horizon manipulation in unstructured environments requires VLMs to reason about changing scene states, action constraints, and execution outcomes, which remains difficult with natural language reasoning alone. We present PLanAR, a planning-language-grounded robot agent framework for open-vocabulary, long-horizon manipulation. PLanAR uses a planning-language interface to define the VLM reasoning space: object predicates represent scene states, action schemas specify robot skills with preconditions and effects, and symbolic plans provide executable intermediate representations. This interface enables stepwise verification: after each action, PLanAR uses onboard observations to check whether the expected symbolic effects have been achieved, allowing the VLM-based agent to update task states, detect failures, and replan when execution deviates from expectation. Across robot embodiments, VLM backends, and tasks including stacking, crossword solving, and long-horizon kitchen workflows, PLanAR demonstrates strong real-world capability while revealing key limitations of current VLMs in embodied reasoning.

</details>


### [1199] [Strategizing at Speed: A Learned Model Predictive Game for Multi-Agent Drone Racing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.06925)
*Andrei-Carlo Papuc,Lasse Peters,Sihao Sun,Laura Ferranti,Javier Alonso-Mora*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究了自主无人机竞速中策略规划深度的问题，对比了交互感知的模型预测博弈（MPG）和快速但无交互推理的模型预测控制（MPC），发现MPG在中速表现更好但高速受延迟影响。为此提出学习型模型预测博弈（LMPG），通过摊销模型预测博弈降低延迟，在仿真和硬件实验中均优于两种基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索自主无人机竞速中一个核心问题：智能体在采取行动前应该进行多深的策略规划？即在交互感知策略（考虑对手行为）与快速执行（忽略交互）之间的权衡。

Method: 1) 对比MPG（交互感知但计算慢）与MPC（计算快但无交互推理）；2) 提出LMPG，通过摊销模型预测博弈来降低延迟，从而兼顾交互感知与快速执行。

Result: MPG在中速时优于MPC，但在高速时因延迟失去优势；LMPG在仿真和硬件竞速实验中均优于MPG和MPC两个基线。

Conclusion: 在高速自主无人机竞速中，深度策略规划（交互感知）虽有效，但必须与控制延迟进行权衡；通过学习摊销的方法（LMPG）可以有效缓解这一矛盾，实现更优的竞速表现。

Abstract: Autonomous drone racing pushes the boundaries of high-speed motion planning and multi-agent strategic decision-making. Success in this domain requires drones not only to navigate at their limits but also to anticipate and counteract competitors' actions. In this paper, we study a fundamental question that arises in this domain: how deeply should an agent strategize before taking an action? To this end, we compare two planning paradigms: the Model Predictive Game (MPG), which finds interaction-aware strategies at the expense of longer computation times, and contouring Model Predictive Control (MPC), which computes strategies rapidly but does not reason about interactions. We perform extensive experiments to study this trade-off, revealing that MPG outperforms MPC at moderate velocities but loses its advantage at higher speeds due to latency. To address this shortcoming, we propose a Learned Model Predictive Game (LMPG) approach that amortizes model predictive gameplay to reduce latency. In both simulation and hardware experiments, we benchmark our approach against MPG and MPC in head-to-head races, finding that LMPG outperforms both baselines.

</details>


### [1200] [SceneSmith: Agentic Generation of Simulation-Ready Indoor Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.09153)
*Nicholas Pfaff,Thomas Cohn,Sergey Zakharov,Rick Cory,Russ Tedrake*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SceneSmith是一种层次化智能体框架，能从自然语言提示生成仿真就绪的室内环境，比现有方法生成多3-6倍的物体，碰撞率<2%，物理稳定性达96%，真实感和提示忠实度胜率分别达92%和91%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有仿真环境无法捕捉真实室内空间的多样性和物理复杂性，场景合成方法生成的房间稀疏缺乏密集杂乱、可动家具和物理属性，难以满足机器人操作训练需求。

Method: 采用层次化智能体框架，分阶段构建场景（建筑布局→家具放置→小物体填充），每阶段由VLM智能体（设计师、评论家、协调者）交互完成；集成文本到3D合成（静态物体）、数据集检索（可动关节物体）和物理属性估计。

Result: 比现有方法多生成3-6倍物体；物体间碰撞率<2%；96%物体在物理仿真下保持稳定；205人用户研究中真实感胜率92%，提示忠实度胜率91%。

Conclusion: SceneSmith能生成更丰富、物理逼真的仿真环境，并可用于端到端自动机器人策略评估流程。

Abstract: Simulation has become a key tool for training and evaluating home robots at scale, yet existing environments fail to capture the diversity and physical complexity of real indoor spaces. Current scene synthesis methods produce sparsely furnished rooms that lack the dense clutter, articulated furniture, and physical properties essential for robotic manipulation. We introduce SceneSmith, a hierarchical agentic framework that generates simulation-ready indoor environments from natural language prompts. SceneSmith constructs scenes through successive stages$\unicode{x2013}$from architectural layout to furniture placement to small object population$\unicode{x2013}$each implemented as an interaction among VLM agents: designer, critic, and orchestrator. The framework tightly integrates asset generation through text-to-3D synthesis for static objects, dataset retrieval for articulated objects, and physical property estimation. SceneSmith generates 3-6x more objects than prior methods, with <2% inter-object collisions and 96% of objects remaining stable under physics simulation. In a user study with 205 participants, it achieves 92% average realism and 91% average prompt faithfulness win rates against baselines. We further demonstrate that these environments can be used in an end-to-end pipeline for automatic robot policy evaluation.

</details>


### [1201] [HyperDet: 3D Object Detection with Hyper 4D Radar Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11554)
*Yichun Xiao,Runwei Guan,Jin Jin,Fangqiang Ding*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HyperDet是一个与检测器无关的框架，通过构建任务感知的超4D雷达点云，显著提升了仅用4D雷达进行3D目标检测的性能。该方法在推理时仅需雷达输入，并可与标准3D检测器直接配合使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代4D雷达虽具有天气鲁棒和速度感知能力，但其点云稀疏、噪声大、不稳定，严重限制了仅依赖雷达的3D目标检测性能。现有方法多聚焦于检测器本身改进，而输入层面的雷达点云增强尚未被充分探索。

Method: HyperDet包含三个关键步骤：1）时空累积、跨传感器验证和多普勒引导的运动补偿来精炼短窗环绕视图雷达观测；2）使用LiDAR引导的伪雷达监督（仅训练阶段）进行前景生成式增强，丰富物体几何信息的同时保留测量雷达背景和原生属性；3）雷达感知的物体级数据增强，在几何重定位下保持多普勒一致性。

Result: 在两个公开环绕视图4D雷达数据集上的实验表明，HyperDet在标准3D检测器上相对于原始雷达输入取得了一致的性能提升，验证了输入级雷达增强作为雷达-only 3D检测有效方法的可行性。

Conclusion: 输入层面的雷达点云增强是一种有效的雷达-only 3D目标检测途径，HyperDet作为检测器无关框架具有良好泛化性，推理阶段无需额外传感器依赖。

Abstract: How far can 3D object detection go using 4D radar alone? Despite offering weather-robust and velocity-aware sensing for autonomous perception, modern 4D radar still yields sparse, noisy, and unstable point clouds, limiting radar-only 3D detection. We present HyperDet, a detector-agnostic framework that constructs task-aware hyper 4D radar point clouds before detection. HyperDet first refines short-window surround-view radar observations through spatio-temporal accumulation, cross-sensor validation, and Doppler-guided motion compensation, improving return reliability and temporal coherence. It then performs foreground generative enhancement using LiDAR-guided pseudo-radar supervision available only during training, enriching object geometry while preserving measured radar background and radar-native attributes. During detector training, radar-aware object-level augmentation further preserves Doppler consistency under geometric relocation. At inference time, HyperDet requires radar input alone and can be directly paired with standard 3D detectors. Experiments on two public surround-view 4D radar datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over raw radar inputs across standard 3D detectors, validating input-level radar enhancement as an effective approach to radar-only 3D detection.

</details>


### [1202] [TRANS: Terrain-aware Reinforcement Learning for Agile Navigation of Quadruped Robots under Social Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12724)
*Wei Zhu,Irfan Tito Kurniawan,Ye Zhao,Mitsuhiro Hayashibe*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出TRANS框架，一个基于深度强化学习的四足机器人社交导航框架，通过两阶段训练（地形感知运动控制+社交导航）和三管道设计（TRANS-Loco、TRANS-Nav、TRANS），实现非结构化地形上的四足机器人社交导航，在仿真和硬件实验中均验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统四足导航方法将运动规划与运动控制分离，忽视全身约束和地形感知；端到端方法虽更集成但需要高频噪声传感且计算成本高；现有方法大多假设静态环境，无法用于人群场景。因此需要一种既能感知地形又能处理社交交互的集成导航框架。

Method: 提出两阶段训练框架，包含三个DRL管道：(1) TRANS-Loco：使用非对称Actor-Critic模型实现四足运动控制，无需显式地形或接触观测即可穿越不平坦地形；(2) TRANS-Nav：使用对称Actor-Critic框架进行社交导航，直接将变换后的LiDAR数据映射到差速驱动运动学下的智能体动作；(3) TRANS：统一管道，集成TRANS-Loco和TRANS-Nav，支持不平坦且社交交互环境中的地形感知四足导航。

Result: 在运动控制和社交导航基线上的综合基准测试证明了TRANS的有效性；硬件实验进一步验证了其从仿真到真实环境的迁移潜力。

Conclusion: TRANS框架成功实现了四足机器人在非结构化地形上的社交感知导航，解决了传统方法中运动控制与导航分离、缺乏地形感知以及无法处理动态社交环境的问题，且具备sim-to-real迁移能力。

Abstract: This study introduces TRANS: Terrain-aware Reinforcement learning for Agile Navigation under Social interactions, a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for quadrupedal social navigation over unstructured terrains. Conventional quadrupedal navigation typically separates motion planning from locomotion control, neglecting whole-body constraints and terrain awareness. On the other hand, end-to-end methods are more integrated but require high-frequency sensing, which is often noisy and computationally costly. In addition, most existing approaches assume static environments, limiting their use in human-populated settings. To address these limitations, we propose a two-stage training framework with three DRL pipelines. (1) TRANS-Loco employs an asymmetric actor-critic (AC) model for quadrupedal locomotion, enabling traversal of uneven terrains without explicit terrain or contact observations. (2) TRANS-Nav applies a symmetric AC framework for social navigation, directly mapping transformed LiDAR data to ego-agent actions under differential-drive kinematics. (3) A unified pipeline, TRANS, integrates TRANS-Loco and TRANS-Nav, supporting terrain-aware quadrupedal navigation in uneven and socially interactive environments. Comprehensive benchmarks against locomotion and social navigation baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of TRANS. Hardware experiments further confirm its potential for sim-to-real transfer.

</details>


### [1203] [NestRL: A Nested Training Regime for Mutual Adaptation in Human-AI Teaming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.17737)
*Upasana Biswas,Durgesh Kalwar,Subbarao Kambhampati,Sarath Sreedharan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出NestRL——一种基于I-POMDP的分层训练框架，通过让智能体与适应性对手逐层对抗训练，在避免产生不透明伙伴特化策略的同时提升人机协作适应性，在Overcooked环境中超越现有基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法使用静态训练伙伴未能捕获人类队友的适应性行为，而标准多智能体联合训练又会导致不透明的伙伴特化策略，泛化能力差。因此需要一种能建模人类适应性行为同时避免过拟合的训练方法。

Method: 将人机协作建模为交互式部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（I-POMDP），提出NestRL嵌套训练框架：在有限层级I-POMDP中，每层智能体与来自下层的适应性智能体对抗训练，逐层构建，使智能体暴露于适应性行为同时防止不透明协调策略的产生。

Result: 理论分析证明NestRL智能体能避免收敛到伙伴特化策略。在Overcooked环境中，与未见过的适应性智能体和真实人类队友协作时，任务表现均优于当前最优基线方法，且在交互过程中展现出显著更强的适应性。

Conclusion: NestRL通过分层对抗训练有效解决了人机协作中伙伴适应性问题和策略过拟合问题，为人机团队协作提供了一种可行的训练范式。

Abstract: Mutual adaptation is a central challenge in human-AI teaming, as humans naturally adjust their strategies in response to an AI agent's behavior. Existing approaches attempt to approximate human behavior by diversifying training partners; however, these partners are typically static and fail to capture the adaptive nature of human teammates. When agents are trained jointly in standard multi-agent settings, they often converge to opaque coordination strategies that work only with their co-trained partners, leading to poor generalization. To model adaptive human behavior, we formulate human-AI teaming as an Interactive Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (I-POMDP). We propose NestRL, a nested training regime that learns the solution to a finite-level I-POMDP by training agents at each level against adaptive agents from the level below. This exposes agents to adaptive behavior while preventing emergence of opaque coordination strategies. We provide theoretical analysis showing that NestRL agents avoid convergence to partner-specific strategies, and validate this empirically in the Overcooked domain against state-of-the-art baselines. NestRL achieves higher task performance with both unseen adaptive agents and real human teammates, while exhibiting significantly greater adaptability over the course of interaction.

</details>


### [1204] [Interpretable Multimodal Gesture Recognition for Drone and Mobile Robot Teleoperation via Log-Likelihood Ratio Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.23694)
*Seungyeol Baek,Jaspreet Singh,Lala Shakti Swarup Ray,Hymalai Bello,Paul Lukowicz,Sungho Suh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种融合Apple Watch惯性数据与定制手套电容传感信号的多模态手势识别框架，采用基于对数似然比的晚期融合策略，在实现与视觉方法相当性能的同时显著降低计算成本，适用于危险环境下的无人机和移动机器人免手提远程操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 危险环境中（如灾区、工业设施）的操作人员仍需人工介入，而现有的基于视觉的手势识别在遮挡、光照变化和杂乱背景下性能下降，难以满足实际应用需求。

Method: 提出多模态手势识别框架，融合双腕Apple Watch的惯性数据（加速度计、陀螺仪、方向）与定制手套的电容传感信号；设计基于对数似然比（LLR）的晚期融合策略，通过量化各模态贡献实现可解释性；构建包含20种飞机地勤指挥手势的新数据集。

Result: 该框架在性能上与最先进的视觉基线方法相当，但显著降低了计算成本、模型大小和训练时间，适用于实时机器人控制。

Conclusion: 基于传感器的多模态融合是实现手势驱动的移动机器人和无人机免提遥操作的鲁棒且可解释的解决方案，展示了其在危险环境实际应用中的潜力。

Abstract: Human operators are still frequently exposed to hazardous environments such as disaster zones and industrial facilities, where intuitive and reliable teleoperation of mobile robots and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) is essential. In this context, hands-free teleoperation enhances operator mobility and situational awareness, thereby improving safety in hazardous environments. While vision-based gesture recognition has been explored as one method for hands-free teleoperation, its performance often deteriorates under occlusions, lighting variations, and cluttered backgrounds, limiting its applicability in real-world operations. To overcome these limitations, we propose a multimodal gesture recognition framework that integrates inertial data (accelerometer, gyroscope, and orientation) from Apple Watches on both wrists with capacitive sensing signals from custom gloves. We design a late fusion strategy based on the log-likelihood ratio (LLR), which not only enhances recognition performance but also provides interpretability by quantifying modality-specific contributions. To support this research, we introduce a new dataset of 20 distinct gestures inspired by aircraft marshalling signals, comprising synchronized RGB video, IMU, and capacitive sensor data. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework achieves performance comparable to a state-of-the-art vision-based baseline while significantly reducing computational cost, model size, and training time, making it well suited for real-time robot control. We therefore underscore the potential of sensor-based multimodal fusion as a robust and interpretable solution for gesture-driven mobile robot and drone teleoperation.

</details>


### [1205] [Hybrid TD3: Overestimation Bias Analysis and Stable Policy Optimization for Hybrid Action Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01302)
*Thanh-Tuan Tran,Thanh Nguyen Canh,Nak Young Chong,Xiem HoangVan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Hybrid TD3算法，原生处理离散-连续混合动作空间，通过理论分析混合动作中的过估计偏差，引入加权裁剪Q学习目标，在机器人操控任务中实现更优的训练稳定性与竞争性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散-连续混合动作空间中的强化学习对机器人操控构成基础性挑战，现有方法存在可扩展性差和训练不稳定等问题。

Method: 提出Hybrid TD3算法，扩展TD3以原生处理参数化混合动作空间；进行混合动作设定下过估计偏差的严格理论分析，推导双评论家架构下的形式化界；引入加权裁剪Q学习目标，通过边缘化离散动作分布实现偏差缩减并提升策略平滑性。

Result: 实验结果表明Hybrid TD3在训练稳定性和竞争性能上优于现有混合动作基线方法。

Conclusion: Hybrid TD3在理论上建立了混合动作空间的偏差排序，实践上在机器人操控任务中实现了更优的训练稳定性，为离散-连续混合动作空间的强化学习提供了有效解决方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning in discrete-continuous hybrid action spaces presents fundamental challenges for robotic manipulation, where high-level task decisions and low-level joint-space execution must be jointly optimized. Existing approaches either discretize continuous components or relax discrete choices into continuous approximations, which suffer from scalability limitations and training instability in high-dimensional action spaces and under domain randomization. In this paper, we propose Hybrid TD3, an extension of Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) that natively handles parameterized hybrid action spaces in a principled manner. We conduct a rigorous theoretical analysis of overestimation bias in hybrid action settings, deriving formal bounds under twin-critic architectures and establishing a complete bias ordering across five algorithmic variants under synchronized Gaussian error assumptions. Building on this analysis, we introduce a weighted clipped Q-learning target that marginalizes over the discrete action distribution, achieving equivalent bias reduction to standard clipped minimization while improving policy smoothness. Experimental results demonstrate that Hybrid TD3 achieves superior training stability and competitive performance against state-of-the-art hybrid action baselines.

</details>


### [1206] [SPARC: Spatial-Aware Path Planning via Attentive Agent Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02845)
*Sayang Mu,Xiangyu Wu,Bo An*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出关系增强多头注意力（RMHA）机制，通过将曼哈顿距离显式嵌入注意力权重计算，使机器人动态优先处理空间相关邻居的消息，结合距离约束注意力掩码和GRU门控融合，在MAPPO框架下实现端到端训练。在40x40网格、30%障碍密度下从8机器人零样本泛化到128机器人，成功率达75%，领先基线超25个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习式通信方法对所有邻近机器人同等对待，未考虑空间距离差异，导致在需要协调的拥挤区域注意力被稀释，影响多机器人路径规划效率。

Method: 提出RMHA机制：1) 将成对曼哈顿距离嵌入注意力权重计算；2) 采用距离约束注意力掩码过滤远距离消息；3) 使用GRU门控机制融合消息；4) 与MAPPO框架结合实现端到端稳定训练。

Result: 在40x40网格、30%障碍密度场景下，从8机器人零样本泛化至128机器人，成功率达75%，超越最优基线超过25个百分点。消融实验证实距离关系编码是高密度环境下成功率提升的关键因素。

Conclusion: 距离感知的注意力机制能显著提升大规模多机器人路径规划的通信效率与泛化能力，在拥挤场景中尤其有效。

Abstract: Efficient communication is critical for decentralized Multi-Robot Path Planning (MRPP), yet existing learned communication methods treat all neighboring robots equally regardless of their spatial proximity, leading to diluted attention in congested regions where coordination matters most. We propose Relation enhanced Multi Head Attention (RMHA), a communication mechanism that explicitly embeds pairwise Manhattan distances into the attention weight computation, enabling each robot to dynamically prioritize messages from spatially relevant neighbors. Combined with a distance-constrained attention mask and GRU gated message fusion, RMHA integrates seamlessly with MAPPO for stable end-to-end training. In zero-shot generalization from 8 training robots to 128 test robots on 40x40 grids, RMHA achieves approximately 75 percent success rate at 30 percent obstacle density outperforming the best baseline by over 25 percentage points. Ablation studies confirm that distance-relation encoding is the key contributor to success rate improvement in high-density environments. Index Terms-Multi-robot path planning, graph attention mechanism, multi-head attention, communication optimization, cooperative decision-making

</details>


### [1207] [HALO: Learning Human-Robot Collaboration via Heterogeneous-Agent Lyapunov Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.03741)
*Hao Zhang,Yaru Niu,Yikai Wang,Ding Zhao,H. Eric Tseng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对人机协作中人类与机器人之间的理性差距导致策略更新不稳定问题，提出HALO框架，通过Lyapunov稳定性理论约束策略参数空间的收缩，实现去中心化多智能体强化学习的稳定训练，并在仿真和真实人形机器人实验中验证了泛化性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机协作中人类行为与上下文存在多样组合，需要多智能体强化学习提升泛化性和适应性，但机器人与人类之间的异质性导致理性差距，使得去中心化策略更新偏离联合优化目标，独立策略梯度更新易振荡或发散。

Method: 提出HALO框架，在策略参数空间中施加Lyapunov收缩约束，通过最优二次投影矫正去中心化梯度，确保理性差距单调收缩，稳定去中心化MARL学习过程。

Result: 在仿真和真实人形机器人协作实验中，HALO实现了更好的泛化能力和鲁棒性，尤其在协作边界案例中表现突出。

Conclusion: HALO通过Lyapunov认证稳定性有效解决了人机异质性带来的理性差距问题，为开放交互空间中的去中心化多智能体学习提供了稳定且可泛化的解决方案。

Abstract: To improve generalization and resilience in human-robot collaboration (HRC), robots must contend with diverse combinations of human behaviors and contexts, motivating multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). However, inherent heterogeneity between robots and humans creates a rationality gap (RG), where decentralized policy updates deviate from cooperative joint optimization. The resulting learning problem is a general-sum differentiable game, so independent policy-gradient updates can oscillate or diverge without added structure. We propose heterogeneous-agent Lyapunov policy optimization (HALO), a framework that stabilizes decentralized MARL by enforcing Lyapunov-based contraction in policy-parameter space. Unlike Lyapunov-based safe RL, which targets state/trajectory constraints in constrained Markov decision processes, HALO uses Lyapunov certification to stabilize decentralized policy learning. HALO rectifies decentralized gradients via optimal quadratic projections, ensuring monotonic contraction of RG and enabling effective exploration of open-ended interaction spaces. Extensive simulations and real-world humanoid-robot experiments show that this certified stability improves generalization and robustness in collaborative corner cases. Our project website is available at https://HaoZhang-THU.github.io/HALO/.

</details>


### [1208] [Approximate Imitation Learning for Event-based Quadrotor Flight in Cluttered Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07578)
*Nico Messikommer,Jiaxu Xing,Leonard Bauersfeld,Marco Cannici,Elie Aljalbout,Davide Scaramuzza*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出近似模仿学习框架，将事件相机驱动的敏捷无人机飞行策略训练时间从52.44小时降至1.86小时（28倍加速），通过分离表征学习与策略搜索，在离线阶段学习任务特定表征，在线阶段仅依赖轻量状态信息，无需渲染事件数据。仿真与实物实验均验证了方法的有效性，无人机在杂乱环境中飞行速度可达9.8 m/s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机虽有高时间分辨率与低延迟优势，但在机器人学习广泛应用中受限于高频事件数据模拟的高昂计算成本，导致策略训练时间过长。

Method: 核心洞察是将表征学习与策略搜索分离：先利用大规模离线数据集学习任务特定表征空间，再通过仅依赖轻量状态信息的在线交互对策略进行微调，完全消除主动策略搜索阶段的事件渲染需求。

Result: 训练时间从52.44小时缩短至1.86小时（28倍加速）；仿真中性能匹配或超越需完整在线事件渲染的标准模仿学习基线；实物验证中四旋翼无人机在密集杂乱环境中飞行速度达9.8 m/s。

Conclusion: 该框架从根本上解决了事件相机在线训练的计算瓶颈，大幅降低开发开销，使基于事件的控制策略能够扩展到复杂环境，且在部署时无需标准相机或中间表征，直接将事件映射为控制指令。

Abstract: Event cameras offer high temporal resolution and low latency, making them ideal sensors for high-speed robotic applications where conventional cameras suffer from motion blur. However, their widespread adoption in robot learning is severely bottlenecked by the computational cost of simulating high-frequency event data during online training. In this work, we present Approximate Imitation Learning, a novel framework that fundamentally resolves this bottleneck, reducing policy training time for complex, agile drone flight from 52.44 hours to just 1.86 hours - a 28x computational speedup. Our key insight is to separate representation learning from policy search. We first leverage a large-scale offline dataset to learn a task-specific representation space. Subsequently, the policy is fine-tuned through online interactions that rely solely on lightweight state information, completely eliminating the need to render events during the active policy search phase. This training paradigm drastically reduces development overhead and enables event-based control policies to scale to complex environments. Furthermore, our approach eliminates the reliance on standard cameras or intermediate representations during deployment, mapping events directly to control commands. In simulation, our method matches or exceeds the performance of standard imitation learning baselines that require full online event rendering. Finally, we successfully validate the framework in the real world, demonstrating that a policy trained via this ultra-efficient paradigm enables a quadrotor to fly through highly cluttered environments at remarkable speeds of up to 9.8 m/s.

</details>


### [1209] [See, Plan, Rewind: Progress-Aware Vision-Language-Action Models for Robust Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09292)
*Tingjun Dai,Mingfei Han,Tingwen Du,Zhiheng Liu,Zihao Zhang,Zhihui Li,Salman Khan,Jun Yu,Xiaojun Chang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SPR是一个面向机器人操作的进度感知型视觉-语言-动作框架，通过"观察-规划-回溯"闭环机制，将语言指令动态转化为空间子目标序列。在LIBERO基准上超越MolmoAct 5%，在更具挑战的LIBERO-Plus基准上展现出最先进的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作任务中，通过明确、可验证的里程碑来度量任务进度对于鲁棒操作至关重要。这种进度感知能力使模型能够定位当前任务状态、预期中间状态，并在进度停滞时检测和恢复失败。现有方法缺乏这种动态进度感知与错误恢复能力。

Method: SPR框架包含三个核心步骤：Seeing（观察当前状态和即将到来的里程碑），Planning（规划朝向下一个2D路点的轨迹），Rewinding（在监控到进度不符合预期序列时回退到可恢复状态）。该闭环方法无需额外训练数据或辅助模型即可实现鲁棒的错误纠正。

Result: 在LIBERO基准上，SPR比MolmoAct基线高出5%；在LIBERO-Plus基准（包含未见指令和初始状态）上，SPR性能下降最小，超越OpenVLA-OFT和UniVLA，展现出优越的分布外鲁棒性。

Conclusion: SPR框架通过进度感知的闭环机制有效提升了机器人操作的鲁棒性和泛化能力，特别是在分布外场景下表现出最先进的性能，验证了显式进度监控对于机器人操作任务的重要性。

Abstract: Measurement of task progress through explicit, actionable milestones is critical for robust robotic manipulation. This progress awareness enables a model to ground its current task status, anticipate verifiable intermediate states, and detect and recover from failures when progress stalls. To embody this capability, we introduce \textbf{S}ee, \textbf{P}lan, \textbf{R}ewind (SPR), a progress-aware vision-language-action framework that dynamically grounds language instructions into a sequence of spatial subgoals. SPR operates through a continuous core cycle, Seeing the current state and upcoming milestone, Planning a trajectory towards the next 2D waypoint, and Rewinding to a recoverable state upon failure by monitoring progress against the expected sequence. This closed-loop approach enables robust error correction without requiring additional training data or auxiliary models. Extensive experiments demonstrate the framework's effectiveness, generalization and robustness: SPR outperforms the MolmoAct baseline by 5\% on the LIBERO benchmark. On the challenging LIBERO-Plus benchmark with unseen instructions and initial states, SPR achieves state-of-the-art robustness with the smallest performance drop, surpassing OpenVLA-OFT and UniVLA, demonstrating superior out-of-distribution robustness.

</details>


### [1210] [Update-Free On-Policy Steering via Verifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.10282)
*Maria Attarian,Ian Vyse,Claas Voelcker,Jasper Gerigk,Evgenii Opryshko,Anas Almasri,Sumeet Singh,Yilun Du,Igor Gilitschenski*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出UF-OPS方法，通过无更新的在线策略引导，利用验证器函数评估动作成功概率，在不修改基础策略参数的情况下提升行为克隆策略的精细操作能力，在5个真实任务中平均成功率提升49%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为克隆策略虽然广泛应用，但往往脆弱且难以处理精确操作任务，需要一种轻量级、灵活的方法来提升现有黑盒策略的性能。

Method: 首先对基础策略进行初始评估并收集策略 rollout 数据，然后训练验证器函数来预测动作的成功概率，在执行时利用这些验证器引导基础策略选择成功率更高的动作，整个过程无需更新基础策略参数。

Result: 在仿真和真实世界实验中，UF-OPS在5个真实任务上平均比基础策略提升49%的成功率。

Conclusion: UF-OPS是一种轻量灵活的方法，能在不修改黑盒扩散策略参数的前提下有效提升行为克隆策略的操作性能。

Abstract: In recent years, Behavior Cloning (BC) has become one of the most prevalent methods for learning manipulation from human demonstrations. Despite their successes, BC policies are often brittle and struggle with precise manipulation. To overcome these issues, we propose UF-OPS, an Update-Free On-Policy Steering method that enables the robot to predict the success likelihood of its actions and adapt its strategy at execution time. We accomplish this by training verifier functions using policy rollout data obtained during an initial evaluation of the policy. These verifiers are subsequently used to steer the base policy toward actions with a higher likelihood of success. Our method improves the performance of black-box diffusion policies, without changing the base parameters, making it lightweight and flexible. We present results from both simulation and real-world data and achieve an average 49% improvement in success rate over the base policy across 5 real tasks.

</details>


### [1211] [MiNI-Q: A Miniature, Wire-Free Quadruped with Unbounded, Independently Actuated Leg Joints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11537)
*Daniel Koh,Suraj Shah,Yufeng Wu,Dennis Hong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍MiNI-Q^2，一种微型无绳四足机器人，采用独立驱动的机械无界2-DOF腿关节，实现振荡步态和旋转运动，可在2.5cm高度折叠，速度达0.46m/s，具备爬行、爬楼梯、倒置运动、跳跃和后空翻能力，所有设计开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理关节限制在腿足机器人中普遍存在，限制工作空间、约束步态设计并增加硬件损坏风险，亟需一种无界关节的微型四足机器人。

Method: 提出MiNI-Q^2微型无绳四足机器人，采用独立驱动的机械无界2-DOF腿关节，进行机械设计、运动学分析及实验验证。

Result: 机器人可折叠至2.5cm高度，最高速度0.46m/s，成功实现低间隙爬行、爬楼梯、倒置运动、跳跃和后空翻。

Conclusion: 无界关节设计有效克服传统关节限制，无绳架构提升了微型装配可靠性，开源设计促进复现与后续研究。

Abstract: Physical joint limits are common in legged robots and can restrict workspace, constrain gait design, and increase the risk of hardware damage. This paper introduces MiNI-Q^2, a miniature, wire-free quadruped robot with independently actuated, mechanically unbounded 2-DOF leg joints. We present the mechanical design, kinematic analysis, and experimental validation of the proposed robot. The leg mechanism enables both oscillatory gaits and rotary locomotion while allowing the robot to fold to a minimum height of 2.5 cm. Experimentally, MiNI-Q achieves speeds up to 0.46 m/s and demonstrates low-clearance crawling, stair climbing, inverted locomotion, jumping, and backflipping. The wire-free architecture extends our previous Q8bot design, improving assembly reliability at miniature scale. All mechanical and electrical design files are released open source to support reproducibility and further research.

</details>


### [1212] [URDF-Anything+: End-to-End Generation for Simulation-Ready Articulated Assets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14010)
*Zhuangzhe Wu,Yue Xin,Chengkai Hou,Minghao Chen,Yaoxu Lyu,Jieyu Zhang,Shanghang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: URDF-Anything+ 是一个端到端的自回归扩散框架，能够从单张RGB图像直接生成可用于仿真的URDF模型，联合建模部件几何与关节参数，无需多阶段流程或外部检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从视觉观测中恢复铰接物体极具挑战性，因为图像仅提供关于部件几何和运动学结构的部分且模糊的线索。现有方法依赖多阶段流水线、资产库检索或显式部件分割，效率低下且不够直接。

Method: 采用端到端自回归扩散框架，在结构化潜空间中联合建模部件几何与关节参数。模型顺序预测每个铰接部件及其关节参数，并通过终止标记动态确定部件数量，无需外部检索或后处理。

Result: 在大型铰接物体基准上，URDF-Anything+在几何重建质量、关节参数估计和物理可执行性方面均优于先前方法，且效率显著高于现有多阶段方法。生成的URDF可作为忠实数字孪生，实现零样本迁移仿真中训练的操控策略。

Conclusion: URDF-Anything+通过统一的生成框架实现了从单张RGB图像到可执行URDF模型的直接生成，在多项指标上超越现有方法，并支持策略的零样本迁移，展示了其在机器人、物理仿真和交互式虚拟环境中的实用价值。

Abstract: Articulated objects are fundamental for robotics, simulation of physics, and interactive virtual environments. However, recovering them from visual observations is inherently challenging, as images provide only partial and ambiguous cues about both part geometry and their underlying kinematic structure.
